Location: NY-Long Island

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Long Island Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

 

This position is 100% commission based. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. 

  

Benefits for Full-Time roles include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner) 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment)

Location: FL-Tampa

Job Title:  Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio

 

Position Overview

Tampa Radio is looking for a Manager of Engineering who will be responsible for executing all broadcast related engineering functions for Cox Media Group (CMG) radio stations in the local market. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all radio frequency (RF) operations, broadcast and digital distribution systems, studio equipment, tower site operations, IP-based broadcast infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, backup and recovery, and security systems. Planning, execution, and timely completion of all projects, maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring compliance with all FCC, FAA, FEMA, OSHA, and company rules, regulations, and guidelines. Maintain, maximize, and service the station’s transmitter, studio, digital distribution, networking, and station facilities. Advise management in the long-range planning for the replacement, modernization, resilience, and secure operation of station equipment and systems. The Manager of Engineering is responsible for improving operational capabilities and supporting all revenue and audience-producing efforts. They will work closely with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, operations, and other departments in the maintenance and operation of their equipment and technical systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and support all broadcast equipment including transmission systems, transceivers, satellite receivers, and broadcast automation equipment for optimum performance 
  • Mange remote, on-location broadcast scheduling, site coordination, timely broadcast equipment setup and operation.  Safely store and maintain remote broadcast equipment 
  • Document equipment installation, wiring, maintenance, repair, and replacement 
  • Ensure that all projects are properly implemented and executed per agreed-upon schedule 
  • Work varied and extended hours may include some weekends, holidays, on-call, and required local travel for scheduled after-hours projects or when emergencies or failure of critical equipment occurs to the operation of the station 
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems at studio, transmitter, and translator locations 
  • Ensure operation and oversee maintenance of company vehicles with the safety of the operator, other personnel, and the public in mind, according to the guidelines of the station and CMG 
  • Update, improve and implement our business continuity plan and contribute as a member of our crisis management team 
  • Support IP-based broadcast infrastructure, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless systems, AoIP platforms, remote control systems, and monitoring tools
  • Support cybersecurity, patching, endpoint protection, access control, secure configuration, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation practices across critical technical systems
  • Plan and execute preventative maintenance, technology upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization projects that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, and operations teams to understand business needs, solve technical problems, and deliver dependable service-oriented support

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, radio technical operations, media technology, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio operations, automation, audio chains, remote control systems, and digital distribution workflows.
  • Hands-on experience supporting IP-connected infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, NTP, SNMP, and wireless systems.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, patching, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, and secure system configuration.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, especially during outages or time-sensitive station operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, project management, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to support station facilities, transmitter sites, and remote locations as needed.
  • Ability to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support when critical systems require immediate response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Society of Broadcast Engineers certification or relevant IT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or vendor certifications.
  • Experience with radio automation, AoIP systems, HD Radio, high-powered AM/FM transmission, broadcast monitoring/control platforms, or remote broadcast technology.
  • Familiarity with virtualized or cloud-connected infrastructure, Windows Server, Active Directory/Azure, Linux, backup platforms, Fortinet, Cisco, Veeam, Wheatstone, WideOrbit, Burk, or comparable platforms.

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.

  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.

  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law.

Job Title:  Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Broadcast Technology Engineer is responsible for the design, installation, support, and continuous improvement of critical broadcast, production, newsroom, master control, RF, IP, and media technology systems. This role serves as a senior technical resource for integrating traditional broadcast infrastructure with IT, network, automation, cloud, and file-based media workflows. The position helps ensure reliable on-air operations, resilient content delivery, secure technology practices, efficient workflows, and strong collaboration across Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, vendors, and corporate technology teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain, support, and improve master control systems, including playout servers, automation, ingest, transcoding, content delivery, file transfer, monitoring, and interfaces with traffic and scheduling platforms.
  • Support newsroom and production technology workflows, including NRCS platforms, media asset management, shared storage, editing environments, graphics, encoding, streaming, and digital publishing integrations.
  • Provide senior-level support for production control room and studio systems, including production automation, routing, control interfaces, video/audio systems, timing, intercom, graphics, monitoring, and related operational workflows.
  • Partner with IT and network teams to support broadcast network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, ACLs, IP transport, streaming, connectivity, and system interoperability across broadcast and enterprise environments.
  • Lead troubleshooting and incident response for on-air, production, and distribution issues; document root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up steps to improve reliability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Maintain system security and operational readiness through software, firmware, and operating system updates; access control coordination; vulnerability remediation support; backup validation; disaster recovery planning; and compliance with corporate IT and broadcast technology standards.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation, drawings, signal-flow diagrams, system inventories, configuration notes, standard operating procedures, and version records.
  • Collaborate with end users, vendors, Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, and corporate technology teams to design, test, and implement workflow improvements that support reliable content creation, distribution, and live operations.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and technical staff by sharing standards, troubleshooting methods, documentation practices, and operational best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of progressive experience supporting broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, master control, newsroom systems, RF, or related IT/media workflows.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, file-based workflows, IP networking, streaming, encoding/transcoding, shared storage, media asset management, automation, and content delivery systems.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast platforms such as automation, playout, NRCS, editing, graphics, media storage, transcode, streaming, monitoring, and live production systems.
  • Knowledge of FCC requirements, EAS, RF systems, transmitter operations, technical compliance, and applicable broadcast industry standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under time-sensitive, live-broadcast conditions while communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating software, firmware, operating system updates, access controls, backups, documentation, and change-management practices in a mission-critical technology environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, support planned and unplanned work, participate in project execution, and remain effective in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Proficiency with standard productivity tools, technical documentation tools, remote support methods, and common operating systems used in broadcast and media environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred qualifications include experience with cloud or hybrid media workflows, IP-based video transport, automation scripting, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery planning, vendor management, mentoring, and platforms such as Avid, Telestream, Ross, Grass Valley, Harmonic, LiveU, or similar broadcast/media systems.

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Dallas, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: General Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop new business through consistent prospecting, networking, referrals, email, phone calls and face-to-face meetings - minimum of 100 outreach per week
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, marketing leaders and decision-makers
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand a client's business, challenges, goals and target audience
  • Create customized, multi-platform marketing solutions based on each client's needs
  • Sell across Audacy's portfolio, including broadcast, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and other marketing solutions
  • Manage the entire sales process from prospecting and presentation through closing and campaign execution and retainment 
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual sales goals
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and actively look for opportunities to grow existing accounts
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and become a trusted marketing partner to your clients
  • Stay current on industry trends, consumer behavior and new advertising opportunities
  • Work collaboratively with sales management, marketing, programming, digital and other internal teams to deliver successful campaigns
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

Required:

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Overview

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.  
  • Generator testing, fueling and supervision of Generator maintenance.
  • UPS testing and supervision of maintenance.
  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years broadcast engineering experience.
  • Associate’s degree in electronics preferred.
  • IT networking skills preferred.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to provide support 24/7 in case of equipment failure; available to work various hours/days, including weekends and holidays.
  • FCC General Class License or SBE Certifications are a plus.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.
  • Strong verbal and writing communications skills.

  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).
  • Radio or audio industry background a bonus.

  • The Pitch & Prospect Mindset: You enjoy business development. Cold calling, networking, and creating opportunities from scratch energizes you.

  • Essentials: A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

If you're ready to take ownership of your earning potential and bring fresh energy to the Bay Area media landscape, apply today.

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times' Motion Graphics team focuses on elevating how animated graphics and motion design are used in our video journalism. Working in close collaboration with Video, Shows and Graphics, the team responds to the demands of stories and formats across the newsroom—from news explainers and visual investigations to enterprise series and shows.

As a member of Digital News Design's Motion Graphics team, you will focus on work for Shows, a department created to expand the reach of The Times's audio and video shows. You will collaborate with reporters, editors, producers, art directors and show hosts to craft motion assets and visuals for our expanding roster of shows across a range of formats and platforms.

You will be responsible for identifying creative needs and producing a range of design assets, including motion graphics, typography, animations, and MOGRT templates. In consultation with editors and other newsroom leaders, you'll exercise journalistic judgment and visual creativity to innovate and ensure accuracy, clarity, and validity of the content presented. Design team members are expected not only to make exceptional contributions to our journalism, but also to engage with others to foster an environment of learning and constructive dialogue about our work.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

  • Create original designs and craft video toolkits for a range of shows and show formats.

  • Work alongside other Times design teams to ensure consistent visual languages, and develop best practices.

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Co-host a live, personality-driven morning show that delivers compelling storytelling, listener interaction, local content, interviews, and engaging entertainment.
  • Develop and execute daily content plans, recurring features, story arcs, and digital content across social, video, web, and podcast platforms.
  • Voice-track assigned shifts and create commercial, promotional, and endorsement content as needed.
  • Represent WNGC at community events, promotions, concerts, remote broadcasts, and client activities while collaborating across departments to support audience growth and revenue opportunities.
  • Operate the control board, radio automation system, phone system, and other studio equipment, including editing interviews, phone content, and other audio.

  • Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, and professional judgment in a live, deadline-driven environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with a relatable, topical, and occasionally humorous point of view.
  • Understanding of audience retention, content pacing, teasing, show momentum, and the Country radio audience.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.
  • Proficiency creating social media and video content across multiple digital platforms.
  • Creative, prepared, coachable, and able to collaborate effectively within a morning show and across Programming, Promotions, Digital, and Sales with a strong work ethic and team-first mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Country music, Country lifestyle culture, and relevant pop-culture trends.
  • Familiarity with the Athens/North Georgia market and local audience interests.
  • Passion for North Georgia, its communities, and the local audience WNGC serves.
  • Experience creating podcast, video, interview, or social-first content.
  • Prior experience with remote broadcasts, promotions, concerts, community events, or client-facing appearances.

job.title: Director, AI Execution & Operations
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

 

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.
  • Maintain consistent executive communication and reporting cadences.
  • Manage operational relationships with AI vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and service providers.
  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education, professional experience, certifications, and demonstrated success leading technology transformation, AI adoption, operational excellence, automation, and organizational change will be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant work in technology, AI adoption, operational leadership, change management, enterprise program execution, business operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives with executive visibility and measurable business outcomes.
  • Natural curiosity and a track record of applying technology, automation, or AI to solve business problems and improve operational outcomes.
  • Track record of translating business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions and operational improvements.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and applying Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, automation, or related AI technologies in a business environment.
  • Deploying, governing, supporting, or driving adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot and related AI capabilities, or comparable AI platforms.
  • Leading or supporting enterprise AI, Generative AI, automation, digital transformation, or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partnering across business, technology, vendor, and executive stakeholder groups to successfully execute AI initiatives and drive business value.
  • Driving technology adoption, communications, stakeholder engagement, and AI enablement programs.
  • Building executive reporting, KPI frameworks, operational dashboards, and business performance metrics.
  • Measuring AI utilization, productivity gains, business impact, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience building and scaling solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
  • Experience establishing AI governance, adoption, enablement, or value realization frameworks.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience scaling AI initiatives from pilot programs into ongoing business operations.
  • Understanding of enterprise integrations, APIs, connectors, and business process automation.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform technologies, including Power Automate and Power BI.
  • Ability to translate strategic objectives into scalable operational execution.
  • Background in media, broadcasting, advertising technology, revenue technology, or digital operations.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times is an industry leader in visual journalism with reporting that includes extraordinary news coverage, investigations, culture and lifestyle reporting. The Reporter Video team identifies compelling stories and brings the depth and breadth of our news report onto our site and other platforms through video that features the expertise of our world-class journalists.

We are looking for an experienced video editor with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to deliver engaging work on tight deadlines. You will work across a range of newsroom video coverage focused on vertical video storytelling with The Times' world-class journalists on-camera. You have deep experience in breaking and ongoing news coverage, with a track record of creating digitally compelling short-form video journalism.

Your portfolio and work samples should reveal a strong grasp of modern mobile video storytelling, and it should show that you're a quick learner with creative ideas and the ability to work on small or large teams. You are collaborative and solid technically with a solutions mindset, detail oriented, organized and fast.

Please note we have two positions available in the newsroom. Please speak to your expertise and/or interest(s) in your cover letter:

  • News and Enterprise

  • Culture and Lifestyle (music and film to fashion and real estate)

These are in-office positions based in New York and include regular attendance in the office four days each week. We are open to a Senior Video Editor working out of our LA office for the News and Enterprise role only. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Video editing and color correction of news, culture, enterprise and investigative videos featuring reporters from across the newsroom.

  • Collaborate with video journalists and producers in the pre/post production process, including writing, structure and creative execution. Demonstrate excellent news judgment across projects.

  • Work across a range of stories with various newsroom desks including culture and styles, often juggling multiple projects.

  • Work with animators to incorporate animation, motion graphics and house design styles into videos.

  • Experiment with different formats of vertical and mobile visual storytelling.

  • Guide junior staff on edits as needed.

  • You will report to a Senior Producer based in New York.

  • 8+ years of multimedia storytelling, video editing and production experience at a major news video outlet and/or production company. (Minimum 5 years of video editing experience.)

  • Strong digital video editing background.

  • Expertise in Adobe Premiere and Creative Suite.

  • Strong audio editing, mixing and fixing skills for video.

  • Proven ability to craft stories, own video research for a project and edit a video with oversight from managers and senior staff.

  • Thorough knowledge of current events, with experience covering news.

  • The ability to conceive and create fresh original videos related to the news.

  • Must have an impressive portfolio of video editing primarily for digital or broadcast.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience animating and editing animations in Adobe After Effects.

  • A digital first mindset to editing on-platform and for social media.

  • Familiarity with the latest video editing techniques and technologies.

  • The ability to make quick decisions under intense deadlines in a high-pressure newsroom setting.

  • A foundational knowledge of legal, ethical, copyright and usage issues for visuals.

  • Well-versed in the world of social and digital media, with a keen eye on what competitors are doing and what new tools are being used.

job.description:
Job Description:


We are looking for Part-Time News Reporters (~24 hours per week) to join the California Post team.

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, the General Assignment News Reporter will have a focus on breaking exclusive stories and covering major events unfolding in Los Angeles and beyond. From delivering exclusive, engaging, agenda setting stories to covering wildfires, celebrity scandals, local politics, crime, courts and viral moments, this reporter will be on the front line of our coverage in one of the country’s most dynamic and newsworthy cities.

Application Instructions: Applicants should submit a cover letter for consideration.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver exclusive stories and cover breaking news across Los Angeles that drives engagement and audience for the California Post. 

  • Write fast, clean, and compelling copy that aligns with the Post’s distinctive voice and style

  • Spot stories that resonate nationally, especially ones with viral or exclusive potential

  • Develop sources across city agencies, emergency services, and local communities to get the inside track on stories

  • Monitor court filings, public records, and social media for scoops and trending topics

  • Collaborate with editors and fellow reporters to ensure comprehensive and coordinated coverage

  • File updates in real time and across multiple platforms, including web, social, mobile, and video

  • Uphold the highest journalistic standards of accuracy, fairness, and integrity

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom

  • Excellent news judgment and the ability to identify compelling angles others may miss

  • High level of self-motivation, commitment to teamwork and ability to win in a competitive environment

  • Proven ability to report and write on deadline while juggling multiple stories at once

  • Experience covering major metro areas, ideally including public safety, politics, or general assignment

  • Proven experience with WordPress of similar CMS highly preferred

  • Strong sourcing skills and a relentless approach to newsgathering

  • Proficiency in social media and SEO best practices

  • Familiarity with court and public records; ability to navigate legal documents a plus

  • A competitive drive to be first and best on big stories

  • Strong writing and reporting skills are the core of this role

  • On-camera experience is strongly preferred, as we’re looking for reporters who are comfortable discussing and presenting their stories on video to help extend our journalism across digital and social platforms

  • A strong social media presence or following is a plus

  • Spanish or other language fluency is a plus

job.title: Assistant Editor, Data Journalism
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

 

 

The Data Journalism team is looking for an experienced journalist with editing, management and data analysis skills to serve as an assistant editor. You'll help to run a group of data journalists who collaborate across the newsroom. You'll also advise on analyses conducted elsewhere in the newsroom.

You should be obsessed with detail and rigor, display a knack for lifting stories to the next level and care deeply about developing your colleagues' talents. Collaboration is at the heart of this role; the Data Journalism team works with virtually every other desk in the newsroom. We'll expect you to deftly navigate these partnerships, which require crisp communication, a problem-solving attitude and a dash of diplomacy.

This is an in-office position and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week. We have a preference for candidates who will work in New York City, with a secondary preference for Washington, DC.

Important application requirement: Please submit a cover letter that describes your qualifications in the context of three stories (or projects) you helped to shape. For each, please provide a link to the work and describe your contributions in one to three paragraphs. Your cover letter should not exceed four pages in total. Within that limit, you are also welcome to provide a more traditional (but brief) description of your career and talents.

Responsibilities:

  • Help to lead the Data Journalism team

job.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Artist Success
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Artist Success team. You will take technical ownership of the tools that help artists understand their audiences, grow their careers, and help the music industry discover its next stars. You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences
  • Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum
  • Work as a peer to product managers and designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way
  • Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase
  • Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

Experience and Background:

  • 4-6+ years of experience with React and modern frontend development, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and drive best practices; experience with native iOS or Android applications is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL
  • Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI and agentic tools to improve quality and velocity, while applying sound judgment around when human expertise is essential and maintaining code quality, product standards, maintainability, and user experience

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a creative and ambitious student journalist to join its Visuals team for the summer 2027 internship program

The position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in visual journalism and gain hands-on experience producing photography and video in a major newsroom. The intern will help produce compelling still photography and short-form video for the Chronicle’s website and social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts.   • Photograph and film daily and enterprise assignments in coordination with editors and reporters

  • Pitch, shoot, edit and publish short-form videos optimized for social platforms

  • Identify visual storytelling opportunities across beats and social trends

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and the audience team to translate Chronicle journalism into visual stories

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Producer

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

Audacy Houston has a rare full time producer opportunity on 95.7 The Fan. We are searching for a technically sound, organized, content creation focused producer for Payne and Pendergast, Houston’s most recognizable morning sports talk program. Strong communication skills, an intimate knowledge of WideOrbit and all radio production software, understanding of digital and social media platforms, and a full, honest investment in Houston sports and culture are vital for this position. This is a live and local position that requires the producer to be based in the Houston area. Previous producing experience in a medium to large market is ideal, but not necessary.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

This position will also include, but not require or guarantee, additional opportunities and considerations for on air opportunities, paid sales endorsements, and promotional appearances.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Produce and run the audio board for Payne and Pendergast, 6a-10a M-F on 95.7 The Fan
  • Develop a signature “show sound” through the use of music beds, drops, and daily featured audio
  • Help develop topic ideas and content for both on air conversations and social media/digital videos
  • Handle podcasting, live video clipping, social media posting, and other ancillary production  responsibilities for Payne and Pendergast
  • Record and edit daily/weekly press conferences, highlights, and other necessary audio clips to be used for over the air playback
  • Respectfully and responsibly uphold the standards of our brand partnership with the Houston Texans both on-air and on social media
  • Protect the station’s FCC license in all on-air and digital programming
  • Participate in and develop original content for digital and social media platforms
  • Collaborate with Brand Manager and other station staff to develop show benchmarks and participate in station-wide events and promotions
  • Attend regularly scheduled staff meetings and weekly coaching sessions
  • Make appearances to promote the station, show, and sponsors.
  • Travel to station and brand events and broadcasts when required, some of which include: Super Bowl Radio Row, the Army/Navy game, Houston Texans Training Camp, Houston Astros Spring Training, etc.
  • Ensure that promotions and contests are executed properly
  • Other duties as required by management

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • 5+ years Radio Production experience preferred
  • Knowledge of the Houston market preferred
  • Solid audio collection skills and working knowledge of studio audio equipment, including digital systems such as Sound Forge, Audition, & Wide Orbit.
  • Proficiency in social media/digital content creation
  • Willingness and availability to make scheduled appearances for sales and promotional purposes
  • A coachable attitude… this position requires someone who is willing to work at their craft in order to be a valuable part of a winning team
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Position Overview

WPXI Pittsburgh TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
