  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Job Title

Cloud Platform Engineering Intern

Job Description

About People Inc:
People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.

•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry

•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Anti-Abuse
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our Berlin or London office.

Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.

You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. The role combines long-term platform and architecture work with rapid response to new abuse vectors, giving you the opportunity to solve both strategic and time-sensitive engineering problems.

You’ll have significant end-to-end ownership to identify problems, shape solutions and drive projects from the ground up, working directly with engineering and T&S Professionals. If you’re creative, proactive and enjoy being the expert who turns complex problems into effective solutions, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact.

  • Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale
  • Shape the platform architecture and technical strategy, balancing long-term scalability with rapid responses to emerging challenges

  • Own problems end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining solutions to driving projects through delivery
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing cost, latency, complexity, scalability and maintainability
  • Drive architecture discussions, contribute to technical strategy, and improve engineering practices, processes and tooling.
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge of industry best practices in abuse prevention and detection
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (e.g. BigQuery or similar)
  • Knowledge of different API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Strong professional experience with Go; experience with Scala or another language is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience in abuse prevention, fraud detection or Trust & Safety is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

Experience and Background

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven backend systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience in building distributed data processing and ETL pipelines, metrics and supporting ML infrastructure 
  • Experience with microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, security, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble, collaborative, team-first mindset and an eagerness to learn and support your colleagues
  • Bonus point: You love music

About us

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)

  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard

You will develop news writing, producing, reporting, and digital media skills while learning from award-winning staff at WESH 2 News. Spring 2027 Session

•    Department preference
•    Available start and end dates

Available Internships

Newsroom

Interns will work alongside reporters, producers, and news managers to learn skills in nearly all aspects of television news production. Examples include on-scene reporting, producing, video editing, research, and working at the assignment desk.

Production/Studio Operations

Interns will learn the technical aspects of live news broadcasts. Behind-the-scenes training will include learning robotic cameras, floor directing, lighting and show set-ups. Interns are required to be comfortable with height, able to lift light equipment, and work non-traditional hours.

Digital

Interns will learn how newsrooms publish content to digital platforms, analyze real-time online metrics and more. Interns will get the opportunity to research, write, and publish stories for WESH.com.

Weather

Interns must have working knowledge of a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. You will work with our team of meteorologists to learn the skills necessary in creating and delivering forecast information for a television and online audience.

Marketing/Promotions

Interns with an interest in marketing, advertising, promotion, or production will be given hands-on experience in these areas.

Once you are accepted as an intern at WESH-TV, you will receive an instruction packet. Your first day at the station is set aside for orientation and you Must attend this. You will work three days a week, eight hours each shift with varying schedules. During the internship you should always check in with your assigned adviser upon entering the building.

Securing housing and transportation during the internship are the responsibility of the student. WESH-TV cannot offer support in this area.

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. Collaboration is at the heart of this role; you'll pair up with other reporters on virtually every story you pursue. You'll also help these colleagues to level-up their own data skills. And you'll be excited, in turn, about learning from them.

You will have a central role in creating and cleaning these data sources for use in our products. You will help knit together data from different sections of the team to build our understanding of what may happen on election night throughout the year. And you will ensure we have proper observability into how data is being used.

Election Analytics is a multidisciplinary team of reporters, developers, statisticians and modelers who work on written coverage, graphics, our polls and the election-night model. The Graphics Intensive is a unique opportunity for mission-driven students and early career professionals with visual skills to work alongside journalists for a 12-week, full-time program. We seek individuals who bring their own inquisitive nature to develop creative approaches to storytelling, including those who may not have previously considered working in an independent newsroom. Prior journalism experience isn't required — many of our team members have embraced journalism's core fundamentals while at The Times — but you must have a desire to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

The Graphics desk at The New York Times is composed of visual journalists from diverse creative backgrounds, including architecture, cartography, and computer science. We cover all topics across the news cycle, motivated by a shared curiosity. This position is designed to cultivate skills and judgment in the creation of visual stories, including training and regular feedback from team members. Many of our projects are a collective effort, so you will work with a range of people and skill sets.

We are interested in applicants who want to learn how to apply creative and technical skills to a range of journalistic and storytelling assignments. Do you know how to write code to analyze data and produce visualizations? Are you a mapmaker or satellite imagery analyst? Do you use design and illustration to clearly convey complex information? These are the types of people that we seek to develop as potential graphics journalists.

  • Participate in training sessions
  • Collaborate with colleagues across the newsroom
  • Complete work assignments based on team needs and news demands
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, or with design tools like Figma

job.title: Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager of Social Media and Audience Growth. This role is responsible for helping shape and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy.

 

This role drives audience growth, engagement, content distribution, platform innovation, and monetization opportunities across all major social platforms. It will establish enterprise-wide social media standards, identify emerging opportunities, analyze performance trends, and partner with local stations to maximize the impact and reach of CMG journalism across social platforms.

 

This role will work closely with CMG Content Leaders, News Directors, Digital Leaders, Marketing Teams, Sales, and on-air talent to ensure social media supports CMG’s broader audience and content distribution strategy while building audience loyalty and expanding reach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent audience growth across CMG social platforms
  • Increased engagement, referral traffic, and loyalty across key social platforms
  • Strong and consistent execution of social best practices across the company
  • Growth of platform-native, original, vertical, and video content
  • Growth of sustainable social revenue and partnership opportunities
  • Stronger integration of social media into daily newsroom and digital workflows
  • Expanded reach and visibility of CMG journalism and journalists
  • Successful adoption of emerging platforms, formats, and technologies
  • Increased use of data and audience insights to drive social decision-making

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Social Media & Audience Growth

  • Helps develop and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on social platforms, audience behavior, content distribution, and emerging trends
  • Establishes platform standards and best practices
  • Drives audience growth, engagement, and referral traffic
  • Leads innovation in vertical video, platform distribution, and emerging channels
  • Identifies external partnerships and opportunities that could enhance CMG’s social strategy, audience reach, and business objectives

Social Media Strategy & Leadership

  • Provides social platform expertise, audience insights, and recommendations to help shape and continuously refine CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Establishes platform-specific standards, best practices, and publishing guidelines
  • Partners with station leadership to align social efforts with audience, content, and business objectives
  • Identifies emerging platforms, technologies, and audience opportunities

Audience Growth & Engagement

  • Drives measurable audience growth and engagement across social platforms
  • Develops strategies that increase referral traffic and platform loyalty
  • Analyzes audience behavior and engagement patterns
  • Establishes performance benchmarks, key performance indicators, and growth goals
  • Identifies opportunities to reach new audiences and expand the reach of CMG journalism
  • Uses data and audience insights to continuously refine content and distribution strategies

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Content Distribution & Platform Optimization

  • Leads social distribution strategies for breaking news, weather, investigations, community coverage, major events, and other high-impact journalism
  • Creates frameworks that help stations maximize the value and reach of content across platforms
  • Develops best practices for audience engagement, including vertical video, platform-native storytelling, and social-first content
  • Partners with newsroom and digital leaders to integrate social strategy into daily editorial workflows
  • Ensures social content remains aligned with CMG editorial standards

Analytics, Revenue & Innovation

  • Analyzes performance metrics, trends, and audience insights
  • Identifies growth opportunities across social platforms
  • Evaluates platform changes, emerging technologies, and distribution opportunities
  • Leads testing and pilot programs for new social products and initiatives
  • Shares learnings, successful strategies, and best practices across CMG markets

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital audience development, or digital content distribution, preferably within a media, news, or content organization

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

We are looking for a Research Lead with experience ensuring that shopping-centric insights are at the heart of product development. You will lead a variety of end-to-end research projects that inform Wirecutter's strategy. Your projects will focus on helping connect our visitors to Wirecutter across the full shopping experience. Your research will inform audience strategy, content prioritization, and the Wirecutter Store, amongst other areas. You will be an important partner with Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data, Editorial, guiding decision-making and informing the teams' strategies.

We at The New York Times seek the truth and help people understand the world. This mission is rooted in our belief that great journalism has the power to make each reader's life richer and more fulfilling, and all of society stronger and more just.

The mission of the New York Times Audience Insights team is to help The Times grow by understanding our audience. The Audience Insights team is a team of researchers that employ tools, methods and approaches across a wide variety of research domains, including product, human-centered design, innovation, market and UX research, and we draw from principles in the social sciences (Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology and Behavioral Economics). We believe that the best work is achieved when we support healthy work-life balance. We support people in managing their workload and encourage team members to take all of their personal and vacation time each year.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead research through a human-centered design approach to identify opportunity areas, alongside Product, Design, and Editorial teams
  • Test prototypes, create surveys, and run alpha and beta programs
  • Evaluate impact on trust and relationships with Wirecutter
  • Complement research with behavioral data, proprietary and industry research, and A/B testing results to provide a holistic view of our users.
  • Be a resource and partner to researchers across Marketing, Cooking, News Product, The Athletic and Games to identify opportunities to collaborate and avoid duplicative product work.
  • Manage external research vendors to support moderation, fieldwork, and analysis, ensuring high-quality and efficient project execution.
  • Contribute to the collaborative culture of Audience Insights and Wirecutter; help The New York Times understand, and build empathy for, our audiences.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Managing Director, Games and Wirecutter Audience Insights

  • Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science in a relevant field
  • 8+ years of research and insights experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in the e-commerce industry, or shopping experiences.
  • 3+ years of experience moderating qualitative research and facilitating brainstorms and workshops with partners.
  • 3+ years of experience summarizing complex findings into compelling narratives and visualize insights for diverse audiences with actionable insights.

Preferred Qualifications:

job.title: Digital Journalist (Part-Time) - Atlanta Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Digital Journalist (Part-Time) - Atlanta Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Atlanta Radio has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Journalist for WSB-FM News. We are building something big at CMG, connecting audiences to the content they rely on and creating solutions that help our advertisers reach the customers they want to reach. We invite you to join us!

 

This role focuses on researching, reporting, and publishing stories across online platforms, including websites, social media, and mobile apps. Our Digital Journalists work within a 24-hour news cycle, prioritizing speed and real-time updates while integrating multimedia elements such as video, audio, and interactive graphics. The Digital Journalist will engage audiences with timely, compelling content and play a key role in expanding our digital footprint and online engagement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manages the regular flow of timely news content on station websites; engages our audience on major social media platforms; drives traffic to our streaming channels; otherwise assists in growing stations’ online presence.
  • Produces digital content that supports and enhances station initiatives, including writing breaking and trending news articles, creating social media content, contests, newsletters, videos, and podcasts.
  • Collaborates with WSB Programming, News, and Promotions teams.
  • Manages the official social media accounts for WSB, including posting on behalf of the station.
  • Brings an array of original ideas and concepts to help create new content that promotes listener participation, builds the online audience, and supports digital business goals.
  • Managing reader interactions through comments and social media and using analytics (such as click rates) to understand which content resonates.
  • Fact-checking viral claims and identifying misinformation to maintain credibility in a fast-paced environment.
  • Edits video and creates graphics for social media as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in news journalism in broadcast media (or a closely related newsroom environment).
  • Firsthand experience creating digital-first news content in a 24-hour news cycle (breaking and trending coverage with rapid updates).
  • Demonstrated experience managing content across websites, social platforms, newsletters, video, and podcasts.
  • Solid news judgment: the ability to prioritize, spot trends, and decide what to publish quickly and responsibly.
  • Research and reporting skills, including sourcing and verifying information under a deadline.
  • Proven record in fact-checking and the ability to identify misinformation and viral false claims to protect credibility.
  • Proficient writing, editing, proofreading, and copywriting (news, plus lifestyle/entertainment as needed).
  • Ability to manage day-to-day publishing via content management systems (CMS) and to learn new systems quickly.
  • Knowledge in managing and posting for official social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X).
  • Demonstrated audience engagement skills, including managing comments and reader interactions appropriately.
  • Ability to use analytics (e.g., click rates and engagement) to understand what performs well and adjust content accordingly.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

Minimum Qualifications (continued)

  • Adept at supporting digital goals such as increasing traffic, expanding the streaming audience, and strengthening overall online presence.
  • Ability to create/edit multimedia elements, including:
    • Basic video editing (Adobe Premiere or similar)
    • Simple graphics creation (Photoshop or similar)
    • Integrating audio/video/interactive elements into stories when relevant
  • Proven project management, organizational, and attention to detail skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal guidance.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration with Programming, News, and Promotions.
  • Flexibility to work a fluid schedule, including occasional evenings/weekends.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in journalism, digital media, or communications.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
The Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive will support Sony Music’s growth of the physical market across Southeast Asia. The role will support the development and operation of physical sales channels for Vinyl, CDs and other physical products, working across both wholesale/distribution and D2C channels.

The role focuses on developing and operating sales channels, ensuring products are priced appropriately, inventory is forecasted and managed effectively, order are fulfilled and collected, and sales channels are maintained and optimised. This includes supporting the development of D2C infrastructure and storefronts using Shopify.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and grow physical sales channels across Southeast Asian territories, supporting the sale of Vinyl, CDs and other physical products.
  • Manage the day-to-day operational requirements of sales channels, including pricing, inventory management, forecasting, orders, delivery and collection of payments.
  • Support the development and management of wholesale/distribution channels, working with local distributors and retail partners to increase physical distribution and sales.
  • Support the development and operation of D2C sales channels, including the ongoing maintenance and optimisation of Shopify powered storefronts.
  • Act as a key operational contact for local and international stakeholders, working across labels, artist teams, merchandise companies, distributors, retail partner and platform partners.
  • Assist in the delivery of album launches, pre-orders, bundles and release activity across wholesale and D2C sales channels, working closely with artist, label and merchandise company partners.
  • Oversee the operational flow of physical products into sales channels, collaborating with fulfilment, logistics and other partners to maintain high service standards.
  • Support sales channel performance, contributing to sales targets, inventory optimisation, forecasting and commercial performance.

Who you are:

  • 2+ years experience in a physical sales, e-commerce or online retail role.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing sales channels and/or e-commerce stores.
  • Sales and operational experience, ideally with physical music products or consumer products.
  • Experience working with distributors, retail partners and D2C sales channels.
  • Comfortable working across multiple projects, artists and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Strong understanding of sales performance, inventory and forecasting and using data to guide decisions.
  • Highly organised, detail oriented, and confident working with numbers, spreadsheets, and Microsoft tools such as Excel, Teams, and Copilot.  
  • Hands-on Shopify experience.
  • Familiarity with the Southeast Asian retail or consumer landscape is advantageous.

job.title: Backend Engineer - Media Streaming
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for a software engineer to join our Media Streaming Team, with a mission to operate a media streaming platform at global scale, delivering the best possible audio experience to creators, listeners, and partners alike. We are handling petabytes of data and gigabytes per second of traffic. You will join a tightly-knit team where you will help shape how millions of people experience music.  

Read about engineering at SoundCloud

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Contribute to building, scaling and maintaining backend APIs and services that serve millions of users
  • Collaborate closely with Android, iOS, web, and full-stack engineers to deliver seamless end-to-end media experiences
  • Ensure performance, scalability, and maintainability of SoundCloud’s services
  • Debug complex issues across systems, ensuring a consistent experience for users globally
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and roadmap planning
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Experience and Background:

  • 4+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Go
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience with microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, and container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages
  • Knowledge of API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Exposure to media streaming, playback, audio engineering or adjacent domains
  • Familiarity with audio/video codecs, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH), and transport container technologies
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.description:
Job Title

Director, Talent Development

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director, Talent Development is a strategic, hands-on learning and talent leader responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high-impact development experiences across People Inc.. Reporting to the VP, Talent Development, this role partners closely with HR Business Partners, and business leaders, to translate business priorities into practical, engaging, and measurable learning and talent solutions.

The Director will help strengthen manager capability, employee growth, leadership pipelines, and a culture of continuous learning. The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, excellent facilitation presence, modern learning-design expertise, and a demonstrated ability to execute enterprise-wide talent and development initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.


Essential Job Functions

Weight % - Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

Learning Strategy, Program Design, and Facilitation — 40%

  • Design, develop, facilitate, and evaluate learning programs, workshops, leadership offsites, cohort-based experiences, and virtual learning solutions for employees, managers, and leaders.
  • Lead engaging, high-energy, inclusive facilitation for audiences at all levels, adapting delivery in real time based on participant needs, business context, and group dynamics.
  • Conduct needs assessments with HRBPs, leaders, and subject-matter experts to identify capability gaps, performance needs, and development opportunities.
  • Translate business priorities into clear learning objectives, practical curricula, participant materials, facilitator guides, toolkits, and reinforcement resources.
  • Build and evolve learning pathways for key populations, including early-career employees, new and experienced managers, high-potential talent, and senior leaders.
  • Create scalable learning experiences using a blended approach that may include instructor-led training, virtual workshops, on-demand content, peer learning, coaching, mentoring, and experiential development.
  • Apply adult learning principles, inclusive design practices, and sound instructional design methodology to ensure learning is relevant, accessible, engaging, and actionable.
  • Establish clear success measures for learning programs, including participation, learner feedback, knowledge or skill gain, behavior change, manager feedback, and business impact.

Talent Management and Leadership Development — 30%

  • Partner with the VP, Talent Development, HRBPs, and leaders to execute core talent management processes, including performance feedback, goal setting, midyear reviews, year-end reviews, 360-degree feedback, talent calibration, and development planning.
  • Lead the operational planning, communication, tools, resources, training, and stakeholder support required for successful performance management cycles.
  • Support the facilitation and ongoing refinement of the organization’s 9-box talent-review process, helping leaders calibrate performance and potential, identify development priorities, and create actionable follow-up plans.
  • Partner with the HRBP team and business leaders to identify high-potential talent, critical roles, readiness needs, and targeted development actions.
  • Support the design and delivery of succession-planning processes in partnership with the VP, Talent Development, including talent-pipeline development, successor readiness, and individual development planning.
  • Leverage internal or external coaching programs to strengthen manager effectiveness, leadership capability, and individual development.
  • Develop practical tools and resources that help leaders conduct high-quality career conversations, performance discussions, feedback conversations, and development planning.

Talent Consulting and Business Partnership — 20%

  • Serve as a trusted learning and talent development consultant to HRBPs and business leaders, helping diagnose needs and recommend appropriate solutions before escalation to the VP, Talent Development.
  • Partner with HRBPs to develop learning strategies for client groups that support organizational goals, career growth, manager capability, team effectiveness, and employee engagement.
  • Advise leaders on effective approaches to leadership development, change adoption, team dynamics, communication, feedback, influence, and emotional intelligence.
  • Collaborate with the Communications team to develop clear, compelling, and timely messaging that drives awareness, participation, and sustained engagement in learning opportunities.
  • Build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external vendors, facilitators, coaches, and subject-matter experts.
  • Stay current on emerging learning, leadership development, and talent management practices; bring forward practical innovations that fit People Inc’s culture and business needs.

Learning Operations, Technology, and Measurement — 10%

  • Own and optimize the learning management system (LMS) to ensure an intuitive, well-organized, and engaging learner experience.
  • Curate and promote learning playlists, on-demand resources, and development content for employees and managers.
  • Expand and enhance the People Inc. onboarding experience to accelerate new-hire connection, productivity, and cultural integration.
  • Track participation, adoption, learner satisfaction, completion, and other key indicators; synthesize insights and recommend improvements.
  • Manage program plans, timelines, budgets, vendor relationships, and project communications to ensure high-quality delivery.

Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, Education, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.


Experience / Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in talent development, learning and development, organizational development, talent management, leadership development, or a related HR discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating high-impact learning experiences for employees, managers, and/or senior leaders.
  • Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide learning, leadership-development, performance-management, or talent-management initiatives from concept through implementation and evaluation.
  • Experience partnering with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose needs and develop practical, business-aligned development solutions.
  • Experience supporting talent reviews, succession planning, performance management, high-potential development, or other talent-management processes.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design, facilitation methods, and learning evaluation.
  • Experience using learning technologies, including an LMS, virtual-learning platforms, and digital or on-demand learning resources.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated project-management ability, including the capacity to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, timelines, and vendors in a fast-paced environment.

Experience in marketing operations, program coordination, business operations, executive support, PMO, who enjoy bringing structure, organization and executional excellence to complex regional teams

job.title: Senior Product Designer - Creator Analytics & Tools
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

As a Senior Product Designer on the Creator Team, you will be a driving force behind defining and designing intuitive, impactful, and innovative tools for artists, producers, and music creators. A massive part of this role will focus on data storytelling: taking complex streaming analytics, audience demographics, and financial metrics, and turning them into clear, actionable insights that help artists grow their careers.

This role requires an entrepreneurial and autonomous mindset. You will have a high degree of ownership and must be comfortable leading complex design initiatives from zero to one with minimal product management support. You will bridge the gap between product strategy and execution, using deep product thinking to define what we build, not just how it looks.

Applications without portfolios will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design high-craft, intuitive product experiences that turn complex streaming analytics, audience metrics, and monetization insights into elegant, actionable dashboards for creators, using exceptional typography, visual hierarchy, and interaction detail
  • Own and drive the end-to-end design process for creator-focused products: step up to define product scope, requirements, and strategy when product management support is light
  • Translate vague, complex user problems and business goals into clear, elegant, and intuitive product workflows
  • Utilize advanced AI design tools and methodologies to supercharge your design process, accelerate rapid prototyping, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your output
  • Conduct scrappy user research and leverage insights to create workflows, UI, and interactions that support creators in uploading, managing, and monetizing their content
  • Partner directly with Engineering leads and key stakeholders to ensure technical feasibility, maintain alignment, and champion design quality through deployment
  • Help evolve and maintain SoundCloud’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability across creator tools

Experience and Background:

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, or interaction design, preferably in music, fintech, creator economy, or complex SaaS platforms
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to take dense, complex data sets and present them in a beautifully simple, intuitive, and visually compelling way. Experience building analytics dashboards is a must
  • Proven track record of leading major product features or entire product areas independently with little day-to-day product support
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with a portfolio that highlights why decisions were made, the business impact, and how you navigated complex user experience constraints
  • Expert-level mastery of Figma, alongside hands-on experience leveraging modern AI design tools (e.g., Figma AI features, automated prototyping tools, or generative asset workflows) to optimize efficiency

job.title: Graphics/Multimedia Editor, News
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Graphics department at The New York Times is looking for a versatile, experienced visual journalist to report, design and create graphics and multimedia stories, with a primary focus on breaking news and fast-turn news response.

You will execute visual coverage on major breaking stories, producing maps, charts, diagrams and interactive graphics on deadline. Your work may also include statistical visualizations, video, photography and animation. You will identify visual story angles, analyze data, and collaborate closely with Graphics colleagues and newsroom journalists across desks. This role combines quick-turn breaking news execution with high-impact journalism. You may also be required to work weekends.

The Graphics department is a diverse group of journalists and visual thinkers with creative backgrounds ranging from architecture to cartography to computer science. We are curious about all kinds of things and seek to find individuals who bring their own curiosity to bear in creative approaches to storytelling.

This is an in-office position based in New York City, and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

Applications should include links to a portfolio or work samples to demonstrate the creation of visual journalism. Please feel free to describe your role in specific projects in your cover letter.

Responsibilities:

  • Conceive, report, design, and publish breaking news graphics and multimedia stories using a variety of visual forms.
  • Design and build interactive and static visualizations.
  • Collaborate with Graphics staff and journalists from other newsroom desks on major breaking news events.
  • Conceptualize new lines of reporting and analyze data to discover visual stories with accuracy, clarity, and impact.
  • Share responsibility for regular weekend news graphics coverage, ensuring prompt, high-quality visual response to breaking news.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the news editor on the Graphics team.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience producing, reporting, or editing visual journalism or news graphics.
  • Proven track record of identifying visual opportunities quickly and delivering effective graphics in a fast-paced breaking news environment.
  • Expertise in visual software (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma) and front-end web development tools (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Demonstrated experience with data reporting, interface design, and information graphics design.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent news judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Familiarity with interactive web frameworks (such as Svelte), web mapping/GIS tools, and tools like ai2html.
  • Experience integrating multimedia elements such as video, photography, and animation into news coverage.
  • Experience prioritizing, organizing, and managing multiple fast-moving visual projects under tight deadlines.
  • Flexibility to work a schedule that includes regular weekend shifts.

job.title: Deputy Editor, Well
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Well desk is seeking a Deputy Editor to join its core leadership team to oversee editorial operations, including day-to-day scheduling, long-term planning and managing editors and reporters.

As our Deputy Editor, you will help the desk to pursue ambitious targets, set priorities, and home in on a consistent voice and mission. You'll push Well editors and reporters to collaborate internally and with the newsroom, and help guide inter-desk collaboration. You will do first edits on stories and top-read our report. You will also serve as the desk deputy and can run all aspects of the desk as a proxy for the Editor of Well, when necessary.

You will report to the Well desk's Editor. This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all aspects of the editorial workflow, including story presentation and promotion. Monitor the status of articles, photography, video and design, as well as display and social copy and any multimedia elements.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Well's desk head and the Well Visuals Team.
  • In partnership with the desk head, lead and shape coverage for the desk; make publishing decisions and take ownership of what is published; set the editorial calendar, make sure that all editorial content is on track, and make adjustments when necessary.
  • In partnership with the desk head, support team development, culture and morale; accountable for success and development of direct reports and their respective teams.
  • In partnership with the desk head, shape and drive desk strategy; identify opportunities for innovation and collaboration.
  • Help the desk head to set audience goals and drive the team toward success. Collaborate closely with the desk audience editor.
  • Serve as a hiring manager and ensure that hiring decisions follow fair and equitable practices.
  • Manage a team of editors and reporters.
  • Run the desk's public representation and communications within the greater news organization, with a particular emphasis on helping us play in the big stories of the day Clearly communicate the desk's plans to other desks and stakeholders.
  • Lead the effort in defining editorial franchises and lanes of coverage.
  • Work closely with Well's operations manager on budget, payroll, freelance contracts and vacation scheduling.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience as an editor, ideally with experience across many forms of storytelling, from news to investigations, features and visual projects.
  • Experience with framing and elevating stories for the broadest possible audience.
  • Experience with brainstorming ideas and coaching reporters, editors and the visual team so they produce their best work.
  • Proven experience directly managing editors and reporters in a high-speed news environment.
  • Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills and an eagerness to coach and support colleagues.
  • A passion for innovative storytelling and a desire to deploy new formats.
  • Superior organizational skills.
  • A collaborative, enthusiastic team spirit and a desire to ask deep, tough questions about health and wellness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep experience editing health and wellness journalism.
  • A deep understanding of video, visual, and audio storytelling.
  • A track record of fostering agility and successfully implementing new operational workflows.

job.title: Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV
job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
job.description:
Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with internal teams.*

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused on markets outside the top 50 in the U.S. Our assets include 340 radio stations across 74 local markets, more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps, a subscription digital marketing services business (Townsquare Interactive) and a digital advertising division (Townsquare Ignite).

 

About the Opportunity:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting owns Townsquare’s external reporting and technical accounting and is a key member of the accounting leadership team.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and own SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K (including earnings releases), and the related financial statements, footnotes and MD&A.
  • Coordinate with Investor Relations on all financial aspects of the earnings release, conference call script and materials posted to the Company’s website, including non-GAAP measures and reconciliations in compliance with Regulation G and Item 10(e) of Regulation S-K.
  • Support Legal Counsel in preparing the proxy statement (including executive compensation disclosures) and Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4 and 5), as needed.
  • Stay current on new and proposed SEC rules, FASB standards and SEC comment letter trends; assess their impact and ensure the Company is prepared for new reporting requirements.
  • Own the SEC reporting process, including the Financial Reporting SOX narrative and the design and timely, effective operation of key controls; partner with the Director of Internal Audit on SOX walk-throughs and testing.
  • Own inline XBRL tagging and compliance.
  • Prepare and review disclosure checklists.
  • Complete quarterly and annual lender reporting under the credit agreement, including covenant compliance calculations and delivery of financial results.
  • Lead the application of accounting standards for the Company, including documentation, resolution of issues and implementation of process changes, particularly revenue recognition (ASC 606), goodwill and FCC license impairment testing (ASC 350), business combinations and dispositions (ASC 805), leases (ASC 842) and segment reporting (ASC 280).
  • Prepare technical accounting memos on complex and non-routine transactions, and review position papers prepared by others.
  • Coordinate with Finance, HR and Legal to maintain equity award records and calculate stock-based compensation expense.
  • Drive continuous process improvement and automation of reporting and close tasks, including appropriate use of analytics and AI tools.
  • Serve as the day-to-day contact with the external auditors for quarterly reviews and the annual integrated audit.
  • Prepare Audit Committee materials on accounting, reporting and control matters, and present to the Audit Committee as needed.
  • Coordinate with Tax on income tax provision (ASC 740) disclosures.
  • Review the quarterly consolidation, segment results and statement of cash flows.
  • Build, supervise and develop a team of reporting and technical accounting professionals.

 

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred) and either at least three years of SEC reporting at a public registrant or equivalent experience auditing public companies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; active CPA license required.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC rules (Regulation S-X and S-K).
  • Experience supervising and developing staff; month-end close experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong written communication skills and the judgment to present to senior management and the Audit Committee.

 

Computer Skills:

NYC and Los Angeles are also possible locations in addition to Nashville


Overview:

Own the product direction for one of the largest sports apps in the country. The CBS Sports App is home to some of the biggest sporting events in the world: The Masters, NFL, March Madness, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full app experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you’re in the details.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for the CBS Sports App and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on.
  • Own the app's plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to continue, change, or stop.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1–2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.
  How We Build (The Builder Culture):
  • We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions.
  • AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll model it and push what's possible further.
  • The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.
  What success looks like:
  • The app's product strategy is coherent. People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not to do.
  • Ideas are tested before they're committed. Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity. Fewer false starts, less rework.
  • PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer environment, ideally mobile-first and at scale. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold app-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view on how AI changes what a product team can do.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting

  • Open to learn new programing languages,

And on the technical side, we need:

Senior Director, Technical Program Management AI/ML

 

45961

 

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Job Summary:

 

The Senior Director of Technical Program Management (AI) collaborates with engineering management. They lead the development and growth of AI-driven platforms and systems. Enhance capabilities within the Consumer AI organization.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product, and business strategy translating AI concepts into scalable, production-grade systems that deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate brings deep systems thinking, deep technical judgment, hands-on experience building AI solutions, and the adaptability to lead in fast-pace, experimental AI environments.

They will oversee a portfolio of AI/ML investments, lead a team of senior program management leaders, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Strategic AI Portfolio Leadership

Own PMO oversight of the end-to-end AI/ML portfolio, including long-range we plan and select where to invest. We also measure the results based on specific goals.

Enable software product operating models that support high-volume experimentation, rapid learning cycles, and continuous improvement.

As the team and AI / ML products scale, introduce the correct level of lean process, while still supporting innovation and autonomy.

Establish planning rhythms, reviews, and metrics. Ensuring accountability and give senior management visibility.

Drive clarity on priorities and tradeoffs across AI investments to maximize long-term leverage and impact.

Establish and track portfolio-level success metrics connecting model performance, adoption, and business outcomes.

Serve as a key contributor on the PMO AI solutions team, actively collaborating in the ideation, design, and build of AI-generated tools and automation workflows to impact productivity, efficiency, and project/people data insights.

Program Management: Risk, Dependencies, and Go-to-Market Integration

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate technical, delivery, and systemic risks along with recommended mitigation strategies and decision points.

Own dependency management across multiple teams, platforms, and product surfaces, ensuring sequencing, interfaces, and handoffs are clearly understood and actively managed.

Drive issue resolution for complex, cross-team challenges by facilitating rapid root-cause analysis, aligning stakeholders on tradeoffs, and ensuring timely, durable outcomes.

Partner closely with adjacent engineering, platform, and product teams to ensure AI/ML capabilities are production-ready, scalable, and aligned to go-to-market timelines.

Synthesize and communicate clear, data-driven insights on program health, risks, and strategic tradeoffs to engineering management and executive stakeholders.

Lead executive-level discussions on program health, delivery progress, and measurable outcomes across AI initiatives.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

12 + years of experience in Technical Program Management, or similar roles.

Proven experience leading AI / ML specific portfolio-level programs spanning multiple teams and product areas, with a focus on consumer- facing capabilities and business growth.

Deep knowledge of agile, lean, and iterative delivery models, with the ability to adapt them to non-traditional workflows.

You should have remarkable communication skills. You need to be proficient in managing stakeholders. You must be able to work well with others.People management skills, including experience managing managers.

Relevant technical certifications such as cloud platforms, AI/MLfoundations, Generative AI, Technical Program/Product Management, or

Technical/Engineering.

Demonstrated hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, low-code/no- code, for prototyping, automation, and analysis.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

Knowledge with the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data sourcing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Experience with experimentation frameworks including A/B and multivariate testing, offline vs. online evaluation, and model iteration

loops.

Knowledge of model performance metrics and tradeoffs (accuracy, latency, bias, explainability).

Experience supporting applied ML use cases such as personalization and recommendation systems, search and ranking, content knowledge, or generative AI for text, image, or video.

job.title: TOC/Editor
job.description:
The Ingest/Transmission Operator and Editor oversees all inbound and outbound media, content distribution, and news-gathering operations. Responsibilities include monitoring on-air product quality, ensuring compliance with government regulations, troubleshooting technical equipment, editing news content, and preparing programming for broadcast. This position is governed by the National IBEW Broadcast Agreement for CBS television stations.

 

Duties & Responsibilities


• Monitor and manage inbound and outbound media using various transmission methods, including fiber, Skype, and LiveU.
• Ensure timely response to breaking news events and oversee broadcast delivery.
• Collaborate with team members and network staff, providing operational support as needed.
• Identify, edit, and insert broadcast-quality video and audio into news bulletins on short notice.
• Handle broadcast media and feeds, manage video and audio switching, and operate recording equipment.
• Utilize servers and monitoring systems to manage media acquisition and delivery.
• Ingest media into servers and prepare files for editing and broadcast.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues when necessary.
• Support live studio production requirements and provide excellent service to internal and external media operations clients.
• Monitor and control video encoding and decoding systems and troubleshoot incoming and outgoing transmission paths.
• Develop and implement backup plans for equipment or transmission failures.
• Edit news content using non-linear editing systems.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Qualifications


• Strong knowledge of server-based news environments, broadcast hardware, and software systems.
• Understanding of news operations, current events, and the importance of attention to detail.
• Proficiency in quality control (QC) tools and processes.
• Familiarity with digital video formats, ingest workflows, media servers, and broadcast production environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.
• Understanding of broadcast production workflows and technical standards.
• Working knowledge of broadcast formats, server systems, and diagnostic tools.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced news environment.
• Strong organizational skills, reliability, and punctuality.
• Experience with Grass Valley Edius editing systems preferred.

 

Education & Experience


• Bachelor's degree in a technical field preferred.
• Minimum of 1–2 years of experience working in a fast-paced television news environment.
• Experience using non-linear editing systems required.
• Must be detail-oriented, deadline-driven, and able to work with minimal supervision.
• Must be a creative and adaptable team player capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
• Flexibility to work nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
