job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Chief Engineer 

WVTM, the NBC and CBS affiliates in Birmingham, Alabama “The Magic City” is seeking a Chief Engineer. The successful candidate will lead a team and demonstrate the ability to organize, plan, manage, document and complete assignments within a live broadcast environment. You will work in collaboration with the other department heads and directly oversee the daily operation of the station. We are looking for someone with experience in broadcast excellence and teamwork, with a passion for serving the local community, ready to embrace the challenges and opportunities of our ever-evolving industry. The ideal candidate must excel in motivating and working with a high-energy team, enthusiastic about collaborating with all departments, integrating AI into solutions and workflow, focused on the future of our industry. Candidate should demonstrate success in budgeting, capital planning and personnel management. This position reports directly to the General Manager and partners with Hearst Television leadership.   

 

What You’ll Do 

Engineering Leadership 

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, AI adoption and implementation, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage. 

  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly. 

  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards. 

Broadcast and Facility Operations 

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems. 

  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations. 

  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up. 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience 

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action. 

  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans. 

  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems. 

 

Planning and Modernization 

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation. 

  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations. 

  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data. 

  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability. 

 

What You’ll Need 

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff. 

  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements. 

  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments. 

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues. 

  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require. 

  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience. 

  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued. 

  • Related military experience will be considered.

job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.
  • Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.
  • Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.
  • Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.
  • Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.
  • Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.
  • Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.
  • Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts
  • Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.
  • 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.
  • Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.
  • Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corp Transactions (Remote)
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Senior Counsel, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Transactions to provide legal counsel on matters related to the distribution of the Company’s local stations, networks, and programming across multiple platforms, including over-the-air, MVPD, streaming, and digital.


This role will structure, negotiate, and draft a variety of commercial agreements; prepare regulatory filings; and oversee compliance with FCC regulations in partnership with internal teams. The Senior Counsel will also support the Company’s mergers and acquisitions activity and advise business leaders on regulatory and transactional matters, with a focus on operational effectiveness, risk management, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Advise on regulatory and contractual rights, obligations, most-favored-nation provisions, and transactional standards related to retransmission consent, network, and program distribution.
  • Draft offers and contracts based on approved deal terms; coordinate with Distribution in negotiations.
  • Review and negotiate inbound contract requests from outside parties, including retransmission consent, network distribution, non-disclosure, master services, and related agreements.
  • Create new contract forms as needed to accommodate evolving business models.
  • Evaluate standard terms and template agreements to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
  • Coordinate with business units to manage deal flow and contract execution.
  • Manage outside counsel when appropriate and oversee contract management system.
  • Monitor FCC regulatory requirements and compliance obligations relevant to the Company’s operations.
  • Draft and coordinate FCC compliance materials in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Work closely with the VP of Government Affairs on compliance-related matters, with advocacy retained by that office.
  • Assist, as needed, with preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual FCC filings and reports.
  • Maintain accurate compliance records and ensure timely submission of required reports to federal agencies.
  • Provide guidance to internal stakeholders to uphold compliance standards across business units.
  • Support Company M&A activity, i.e., securing regulatory approvals.
  • Prepare required regulatory filings and notices including but not limited to FCC license transfer applications (incl. waiver requests).

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
The News Producer is responsible for their individual, assigned newscast. Each Producer works with their Executive Producer and other newsroom staff to take daily reporter assignments, voiceovers (VOs), voice-over sound on tape (VOSOTs) and other stories to build compelling, informative newscasts.  Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following duties.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Manage daily production of newscasts by compiling and writing stories, logging video, etc. within specific time constraints to meet news deadlines.
  • Manage the Control Room during assigned newscasts, working closely with Directors and Production teams to ensure live programs are executed flawlessly.
  • Provide direction and talent instruction to crews in the field and in studio.
  • Collaborate about changes with Executive Producer prior to air and during newscasts.
  • Supervise and oversee Writers assigned to the shift, assign writing ideas to APs, edit AP scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Work with reporters to develop story scripts, edit Reporter scripts, and provide feedback.
  • Assign voiceovers and VO-SOTs to Reporters and Anchors.
  • Collaborate with on-air staff to assist with story development and story support.
  • Work with field crews, via telephone, to manage stories, provide graphics support, video, and logistical support.
  • Log, edit, and transcribe soundbites, write VOs, teases and opens, create basic graphics and coordinate closely with video editors.
  • Work closely with Assignment Desk staff to coordinate live shots and Reporter and Photographer assignments.
  • Maintain open communication with News Director, the news management team, and all station personnel to efficiently, respectfully, and professionally complete news assignments.
  • Collaborate with web/social media team to coordinate coverage for online and on-air stories.
  • Quickly add appropriate information to newscasts in the event of breaking news.
  • Produce unscheduled breaking news or other items as events warrant.
  • Attend and participate in department meetings.  Provide suggestions for news related stories and participate in post-production critiques.
  • Demonstrate responsibility for all equipment issued by FOX.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate computer requirements.
  • Comply with all FOX Corporate and station policies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Proficiency with MS Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to work under daily pressure and successfully manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • This is a full-time position on a regular shift, but the news is a 24/7 world and that could occasionally include other shifts as breaking news or other circumstances warrant.

Education and Experience

  • One (1) year of experience in a medium to major television market is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Radio/TV or related discipline preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working at a computer.
  • Regularly stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
  • Occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • Regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Streaming News Producer
job.description:
KCPQ/KZJO FOX 13 Seattle is seeking a Streaming News Producer with strong technical instincts and a deep understanding of digital-first news production. This role is centered on live streaming, social video, and platform-native storytelling. You will be responsible for producing, managing, and optimizing live and on-demand content across FOX LOCAL and major social platforms, ensuring coverage is fast, accurate, visually compelling, and technically sound.

Reporting to the Streaming Executive Producer, the ideal candidate is fluent in the mechanics of streaming production and social/digital distribution, CTV, and understands how audiences consume news outside of linear TV with a balance of speed, quality, and journalistic integrity. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a live environment and wants to build the future of local news.

Does This Sound Like You?

You are digitally native, technically confident, and calm under pressure. You understand streaming workflows, live video production, and best practices for digital and social platforms. You have strong news judgment, pay close attention to detail, and can make smart editorial and technical decisions quickly. You enjoy collaborating across teams, experimenting with new formats, and using data to improve performance. You want to create content that reaches audiences where they are and keeps them coming back.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and manage live streaming coverage of breaking news, live events, press conferences, and original programming for FOX LOCAL and social platforms.
  • Operate and oversee streaming production tools, including live switching, encoding, clipping, publishing, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Create platform-native digital and social video content, including live clips, short-form video, graphics, and text-based storytelling optimized for mobile & CTV consumption.
  • Distribute and optimize content across the FOX Local app, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms with an emphasis on audience growth and engagement.
  • Collaborate with newsroom, digital, social, and production/engineering teams to align coverage, workflows, and priorities across platforms.
  • Monitor real-time analytics, audience behavior, and trending topics to inform editorial and production decisions before, during, and after live streams.
  • Ensure all content meets journalistic standards, legal requirements, and FOX group guidelines for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Participate in ongoing testing and refinement of streaming formats, tools, and workflows.
  • Assist in the planning, production and publication of regular podcasts on both VOD and audio platforms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, ideally in Journalism, Communications, Media Production, TV/Film production, or a related field with a digital focus.
  • 3 or more years of experience producing digital video, live streams, or social-first news content; newsroom experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical proficiency with live streaming workflows, including video switching, live publishing, clipping, and distribution.
  • Hands-on experience with video editing tools and production software, Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated understanding of social media platforms, video formats, and audience behavior across digital ecosystems.
  • Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and adjust content strategy in real time.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, writing skills, and attention to detail in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and non-traditional hours as news demands.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As a Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be responsible for bringing gameplay characters to life. You have a passion for NPC and player gameplay systems and a keen eye for animation detail and quality. You have a deep understanding of body mechanics and master core animation principles like weight, posing, arcs, anticipation, and follow-through.

In the role of Senior Gameplay Animator, you will be creating high-quality character animations for navigation, interactions, conversations, and other gameplay systems.

  • Collaborate closely with a team of skilled animators, designers, and gameplay programmers.
  • Ensure animation work meets artistic goals and quality standards while respecting project deadlines.
  • Participate in animation reviews and collaborate with other team members to maintain consistency and quality.
  • Exporting, implementing and testing animations into the game engine.
  • Troubleshoot animation gameplay issues and provide solutions to ensure smooth animation production.
  • Provide guidance and feedback to junior animators, helping to mentor their development and maintain consistent quality across the board.

RESPONSABILITÉS

À titre d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous serez responsable de donner vie aux personnages de jouabilité. Vous êtes passionné·e par les systèmes de jouabilité des NPC et des personnages joueurs et possédez un sens aigu du détail ainsi qu’un souci constant de la qualité de l’animation. Vous avez une compréhension approfondie de la mécanique corporelle et maîtrisez les principes fondamentaux de l’animation, notamment le poids, les poses, les arcs, l’anticipation et le suivi du mouvement.

Dans ce rôle d’animateur ou animatrice senior, Jouabilité, vous créerez des animations de personnages de grande qualité pour la navigation, les interactions, les conversations et d’autres systèmes de jouabilité.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec une équipe d’animateurs et animatrices, de concepteurs et conceptrices ainsi que de programmeurs et programmeuses de jouabilité hautement qualifiés.
  • Veiller à ce que les travaux d’animation répondent aux objectifs artistiques et aux normes de qualité tout en respectant les échéances du projet.
  • Participer aux revues d’animation et collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité du travail.
  • Exporter, intégrer et tester les animations dans le moteur de jeu.
  • Diagnostiquer les problèmes liés à l’animation et à la jouabilité et proposer des solutions afin d’assurer une production fluide des animations.
  • Fournir de l’encadrement et de la rétroaction aux animateurs et animatrices juniors, contribuer à leur développement professionnel et maintenir un niveau de qualité constant au sein de l’équipe.

Basic Requirements: 

  • 6+ years of experience in 3D character gameplay animation.
  • Strong demo reel showcasing gameplay animations.
  • Solid animation skills with a great understanding of human motion, body mechanics, biped locomotion and animation principles.
  • Strong proficiency in industry-standard animation tools such as Motionbuilder or Maya.
  • Experience in working with motion capture data and keyframe animations.
  • Having shipped a AAA game.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively within cross-disciplinary teams.
  • Basic technical understanding of gameplay systems and animation blend systems.

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Working experience with game engines such as Unreal
  • Experience working on occupation, conversation and traversal systems
  • Understanding of animation-graph techniques and workflows
  • Understanding of root-motion and motion matching
  • Experience in developing first-person and third-person gameplay systems and good understanding of 3C concepts
  • Experience with different animation styles
  • Experience animating animal and creature characters
  • Rigging experience
  • Facial animation experience
  • Experience developing Multiplayer games

QUALIFICATIONS

Exigences de base : 

  • 6 ans ou plus d’expérience en animation de jouabilité de personnages 3D.
  • Démo professionnelle solide présentant des animations de jouabilité.
  • Excellentes compétences en animation et solide compréhension du mouvement humain, de la mécanique corporelle, de la locomotion bipède et des principes d’animation.
  • Maîtrise avancée des outils d’animation reconnus dans l’industrie, tels que MotionBuilder ou Maya.
  • Expérience de travail avec des données de capture de mouvement (motion capture) et des animations par images clés (keyframe).
  • Avoir contribué à la livraison d’un jeu AAA.
  • Capacité à collaborer efficacement et à communiquer clairement au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Compréhension technique de base des systèmes de jouabilité et des systèmes de fusion d’animation (animation blend systems).

Caractéristiques souhaitées : 

  • Expérience de travail avec des moteurs de jeu tels qu’Unreal.
  • Expérience de travail sur des systèmes d’occupation, de conversation et de déplacement (traversal).
  • Compréhension des techniques et des flux de travail liés aux animation graphs.
  • Compréhension du root motion et du motion matching.
  • Expérience dans le développement de systèmes de jouabilité à la première et à la troisième personne ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des concepts 3C.
  • Expérience avec différents styles d’animation.
  • Expérience en animation de personnages animaux et de créatures.
  • Expérience en rigging.
  • Expérience en animation faciale.
  • Expérience dans le développement de jeux multijoueurs.

Role Summary

NBCUniversal is seeking an experienced Associate Art Director – Characters to lead, define and drive the visual direction and consistency of characters for an ambitious new interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that the full character ecosystem—including hero characters and large-scale population systems—achieves a high level of quality, cohesion, and scalability. 

Reporting to the Art Director, the Associate Art Director – Characters will work closely with Character Art Leads, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure alignment across pipelines, systems, and production goals. The role involves leading and managing Character Art Leads while providing high-level direction, establishing standards, and maintaining consistency across internal teams and external partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the visual direction for characters across the full project. 
  • Ensure consistency and quality across the full character ecosystem (hero characters and crowd systems). 
  • Lead and manage Character Art Leads and Review Artists, providing mentoring, direction, feedback, and alignment. 
  • Review assets and validate quality to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards. 
  • Drive cross-discipline collaboration with Animation, Design, Tech Art, and Lighting teams. 
  • Ensure alignment between art direction, production constraints, and scalable pipelines. 
  • Maintain visual consistency across internal production and external partners. 
  • Identify risks and guide teams to deliver quality at scale across large production environments. 

Résumé du poste 

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne expérimentée au poste de directeur(trice) artistique associé(e) – Personnages afin de diriger, définir et faire évoluer l’orientation visuelle ainsi que la cohérence des personnages pour une nouvelle expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable d’assurer un haut niveau de qualité, de cohérence et de scalabilité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème de personnages, incluant les personnages principaux et les systèmes de population à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction de la Directrice Artistique, le·la Directeur.trice Artistique Associé.e – Personnages collaborera étroitement avec les Leads Character Art, les équipes d’artistes techniques et les équipes transverses afin d’assurer l’alignement entre pipelines, systèmes et objectifs de production. Le rôle inclut la gestion des Leads Character ainsi que la définition de standards, la direction artistique globale et la cohérence entre équipes internes et partenaires externes.

  • Assurer la cohérence et la qualité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème (personnages principaux et systèmes de foule). 
  • Encadrer et manager les Leads Character Art, et les Artists de review, en assurant mentorat, direction, feedback et alignement. 
  • Réviser les assets et valider la qualité afin de respecter les standards artistiques et techniques.

  • Assurer l’alignement entre direction artistique, contraintes de production et pipelines scalables. 
  • Maintenir la cohérence visuelle entre production interne et partenaires externes. 
  • Identifier les risques et guider les équipes pour livrer à grande échelle avec un haut niveau de qualité.

  • Proven experience leading multiple teams or disciplines on published AAA title. 
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality character work and artistic direction. 
  • Strong understanding of modular character pipelines and real-time production workflows. 
  • Experience working with large-scale character systems including crowd or customization pipelines. 
  • Strong experience with real-time engines. Unreal Engine 5 and Metahuman experience is a plus. 
  • Solid comprehension of technical constraints allowing scalability on multiple platforms, from high-end to mobile. 
  • Ability to translate artistic vision into clear direction for teams. 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Artist (Props) to own and drive prop production quality and pipelines for an ambitious interactive entertainment project. This role is responsible for overseeing the creation and implementation of props across the project, ensuring consistency, scalability, and high visual fidelity across a wide range of content including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and user-generated content (UGC). 

Reporting to the Associate Art Director – World, the Lead Artist (Props) will work closely with Environment, Technical Art, and cross-functional teams to ensure that prop production supports both artistic vision and production requirements. The role involves leading and managing a team of prop artists while establishing pipelines, workflows, and scalable solutions, and acting as a key bridge between internal teams and external development partners to ensure aligned production from high-end to mobile. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate artistic direction into high-quality prop assets across diverse categories including city dressing, interiors, vehicles, and UGC. 

  • Drive the development and production of prop assets supporting large-scale world building and environmental storytelling. 

  • Lead and manage the prop art team, providing mentorship, feedback, and direction. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve pipelines and workflows for prop production with a focus on scalability and consistency. 

  • Ensure consistency and quality across all prop assets and integration within environments. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Lighting, Tech Art, and Production teams for proper implementation. 

  • Ensure prop creation workflows meet both artistic goals and technical constraints. 

  • Act as a bridge between internal teams and external development partners, aligning production standards and expectations. 

  • Optimize asset production pipelines for efficiency and scalability from high-end to mobile platforms. 

  • Support production planning, milestone readiness, and continuous pipeline improvements. 

  • Maintain visibility on quality, risks, and production challenges across prop content. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  afin d’assurer la responsabilité et l’orientation de la qualité de production des accessoires ainsi que des pipelines associés pour un ambitieux projet de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de superviser la création et l’intégration des accessoires dans l’ensemble du projet, en assurant la cohérence, l’évolutivité et un haut niveau de fidélité visuelle pour une vaste gamme de contenus, notamment l’habillage urbain, les environnements intérieurs, les véhicules et le contenu généré par les utilisateurs (UGC).

Relevant de la direction artistique associée, Monde, la personne occupant le poste Chef.fe d’équipe Artiste (Props)  travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’Environnement, d’Art technique et d’autres équipes multidisciplinaires afin de s’assurer que la production des accessoires soutient à la fois la vision artistique et les exigences de production. Ce rôle comprend le leadership et la gestion d’une équipe d’artistes d’accessoires, tout en mettant en place des pipelines, des flux de travail et des solutions évolutives. La personne retenue agira également comme principal point de liaison entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes de développement afin d’assurer l’alignement de la production sur toutes les plateformes, du haut de gamme au mobile.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong collaboration experience across art, technical, and production teams. 

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills. 

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience working with Unreal Engine pipelines.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to bridge creative and technical constraints. 

  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Qualifications de base

  • Ensure vegetation assets and systems meet artistic, technical, and performance requirements.

  • Guide vegetation direction across biomes, neighborhoods, and environmental storytelling needs.

Paramount Streaming is investing heavily in personalization, experimentation, and applied AI to shape how millions of viewers begin — and continue — their journey with Paramount+ and Pluto TV. We are seeking an Experimentation Lead to own and scale experimentation across the sign-up and cancellation flows. This is a highly strategic and execution-oriented role focused on identifying, prioritizing, launching, and scaling experiments that directly impact conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Reporting to the Principal Machine Learning Engineer for Sign-Up Optimization, you will act as the connective tissue between product, ML, engineering, data science, design, and growth — ensuring we are running the right experiments, running them well, and learning from them rigorously. This role blends product thinking, scientific rigor, experimentation design, and operational management.

 

What You’ll Do
Experimentation Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Define and own the experimentation roadmap across sign-up, onboarding, and cancellation flows for Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Identify high-impact test opportunities across UX, messaging, offers, personalization, pricing, bundling, and model-driven experiences.
  • Translate business goals (conversion, churn reduction, engagement, LTV) into structured, testable hypotheses.
  • Prioritize experiments using data-driven frameworks balancing impact, risk, and resource constraints.

End-to-End Experiment Ownership

  • Drive experiments from ideation → design → instrumentation → launch → feedback → iteration.
  • Partner with ML engineers and applied scientists to test model-driven experiences (ranking, personalization, content ordering, offer targeting).
  • Ensure experiment configurations are correctly implemented and debug issues in targeting, logging, or exposure.
  • Monitor live experiments for integrity, guardrail breaches, or unintended side effects.
  • Lead post-test readouts and translate results into clear, actionable next steps.


Scientific Rigor & Measurement

  • Design robust A/B, multivariate, and sequential testing frameworks.
  • Define primary metrics, guardrails, and success criteria aligned to long-term value, not just short-term conversion.
  • Improve offline-to-online validation practices in partnership with ML teams.
  • Standardize experimentation best practices across the Applied Intelligence group.
  • Champion causal reasoning and statistical discipline in decision-making.

Cross-Functional Management

  • Partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination for experimentation across the lifecycle entry/exit flows.
  • Communicate insights clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Create scalable documentation and experiment tracking processes.


Basic Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in experimentation, growth, product analytics, applied ML, or related quantitative roles.
  • Proven track record designing and executing high-impact A/B tests in high-scale consumer digital products.
  • Deep fluency in experimentation methodology: statistical inference, power analysis, guardrails, sequential testing, causal reasoning.
  • Experience working closely with ML-driven systems (recommendation, ranking, personalization) in production environments.
  • Strong analytical toolkit (SQL required; Python/R preferred).
  • Ability to debug experiment integrity issues (logging, targeting, traffic splits, instrumentation gaps).
  • Strong product intuition and ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured testable frameworks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and executive-level communication.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in subscription businesses, streaming media, or lifecycle optimization.
  • Familiarity with experimentation platforms and feature flag systems.
  • Background in growth, pricing optimization, offer testing, or churn reduction strategies.
  • Experience working in ML-first or AI-driven product environments.


Why Join Us

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape how millions of users begin and end their relationship with Paramount’s streaming products.
  • Ownership: You will define the experimentation engine for some of our most critical user journeys.
  • Influence: Work alongside senior ML leaders and help establish how personalization and growth intersect across the company.

Technical Leadership

Application Development

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new solutions as well as maintaining, integrating and improving existing solutions using modern technologies and industry best practices

AI-Integrated Development

  • Leverage AI-driven coding assistants like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude as a core component of the daily engineering lifecycle, including architectural design, implementation, and refactoring.

Mentorship

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Process Improvement

Ownership and Accountability

  • Experience using Gradle and Android Studio
  • Experience following and implementing software design patterns.

 

System Design & Architecture

  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications
  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries

 

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Strong experience in writing unit tests, UI tests, and automated tests using frameworks like JUnit, Espresso, and others
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)

 

Performance Optimization

  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, slow rendering, and network inefficiencies
  • Skilled in using performance profiling and optimizations (e.g., Android Profiler, Leak Canary)

 

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executives
  • Strong mentoring skills, with a track record of developing and inspiring high-performing teams

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 6 years focused on Android development
  • Demonstrated history of leading and delivering multiple large-scale Android projects in a production environment with multiple scrum teams in an agile process
  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and driving technical decisions
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to facilitate conversations with business partners in project definition, business requirements definition and functional design sessions
  • Eye for quality and user experience
  • Translate business objectives into software requirements

 

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands on software development on the Android/Android TV/Amazon/Amazon Fire TV platform
  • Have shipped one or more apps to the Google Play and/or Amazon app store
  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and multiple interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience working on Android projects with multi-module architecture
  • Experience with assistive technologies such as JAWS/VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only input methods
  • Experience evaluating front-end code against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
  • Experience developing accessible front-end experiences with techniques such as TalkBack properties used in XML (labelFor, contentDescription), TalkBack announcements, dynamic text scaling, and responsive design

 

AI Literacy

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent, with a clear sense of what these tools are good and bad at.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts, structuring context, and evaluating AI-generated diffs critically before they land in the codebase.

  • Judgment about responsible AI use: privacy, IP, attribution, and when a human review gate is required.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice To Have)

  • Experience with Video Streaming (HLS / MPEG-DASH)

job.title: Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


Overview

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the PlutoTV pod. You will focus on Channel, Guide, and Schedule personalization. Your goal is to make the FAST (Free Ad-supported Streaming TV) experience feel as dynamic as a premium on-demand service. You will help build the models that select which channels appear in the guide and how content is scheduled to maximize viewer session length.   This role requires deep knowledge of FAST systems and the unique constraints of linear programming. You will implement features within our GCP stack, leveraging Qdrant for content similarity and Post-training RL to optimize the "Lean-back" viewing experience.   Why This Role Matters
  • Modernizing Linear TV: You are part of the team transforming the static EPG (Electronic Programming Guide) into a personalized, data-driven discovery engine.
  • Optimizing the "Lean-Back": Your models help users find something to watch immediately, reducing the friction inherent in "channel surfing."
  • Global Scale: PlutoTV is a leader in the FAST space; your code will impact the viewing habits of millions of users worldwide.
  Key Responsibilities
  • Feature Development: Design and deploy ML components for channel ranking and guide personalization.
  • FAST Metadata Integration: Work with linear scheduling data to create features that account for "Current" vs "Next" program relevance.
  • Vector-Based Similarity: Use Qdrantto group similar channels and content to improve the "More Like This" experience within the guide.
  • Model Refinement: Train and iterate on models using TensorFlow/PyTorch, focusing on session-start and watch-time metrics.
  • Independent Execution: Own the delivery of defined tasks within the PlutoTV roadmap, from data exploration to production deployment.
  Basic Qualifications
  • Minimum: 3+ years in MLE; proficiency in Python/SQL; experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch and GCP.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Preferred: Knowledge with FAST or Broadcast TV data structures; experience with Qdrant or similar vector databases.

 

#LI-PG1

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Audience Analyst
job.description:
Position Summary:

American Public Media Group is seeking an Audience Analyst to join the Audience Insights & Analytics team. This role offers a unique opportunity to use data, analysis, and insights to support audience growth, fundraising performance, and community impact at a mission-driven media organization.

This role supports strategic decision-making, revenue growth, and operational efficiency by analyzing audience, donor, and other first-party data. Its primary focus is partnering with the Membership and Audience Development & Marketing teams to provide reporting, analysis, and actionable recommendations for marketing campaigns, member drives, ongoing fundraising campaigns, annual planning, and overall strategy. The role also supports Philanthropic Development, Broadcast, Digital Products, and Finance teams.

The Audience Analyst will serve as a key contributor in utilizing data from the organization’s CRM, marketing activation platforms, data warehouse, and external sources. The role will develop and deliver efficient, reliable reporting and analysis while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and strengthen analytical processes.

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated and demonstrates the ability to work collaboratively and effectively with colleagues in multiple departments across the organization. Success in this role requires combining technical depth with business judgment, producing accurate and reusable reporting, identifying meaningful patterns in audience and donor behavior, and translating findings into recommendations that stakeholders can act on.

Expected Compensation Range: $37.50 - $40.85 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple internal and external sources with focus on CRM, marketing activation platforms, and other first-party data systems.
  • Develop proficiency with a variety of data platforms and reporting tools including Salesforce NPSP, Marketing Cloud, Power BI, and other tools as needed.
  • Provide analytics support for Membership teams by measuring and evaluating member drives, fundraising campaigns, and ongoing strategy; developing actionable reporting and recommendations; and supporting annual planning, revenue projections, and tracking of key performance indicators.
  • Provide reporting and analysis for our broadcast channels and teams across multiple stations and markets.
  • Translate data into clear recommendations, risks, and opportunities for senior leaders.
  • Query, mine, and analyze large data sets using SQL and other tools to identify patterns, troubleshoot discrepancies, validate data, and develop analyses that help the organization better understand its members and audiences.
  • Develop and maintain automated reporting and well-documented workflows that improve efficiency and ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance across reporting used to support marketing, fundraising, and audience strategy.
  • Partner with technical and business teams to define business questions, develop measurement strategies, conduct analysis, validate findings, and deliver actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the Audience Insights & Analytics team to prioritize recurring reporting and ad hoc requests, meet agreed-upon deadlines, and communicate clearly with leaders and stakeholders about scope, timelines, tradeoffs, and analytical opportunities.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Analytics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, related field, OR equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, database analytics, audience analytics, donor analytics, or a similar role.
  • 2+ years of experience and proficiency using SQL independently for data extraction, transformation, validation, troubleshooting, and analysis of large or complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify patterns and anomalies, retrieve and manipulate data, investigate discrepancies, and draw well-supported conclusions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Ability to self-manage goals, priorities, workload, deadlines, internal client relationships, and process development.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.), Teams, Slack, or similar productivity software.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Experience working with Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, or other CRM platforms and associated data.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar business intelligence tool.
  • Proficiency in SQL or other analytical programming languages or tools, such as DAX, R, Python, or SAS.
  • Familiarity with advanced techniques to support marketing such as clustering, predictive modeling, lifetime value (LTV), attribution, media mix modeling, or other concepts to support marketing spend, conversion, and strategy.
  • Experience analyzing performance across content, media, digital publishing, or membership/subscription businesses.

Reporting To This Position:  None.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position in an office environment with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands: Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time. Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.

The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. Page Six Digital is the modern evolution of the iconic gossip column, delivering the latest in celebrity news, entertainment, and pop culture with a bold, fast-paced digital edge. job.title: Junior HR Business Partner (Remote)
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Location: Remote, U.S.

 

Why this role matters:

We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Junior HR Business Partner to support our HR Business Partner team in delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience across AP. Reporting to the HR Director, News, this role will serve as a key partner to HR Business Partners and business leaders, providing HR support on talent, organizational, and workforce matters.

 

What you will do:

Working closely with HRBPs, HR Operations, and other HR specialist teams, the Junior HR Business Partner will support a wide range of employee and manager needs across assigned client groups. This role will provide hands-on HRBP support on both routine activities and contribute to strategic initiatives led by HRBPs, while partnering directly with managers and employees to resolve issues, coordinate HR processes, and ensure effective delivery of HR services.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as support to HRBPs on a variety of requests, providing guidance and support across a range of day-to-day HR topics and escalating more complex matters as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and HR Operations to support managers and employees and ensure smooth coordination and follow-through on requests and cases.
  • Support managers and HRBPs with employee and labor relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary processes, providing guidance within established policies and practices and escalating complex or higher risk matters as appropriate.
  • Help facilitate employee transfers, mobility-related processes, immigration, and other cross-functional HR activities as needed.
  • Partner with the Talent and HRIS teams to understand data as it relates to people and ensure HRBPs and HR specialist teams are connected on people data.
  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements and operational initiatives that support team effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Help document and improve HR processes and ways of working in partnership with the HR Operations team.

 

Who you are:

This role is ideal for someone currently in an HR Adviser or Generalist role, with an interest in developing as an HR Business Partner in a fast-paced global environment. The successful candidate will have HR generalist experience supporting employees and managers across the U.S and other countries.

 

The Junior HRBP will support across the employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, employee and labor relations, manager coaching, employee mobility and organisational change, while helping ensure HR policies practices are aligned with local employment requirements and business needs.

 

The successful candidate will be highly organized, solutions-oriented, collaborative, and comfortable managing a variety of operational, tactical and strategic support activities simultaneously.

 

The successful candidate will be

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong critical thinker who is comfortable evaluating complex situations, navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • A collaborative and proactive team player who enjoys solving problems and working across teams.
  • A confident communicator with the ability to build strong working relationships with employees, managers, and HR stakeholders, and is comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders and managing up effectively.
  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn across both HRBP and HR Operations disciplines.

 

Required:

  • Up to 3 years of HR experience in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Experience supporting managers and employees across day-to-day HR processes and inquiries.
  • Experience supporting employee relations processes, HR policies, and employee lifecycle. 
  • Experience applying HR policies and employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, including recognizing when local requirements or specialist guidance apply.
  • Experience working with HR systems, maintaining and analyzing employee data with accuracy, and using data to inform decision making.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Ability to drive actions and initiatives through to completion and deliver agreed outcomes in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Experience partnering across all HR functions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

 

What will set you apart:

  • Experience supporting employees and managers in a unionized environment, or an interest in developing experience in labor relations, preferred.
  • Knowledge of SAP and Success Factors preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, is preferred.

 

Why Join Us? 

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.
  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.
  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.

 

If you are passionate about people, thrive in a collaborative environment and are committed to driving business success, we encourage you to apply.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000, based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications and location. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:   

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

job.title: Summer 2027 Bartley Fellowship - Arts Criticism Internship
job.description:
Job Description:


Summer 2027 Bartley Fellowship - Arts Criticism Internship 

Job Description:

The Wall Street Journal's Arts in Review section is seeking aspiring journalists—juniors, seniors or recent graduates (within one year of graduation) with a strong editing background at their school newspapers or elsewhere—for a 10-week paid summer internship. The in-person internship is an opportunity to get hands-on experience working alongside some of the best opinion writers and editors in the world.

The internship—formally the Bartley Fellowship—honors the Journal’s former Opinion editor, Robert L. Bartley. Opportunities will be awarded to individuals interested in the arts who intend to pursue a career in journalism or cultural criticism.

The Arts intern is one of several fellows selected each year through an application process that is overseen by senior editors. Bartley Fellows are assigned to a department within the Opinion section—Arts in Review; Books; or Features (Op-Eds and Columns). The fellow will assist in producing Arts in Review’s content for the print and digital editions of the Journal—editing, fact-checking, liaising with writers, writing display copy, proofing, contributing to social media and digital production. Though this is not a writing fellowship, the Bartley fellow will be encouraged to produce a Masterpiece column, of which more below. They may also pitch articles or projects to editors elsewhere in the Opinion section.

Internships are paid, and generally take place during June, July and August, though start dates can be flexible. 

If you are interested in applying for the Opinion, Books or Arts in Review Bartley Fellowships, please submit separate applications for each position.


About Arts in Review 


Arts criticism is recognized at the Journal as an Editorial Page function, and as such operates under the umbrella of the Opinion section. Like the rest of the Opinion section, in our Arts reviews we believe in rendering clear, independent judgments that are as well argued as they are deeply informed.

In its Arts reviews, the Journal covers the full spectrum, from high art to TV, movies, theater and the many forms of popular music. Our approach is strictly art-for-art’s-sake: We review things because they are intrinsically interesting, not to fulfill a quota or make a political statement. We believe in the past and its traditions, but are keenly interested in the new—not in novelty for its own sake but in the ways those traditions are being extended and new ones invented. And we prize above all a lively, lucid prose style free from jargon of all kinds.


Guidelines and Application Deadline

Though a reporting and/or writing background is a plus, the fellowship is primarily an editing internship. Therefore applicants should have experience editing arts or arts-related copy for their college newspaper, literary magazine, or a comparable publication. Students from any discipline may apply, but preference will be granted to those concentrating in literature, history, a foreign language, classics, pre-law, music, theater, art history, studio art, architecture, philosophy, political science or archaeology—via coursework (though not necessarily a major) or sustained leisure-time activity.

An appreciation for both the Western and non-Western canons is desirable, as is an understanding of current issues in the arts. A demonstrated ability to multitask and meet daily deadlines is critical for success, as is attention to detail and a focus on accuracy. Applicants should be familiar with technology as it relates to journalism. Social media experience with a publication or brand would be a plus.

Applicants will be expected to demonstrate familiarity with our section’s content (student applicants without campus-wide access to the WSJ can purchase discounted subscriptions at https://www.wsj.com/studentoffer).

If you’d like to be considered, please submit the following in one single, complete PDF file:

  • A cover letter
  • Your résumé
  • Full text of your two best clips
  • Your response to the following prompt in no more than 800 words: Write a “Masterpiece” column. In these essays that appear every Saturday, a writer discusses a single work of art (painting, book, film, etc.) and explains why, in their view, it is of surpassing cultural significance. (Examples: https://www.wsj.com/news/types/masterpiece)

All materials must be received by Nov. 30, 2026. Only complete applications that include a cover letter, résumé and responses to the prompt will be considered. Please do not include any additional materials, such as transcripts, recommendation letters, etc. In order to be considered, you must be a U.S. citizen, or a holder of a green card or visa that will allow you to work in the United States. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and we endeavor to make selections by the end of February. Only finalists will be contacted.


About Bob Bartley


Throughout his 30 years as The Wall Street Journal’s Editorial Page Editor, Bob Bartley inspired principled and original thinking that changed and shaped the society in which we live. He also devoted attention to teaching and motivating talented young people, many of whom have gone on to careers in journalism at the Journal and elsewhere. The Bartley Fellowships are consistent with that legacy.

Bob Bartley achieved many honors during his long tenure here, including a Pulitzer Prize and, shortly before his death in December 2003, the Presidential Medal of Freedom. In awarding that medal, President George W. Bush cited Bob as “one of the most influential journalists in American history.” The Robert L. Bartley Fellowships will help to perpetuate not only Bob’s memory but, above all, the principles and priorities to which he devoted his distinguished career.


About the Opinion Section


Following the American newspaper practice, the heads of News and Editorial report independently to the publisher of the Journal and CEO of Dow Jones, Almar Latour. The Editorial staff is responsible for the Opinion content published on WSJ.com, the editorial and op-ed pages of The Wall Street Journal in print, and criticism of books and the arts, which are recognized at the Journal as an Opinion function.

While The Wall Street Journal’s news pages are committed to informing our readers, our editorials are dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy and positions that emanate from it. That philosophy can be summed up as “free markets, free people.” We have stood for these fundamental principles even in times—and places—when they were not considered fashionable. While specific issues differ in various parts of the world, we view those issues through a consistent lens everywhere; for example, while protectionism is more popular in some parts of the world than others, our publications around the world are committed uncompromisingly to free trade.

We believe in the individual, in his wisdom and his decency. We oppose all infringements on individual rights, whether they stem from attempts at private monopoly, labor union monopoly or from an overgrowing government. Our section is not easily pigeonholed or predictable. We resist the label “conservative,” in the sense of preserving the status quo, because we think it too confining, too devoid of the optimism inherent in trusting individual wisdom and decency.

It is also important to state clearly what our section does not represent. It is not partisan. Unlike many American publishers, we do not endorse political candidates, and from time to time we have important disagreements with all leading political figures. We view issues through the lens of our philosophy and let our readers decide which person or party best serves to protect market capitalism and self-government.

We believe that the ultimate function of opinion journalism is the same as the rest of the newspaper: to inform. But in opinion journalism we have the additional purpose of making an argument for a point of view. We often take sides on the major issues of politics and society, with a goal of moving policies or events in what we think is the best direction for the country and the world. Our experience over many years is that even those who disagree with us on particular issues—or even on broader philosophical grounds—nevertheless respect us for the clarity, consistency and eloquence with which we present our point of view. In stating our own views forcefully, we hope to raise and sharpen the level of debate and knowledge. And we hope that our editorials reflect not merely the passing whim of passing editors, but a body of thought shaped by a century of tradition.

The Wall Street Journal's Books section is seeking beginning journalists—juniors, seniors or recent graduates (within one year of graduation) with reporting and writing experience at their school newspapers or elsewhere—for a 10-week paid summer internship in our New York City office. The internship—formally the Bartley Fellowship—honors the Journal’s former Opinion editor, Robert L. Bartley. Opportunities will be awarded to young thinkers and writers who intend to pursue a career in journalism or cultural criticism.

The Books intern is one of several fellows selected each year through an application process that is overseen by senior editors. Bartley Fellows are assigned to a department within the Opinion section—Arts in Review; Books; or Features (Op-Eds and Columns). The fellow selected to work with the Books team will assist in commissioning reviews, conducting research, fact-checking and editing content for the print and digital editions, as well as contributing to social media and digital production. The fellow will be encouraged to submit ideas for book reviews and may also pitch articles or projects to editors elsewhere in the Opinion section.

Internships are paid and generally take place during June, July and August, though start dates can be flexible.

If you are interested in applying for the Opinion, Books or Arts in Review Bartley Fellowships, please submit separate applications for each position.

Though a reporting and/or writing background is a plus, the fellowship is primarily an editing internship. job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Executive Director - Chemical Markets Price Reporting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy's global chemicals price reporting business. You will oversee the editorial teams responsible for the assessment and publication of benchmark prices, assessments and market-moving news across global petrochemical and chemical markets from our PCW brand.

You ensure the integrity, quality, transparency, and market relevance of chemical price assessments while maintaining the highest ethical and methodological standards. You will lead a global team of price reporters and editors responsible for market coverage across key chemical value chains - including aromatics, olefins, plastics, polymers, syngas, methanol, feedstocks, and emerging chemical markets.

You will drive editorial excellence, benchmark innovation, and market engagement, while ensuring compliance with legal requirements and industry standards. You will partner closely with Product, Standards & Compliance, Risk, and other Editorial leaders to ensure Dow Jones Energy's chemicals assessments remain trusted, transparent, and indispensable to global commodity markets.

You will report to the SVP - Markets & Price Reporting.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Lead and develop a global team of chemicals price reporters, editors, and market specialists, fostering a culture of editorial excellence, accountability, and collaboration

  • Ensure all chemical market assessments are developed, maintained, and published in accordance with the highest standards of price assessment integrity, market transparency, governance, and ethical conduct consistent with Dow Jones’ and The Wall Street Journal’s values

  • Lead methodology development, periodic methodology reviews, market consultations, and stakeholder engagement processes to ensure pricing methodologies remain robust, representative, and responsive to evolving market dynamics

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with producers, consumers, traders, brokers, exchanges, trade associations, and other market participants to strengthen market engagement, data integrity, and confidence in Dow Jones Energy's petrochemical and chemical markets assessments

  • Partner with Standards & Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure ongoing compliance with applicable benchmark regulations, internal controls, audit requirements, and governance frameworks

  • Partner with Product to execute the strategic roadmap for global chemicals market coverage, including identifying opportunities for new benchmarks, market expansion, and portfolio optimization

  • Monitor benchmark performance, market adoption, customer feedback, and competitive developments - recommending changes to methodologies, coverage, and editorial priorities as appropriate

  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing editorial talent, ensuring appropriate succession planning, capability development, and organizational resilience across the chemicals price reporting organization

  • Act as a senior spokesperson and subject matter expert for chemicals markets, representing Dow Jones Energy at industry conferences, customer engagements, webinars, and regulatory forums

  • 15+ years’ experience in commodity price reporting, market intelligence, or related information services organization

You will report to the Vice President - Head of Financial Operations.
