job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Working knowledge of financial concepts—markets, instruments, portfolio construction—sufficient to partner deeply with domain experts

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on data visualization, information design, or design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition), you will define the future of subscriber growth across Dow Jones' portfolio of brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily, and future subscription products.

In this senior individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of design strategy, business strategy, and growth, you'll establish the long-term vision for how prospective customers discover, evaluate, and subscribe across our Commerce ecosystem - spanning registration, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing and packaging, checkout, identity, and experimentation.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and executive leadership to solve highly ambiguous challenges and shape investment priorities that accelerate subscriber growth. Your work will define scalable Commerce patterns, influence our acquisition platform strategy, and connect design decisions to measurable business outcomes across multiple brands.

Beyond delivering exceptional product experiences, you'll mentor senior designers, elevate design quality across Commerce, and establish standards that scale throughout the organization.You will report to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

About The Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Define the long-term design strategy for subscriber growth across multiple Dow Jones brands.

  • Lead highly ambiguous, business-critical initiatives spanning registration, identity, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing, packaging, checkout, and experimentation.

  • Partner with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to shape roadmap priorities and strategic investments.

  • Create scalable acquisition patterns, frameworks, and interaction models that extend our Index Design System and can be reused across brands.

  • Drive experimentation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities throughout the acquisition funnel and translating insights into long-term product improvements.

  • Translate customer research, behavioral data, market trends, and business goals into experiences that improve acquisition performance while maintaining a high bar for user experience.

  • Lead strategic design explorations, vision work, and cross-functional workshops that align teams around future Commerce investments.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level designers through design reviews, coaching, and thoughtful feedback that elevates craft across the organization.

  • Influence how Commerce measures success by defining experience quality metrics alongside conversion, acquisition, and revenue KPIs.

  • Represent Commerce Design within the broader Design & Research organization while contributing to company-wide design strategy and thought leadership.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience leading complex digital products.

  • Portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, product vision, and measurable business impact.

  • Experience leading highly ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Exceptional interaction, visual, systems, and service design skills.

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across disciplines.

  • Experience defining design systems, reusable frameworks, and scalable product patterns.

  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills.

As Executive Director - Intermediate Chemicals Market Research & Analysis, you will be a member of the research leadership team responsible for developing and stewarding intermediate chemicals market research and analysis. You will report to the Vice President of Research.

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

job.description:
Job Description:


Financial Translator - Spanish (Latin American) 

New York/ Hybrid based


Dow Jones Newswires is seeking two AI-literate translators fluent in Spanish and English to join its growing team of linguists and be a key player in ensuring accuracy while constantly monitoring the quality of our autotranslation model.

The successful candidate will assess and improve the autotranslation from English to Spanish of Dow Jones Newswires financial, business, and economic news. 


Our model in this case will be based on Latin American Spanish. The job holder will be expected to demonstrate strong skills in prompt engineering and experience with building glossaries to improve translation consistencies and outcomes. 


This is a full-time contract with office attendance on a hybrid basis at our Americas HQ in New York City.

    • Document and track translation quality metrics to monitor trends, identify improvement areas and support continuous enhancement
    • Implementing the correction policy for Spanish products
    • Building and maintaining glossaries 
    • Designing, testing, and iteratively refining prompts to continuously enhance the quality, accuracy, and style of our autotranslated financial news 
    • Regularly communicating and sharing ideas with global colleagues to enhance the autotranslation quality and work efficiency
    • Interacting with different stakeholders (Product, Editorial, customers, and partners)
  • Assist with translating pre-defined templates for generating automated content and other translation-related work that may be required by the business

You Have:

  • A native level of Spanish (C2)
  • A strong understanding of Spanish culture in particular that of Latin America to ensure appropriateness and cultural compliance
  • Demonstrable experience in LQA and Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE)
  • Strong experience using CAT tools - specially for building and implementing glossaries
  • Excellent knowledge of financial & economic news & terminology in English and Spanish.
  • Experience with machine translation and GenAI
  • Preferably some experience in a financial-focused newsroom

About the Role: As an Experimentation Intern at Dow Jones, you will focus on understanding reader behavior and optimizing the subscription journey through testing. job.title: The Wall Street Journal Visual Investigations Internship (Summer 2027)
job.description:
Job Description:


The Wall Street Journal internship program is an opportunity primarily for college juniors to work with our award-winning data and visual investigations teams in New York. Graduate students enrolled in a degree program by the application deadline – October 31– who are returning to school in the fall are also eligible to apply. Graduating seniors should apply to WSJ News Associates.


Applicants should be excited at the prospect of scraping poorly formed websites, reviewing massive datasets, analyzing satellite imagery, geolocating and chronolocating videos and photos, and digging through public records, including FOIA requests. You will have the opportunity to pitch editorially strong visual journalism, which may include data-driven interactives, maps, charts and explanatory graphics, as well as help experiment with AI-powered reporting workflows.


You will:

Contribute reporting, data analysis, open-source reporting and visual verification to ambitious investigative projects and quicker-turn visual stories. 

Work cross-functionally with reporters and editors across the newsroom

Be immersed in audience-first visual storytelling that aims to reveal critical information through maps, video, satellite imagery, and interactive graphics. 

Gain hands-on experience analyzing large datasets and utilizing open-source intelligence (OSINT) to verify digital evidence and uncover hidden truths while maintaining rigorous editorial standards.


You have:

An analytical approach to journalism, with experience cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data to support reporting. 

The ability to scrape and mold unstructured data using tools like Python, R and SQL. 

Familiarity with JavaScript, D3.js, 3D modeling, animation, video editing and open-source reporting techniques such as geolocation, video and photo verification is a significant bonus.

Completed at least one prior reporting internship with another professional media organization or published exceptional data or visual or open-source investigative  work with a campus news outlet or as a freelancer.


You should be a self-starter with a collaborative mindset who understands the needs of our audience across multiple platforms and is able to work independently under deadline pressure. Dedication to high journalistic standards and excellent reporting skills are required. A demonstrated interest in business reporting is a plus, though prior business/finance reporting experience is not required.


HOW TO APPLY:

Please upload one PDF document (max. 5MB). Your application should contain:


  • A cover letter that highlights why you would be an asset to that desk. 
  • Your résumé.
  • Three examples of your data, OSINT and visual investigative reporting work (including links to interactive projects, published graphics, or code repositories), outlining your role and/or contribution. 

The deadline to apply is October 31 at midnight Eastern time. Late or incomplete submissions will not be considered.


Internship timing: 10 weeks between June and August.


Only finalists will be contacted. We will review applications on a rolling basis and strive to make selections by the end of January.


MORE QUESTIONS?

Visit https://careers.wsj.jobs

job.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Architecture & Core Platform
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an experienced Mobile Software Engineer to drive the technical evolution of our flagship mobile applications. In this role, you will focus on core mobile architecture, application performance, modularity, and cross-cutting platform systems. Our native apps drive the majority of our digital reach and serve millions of daily readers, making app reliability, fluid responsiveness, and maintainable software design central to our engineering mission. You will be responsible for defining structural patterns, eliminating technical debt, optimizing foundation-level workflows (networking, caching, state orchestration), and safely integrating high-impact domain modules - ranging from reader experiences and personalization to native monetization frameworks.


What Motivates You

  • You are passionate about clean system design, modular codebases, and establishing design standards that make multi-team feature development faster and safer.
  • You care deeply about fundamental app metrics—cold start times, smooth 60/120 fps rendering, battery efficiency, and low memory footprints.
  • You enjoy solving systemic, cross-cutting engineering problems that impact the entire application stack, not just isolated user interfaces.
  • You appreciate that third-party systems and revenue mechanisms are integral to running a premier media operation, and you relish the challenge of isolating external dependencies behind strict, testable abstractions.
  • You are eager to work with modern native patterns (Swift, Kotlin, declarative UI) and explore shared architecture paradigms to streamline cross-platform capabilities.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, implement, and maintain core mobile architecture patterns, shared foundational frameworks, and modular dependency graphs across the application.
  • Drive app-wide technical initiatives: optimize cold/warm startup times, reduce memory and binary footprint, and eliminate main-thread bottlenecks using profiling tools.
  • Establish robust abstraction layers, adapter patterns, and dependency injection strategies to isolate high-risk third-party SDKs, revenue systems, and analytics vendors.
  • Partner with product, backend, and feature teams to establish standardized API contracts, networking patterns, data persistence schemes, and caching strategies.
  • Lead architectural design discussions, author RFCs, define code quality benchmarks, and conduct thorough peer code reviews.
  • Support high-impact vertical integrations (such as native monetization, audio/video playback, and content feeds) by designing clean hook points and lifecycle management pipelines.
  • Ensure app compliance with platform privacy policies, sandbox requirements, and operating system updates across Apple and Google ecosystems.
  • Champion automated testing standards, CI/CD pipeline reliability, and contract testing across client-server boundaries.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Design, implement, and maintain core mobile architecture patterns, shared foundational frameworks, and modular dependency graphs across the application.
  • Establish robust abstraction layers, adapter patterns, and dependency injection strategies to isolate high-risk third-party SDKs, revenue systems, and analytics vendors.
  • Lead architectural design discussions, author RFCs, define code quality benchmarks, and conduct thorough peer code reviews.
  • Champion automated testing standards, CI/CD pipeline reliability, and contract testing across client-server boundaries.

Qualifications

  • Bachelorʼs degree in Computer Science, engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional mobile engineering experience shipping large-scale, production-grade applications.
  • Strong proficiency in modern native mobile development (Swift/iOS; familiarity with Android or Kotlin Multiplatform is a strong asset).
  • Deep understanding of architectural paradigms (MVVM, Clean Architecture, Unidirectional Data Flow / MVI, modularization) and design patterns.
  • Proven track record diagnosing and resolving system-level performance issues (concurrency, memory leaks, frame drops, network overhead).
  • Experience architecting SDK integration layers, wrapper libraries, or plugin systems that protect host app stability and crash-free rates.
  • Solid grasp of client-server API design, schema definition (REST, Protocol Buffers/gRPC, or GraphQL), and offline-first data synchronization.
  • Demonstrated commitment to code hygiene, automated testing (unit, integration, snapshot/UI), and continuous integration workflows.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$98,800 - $164,600 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Director, FP&A
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

Job Title: Director, FP&A 


A little bit about our team:  

The WMG FP&A team is responsible for ensuring compliance with WMG’s internal management reporting standards. The team collaborates across divisions, conducting a wide range of analyses including operating performance, market/competitive analysis, and ad-hoc projects. They provide comprehensive reporting and analysis for all actual, forecast, and budget cycles within WMG. 


Your role:  

This role requires a strong background in variance analysis and a deep understanding of accounting and finance. We are seeking an individual who is proactive in analyzing financial variances and can effectively communicate financial results and forecasts. You will collaborate closely with financial leadership across all divisions and the corporate executive team.  You will be responsible for the preparation and delivery of key management financial reports, focusing on areas such as affiliate-specific P&L performance, consolidated WMG performance against the annual budget, prior forecasts, and prior year results. This position will report directly to the VP, Financial Reporting & Analysis.  

 

As a proactive leader, you will manage financial analysis and drive performance across departments, acting as a key strategic partner to executive leadership on critical cross-functional projects. This role requires moving beyond standard metric reporting to actively shape high-level business decisions. We are looking for someone who demonstrates strong leadership by effectively managing resources, mentoring team members, and collaborating across all levels of the organization. You will be expected to inspire, motivate, and hold others accountable for achieving both individual and team goals, fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, and collaboration. 


Here you’ll get to:  

  •  Lead Financial Reporting & Analysis: Oversee monthly and quarterly reporting cycles, ensuring accurate and timely communication of results and forecasts to senior management.  
  • Mentor & Develop Team Members: Manage two direct reports, providing coaching and guidance to help them grow professionally while fostering a high-performance culture.  
  • Strategic Collaboration: Work with various stakeholders, including senior leadership, to integrate financial insights into company strategy and influence decisions.  
  •  Promote Accountability: Ensure team members and stakeholders are held accountable for deliverables, consistently meeting performance targets and financial goals.  
  •  Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Take charge of ad-hoc projects that require collaboration across departments, demonstrating your ability to unite teams and drive outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities Include:  

 

  • Oversee the Corporate Reporting and Analysis process, ensuring timely monthly reporting of actual and forecast results. Coordinate with segment finance leads at Recorded Music, Music Publishing, and Corporate operating segments for accurate reporting and analysis of WMG’s performance.  
  • Manage and review financial review packages summarizing WMG’s performance, including key metrics, for the Board of Directors, CEO, CFO, and Controller.  
  • Prepare concise summaries of monthly actual and forecast results, comparing them to prior year, prior forecast, and budget, highlighting significant variances. Calculate and track critical compliance metrics, including comparative leverage calculations (e.g., Moody's vs. S&P methodologies), and model Adjusted EBITDA across various projections and business scenarios.  
  • Oversee the preparation and maintenance of recurring source files, primarily in Excel with HFM Smart View functionality, which form the foundation of senior management reporting.  
  • Collaborate with Investor Relations and External Reporting to assist in the development of quarterly and annual press releases, earnings script documents, and other financial communications, including directly supporting IR in answering investor and analyst questions.  
  • Manage KPI reporting across the organization and conduct detailed cost analysis. Perform deep-dive strategic analysis to evaluate key business drivers, model the financial impacts of internal structural changes, assess margin performance, and develop actionable scenarios to optimize financial outcomes. 
  • Work closely with External Reporting to review quarterly MD&A, income statement analysis, and other ad-hoc reporting during the earnings process. 

 

This role offers the opportunity to significantly contribute to WMG’s financial performance and provide strategic insights to senior leadership. 


About you:  

  • 10+ years professional experience in accounting and financial analysis  
  • CPA preferred  
  • Large multi-national experience a plus  
  • Strong computer skills with knowledge of financial systems and software  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/ Finance / Economics  

We’d love it if you also had:  

  • Deep understanding of financial analysis and reporting, key business metrics, forecasting, and annual budgeting;  
  • Problem solving, decision making, and continuous process improvement skills  
  • Superior organizational skills with attention to detail  
  • Partnering, influencing, and communication skills up and down the organizational structure to convey key elements in a concise and positive manner  
  • The ability to work proactively, independently and as a strategic partner in a team environment  
  • Knowledge of music/media industry strong plus  

 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike.   • Provide EHS-related support for the West Coast Studio Operations locations.
  • Conduct inspections and hazardous materials determinations, recommend updates or improvements to operations, identify trend changes based on gathered data, with a focus on environmental endpoints, and maintain government database information as assigned.  
  • Perform incident investigation and root cause analysis.
  • Perform health risk assessments of selected operations.
  • Manage consultants to perform health risk assessments, program development, and conduct indoor air quality (IAQ) investigations.
  • Manage and maintain site chemical inventory.  
  • Approve chemicals for use in the studio lot.
  • Conduct health and safety program audits.
  • Respond to incidents and complaints regarding chemicals, indoor air quality, mold, noise and radiation.
  • Develop programs for technical EHS areas.
  • Advise, direct and instruct personnel on correct implementation of technical EHS requirements.
  • Perform health and safety inspections.
  • Provide weekly and monthly metrics.
  • Perform training as needed.
  • Interact and provide guidance to tenants and non-employees.
  • Participate in Safety Team meetings including developing content and presenting.
  • Answer and respond to Safety Hotline concerns.  Respond to emergencies during work and off hours.
  • Manages day-to-day use of internal electronic systems (Gensuite) and ensures that all tasks, inspections, action items, etc. are properly tracked/documented and actions closed in a timely manner.
  • Analyze EHS Data for insights on how to support performance improvement and to effectively improve processes with minimal direction and information. 
  • Conduct investigations of incidents, significant events and emergencies promptly in accordance with company policies and/or applicable laws and regulations.
  • Assist operations with preparation and coordination of regularly scheduled audits and reviews from both internal and external inspections.  Meet deadlines on any action items/MAPs resulting from audit and provide documentation supporting resolution.
  • Coordinate and accompany outside regulatory agency regulators or inspectors that visit the operations as assigned, e.g., Los Angeles County CUPA, Los Angeles City CUPA. 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in safety, occupational health or related discipline, or equivalent work experience 
  • Minimum one (1) year experience in the Environmental Health and Safety field or the television and/or live entertainment industry
  • Experience with EHS technical programs.
  • Working knowledge of US EPA, US OSHA, and US DOT regulations.
  • Must have ability to manage multiple priorities and drive implementation of key EHS initiatives.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and associated tools.
  • Excellent verbal, written skills and presentation skills and detail oriented.
  • Willing to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Must be able to work outdoors with varied weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift / carry items weighing up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to stand / walk a minimum of four (4) hours per day.
  • Ability to work with a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to work at heights.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Position requires the individual to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to work extended hours, on weekday nights, and on weekends as needed.
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older.

job.title: Executive Editor, The Asheville Citizen-Times, Ashville, NC
job.description:
The Asheville Citizen-Times, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is seeking a digital savvy, strategic and community minded executive editor who is committed to audience growth, digital innovation and powerful journalism in fast-growing Asheville and Western North Carolina.

The ideal candidate has a collaborative mindset and is eager to work together to raise the newsroom’s digital acumen and drive high-quality journalism that is essential to the Western North Carolina communities it serves. This is a person fluid in news analytics, energized by new ideas, and whose enthusiasm for great journalism is contagious.

The ideal candidate will be a transformational leader who is passionate about watchdog and enterprise reporting who also possesses a deep knowledge of audience.

This editor must understand and illustrate how community engagement and subscriber loyalty are at the forefront of what we do and how we operate.

We need a strong communicator and collaborator, as well as someone who understands how to inspire and lead even more sophisticated work through community engagement, social media and other platforms.  We also need a leader who embraces the ethos of servant leadership and continuous self learning.

This person must have impeccable journalism credentials, outstanding leadership skills, and a keen grasp of the ever-changing digital space, including a strong knowledge of visual storytelling. The right editor is people-centric, has lofty standards, remains focused on the most important priorities and opportunities, and easily shifts between strategy and execution.

The executive editor will work collaboratively with partners in the USA TODAY Network South Region to become the voice of authority for Western North Carolinians through quality journalism, strategic outreach and diverse storytelling.

Responsibilities:

Uphold the highest journalism standards across digital and print platforms, strongly support the First Amendment and conceive, pursue and execute watchdog reporting.

Develop and implement a multi-platform digital vision and strategy focused on achieving target audience specific goals and objectives.

Provide leadership and be knowledgeable in state and local news, investigative journalism, Helene recovery issues, public service and government issues.

Champion change management efforts that include strong communication of the company’s strategic initiatives, purpose, vision, culture and plan.

Lead the planning and oversee execution of content strategies with a keen eye focused on strategic audiences. Special emphasis is placed on digital and other new platforms. Creativity and an ability to develop and execute innovative approaches are essential.

Facilitate strong community connections with a relevant editorial voice and personal interaction.

Attract, retain and develop top talent.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum of five years in significant leadership roles in a newsroom with demonstrated success.

Clear understanding of the First Amendment and the highest regard for upholding those standards.

Experience in high-level decision-making with complex, impactful or sensitive news content.

Experience working in industries undergoing substantial change and transformation.

A history of successful leadership, innovation and goal achievement.

Demonstrated change leader who collaborates and communicates effectively.

Personal charisma, comfort with public speaking and commitment to staff interaction.

Understanding of the changing media landscape and ability to adapt strategies that address continually changing market and consumer needs and desires.

Demonstrated strong competitive instincts and intellectual curiosity.

Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and coordinate in an environment of accountability.

Demonstrated track record in recruiting a highly successful leadership team.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1.    Your resume – one to two pages.2.    A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.3.    Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive – Outside Sales

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Erie, PA area | Hybrid (home office with client/prospect visits as needed)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Are you looking to launch or grow your career in sales and marketing? Our Account Executive role is an excellent opportunity for motivated early-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative selling, develop business relationships, and make a direct impact on local businesses.

In this role, you'll identify new business opportunities, engage with prospective clients, and recommend marketing solutions that help businesses grow. You'll partner with local businesses to understand their goals, present tailored marketing recommendations, and support their growth through a combination of digital and traditional advertising solutions. You'll also collaborate closely with our post-sale support teams, who manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimization.

During your first 90 days, you'll participate in structured onboarding, learn LocaliQ's products and sales process, and begin building your prospecting and client engagement skills. Our goal is to provide the coaching and resources needed to help you ramp successfully and build a long-term career in sales.

Why This Role Stands Out

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential

Comprehensive training and structured onboarding program

Hands-on experience in consultative sales and digital marketing

Mentorship and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders

Clear career path into senior sales and leadership opportunities

President's Club, contests, and recognition programs

Hybrid flexibility and autonomy in managing your territory

Access to industry-leading marketing solutions and technology

Strong support from marketing specialists, strategists, and post-sales teams

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Build relationships with prospective clients and identify business growth opportunities.

Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs and business goals.

Partner with experienced team members to develop and present marketing recommendations.

Maintain accurate CRM records and develop strong pipeline management habits.

Collaborate with internal teams to support positive client experiences.

Participate in ongoing sales training, coaching, and professional development.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Motivated self-starter with a desire to learn and grow in a sales career.

Comfortable speaking with new people and building professional relationships.

Organized with strong time-management skills and attention to detail.

Experience using Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems

Interest in digital marketing, advertising, or business growth solutions.

Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Executives are curious, coachable, resilient, and motivated to learn. They enjoy connecting with people, are comfortable stepping outside their comfort zone, and view challenges as opportunities for growth. Whether you're coming from sales, customer service, hospitality, athletics, recruiting, or are an upcoming graduate, this role offers the training and support needed to build a rewarding career in consultative sales.

job.title: Director of Audience - Remote
job.description:
BLOX Digital is seeking an energetic, strategic Director of Audience to lead the continued advancement of BLOX Audience+, our dynamic paywall and audience monetization solution. As a member of our product team, this leader will shape the technology, prioritize investment, and guide product development to help our media partners grow subscription revenue, deepen engagement, and retain more subscribers.

Audience+ helps partners connect audience behavior with personalized offers, flexible customer journeys, and subscription experiences that support conversion and retention. The Director of Audience will build on that foundation, identifying opportunities to make the solution more effective, easier to use, and responsive to the evolving needs of BLOX Digital’s customer base and their goals.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who understands subscription economics and can translate that knowledge into technology that delivers measurable business value. The ideal candidate combines a clear product vision with strong execution, commercial judgment, and the ability to align teams around improvements that drive lasting partner success.

Key Responsibilities

Set the vision and roadmap for Audience+

Own the product strategy and roadmap for Audience+, aligning continued development with partner subscription goals, market needs, and BLOX Digital’s business priorities.

Identify opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, retention, and audience monetization across the subscriber lifecycle.

Prioritize initiatives using customer evidence, revenue potential, usability, technical dependencies, development effort, and long-term product value.

Define clear outcomes for product investments and communicate roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and progress to internal stakeholders and partners.

Turn audience strategy into better technology

Lead product discovery and requirements for improvements to audience segmentation, dynamic metering, registration, offers, pricing, and customer journeys.

Advance subscription experiences that reduce friction in checkout, account access, renewal, cancellation, and reactivation.

Guide the development of tools that help partners test offers, understand performance, and act on audience insights with greater confidence.

Evaluate practical uses of AI and automation to improve targeting, simplify workflows, and support better subscription outcomes, with clear measures of value.

Lead development and delivery across teams

Partner closely with engineering, design, analytics, and other product leaders to turn priorities into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and achievable release plans.

Maintain a disciplined product backlog and make informed decisions about scope, sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs throughout development.

Work with technical teams to strengthen product reliability, performance, scalability, and integration across the BLOX ecosystem and relevant third-party systems.

Coordinate validation, launch readiness, and post-release evaluation, ensuring new capabilities solve the intended problems and can be adopted successfully.

Make partner needs central to product decisions

Build a consistent feedback process through customer research, product usage data, support trends, and input from sales and implementation teams.

Engage partners in discovery, usability testing, and pilot programs to validate needs and refine solutions.

Translate recurring customer challenges into scalable product improvements that benefit organizations of different sizes and levels of audience expertise.

Equip sales, marketing, implementation, and support teams with clear product positioning, release guidance, and training so partners can realize value from new capabilities.

Measure impact and strengthen competitiveness

Establish product measures covering feature adoption, task completion, reliability, and partner outcomes such as conversion, subscription revenue, engagement, and retention.

Evaluate results against baselines, distinguishing the effects of product changes from pricing, campaigns, seasonality, and other influences on performance.

Monitor subscription technology, payment experiences, audience data practices, and competing solutions to identify gaps and opportunities for differentiation.

Develop business cases for product investment and use results to determine what should be expanded, refined, or discontinued.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Significant experience in product management, digital product strategy, subscription growth, audience development, or a related commercial discipline, with demonstrated responsibility for advancing technology products.

Demonstrated success turning early-stage ideas into launched products, commercial offerings, partnerships, or revenue-producing programs.

Experience owning a product roadmap, prioritizing development, defining requirements, and working closely with engineering and design teams.

Strong commercial judgment, including experience assessing market demand, developing business cases, and evaluating financial potential.

Understanding of subscription economics and the relationship between acquisition, pricing, engagement, churn, and customer lifetime value.

Ability to interpret product and audience data, assess experiments, and translate findings into clear development priorities.

Experience negotiating partnerships and working with senior decision-makers inside and outside an organization.

Ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, with strong communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

Comfort operating in a changing environment with a high degree of ownership and ambiguity, and a practical, entrepreneurial approach to execution.

Ability and willingness to travel as business needs require.

Experience in media, subscriptions, membership, local commerce, education, technology, or another industry undergoing business-model transformation is helpful but not required. Familiarity with paywalls, customer data platforms, experimentation tools, or payment and renewal systems is a vital.

Leadership Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

Externally curious and alert to emerging business models and technologies.

Commercially creative while grounded in data and financial discipline.

Skilled at connecting customer needs with BLOX Digital’s distinctive assets and capabilities.

Collaborative, credible, and effective across organizational boundaries.

Comfortable testing ideas, learning quickly, and adapting based on results.

Accountable for product delivery, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Salary Range $110,000-$130,000

Why Join BLOX Digital

Help shape the next generation of audience technology for local media. At BLOX Digital, your product decisions will help partners build stronger reader relationships and more sustainable subscription businesses. For more information, visit www.bloxdigital.com and www.lee.net.

job.title: Sales Specialist
job.description:
Job Description:


Sales Specialist, Global Risk Insight

 

Job Description

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivalled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Investor’s Business Daily, Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Newswires, OPIS and Chemical Market Analytics. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

 

About the Team:

Our Global Risk Insights business provides geopolitical, security, macroeconomic and regulatory insights to a wide range of customers including financial institutions, corporations, universities, government agencies, executives and business professionals. We help organizations navigate an increasingly complex world and manage risk to their business and staff. This role will be driving sales for Global Risks Insights on Oxford Analytica and Dragonfly platforms as well as bespoke advisory projects. 

About the Role:

As a Sales Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Dow Jones' footprint across the Europe region by driving adoption of our geopolitical, security and macroeconomic analysis. This role is designed for a seasoned sales professional with a strong track record in enterprise solution selling, deep understanding of the security and geopolitical risk, and the ability to influence senior business and technical stakeholders.

You’ll partner closely with Sales Generalists, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to craft strategic solution narratives that resonate with enterprise clients. Your consultative approach, commercial acumen, and ability to translate complex technology into meaningful business impact will be key to your success.

 

You Will:

  • Own and drive complex, high-value sales cycles for Global Risk Insights solutions across the European region. This includes but is not limited to our flagship subscription services Security Intelligence and Analysis Service (SIAS), the Oxford Analytica Daily Brief and our advisory services.
  • Create a sales strategy to maximise revenue growth and market expansion within your geographical territory and specialization.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders (e.g., CSO, Head of Intelligence, Head of Public Affairs etc), positioning Dow Jones GRI as a long-term strategic partner.
  • Lead advisory discussions with the internal Advisory  teams and external client stakeholders to shape integrated use cases that align to customer priorities 
  • Exceed on the position’s sales target and role based KPIs - the role’s primary focus will be on generating and closing new opportunities across your geographical territory
  • Drive strategic pursuit planning and pipeline development in collaboration with Sales Generalists, unlocking net-new opportunities and expanding existing relationships
  • Contribute to or lead the writing of any proposal, statement of work or technical document relating to the products
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to identify whitespace opportunities and differentiate Dow Jones’ offerings
  • Participate in, lead or coach the negotiation of terms, conditions, or prices leading to the closure of the contract
  • Contribute to thought leadership and client education through events, briefings, and strategic workshops.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap based on customer feedback and emerging market needs.
  • Maintain accurate sales reporting, pipeline forecasts, and opportunity tracking in our global CRM system
  • Other activities, tactics and behaviours as directed by management

You Have:

  • 7+ years of quota carrying experience in enterprise sales or business development, with a focus on the geopolitical/security/macroeconomic/data or analysis space
  • Proven success in selling to large enterprises and managing complex deal cycles with multiple stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate strategic accounts, identify key decision-makers, and build influence at the executive level.
  • Strong commercial acumen with consultative selling skills and familiarity with methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDPICC, or SPIN.
  • A collaborative mindset with experience working across matrixed teams including marketing, product, and customer success.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills tailored to both business and technical audiences.
  • Regional experience and cultural fluency across relevant markets.
  • Business-level proficiency in local language is a plus; English fluency is required. Additional languages are preferable. 
  • Experience in field sales and willingness to travel across the region (approximately 30%).

Our Benefits

  • Comprehensive Insurance & Retirement plans
  • Paid Time Off and Leaves
  • Education Benefits
  • Family Care Benefits
  • Career Growth Programs
  • Access to Dow Jones Products
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Employee Well-being Support & Fitness Programs

Equal Opportunity Employer


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Reasonable Accommodation


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

job.title: Press Journeyman/Woman
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Print Team supports the end-to-end lifecycle of Dow Jones’ print publications—including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, Investor’s Business Daily, and the New York Post.


Operating across ad intake, production workflows, plant operations, printing, packaging, single copy and amenity sales, Reprints and Licensing, and distribution; the team collaborates with internal cross-functional partners and external vendors, distributors, and the USPS to ensure quality, content freshness, safety, and cost efficiency from creation to final delivery.


About the Role

Production department: Printing and packaging of various newspaper titles including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, Investors business daily and New York Post. You will perform daily press operations in the manufacturing of Dow Jones' and contract print publications in a cost-effective manner, with the highest quality standards available using existing technology. This includes Preparing, Operating and Maintain newspaper printing presses and all associated pressroom equipment. You will report to the Foreman/Woman and be based in White Oak, Maryland.


You Will:

  • Prepare presses for nightly operation of Dow Jones & Co. publications.
  • Perform press operations to continuously improve upon the Production Quality Score, which integrates key performance measures such as reproduction quality, content freshness, productivity, and cost-effective materials consumption.
  • Maintain open communication with supervisor and other employees to reach the goals and objectives of the department.
  • Assist in the training of new employees.
  • Meet established performance standards, attend recommended training and complete active assignments.
  • Understand and follow all corporate and plant policies/practices.
  • Keep accurate, useful and timely operational and maintenance records.
  • Work with the production manager to set equipment maintenance priorities.
  • Make pasters, web presses, push rolls, hang printing plates, set color and registration and general equipment cleaning and maintenance.
  • Meet customer expectations for reproduction quality, content freshness and productivity, while managing materials consumption cost-effectively.

You Have:

  • 4-5 Years of newspaper press experience.
  • Ability to stand for 7.25 hours, be able to lift 50 lbs., kneel, bend, stoop and reach out and over head, climb stairs and ladders and push rolls of newsprint.
  • High School Graduate/GED or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • Good color perception and are mechanically inclined.
  • Previous experience in a production environment preferably in cold web offset newspaper printing production environment.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in the use of business PC applications and press controls.

job.description:
Come be the technical leader of our thriving public radio station in Wichita, Kansas. The station is in a historic structure in Old Town, the heart of downtown. Dozens of restaurants, shops, museums, clubs, and breweries are within walking distance, along with live music and public art around each corner.

KMUW-FM, Wichita is looking for a Chief Engineer who is a collaborative thinker to work closely with the General Manager and Director of Content. This position will oversee the daily technical broadcast and IT operations. The Chief Engineer is responsible for keeping abreast of changing technologies and upgrades. The role includes maintenance of the station facilities, transmitter site, and nine in-house studios. The role does have support from a part-time assistant production and broadcast engineer.

KMUW operates a single 100K watt transmitter with antenna, no translators or repeaters. We recently invested in a new transmitter, studio boards, UPS modules, studio telecom, as well as ENCO and RDS upgrades.

job.title: Delivery Driver (RSH)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times Company is looking for Drivers to join the team!

The Delivery Driver delivers the newspapers and other required products to multiple delivery sites in the New York Metropolitan area pursuant to Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations (FMCSR) and all governing Company policies.

You will be a full-time driver with a seven-hour shift schedule that includes nights and weekends.

Shifts:

  • Dayside shifts are 8 hours
  • Nightside shifts: 7 hours Sunday night through Thursday night - 8 hours Friday night - 7 1/2 hours Saturday night.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform pre-trip and post -trip vehicle inspections.
  • Deliver newspapers and other products.
  • Functions will also include performance of all delivery department and production plant floor tasks.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 21 years old.
  • Valid Class A or B  Commercial Driver's License (CDL) required.
  • Can pass a valid Department of Transportation (DOT) certificate of physical examination.
  • Must pass pre-employment and post-employment random drug and alcohol screens.
  • Can drive a Manual Transmission.
  • Must demonstrate that they can safely operate the type of vehicle that will be driven by passing a Company-administered Road test.
  • Prepare and furnish the Violation and Review Record (Record of Violations).
  • Must have a satisfactory driving record during the preceding three years.
  • Must have a satisfactory safety performance history with all prior DOT regulated employers during the past 10 years.
  • Must not have been convicted of a serious traffic violation, failed or refused a controlled substance/alcohol test for a prior DOT-regulated employer in the past three (3) years, have been convicted of a DUI/DWI within the past five (5) years or have accumulated a total of six (6) points on their license in the past five (5) years.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalency.

This position is represented by the Newspaper Mail Delivers Union.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  
  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  
  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  
  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.
  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 
  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be
  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live
  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 
  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 
  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.
  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.
  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 
  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 
  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 
  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Detroit, MI: 2529 Orleans St., Suite 100, 48207

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!
