  • Entertainment and Sports Experiences: Create differentiated experiences around live sports, TV, movies, franchises, and major cultural moments, working closely with Sports and the NBCUniversal Studio Group to Innovate across fandoms, interaction mechanics, and content formats to deepen engagement and deliver outstanding fan experiences.
  • Discovery and Browse Experience: Define how customers explore Peacock and decide what to watch or play across platforms. Creating simple, intuitive journeys that thoughtfully integrate capabilities from other product groups including Search, Personalization, Advertising and content metadata teams into a coherent customer experience.
  • Mobile Reimagined: Define a differentiated vision for mobile that revolutionizes how customers discover, watch, play, and participate on their phones. Develop compelling formats beyond traditional streaming, including games, podcasts, microdramas, short-form and vertical video, while bringing these experiences together into a coherent and intuitive product.

This is a senior leadership role that requires product judgement, organizational leadership, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into customer-facing experiences and roadmaps that scale across platforms and teams.

We are looking for an experienced, versatile product leader who can take an ambitious strategic direction and turn it into a distinctive product vision with measurable outcomes, and develop a growing product team in a competitive consumer landscape. A successful candidate will bring creativity to look at problems in new ways, discipline in using experiments and proof of concepts to validate hypotheses, strong collaboration skills to get things done across a matrixed organization, including the wider NBCUniversal and Sky businesses, and excellent communication skills.

This role will lead a team of approximately 20 product managers, report to the SVP, Product and UX, and work across the organization to deliver measurable improvements in customer engagement, including frequency, watch time, discovery success, and participation in entertainment and sports experiences.

In this role, you will:

  • Create and champion a bold product vision that brings Peacock and NBCUniversal’s broader strategic ambitions to life for how customers engage with Peacock across all devices, including TV, mobile, web, and next-generation devices, through a mix of new features, enhancements, and innovation.
  • Grow and lead an experimentation portfolio that rapidly validates new content formats, interaction models, and engagement experiences through iterative testing.
  • Act as a senior thought partner to the SVP Product & UX on content innovation, portfolio prioritization, and executive stakeholder management, balancing immediate business priorities, foundational capabilities, and longer-term innovation.
  • Define how Search, Personalization, Ad Innovation, and emerging AI capabilities come together within the customer experience, partnering with the teams that own those capabilities to deliver simple, intuitive, and differentiated journeys.
  • Create coherence across discovery, mobile, playback and fan experiences, ensuring that individual initiatives contribute to a simple and connected customer experience.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of product leaders and managers, establishing a culture of clear accountability, strong decision-making, and alignment around a shared vision and measurable outcomes.
  • Help create an AI-forward product culture by establishing new ways of working that improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of research, product definition, prototyping, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Have a keen sense for good UX/design and the ability to make evidence-based decisions using consumer insights, product analytics, competitive and market analysis.
  • Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling executive presentations and prototypes that explain product vision and strategy.
  • Collaborate with product design, project management, merchandising, data, marketing, content, and strategy teams to develop holistic points of view and confidently make product decisions and deliver high quality products.
  • Build business cases for incremental product investment that drives innovation and measurable customer or business impact.
  • Build experiences and engagement capabilities that can scale across Peacock, Sky and global streaming platforms.
  • Minimum of 15 years of product strategy/management experience within the media or consumer technology space
  • Minimum of 8 years successfully leading a team of customer-centric product managers
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision and outcome through collaboration, even without direct authority.
  • Experience managing a broad product portfolio and making investment and prioritization decisions across near-term delivery, foundational capabilities, and longer-term innovation.
  • Consumer-centric view with a proven track record of developing and acting on customer insights
  • Proven ability to be flexible and quickly adapt to changing priorities, with tight deadlines, balancing short-term progress with long-term thinking
  • Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop senior product leaders and build an organization that delivers through clear accountability and empowered decision-making.
  • Track record of successfully operating within a highly matrixed work environment, managing multiple stakeholders
  • Experience building products across multiple platforms (iOS, tvOS, Android, Roku, Amazon)
  • Ability and self-motivation to work effectively offsite and onsite and with global, multilingual teams
  • Strong analytics skills and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving, including significant experience with A/B testing and analytics
  • Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.title: Broadcast Engineer Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WATN / WLMT TV seeks a Broadcast Engineer Lead to own the broadcast and IT systems behind our 24/7 news operation. Reporting to the Head of Technology as the station’s senior technical leader, you will set technical direction, lead major projects, and serve as the escalation point for engineering staff, with decision-making authority and no direct reports.

Responsibilities:

  • System Ownership: Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of key broadcast and IT systems.
  • Technical Direction: Set system architecture and engineering standards within corporate guidelines, and recommend technology roadmaps.
  • Project Leadership: Plan, design, and deliver local, capital, and corporate engineering projects.
  • Systems Integration: Design and approve integration of studios, control rooms, transmission, automation, and asset management systems.
  • Mentorship: Guide engineering staff, delegate routine work, and review work for quality.
  • Maintenance & Troubleshooting: Maintain servers, storage, and networks; resolve complex issues; support HVAC, UPS, and backup power.
  • Compliance: Ensure adherence to FCC, IT security, OSHA, and disaster recovery requirements.
  • Documentation: Maintain engineering standards, wiring documentation, and operating procedures.
  • Collaboration: Coordinate with corporate engineering, vendors, IT security, and station leadership.

Requirements:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience) and 5+ years in broadcast operations or technology, including leading complex projects.
  • Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with broadcast systems, networking, servers, and desktop support; satellite, microwave, and IP newsgathering knowledge preferred.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

job.title: Associate Producer, Visual Content
job.description:
USA TODAY is seeking an Associate Producer, Visual Content to join its national photo and video team. This role combines content programming, AI-assisted video production, and visual storytelling through galleries and playlists. This role will be specifically focused on USA TODAY’s entertainment vertical and will play a critical role in identifying and covering red carpet moments, celebrity interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, and viral entertainment trends.

We're looking for a digital-first journalist who understands audience behavior, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and can create, optimize, and distribute visual content across platforms. This role will help drive audience growth, engagement, and revenue through strategic programming and scalable content production using AI-powered platforms and tools.

Responsibilities

Content Programming & Distribution

Program and optimize visual content across USA TODAY, Network sites, mobile apps, articles, playlists, galleries, and social platforms.

Serve as a centralized programming resource, making real-time editorial decisions to maximize audience engagement and content performance.

Monitor analytics using tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics to inform programming strategy.

Monitor real-time analytics and entertainment trends to identify visual opportunities and adjust content strategy accordingly.

Write compelling headlines, metadata, descriptions, and promotional copy optimized for SEO and audience growth.

Identify, source, and distribute the most relevant in-house, third-party, and publicly available content while ensuring editorial quality and rights compliance.

Manage automated and third-party video feeds, playlists, and related content experiences.

AI-Assisted Video Production

Serve as the national hub for AI-assisted video creation using platforms such as Stringr, Wochit, and future automation tools.

Produce high-volume short-form video content for breaking news, service journalism, entertainment, sports, obituaries, trending topics, and high-interest local stories.

Create vertical video optimized for platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.

Repurpose automated and AI-generated content for owned and social platforms.

Fulfill newsroom video requests and support priority local markets and network editorial initiatives

Visual Curation

Create and curate entertainment photo galleries that capture the emotion, artistry, and defining moments of celebrities, events, and fan culture.

Program visual experiences into articles, section fronts, and promotional placements across the Network.

Source and manage visual assets from the USA TODAY Network, wire services, and approved third-party providers.

Editorial Collaboration

Maintain high standards for editorial quality, accuracy, and brand consistency.

Collaborate with local and national newsroom teams on coverage planning, major events, and visual storytelling opportunities.

Support the USA TODAY Network by answering questions, troubleshooting workflows, and sharing best practices.

Develop training materials and assist with newsroom education initiatives related to video production, programming, galleries, playlists, and AI-powered workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent delivery of high-quality visual content across video, galleries, playlists, and promotional experiences.

Growth in audience engagement metrics, including views, watch time, click-through rates, article engagement, and content consumption.

Increased adoption of AI-assisted production workflows that improve newsroom efficiency while maintaining quality standards.

Strong content discoverability through strategic programming, SEO optimization, and effective distribution tactics.

Successful support of major news, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, and breaking news coverage initiatives.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, digital media or related field.

2-5 years of newsroom, digital media, content production, audience engagement, or visual storytelling experience for an entertainment news publisher or brand.

Experience programming content and producing video for digital platforms.

Strong understanding of SEO, audience development, analytics, and content optimization.

Experience with analytics tools such as Parse.ly and Google Analytics.

Excellent headline writing, editing, and communication skills.

Strong news judgment, organizational skills, and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Knowledge of AP Style.

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Stringr, Wochit, True Anthem, or similar platforms.

Experience creating photo galleries, playlists, and audience-focused visual experiences.

Familiarity with Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Canva, or similar editing tools.

Experience using AI tools for content creation, automation, and audience optimization.

Knowledge of video rights management and content licensing.

Experience producing content for social and mobile-first platforms.

Who You Are

A digital-first storyteller with strong audience instincts.

Obsessed with celebrities, movies, music, Hollywood, red carpets, and trending moments.

Equal parts programmer, producer, and visual curator.

Passionate about analytics, optimization, and content performance.

Curious about AI and emerging newsroom technologies.

Organized, collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working at scale.

Schedule

This role requires flexibility, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as needed.

Application Instructions

Please submit a single document containing:

Resume (1-2 pages)

Cover letter explaining your experience and approach to the role

Five examples of work demonstrating video production, content programming, visual storytelling, galleries, playlists, or audience growth initiatives

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

job.title: Account Executive - Olds, AB
job.description:
Your next big break is here!  Vista Radio is looking for an Account Executive to help grow our business in Olds, AB. The role supports the Olds market, working with our local brands including 104.5 The GOAT Rocks and 96.5 The Ranch in Olds.

The right candidate will be outgoing and ready to really dig into the community and be the face of the station around town.  In addition, you'll be joining the Vista team which prides itself on creating opportunity for advancement.  So, if you're ready to jump start your career, this is the place for you!

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re competitive, driven, and we support each other to win. This is not an easy role — it’s a high-energy, high-reward environment where resilience, consistency, and attitude matter. We have some pretty awesome ready-made sales for you, and lots of opportunity to build on that list with active and inactive clientele that are just waiting for you to come through their doors!

If you’re looking for a highly active sales position and someone who thrives on challenge, isn’t afraid of hearing “no,” and knows that success in sales is built through dedication to training, and pure old-fashioned hard work — we’re ready to talk to you.

About the Job:

Vista Radio has an immediate opening for an Account Executive, based in Olds, AB.

What you'll do

Creating and managing multi-platform marketing campaigns that integrate radio, digital, and social media to help clients achieve their goals

Supporting an existing client base by developing new campaigns, optimizing ongoing strategies, and uncovering new growth opportunities

Prospecting and cold calling to develop new business from unassigned accounts and fresh leads

Designing creative sales strategies and proposals tailored to client needs and business goals

Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly revenue targets

Managing your own account receivables to ensure timely billing and follow-up

What you Bring

Education in sales, marketing, business, or communications preferred and entrepreneurial backgrounds are welcomed

Sales experience is an asset; media sales experience is a bonus (we’ll train the right person!)

Comfortable working on a commission-based compensation structure

Self-starter with the ability to manage time, priorities, and deadlines independently

Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills

Computer-savvy, especially with Microsoft Office or Google Suite tools

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Customer service-oriented with exceptional networking skills

Creative thinker with a knack for problem-solving and solution development

Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment

Must have a valid driver’s license and a reliable, fully insured vehicle

This is not a passive sales role. It’s for people who want to build something, push themselves, and grow quickly.

Have questions? Apply and start the conversation — we’d love to connect with you. Taking that first step is exactly the kind of drive we’re looking for.

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

🩺 Health & Dental Coverage – Comprehensive plans for individuals and families📈 RRSP Program with DPSP Matching – Vista matches your contributions into a Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan💪 Short-term & Long-term Disability – Income protection when life throws you a curveball🧠 Employee and Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) – 24/7 access to mental health and counseling support🏖️ Annual Vacation & Stat Holidays – Paid time off to relax and recharge❤️ Life & Optional Life Insurance – Protection for you and your loved ones💻 Virtual Care Access – On-demand, 24/7 healthcare wherever you are🌍 Work Where You Live – Make a real impact in the communities we serve

If you’re motivated by results, driven by challenge, and ready to take control of your earning potential, Vista Radio wants you on our team.

$18.00 - $19.00/hr.

Shift and Schedule:

Fri. - Tues. (9:30 am - 6:30 pm)

Job Type:

Full-Time

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who is naturally curious about the world around you? KTTC in Rochester, MN, is looking for a high-energy Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) who is ready to start their career by making a real impact. We’re not just looking for an employee; we’re looking for a storyteller who is eager to share facts, seek the truth, and own the news cycle across every screen—from the TV in the living room to the phone in the palm of a viewer's hand.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

What You'll Do:

• Own the news cycle: Gather, shoot, and edit high-impact content for multiple platforms, ensuring our audience stays informed.
• Pitch with purpose: Come ready to the editorial meeting with researched ideas pitched through Microsoft Teams. You’ll have already made the calls and prearranged interviews to hit the ground running.
• Master the multi-platform: Write and adapt stories for different screens—from the morning news to quick social updates and deep-dive web articles.
• Report live from the scene: Be the first on the ground when news breaks, delivering authoritative and calm live reports that keep our viewers connected.
• Verify and validate: Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and deep research—because accuracy is our foundation.
• Manage your time: Take charge of your daily workflow—from getting out the door for fresh video to editing your final masterpiece before the deadline hits.
• Stay agile: Update stories as they evolve and be ready to fill in on different shifts when the news demands it.

Why You'll Love It Here:

• A launchpad for your career: Join a young, energetic newsroom led by anchors with decades of experience who are eager to mentor the next generation of journalists.
• Growth every day: We believe feedback should happen in real time, not just during a yearly review. You’ll grow faster here than anywhere else.
• Innovation focus: KTTC is evolving on purpose—we’re serious about the future of media and want you to help shape it.
• Community impact: Tell stories that actually matter to the people of Rochester and the surrounding area.
• Supportive culture: We value scrappiness and digital innovation, but we also value our people. You’ll have the tools and the team to do your best work.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:

• The mindset: Above all else, a relentless desire to learn, seek the truth, and share stories that matter.
• Strong writing chops: You craft scripts and articles that are tight, clear, and compelling (AP style is your best friend).
• Technical potential: While we can teach you to shoot and edit video, a familiarity with camera equipment and systems like ENPS or Edius is a great head start.
• Self-motivated hustle: The ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment without breaking a sweat.
• Versatility: You can manage multiple projects at once and pivot quickly when breaking news hits.
• A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to hit the road and go where the story takes you.
• Human qualities: Empathy for the stories you tell, urgency in how you tell them, and the flexibility to roll with the punches of a dayside shift.

Ready to start your journey and own the news cycle in Rochester? Let’s create something amazing together.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Lead Material Artist (World/Props) to define and drive world material systems for an ambitious interactive open-world experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that environment and prop materials achieve a high level of visual quality, consistency, and scalability across large and diverse environments, from high-end platforms to mobile. 

The Lead Material Artist (World/Props) will work closely with the Associate Art Director – City Environment, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure materials are fully integrated within environment pipelines and rendering systems. The role involves leading and managing a team while defining scalable approaches for surfaces, tiling, modular shaders, and material libraries supporting production at multiple performance targets. 

Responsibilities 

  • Translate Art Direction into high-end world and prop materials that meet visual and technical requirements. 

  • Lead and manage the world material team, ensuring consistency and quality across assets. 

  • Define, maintain, and evolve scalable material pipelines, workflows, and best practices. 

  • Create and oversee surface materials, tiling systems, and modular shader approaches. 

  • Ensure consistency and scalability across environments, props, and large-scale worlds from high-end to mobile targets. 

  • Collaborate closely with Environment, Tech Art, and Lighting teams for proper integration. 

  • Ensure correct implementation within rendering, shading, and runtime systems. 

  • Act as a bridge between art, technical art, and pipeline development teams. 

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’un ou d’une Artiste des matériaux Lead (Environnements/Accessoires) pour définir et piloter les systèmes de matériaux d’environnement dans le cadre d’une ambitieuse expérience interactive en monde ouvert. Ce poste est responsable de veiller à ce que les matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires atteignent un niveau élevé de qualité visuelle, de cohérence et d’évolutivité dans des environnements vastes et diversifiés, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.

La personne titulaire du poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec la personne associée à la direction artistique, Environnement urbain, l’équipe d’Art technique et des équipes multidisciplinaires afin de garantir l’intégration complète des matériaux aux pipelines d’environnement et aux systèmes de rendu. Le poste implique de diriger et gérer une équipe tout en définissant des approches évolutives pour les surfaces, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling), les shaders modulaires et les bibliothèques de matériaux soutenant la production pour plusieurs cibles de performance.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Traduire la direction artistique en matériaux d’environnements et d’accessoires haut de gamme répondant aux exigences visuelles et techniques.
  • Diriger et gérer l’équipe responsable des matériaux d’environnement afin d’assurer la cohérence et la qualité des actifs.
  • Définir, maintenir et faire évoluer des pipelines de matériaux évolutifs, des flux de travail et des meilleures pratiques.
  • Créer et superviser les matériaux de surface, les systèmes de textures répétitives (tiling) et les approches de shaders modulaires.
  • Assurer la cohérence et l’évolutivité des matériaux à travers les environnements, les accessoires et les mondes à grande échelle, des plateformes haut de gamme jusqu’aux appareils mobiles.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Environnement, Art technique et Éclairage afin d’assurer une intégration adéquate.
  • Veiller à l’implantation correcte des matériaux dans les systèmes de rendu, d’ombrage et d’exécution.
  • Agir comme point de liaison entre les équipes artistiques, d’art technique et de développement des pipelines.

Basic Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on environment material creation. 

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team of artists. 

  • Experience as a Lead on at least one shipped AAA title. 

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality world and prop materials. 

  • Strong understanding of PBR workflows, surface definition, and shader systems. 

  • Experience with real-time pipelines and multi-platform performance constraints. 

  • Experience working with modern game engines such as Unreal Engine. 

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills. 

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience building scalable material libraries and reusable systems. 

  • Experience with Unreal Engine 5 and advanced shader workflows. 

  • Familiarity with procedural world-building workflows or systems. 

  • Experience working with outsourcing partners or distributed teams. 

  • Strong eye for realism, surface fidelity, and material consistency. 

QUALIFICATIONS DE BASE

  • Expérience approfondie du développement de jeux AAA, avec une spécialisation en création de matériaux d’environnement.
  • Expérience démontrée en direction et gestion d’une équipe d’artistes.
  • Expérience à titre de Lead sur au moins un titre AAA commercialisé.
  • Portfolio solide démontrant des matériaux d’environnement et d’accessoires de haute qualité.
  • Excellente compréhension des flux de travail PBR, de la définition des surfaces et des systèmes de shaders.
  • Expérience des pipelines en temps réel et des contraintes de performance multiplateformes.
  • Expérience avec des moteurs de jeu modernes tels qu’Unreal Engine.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en leadership et en collaboration.

Role Overview 

The SVP, Head of Studio Data & Insights leads Universal Entertainment's data strategy, analytics and AI insights functions in Los Angeles. Reporting to the EVP, the role owns the teams - their people, priorities, standards and delivery - and provides the sustained executive presence and stakeholder leadership that drives adoption of the function's agenda within the rhythms of the studio. 

Mission 

Over the past six years, the data function has built a substantial insights platform and analytical capability; this role will embed these capabilities in how the studio makes decisions throughout the content lifecycle, and will lead and develop the LA organization that delivers them.  

Success in this role requires a leader who shapes strategy with a one-company mindset, inspires transformation and innovation, drives execution excellence, and builds inclusive, empowered teams that can adapt through change while modelling NBCUniversal’s values. 

Core Responsibilities 

  • Act as the EVP's senior partner in-region, operating with delegated authority within an agreed decision framework and serving as the function's voice in executive, fast-moving, and cross-functional forums where in-region presence and judgement are required. 
  • Provide leadership and direction for the Los Angeles-based data strategy and analytics organization, including teams focused on insights, analytics, and AI-enabled decision support. Partner closely with the LA-based SVPs and their teams to align priorities, support delivery across the portfolio, shape the operating plan, and foster a high standard of work and impact across the region. 
  • Identify, develop, and empower talent across the leadership bench. Raise the bar through hiring, coaching, and succession planning; build collaborative and inclusive teams; grow senior leaders who can own their areas independently; and establish clear rules on which decisions genuinely need escalation. 
  • Lead and deepen the function's senior stakeholder relationships across UE's departments, owning the strategic agenda, the value narrative, and the forward asks for each. This includes establishing a consistent rhythm of engagement with department leadership — from quarterly strategic reviews to proactive intelligence — so that each senior partner has a clear, current view of the value being delivered and the opportunities ahead. 
  • Represent the Los Angeles’ studio’s requirements into the global data & analytics platform roadmap. Work with the EVP and the UK-based data platform team to translate stakeholder needs into prioritised input on analytics platforms and the underlying data and AI capability — qualifying genuine capability gaps, making the case for what the studio needs, and setting clear expectations with stakeholders on what the platform delivers and when. 
  • Partner closely with Strategy and Research teams as the function's nearest neighbours, ensuring data, analytics and AI insight is combined with strategic and audience research rather than delivered in parallel — presenting a single, coherent evidence base to decision-makers and jointly shaping the questions worth answering. 
  • Drive adoption and embedding of central insights platforms and AI-enabled analyses across creative development, greenlight, marketing, and distribution for Universal Entertainment's Film and TV divisions. The emphasis is evangelism, mandate-building, and integration into existing decision processes and systems — and success is measured in how deeply the capability becomes part of how departments work. 
  • Own the evidence of impact. Establish how the function's contribution is tracked and articulated — where insight changed a decision, and what it was worth — and carry that case to UE and NBCU leadership, so the mandate is renewed on demonstrated value rather than goodwill. 
  • Orchestrate across the function's teams in and outside the region, convening workstreams into strategically aligned and coherent outputs, and ensuring stakeholders experience the function as a single, joined-up partner rather than a collection of individual projects. 
  • Drive and maintain strategic partnerships across NBCU with a one-company mindset, identifying opportunities for data and insights sharing, supporting central initiatives focused on growth and innovation. 
  • BA/BS required, MBA or JD preferred  
  • Forward-thinking, strategic, tactical and detail-oriented; proven ability to work across an organization at all levels with technical, creative, and executive team members   
  • Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information in a discrete manner   
  • Superior analytical, presentation and communication skills – written and verbal   
  • Ability to identify key priorities and execute on them

You'll build and ship the Paramount+ Roku application used by millions of viewers. The Roku platform has constraints other platforms don't: tight memory budgets, a single-threaded render loop, device hardware that ranges from flagship to five years old. • You write and speak about technical decisions in a way that helps people act on them

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Other OTT platforms: Fire TV, Android TV, Apple TV, Samsung TV, LG webOS

• GraphQL

In this role, you will work on the core infrastructure and internal tools that enable high- quality metadata ingestion and curation directly impacting content discovery, recommendations, and user experience across Paramount's streaming portfolio.   This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of content, data, and machine learning, partnering closely with ML engineers, product teams, and data stakeholders to bring metadata-driven experiences to life.   The ideal candidate will be:   - Enthusiastic about spanning the full lifecycle of a content data system from ingest and enrichment through deployment, monitoring, and downstream delivery - Invested in going beyond moving data to understanding it; developing domain-level familiarity with the content catalog, and how data quality issues upstream affect systems downstream - Committed to continuous improvement; takes ownership of feature implementation, plans for future maintainability - Skilled at partnering with Product to translate evolving content strategy into concrete engineering decisions; asking clarifying questions and iterating toward well-defined solutions under ambiguity - Collaborative across engineering teams; working with upstream providers and downstream consumers to define integration contracts, and ensuring the sequencing of changes so that features ship cohesively - Eager to leverage AI agents in the software development process for understanding code, troubleshooting, developing new features, and fixing issues   Responsibilities Include: Metadata Ingestion & Enrichment - Design, build, and maintain backend services that support content understanding, metadata modeling, and enrichment workflows - Contribute to systems that process and manage metadata for a large-scale, global content catalog Backend Services & Data Modeling - Maintain and expand the API layer and data models across two provider contexts (Paramount+ and PlutoTV) as the codebase converges toward a unified multi-tenant architecture - Uphold engineering quality through test coverage, code reviews, and consistent application of coding standards Internal Tooling & Curation - Support editorial curation workflows that feed the personalization experience, ensuring curators have the tooling and data quality needed to make effective content decisions     Basic Qualifications     - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience - Strong proficiency in a Python web API and ORM framework (Django/ORM/DRF preferred) - Knowledge of cloud infrastructure including managed databases, object storage, and container orchestration (GCP, AWS, or Azure) - API design with backwards compatibility across multiple consumer teams - Relational data modeling for transactional systems - Experience building data engineering pipelines, including best practices like defensive coding at ingestion boundaries, instrumentation to surface anomalies early, and awareness of data drift so that quality issues are caught before they propagate downstream     Additional Qualifications     - Django and Django REST Framework for production backend applications - Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, GKE - Google Cloud Pub/Sub subscriber/publisher patterns - Elasticsearch index management, full-text search, mapping updates - Experience building content metadata management systems - Exposure to personalization, recommendation systems, or ML-adjacent platforms - Experience working in event-driven architectures, designing systems around async pipelines  

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Visual Journalist

Bring stories to life in a fast-moving, digital-first newsroom. As a visual journalist at McClatchy, you’ll shape how our diverse and growing community sees itself—capturing moments, people and issues with photography and video that matter to our readers. Job Description:


WSJ Newsroom | Senior Data Analyst (September 2026)

The Wall Street Journal is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our newsroom data team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Newsroom Analytics. You will work directly with editorial, audience, and product teams on the decisions that shape how our journalism is reported, prioritized, and delivered to readers.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role that blends strong analytical craft with sharp newsroom judgment. You will own the analyses, dashboards, and measurement frameworks the newsroom depends on, and see your work through from question to adopted decision. You will also help set the technical bar for the data team, mentoring more junior colleagues and strengthening our shared practices.

This position will be based in our New York office.

You will:

  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to newsroom editorial and strategy leaders, driving audience growth, engagement and retention. Frame the right questions, answer them with rigorous analysis, and translate findings for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain centralized dashboards and automated reports that expand self-serve access to newsroom data.

  • Run deep-dive analyses on areas of opportunity, major news events, high-priority moments, and unexplained shifts in performance.

  • Push measurement forward by developing novel metrics and analytical frameworks that inform newsroom strategy, and drive adoption across editorial, product, and business teams.

  • Own and maintain the reporting stack, partnering with data engineering and product to keep our data accurate, fresh, and high-quality, and to strengthen the taxonomies, instrumentation, and foundational datasets the newsroom relies on. Respond to and prevent pipeline incidents so daily reporting stays reliable.

  • Design and run A/B tests and experiments in partnership with strategy, product, and tech teams, applying statistical measurement to interpret results and translate them into decisions about editorial and audience strategy.

  • Mentor junior analysts, set shared standards for technical and non-technical outputs, and contribute to a shared library of methods and lessons the team can pull from.

You have:

  • 3+ years in data analytics, data science, or a related field, preferably in media, publishing, or content.

  • Track record of owning recurring reporting end-to-end and delivering analyses whose findings have shaped business decisions.

  • Strong SQL skills, with experience working in large-scale data warehouses like BigQuery or Snowflake, and analytics-engineering frameworks like dbt.

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests, and applying statistical methods to interpret results

  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, data wrangling, and automating analytical workflows, with experience  maintaining code in Git.

  • Strong communication skills, with a track record of driving alignment and consensus across cross-functional groups.

Standout candidates will have strengths in one or more of the following:

  • A background in content performance analysis, audience segmentation, cohort analysis, or editorial research.

  • Working knowledge of off-platform attribution, connecting distributed content and platform referrals to downstream engagement.

job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We work closely with the local finance teams around the world which means we have an excellent understanding of how the company operates and are kept up to date with key developments in this exciting and fast paced industry.   • Monitoring of third-party PTP team to ensure adherence to established processes and policies.

  • Review /assess the accuracy of PTP transactions and promptly address process gaps and noncompliance issues Ensure up to date and complete documentation ( SOPs & DPMs )

Support and Training:

  • Assist with requests by local finance
  • Support the PTP Manager in identifying PTP training needs in order to built best-in-class PTP services

Process Improvement:

  • Implement best practices to improve operational efficiency.

Transition

  • Prepare comprehensive desktop procedures to ensure a seamless transition process.
  • Actively participate in transition calls to facilitate effective communication and coordination.
  • Capture and document essential knowledge for a smooth handover of responsibilities.
  • Share the knowledge and best practices with PTP Global team members
  • Support more junior team members by leading by example and providing feedback
  • Engage in new processes/systems/tools testing and provide feedback

Performance Metrics:

  • Comprehend and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess PTP Global Team and the third-party team's performance and also prepare PTP Dashboards.
  • Generate regular reports and dashboards to track and communicate progress to the PTP Manager

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience, preferably in a multi-national company with proven experience in a supervisory role within a PTP or Accounts Payable function
  • Strong understanding of PTP processes, systems, and best practices
  • SAP experience
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred - in accounting/ finance
  • MS Office proficient
  • Problem solving ability
  • Proactive self- starter
  • Flexible working style

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you'll make an impact:

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SiriusXM, you will bring machine learning models from development and experimentation to reliable, scalable production systems. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Services teams to productionize models, build robust feature pipelines, and ensure models operate reliably in live environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership across deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management of ML systems.

What you'll do:

Model Productionization and Deployment

  • Lead the deployment of ML models into production using Databricks and MLFlow, ensuring high performance and integration with existing systems.

  • Implement scalable and reliable model serving solutions (both batch and real-time).

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, validation, and deployment of ML artifacts.

  • Support safe rollout and rollback strategies across environments.

Feature Engineering and Serving

  • Translate feature definitions from data scientists into production-grade pipelines.

  • Build and maintain reliable feature serving systems to ensure consistency between training and inference environments.

  • Optimize feature pipelines for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

Model Lifecycle Management

  • Support model registration, versioning, publishing, and promotion.

  • Implement retraining pipelines and redeploy improved models as data and algorithms evolve.

  • Participate in the decommissioning and retirement of models.

Reliability, Observability, and Performance

  • Ensure production models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements.

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting of ML systems.

  • Investigate and resolve issues related to model performance, deployments, and infrastructure.

  • Contribute to operational runbooks and documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with data scientists, engineers, and other stakeholders, providing ML engineering and operations expertise and support.

Best Practices Implementation

  • Spearhead the adoption of industry best practices in ML engineering and operations, focusing on areas like version control, data governance, and resource optimization.

Problem Resolution

  • Identify and resolve complex issues in ML model performance, deployment, and operational workflows.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering, MLOps, data engineering, or a similar role.

  • Working knowledge of ML models and algorithms.

  • 2+ years of experience with Databricks, MLFlow, and other relevant ML tools and frameworks.

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling and practices, e.g., CDK, Terraform

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

job.title: Assistant Editor, Visuals
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

We’re looking for a senior editor to lead our visual journalism across Asia, driving the execution of new forms of storytelling and overseeing a team of graphics and multimedia journalists. This role is based in the Times’ Seoul newsroom. 

Visual journalists at The Times have investigated how China built a great wall of villages along its frontier and strong-armed its way into dominating the South China Sea, documented the Myanmar military’s campaign of terror against its own people and Taliban rule in Afghanistan, and reconstructed South Korean president’s botched martial law bid. They have revealed how drones have transformed the war in Ukraine. They have also devised ambitious multimedia approaches to explain the far-reaching impact of the Iran war, air pollution in India and American households’ reliance on Chinese goods.

We want to do more of these kinds of stories. And we want to continue to transform how we work to bring visual reporting and editing into the core of how we show readers the world and hold power accountable. We will do this through compelling graphical explanations; urgent, immersive field reporting in photography and video; sharp visual news coverage; and investigations driven by deep reporting on imagery and data.

This role reports to the assistant international editor for visuals in New York and collaborates with the Asia editor to help drive coverage of Asia. You will work closely with the lead video producer and photo editor in Seoul, the senior editor for visuals in London, and counterparts in photo, video, graphics and news design.

This is an in-office position based in Seoul,  and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Main responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with international editors to drive visual coverage of Asia. 
  • Coordinate, lead and edit the work of correspondents and visual journalists on visual stories.
  • Serve as the leader of a small group of graphics/multimedia reporters focused on Asia, helping to create, design and edit multimedia coverage. 
  • In collaboration with the deputy International editor for visuals, plan and execute stories that use data analysis and visualization, photography, imagery analysis, open source investigation and other reporting techniques.
  • Work with desk leaders to shape and execute our broader editorial strategy for visual journalism, including how we should work with partners in photo, video, graphics and news design.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the assistant international editor for visuals.

Basic qualifications:

  • Strong news judgment.
  • Ability to identify and conceive ambitious stories, spot visual opportunities in reporting and develop them into a range of compelling visual forms.
  • Skill pulling multiple visual disciplines together into multimedia projects, with an emphasis on visualization, explanatory visuals, digital design, use of video and other visual forms. 
  • A record of clear communication and strong collaboration with colleagues.
  • The ability to write clearly, work on tight deadlines and edit to sharpen the relationship between visuals and copy.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams to create ambitious multimedia news stories, including interactive visuals, and help them develop as journalists. . 
  • Strong portfolio in one or more of these areas: data visualization, mapping, explanatory writing, news illustration, digital design, interactive development and explanatory multimedia or video.

In order to be considered for this role, please submit the link to your portfolio/clips.

job.title: Senior Newsroom Developer
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a Sr. Newsroom Developer (Machine Learning) to help build the next generation of AI-powered newsroom and product capabilities. As we expand into new sector products, new professional audiences and new geographies, POLITICO is investing in machine learning systems that go beyond simply integrating foundation models. This role will work alongside software engineers, product managers, journalists and editorial leadership to develop models, evaluation frameworks and data pipelines that apply POLITICO's editorial expertise across AI-powered tools and improve newsroom and product workflows.


The ideal candidate is excited about applying machine learning in support of journalism. You'll work closely with software engineers, journalists and product teams to develop AI-powered tools and data products that strengthen reporting, improve newsroom workflows and help bring POLITICO's editorial expertise to a broader audience.


What You'll Do:

  • Design, build and deploy production machine learning systems that support newsroom, editorial and new-audience initiatives.
  • Develop classification, prediction and ranking models using proprietary newsroom data and editorial expertise — a modeling foundation that extends across new products rather than requiring a bespoke build per vertical.
  • Build datasets, feature engineering pipelines and evaluation frameworks to improve AI system performance.
  • Experiment with prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning and other model adaptation techniques to solve journalism-specific problems.
  • Partner closely with journalists and editors to translate editorial knowledge into machine learning features, labels and evaluation criteria.
  • Collaborate with software engineers to integrate machine learning capabilities into production applications.
  • Measure and improve model quality using rigorous evaluation methodologies that balance accuracy, editorial standards and operational performance.
  • Evaluate new AI technologies while considering performance, cost, maintainability and long-term flexibility.

Example Projects:

You may work on initiatives such as:

  • Building systems that classify the newsworthiness of stories using editorial judgment.
  • Developing prediction models that combine public information with POLITICO's proprietary reporting expertise.
  • Improving AI-assisted editing by helping models better understand and apply POLITICO's editorial style guide.
  • Creating proprietary classifiers that enrich public datasets with editorial intelligence, extendable to new sector products as they launch.
  • Designing evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality before newsroom deployment.
  • Optimizing AI workflows to improve performance while reducing inference costs.
  • Supporting investigative and enterprise reporting through machine-learning-assisted analysis of complex datasets.

What You'll Need:

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience building or deploying machine learning systems.
  • Strong software engineering skills, preferably in Python.
  • Experience with machine learning fundamentals including supervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation and experimentation.
  • Experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Familiarity with large language models, embeddings or natural language processing techniques.
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with engineers, product managers and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience adapting or fine-tuning foundation models.
  • Experience building NLP, information retrieval, classification or ranking systems.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation frameworks, experiment tracking or MLOps practices.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models to cloud infrastructure.
  • Interest in journalism, media, public policy or knowledge-intensive domains.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year:

  • Improve the accuracy and reliability of AI systems used by POLITICO's newsroom.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that help teams confidently assess AI quality and editorial alignment.
  • Contribute to proprietary classifiers, prediction systems and editorial intelligence capabilities that differentiate a named initiative.
  • Partner effectively with software engineers, product teams and newsroom stakeholders to bring machine learning solutions into production.
  • Help establish a strong technical foundation for future AI initiatives across the newsroom and our new lines of business.

COMPENSATION: $175,000 - $225,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

job.title: Vice President, Global Controller
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an experienced Vice President, Global Controller to lead our global accounting function and serve as a key partner to the CFO and Finance leadership team. Based at our Arlington, Virginia headquarters and reporting to the CFO, you will lead our Global Accounting Team (US and European). This highly visible role will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of POLITICO’s financial operations across our growing global organization. The ideal candidate brings deep technical accounting expertise combined with strong business judgment and a modern, forward-looking approach to finance—someone who can strengthen controls and processes, develop a high-performing global team, and build the financial infrastructure needed to support POLITICO’s continued growth and evolving business.


Who You Are:

  • A strategic finance leader and trusted advisor who can translate complex accounting and financial matters into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions for senior leadership.
  • A strong technical accounting expert with deep knowledge of financial reporting, controls, audit, compliance, and accounting policy across a complex, multi-entity organization.
  • A hands-on operator and transformation leader who can balance day-to-day execution with opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale global finance processes.
  • A collaborative global leader who builds strong partnerships across Finance and the broader business and can effectively navigate different entities, markets, and regulatory environments.
  • A developer of high-performing teams who establishes clear accountability, develops talent, and creates a culture of accuracy, partnership, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the global close and IFRS consolidation for group reporting, with operational accounting delivered through our regional Controllers.
  • Set accounting policy and be the final voice on complex judgments, including subscription revenue recognition.
  • Lead statutory reporting and filings in every jurisdiction in which POLITICO operates, in partnership with our external accountants.
  • Own the financial governance and control framework (ICFR), and serve as the main contact for external auditors and Internal Audit.
  • Oversee tax accounting, transfer pricing and indirect tax compliance with external tax advisers.
  • Partner with tax and legal on international structure, entity set-up, and the financial unwinding, liquidation or roll-up of legacy and redundant entities.
  • Support acquisitions end to end, from financial due diligence and quality of earnings through to post-deal integration.
  • Lead purchase accounting, including purchase price allocation, valuation of identifiable intangibles and annual goodwill impairment testing.
  • Lead the accounting for disposals and restructurings, including carve-out financials and discontinued operations.
  • Drive automation of finance processes in Workday and the order-to-cash flow from Salesforce through to the ledger.
  • Build and develop the global accounting team, set clear accountabilities, and define how we measure the function’s success.

What You’ll Need:

Required

  • 15+ years of progressive accounting experience at an international group, including several years as a regional or global Controller.
  • A professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) and a degree in accounting, finance or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of the accounting principles under both IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Experience consolidating a multi-entity, multi-currency group into a large corporate parent, whether in industry or in an audit practice.
  • Proven ownership of an internal control framework over financial reporting and of external audits.
  • Strong revenue recognition experience (IFRS 15 and ASC 606), ideally with subscription, advertising or events revenue.
  • Working knowledge of transfer pricing and international tax, enough to shape structure and challenge advisers. You do not need to be a tax specialist.
  • Experience leading finance teams across countries and time zones, including a regular early-morning overlap with our Brussels hub.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with acquisitions, disposals or carve-outs, including purchase accounting and discontinued operations.
  • Workday Financials and Salesforce experience, and a record of automating close and reporting.
  • Familiarity with Belgian GAAP, and additional European languages.

Compensation: $250,000 - $275,000 annual salary. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

job.title: Standards and Ethics Editor (Temporary, 12-Months)
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is looking for an experienced editor of impeccable judgment for a 12-month, 4 days per week assignment to join our growing global standards and ethics team to ensure the integrity of our journalism across all platforms and deepen our bonds of trust with readers.

 

This role comes with a mandate to uphold POLITICO’s editorial values and commitment to authoritative, nonpartisan and tough-mindedly fair journalism; to provide an essential quality check on all the work we do; and to set guidelines but more importantly in real time help journalists resolve knotty ethical questions as they arise.

 

This editor will serve as a hands-on collaborator with other editors on pre-publication reporting and reviews of our most sensitive content as well as the countless issues that come up in the course of producing ambitious and innovative journalism.

 

This editor will take a lead role in writing and updating newsroom policies and stylebook entries to offer clear direction to the staff across the globe and work alongside others to assist on training and development programs for our journalists. 

 

This 32-hours-a-week position can be based in Arlington, VA, New York, NY or Sacramento, CA with the strong preference to work in the afternoon and evening (Eastern Standard Time).


What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a hands-on editor who can offer pre-publication guidance on stories
  • Address and resolve issues related to our journalism after it is published
  • Help research and write newsroom policies on ethics and professional behavior and stylebook entries 
  • Assist in designing training and development programs for POLITICO journalists

 

 What You’ll Need:

  • A rigorous commitment to fair-minded, nonpartisan journalism 
  • Ability to juggle multiple tasks at once at a demanding pace  
  • Desire to collaborate with journalists across the newsroom, helping broker solutions to challenging situations
  • Demonstrated commitment to excellence and the highest standards of professional integrity.

Compensation:

  • $100,000–$120,000 annual salary, based on a four-day-per-week (80% FTE) schedule

Please submit a resume and cover letter under the Resume/CV section of the application.

Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a Newsroom Engineering intern for Summer 2027. The intern will help reporters and editors solve real workflow problems with practical, responsible technology, with the goal to help shape the future of newsroom tools and workflows. This opportunity sits at the intersection of journalism, product thinking, and technology, supporting experiments and internal tools that help reporters and editors work more effectively. You’ll help research newsroom needs, code real tools, and evaluate AI-assisted workflows in newsroom contexts.


You don't need necessarily need to come from a Computer Science background. If you ever written a script to scrape data for a story, built a personal site or taught yourself to code out of curiosity – that counts.


Who You Are: 

  • You have both journalistic instincts and a technical aptitude 
  • You like understanding how reporters and editors work, where workflows break down, and how tools can help. 
  • You’re thoughtful about emerging technologies, including AI, and interested in how they can support journalism 
  • You’re comfortable collaborating across multiple stakeholders, especially with reporters, editors, product managers and engineers 

 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Own at least one scoped project that improves how reporters or editors work 
  • Contribute to other Newsroom Engineering projects by writing code, building prototypes, testing features and documenting technical decisions 
  • Research and document workflow challenges facing reporters and editors  
  • Help identify opportunities to improve newsroom processes and internal tools. 
  • Test prototypes and internal tools with realistic reporting and editing scenarios. 
  • Help evaluate AI-assisted workflows for accuracy, usefulness, risk and editorial fit. 
  • Participate in conversations about responsible technology usage in newsroom products and workflows 

 

What You’ll Need: 

  • Demonstrated interest in Washington, politics and policy 
  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadlines 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset 
  • Proven experience in a newsroom. At least one professional news media internship or job preferred 
  • Familiarity with basic technical concepts, digital tools, or prototyping workflows is preferred 
  • Interest in AI and emerging technologies as they relate to journalism and editorial work 

 

Why Intern at POLITICO?

We’re looking for interns on the following teams:

  • Breaking News: Interns cover fast-paced developments in real time, quickly turning around stories on Washington’s most important power players and events.

  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently under deadlines
