job.title: Senior / Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the cloud that runs Suno. That covers our Kubernetes clusters, the GPU compute behind our AI workloads, and the network that connects them. You’ll report to our Security Lead, work closely with Platform Engineering, and partner with AppSec engineers and our Detection & Response team as they grow alongside you. This is a building job. You’ll write threat models, set hardened defaults, and create paved paths that engineers actually want to use. Some of the work is familiar cloud security. Some of it, like securing AI infrastructure, is new for everyone. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/Utj2JDlLzR4Dvs3p What You'll Do Build Suno’s infrastructure threat model across cloud, Kubernetes, GPU compute platforms, and networking, and use it with the Security Lead to decide where to focus first. Harden our EKS clusters, GPU compute environments, and infrastructure-as-code pipeline, including who can change infrastructure and how. job.title: US Legal Correspondent
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

The role

The Financial Times is looking for an experienced journalist to join the New York bureau to cover law and the legal industry.

The beat has essentially two interlocking halves, one focusing on white collar crime and financial enforcement, and the other centered on the powerful law firms and larger-than-life characters operating in the world’s largest legal market.

The first half is rooted in the federal prosecutor’s offices in New York’s Southern and Eastern Districts, and the enforcement arms of the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission. That means covering some of the US’s highest profile white collar cases – past examples include the investigations into First Brands’ Patrick James, Archegos’ Bill Hwang and FTX’s Sam Bankman-Fried. 

You will also collaborate directly with the US Justice correspondent and corporate beat reporters to cover top legal cases elsewhere in the country. That requires proficiency in developing relationships with both defence attorneys and prosecutors in New York and beyond.

Coverage of the legal industry means breaking news and writing about the top American lawyers and law firms who act as powerbrokers across business, finance and politics. Lawyers pop up as key donors and advisers on both sides of the political aisle and litigation – or the threat of it – is the constant companion of corporate activity, government regulation and the electoral process. 

The FT has been expanding its footprint in the US professional services sector at a time of significant change that is challenging the business models of the big law firms. Consolidation is accelerating, as are high-profile poaching raids. Private equity is eyeing a way into the profession. AI threatens to upend both training and billing norms, and some venerable firms are struggling while upstarts expand into new practice areas

 

Key responsibilities

  • Cover federal and New York authorities responsible for investigating and prosecuting financial and corporate malfeasance
  • Develop sources in the criminal defence bar and state and federal courts to break stories in core FT areas, including money laundering, insider trading and financial fraud
  • Work closely with Washington, London and corporate correspondents while cooperating within a distributed team to pursue big cases
  • Pick out unique angles on New York law firms and prominent lawyers for compelling reads on the legal community
  • Weekend shifts are required as part of the team rota

 

Who we are looking for

You will have a proven track record of breaking stories on news-heavy beats, and shown an ability to work well within a team. You will be expected to quickly parse complex legal documents and translate legal jargon to deliver clean copy and compelling narratives. Familiarity with the intricacies of international finance is preferred, given the frequently complicated cases brought by federal authorities.  

 

Please submit your application by the end of the day, Wednesday 28th October 2026

 

Salary range

A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role is $90,000-$135,000p.a. To ensure pay fairness, the successful candidate will be offered a salary within the estimated salary range based on a number of considerations including but not limited to: skill set; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organisational needs.

This position is open to a broad pool of candidates, both internal and external. Where an external candidate is hired or a successful internal candidate is appointed to the role on terms covered by the collective bargaining agreement, they will be represented by the News Media Guild (NMG). Candidates appointed on other (i.e. foreign) employment terms, including certain internal transfers on assignments from other bureaux, may not be represented by the NMG.

 

The use of AI

Original reporting, great writing and intelligent commentary lie at the heart of FT journalism. Our readers trust us to produce quality journalism that is accurate, fair and insightful. This is why FT editorial staff do not by default use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to write articles or create other reader-facing content. For specific and pre-approved cases, AI can be harnessed for certain tasks, such as assisting data research for investigations.  

We expect applicants to the FT newsroom to refrain from using AI in their test submissions, and any written materials should be a genuine reflection of their own knowledge, skills and experiences. We encourage candidates only to employ AI as a tool to help with research and interview readiness for a role. 

Candidates should be aware that the use of AI throughout the application process is monitored to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process for all.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion 

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

FT Newsroom staff are expected to work onsite a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and regular review. While flexible working requests will be considered, not all patterns are suitable for Editorial roles.

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory. 

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help. 

*LI-RS1

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

  • Lead the design, build, and management of content analysis and reporting systems and procedures

job.title: Sr. Product Designer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

 

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

Money moves our business—and you’ll be the one keeping it aligned.

As our Cash Operations Expert, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of Cash and Cash Equivalents across Skydance (Previously Paramount). If you’re a sharp, process-minded finance professional who thrives on turning complex ledger data into seamless automation and trusted business partnerships, this is the place to make a measurable impact.

What You’ll Do

This is a high-visibility, dynamic role with a blend of core cash accounting, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization.

  • Master the Ledgers: Drive the day-to-day management, standard journal entry preparation, and monthly reconciliation of all Cash and Cash Equivalent accounts.

  • Connect the Dots: Serve as a trusted finance partner providing hands-on accounting support across Treasury, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Payroll and Production Finance teams.

  • Maintain Gold-Standard Controls: Ensure internal policies, procedures, and SOX compliance framework controls are robust, active, and audit-ready.

  • Own Audit Operations: Partner directly with external auditors during annual reviews, managing information requests and technical inquiries.

  • Drive Automation & Efficiency: Bring a continuous improvement mindset—modifying rules, automating cash clearing processes, and standardizing workflows as activities migrate into our Global Business Services (GBS) model.

  • Mentor & Champion Projects: Guide, educate, and train junior team members while actively participating in broader finance transformation projects.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Effective Communicator: Confident presenter, open communicator, and persuasive partner who can translate big-picture vision into actionable daily plans.

  • Role Model & Mentor: A mature, positive professional with a can-do attitude who fosters a culture of learning, collaboration, and DE&I advocacy.

  • Risk & Control Awareness: Sharp eyes for process controls, risk mitigation, and compliance.

Why Skydance (Previously Paramount)?

You’ll be joining a creative, global media powerhouse where your analytical skills help protect and propel the business forward. We value innovative thinkers who aren't afraid to challenge current processes and build smarter ways of working.

job.title: Writer/Editor, The Stockton Record
job.description:
The Stockton Record/recordnet.com, part of the USA TODAY Co., seeks an ambitious writer/editor to serve as a player/coach at one of the Central Valley’s most storied print and digital mastheads

You’ll be physically based in Stockton – and if you’re the right candidate, that’s the only way you’d have it. Stockton is home to some 320,000 people and is among America’s most diverse cities – full of vibrant culture, a global smorgasbord of food options and an endless supply of great stories. Its local government and public schools remain mired in controversy and allegations of corruption. A political operator runs a large-scale local influence network posing as news. Local journalists here have to rely on tough skin and fierce determination. There are few places where the need for professional journalism is greater.

In short, somebody could win the Pulitzer covering Stockton. It might be you and your team.

The prevailing candidate will lead by example, pursuing high-interest and impactful journalism while serving as a mentor and assigning editor to fellow journalists.

As a player/coach you will divide your time to maintain a consistent flow of quality journalism, some of which you will pursue and some of which you’ll provide guidance for, from idea to publication, to deliver stories that engage on key issues and interests within the community. This will mean working with reporters to hone ideas into focused stories driven by readers’ interests and needs. You will help to cultivate a high-performing team and intentionally create a culture of collaboration and belonging.

As a hands-on digital leader, you will make effective use of social media, SEO and trends garnered from metrics. You’ll watch analytics throughout the day, adapting to the audience in real time; and you’ll be a voracious consumer of content strategy reports that show trends in our coverage and readers’ interest. The successful leader in this role is adept at translating raw data into the language of journalism and motivating front-line journalists. Dedication to transparency and accountability is key, as well as an eye for meaningful enterprise and quick-turn watchdog stories with a focus on solutions.

Player/coach journalists are part of a team in Gannett’s Center for Community Journalism, a nationwide leadership, editing and planning structure supporting small and mid-sized newsrooms. They may work across multiple newsrooms and even across state lines, so curiosity and commitment to remote teams and other communities is essential. The CCJ is designed to prioritize what matters most to local communitie

The player/coach reports to the group editor and supervises frontline journalists within the wider context of the CCJ.

Responsibilities:

Coaching and directly supervising front-line journalists.

Ensuring steady productivity around high value topics and adjusting as needed.

Prioritizing DEIB values in story selection, sourcing, hiring and coaching.

Being the local face of the news organization for the community and ensuring local engagement by frontline journalists. Must live in the area or be able to relocate.

Helping the staff hone skills in a wide range of storytelling: from real-time digital updates to narrative storytelling, employing alternative story forms and multimedia.

Using metrics and analytics to determine how to best reach and grow the audience.

Increasing digital audience and engagement and growing digital subscriptions.

Assuring daily work is completed on time and efficiently, setting priorities and coordinating with colleagues.

Receiving assignments in the form of objectives to meet goals; administering company policies that directly affect team members.

Assigning and editing articles for context, completeness, fairness, accuracy, balance, and adherence to news values. Demonstrating strong news judgment in the selection, prioritization and editing of content.

Writing effective digital headlines, social media posts, briefs and breaking news alerts that help attract audiences.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, marketing, or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

3-5 years of relevant work experience. Management/supervisory experience a plus.

Commitment to values of fairness, diversity, inclusion, and professionalism.

Live and work in the coverage area – this position is not remote

Strong writing skills and a command of grammar and style.

Strong story and word editing skills.

Knowledge of data-based reporting and use of spreadsheets such as Excel.

Ability to work collaboratively with others locally and regionally to meet common goals.

Candidates should have facility with AI and automation and experience in using it to enhance their journalism

Demonstrated commitment to reader interest and reader questions in helping reporters frame stories, utilizing tools such as Google Trends and Parse.ly.

Top-notch planning, organizational and time management skills.

Understanding of metrics, social media, and SEO and how they relate to the audience funnel.

Self-motivation and self-direction.

Ability to work as a member of a team.

Ability to multi-task and excel under deadline pressure in a rapidly changing environment.

Solid news judgment and mastery of ethical and legal principles in day-to-day journalism.

This role requires a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment, post-offer background check, drug screen & motor vehicle record check

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to no more than three published stories, writing samples and/or audio samples.

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Advertising Operations Associate
job.description:
Advertising Operations Associate - Lincoln, NE

Are you highly organized, detail-oriented and energized by keeping a fast-paced sales organization running smoothly? We're seeking an Advertising Operations Associate who thrives behind the scenes, connecting people, processes and information to help our sales team succeed. In this role, you'll serve as a critical link between sales, finance and internal operations, ensuring accurate revenue reporting, tracking sales performance, resolving billing questions and supporting the day-to-day needs of our advertising business. Based in Lincoln, this position is ideal for a proactive problem-solver who enjoys working with data, managing multiple priorities and making a meaningful impact on business performance.

Your responsibilities will include:

Sales Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, including revenue to goal, active accounts, sales activity and progress toward individual and team targets. Provide timely, accurate reporting to help drive accountability and revenue growth.

Pre- and Post-Sales Support: Proactively support the sales team throughout the sales cycle, from prospect research and proposal preparation to order entry, billing and follow-up. Streamline administrative processes and remove obstacles so our sales professionals can spend more time selling and less time on paperwork.

Revenue Analysis: Research and resolve invoice questions, billing discrepancies and revenue-related issues, working collaboratively with sales, finance and other internal teams.

Sales Tracking & Project Management: Develop and maintain trackers for advertising initiatives, sales campaigns and special projects, monitoring progress, deadlines and results.

Financial Reporting: Prepare profit and loss (P&L) statements for advertising projects and publications, providing insights into financial performance.

Data Management & Sales Intelligence: Research and compile historical client advertising spend, contract information, campaign tactics and other business intelligence to support sales strategies, client meetings and revenue opportunities.

Advertising Campaign Coordination: Serve as a liaison between the sales team and internal operations to help ensure accurate order processing, timely campaign execution and resolution of operational issues.

Digital Advertising Knowledge: Maintain a working understanding of digital advertising solutions, including Google, Meta/Facebook and programmatic advertising, to effectively support the sales team and internal processes.

The ideal candidate will:

Possess a bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or related field.

Have 2+ years of experience in advertising sales coordination or a similar role.

Demonstrate strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Hubspot.

Be Able to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager - Customer Success,  you will be the trusted technical leader responsible for driving the successful delivery, integration, and adoption of our AI-powered pricing solutions. You will own the end-to-end customer delivery lifecycle; from discovery to go-live and continuous optimization; ensuring every engagement delivers measurable business impact.


In this role, you will lead complex technical deployments, act as the bridge between customers and product teams, and mentor junior engineers to ensure consistent excellence in delivery execution. Your blend of technical depth, customer empathy, and delivery discipline will make you a key contributor to our customers’ success and Dow Jones Energy’s continued growth.     • Drive delivery governance; risk management, progress tracking, and stakeholder communication  to ensure customer confidence and alignment
  • Customer Engagement & Success

  • Integration & Automation Expertise

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing
    • Support the professional growth of delivery engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and methodology improvements
    • Champion a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning within the Customer Success team



You Have:
  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software implementations, ideally in customer-facing roles

job.title: Sr. Specialist, Licensing Operations
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Sr. Specialist, Licensing Operations  partners with Licensing and Technology teams to support business process improvement and ensure system changes align with operational needs. This role is responsible for assigned recurring and business-critical processes; documents and validates business requirements; and coordinates user acceptance testing for CRM and related technology changes. Two specialists serving in this role will be assigned responsibility for related processes, initiatives, and releases while cross-training across the broader workload to provide continuity and coverage. The position coordinates cross-functional work through requirements gathering, testing, implementation, and post-release support; maintains process documentation; and prepares reporting related to requirements, testing progress, defects, risks, readiness, and outcomes.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

Shares responsibility with a peer manager for assigned Licensing Operations processes, projects, testing activities, and system releases, while providing cross-trained backup coverage across the team.

Maintains common templates, documentation standards, and established practices for process improvement, business requirements, user acceptance testing, implementation readiness, and sustainment.

Coordinates assigned recurring, active, business-critical, and ad hoc operational initiatives, providing project coordination, research, organizational, and analytical support while maintaining documentation, schedules, service expectations, review cycles, and stakeholder communications.

job.title: Review Panel Member
job.description:
Guardian News & Media (GNM) is a leading global media organisation, publisher of the guardian.com and The Guardian newspaper, acclaimed for investigative journalism on topics such as phone hacking among the UK press, the Paradise Papers and Panama Papers, the Pegasus Project and investigations into Nigel Farage and his finances.  

As well as being the UK’s largest quality news brand, GNM has pioneered a highly distinctive, open approach to publishing on the web and has achieved significant global audience growth over the past 20 years, with growing newsrooms and operations in the US and Australia

 

Guardian News and & Media operates a system of self-regulation that consists of editorial standards and behaviour governed by the GNM editorial code of practice, an internally independent readers’ editor who receives complaints from readers who believe that journalists have breached the GNM editorial code of practice, and an independent review panel established in 2014 by the Scott Trust.

 

The review panel exists to ensure that where complainants do not feel their issues have been adequately resolved through the internal complaints procedures, they have the chance to have their complaint further considered by an independent panel. The role of the review panel is to consider only those complaints that fall under one of the 16 sections of the revised GNM editorial code of practice Editors’ Code of Practice. Its role is not to regulate GNM, or its journalists or to review complaints against wider guidance to GNM journalists.

The Scott Trust is responsible for appointing the review panel. 

 

The Trust is seeking to appoint a new member of its review panel to work alongside existing chair and panel members to assess complaints received by the panel, in accordance with its terms of reference. The successful candidate is likely to have an understanding of digital journalism and media regulation. 

 

Person specification

 

Candidates must be able to demonstrate the following essential criteria:

  • The capacity to act fairly and impartially in the decision-making of the panel.
  • Knowledge and experience of the process of journalism or news publishing.
  • Experience of the role of self-regulation in maintaining high standards of industry practice. Knowledge of media law would be welcome.
  • An understanding of journalistic codes of practice, processes and standards.
  • An affinity with The Scott Trust values of honesty, integrity, courage, fairness, a sense of duty to the reader and the community and public interest journalism.

Responsibilities:

  • To consider and scrutinise case bundles provided to the review panel with a view to playing an active role in helping the panel to make a determination.
  • To work collegiately with other panel members to come to a consensus view on the outcomes of cases.

Appointment Term

New panel members will be appointed for an initial term of four years, which may be extended once by a further period of four years.

 

Time Commitment

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

What you’ll work on

You will be accountable for ensuring the engineering team is effectively organised, supported and resourced to deliver business outcomes. This includes leading delivery and planning, managing engineering capacity and priorities, building strong relationships with Product, Programme and business stakeholders, and ensuring risks, dependencies and resource constraints are understood and actively managed.

You will be leading a team through a significant transformation of the FT's commercial technology landscape, balancing the delivery of new capabilities with the operational health of existing platforms, the development of engineering capability and the longer-term evolution of the Commercial Technology estate.

You will also work with Principal Engineers and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your team's boundaries, ensuring local engineering decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

Engineering Delivery & Planning

  • Identify and actively manage delivery risks, dependencies, resource constraints and capability gaps, escalating where necessary.
  • Continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, documentation and ways of working.

  • Leading, supporting and developing engineers, admins and specialists across Marketing Technology and Commercial Data through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback and career development.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with Product, Programme, business stakeholders and other technology teams, providing clear visibility of delivery, capacity, operational health, risks and dependencies.

  • Represent the needs, constraints and capabilities of the engineering team in programme, planning and stakeholder discussions.

Operational Readiness & Engineering Excellence

  • Be accountable for ensuring Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities are operationally ready, supportable and sustainable throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure operational requirements are built into delivery, including observability, monitoring, resilience, documentation, support models, knowledge transfer and clear ownership.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Ensure the team remains engaged in the ongoing health of the capabilities it owns, providing specialist domain or engineering expertise when required.
  • Lead the Marketing & Commercial Data team's response to incidents affecting capabilities it owns, working within the Commercial Technology incident-management model led by Commercial Platform.
  • Ensure operational health, capability risks, technical debt and engineering improvements are visible and prioritised alongside product and programme delivery.
  • Ensure learning from incidents, operational issues and business-user feedback is incorporated into future delivery and continuous improvement.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Lead the engineering team through the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Support the transition from legacy marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Own the people, skills and team structure required to support the transition to the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform, ensuring the capability can be sustainably owned beyond programme delivery.
  • Work with the Technical Lead, Commercial Platform and wider Commercial Technology leadership to introduce platform changes sustainably and maintain operational continuity.

Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing or leading software engineers within a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Strong coaching, feedback and people-development skills, with experience helping engineers progress in their careers.
  • Experience leading engineering delivery across complex platforms or products.
  • Experience balancing strategic programme delivery with operational responsibilities and longer-term engineering priorities.

  • Experience supporting teams responsible for operating and continuously improving business-critical technology.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in partnership with senior technical leaders, architects or Technical Leads.
  • Comfortable operating across Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, organisational change and evolving priorities.

Characteristics we value

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Pragmatism and sound judgement when balancing business, people and engineering needs.

  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An appreciation for strong engineering practices, operational excellence and sustainable technology.
  • Calmness under pressure and the ability to lead teams through challenging situations.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to work across organisational and technology boundaries.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

Our benefits vary by location, but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

The Daily Beast delivers award-winning original reporting and sharp opinions from big personalities in the arenas of politics, pop culture, world news, and more. Fiercely independent and armed with irreverent intelligence, The Daily Beast now reaches more than 20 million readers per month.

Job Description

The Daily Beast is seeking a dynamic and dedicated Associate Executive Editor to join our news team.

About the Role

The Daily Beast is roaring. Now we need a news executive who can help us turn up the volume. We are recruiting a driven newsroom leader to be a key part of our breaking news operation, which is the core of our journalism.

You already have at least five years of experience as a newsroom leader in a breaking news environment. You’re used to spotting, commissioning, editing, and publishing stories in a fast-paced environment where high editorial standards matter, and where stories are told in words, pictures, video and graphics.

You have brilliant ideas, line-editing, and headline-writing skills. You know how to help reporters shape news-breaking enterprise stories, how to guide those stories to publication, and how to maximize their impact.

Crucially, you're steeped in the news agenda—and especially fluent in the political scene and its ever-shifting cast of characters.

You'll report to our Deputy Executive Editor and support her as she directs the newsroom.

This role is your chance for professional growth at a news site that is growing and investing. More and more people are subscribing to our website and app. And we're bringing our journalism to YouTube and Substack, so our vital voice can be heard wherever people get their journalism.

Pay Range Salary

The pay range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high ends of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location, experience, performance, and other factors.

Additional Information

Don’t meet every single requirement listed here? If you’re interested in joining the Beast but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with this job description, we encourage you to give it a shot all the same. It might turn out that you’re just the right candidate for this or other roles. See more about our commitment to diversity at https://www.thedailybeast.com/company/diversity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

job.title: Workplace Investigator
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Legal, Regulatory and Governance

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, ONT (Hybrid)

About the Role:

As a key member of Corus Entertainment’s Legal, Regulatory and Governance department, you will lead the resolution of complex and confidential respect, safety and violence in the workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies. You will be responsible for conducting timely, unbiased and fair investigations or engaging in other forms of resolution, including conciliation. You will also lead complaint intake, case documentation and management, and provide regular status reporting, including annual reporting under the Canada Labour Code. You will join a talented and collegial team that works closely with business partners and will report directly to the Director, Legal Counsel, Employment and Investigations.

You’ll contribute by:

• Conducting timely and confidential workplace investigations in areas including discrimination, workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, and violence.

• Conducting interviews, gathering and analyzing evidence, assessing credibility, and writing formal investigative reports with findings.

• Providing recommendations in accordance with established legal practices, policies and any applicable collective agreement.

• Acting as a conciliator to facilitate the process for parties that elect this resolution.

• Supporting the development and interpretation of policies and delivering training.

• Conducting the intake of investigation files, case management and post-investigative reporting and tasks.

• Conducting regular reporting on workplace complaints, investigations and other resolution avenues.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Minimum of three (3) years of related work experience managing and resolving workplace complaints and conducting complex workplace investigations, including experience in facilitating alternative dispute resolution.

• Demonstrated experience facilitating the management and resolution of workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies.

• Experience documenting investigative findings and writing reports that are clear, concise, complete, and provides analysis of the evidence considered in reaching conclusions.

• Demonstrated awareness, understanding and experience identifying and addressing discrimination and harassment, including racism and systemic and intersectional forms of discrimination.

• Ability to effectively manage multiple investigations, identify risks, react to changing situations and manage multiple priorities in a timely and judicious manner.

• You are an innovator, always looking to develop and improve your approach and that of the team, in line with legislative changes and industry best practice.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment yet independently on assigned files.

• Excellent writing and analysis skills.

• Able to handle confidential information in a mature and professional manner.

• Strong ability to multi-task and respond effectively to changing priorities and demands.

• Develop trust and rapport and influence partners and business leaders.

• Exemplifies Corus’ values and foster an inclusive and respectful working environment.

• Excellent project management, prioritization and planning skills.

Application Deadline: October 29, 2026

job.title: ESPN Cleveland Digital Account Executive
job.description:
Digital Marketing Consultant (Account Executive)

(Cleveland, OH)

Good Karma Sports is seeking an experienced and high-performing Digital Marketing Consultant to join our Cleveland team. This role will help local and regional businesses connect with highly engaged sports audiences through Good Karma Sports’ diverse portfolio of digital, video, streaming, CTV, content, and premium sports media offerings.

Our portfolio includes ESPN, March Madness, NBA, New England Sports Network, SportsNet Pittsburgh, and other premium sports and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will be passionate about helping partners grow their businesses through creative, customized, and results-driven marketing solutions.

The Digital Marketing Consultant will develop and grow long-term relationships with local and regional businesses by identifying their marketing objectives, uncovering challenges, and building integrated digital strategies that deliver meaningful results. This teammate will own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and proposal development through campaign execution, partner retention, and account growth - while serving as a trusted marketing advisor.

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to

  • Identify, uncover, and develop new digital advertising partnerships   
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local and regional decision-makers   
  • Create customized, results-driven digital marketing solutions aligned with partner objectives    
  • Present and sell customized solutions across Good Karma Sports' full portfolio of digital, video, streaming, CTV, content, and premium sports offerings
  • Grow and retain an active book of business through consultative selling   
  • Develop deep knowledge of Good Karma Sports’ full digital portfolio and targeting capabilities   
  • Stay current on digital media trends, products, and best practices
  • Effectively uncover marketing challenges and position solutions at all organizational levels, including the C-suite
  • Network within the Cleveland business community to expand market presence and develop new business opportunities   
  • Maintain accurate activity and pipeline reporting using CRM tools   
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to improve new business outreach, partner research, campaign development, communication, and sales effectiveness while maintaining a high level of personalization and partner interaction
  • Other assigned tasks
  • Be a Good Karma Sports ambassador by adhering to the company core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Work Hard, Teamwork and Over Deliver   

   

Preferred knowledge, skills, and qualifications   

  • 3+ years of successful sales experience in digital sales or at an advertising agency
  • Digital and digital video knowledge and experience   
  • Passion for sales and service with an entrepreneurial spirit
  • Demonstrated success meeting and exceeding sales goals with local business owners, CEOs, general managers, and advertising agencies   
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills   
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment 
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI-powered productivity tools and integrations to enhance traditional business applications, including document creation, spreadsheet analysis, presentations, and workflow automation.
  • Occasional travel for out of market partner meetings may be required
  • Valid driver’s license required; in-market partner meetings are an essential function of this role    

Hours/Salary/Benefits

This is an exempt role with a competitive base salary plus commission. This role is eligible for full benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, Life Insurance, STD, LTD, 401(k) Plan, Dependent Care, paid parental leave, and more. This position requires occasional evening and weekend work for events and games, and other partner needs.


Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates can continuously learn and grow within Good Karma Sports and are responsible for representing our story and core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  


How to Apply  

Apply by submitting your resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than October 29, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.  


About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as a Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As a Multi-Market Brand Integrations Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Columbus, OH: 2323 West Fifth Avenue, Suite 200, 43204

job.title: Digital Coordinator (Client Success)
job.description:
HELP BRING DIGITAL CAMPAIGNS AND CLIENT SUCCESS TO LIFE!

Are you passionate about digital marketing, building strong relationships, and helping businesses achieve their advertising goals? Do you enjoy connecting people, solving problems, and turning great ideas into successful digital campaigns?

At Vista Radio, we believe exceptional client experiences start with great teamwork, clear communication, and seamless campaign execution.

We're looking for an outgoing, enthusiastic, organized, and solutions-focused Digital Coordinator (Client Success) to join our Digital Operations team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with sales teams and clients, understands the world of digital advertising, and takes pride in ensuring campaigns run smoothly from initial planning through launch and performance review.

If you're a proactive communicator, a natural problem-solver, and someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you!

About the Job:

Vista Radio is looking for a full-time Digital Coordinator (Client Success) to support our growing Digital Operations team.

In this role, you'll serve as an important connection between our Sales team, clients, Digital Operations, Creative, Production, and Development departments.

You'll support sales representatives with digital advertising product knowledge, campaign requirements, and technical clarification before the sale, while helping ensure sold campaigns move efficiently through internal coordination, launch preparation, execution, and performance monitoring.

You'll also assist with campaign documentation, digital trafficking and fulfillment support, and our Half Price Deals platform.

Your goal? To help deliver a smooth campaign experience while supporting our clients' advertising objectives and keeping internal teams aligned every step of the way.

What you’ll do

Support Sales Teams and Client Success – Serve as a key coordination resource for sales representatives, providing guidance on digital advertising products, campaign requirements, specifications, timelines, and internal processes.

Participate in Client Discussions – Join client calls when needed to explain digital advertising solutions, clarify technical requirements, and support campaign planning and readiness.

Coordinate Digital Campaign Execution – Review sold campaign details, identify missing information, clarify expectations, and ensure creative assets and campaign requirements are ready for successful launches.

Support Campaign Administration – Assist with Insertion Orders (IOs), campaign documentation, approvals, and internal workflows to ensure accurate and timely processing.

Assist Digital Traffic and Operations – Provide trafficking support, follow up on campaign setups, conduct fulfillment checks, and help maintain accurate execution updates.

Monitor Campaign Performance – Review digital campaign analytics and monitoring dashboards, identify performance trends, and recommend opportunities to improve results and support client goals.

Facilitate Internal Collaboration – Coordinate handoffs between Sales, Creative, Operations, Production, and Development to ensure clear communication, accountability, and timely campaign delivery.

Support Half Price Deals – Assist with accurate offer entries, coordinate marketing requirements, and contribute ideas to improve the platform and program.

Maintain Organized Records – Keep internal trackers, checklists, campaign notes, and status updates accurate and accessible to support effective communication and follow-through.

Identify and Resolve Challenges – Proactively address campaign issues and escalate operational concerns to the Digital Operations Manager or technical and strategic matters to the Director when required.

What you Bring

Previous experience in digital advertising, media sales, client success, campaign trafficking, marketing coordination, or project coordination.

Familiarity with digital advertising products such as display, programmatic, social media, video, websites, newsletters, SEO, digital audio, e-commerce, deal platforms, contesting, and promotions.

Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, TikTok, and related systems.

Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain digital advertising concepts and technical requirements clearly to sales representatives and clients.

Confidence reviewing campaign analytics and performance dashboards and translating observations into practical recommendations.

Strong attention to detail when reviewing campaign requirements, Insertion Orders, creative assets, approvals, and launch readiness.

The ability to translate client and sales representative needs into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.

A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with sound judgment when resolving issues or escalating concerns.

A collaborative, adaptable, and dependable approach to working with multiple departments in a fast-paced digital environment.

Why Join Vista Radio?

At Vista Radio, we believe that successful advertising campaigns are built on strong relationships, innovative solutions, and exceptional teamwork.

As part of our Digital Operations team, you'll have the opportunity to support digital advertising campaigns across our Canadian markets while working closely with talented professionals and helping our clients achieve their business goals.

Here's what makes this opportunity exciting:

Collaborative Team Environment – Work alongside experienced professionals in Sales, Digital Operations, Creative, Production, and Development.

Client-Focused Impact – Play an important role in helping clients achieve their advertising objectives through effective digital campaign coordination and support.

Exposure to Diverse Digital Products – Gain experience with a wide range of digital advertising platforms, products, and solutions.

Professional Growth – Expand your knowledge of digital marketing, campaign analytics, client support, and cross-functional coordination.

Flexible Work Location – Depending on operational requirements, this position may be based at a Vista Radio location across Canada or performed remotely.

Have questions? Apply and start the conversation — we’d love to connect with you. Taking that first step is exactly the kind of drive we’re looking for.

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

🩺 Health & Dental Coverage – Comprehensive plans for individuals and families📈 RRSP Program with DPSP Matching – Vista matches your contributions into a Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan💪 Short-term & Long-term Disability – Income protection when life throws you a curveball🧠 Employee and Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) – 24/7 access to mental health and counseling support🏖️ Annual Vacation & Stat Holidays – Paid time off to relax and recharge❤️ Life & Optional Life Insurance – Protection for you and your loved ones💻 Virtual Care Access – On-demand, 24/7 healthcare wherever you are🌍 Work Where You Live – Make a real impact in the communities we serve

If you’re motivated by results, driven by challenge, and ready to take control of your earning potential, Vista Radio wants you on our team.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 2 years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role, including preparing and presenting sales opportunities and post-sale successes to clients/potential clients.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

  • Flexible, creative and curious.

  • Digitally savvy - proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools highly preferred.


Pay Range

USD $3,500.00 - USD $5,000.00 /Mo.
Pay Range

The monthly pay range listed above reflects your guaranteed income during your first year, with additional opportunities to earn commissions
What We Offer

  • Commission-based organization with uncapped earning potential and guaranteed income in year one of employment
  • Focused, responsible and collaborative work environment with the ability to ask, “what if” and try innovative solutions
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance coverage
  • 401K with company match
  • Paid Vacation, Sick & Holiday time off
    Parental leave time off benefits, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness, and an employee referral bonus program

 

For immediate consideration, please visit: https://jobs.cumulusmedia.com/careers

 

For more information about Cumulus Media, visit our website at: https://www.cumulusmedia.com/


EEO Statement

CUMULUS MEDIA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).

job.title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of experience and education
  • FPC or CPP certification strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience servicing a large volume of employees (including a remote workforce) in a multi-state, multi-entity organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations
  • Strong working knowledge of taxation of fringe benefits and long-term equity incentive instruments (RSUs, NQ Stock Options, etc.)
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail with high service orientation, integrity, discretion, and ownership of work with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, be self-motivated, and piece together facts and data necessary to identify issues, propose resolutions, make decisions, and operationalize necessary changes to improve taxes and service delivery
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate to advanced analytical skillset, including the use of Excel V-Lookup and Pivot Tables and/or other tools
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Able to handle confidential information and issues effectively and without breach of confidentiality


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday and ADP systems
  • Experience with inpats and expats
  • Experience with international payroll (UK, EU, Israel)

job.description:
