job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.

job.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
job.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

Responsibilities

Global Fandom Intelligence

  • Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
  • Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
  • Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

Strategic Insights & Business Planning

  • Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
  • Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

Consumer Insights & Research Execution

  • Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
  • Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness

  • Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
  • Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
  • Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution

  • Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
  • Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
  • Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
  • Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
  • Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
  • Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
  • Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
  • Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
  • Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
  • Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

job.title: Career Consultant
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Career Consultant for this role supports South Florida Section and must reside in this section.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Service to PGA Professionals:

  • Provide insightful and meaningful career counseling and career coaching to PGA Professionals throughout their career life cycle from job search and membership to retirement.
  • Provide career services to include job search strategies, resume development, interviewing skills, offer negotiation, and exit and retirement strategies.
  • Promote the benefits and grow the utilization of PGA ExecuSearch, Job Seeker Profiles, the PGA Job Board and other employment tools across PGA platforms (e.g. - PGA.org, PGA.com, PGA member app, etc.).
  • Provide education programs to PGA Professionals through all available venues (national, sections and chapters).
  • Assist PGA Professionals in gathering and utilizing information from PGA and industry data resources.
  • Promote the benefits of the PGA Compensation Survey and other related Association surveys.
  • Promote and generate participation in PGA Player Development programs and strategies and document the value it brings to facilities and PGA Members.

Service to Employers:

  • Provide exceptional hiring services and resources, and assistance to employers to enhance relationships with industry stakeholders. Services and resources include PGA ExecuSearch, hiring process planning, resume review, interview planning, compensation and benefit packages, correspondence, and PGA preferred background check provider.
  • Provide compensation reports within department guidelines.
  • Market the value of PGA Professionals to non-PGA facilities and the industry.
  • Assist in creating awareness of PGA Player Development strategies and programming.

Service to PGA Sections:

  • Manage and maintain relationships with Section leadership, staff, and Section Education and Employment Committees.
  • Partner with Sections to develop employment strategies, and deliver employment presentations and education seminars to industry employers and organizations.
  • Support Section and Chapter membership meetings, Board meetings and special events as needed.
  • Communicate with Section Executive Directors and leadership quarterly (at a minimum) and provide golf industry updates on Employment.
  • Attend Section tournaments/events to cultivate relationships, foster goodwill, and support PGA Section staff.

Association/Departmental Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the development and improvement of PGA Career Services programs, projects, systems, publications and information.
  • Assist in the marketing and promotion of Association and PGA Career Services programs and initiatives.
  • Engage in proactive outreach and collaborate with other Career Consultants to identify candidates for available opportunities.
  • Provide support as needed to non-industry candidates and search support for nontraditional PGA Member roles such as General Managers, Golf Course Superintendents, etc.
  • Provide editorial content and articles for Section newsletters, PGA magazine, and other industry publications.

Contributions to the Game and Business of Golf:

Talent Development

  • Educate and inform the marketplace about the impact PGA Professionals have on the community, golf business, and local economy.
  • Provide field support and collaborate with PGA of America Diversity and Inclusion efforts.
  • Active participant in PGA of America recruiting efforts as needed.

Allied Associations & Partners

  • Establish effective working relationships with the Amateur body, including state and local golf associations. 
  • Engage with local chapters of GCSAA, CMAA, and NGCOA. 
  • Assist department leaders in improving working relationships with golf management companies.

Golfer Development

  • Participate in player development programs hosted by PGA Professionals, working in conjunction with fellow field staff.
  • Attend community/Section programs providing instruction or programming targeting new and existing golfers as available.

SHARED VALUES: 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing.


SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities.  


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

No financial responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree: (B.A.) or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources, Professional Golf Management (Executive Management preferred) or related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in golf operations or golf industry management/leadership.
  • Employment/club relations experience, career counseling and Human Resources management training preferred.
  • PGA Member preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:


Job Knowledge/Technology: Must have knowledge of the golf industry and/or golf facility operations, employment and/or recruiting. Knowledge of the PGA of America and Section operations are preferred. Must have knowledge of managing multiple priorities, in a multi-functional work environment. Demonstrated leadership skills and a proven ability to motivate and manage professionals to achieve results. Skilled in customer service and/or sales. Must have a thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to lead various projects and programs. A knowledge of the organizational functions of a business operation. Must possess a high degree of trust and confidentiality. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.

job.title: Master Control Hub Maintenance Tech
job.description:
Are you a broadcast technology expert who thrives on solving complex problems and keeping critical systems running at their best? Scripps is looking for a seasoned technical professional to join our Master Control Hub team in Indianapolis, Indiana. In this pivotal role, you'll serve as the go-to technical expert supporting Scripps television broadcasting entities across the country, leveraging deep knowledge of computers, IP networks, and master control operations to troubleshoot, diagnose, and implement solutions that keep our stations on air. The Scripps Master Control Hub is the backbone of centralized, remote control and monitoring of commercial and programming sources for Scripps stations, and your work will directly shape its performance and reliability.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Serve as liaison to the IT group for Master Control.
  • Report to the master control hub manager but consult with Scripps local station engineering directors and other senior leadership, including the senior director of Scripps engineering.
  • Install, maintain, and repair critical broadcasting components to ensure all systems are functioning at peak efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and repair a variety of issues with broadcast and IT equipment.
  • Rely on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to perform efficiently and successfully.
  • Make recommendations for products and service enhancements.
  • Significant technical ingenuity and flexibility are expected.
  • Collaborate with technology suppliers regarding set-up, upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Program/customize master control software functionality.
  • Track and assist master control users with desktop computer and server issues.
  • When resolving open issues, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information when necessary, close or escalate issues, and monitor resolution so that hub operation is optimized.
  • Work with the hub leadership team to address operational issues and facilitate decision-making with regard to technical matters.
  • Provide input and make recommendations to assist in disaster recovery and system planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Very strong analysis and problem-solving skills: The ability to assess a situation, seek multiple perspectives, gather information, and identify key issues is critically important in this role
  • Solid knowledge of computer hardware, software, LAN environment, configuration, and operation
  • A very high sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work
  • Strong organization skills
  • Highly detail-oriented
  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment
  • Working knowledge of television RF transmitter parameters and operations
  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television Master Control
  • This position may require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Indianapolis is a world-class city that punches well above its weight in sports, culture, and livability. Known as the "Racing Capital of the World," it is home to the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway and the legendary Indy 500, one of the most celebrated motorsports events on the planet. The city is also a major hub for professional sports, boasting the NFL's Indianapolis Colts and the NBA's Indiana Pacers, along with a well-earned reputation as one of America's premier hosts for NCAA championships, the Big Ten Championship Game, and other marquee sporting events.


Beyond the excitement of game day, Indianapolis offers a rich cultural landscape that surprises and delights. The Children's Museum of Indianapolis, the largest of its kind in the world, sits alongside gems like the Eiteljorg Museum, the Indiana State Museum, and the stunning Newfields campus, home to the Indianapolis Museum of Art and a beloved outdoor art and nature park. The city's vibrant neighborhoods, from the galleries and restaurants along Massachusetts Avenue to the eclectic energy of Fountain Square and Broad Ripple, give residents a thriving local food, arts, and nightlife scene to explore.


For outdoor enthusiasts, Indianapolis delivers with Eagle Creek Park, one of the largest municipal parks in the United States, offering boating, hiking, birdwatching, and sailing year-round. White River State Park sits right in the heart of downtown, connecting you to green space, the Indianapolis Zoo and the scenic Central Canal Walk. Add a cost of living that remains well below the national average for a major metro, and you'll quickly discover that Indianapolis is a genuinely great place to plant roots, grow a career, and enjoy everything a thriving Midwestern city has to offer.

job.title: Local Sales Manager, KTVH
job.description:
Are you a proven media sales leader ready to inspire a high-performing team and make a measurable impact in your market? KTVH is looking for a Local Sales Manager who will champion the growth of local businesses through innovative, multi-platform advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display and email targeting, you'll guide a talented team of Account Executives in connecting clients with the audiences that matter most — all while driving the station's revenue forward and developing the next generation of Scripps sales talent.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Live in the center of adventure. Helena is the capital of Montana and is centrally located near the continental divide and at the halfway point between two of America's premier national parks: Yellowstone and Glacier. The city's history lies in the search for gold in the west. Prospectors descended on Last Chance Gulch in the mid-1800s and struck gold, transforming a small camp into a frontier town. You will find history across the city. Tour the quiet mansion district's leafed streets in the summer, walk the beautiful campus of Carroll College, or stop at the stately Capitol building to visit the summer farmer's market. If you want to stretch your legs a bit, hop on your mountain bike after work and hit one of Mount Helena's many trails. The Mount Helena city park encompasses an entire mountain and is just minutes from the television station and downtown. Helena is surrounded by the Lewis and Clark National Forest. The forest is home to some of the best hunting, fishing and outdoor recreation opportunities in the state. Blue ribbon trout fisheries that include the mighty Missouri River and the Little Blackfoot are less than an hour's drive from downtown. In the winter, there are ample trails for cross-country or downhill skiing at Great Divide, which is famous for being the first Montana ski hill to open and the last to close each season.

job.title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
job.description:
As a Senior Payroll Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for payroll tax reporting, compliance, liabilities, and the filing of associated employment tax returns for multiple FEINS in multiple states.  You will also ensure the integrity of employee wage and tax data reported on employees’ Form W-2.

You will drive efficiencies through creative problem-solving and analysis as you work with large volumes of complex data to draw conclusions that identify process improvements and automations, improving accurate and timely tax payments and filings.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of all monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings, amendments, and reporting including employee W-2s and W-2c’s
  • Reconcile all tax and wage amounts for multiple legal entities monthly, quarterly, and annually between the payroll system and third-party tax service including reconciliation of W-2s to payroll tax reports and the quarterly 941 returns to W-2 totals. Research and correct any discrepancies
  • Analyze payroll tax issues and provide recommendations for solutions relating, but not limited to employee mobility, reciprocal taxation, stock taxation and reporting, inpats and expats, employer-provided fringe benefits and local taxation
  • Review and reconcile all daily tax and wage amounts submitted to third-party tax services and research any discrepancies and handle accordingly
  • Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual reconciliations of gross earnings to taxable wages to validate accuracy of taxable wages
  • Submit tax notices and facilitate resolutions in coordination with third-party tax vendors timely to avoid penalties and interest; research and determine the root cause, and work with the appropriate parties to take action to prevent future issues
  • Provide excellent customer service in researching and responding to payroll tax-related inquiries from employees, agencies, and other internal/external parties
  • Research all W-2 correction inquiries, complete and submit all W-2c’s for review and approval, and distribute W-2c through appropriate channel
  • Review all Workday tax updates and test accordingly, and communicate key changes to the Payroll team and HR as necessary
  • Partner with the Payroll team to ensure state and local taxes are set up correctly for employees, particularly for employees who live and work in different states
  • Maintain unemployment tax rates and communicate changes to third-party tax services
  • Apply and register for new state SUI and withholding tax accounts for new locations, FEINS, as needed
  • Prepare various tax returns and reporting not filed by third-party tax services, including other required government reporting
  • Review third-party sick pay and ensure appropriate reporting
  • Collaborate with the Manager to enhance, streamline, and document payroll tax processes
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations, including taxation of fringe benefits, by studying existing and new legislation and ensure compliance and advise management on needed actions


WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of experience and education
  • FPC or CPP certification strongly preferred
  • 5+ years of relevant work experience servicing a large volume of employees (including a remote workforce) in a multi-state, multi-entity organization
  • Comprehensive knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations
  • Strong working knowledge of taxation of fringe benefits and long-term equity incentive instruments (RSUs, NQ Stock Options, etc.)
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail with high service orientation, integrity, discretion, and ownership of work with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, be self-motivated, and piece together facts and data necessary to identify issues, propose resolutions, make decisions, and operationalize necessary changes to improve taxes and service delivery
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate to advanced analytical skillset, including the use of Excel V-Lookup and Pivot Tables and/or other tools
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
  • Able to handle confidential information and issues effectively and without breach of confidentiality


NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience with Workday and ADP systems
  • Experience with inpats and expats
  • Experience with international payroll (UK, EU, Israel)

job.title: Streaming Executive Producer
job.description:
Do you understand how audiences consume news today — on their phones, through streaming apps, social feeds, and connected TVs? Are you driven to create storytelling that meets viewers wherever they are? If you’re ready to help reinvent how local news connects with a digital-first audience, FOX 35 Orlando wants to hear from you.

As Executive Producer, Streaming, you’ll lead the expansion of streaming content across PM and weekend hours, providing dedicated leadership for these growing dayparts. You’ll collaborate with anchors, reporters, producers, and digital journalists to develop focused, live programming built for the way people watch now — live, on demand, and on every screen. This includes developing live debate formats, newsmaker interviews, interactive viewer segments, and other original programming during hours when live event feeds may not be readily available.

This is an off-camera leadership position focused on programming, production, and strategy rather than hosting. You’ll serve as a key owner of the station’s CTV experience, ensuring FOX LOCAL programming, content shelves, live coverage, and sponsorship opportunities are updated, strategically positioned, and aligned with what audiences want to watch. Your leadership will help FOX 35 expand its streaming presence across multiple dayparts while creating a consistent, engaging experience for viewers across Central Florida.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

●      Lead Daypart Expansion: Oversee and develop streaming content specifically for PM and weekend hours, building a clear programming strategy for these dayparts.

●      Develop Original Live Programming: Create focused programming such as live debates, newsmaker interviews, interactive viewer segments, and other formats designed specifically for streaming audiences.

●      Own the CTV Experience: Oversee the station’s CTV presence, ensuring FOX LOCAL programming, content shelves, and live offerings are current, relevant, and positioned around viewer interests.

●      Champion Innovation: Drive the evolution of local news for streaming, FAST channels, CTV, and social platforms.

●      Collaborate Across the Newsroom: Partner with teams across the newsroom to produce live coverage, original features, breaking news, and special programming tailored for streaming and digital audiences.

●      Shape the Strategy: Develop a forward-thinking content approach that blends live, on-demand, and social-first storytelling across multiple dayparts.

●      Drive Audience Interaction: Develop programming that encourages real-time viewer participation and creates opportunities for audiences to actively engage with live content.

●      Enhance Viewer Experience: Experiment with new formats and technologies to deliver visually engaging, high-impact news experiences.

●      Use Data to Drive Decisions: Analyze performance metrics and audience behavior to inform programming, placement, and content decisions and grow engagement.

●      Support Revenue Opportunities: Collaborate with appropriate teams to identify and support sponsorship opportunities within streaming programming while maintaining editorial standards.

●      Elevate the Brand: Ensure content reflects high editorial and production standards across digital and streaming platforms.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

●      A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

●      Proven experience producing or leading content for streaming, digital, or social platforms.

●      Leadership experience developing programming, managing content strategy, or overseeing newsroom production.

●      Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make fast, accurate decisions in a live news environment.

job.description:

This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of NBC broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to Denver's trusted news and programming. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch.

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain.

  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe

job.title: Prinicipal Multi Media Designer - Creative Stategy & Enablement
job.description:
designIQ is a full-service creative, design, and pre-media group supporting internal and external partners across print, digital, social, video, branding, campaign creative, imaging, and ad production services.

Our work ranges from high-volume production to agency-level creative solutions. That includes print and digital advertising, social media creative, short-form video, logos, brand identity systems, company stationery, branded materials, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy and newsprint products, campaign assets, and custom creative solutions.

We’re looking for a senior creative leader who can operate beyond execution. This person will serve as creative counsel to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations, support sales and partner conversations, help shape creative standards, and assist with training and enablement across the creative operation.

This role is ideal for someone who can think like an agency creative, work like a production expert, communicate like a client-facing partner, and help move a large creative operation forward.

Role Summary:

The Principal Multimedia Designer, Creative Strategy & Enablement is a highly experienced creative professional responsible for supporting elevated creative work, client-facing creative conversations, internal training, sales enablement, and quality improvement across designIQ.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, multimedia design, production excellence, client consultation, and operational enablement. The person in this position should be able to understand a business need, translate it into a creative approach, guide others toward stronger work, and produce high-quality creative when needed.

The role will regularly partner with the Sr. Director of Creative Operations to help shape creative direction, review strategic opportunities, support new business conversations, advise on creative capabilities, and strengthen the overall quality and consistency of designIQ’s work.

This person may attend internal meetings, external partner meetings, sales calls, discovery calls, client-facing creative discussions, and training sessions. They should be comfortable speaking with sales teams, customers, creative teams, production teams, leadership, and external partners.

The ideal candidate brings agency-level design experience, strong multimedia capability, polished communication skills, and the ability to teach, coach, and influence without needing direct authority in every situation.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as creative counsel and strategic design partner to the Sr. Director of Creative Operations.

Support sales calls, discovery calls, partner meetings, and client-facing conversations where creative expertise is needed.

Help translate client goals, sales objectives, and business challenges into clear creative recommendations.

Provide creative direction and guidance on complex, high-value, or strategically important work.

Create, review, or advise on agency-level creative across print, digital, social, video, branding, direct mail, billboards, packaging, product design, glossy publications, newsprint products, and campaign-based deliverables.

Assist in shaping creative approaches for new business opportunities, partner onboarding, premium creative services, and custom creative requests.

Help determine whether a creative request belongs in standard production, premium creative, Studio-level work, or a custom scope.

Support the development of creative briefs, intake standards, client discovery questions, and creative readiness requirements.

Join internal planning meetings to represent creative quality, design feasibility, production needs, and client experience.

Present and explain creative work, design direction, and creative recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

Uncapped Earnings Potential

Sell with a Competitive Edge
Leverage advanced tools like ChatGPT Enterprise to streamline prospecting, sharpen presentations, and accelerate deal cycles.

job.title: Manager, Payments and Fraud Analytics - AEG
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

 

 

The Role

AXS is seeking a Manager, Payments and Fraud to lead macro-level analytics for AXS payment performance and fraud risk. The role uses advanced SQL, data visualization, and payments expertise to identify opportunities to increase authorization and conversion, reduce processing costs, prevent material fraud and chargeback losses, and improve payment reliability across markets, channels, and providers. Unlike transaction-review roles that make accept-or-decline decisions on individual orders, this position analyzes portfolio trends and converts findings into business, product, routing, and risk recommendations. The manager partners with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and internal Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Fraud Prevention teams. The role initially leads through expertise and cross-functional influence and is expected to assume direct people-management responsibility as the analytics team grows.

 

What Will You Do?

  • Lead deep-dive analysis of payment authorization, decline, conversion, routing, settlement, and processing-cost data; identify material trends and quantify opportunities by market, issuer, network, gateway, payment method, and customer segment.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and loss data at the portfolio level; identify emerging patterns and control gaps, size financial exposure, and recommend changes to fraud strategies, rules, tools, and operating processes.
  • Build and maintain trusted KPI definitions, SQL analyses, dashboards, and executive reporting for payment performance, fraud, chargebacks, costs, and customer impact; establish data-quality controls and clear measurement methods.
  • Develop business cases and lead cross-functional optimization initiatives, experiments, and post-implementation measurement for payment routing, authorization uplift, fraud controls, payment methods, tokenization, 3DS, and cross-border performance.
  • Monitor high-volume on-sales and material payment or fraud events; perform root-cause analysis, coordinate stakeholders, and translate incidents into corrective actions and longer-term improvements.
  • Partner with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, Stripe, and other providers to review performance, investigate issues, evaluate capabilities, and hold partners accountable for agreed service and optimization actions.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud Prevention, and senior leaders on priorities, tradeoffs, and policy or process changes; communicate complex findings and gain support for recommendations with financial and customer impact.
  • Establish the operating model, priorities, documentation, and performance standards for the analytics function; coordinate work across analysts and develop, coach, and manage direct reports as positions are added.

 

What Will You Bring?

  • BA/BS Degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 4-6 years of hands-on advanced SQL analysis using large transaction-level datasets and development of dashboards or data visualizations for business decisions.
  • 4-6 years of progressive experience in payments analytics, fraud analytics, payment operations, risk, or a closely related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives, coordinating the work of analysts, or managing and developing team members.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to join, validate, segment, and interpret large payment and fraud datasets.
  • Advanced data visualization and dashboard development skills using Tableau, Looker, or comparable tools; experience working with Snowflake or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Strong knowledge of card payments, authorization and decline behavior, routing, processing economics, interchange and network fees, settlement, chargebacks, disputes, and fraud controls.
  • Working knowledge of payment networks and processors or gateways, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, ACI, Braintree, and Stripe.
  • Knowledge of tokenization, 3DS, alternative payment methods, cross-border payments, and the customer checkout experience.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business questions, perform root-cause analysis, quantify financial and customer impact, and recommend practical actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis to technical and nontechnical audiences and influence decisions across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Leadership skills to set priorities, establish standards, coordinate work, coach analysts, and build a high-performing analytics function as the team grows.

 

Pay Scale: $95,000 - $109,000

 

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. job.title: WLKY - Chief Engineer
job.description:
WLKY, the CBS affiliate in Louisville KY is seeking a Chief Engineer to lead the technical operation and continued modernization of a television station. Reporting to the General Manager, this role is a member of the station leadership team and is accountable for the reliability, safety, compliance, and performance of the systems and facilities that support broadcast, news, production, transmission, and digital distribution. The Chief Engineer partners across the station and with Hearst Television teams to keep service dependable today and plan for what comes next. The right candidate will be a proven leader with the ability to motivate teams and build a culture of excellence.

What You’ll Do

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the station’s engineering team, including staffing, scheduling, performance feedback, technical training, and on-call coverage.
  • Set priorities and service standards for engineering work, build strong working relationships across departments, and communicate technical issues and their operational impact clearly.
  • Partner with the General Manager and station leaders to align technology plans with local journalism, production, business needs, and Hearst Television standards.

 

Broadcast and Facility Operations

  • Oversee the reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle planning of broadcast, newsroom, production, automation, master control, media storage, network, streaming, and transmission systems.
  • Maintain station transmission and RF facilities, studios, control rooms, remote production equipment, and critical infrastructure such as generators, UPS, and HVAC systems supporting technical operations.
  • Provide engineering leadership during live programming, breaking news, severe weather, outages, and other urgent events; coordinate response, recovery, and follow-up.

 

Compliance, Safety, and Resilience

  • Ensure required FCC, EAS, and other applicable regulatory and industry obligations are met, with accurate records, scheduled testing, inspections, and timely corrective action.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance, equipment inventory, technical documentation, safety practices, emergency preparedness, backup power, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Coordinate with Hearst Television and enterprise IT partners on cybersecurity, network resilience, access practices, and business continuity for station systems.

 

Planning and Modernization

  • Develop and manage operating and capital budgets, equipment replacement plans, vendor relationships, service contracts, and engineering projects from proposal through implementation.
  • Evaluate and implement improvements to IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid services, streaming, and other emerging technologies while protecting reliable on-air operations.
  • Use approved AI tools, where appropriate, to support technical research, summarize logs or documentation, identify workflow improvement opportunities, and organize maintenance or project information; verify outputs before use and follow company requirements for confidential, employee, and operational data.
  • Review significant technical incidents, identify root causes, document corrective actions, and apply lessons learned to improve reliability.

 

What You’ll Need

  • At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in television broadcast engineering, media technology, or a closely related technical field, including experience leading or supervising technical staff.
  • Working knowledge of television broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio and newsroom technologies, automation, IP-based media workflows, and applicable FCC and EAS requirements.
  • Experience planning technical projects, managing budgets and vendors, prioritizing equipment lifecycle needs, and coordinating work across departments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems, make sound decisions under deadline pressure, and explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Ability to provide support during live operations and occasional nights, weekends, holidays, or emergencies as station needs require.
  • Education, training, or experience in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, electronics, or a related field. Hearst Television will consider a college degree, trade school diploma, professional certificates, military training, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with broadcast automation, IP video and audio, streaming, cloud or hybrid media systems, cybersecurity practices, emergency planning, and relevant certifications such as SBE is valued.
  • Related military experience will be considered.

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

 

Benefits

Hearst's benefit programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on you. As a Hearst employee, you and your spouse or partner or dependents would have access to the following benefits.

• Medical | Dental | Vision

• 401(k) matching

• Emotional Wellness Support

• Paid Time Off

• Paid Parental Leave

• LGBTQ+ Health Services

• Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

job.description:
Criminally Obsessed is Sinclair’s always-on true crime brand. By aggregating the depth of our local stations’ reporting from the crime scene to the courtroom under one umbrella we have created a gathering spot for more than 2 million passionate fans of the genre and are growing every day. With a dynamic mix of short-form social posts, trial livestreams, topical podcasts, and narrative documentaries we are delivering a steady stream of scroll stopping content to our followers every day and are looking for someone to join our team who can engage with fandom in a meaningful way both online and in real life. The ideal candidate is passionate about true crime, has experience leading community management for editorial brands or fan based communities, is ahead of the curve on internet culture and social media trends, and is an excellent communicator who understands brand voice.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Audience Engagement (60%)

  • Manage day-to-day audience engagement and moderation of comment sections, live chats and direct messages across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Snapchat and Threads, using sound editorial judgment when navigating sensitive conversations.
  • Represent Criminally Obsessed within relevant online communities, including Reddit and Facebook groups.
  • Stay on top of trending true crime stories to effectively engage with our audience.
  • Develop and publish daily audience questions and prompts to help foster a sense of community.
  • Manage scheduling and publishing of content being released after standard East Coast office hours
  • Share actionable insights from our audience engagements with the Criminally Obsessed leadership team to help inform content and publishing strategy.

 

Publicity and Marketing (15%)

  • Identify creator collaborations, conduct press outreach, and build relationships that expand Criminally Obsessed’s reach.
  • Identify and coordinate strategic awards submissions for our documentaries, podcasts and overall brand.
  • Track earned media for the brand to measure effectiveness of promotion efforts.


Events and Activations (15%)

  • Develop and execute promotional campaigns for tentpole content, including original documentaries and exclusive interviews, to increase viewership and engagement.
  • Collaborate on the development of programming and creative for live events and other audience activations, coordinating with marketing, editorial, sales and external partners to drive attendance, participation and merchandise sales.
  • Represent Criminally Obsessed at live events.


Competitive Analysis (10%)

  • Track relevant creators, podcasts, media outlets and social accounts to understand what interests the broader true crime community.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media community management, preferably with an editorial brand or media organization operating on a high-volume daily publishing schedule.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills, with a clear understanding of brand voice.
  • Strong knowledge of and connections within the true crime media landscape.
  • Proficiency with social media management tools such as Hootsuite or Sprout Social, as well as media monitoring platforms such as Meltwater/
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for events throughout the year.
  • Experience with media outreach and creator partnerships is a plus.
  • Experience in event planning, marketing, public relations and/or creator partnerships is a plus.

job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
The AI Solutions Engineer is a key role within the AI team that partners with business teams to turn real operational challenges into practical AI-enabled solutions. This person combines strong business curiosity, consultative problem-solving, and hands-on AI capability in designing, building, testing, and improving sophisticated AI agents and workflows.

They will help teams identify where AI can create meaningful value, translate needs into clear solution designs, and build usable prototypes and production-ready solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical partners.

This position is on-site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the business

  • Partner with business units to understand their goals, processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate in discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined AI solution requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader AI team to shape solution designs, provide practical feedback on feasibility and user needs, and help prioritize the AI opportunity pipeline based on business value, complexity, risk, and strategic alignment.
  • Work with data, technology, security, legal, and risk partners to ensure solutions are reliable, responsible, and appropriate for the business context.

Build and integrate

  • Design, build, and iterate AI agents, copilots, automations, and workflow integrations using modern AI platforms and tools.
  • Develop agent instructions, tools, knowledge sources, guardrails, and human-review workflows.
  • Create prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, then help evolve successful concepts into durable solutions.

Test and improve

  • Define success metrics and evaluation approaches before build, so each solution has a clear bar for what good looks like.
  • Test AI solutions for accuracy, usefulness, safety, consistency, and user experience; continuously improve them based on feedback and performance data.
  • Monitor solutions in production for adoption and accuracy drift; retire or rework anything that no longer meets its success bar.

Enable and share

  • Explain AI capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommended practices in clear, non-technical language.
  • Build adoption through training, documentation, office hours, and hands-on support for business users.
  • Stay current on AI tools, agent patterns, governance practices, and emerging opportunities; bring relevant ideas back to the organization.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
  • 5-7+ years experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions
  • Hands-on experience building AI agents, copilots, or automations using generative AI platforms, APIs, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Basic programming or scripting capability, such as Python, JavaScript, SQL, or API integration, with experience in workflow automation, systems integration, or service design.
  • Experience evaluating AI systems (test cases, quality measurement, prompt iteration, monitoring) and applying responsible AI practices (privacy, security, model risk, change management).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make technical topics understandable and actionable.
  • Sound judgment about when AI is appropriate versus a simpler solution, and comfort experimenting, learning quickly, and moving concepts to usable solutions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to translate business requirements into solution designs, user journeys, and measurable success criteria.
  • Product management experience, including working with product roadmaps and stakeholder prioritization.
  • Media or broadcast industry experience, including familiarity with newsroom, sales, or traffic operations, or systems such as WideOrbit or OSI.
  • Experience with modern agent frameworks and evaluation tooling, such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol, LangSmith, or Braintrust.
  • Data analysis and enterprise data platform experience, such as Snowflake, Power BI, or dbt, and SQL beyond basics.
  • Prior experience on an internal AI enablement, digital transformation, or innovation team.

 

What Success Looks Like

The AI Solutions Engineer is a constructive, trusted contributor to the broader AI team, bringing business-unit insight into solution design and helping the organization focus its AI investment on the highest-value opportunities. Within the first year, the AI Solutions Engineer will have delivered several solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, or customer and employee experience. They will be known as a practical business partner who can turn AI potential into responsible, measurable results.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and ownership

job.description:

LET’S GO!

 

Overview: 

The Senior Vice President, Finance Innovation is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role responsible for reimagining how the Finance organization operates through the application of artificial intelligence and agentic automation. This role will identify, champion, and implement AI-driven opportunities across the Finance function, with a particular focus on building agentic workflows and AI systems capable of autonomously executing multi-step financial processes with human oversight, across Accounting, Forecasting & FP&A, Treasury, Tax, and operational finance areas unique to a media and entertainment enterprise, including Production Finance and Participations & Residuals. This leader will serve as the bridge between Finance, Technology, and Data/AI teams, translating complex financial processes into scalable, intelligent automation while maintaining rigorous controls, auditability, and compliance standards appropriate for a large public company. The successful candidate will combine deep finance domain expertise with a strong point of view on emerging AI capabilities, and the organizational influence to drive adoption across a broad and often decentralized finance ecosystem. As Finance advances its Fusion systems integration, this leader will be a key voice in shaping how that effort intersects with Finance's broader innovation and automation agenda.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Define and lead the enterprise Finance Innovation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AI and agentic workflow adoption across all Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with the CFO organization and Finance leadership to identify, prioritize, and business-case AI opportunities based on value creation, risk profile, and feasibility. 
  • Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of use cases spanning close and consolidation, reconciliations, forecasting and variance analysis, cash and liquidity management, tax provision and compliance, and production finance/participations & residuals calculations and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of the external AI and finance-technology landscape (agentic frameworks, LLM-based finance copilots, RPA-to-agentic evolution) and translate relevant developments into actionable internal opportunities.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data & Analytics, and external delivery partners on agentic workflow and AI-tool initiatives as the Finance domain voice, defining use cases, finance requirements, and success criteria, and providing continuous feedback through design, build, and deployment. Product and Technology direct solution design, engineering, and production deployment; this role ensures what gets built reflects finance process reality and business need.
  • Own finance-side accountability across the delivery lifecycle: opportunity identification and prioritization, requirements definition, controls and change management within Finance, driving adoption, and validating realized value while Product and Technology own solution design, build, and rollout execution.
  • Specify the finance control requirements agentic systems must meet: human-in-the-loop oversight, exception handling, and escalation, and validate that the frameworks Product and Technology implement keep those systems within Finance's risk, controls, and SOX/regulatory boundaries. 
  • Convene Internal Audit, SOX, and Compliance to define the control and documentation standards AI-driven finance processes must satisfy, and carry those requirements into the Product and Technology build so solutions meet public-company standards.
  • Partner closely with the EVP of Integration on systems integration work related to Fusion, ensuring Finance requirements, controls, and adoption considerations are represented as Fusion capabilities are integrated into Finance systems and processes.
  • Accounting & Close: Identify opportunities for agentic automation in journal entries, reconciliations, close checklists, and financial reporting. 
  • Forecasting & FP&A: Champion AI-augmented forecasting, scenario modeling, and variance analysis to improve speed and accuracy of business planning.
  • Treasury: Explore agentic support for cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations, and risk monitoring.
  • Tax: Identify AI applications in tax provision, compliance documentation, and regulatory research and monitoring. 
  • Production Finance: Drive automation of production cost tracking, budget-to-actual analysis, and studio/content cost reporting specific to media production.
  • Participations & Residuals: Champion agentic solutions for the complex, high-volume calculations, contract interpretation, and reporting inherent to participations and residuals processing. 
  • Serve as a visible champion and educator for AI adoption, building Finance-wide fluency and comfort with agentic tools through training, communication, and hands-on enablement.
  • Develop governance structures, including an AI use-case intake process and a Finance Innovation council or working group with representation across Finance sub-functions.
  • Partner with HR and Finance leadership to evolve talent, role design, and ways of working as agentic workflows shift the nature of finance work.
  • Manage change resistance thoughtfully, ensuring adoption is durable and supported by the broader finance organization rather than imposed top-down. Stakeholder Management & Reporting
  • Regularly report progress, value delivered, and roadmap updates to executive leadership, including the CFO and relevant Audit/Risk committees as appropriate.
  • Build strong relationships with Technology, Data/AI, Legal, business-unit finance leaders, and the EVP of Integration to ensure alignment and shared ownership of innovation initiatives, including Fusion-related systems integration work. 
  • Represent the company's Finance Innovation agenda in relevant internal forums and, where appropriate, external industry settings.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field required; MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced credential preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or FP&A experience, ideally within a large, complex, public media, entertainment, or content organization. 
  • Demonstrated track record leading finance transformation, process automation, or technology-enabled change initiatives at scale. 
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and agentic or RPA-based automation, and how they apply to financial processes; direct experience implementing such tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience with production finance and/or participations and residuals processes is a plus given the specialized nature of these areas in media and entertainment.
  • Prior exposure to SOX controls, internal audit requirements, and the governance considerations of deploying automation in a public-company financial environment. 

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong finance and accounting fundamentals combined with genuine curiosity about, and fluency in, emerging AI capabilities.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and business units without direct authority over all of them.
  • Proven ability to translate technical AI/automation concepts into business terms finance professionals can act on, and vice versa.
  • Strong program and change management skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building new organizational muscle from scratch.
  • Sound judgment regarding risk, controls, and the appropriate pace and boundaries of automation in regulated financial processes.

job.title: Director, Product Management
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

 

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering


#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.


Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
    continue, change, or stop.
  • Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
    gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.
  • Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
    like the CBS Sports App.
  • Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
    tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
    the thing in your hand.
  • Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.
  • Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.
  • Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.
  • Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

 

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission. 

 

What success looks like:

  • The web product strategy is coherent.
  • People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
    to do. 
  • Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.
  • The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.
  • High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.
  • Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.
  • Fewer false starts, less rework.
    PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.
  • Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.
  • Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.


Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.


Additional Qualifications

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.
  • Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.
  • Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.
  • Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.
  • An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
    on how AI changes what a product team can do.


CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.
