job.title: Director, Product Marketing
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is looking for a Director, Product Marketing to lead go-to-market strategy and messaging for our linear and streaming TV and advertising business, with a strong focus on Premion, TEGNA's streaming ad platform (DSP). This role reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing and sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. The Director will translate platform capabilities into clear, compelling positioning that helps our sales teams win and grow streaming advertising revenue — and will build and lead a small product marketing team. They will identify and translate the needs of our key customer segments, mid-sized to large SMBs and the agencies that serve them, as well as our publisher partners, to the larger organization.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone energized by the pace of the CTV/streaming market who wants to shape how TEGNA tells its story to agencies and advertisers — and who is ready to develop talent alongside doing the work.

Key Responsibilities 

Product and Sales Collaboration

  • Partner deeply with Product to translate CTV/streaming and Premion DSP capabilities into positioning, messaging, and sales-ready narratives
  • Act as the voice of the customer in product conversations, advocating for solutions and features that deliver the most value to advertisers and agencies
  • Build strong working relationships across product, sales, customer success and other key stakeholders to stay ahead of roadmap changes and market shifts

Messaging and Positioning 

  • Own product marketing messaging for Premion and TEGNA's broader CTV/streaming offering, ensuring consistency with TEGNA's brand pillars and current terminology
  • Develop clear, differentiated positioning against competitors in the CTV/streaming ad tech space
  • Translate complex product and data capabilities — outcomes-based buying, first-party data, audience targeting — into messaging that resonates with agencies and advertisers

Sales Enablement 

  • Design, create and oversee sales enablement assets — pitch decks, one-pagers, talking points, objection-handling guides, case studies — that equip the sales organization to grow streaming advertising revenue
  • Partner with sales leadership to identify enablement gaps and prioritize asset development accordingly
  • Train and support sales teams on new product launches, features, and positioning updates

Revenue Growth and Market Focus 

  • Support pipeline growth for streaming advertising by arming sales with the right tools at the right moments in the sales cycle
  • Build messaging and enablement tailored to local and regional agency buyers, a key and growing segment for TEGNA
  • Partner with Marketing Strategy and Insights on packaging, upfront kits, and go-to-market campaigns tied to CTV/streaming priorities

Team Leadership 

  • Manage and develop a Product Marketing Analyst, setting clear priorities, providing regular coaching, and building their capability over time
  • Model strong cross-functional partnership and help the broader B2B Marketing team understand and use product positioning effectively
  • Build scalable processes for asset management, messaging governance, and sales enablement delivery

Qualifications 

  • 10+ years in product marketing, with meaningful experience in digital content, CTV, or streaming media (ad tech, media company, or streaming platform background preferred)
  • Demonstrated leadership experience — prior people management preferred, but strong mentorship and cross-functional leadership also considered
  • Proven track record building messaging and positioning for advertising or media products, ideally in a DSP, ad platform, or programmatic environment
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product and Sales, including building sales enablement materials that directly drove revenue
  • Experience working with or selling to local and regional agencies is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical/product complexity into clear, persuasive messaging for both internal and external audiences
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous market and adapting messaging as the competitive and product landscape shifts
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus but not required

Location and Reporting 

  • New York City or Washington, D.C. metro area preferred but not required; hybrid work model
  • Reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing
  • Manages: Product Marketing Analyst
  • Some travel expected for sales meetings, agency visits, and industry events #LI-MS1

job.title: Prepress Operator
job.description:
Prepress Operator

 

Position Summary

Responsible for reviewing, preparing, and processing newspaper and commercial print materials to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with production specifications before files are released to press. This position requires strong attention to detail, effective communication, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and the ability to work efficiently in a deadline-driven production environment.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Review pages, layouts, plans, and sections to ensure accuracy and completeness before files are released to press plates.

job.title: Marketing Manager - Frontline & Artist Development
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is one of the leading record labels in the world and Philippines, dedicated to promoting and supporting both international and local artists and music. In this rapidly evolving streaming era, we are actively seeking a talented Marketing Pop Hub. Manager to drive our extensive, hit-laden local catalogue's success in the digital landscape.    As a Marketing Manager - Frontline & Artist Development, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our reach, connecting with our target audience, and maximizing the visibility of our local music catalogue. We are looking for someone who is not only clued in to the latest trends in local Gen Z pop culture but also appreciates the rich heritage of older OPM tracks. You will be responsible for developing and executing innovative marketing strategies that resonate with our target audience and drive engagement

What you'll do:

ARTIST DEVELOPMENT & BRAND STRATEGY

  • Lead the marketing-led development and growth of new, emerging, and established frontline artists.
  • Develop clear artist positioning, brand identity, audience strategy, and long-term growth plans in collaboration with A&R and other relevant teams.
  • Partner with A&R on sonic positioning and ensure each artist’s music, visual identity, storytelling, and marketing direction are aligned.

  • Develop artist development plans that go beyond individual releases, building sustainable audiences and long-term artist careers.
  • Use performance data, audience insights, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and recommend strategies for each artist.
  • Work closely with Business Development to identify brand partnerships, live opportunities, collaborations, and other commercial opportunities that support artist growth.
  • Ensure all release-related assets and marketing materials are complete, compliant, and delivered according to agreed timelines.

FRONTLINE MARKETING STRATEGY & CAMPAIGN EXECUTION

  • Lead the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for assigned SMEP frontline artists and releases.
  • Develop integrated marketing plans covering audience development, digital, social media, content, publicity, partnerships, activations, and fan engagement.
  • Create campaign strategies, concepts, and content plans informed by data and insights from the Digital and Data teams.
  • Build clear campaign objectives, KPIs, timelines, and measurement frameworks for each priority release.
  • Monitor campaign performance and adjust strategies based on results, audience response, and market developments.
  • Stay current on music, entertainment, digital, social, and cultural trends to identify opportunities for artists and releases.
  • Collaborate closely with A&R, Digital, AdProm, Creatives, Business Development, and other teams to ensure aligned and effective campaign execution.

INTERNATIONAL MARKETING & AUDIENCE DEVELOPMENT

  • Analyze frontline roster performance to identify artists and releases with potential for regional and international growth.

  • Coordinate with international Sony Music teams, agencies, partners, and third-party vendors for campaigns and artist promotional visits.

DIRECT-TO-CONSUMER (D2C), FAN DEVELOPMENT & CRM

  • Work with relevant teams on physical products, merchandise, bundles, and other artist-led D2C opportunities.

PROJECT, BUDGET & ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGEMENT

  • Manage marketing projects from planning through execution, ensuring timelines, budgets, deliverables, and internal approvals are properly managed.
  • Ensure marketing plans, project documentation, budgets, and approval requirements are completed before campaign execution.
  • Manage external agencies, production partners, suppliers, and vendors required for marketing campaigns.

  • Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure timely processing of POs, invoices, vendor payments, and financial liquidation requirements.
  • Maintain clear reporting on campaign performance, budgets, key learnings, risks, and issues affecting artists or releases.
  • Conduct post-campaign reviews and translate learnings into recommendations for future artist and release strategies.

Who you are:

  • Proven experience (2+ years) in marketing, preferably within the digital/streaming/entertainment landscape, with a track record of successfully promoting content.

What we give you:

job.title: Engineering Manager - Ads
job.description:
About SoundCloud

What's next in music happens on SoundCloud first. As the world’s largest open audio platform, SoundCloud is powered by a connected community of creators, listeners, and curators who share, discover, and influence what’s new, now, and next in music and audio.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Ads ML (Machine Learning) team within the Growth, Revenue and Commerce group, and to take SoundCloud's ad delivery into the machine learning era.

Advertising is one of SoundCloud's core revenue streams. It earns money directly, and it is also one of the main ways free listeners discover and move to a paid subscription. That revenue pays creators on our platform, covers content costs, and keeps SoundCloud a healthy, independent company. Getting ad delivery right matters to listeners, artists, and the business.

Our team builds the systems that decide which ads SoundCloud listeners hear and see, how many, and when. We're replacing fixed rules with ML: contextual bandits and predictive models (churn risk, subscription propensity, user LTV) that set ad load for each listener in real time. The goal is more ad revenue without hurting retention, and you'll decide how far and how fast we get there.

This is a hybrid leadership role with a strong hands-on component. You'll lead a team of four backend and ML engineers, contribute directly to the codebase, and own the technical direction of machine learning driven ad delivery. You'll work closely with client engineers, data analysts, and product, and report to the Director of Engineering in a flat structure.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the ML roadmap for ad delivery. Take personalised ad serving (contextual bandits, churn and subscription-propensity models) from experiment to production across markets, and decide what the team builds next.
  • Own the production ML stack behind ad decisions: online model serving, real-time bandit decisioning, feature pipelines, and model evaluation and monitoring.
  • Build a rigorous experimentation practice for ML: offline and online evaluation, A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and clear ship-or-hold decisions on ad load and user LTV.
  • Own the backend ad delivery services that turn model decisions into the ads served on iOS, Android and web.
  • Partner with client engineers, data analysts and product on the roadmap, balancing revenue, retention and ad inventory.
  • Grow the team's ML depth through hiring, mentorship and career development, and manage performance effectively.

Background & Experience:

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience.
  • 5+ years as a backend software developer. You're comfortable writing code, discussing trade-offs and taking part in system design.
  • Hands-on experience building and running ML systems in production: model serving, real-time decisioning, feature pipelines, and monitoring for model drift and data quality.
  • Solid grasp of applied ML for decision-making (bandits, ranking, recommendation or propensity models), deep enough to challenge modelling choices and trade-offs with the team.
  • Strong experiment design skills, including statistical rigour and the trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term retention.
  • Experience managing engineers, including coaching, feedback and performance development.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining ML trade-offs in business terms.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in ad tech, ad serving or large-scale experimentation on a large consumer platform.
  • Contextual or multi-armed bandits, reinforcement learning or uplift modelling in production.
  • ML platform tooling: feature stores, model registries and workflow
  • User LTV, churn or subscription-propensity modelling.
  • Ad standards and integrations: VAST, programmatic demand (SSPs and DSPs), frequency capping.
  • Audio or video advertising.
  • Scala or another JVM language, and Python for ML work.

If you're excited about bringing machine learning to ad delivery at scale, leading a team, and shaping how millions of listeners experience ads on SoundCloud, we'd love to hear from you.

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)

  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home

  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard.

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. job.title: Education Officer
job.description:
The Guardian Foundation is a charitable body whose purpose is to promote global press freedom and access to liberal journalism. Our vision is a world where people have access to reliable information from a diverse range of sources, strengthening their ability to hold power to account.

Through our news and media literacy programmes, we empower children and young people with the critical skills they need to navigate and engage with news in an informed way.

Our news and media literacy programmes, NewsWise (for primary students) and Behind the Headlines (for secondary, further, and higher education), equip young people with the skills to critically analyse news, engage with journalism, and navigate an increasingly complex media landscape.
 

The Guardian Foundation is now looking for an Education Officer for a 12 month fixed term contract to work across The Guardian Foundation’s news and media literacy programmes, delivering high-quality workshops and developing engaging educational resources. 

 

This is a part time role, 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday each week. Hours are typically 8am - 4pm on workshop delivery days, and 9:30am - 5:30pm on non-delivery days, with 2 days per week required in office. 

 

About the Role

 

  • Deliver engaging news and media literacy workshops to primary and secondary students (Key Stages 2 - 5) both in-person and online. Workshops are delivered in various settings: in primary and secondary schools, in our Education Centre in the Guardian’s office, and in informal settings (eg. libraries), including occasional travel where required.
  • Lead and support the development and updating of high quality learning resources and schemes of work for teachers and students across Key Stage 2 - 5
  • Adapt sessions and resources to different age groups and educational needs, ensuring accessibility and inclusion.
  • Translate workshop content into scalable formats (e.g. lesson plans, classroom activities, digital and printable resources)
  • Maintain and develop relationships with schools, universities, teachers, and community groups.

 

About You

This is not a prescriptive list, and we do not expect applicants to meet every item outlined below. We believe that this role would suit someone looking to build on their existing experiences and skills, whilst also having an understanding of their personal and professional development goals.

 

  • Qualified teacher status (QTS), with at least 2 years' experience delivering high quality educational sessions to young people. 
  • Ability to adapt teaching and delivery across a range of age groups (eg. KS2 - 5 and / or post-16 learners).
  • Experience developing and designing high-quality educational resources or curriculum materials.
  • Good understanding of the UK curricula and current education priorities.
  • An interest in news and current affairs, with an understanding of the importance of news and media literacy.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally within London and across the UK to support programme delivery and training, including occasional overnight stays.

 

The salary band for this fixed term contract is £21,000-22,2000 based on 3 days per week (£35,000-37,000 full time equivalent).

 

This post is subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. The Guardian Foundation is committed to safeguarding the children and adults at risk with whom it works. The successful candidate will be expected to adhere to our policy and code of conduct. 

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at The Guardian Foundation. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. The Guardian Foundation actively encourages applications from candidates underrepresented within the media and not-for-profit sectors. 

 

How to Apply

 

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. A cover letter is required for your application. 

 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

 

The closing date for applications is 10am on Monday 2nd November 2026. 

Interviews are expected to take place at our Kings Cross office w/c 16th November 2026.

 All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers on anna.vipers@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

Benefits at the The Guardian Foundation

 You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Audience Development Executive- Fixed term Contract
job.description:
About us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Here, you’re given the chance to reach millions, create work that matters and deliver impartial journalism in a polarised world.

In our warm, collaborative culture, you’ll connect with a diverse community of experts who support your growth, career aspirations and wellbeing.

Your future at the FT will be filled with opportunities that challenge and inspire you. With no fixed path, you’ll discover new skills and forge a career that can take you anywhere.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe in the power of unique perspectives and want all voices in our organisation to be heard, respected and valued. A supportive workplace is one where employees feel they can be themselves and operate to their full potential. We are committed to removing barriers for everyone, with a focus on addressing those faced by underrepresented groups.

The role 

FT Live is the global conferences and events division of the Financial Times Group. We deliver more than 200 events a year, including large-scale global summits, bespoke client forums, and digital conferences. Our events convene world-class speakers and bring together senior executives, policymakers, and thought leaders across industries and geographies.

The Audience Development Executive plays a crucial role in driving delegate acquisition and audience engagement for high-impact B2B events. Based in Manila, this role supports the FT Live marketing team by researching, qualifying, and managing delegate leads, contributing directly to the success of our client-sponsored and FT-branded events.

Working under the supervision of the Audience Development Manager, the Executive will be responsible for researching and building prospect lists, conducting outreach, and ensuring data accuracy in line with campaign briefs. 

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented, curious, and proactive individual looking to gain experience in international events and audience marketing. This role is instrumental in identifying new leads for FT Live events and supporting the broader data acquisition strategy. Working from detailed marketing briefs, the Executive will conduct targeted research, build lead lists in a templated format, and collaborate with the Data team to upload and process records.

Key responsibilities

Audience Research & Acquisition

  • Create high-quality lead lists based on event-specific briefs (e.g. job title, industry, location, and company).
  • Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Cognism, web research, databases, and other tools to identify prospects.
  • Collaborate with marketing managers and project leads to define and expand on target profiles.
  • Conduct independent company, sector and market research to identify relevant organisations and decision-makers beyond initial campaign wishlists.

Audience Outreach

  • Craft and send personalised LinkedIn InMails and emails to potential delegates.
  • Support delegate invitation campaigns by managing email follow-ups and tracking responses and identifying opportunities for further engagement.

Data Management

  • Perform data audits, clean-ups, and deduplication to maintain high data quality.
  • Support audience data checks to assess the size, relevance and feasibility of potential audiences for prospective events.
  • Collaborate with the Data and Delegate Services teams to ensure leads are uploaded, segmented, and handled in accordance with FT’s compliance protocols, including GDPR and consent regulations.

Campaign Support

  • Track responses and lead engagement through internal systems and campaign dashboards.
  • Contribute to post-campaign analysis, highlighting the impact of research activity and identifying relevant audience insights and learnings.
  • Monitor the status of leads and support the audience development manager in adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis as requested.
  • Manage research across multiple campaigns and priorities, adapting to changing deadlines during busy periods.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with event marketers, project managers, sales, and operations to ensure alignment on delegate recruitment goals and expanded event presence.
  • Attend internal briefing meetings and proactively share research findings, audience trends and potential targeting opportunities.

Required skills and experience 

  • Open to fresh graduates with a Bachelor's degree in any four-year course
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about different industries, companies, markets and business topics.
  • Experience of working with and manipulating large sets of data.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to find, assess and organise information from multiple sources.
  • Must be proactive and be able to operate with limited supervision from line manager.
  • A team player, who is a strong, confident communicator and collaborator.
  • Ability to think creatively, ask questions and test ideas.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Resourceful approach to research and willingness to explore different sources and methods when information is difficult to find.

Desirable experience 

  • Prior experience in audience research, lead generation, or delegate acquisition.
  • Knowledge of GDPR (and similar), impact on Marketing and Communications globally.
  • Microsoft Excel Proficiency: Confident using Excel to manage, clean, and analyse lead data (e.g. using filters, pivot tables, and formulas).
  • CRM Experience: Familiarity with Salesforce (or similar CRM systems) for logging, managing, and tracking lead data in alignment with audience development campaigns.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered research tools or data visualisation platforms.
  • Knowledge of Cognism or other B2B contact data platforms for sourcing and verifying leads.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools like Slack, Monday.com, or other similar tools for task tracking and internal communications.
  • Previous experience working within a global or internationally distributed team.

Working Hours:

  • Flexibility to work UK business hours is required. Occasional out-of-hours support may be needed during key campaign periods.

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

Our benefits vary by location but we are committed to providing best-in-class perks across all our offices. These include generous annual leave, medical cover, inclusive parental leave packages, subsidised gym memberships and opportunities to give back to the community. Full details of our benefits are available here.

We’ve embraced a 50% hybrid working model (averaging two to three days onsite) that fosters trust and remote adaptability while encouraging in-person camaraderie and peer learning. Additionally, we are open to accommodating specific flexible working pattern requests for all roles where feasible.

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

Further information

At the FT, we embrace innovation and the use of technology and appreciate that individuals may leverage AI tools as part of their job application process. Whilst we are happy for you to use AI to assist with your application, it is essential that all information provided is authentic and accurately represents your skills, experience, and qualifications.

job.title: Equity & Belonging Specialist
job.description:
Title: Equity & Belonging Specialist

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: $69,000 - $72,000

Entry -Level Position 


Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Organizational Equity & Belonging, the Equity & Belonging Specialist is an entry level position that supports the implementation of KQED's equitable excellence strategy by coordinating DEI initiatives that foster belonging, curiosity, and inclusive engagement across the organization. Through project coordination, content development, facilitation, and operational support, the Specialist helps translate strategic direction into consistent, high-quality execution.

Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders, the Specialist supports DEI-related learning experiences, Employee Belonging Groups (EBGs), GUIDE Council initiatives, heritage month programming, and departmental operations. The role also maintains resources, coordinates logistics, tracks program outcomes, and serves as a trusted partner in ensuring DEI initiatives are organized, accessible, and effectively delivered in alignment with the strategic direction established by the Director.
KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics
The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely.

 

Essential Functions: The Equity & Belonging Specialist may assist with one or more of the following:

  • DEI Learning Support & Facilitation (40%)

    • Develop presentation decks, facilitator guides, participant resources, interactive activities, surveys, and other educational collateral that support DEI-related learning initiatives based on the curriculum strategy and learning objectives established by the Director.
    • Facilitate foundational DEI learning experiences and educational sessions for staff, creating engaging and inclusive learning environments.
    • Coordinate scheduling, invitations, room and virtual meeting logistics, materials, and resource repositories that support DEI educational programming.
    • Distribute post-session surveys, track attendance and participation, and compile data and insights that support evaluation and continuous improvement of DEI initiatives.

  • Heritage Month Content & Engagement Support (35%)

    • Coordinate the operational workflow for heritage month initiatives by managing content movement and communication between Creative, Product, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Draft introductory copy and supporting content for heritage month collections based on established content frameworks and organizational standards.
    • Audit, organize, and maintain multimedia content libraries that showcase KQED programming and storytelling across heritage month collections.
    • Provide logistical and administrative support for GUIDE Council-led heritage month events and cultural engagement activities, including scheduling, room setup, catering coordination, RSVP tracking, vendor support, and event execution.

  • Employee Belonging Group (EBG) Support (20%)

    • Support the onboarding of new EBG leaders by providing guidance on the EBG Guidebook, governance resources, templates, organizational processes, and operating expectations.
    • Serve as a liaison for EBG leaders by connecting them with appropriate internal partners, coordinating communications, and helping navigate organizational resources and procedures.
    • Maintain EBG documentation, resource libraries, budget tracking tools, and program records to support effective governance and long-term sustainability.

  • Administrative & Operational Support (5%)

    • Partner with internal stakeholders to maintain departmental calendars and coordinate scheduling that supports effective participation across DEI initiatives.
    • Maintain the department's internal knowledge base, ensuring DEI resources, templates, guidance documents, and reference materials remain current and accessible.
    • Provide general administrative and operational support for departmental initiatives, reporting, communications, and resource management
  • Perform other related duties as assigned in support of DEI programs and organizational needs.

job.description:
Title: On-Call Brand and Motion Graphics Designer / Designer 2

Schedule Format - Location: Hybrid - San Francisco

Pay Information: Hourly Rate: $39.00 - $56.00


KQED is one of the largest and most respected nonprofits in Northern California — a 70+ year institution that generations of Bay Area residents have turned to for news, culture, and community. And yet the most exciting chapter in KQED's story is still ahead. As audience behaviors shift and competition for attention intensifies, building deeper connections with new and younger audiences isn't just a marketing goal — it's an organizational imperative, and brand is at the center of how we will get there.

The KQED Creative department plays a vital role in bringing this vision to life. As a member of our team, the On-Call Brand and Motion Graphics Designer will help shape and evolve KQED’s visual identity, developing cohesive brand systems and compelling motion graphics that connect with audiences across platforms. The ideal candidate is a multidisciplinary designer with strong expertise in brand identity systems and motion design, capable of translating strategic and creative concepts into engaging visual experiences across video, digital, social, print, environmental, and emerging platforms. The successful candidate will bring creative versatility, thoughtful collaboration, and a shared commitment to KQED’s mission of making a difference in the communities we serve.
 

KQED envisions a public media organization with a culture that centers on human dignity, equity, and belonging. This will enable us to better serve and reflect the Bay Area through diverse and inclusive storytelling. 

We value the contributions of marginalized people in society — including Black, Indigenous, and all people of color,  people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people — and we believe that these communities must be centered in the work we do, and we strongly encourage members of these communities to apply.

KQED Code of Ethics  https://www.kqed.org/about/code-ethics

The mission that drives us:

KQED provide citizens of Northern California with a community-supported alternative to commercial media.   We provide citizens with the knowledge they need to make informed decisions; convene community dialogue; bring the arts to everyone and engage audiences to share their stories. We help students and teachers thrive in 21st-century classrooms, and take people of all ages on journeys of exploration- exposing them to new people, places and ideas.

This role will work hybrid between working in KQED's newly renovated headquarters and working remotely. 

Essential Functions

  • Understand, interpret, and apply KQED brand guidelines while completing projects according to established benchmarks and deadlines.
  • Develop and extend cohesive visual brand systems and identities for KQED programs, campaigns, initiatives, and sub-brands, translating creative direction into typography, color, graphic language, imagery, iconography, layout, logos, and other identity elements.
  • Apply and scale brand systems across digital, social, video, print, environmental, presentation, and promotional platforms, ensuring consistency while adapting the visual language to different audience experiences.
  • Translate visual brand systems into motion, conceptualizing and producing animated typography, title sequences, logo animations, transitions, lower thirds, information graphics, explainers, social video graphics, and video packaging that establish consistent brand behavior across platforms.
  • Develop reusable motion templates, toolkits, illustrations, infographics, and other graphic assets that enable consistent execution while supporting storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Design and animate using Adobe Creative Suite, with particular expertise in Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects and Premiere.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director, Art Director, designers, producers, editors, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute creative concepts.
  • Present and articulate design thinking and synthesize creative feedback and translate it into thoughtful design refinements while maintaining the integrity of the overall system.
  • Manage multiple assignments and production timelines within an on-call environment while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.

Candidate qualifications

  • Minimum 3–5 years of professional design experience, with demonstrated expertise in both brand identity/system development and motion design.
  • Bachelor’s degree in visual design, graphic design, motion design, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong conceptual and visual-design skills, with the ability to translate strategy, ideas, and storytelling into cohesive brand systems that extend across multiple applications and platforms.
  • Advanced motion-design skills with a strong understanding of timing, pacing, typography, composition, hierarchy, and storytelling through motion.
  • Strong typography, layout, information-design, and production skills across video, digital, social, and print, including working knowledge of print production and pre-press preparation.
  • Ability to move fluidly between concept development and hands-on production, managing multiple projects from concept through final delivery within limited timeframes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to articulate design decisions, receive and synthesize creative direction and stakeholder feedback, and work effectively with creative leadership, designers, producers, editors, stakeholders, and internal clients.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, with experience working in 3D environments or integrating 3D elements into motion design.
  • The successful candidate will be required to join NABET Local 51.

Portfolio + Reel Requirements

  • Brand identity and visual-system work demonstrating process and iteration—from initial exploration through a cohesive identity system and its application across multiple touchpoints.
  • Motion and motion-branding work demonstrating how visual identities translate into movement, including examples of motion typography, animation, transitions, information graphics, and/or video packaging.
  • Strong typography, visual hierarchy, layout, and composition skills across digital, motion, and print applications.
  • Clear identification of the candidate’s individual role and contribution to collaborative projects.

Knowledge/Experience Desired

  • Experience creating motion identity guidelines, animation principles, reusable motion templates, or toolkits that extend brand systems across platforms.
  • Experience designing for social and short-form video platforms and adapting creative systems for evolving audience and platform needs.
  • Additional craft capabilities such as hand-rendered/vector illustration and Cinema 4D, Blender, or other 3D design and animation tools.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design principles, as well as emerging creative technologies and workflows, including generative and AI-assisted design tools.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to lift a minimum of fifteen (15) pounds;
  • Ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull or carry;
  • Ability to use abdominal and lower back muscles over time without fatigue;
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for extended periods;
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach;
  • Fine motor skills;
  • Good visual and auditory acuity.

The physical demands described here represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully.

 

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as necessary to meet the ongoing needs of this organization.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

job.description:
Have you always dreamed of being on the radio?

Do you have a lot to say and enjoy being the center of attention?

Are you looking for a career change?

If you are a highly creative, dynamic individual with a hard-core passion for great radio, we’d love to hear from you. We have a rare opening for an On-Air Host serving Bracebridge and the Muskoka region. We’ve been “putting the wattage in your cottage” for over 25 years, and we’re looking for the next BIG talent to help us evolve into the next 25.

CAREERS AT VISTA RADIO

Vista Radio prides itself on a fresh vision of broadcasting and an unparalleled commitment to community involvement. Vista Radio operates 45 radio stations (and growing) broadcasting across 75 transmitters located in three Provinces and the Northwest Territories. As one of the first broadcasters in Canada to embrace cloud-based music distribution, Vista truly is one of Canada’s most innovative radio companies.

If you are looking for a career that offers challenging work, long-term growth potential, and the chance to make a real difference, join our team. We operate four radio stations in Ontario’s Cottage Country, and our team is passionately dedicated to the communities we serve and committed to generating exceptional local radio.

About the Role

Vista Radio has an opening for a full-time On-Air Host based in Bracebridge / Muskoka, Ontario.

The successful candidate will host either:

Morning Show: 6:00am – 10:00am (Work schedule 5am to 1pm)OR

Afternoon Show: 2:00pm – 6:00pm (Work schedule 10am to 6pm)

Final shift assignment will be determined based on station needs and candidate fit.

Position Description

Be a storyteller with creative, compelling content

Prepare and deliver an engaging daily show for our audience

Create and execute station promotions

Maintain station social media pages and websites

Be a part of the community and make promotional appearances, as required

Attend regular air checks

Liaise with clients as necessary

Assist the sales team and help develop creative promotions

Voice track shifts as necessary

Voice commercials for other Vista properties as needed

Position Requirements

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Self-starter (this is a big-time necessity)

Demonstrated teamwork and collaboration; ability to take direction and coaching

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team

Valid Class 5 driver’s license

Working familiarity with Adobe Audition and ENCO is a strong asset

Demonstrated ability to use and excel with social media platforms (Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, etc.)

Familiarity with G-Selector is an asset

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

🩺 Health & Dental Coverage – Comprehensive plans for individuals and families📈 RRSP Program with DPSP Matching – Vista matches your contributions into a Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan💪 Short-term & Long-term Disability – Income protection when life throws you a curveball🧠 Employee and Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) – 24/7 access to mental health and counseling support🏖️ Annual Vacation & Stat Holidays – Paid time off to relax and recharge❤️ Life & Optional Life Insurance – Protection for you and your loved ones💻 Virtual Care Access – On-demand, 24/7 healthcare wherever you are🌍 Work Where You Live – Make a real impact in the communities we serve

job.title: Marketing Executive - Timmins, ON
job.description:
Marketing Executive (Account Executive) – Timmins, ON

Welcome to Canada’s fastest growing broadcast company.  Radio, Digital and Social media are the platforms.  As a Marketing Executive you will be  building strong relationships with clients while developing strategic advertising solutions to meet their business objectives.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Developing and managing media marketing campaigns that integrate advertising, public relations, sales promotion as well as marketing disciplines to deliver consistent messages across local broadcasting and digital platforms

Developing creative sales strategies and proposals for new and existing customers and subsequently, developing ads for client approval and implementation

Developing new business; specifically, new revenue streams from unassigned accounts. Providing on-going customer support to ensure optimal service levels at all times

Meeting and exceeding monthly/quarterly/yearly radio and digital revenue targets

Managing accounts receivables

Position Requirements:

Sales experience, as well as knowledge and experience with commission structured business is an asset

Radio and digital sales experience is considered an asset

Education in sales and marketing preferred; entrepreneurial background welcomed

Ability to prioritize and work with a high level of initiative, autonomy and self-motivation

Strong verbal and visual presentation skills

Strong computer skills - specifically Microsoft Office products, Wide Orbit and vCreative

Strong organizational and interpersonal skills

Exceptional business customer service and networking skills

Ability to think conceptually and creatively to resolve problems and develop unique solutions

Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment that is based on team and individual effort

A valid driver’s license and reliable, fully insured automobile is required

Proven track record in business development

Whether we're delivering local news, playing your favorite tunes, or supporting events that bring people together, we care about our team and the communities we serve. Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Systems Analyst II

 

Position Overview

The Digital Customer Support (DCS) Systems Analyst II provides Tier 2 technical and operational support for Cox Media Group's business-critical applications and digital platforms. This role focuses on troubleshooting, incident resolution, application administration, and maintaining reliable services for internal customers.

 

The ideal candidate is a customer-focused problem solver with strong technical, analytical, and communication skills. The position includes participation in an after-hours on-call rotation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 support for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and associated integrations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents and service requests escalated through the Service Desk.
  • Support CMG's Content Management Systems (CMS) and WideOrbit revenue platform, including troubleshooting, user provisioning, and account management.
  • Participate in on-call support, major incident response, and technical escalations.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed
  • Collaborate with vendors, application owners, and other IT teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain support documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce recurring incidents, and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Support and cross-train on Change Management and Critical Problem Management processes to ensure team-wide coverage, operational continuity, and backup support when needed.

Fox Business Network

FOX Business Network (FBN) is a financial news channel delivering real-time information across all platforms that impact both Main Street and Wall Street. Owned by FOX Corporation, FBN is a unit of FOX News Media and has bureaus in Chicago, Los Angeles, and Washington, D.C.

We are looking for a confident, highly motivated, proactive Booker to join our team. job.title: Pricing, Planning & Inventory Manager
job.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on maximizing revenue through data-driven insights? Scripps Networks is seeking a Pricing, Planning, and Inventory Manager who will lead the strategic optimization of all ad sales inventory, architect deal approval processes and systems, and drive revenue growth through advanced analytics and strategic leadership. This is your opportunity to shape business strategy at one of the nation's leading media companies.
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Lead strategic initiatives to maximize inventory value and revenue, guiding traffic, sales, and planning teams on prioritization for all revenue streams including cash, Audience Deficiency Unit (ADU), and Direct Response.
  • Collaborate on the development of and implement strategies for mitigating liability and risk, driving cross-functional alignment to ensure revenue goals and operational excellence.
  • Serve as authority on Wide Orbit Sales & P&I functionalities, setting process workflows, testing and managing Wide Orbit or other leading software solution system enhancements and documentation to drive efficiency.
  • Conceptualize advanced analytical tools and models for the sales support team, mentor Sales Assistants and Planners on inventory maximization and strategic flighting.
  • Deliver strategic insights and recommendations to senior management based on comprehensive analysis (inventory, Direct Response (DR) rates, liability, etc.) to shape revenue forecasting, pricing, and long-term budgeting strategies.
  • Build and oversee the creation, compilation, and dissemination of all Sales rate cards and associated analysis.
  • Manage post-analysis reports Management Science Associates, Inc. (MSA).
  • Participate in training and development for sales assistants and planners, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of analytical excellence.
  • Identify revenue optimization opportunities, presenting business cases to leadership and directing their implementation.
     

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 8+ years of experience in related field preferred
     

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Deep understanding of advertising and media sales industry, specifically linear TV media planning and inventory management
  • Advanced Excel proficiency and experience with Ad Sales systems
  • Experience working with sales teams and cross-functional partners
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to meet deadlines
     

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


New York City is the epicenter of media, culture, and innovation. As the nation's largest city, NYC offers unparalleled professional opportunities alongside world-class dining, arts, entertainment, and nightlife. From Broadway shows to cutting-edge museums, iconic landmarks to hidden neighborhood gems, the city provides endless ways to explore and be inspired.


The five boroughs offer diverse communities and lifestyles, whether you prefer the energy of Manhattan, the creative spirit of Brooklyn, the cultural richness of Queens, the green spaces of the Bronx, or the waterfront charm of Staten Island. With an extensive public transportation system, you can navigate the city without a car while enjoying access to beaches, parks, and weekend getaways to the Hamptons, Hudson Valley, or beyond.


New York City is where ambitious professionals come to make their mark, surrounded by the best talent in every industry and a vibrant community that never stops moving forward.

job.title: Account Executive, KERO
job.description:
We are looking for a driven, creative sales professional who loves helping local businesses grow? KERO in Bakersfield, California is looking for an Account Executive, Local who will be a true partner to the business community — connecting clients to the audiences that matter most through a powerful, multi-platform suite of advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, search strategies, social media, digital display, and e-mail targeting, you'll craft customized campaigns that deliver real results and real return on investment. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making a measurable difference for the businesses in your community, this is your opportunity to shine.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)

WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Bakersfield is California's ninth-largest city and a place with a character all its own — rooted in agriculture, energy, and a deep musical heritage that gave birth to the Bakersfield Sound, a twangy, West Coast alternative to Nashville country that produced legends like Buck Owens and Merle Haggard. The city is home to the Kern County Museum, a vibrant arts scene, and a calendar full of festivals and community events that reflect its proud, hardworking spirit.

Surrounded by stunning natural landscapes, Bakersfield sits at the southern end of the San Joaquin Valley with easy access to some of California's most spectacular outdoor destinations. The nearby Kern River offers whitewater rafting and scenic hiking, while Lake Isabella is a favorite for boating, fishing, and camping. The southern Sierra Nevada mountains are just a short drive away, putting world-class skiing at Mammoth Mountain and the towering peaks of Sequoia National Park well within weekend reach.

With a lower cost of living than most California metros, Bakersfield gives residents the ability to stretch their dollar further while enjoying a warm climate, a growing restaurant and craft brewery scene, and a close-knit community that takes pride in its roots. The city is well-connected via Highway 99 and is within a two-hour drive of both Los Angeles and the Central Coast — making it an ideal home base for those who want California living without California prices.

WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company's ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a driven and experienced Local Sales Manager to inspire a team of Account Executives and help local businesses grow through innovative, multi-platform advertising solutions. From broadcast television to Over The Top (OTT) video, SEO/SEM, social media, digital display, and email targeting, you'll have a full arsenal of tools to connect clients with the audiences that matter most — and a talented team to lead in doing it.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Collaborate with DOS and other sales managers and departments to accomplish the objectives of the station.
  • Organize, direct and manage the execution and performance of a team of local sales Account Executives.
  • Negotiate ratings, rates and budgets.
  • Develop new business for station utilizing and maximizing all station platforms including but not limited to broadcast, digital and mobile.
  • Develop working knowledge of Scripps Sales Process (SSP) and coach Account Executives regarding SSP in the field.
  • Utilize SSP, resources and tools provided to build effective sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to train, develop and motivate the local sales team so that revenue goals are achieved.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and Sales Managers to foster career growth and development of the local sales team so that a pipeline of talent for future Scripps sales management openings is ready.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with outside vendors.
  • Interface with traffic systems and personnel to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory.
  • Oversee accounts receivable and credit policies.
  • Develop and implement pricing and packaging to fill needs of both client and station.
  • Know the strengths and weaknesses of the competing stations, other advertising mediums and position the station accordingly.
  • Effectively forecast sales revenue and manage department expenses so that financial goals are achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field or equivalent experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years proven success in media sales
  • Experience in agency and direct strategic account management, broadcast inventory and digital/video capabilities required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Demonstrated aptitude for informal leadership and mentoring; fosters open dialogue, empowers others, addresses conflict quickly and directly
  • Strong coaching and feedback skills
  • Strong ability to motivate others toward team goals
  • Able to foster an environment that enables creative and innovative thinking
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to help others translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organization skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • May require some travel

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland is a city that surprises — a place where world-class culture, passionate sports fandom, and a thriving food scene come together on the shores of Lake Erie. The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the Cleveland Museum of Art, and Playhouse Square (the largest performing arts center outside of New York City) give the city a cultural footprint that punches well above its weight. Cleveland's neighborhoods — from the electric energy of the Flats and East 4th Street to the eclectic charm of Tremont and Ohio City — each bring something unique, with independent restaurants, craft breweries, and local markets around every corner.


Sports are a way of life here. Clevelanders bleed orange and brown for the NFL's Browns, cheer on the Guardians at Progressive Field, and pack Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse for Cavaliers basketball. Beyond the stadiums, the region offers beautiful outdoor escapes — from the winding trails of the Cuyahoga Valley National Park to the beaches and marinas along Lake Erie. With a cost of living well below most major metros and a genuine sense of community pride, Cleveland is a city that's easy to love and even easier to call home.

job.title: Senior Producer, Editorial Video, Amazing America
job.description:
Sinclair, Inc. is seeking a highly creative and experienced Senior Producer, Editorial Video to join Amazing America, our digital-first lifestyle brand that spotlights what makes America amazing. Our mission is to celebrate our country’s unique culture, adventurous spirit, and extraordinary stories hiding in ordinary places. Through entertaining, informative, and personality-driven storytelling, we inspire audiences to explore the country, experience its traditions, and connect with the people who make it special.

As a senior member of our creative production team, this individual will play a key role in developing original editorial concepts, building repeatable content franchises, identifying and cultivating on-camera talent, and establishing a distinctive visual and storytelling style across our platforms.

This is a hands-on creative position requiring strong editorial instincts, exceptional storytelling skills, and the technical ability to execute productions from concept through delivery.

The Senior Producer will work across short-form vertical video, mid-length digital programming, and longer-form original series distributed across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and other digital platforms.

The successful candidate will understand how to balance journalistic curiosity with entertaining storytelling, creating content that is informative, visually compelling, authentic, and optimized for digital audiences.

Responsibilities

Ideation & Development

  • Develop and pitch original editorial video concepts, standalone stories, repeatable formats, and recurring series that align with Amazing America’s brand identity and audience development objectives.
  • Monitor assigned geographic markets to identify interesting events, unique destinations, regional traditions, and fascinating personalities that define our country’s culture
  • Create comprehensive pitches that clearly articulate the editorial premise, audience hook, narrative structure, visual approach, production requirements, editing strategy, and intended distribution.
  • Identify opportunities to connect individual stories to larger seasonal initiatives, editorial campaigns, and brand programming priorities.

Writing & Research

  • Lead research and story development for approved projects, ensuring accuracy, originality, and a compelling narrative approach.
  • Develop creative treatments, scripts, outlines, interview questions, and production plans for a wide range of digital video formats.
  • Source archival photographs, video footage, historical materials, and supplemental B-roll to support editorial storytelling.
  • Work collaboratively with on-camera talent to develop scripts and storytelling approaches that complement their individual personalities and presentation styles.

Production

  • Serve as lead producer and creative director for original video productions in studio and field environments.
  • Direct hosts, creators, interview subjects, and other on-camera talent to deliver authentic, engaging performances to deliver compelling, character-driven storytelling.
  • Independently shoot high-quality video using DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and other professional production equipment.
  • Manage creative decision-making during field productions, adapting to changing circumstances and recognizing opportunities for spontaneous storytelling.
  • Travel as needed to produce original content in markets throughout the United States.

Post-Production

  • Lead the editorial and creative execution of post-production, ensuring finished content meets Amazing America’s storytelling and visual standards.
  • Independently edit original video content using Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Provide creative direction, feedback, and editorial notes to internal or freelance editors when projects require additional post-production support.
  • Shape compelling narratives through pacing, interview selection, music, sound design, archival footage, graphics, and visual sequencing.
  • Utilize Adobe Photoshop and other Adobe Creative Suite applications to create or enhance graphics, static social content, and visual storytelling elements.
  • Develop platform-specific edits that reflect the distinct audience behaviors and storytelling conventions of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Maintain consistency in visual style, tone, and production quality across Amazing America’s content portfolio.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of professional experience developing, producing, shooting, and editing editorial or entertainment-focused digital video content.
  • Strong editorial judgment and an ability to identify stories and characters that resonate with digital audiences.
  • Exceptional research, writing, and narrative storytelling skills.
  • Hands-on experience directing studio and field productions.
  • Advanced proficiency operating DSLR/mirrorless cameras, DJI Osmo cameras, smartphones, and associated production equipment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Deep understanding of short-form and longer-form digital video storytelling across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects while meeting creative, editorial, and production deadlines.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaborative skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional creative team.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for productions.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience producing lifestyle, travel, food, culture, entertainment, adventure, or human-interest programming.
  • Experience developing successful social-first content franchises and recurring editorial series.
  • Background in digital journalism, documentary production, or character-driven nonfiction storytelling.
  • Experience working across both premium digital productions and fast-turnaround social content.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $90,000 to $120,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY:

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair:

job.description:
Streaming Line Producer

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 PLUS

The Opportunity

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is seeking a sharp, creative, and decisive Streaming Line Producer to lead compelling live coverage across linear television and digital streaming platforms. Reporting to the Executive Producer, you’ll shape rundowns as stories develop, make real-time editorial decisions, and help drive the future of local streaming news.

Bring strong news judgment, crisp writing, control-room confidence, and a digital-first mindset. You’ll use video, sound, graphics, live elements, social platforms, and audience insights to make coverage immediate, useful, and engaging wherever viewers watch.

What You’ll Do

• Lead live coverage and editorial execution. Write, stack, time, and line produce structured newscasts and continuous coverage for linear and streaming platforms; adjust rundowns as news develops; guide breaking-news coverage from the control room; manage multiple live elements; and direct anchors, reporters, field crews, and production teams.

• Create streaming-first, multiplatform content. Develop live streams, explainers, interviews, and presentation elements for digital audiences and the station’s broader content strategy; write broadcast and digital copy; log, clip, and edit video; coordinate graphics; produce interviews and digital video packages; and repurpose content before, during, and after live broadcasts.

• Grow reach through smart distribution and insights. Optimize and distribute video and live content across station digital products and YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, tailoring presentation to each platform and its audience. Monitor real-time metrics, social feeds, and regional news trends to inform live coverage, story placement, follow-up content, and streaming priorities.

• Collaborate across the newsroom. Partner with anchors, reporters, writers, digital producers, video editors, assignment teams, and production staff to deliver cohesive, accurate, high-quality journalism across platforms.

• Use evolving newsroom technology. Work confidently with iNews, live streaming tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing tools, audience analytics platforms, Outlook, and Workday, while adapting as station technology evolves.

What You Bring

• Experience. Two to four years as a news producer, line producer, or in a similar role in a medium-to-large broadcast newsroom; live streaming or digital-first news production experience is strongly preferred.

• Editorial and live-production strength. Strong news judgment, AP-style writing, and demonstrated control-room leadership, with the ability to manage breaking news, multiple live elements, and intense deadlines. Working knowledge of broadcast law, FCC regulations, journalistic standards, and editorial best practices.

• Multiplatform expertise. A strong understanding of multiplatform storytelling, social media strategy, digital video distribution, and audience engagement.

• Technology fluency. Experience with linear rundown software, live streaming production tools, control room automation, digital video editing and publishing workflows, and audience analytics, plus the ability to learn evolving systems quickly.

• Education and leadership. A bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, along with clear professional communication, strong collaboration, sound decision-making, and the composure to lead effectively in fast-moving live-news situations.

Additional Information

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Schedule & Adaptability

FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 Plus is a 24/7 news operation. This position supports the morning show and requires overnight hours. This role requires flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, breaking news, and special events. Extended shifts may be required during severe weather, major news events, or emergencies to support continuous coverage across linear and streaming platforms.

Ready to combine strong line-producing discipline with the creativity and speed of digital-first journalism? Apply today and help FOX 5 DC deliver meaningful live coverage across every screen.

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans.
