  Overview and Responsibilities:   Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Broadcast Maintenance Technician to support engineering maintenance and technical operations for the CBS Network and affiliated production units. This role offers essential support around the clock for broadcast systems that are on-air and in production. It involves setting up, monitoring, and solving problems related to complex technical systems.   We use several systems. These include SDI and ST 2110 IP video routers. We also have channel playout systems, high-speed Ethernet fabrics (25–200GbE), and structured fiber optic cabling. In addition, we utilize media storage and transfer platforms, switchers, and both satellite and terrestrial contribution and distribution systems. Our on-air graphics and internet/cloud streaming encoding systems are included as well.     Basic Qualifications:  
  • 3+ years of engineering support and troubleshooting experience in broadcast environments, including one or more of the following:
  • On-air playout in broadcast and/or streaming environments
  • Live broadcast control room operations, preferably in sports or live entertainment
  • Transmission operations supporting real-time monitoring and distribution across multiple delivery paths
  • Expert-level knowledge of SMPTE ST 2110 IP video infrastructure, including uncompressed video (ST 2110-20), audio (ST 2110-30), and ancillary data (ST 2110-40) flows, with solid comprehension of PTP-based timing and synchronization
  • Proficiency with broadcast test and measurement equipment (waveform monitors, vectorscopes, rasterizers, signal analyzers) for validating video/audio integrity across SDI and IP signal paths
  • You need to know about broadcast network design principles for high-bandwidth, uncompressed video. This includes redundancy models such as dual fabric and hitless switching. It is also important to understand multicast design and how to manage essence flow bandwidth.
  Additional Qualifications:   IP & Broadcast Systems
  • End-to-end signal chain troubleshooting across IP, SDI, LTC, L-Band, and ASI signals, with a structured methodology for isolating issues across network, device, and workflow layers
  • Experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining Evertz IP-based systems, including ST 2110 routing, signal processing, control infrastructure, NMOS integration (e.g., Evertz Magnum), SDP generation/exchange, and control plane vs. data plane separation
  • Knowledge of broadcast engineering best practices related to signal redundancy, failover, and resiliency design
Playout & Monitoring
  • Experience supporting channel origination workflows with Grass Valley AMPP. This work involves playout service orchestration. It also includes graphics insertion, SCTE triggers, and content scheduling.
  • Experience supporting Imagine Communications SNP or equivalent IP gateway systems in live production or playout environments
  • Familiarity with TAG Video Systems multiviewers, including monitoring layout configuration, signal health validation, and alarm interpretation in IP video environments
  • Working knowledge of Telestream PRISM waveform monitors for real-time SDI and ST 2110 signal analysis, including video quality, color space accuracy, and HDR/SDR compliance
Color, HDR & Satellite
  • Knowledge of color space conversion and HDR/SDR compatibility is important. This involves working with LUTs and tone mapping. You should also be able to fix EOTF/gamma errors, address color space metadata mismatches, and ensure consistent HDR/SDR output across devices.
  • Proficiency configuring and troubleshooting IRDs, L-Band routers, and associated RF equipment; solid knowledge of end-to-end satellite downlink signal chains including RF, L-Band, ASI, and IP outputs
Cloud & General
  • Knowledge of cloud-based or hybrid broadcast workflows, including remote production or IP extension of linear streams into AWS or Oracle Cloud environments
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering teams to troubleshoot issues across routing control systems, multicast networking, and downstream playout or monitoring devices
  • Proficient written documentation skills. This includes operational procedures. It also includes troubleshooting guides and engineering run books.
  • You should communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should also be self-directed and able to work in environments where priorities change.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Privacy Platform

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

 

As People Inc. expands and scales its product offerings, maintaining user trust is foundational to our growth. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager – Data Privacy, Trust & Platform to lead the product strategy, platform capabilities, and user experiences that power data privacy, consent, and user trust across our ecosystem.


In this role, you will bridge the gap between business strategy, legal requirements, and engineering execution, serving as the platform owner for backend data pipelines and compliance automation, and the functional strategist defining user-facing consent controls and preference touch points.

 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

 

About The Team:

At People Inc., reader trust is essential. This team builds the critical platform infrastructure and defines the user-facing privacy logic that ensures data rights are honored seamlessly for our readers, operationally efficient for internal teams, and fully compliant across global regulations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Product Strategy & Leadership: Define and execute a comprehensive product roadmap for user trust, data privacy, and consent management. Serve as the strategic bridge aligning Legal, Engineering, Product, and Revenue leadership around complex trade-offs.
  • Platform Architecture & Data Systems: Partner with engineering teams to design and scale backend data infrastructure, event tracking, and automated compliance pipelines that streamline operations and eliminate manual drag.
  • Agile Team Leadership & Day-to-Day Execution: Lead and run the dedicated engineering scrum team on a day-to-day basis owning sprint planning, backlog prioritization, refinement, discovery and continuous delivery of platform capabilities.
  • User Experience & Product Taste: Lead the functional strategy and design logic for user-facing privacy controls, consent touch points, and account preferences across web and mobile applications ensuring they build brand trust without introducing unnecessary user friction.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Revenue Safety: Balance competing business priorities by negotiating clear trade-offs between regulatory risk, user conversion, and ad revenue/analytics sustainability.
  • Internal Tools: Build operational tools and capabilities for internal stakeholders (Legal, Support, Operations) to audit data lineage, monitor compliance metrics, and ensure operational efficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:


  • 5+ years of Product Management experience owning software roadmaps, driving strategy, and shipping technical products end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing up and driving alignment across product leadership, legal, revenue, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong technical and systems acumen: Comfortable working with backend data platforms, event tracking, APIs, and data routing infrastructure.
  • User-centric mindset: Passion for building intuitive, high-quality user experiences that simplify complex privacy choices for consumers.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to define functional requirements and strategy for neighboring engineering, design, and growth teams.

PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS & TARGET ENVIRONMENTS:


  • Experience in digital media, digital publishing, subscription services, high-scale consumer apps, or B2B data infrastructure balancing subscription growth, user accounts, and revenue sustainability.
  • Background in Data Platform, Growth Infrastructure, Core Platform, Data Governance, or Monetization Systems.
  • Exposure to environments like digital subscription media (The New York Times, Vox Media, Spotify), consumer apps (Airbnb, Uber, Calm, Duolingo), or data platform architectures (Twilio Segment, Snowflake).
  • General understanding of privacy frameworks and how user consent choices impact analytics, ad targeting, and revenue.

job.title: Government and politics editor
job.description:
IndyStar, part of the USA TODAY Network, has an immediate opening for a watchdog-minded, politically savvy journalist who can lead a team of reporters in a competitive, newsy market.

This is a key newsroom role, particularly following the 2026 midterm elections and heading into the start of the Indiana legislative session. Meanwhile, a highly competitive mayoral election has already kicked off ahead of next year's election.

This government and politics editor will work with reporters on the front end as well as the back to shape the full range of politics and government coverage, from breaking news to contextualized enterprise to investigative and watchdog journalism only IndyStar delivers.

The editor will put audience at the center of our coverage, asking with every story what do residents of Central Indiana want and need to know about their governments. They will embrace change and experimentation, learning from failures and pivoting quickly. And they will recognize the value of urgency and scoops.

The successful candidate will have political reporting experience, a keen editing eye and sharp news judgment — someone who is a team player and self-directed, passionate and compassionate, someone who finds success in the success of others.

People skills are as important as journalism skills in this role. Our government and politics editor will be part of a small but mighty team of news editors who rely on each other daily. You will lead your team with empathy while also challenging them to do their best work — whether they're interns still in college, our most experienced staffers or somewhere in between.

IndyStar is the winner of three Pulitzer Prizes, most recently in 2021. You’ll work with and learn from some of journalism’s best while living in a vibrant and diverse city in the heart of the Midwest.

Our mission is clear: IndyStar informs, empowers and inspires the people of Central Indiana with our journalism. We deliver journalism that is essential to the communities we serve with urgency. We are a people-centered newsroom that’s obsessed with thoughtful experimentation and developing our next generation of industry leaders.

If you’re up to the challenge of moving us forward, read on for job requirements and information on how to share your qualifications and best work.

Key responsibilities:

Manage a team of news reporters, including reporters covering Indianapolis city hall, Hamilton County, the Indiana Statehouse and our federal delegation

Lead and provide coverage of national or statewide interest for the USA TODAY Network

Mentor reporters on source-building, interviewing and public records

Meet our audience where they are by using different story formats, video and other visuals to convey information

Use metrics and our internal metrics experts to guide your team's approach to stories

Handle other editing duties as needed, including evening and weekend editor rotations

Requirements:

At least five years of journalism experience, including experience in political reporting or editing

Proven proficiency in applying analytics to content strategy

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Comfort in deadline-driven environment

Exceptional planning and organizational skills

Social-media and SEO knowledge

Strong line-editing skills

Strong people-management skills

Strong problem-solving skills

Experience with public records and data journalism

Command of media law and principles of ethical conduct

Bachelor's degree

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer pre-employment background check.

We are eager to learn more about you and what you will add to an already-great newsroom. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, put together a single document file that includes the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

job.title: Kentucky Men's Basketball Insider
job.description:
Covering Kentucky basketball for the Lexington Herald-Leader is a high-impact, high-visibility assignment at the heart of college sports journalism. This is not a traditional beat: you’ll be the go-to source for Big Blue Nation, breaking news and delivering in-depth, personality-driven coverage of the winningest program in men’s college basketball history. You’ll dig into the stories behind the box score—NIL, recruiting, the transfer portal and the business of the UK brand—while also capturing the culture, personalities and community impact that make Kentucky basketball a year-round obsession.

You’ll work across formats, from rapid-turn breaking news to explanatory video, and connect with fans on every platform, from TikTok to live events. AI and automation will help you focus on what matters most: building sources, breaking stories and delivering journalism that sets the agenda for Kentucky sports. You’ll also pitch in on major events like the Kentucky Derby, keeping your reporting fresh and relevant all year.

What sets this role apart:

  • Own one of the most competitive and vital beats in college sports
  • Combine relentless reporting with digital storytelling and audience engagement
  • Use AI and automation to free up time for deeper journalism—never to replace your voice or judgment
  • Reach fans wherever they are, with vertical video, social media and in-person events
  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive newsroom that values experimentation and continuous learning

What you’ll bring:

  • A college degree in journalism or equivalent experience
  • 3-5 years of reporting experience, ideally in highly competitive environments
  • Strong writing skills, excellent news judgment and the ability to spot stories that matter
  • Relentless reporting drive and a commitment to accuracy and ethics
  • Experience building sources and using public records
  • Comfort working nights, weekends and traveling for coverage
  • Skill in shooting and appearing on video, plus a strong grasp of vertical and social-first formats
  • Familiarity with Facebook, X, TikTok, Instagram and emerging platforms
  • Experience with AI tools and/or a willingness to experiment in that space
  • A collaborative approach and eagerness to learn and adapt
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance
  • Residency in Lexington-Fayette County

If you’re ready to set the pace for Kentucky basketball coverage and thrive in a digital-first, audience-obsessed environment, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please submit a resume, work samples and a one-page cover letter explaining how you would approach the job.

job.title: Assistant Video Editor
job.description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting

job.title: Commerce Analyst
job.description:
Commerce Analyst

You'll be the primary point of contact for ecommerce data questions and analysis, translating numbers into clear stories and recommendations for editors, business development, and social teams. This is a role with a lot of autonomy — you'll help own the analysis of specific brands and verticals, structure your own day-to-day, and bring a level-headed approach to a fast-moving media environment.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position with an initial five month term, with the possibility of extension based on performance and business need.

What you'll do

  • Present in-depth analyses of ecommerce performance that go beyond reporting what happened, to explain the bigger trends behind it
  • Translate data into plain language for non-data stakeholders, and make clear recommendations to editorial, business development, and social teams
  • Identify growth opportunities and design tests to act on them
  • Own solving problems as they come up — looking for ways to automate or use tools and data rather than patch things manually
  • Support the business with regular reporting, dashboards, and insights, and keep them well-maintained over the course of the engagement
  • Lead ad-hoc analysis for major commerce moments during the contract window (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, holiday season, and into Q1)
  • Help set up reporting and processes that can hand off cleanly at the end of the term

What we're looking for

Skills

  • Strong analytical ability, with a track record of synthesizing data into concepts non-data people can act on
  • Strong understanding of affiliate ecommerce 
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics and Big Query
  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with Google Sheets a plus
  • Experience with a data visualization tool — Looker, Google Data Studio (Looker Studio), or Tableau
  • Understanding of statistical concepts
  • Understanding of LLM’s and how they relate to retail/affiliate marketing

Experience

  • 4+ year working in an analytical role
  • Background at an ecommerce company, media company, or tech company preferred — we're open to other paths that show the same analytical muscle
  • Titles like Analyst are typical, but we care more about the work than the title
  • Comfortable hitting the ground running — this is a short-term engagement over our highest-volume season

Nice to haves

  • Experience with BigQuery or another SQL-based analytics tool
  • Search experience — SEO, SEMRush or a competitor tool, Search Console
  • Paid social experience
  • Experience with an affiliate or retail brand business
  • Experience with LLM analytics 

Education

  • No formal degree required. We've worked successfully with people who didn't go to college — what matters is that you're analytical and get results.

job.title: Head of Social, Vulture
job.description:
THE ROLE

Social media is a linchpin of Vulture’s editorial operation — it’s an essential component of everything we produce and the businesses that support those efforts. We’re looking for a Head of Social to oversee that department. This person and their team will collaborate on all the work that Vulture produces and promotes, including articles, video, podcasts, games, and live events. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and lover of culture who is as comfortable in a creative brainstorming session as they are poring over editorial analytics. job.description:

Vox Media is looking for a Motion Design Lead, who is both a highly-skilled motion designer and an experienced leader, responsible for conceptualizing and executing motion designs across platforms to create industry-leading branded content for New York Magazine and Vox. The Motion Design Lead is a “player/coach” and has extensive experience creating story-driven content for digital platforms, as well as providing motion design leadership. This role is accountable to the art director and creative director on a project level, and the Head of Branded Content at a high level.

  • Develop and maintain brand guidelines for motion and animation, ensuring Vox Media’s visual voice and aesthetic stay consistent and elevated across every deliverable

job.title: Network & Systems Engineer
job.description:
THE ROLE

Vox Media is looking for a Network & Systems Engineer to own the design, operation, and evolution of our enterprise office network, studios, and production facilities. This is a hands-on engineering role on a small, high-trust infrastructure team — you will be the person who owns the network end to end.

You will be a primary technical owner of our enterprise network environment, with particular responsibility for our current Juniper infrastructure with Cato Networks providing SASE/SD-WAN and secure remote access. Because we operate as a lean infrastructure team, we're looking for someone who is comfortable working beyond traditional networking boundaries. 

The right person will be equally comfortable troubleshooting a complex routing or switching issue, planning a network migration, supporting server or cloud infrastructure, and partnering with Media & Production Technology, Service Desk, and other technical teams to solve cross-functional problems.

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This role is located in our New York City office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Network & Systems Engineer on a lean infrastructure team, you'll own networking end to end while contributing across systems, cloud, and identity infrastructure when needed. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Vox Media's enterprise network across offices, data centers, cloud environments, and remote connectivity
  • Serve as the senior technical resource for our Juniper networking environment, including configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management
  • Administer our Cato Networks SASE platform, including SD-WAN connectivity, secure remote access, and associated security policy
  • Help define the future direction of Vox Media's network architecture, including evaluating and potentially migrating infrastructure to platforms such as Cisco and Meraki
  • Design and support LAN, WAN, wireless, and internet connectivity across multiple locations
  • Configure and manage VLANs, routing, switching, STP, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and related network services, supporting routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF where applicable
  • Troubleshoot complex Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues, including packet-level analysis and root-cause investigation of difficult network and application connectivity problems
  • Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and reliability, and proactively address emerging issues
  • Plan and execute network hardware upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and office infrastructure projects — including studio, conference room, and event connectivity — while minimizing business disruption
  • Manage ISP, circuit, and network hardware vendor relationships, including escalations, renewals, and capacity planning
  • Support and troubleshoot server, virtualization, cloud, identity, and enterprise infrastructure, assisting with systems administration across environments such as AWS, VMware, and Windows and/or Linux
  • Support enterprise identity and authentication technologies such as SSO and identity providers, and partner with IT operations on endpoint management (Mac and Windows MDM) and SaaS platform administration
  • Help administer monitoring, logging, configuration management, backup, and infrastructure management platforms
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for infrastructure incidents and perform root-cause analysis across networking, systems, and cloud environments
  • Develop repeatable processes and automation — using scripting, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code tools — that reduce manual administration and improve reliability
  • Assist with hands-on service desk support as needed, particularly for onsite requirements, including hardware and software troubleshooting, employee onboarding/offboarding, and resolution of support tickets to maintain operational continuity.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in network engineering and infrastructure engineering
  • Strong hands-on production experience with Juniper networking technologies and Junos
  • Relevant networking certifications such as JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP, CCNA, or CCNP
  • Hands-on production experience with Cisco and/or Meraki, and the judgment to evaluate platforms on technical merit rather than familiarity
  • Deep understanding of enterprise TCP/IP networking, including designing, configuring, and troubleshooting Layer 2/Layer 3 switching, routing, wireless, and network connectivity
  • Systematic troubleshooting skills, including diagnosing complex network and application connectivity problems using monitoring, logging, packet capture, and performance-analysis tools
  • Experience planning and executing network upgrades or migrations with minimal business disruption
  • AWS networking experience, including VPCs, routing, VPNs, and cloud connectivity
  • Systems administration or broader infrastructure engineering experience alongside networking
  • Ability to independently own technical projects from design through implementation and ongoing operations, with the documentation and communication skills to bring others along
  • Ability to work onsite up to 5 days per week in Lower Manhattan(Financial District) and to be onsite for after-hours escalations and scheduled maintenance windows

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SASE/SSE platforms such as Cato Networks, Zscaler, or Palo Alto Prisma Access
  • Experience migrating between networking vendors or architectures
  • Experience with Juniper Mist
  • Enterprise wireless design and troubleshooting experience
  • Experience with firewall and network-security platforms
  • Experience with VMware or other virtualization platforms
  • Infrastructure automation with Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar
  • Familiarity with identity platforms such as Okta and enterprise SaaS infrastructure
  • Media, broadcast, or production environment experience

job.title: Senior Editor, Vox
job.description:
Vox is seeking an experienced editor to help oversee its distinctive coverage of policy in a changing America. This editor will lead a team of multiplatform journalists who explore and explain the world of policy and ideas for Vox’s wide-ranging and curious audience, in a variety of formats including text, podcasts, and video. 

Vox’s coverage is dedicated to original reporting and analysis on issues, personalities, and movements that help people truly understand what’s at stake. We cover policy with a strong grounding in the news, but an eye toward the future and delivering smart solutions.

We’re looking for a dynamic, creative team member who can help Vox grow and adapt in a fast-changing political news landscape – and a pivotal moment in the national conversation. The editor should be eager to manage Vox’s coverage with urgency and ambition. They should also be highly collaborative and excited to work across Vox’s multimedia newsroom, finding creative ways for journalists to contribute to Vox’s signature podcast and video franchises, as well as its growing portfolio of newsletters. 

We’re looking for a leader who closely tracks the news, staying on top of major storylines and nimbly finding ways for Vox to offer distinctive coverage in a busy space. This editor should be able to find smart, original ways into major storylines — and guide reporters to uncovering fresh issues to bring to public attention. They should have a gift for finding points of intersection between American political currents and big-picture areas like technology, religion, and social policy. 

The ideal candidate should have a clear track record of managing journalists to deliver sharp, original angles that cut through the conversation, publishing original pieces on crisp deadlines, while also creating space for longer, more ambitious articles that help shape the public conversation. This position will be based in Washington, D.C. or New York, and report to the executive editor. 

This is a permanent, full-time position. This job is benefits-eligible. We pride ourselves in providing comprehensive benefits to support all of our employees wherever they are in life.

This is a hybrid position based in the Washington, D.C. or New York office, and reports to the executive editor. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage and lead a team of 4-5 reporters to conceive, assign, and edit pieces rooted in reporting and research. These include both fast analysis off the news and longer-horizon features — all driven by Vox’s commitment to explanation, solutions, new ideas, and improving people’s’ lives.
  • Guide Vox’s coverage of big policy topics with a clear hand and vision, staying on top of the news to find fresh angles
  • Collaborate closely with Vox’s editorial director for politics, as well as other Vox editors across multiple platforms, to deliver a rich and compelling political report.
  • Shape stories and broader coverage plans to ensure they are rigorous, compelling, and aligned with Vox’s editorial strategy and audience goals. You should be able to spot when a piece needs a sharper argument, a stronger evidence base, or a fundamentally different frame. You should also be able to see how each beat fits into Vox’s overall coverage, and identify ways to collaborate, prevent overlap, and build on our strengths.
  • Collaborate with other teams across the newsroom to help develop and sharpen your reporters’ stories in other platforms, including audio, video, and social video.
  • Work closely with colleagues in policy and politics, the executive editor, and the managing editor for audience and membership to ensure our editorial approach connects to Vox’s broader strategy in the membership era.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5 years’ experience editing
  • While experience with audio and video production is not necessary, the candidate should have an understanding of the politics and policy podcast and video landscape
  • Strong leadership, management, communication, and editing skills
  • Excellent news judgment and a demonstrated ability to bring analysis and sharp angles to news stories
  • Analytical rigor. We want an editor with the ability to pressure-test arguments and take opposing ones seriously. We want an editor who can confidently edit pieces that explain ideas and/or stake out intellectual claims, and who is eager to assign and edit pieces that embrace nuance and complicate narratives without sacrificing clarity. 
  • Passion for Vox’s mission of serving the audience and making complex concepts accessible through explanatory journalism

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer, and close — for a portfolio of roles spanning editorial, podcast/audio, revenue, and operations functions.
  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to scope open roles, build hiring plans, and act as a strategic advisor throughout the search.
  • Build and maintain proactive, representative talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and passive-candidate outreach, rather than relying solely on inbound applications.

As a Podcast Video & Social Producer you will be responsible for creating video and social content for our digital platforms. This will range from producing long-form video interviews to short-form social media video clips. You will work closely with the podcast producers and the podcast marketing team to reflect Criminal Productions’ voice, spirit, and brand.

job.title: Senior Financial Accountant
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s Finance Department is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to join our Financial Accounting and Reporting team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the integrity of financial data that enables our leaders to make informed, strategic decisions. You will thrive here if you are adaptable to evolving business priorities, curious about the bigger picture, and eager to apply your accounting expertise to enhance processes and deliver high-quality results.
 

What Motivates You

  • You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality financial information that supports strategic decision-making.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and maintain efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

  • You adapt quickly to shifting priorities and balance speed with precision in your daily work.

  • You enjoy applying your technical accounting knowledge to complex scenarios, researching new guidance, and finding practical solutions.

  • You are energized by opportunities to improve processes, introduce automation, and drive innovation.

  • You appreciate working independently while providing timely updates, managing competing priorities, and collaborating with stakeholders across the organization.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Execute general ledger accounting functions, including journal entries, month-end and year-end close activities, and preparation of accurate financial statements.

  • Conduct detailed variance analyses for income statement and balance sheet accounts, identifying trends and insights for leadership.

  • Interpret and apply GAAP accounting standards in collaboration with Financial Accounting management, ensuring compliance and accuracy.

  • Develop and maintain clear, up-to-date process documentation for accounting procedures, outlining both task execution and business purpose.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, recommend innovative process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and utilize tools to build automations for your areas of responsibility.

  • Prepare documentation for annual financial statements, tax and compliance filings, and audit requirements.

  • Support interim and year-end audit cycles by providing timely, accurate data to internal and external auditors.

  • Lead or contribute to special projects, analyses, and ad hoc reporting requests.

  • Deliver excellent service to internal and external stakeholders, fostering collaborative relationships across departments.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.

  • At least 3 years of progressive experience in accounting or auditing.

  • Proven expertise in general ledger operations and financial reporting.

  • Proficient with data analytics platforms and data visualization tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI)

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, Power Pivot).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to prepare, present, and collaborate effectively.

  • Ability to prepare and analyze complex financial statements.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills with attention to detail and follow-through.

  • Strong time management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CA designation or CPA candidate.

  • Experience with Oracle, Hyperion Smartview, BlackLine, Salesforce, Bloomberg Tax and Accounting Fixed Assets, LeaseQuery, SAP, and Asana.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

job.title: VP, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The VP, Creative Membership is responsible for championing, supporting and advocating on behalf of ASCAP’s diverse community of creators in the West Coast market. They will serve as a key point of contact for high profile members, developing member outreach initiatives, recruiting and retaining West Coast creative talent, and building and maintaining a deep network of relationships across labels, publishers, lawyers, managers and other industry stakeholders in order to increase value of the ASCAP repertory. The West Coast Membership department is directly responsible for outreach to some of ASCAP’s most prominent and successful West Coast -based members.

This position is based in our Los Angeles office and will report to the EVP, Head of Creative Membership located in the New York office. This position is subject to ASCAP’s in-office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Establish, cultivate, and maintain deep, trusted relationships with our diverse community of songwriters, composers and producers in the West Coast market to protect, strengthen, and grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Serve as the primary ASCAP point of contact for assigned high-profile creator members and their key representatives, providing high-touch service and resolving complex membership, catalog and distribution inquiries with diplomacy.
  • Proactively escalate highly sensitive or complex issues to the relevant internal subject matter experts and ASCAP executive leadership to ensure swift, white-glove resolution.
  • Act as a brand ambassador and strategic voice for ASCAP at industry panels, conferences, award shows, and high-profile events to drive market awareness of ASCAP’s creator-first mission and value proposition.
  • Foster relationships between ASCAP members and the broader music ecosystem by maintaining relationships with publishers, artists, record labels, licensees, lawyers, managers, agents and trade organizations.
  • Partner with the Marketing & Communications team to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Develop a deep, authoritative understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership- and distribution-related inquiries.
  • Translate market analysis and industry trends into visually engaging and compelling presentations (including advanced PowerPoint collateral), with the versatility to confidently pitch, present, and align both small, high-profile talent teams and large organizational audiences around the ASCAP value proposition.
  • Analyze critical market share data and deliver strategic recommendations to key internal stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Provide strategic leadership, coaching, and career development for direct reports; and oversee, inspire, and manage the day-to-day operations of the Membership team in the West Coast office.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal departments to continually expand and refine ASCAP services, including career development, member benefits, education, and advocacy programs.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field. MBA or JD preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive, leadership-level experience in the music industry.
  • A deep, well-established network of high-level relationships spanning licensing, songwriting, music publishing, and record labels specifically within the West Coast market and broader music industry.
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing diverse teams of direct reports at varying career stages.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate highly autonomously, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with exceptional clarity and diplomacy with ASCAP executive leadership.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, with a proven track record of designing highly influential, executive-level PowerPoint presentations that distill complex strategies into compelling visual narratives for senior leadership.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, with an ability to evaluate complex market trends, track competitor landscapes, and translate raw data into actionable strategic insights.
  • A discerning instinct for songwriter and composer talent (an “ear” for music) and a proven track record of identifying, onboarding, and nurturing high-potential creators toward long-term career success.
  • Excellent organizational, and time-management skills, with a track record of delivering flawless executive-level work under tight deadlines and during high-volume periods.
  • Ability and willingness to attend Nashville and other music industry events, including on the weekends and in the evenings, with ability to travel for meetings and events as needed.
  • Comprehensive understanding of music publishing, copyright law, and performance rights dynamics on a global scale.
  • A passionate, authentic advocate for ASCAP’s core values, including transparency, fairness, a future-forward outlook, and putting creators first.
  • Ability to comply with ASCAP’s current in-office policy (subject to change).

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $180,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

Please be aware that ASCAP is not a nut-free or other allergen-free workplace.

ASCAP is an equal opportunity employer. All ASCAP employment decisions are made on the basis of individual qualifications and performance and not on the basis of race, national origin, ethnicity, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, genetic information, disability, handicap, color, creed, religion, veteran status, or any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

job.title: Analyst, Marketing Financial Planning
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and music-passionate Analyst to join our centralized finance team supporting the Sony Music US Front Line Label Group, which includes Columbia Records, RCA Records, Epic Records, Arista Records, Sony Music Nashville, Provident Entertainment, and Ultra Records.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Marketing Financial Planning, this position will support the planning, tracking, and analysis of marketing expenses across artist campaigns for assigned labels. The Analyst will work closely with finance, marketing, and media teams to help maintain accurate budgets, process purchase orders, reconcile expenses, and provide visibility into campaign spending. The ideal candidate is organized, curious, comfortable working with financial data, and able to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative environment.

What you'll do:

  • Budgeting and Forecasting: Assist with maintaining artist marketing budgets that support release strategies and commercial plans. Update marketing budgets in the company’s planning system and help ensure information remains accurate as campaign plans change. Support the monthly forecast process by gathering campaign updates and entering revised spending assumptions.
  • Purchase Order Administration: Coordinate with label teams to create and submit marketing-related purchase orders in line with approved campaign budgets and internal requirements. Work with Accounts Payable and label partners to research discrepancies and support timely vendor payments.
  • Expense Reconciliation and Analysis: Complete monthly and quarterly reconciliations of marketing expenses. Support the preparation of accruals and journal entries. Review spending activity, identify potential variances, and share findings with the manager. Assist with reviewing marketing recoupment calculations and tracking third-party sponsorships, invoices, and payments.
  • Financial Reporting and Spend Visibility: Maintain marketing expense reports and dashboards that provide visibility into actual spending and remaining budgets by artist, project, and campaign. Assist with tracking contractual marketing commitments across artists, projects, spending categories, and release phases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with marketing, media, promotion, and finance teams across assigned labels to gather information and resolve questions. Participate in marketing financial planning meetings and provide updates on budgets, spending, and purchase orders.
  • Compliance and Process Support: Help ensure marketing expenses are supported by the appropriate documentation and follow company finance policies, approval requirements, and established controls. Assist with audit requests and support updates to budgeting, reporting, and purchase order processes.
  • Special Projects: Assist with campaign analyses, vendor comparisons, label-wide marketing expense reviews, and other projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • You have up to two years of experience in accounting, financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, or a related area. Internship or entry-level experience in music, entertainment, or media is a plus.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and are comfortable learning new systems and applications.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, Tableau, or other financial reporting tools is a plus, but not required.
  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and accuracy.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally and are comfortable working with colleagues across different teams and levels.
  • You are organized, able to manage multiple assignments, and comfortable adjusting to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • You are collaborative, curious, and willing to ask questions and learn.
  • You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and raise issues when additional guidance is needed.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Vous intégrerez notre équipe International Product, responsable de l'expérience client dans les nombreux pays où Amazon Music est présent. Vous contribuerez à améliorer le quotidien de nos clients francophones et à définir les exigences linguistiques pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités d'Amazon Music qui améliorent leur expérience musicale. Vos missions consisteront notamment à analyser et résoudre les problèmes rencontrés par les clients, à identifier les lacunes de l'expérience client (CX) via des audits de parcours et des workshops, à fournir un support produit et créer des rapports personnalisés pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, ainsi qu'à accompagner nos équipes mondiales Produit et QA (Assurance Qualité) pour tester l'expérience locale des nouvelles fonctionnalités. Nous recherchons une personne à l'aise avec les données et les produits technologiques pour prendre des décisions et proposer des améliorations de l'expérience client, et qui s'épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.

English:
Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music ad-free in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

We are looking for a Program Manager with native / C2 level proficiency in French. You will be part of our International Product Team that owns the customer experience in our vast number of Amazon Music supported countries around the world. You will help us improve the day-to-day experience of our French speaking customers and define language-specific requirements for new Amazon Music features that make it easier for customers to fall in love with music. Your focus will be to analyze and fix current customer issues, identify CX gaps by conducting walk-the-store and workshops, provide product support to and create customized reports for internal and external stakeholders, and support our global Product and QA teams to test the local experience of brand-new features. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working with data and technology products in order to make decisions and suggest improvements to the CX, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
Français:
- Connaissance client : Vous adorez vous mettre à la place des clients, et êtes curieux(se) d'explorer les différentes manières dont ils consomment la musique. Vous tirez des enseignements des retours clients, des données d'utilisation et d'études externes, et alimentez la réflexion de nos chefs de produit grâce à des analyses ponctuelles ou des rapports hebdomadaires/mensuels sur l’expérience client.

- Gestion des problèmes : Vous gérez simultanément de nombreuses demandes ponctuelles, tout en priorisant et en résolvant les lacunes de l'expérience client, qu'elles soient internes ou externes. Vous simplifiez des problèmes complexes, produisez des rapports personnalisés grâce à votre capacité à analyser les données, et communiquez efficacement avec les chefs de produit ainsi qu'avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

- Soutien au lancement de fonctionnalités : Vous incarnez la voix locale du client pour les nouvelles expériences Amazon Music. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes mondiales d'assurance qualité (QA) pour comprendre et vérifier l'expérience client locale. Vous communiquez vos conclusions de manière précise et orientée vers les solutions, tout en sachant trouver le juste équilibre entre rapidité d'exécution et obsession du client.

- Soutien éditorial : Vous travaillez avec les équipes éditoriales, de programmation de contenu et de relations avec les labels pour garantir une expérience produit optimale lors de nos campagnes marketing et artistiques. Vous conseillez sur l'expérience visée, puis définissez et mettez en œuvre des solutions créatives pour ravir nos clients.

- Benchmarking : Vous êtes l'expert(e) concernant l'expérience client du streaming musical local. Vous comparez notre produit à ceux d'autres fournisseurs internes et externes, et utilisez vos conclusions pour formuler des recommandations à nos chefs de produit.
- Gestion des parties prenantes: Vous collaborez avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs clés, notamment les chefs de produit locaux et mondiaux, le service client, les ingénieurs QA, le marketing, la programmation de contenu et les équipes chargées des relations
avec les artistes et les labels.
- Gestion des processus : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres chefs de programme et membres de l'équipe à l'élaboration de protocoles et de processus pour les mécanismes existants et futurs. Vous évaluez en permanence les outils et processus de collecte de données et proposez des solutions pour garantir leur efficacité, leur qualité et leur évolutivité.

- Adoption de l'IA : Vous identifiez des opportunités d'utiliser des outils d'IA pour optimiser et automatiser des processus tels que l'analyse de l'expérience client, le reporting et le tri des problèmes, réduisant ainsi la charge de travail manuel tout en étendant la couverture géographique. Vous restez à l'affût des capacités émergentes de l'IA et formulez des recommandations concrètes pour améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe grâce à ces technologies.

English
- Customer Insights: You live and breathe customer insights, and are curious to explore the differences in how customers consume music. You derive insights from customer feedback, usage data, and external research, and provide input to our product managers through ad-hoc analyses or weekly/monthly CX reporting.

- Issue Management: You manage numerous ad hoc requests concurrently, and prioritize and resolve internal and external customer experience gaps. You simplify complex issues, provide customized reporting with the ability to understand and analyze data, and effectively communicate to product managers, internal and external stakeholders.

- Feature Launch Support: You are the local voice of the customer for new Amazon Music experiences. You work closely with global QA to understand and verify the local CX. You communicate findings in a precise and solution oriented manner and are able to walk the fine line between speed and customer obsession.

- Editorial support: You work with editorial, content programming and label relations to enable a great product CX for our artist and marketing campaigns. You consult on the desired experience, and define and execute creative solutions to delight our customers. Benchmarking: You are the subject matter expert for the local music streaming CX. You benchmark our product against other internal and external providers, and use your findings to make recommendations to our product managers.

- Stakeholder Management: You work with a broad set of key stakeholders including local and global product managers, customer service, quality assurance engineers, marketing, content programming and artist/label relations.

- Process Management: You partner closely with other Program Managers and team members on protocol/process development for existing and future mechanisms. You continuously evaluate data collection tools and processes and offer solutions to ensure they are efficient, high quality and scalable.

- AI Adoption: You identify opportunities to apply AI tools and automation to streamline processes such as CX analysis, reporting, and issue triage — reducing manual effort while scaling coverage across territories. You stay curious about emerging AI capabilities and bring practical recommendations for where they can improve team efficiency.

- Expérience en gestion de programmes ou de projets / Experience in program or project management
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) au niveau C2 ou supérieur / Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C2 level or above
- Expérience dans la facilitation de la collaboration interne entre différentes équipes / Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

- Connaissance d’outils d'IA généralistes / Knowledge of general AI tools
- Expérience dans des tâches ou projets analytiques impliquant le traitement de données / Experience in analytical tasks or projects, working with data

- Capacité avérée à travailler en autonomie au sein d'une équipe répartie géographiquement, en collaborant efficacement avec des parties prenantes situées sur différents sites et fuseaux horaires / Demonstrated ability to work autonomously within a distributed team, collaborating effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Data Strategy & Operations leads the data function within PBS Business Intelligence, owning how PBS collects, governs, and delivers audience and content performance data. The role directs Nielsen Operations, digital analytics implementation, and the Domo business intelligence platform, ensuring that internal stakeholders, member stations, and producers work from data that is accurate, consistent, and available when they need it. The Sr. Director is the technical counterpart to the Senior Director, Audience Insights & Analytics, and represents Business Intelligence in enterprise-wide data initiatives.

Ensure data collection and use meet privacy obligations, including regulations governing consumer data and data about children and families. Represent Business Intelligence in enterprise data initiatives, translating business needs into technical requirements with PBS technology teams. The Manager, Audience Insights is a research generalist supporting PBS’s general audience content and marketing teams. The role conducts primary research — qualitative and quantitative — into attitudes toward public television, motivations to donate, and perceptions of the PBS brand, and pairs that work with analysis of Nielsen, Google Analytics, and syndicated sources to build a complete picture of audience behavior across platforms. job.title: Client Systems Specialist
job.description:
The Client Systems Specialist’s primary responsibility is to provide responsive customer service, technical support, and troubleshooting for approximately 100 AccuWeather TV customers. This role supports the department’s 24/7 customer service coverage, helping customers maintain reliable operation of their AccuWeather software, hardware, and data services. The position requires proactive customer communication, advanced troubleshooting, and coordination with internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Occasional travel is required for product demonstrations, system installations, customer training, and trade shows. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Serve as a primary technical support resource for AccuWeather TV customers, providing timely, professional assistance by phone, email, and remote support.
• Participate in the department’s 24/7 support coverage and assigned on-call schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Monitor customer support calls, emails, and requests; prioritize issues based on urgency, impact on customer operations, and departmental guidelines.
• Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, system configuration, and data issues, with particular attention to problems affecting on-air operations.
• Take ownership of assigned support issues from initial response through resolution, keeping customers informed of progress and next steps.
• Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions to support consistent service and knowledge sharing.
• Escalate complex or unresolved issues to management and developers, providing clear details to support timely resolution.
• Communicate with sales and account management teams about ongoing customer issues, support needs, and customer satisfaction.
• Provide proactive customer guidance to help prevent recurring problems and improve system reliability.
• Maintain proficiency and required certifications on all AccuWeather TV graphics systems.
• Maintain a working understanding of AccuWeather and other meteorological data to effectively support customers and meteorologists.
• Test new software versions using current customer configurations and coordinate customer upgrades following release.
• Provide remote customer training on system operation, new features, and troubleshooting procedures.
• Occasionally travel to customer sites to install and configure systems, verify proper operation, and provide training.
• Support sales efforts by demonstrating AccuWeather TV products remotely and, as needed, at customer sites and trade shows.
• Identify customer needs for upgrades, additional systems, or training, and communicate those opportunities to the appropriate sales or account management team.
• Provide technical training, guidance, and mentorship to new staff and sales team members.
• Coordinate support coverage with the team during travel and other scheduled activities.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS
• At least one year of professional experience supporting PC or Mac computers, software, or hardware required. Relevant education or extensive technical training may be considered in place of employment experience.
• Strong customer service skills, including the ability to remain calm, responsive, and professional when customers experience urgent technical issues.
• Ability to troubleshoot software and hardware problems, prioritize competing requests, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Ability to read and interpret instructions, technical documentation, procedural and policy manuals, and customer communications.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues, coordinating follow-up, and maintaining customer records.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating with support staff, sales, management, and developers.
• Availability to participate in assigned 24/7 on-call coverage, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for demonstrations, installations, training, and trade shows.
• Experience with broadcast systems, graphics systems, or meteorological data preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. The position requires extended periods of work at a computer workstation using a keyboard and mouse, as well as frequent communication by phone and video conference. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds during installations, demonstrations, or training. Specific vision abilities include color vision, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. Work is primarily performed in an office or remote support setting, with occasional work at customer stations and trade shows. The role includes responding to time-sensitive technical issues in a live broadcast environment and providing support outside regular business hours as part of the department’s assigned coverage schedule.

job.title: Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications
job.description:
AccuWeather is seeking a highly creative, curious, and deeply collaborative Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications, to work directly with AccuWeather forecasters and the Writing Committee to further elevate the detail, clarity, precision, and distinctiveness of the language used to describe forecasts for our users. This role is designed for a graduate student or an individual with equivalent writing experience who brings fresh thinking about how complex weather information can be expressed in ways that are more detailed, precise, clear, engaging, and scientifically sound.

Embedded closely with Forecast Operations, this position will learn from meteorologists, participate in the forecast-writing process, and help develop new approaches, terminology, and descriptive frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more informative and better than what is available from any other source. The emphasis is on improving the consumer forecast experience - not traditional public relations - by helping forecasters communicate what the weather will be, what the impact will be, how it will evolve, what it may look like, and what details matter most to people making decisions. This includes a laser focus on developing stronger displays, greater artistry, and more effective visual communications that amplify the advantages of AccuWeather forecasts and content.

The Digital Content & Engagement Intern – Forecasting and Communications will serve as a bridge between meteorological expertise and exceptional consumer-facing writing, helping AccuWeather deliver forecast descriptions with greater depth, nuance, consistency, and usefulness while preserving the scientific accuracy and authority at the core of the AccuWeather brand.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Forecast Language, Detail & Description:

  • Work side-by-side with forecasters to craft and refine accurate, detailed, consumer-focused descriptions of daily weather, changing conditions, major storms, seasonal patterns, and forecast developments.
    • Elevate forecast language beyond basic conditions by identifying the most useful details, nuances, timing, impacts, transitions, and sensory descriptions that help users better understand what to expect. Use bold, catchy and descriptive language.
    • Translate complex meteorological concepts into clearer, more detailed, consumer-friendly language without sacrificing scientific meaning, accuracy, or appropriate expressions of forecast confidence.
    • Develop new descriptive approaches, vocabulary, sentence structures, and frameworks that make AccuWeather forecasts more distinctive, informative, and useful than competing forecast experiences.
    • Help establish consistent terminology for recurring weather patterns while preserving enough flexibility for forecasters to communicate the unique character and details of each forecast.

 

Forecaster & Writing Committee Collaboration:

  • Embed with AccuWeather forecasters to understand how forecasts are created, where language choices can add value, and how writing can better communicate meteorological insight to users.
    • Work closely with the AccuWeather Writing Committee to test, evaluate, and introduce new approaches to forecast writing and description.
    • Bring an outside writing perspective to established forecast workflows, asking thoughtful questions and proposing new ways of thinking, writing, and working.
  • Challenge conventional approaches to forecast description and explore new ways to communicate weather that provide users with greater detail, context, understanding, and value.
    • Gather feedback from meteorologists and other stakeholders, iterate on language, and help turn successful approaches into practical writing guidance and repeatable standards.
    • Support a collaborative environment in which meteorological expertise and strong writing work together to create a richer forecast experience.

 

Consumer Forecast Experience & Innovation:

  • Review forecast descriptions across AccuWeather consumer experiences and identify opportunities to add specificity, context, clarity, and useful detail.
    • Develop and test language that helps users better understand the timing, intensity, duration, variability, uncertainty, and real-world impacts of weather events.

job.description:
