Job Summary: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Product Management is responsible for driving the overall user experience, feature strategies and concepts, and engagement paradigms for Disney Entertainment & ESPN's global portfolio of consumer-facing streaming and digital products – including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars. About the Role At The Walt Disney Company, we believe in the power of storytelling to inform, connect, and inspire. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager II to lead the evolution of the Media Platform within the ABC News CMS, which powers content creation and publishing to ABC News websites, mobile apps, and digital platforms. In this role, you will own the media platform end-to-end - including asset models, ingestion pipelines, AI integrations and metadata systems - and shape how editors create, manage and publish media within the CMS, ensuring workflows are intuitive, scalable, and tightly integrated across authoring and downstream experiences. This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives in complex, technical environments and brings strong product judgment to ambiguous problems - translating cross-system complexity into clear, scalable solutions and driving alignment across teams to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes. Responsibilities Strategy & Vision Define and drive a clear product strategy for media capabilities within the ABC News CMS that support digital publishing across web and mobile experiences. Establish success metrics that reflect editorial efficiency, system performance and reliability. Own the long-term strategy for ABC News media platform evolution, including integration of future capabilities such as video authoring, platform consolidation and AI workflow optimizations. Set cross-domain strategy for media capabilities, ensuring alignment across authoring, media, and curation workflows. Media Platform Leadership Define the media object model - structure, metadata, and lifecycle - for video and image assets used in digital publishing. Own the experience of media workflows within the ABC News CMS, including how editors upload, manage, and edit media metadata, ensuring workflows are intuitive, efficient, and aligned to editorial needs. Drive convergence of fragmented workflows into a unified, platform-driven approach. Cross-Functional Collaboration Deliver end-to-end media capabilities in partnership with engineering, design, and editorial teams. Drive integration of media workflows across authoring and curation domains in partnership with product leads. Build alignment across stakeholders, ensuring shared understanding of goals, priorities, and outcomes. Execution & Delivery Translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and deliver in iterative, measurable phases. Lead complex, cross-system initiatives such as media migration and workflow consolidation. Launch products with strong coordination, clear communication, and a focus on impact. Audience-Centered Product Development Reduce friction in editorial workflows, enabling users to spend more time focused on journalism and less on technical processes. Partner closely with design and authoring product leads to improve the CMS experience for publishing and managing media, including metadata editing and asset management workflows. Balance editorial needs with technical feasibility and long-term platform scalability. Stakeholder Leadership Build strong, trusted relationships across product, engineering, editorial, and business teams. Communicate product strategy, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership. Act as a platform leader, ensuring the broader ecosystem evolves in a cohesive and scalable way. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in content platforms or media technology. Experience building and scaling platform products, such as content management systems, asset management systems, or enterprise products. Proven ability to define product vision and align cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and editorial stakeholders. Experience delivering complex products with measurable impact on performance, scalability, or workflow efficiency. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort using both qualitative insights and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ideas to diverse audiences. Technical fluency and experience working closely with engineering teams in agile environments. Experience navigating ambiguity and making high-impact tradeoffs across multiple product domains. A user-focused mindset with a passion for enabling high-quality content creation and publishing experiences. Bachelor’s degree required #DISNEYTECH The hiring range for this position in New York City, NY is $165,600.00 - $222,000.00 per year and in Glendale, CA is $158,100.00 - $211,900.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: General Counsel - ESPN
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs General Counsel - ESPN Job ID 10163073 Location Bristol, Connecticut, United States / New York, New York, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Oct. 16, 2026 General Counsel - ESPN Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements The General Counsel role has overall responsibility for legal matters affecting ESPN as part of The Walt Disney Company. Reporting to the Chief Legal and Global Affairs Officer of The Walt Disney Company, this position leads the legal support for the ESPN and Sports Content group, which acquires, produces, and distributes ESPN’s live sports programming, sports news, and original and non-scripted sports content across The Walt Disney Company’s direct-to-consumer and linear channels, including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN’s streaming services, and ABC. This individual sits on the ESPN senior leadership team, providing advice directly to ESPN’s Chairman and other senior executives. The General Counsel supports ESPN’s sports rights negotiations and works closely with other parts of Legal & Global Affairs (LGA), orchestrating the delivery of legal services from across LGA with a One Disney mindset. This role is based in either Bristol, CT or New York, NY with a four-day in-office expectation. Responsibilities: Quickly and accurately identify and evaluate legal risks in a complex, fast-moving media and sports business environment and provide expert and strategic legal advice to business unit leaders. Anticipate issues and proactively develop creative, business-oriented and brand-consistent solutions to mitigate legal risks across a wide range of practice areas, including intellectual property, rights acquisitions, multi-platform content distribution, newsgathering, advertising and marketing, digital and social media, talent and labor matters, antitrust, sports betting and gaming, college sports and athlete name, image, and likeness matters, legal compliance, government relations, and corporate governance. Support ESPN’s sports rights negotiations, providing legal leadership on deal strategy, structure, risk allocation, and documentation. Orchestrate the delivery of legal services with a One Disney mindset, drawing on the ESPN legal team and shared services elsewhere in LGA to ensure responsiveness and efficiency while maintaining quality. Attract, develop, mentor, and motivate the ESPN legal team, upholding integrity, sound judgment, innovation and collaboration while investing in the training and support the team needs as its operating model evolves. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and the legal team, including senior executive business leaders, legal leaders, and external parties (e.g., regulators, rights holders, external counsel, partners). Keep abreast of relevant legislative and regulatory changes, including those affecting media, sports rights, and content distribution. Basic Qualifications: Minimum of 15 years of legal experience, including significant in-house leadership experience in a global media, entertainment, or sports business, leading and overseeing business legal advisors in multiple disciplines. Exceptional business acumen and sound legal judgment, with the ability to evaluate and advise business units on risk and develop creative, business-oriented solutions in a fast-paced, consumer-facing media environment. Broad experience across the practice areas described above, including intellectual property, rights acquisitions and licensing, content distribution, employment and labor, litigation, and legal compliance. Experience supporting or leading the negotiation of complex sports or media rights agreements. Proven leader of a multidisciplinary legal team at scale, with demonstrable expertise in organizational design and change management. Direct experience leading the evolution of a legal operating model — including deployment of legal technology tools, alternative legal service provider relationships, shared services models, and in-sourcing/out-sourcing decisions — to drive efficiency and fiscal accountability. Comfort making rigorous, data-driven resource allocation decisions and communicating them with transparency and care. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate across legal teams, shared services, and business units with an enterprise, One Disney mindset. Ability to operate independently, escalating to senior leadership as appropriate. Law firm and budget management experience, with creative approaches to outside counsel spend and legal technology. Active license in good standing to practice law in a US jurisdiction and capable of meeting admission requirements in CT and NY. Job Summary: Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology On any given day at Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment & ESPN Technology Building the future of Disney’s media business: DE&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach & Scale: The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN+, and much more. Innovation: We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment & news. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment & ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. Job Summary: ESPN is investing in large‑scale data infrastructure and real‑time processing platforms that power next‑generation personalization and live sports experiences. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will focus on building and operating distributed data and ML infrastructure that supports high‑throughput, low‑latency data processing and real‑time ML use cases. In this role, you will work closely with senior MLEs, data engineers, platform/SRE, and product teams to develop streaming data pipelines, feature computation systems, and ML‑adjacent services that operate reliably at scale. The role emphasizes hands‑on engineering, strong fundamentals in distributed systems, and practical experience operating production data infrastructure. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: 1) Large-Scale Data Processing & Streaming Systems Build and maintain high‑throughput batch and streaming data pipelines to support ML, analytics, and real‑time decisioning use cases. Implement data ingestion, enrichment, aggregation, and transformation workflows using modern distributed data frameworks. Ensure pipelines meet latency, reliability, and data quality requirements for downstream ML and product teams. 2) Real‑Time Data & Feature Infrastructure Develop and operate systems that support real‑time feature computation and delivery for online ML services. Work with feature stores and event‑driven architectures to ensure consistency between offline and online data. Improve data freshness, schema evolution, and backward compatibility in streaming environments. 3) ML-Adjacent infrastructure & Platform Engineering Build and operate ML‑adjacent services such as inference inputs, feature APIs, and data access layers. Contribute to scalable service patterns including autoscaling, rollout strategies, and resiliency mechanisms. Partner with platform/SRE teams to improve system availability, performance, and cost efficiency. 4) Reliability, Observability & Operations Instrument data and ML infrastructure with metrics, logging, and alerting to support production operations. Participate in on‑call rotations and incident response for data and ML platforms. Identify and remediate data pipeline failures, performance regressions, and operational risks. 3) Collaboration & Engineering Execution Collaborate with applied ML and data science teams to enable production ML workflows through reliable data systems. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions. Follow established platform standards and contribute incremental improvements over time Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Basic Qualification: Experience building and operating large‑scale data or ML systems in production. Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and data processing architectures. Hands‑on experience with streaming and batch data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, Flink, or equivalent). Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Java, Scala, Go, or C++. Experience operating systems in cloud‑native environments (AWS, containers, Kubernetes, IaC tools). Familiarity with observability and operational best practices for production systems. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across engineering and data teams Preferred qualification: Experience supporting real‑time personalization, recommendation, or analytics systems. Familiarity with feature stores, event‑driven architectures, and real‑time ML pipelines. Exposure to ML infrastructure concepts such as inference pipelines, data validation, and model lifecycle tooling. Experience optimizing data systems for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency. Understanding of experimentation platforms and data instrumentation for online systems. Experience with: 5+ years of industry experience building data‑intensive or ML‑adjacent systems in production Required Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $150,900.00 - $202,400.00 per year, in Glendale, CA is $144,100.00 - $193,200.00 per year, and in San Francisco, CA $157,800.00 - $211,600.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Coloradoan Reporter
job.description:
The Coloradoan seeks a talented journalist capable of covering multiple topics on multiple mediums. We seek someone nimble enough to cover a court case in the morning and a wildfire in the afternoon. Someone who can independently dig in on a single topic, or lend a hand to a fellow reporter in a pinch. Strong video production skills are required for this position and familiarity with reporting on social platforms is desired.

As our audience develops and evolves we seek to meet them where they are at and where they consume their news, and a qualified candidate is someone who understands this and can demonstrate a track record of publishing news to a variety of platforms in a variety of formats. The Coloradoan values innovation and collaboration, and a good candidate will bring both to this role. When applying, please provide examples of your writing, photography, videography and any other applicable materials that demonstrate your ability to meet the demands of modern journalism.

This reporter will be a swift breaking news reporter and in tune with what’s trending each day, sometimes writing multiple times per day. This person will be expected to be among the newsroom’s top pageview producers. They will create quick videos for almost every story; sometimes producing video-only stories. This reporter will need to have the basic skills of a reporter, knowing how to access public records (such as police records and body cam and surveillance video), build sources, conduct interviews and find and read data.

Knowing and embracing Artificial Intelligence as a tool to improve their reporting duties is a must. They will be asked to localize national and state stories for our audience. They will be asked to work with other reporters and editors to create alternate URLS from existing stories. They will occasionally report in the field and will be a part of the newsroom’s coverage of big, breaking stories, such as wildfires, and tent-pole events. They will sometimes be asked to work weekends.

Responsibilities:

Write quickly and clearly, with voice.

Deliver news via stories, video, newsletters, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or any other methods available to reach our audience.

Use metrics to inform story choices and shape beat strategies. This includes being adept at SEO.

Identify top stories of the day based on analytics and audience potential.

Work with editors to experiment with new ways of informing and engaging audiences on social platforms and alternate story forms. This includes experimenting with long-tail (evergreen) content.

A self-starter who is eager to take the lead on new coverage areas, as well as ambitious projects to grow our brand.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Minimum of 2-3 years’ digital journalism experience, preferred.

Able to file quickly across platforms: mobile, desktop and social media.

Strong command of AP grammar and style.

Ability to produce content that is clean, accurate and "publication ready."

Passionate and enthusiastic about news and content that will work well with audiences on social platforms.

Comfortable in fluid, fast-breaking, stressful situations. Also comfortable using social media to enhance reporting and promote stories.

Understand reporting ethics and sourcing.

Excel in a fast-paced news environment and understands the digital first mission.

Collaborate well with others and can work with a team – including teammates and colleagues who are remote.

Open to off-typical schedules, including the possibility of early mornings, late nights and/or weekend work. Able to be flexible as needed.

Application InstructionsWe are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.

Links to 3-6 online samples of your work. Show us what you’ve produced or had a hand in that best reflects what you can do in your desired role.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

#Newsgnt

#LI-NC1

The hourly rate for this role will range between $25.00 and $32.00.  Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience.   Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

Position Title:

Android Senior Developer, OTT Team (French Services) (Telework/Hybrid)

Position Language Requirement:

Language Skills:

English (Reading - B - Intermediate), English (Speaking - B - Intermediate), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - C - Advanced)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-01 11:59 PM

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling, and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities  connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI Tou.TV.

 

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and/or modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms; such as the audio/video player.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum activities designed to review ongoing production projects in order to make necessary corrections and adjustments, or completed projects to measure their results.
  • Participate in the development of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Experience in developing complex and high-performance mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in Android Studio, Git, and the Kotlin language.
  • Experience in developing an application published on Google Play.
  • Experience in developing within code review context (pull request).
  • Knowledge of programming patterns (such as MVP or MVVM).
  • Knowledge of SOLID architecture principles is an asset.
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagram, etc.).
  • Interest in working on an application available on multiple form factors (mobile/tablet/TV).
  • Knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Exoplayer, Kotlin Multiplatform is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the libraries Dagger, Hilt, Koin is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Google architecture components is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Maven (including the design/maintenance of internal libraries) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written, mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with attractive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

Promotions Specialist (12 month contract position)

 

Come join the fun at Rogers, working to promote two of Calgary's best loved brands, STAR 95.9 and JACK 96.9! 

 

The Promotions Specialist plays a critical role in executing audience engagement initiatives that drive ratings growth, support revenue-generating opportunities, and enhance the listener experience across our radio brands. This role is responsible for the end-to-end coordination and execution of contests, promotions, ticket giveaways, and audience communications while ensuring all activities are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with company and regulatory requirements.

 

Working closely with Content Directors, Talent, Sales, and Go-To-Market teams, the Promotions Specialist helps bring station campaigns to life and supports key business objectives through exceptional organization, attention to detail, and project management.

 

Success in this role is demonstrated through the flawless execution of promotional campaigns, strong audience engagement, effective collaboration across teams, and the ability to deliver results that support both station and revenue objectives.

 

What you'll do: 

 

Contest & Promotion Execution

  • Support planning and lead execution for station and client-based paid and added-value contests.
  • Partner with sales team, content director, and/or promotions manager to support planning station-led events and participating in in-person promotional activities as needed to ensure strong execution and alignment with programming and market needs.
  • Develop and maintain contest rules and regulatory documentation.
  • Create and manage online contest pages.
  • Coordinate hero banner placement and promotional website assets.
  • Set up and manage Easy Promos on-air contesting mechanics.
  • Manage contest keywords and listener entry processes.
  • Coordinate national promotions, including flyaway contests and special events.
  • Lead prize fulfillment, winner verification, and distribution.

 

Audience Engagement & Communications

  • Create and schedule static social media posts supporting promotional campaigns.
  • Manage Seekr push notifications to drive audience engagement and contest participation.
  • Coordinate concert ticket requests, listener giveaways, and promotional ticketing initiatives.
  • Develop and deploy promotional email campaigns to subscriber databases.
  • Support station marketing initiatives that increase audience reach and listener engagement.

 

Creative & Asset Coordination

  • Submit and manage graphic design requests for contests and promotions.
  • Collaborate with internal creative teams to ensure campaign materials are produced on schedule and aligned with brand standards.
  • Ensure all promotional assets are accurate, approved, and delivered on time.

 

Project Management & Administration

  • Track all promotional projects, timelines, capacity planning, and vacation schedules within Monday.com.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and status updates.
  • Coordinate multiple campaigns simultaneously while meeting deadlines and ensuring operational excellence.
  • Monitor promotion execution to ensure compliance with station, company, and regulatory guidelines.

 

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with Content Directors, Talent, Sales, and Go-To-Market teams to support station objectives.
  • Participate in regular promotional planning meetings and cross-market collaboration sessions.
  • Share best practices and contribute to continuous improvement of promotional processes and audience experiences.

 

What you bring: 

  • Post-secondary education in Marketing, Communications, Broadcasting, Event Management, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in promotions, marketing, media, radio, events, or audience engagement.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with social media platforms, email marketing tools, and project management systems such as Monday.com.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work within established processes and deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

job.title: Promotions Assistant (part-time) – Cbus Media Group
job.description:
Promotions Assistant (Part-Time)

Cbus Media Group | Columbus, OH

You like being where the action is. You’re comfortable talking to anyone. You’d rather be out at an event than stuck behind a desk. If that sounds like you, we want to meet you.

Cbus Media Group is home to Qfm96, Sunny 95, Mix 107.9, and more. We’re part of Columbus every day on the air, online, and out in the community. Our Promotions team is the reason listeners get to meet us face to face, and we need another enthusiastic pair of hands.

What you’ll do

  • Help set up, run, and tear down station appearances, live broadcasts, and public events across Central Ohio.
  • Capture photos and video at events for our station social channels.
  • Greet listeners, hand out prizes, and represent our stations with energy.
  • Connect with our advertising partners on-site and make sure their event goes well.
  • Pitch in wherever the team needs you. Some days that’s a tent and a banner. Some days it’s something new.

Where you can grow

This job is part-time, but it doesn’t have to stay small. If you’re interested, you can learn studio work and how to run a live broadcast. You can also train on the advertising side of the business. Our company runs on a lot of different skills. Ambitious people find room here.

What you bring

  • Reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and some holidays.
  • Ability to lift and carry event gear (up to 50 lbs).
  • Comfort with a smartphone and social media.
  • A positive attitude and a willingness to jump in.

No media experience required. We’ll teach you.

Pay and schedule

  • $14–$18 per hour.
  • Weekly schedule is negotiable.

To apply

promoduo@columbusradiogroup.com ; No phone calls, please.

Cbus Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Freelance Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Orlando or Phoenix)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for Freelance Host/Producers to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As a Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.


LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.


**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.
  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.
  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.
  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.
  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.
  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.
  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.
  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $75,000.00-85,000.00 annually.

job.title: Freelance Associate Producer, America's Newsroom
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

America's Newsroom is looking for a sharp, motivated, and versatile Freelance Associate Producer to join our fast-paced morning news team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career television news producer looking to sharpen their editorial instincts, strengthen their production skills, and contribute to one of the nation's leading live news programs. The ideal candidate is a strong writer with solid newsroom experience, exceptional news judgment, and a genuine curiosity to learn every aspect of live television production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Write clear, conversational scripts, teases, guest tosses, and banners under tight deadlines
  • Pitch story ideas, compelling soundbites, and visual elements that strengthen our coverage
  • Collaborate with producers to coordinate reporter live shots and guest segments
  • Research developing stories and identify editorial updates throughout the news cycle
  • Monitor live events, news conferences, and breaking developments, communicating updates quickly and accurately
  • Learn and contribute to multiple aspects of live television production while working alongside experienced producers and newsroom leaders 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field of study preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Experience working in a major-market newsroom or national news environment
  • Exceptional writing skills, impeccable grammar and strong editorial judgment
  • Deep understanding of politics, current events and the national news landscape
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and adapt quickly in a fast-paced breaking news environment
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset
  • Demonstrated curiosity and a desire to continuously develop new editorial and production skills
  • Experience working with newsroom systems such as iNews, VIZ, Dalet, or similar production tools preferred
  • Control room experience and desktop editing experience are a plus

job.title: HR Coordinator
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

Under the general supervision of the People & Organization Manager, you'll help create a positive team member experience by coordinating People programs, onboarding events, and essential administrative processes. You'll partner with the local People & Organization, Team Member Relations, and Talent Planning & Acquisition teams to keep activities organized, responsive, and running smoothly.


You'll work closely with the site's People team and collaborate with team members, leaders, vendors, and partners across the business. Your coordination and follow-through will help connect people with programs, information, and support throughout their experience at QVC.


Where You'll Work

This role is onsite and will require you to work from our Florence fulfillment center daily. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.


What You'll Do

  • Facilitate new hire orientation
  • Administrative support (answering internal questions about benefits and leave of absence, maintaining employee and legal filings, managing payroll inbox)
  • Supporting events as necessary including primary ownership as well as tactical support.
  • Perform a variety of clerical duties to include correspondence with team member, creating letters and documents, data entry, filing, photo copying, opening and distributing mail, maintaining records / files, and other related duties, as assigned.

What You'll Bring

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience, including customer service and human resources experience.
  • Excellent working knowledge and ability in MS Office computer packages; experience working with an HRIS database is preferred.

#LI-MW1

Our Total Rewards package includes benefits you’ll love such as competitive compensation, paid time off, an employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, and amazing company discounts! job.title: Freelance Associate Producer, America's Newsroom
job.description:
America's Newsroom is looking for a sharp, motivated, and versatile Freelance Associate Producer to join our fast-paced morning news team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career television news producer looking to sharpen their editorial instincts, strengthen their production skills, and contribute to one of the nation's leading live news programs. The ideal candidate is a strong writer with solid newsroom experience, exceptional news judgment, and a genuine curiosity to learn every aspect of live television production.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Write clear, conversational scripts, teases, guest tosses, and banners under tight deadlines
  • Pitch story ideas, compelling soundbites, and visual elements that strengthen our coverage
  • Collaborate with producers to coordinate reporter live shots and guest segments
  • Research developing stories and identify editorial updates throughout the news cycle
  • Monitor live events, news conferences, and breaking developments, communicating updates quickly and accurately
  • Learn and contribute to multiple aspects of live television production while working alongside experienced producers and newsroom leaders 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field of study preferred, or equivalent experience
  • Experience working in a major-market newsroom or national news environment
  • Exceptional writing skills, impeccable grammar and strong editorial judgment
  • Deep understanding of politics, current events and the national news landscape
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and adapt quickly in a fast-paced breaking news environment
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset
  • Demonstrated curiosity and a desire to continuously develop new editorial and production skills
  • Experience working with newsroom systems such as iNews, VIZ, Dalet, or similar production tools preferred
  • Control room experience and desktop editing experience are a plus

job.title: Freelance Host/Producer, LiveNOW (Orlando or Phoenix)
job.description:
LiveNOW from FOX is looking for Freelance Host/Producers to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As a Host/Producer, you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live, and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.
  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.
  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.
  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.
  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.
  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.
  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.
  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

In this role, you’ll use C++ to build important software that powers machine learning, computer vision, and 3D modeling applications. This software will rely on mathematical concepts to analyze images and create realistic 3D models based on real-world data. 

You’ll get to work with the latest research in fields like artificial intelligence, computer vision, and computer graphics.

To keep track of your code and changes, you’ll use Git. You’ll also test and run your code on a cloud platform, working with large-scale geospatial data (like maps and geographic information) to create 3D content that users will eventually use. 

Responsibilities include, but not limited to: 

  • You will implement, in C++, core machine-learning/computer vision and (inverse-) procedural modeling algorithms, with varying levels of oversight. These algorithms rely on mathematical techniques from linear algebra, probability, and geometry.   
  • Apply cutting-edge research in machine learning, computer vision, and computer graphics. 
  • Work closely with leadership to understand high-level product vision and customer requirements. 
  • Utilize Git for effective source code management. 
  • Deploy and test your code on large scale geospatial datasets (and ultimately generate 3D content that will be available to users) This requires you to interact with remote machines via a Unix shell. 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field 
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience in a fast paced, high growth tech environment.

job.title: SAMMA Digitizer
job.description:
CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS Evening News, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.
  • Hourly rate: $26.44 per hour, equivalent to $54,995.20 annually based on a 40-hour workweek.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end archive digitization workflow, with an initial focus on SAMMA tape preparation and staging.
  • Prepare, barcode, label, sort, organize, and stage videotape media for digitization.
  • Enter and verify identifying metadata, including tape IDs, station IDs, dates, and other available information.
  • Follow established workflows for preparing Beta, U-matic, DVCPro, XDCAM, and other legacy videotape formats.
  • Identify and escalate unclear labels, missing metadata, damaged media, equipment concerns, or workflow questions.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of prep, staging, digitization, and workflow status.
  • Support daily production goals by ensuring media is prepared and available for digitization.
  • As trained and assigned, operate SAMMA robotic tape digitization systems and monitor digitization workflows.
  • Perform basic workflow checks and quality-control steps to confirm successful completion of assigned tasks.
  • As trained and assigned, support film preparation and film digitization workflows, including inspection, labeling, documentation, staging, and scanner support.
  • Handle videotape, film, and related archival media carefully to prevent damage or misplacement.
  • Follow all safety, handling, and operational procedures in the archive workspace.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions carefully.
  • Comfortable performing repetitive but detail-sensitive work.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of web-based tools or spreadsheets.
  • Ability to read handwritten and printed labels and transcribe information accurately.
  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Ability to work independently once trained, while escalating questions when needed.
  • Comfortable handling physical media, boxes, labels, barcode scanners, and digitization-related equipment.
  • Ability to stand, sit, bend, and move throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes of videotapes or film materials, typically up to approximately 25–35 lbs.
  • Availability to work onsite in Metropark/Iselin, NJ, including nights and weekends as operational needs require.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in archives, broadcast, libraries, records management, digitization, post-production, or a related media environment.
  • Familiarity with legacy media formats, including videotape and/or motion picture film.
  • Experience with barcode workflows, inventory systems, asset management systems, or media tracking tools.
  • Experience operating or supporting digitization, ingest, playback, scanning, or media migration systems.
  • Comfort working in a production-focused environment with daily throughput goals.
  • Interest in archive preservation, legacy media, and digitization workflows.

 

Skills and Attributes

  • Highly organized and methodical.
  • Patient and careful with legacy media.
  • Comfortable asking questions when instructions or media labels are unclear.
  • Able to maintain focus and accuracy over long periods of repetitive work.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Team-oriented, but capable of working independently.
  • Flexible and willing to adapt as workflows evolve.
  • Willing to be trained across multiple parts of the tape and film digitization workflows.

 

Work Environment

  • These positions are based onsite in an archive/digitization operations environment at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ. The work involves handling physical videotape, film, and related archival media; applying or scanning barcodes; entering metadata; staging media for digitization; operating or supporting SAMMA digitization workflows; supporting film prep and digitization workflows; and coordinating with Archives staff and digitization operators.
  • The roles support a high-volume digitization operation, so consistency, accuracy, dependability, and careful handling of archival media are critical.

 

Training

  • Training will be provided on CBS News Archives’ specific SAMMA workflows, barcode procedures, tape identification rules, prep and staging processes, digitization procedures, film preparation workflows, film handling procedures, and escalation processes for unclear, unknown, damaged, or problematic media.
  • Initial training and assignments may focus primarily on SAMMA tape preparation and staging. As employees demonstrate proficiency and as operational needs require, additional training may be provided for SAMMA digitization operation, workflow monitoring, basic troubleshooting, quality-control procedures, film preparation, and film digitization support.
  • Additional training and/or certification opportunities may be available as related workflows and partnerships continue to develop.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 


We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist who is excited to build ML products that shape business strategy, optimize content, inform marketing investment decisions, and enhance the user experience. You will leverage rich datasets such as video and ads consumption, clickstream activity, subscription history, and 2nd/3rd party data to build user- and session-level causal and predictive models. Key applications include identifying the drivers of retention, quantifying the impact of high-value user actions, forecasting content viewership, developing user segmentations for cohort-based targeting, and surfacing opportunities to enhance the user experience. Success in this role requires a solid foundation in Python and SQL, comfort writing production-quality code in a collaborative environment, effective communication skills, and a willingness to continuously learn new tools and techniques.  
Your Day-to-Day:  
  • Translate complex business problems into coherent, actionable quantitative solutions.
  • Implement, automate, and maintain reliable, performant, and end-to-end ML systems using software engineering and MLOps best practices.
  • Deliver clear, impactful insights to stakeholders through effective communication.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the Product org to operationalize data science solutions that inform strategy and optimize the user experience.
  • Promote best practices across the data science and product analytics team.
  • Key Projects:
    • Leverage 1st / 2nd / 3rd party data to build global models that predict user behavior throughout their subscription journey (e.g., sign-up, churn)
    • Build models to identify and measure high-value user actions and drivers of habit formation.
    • Develop session-level predictions to uncover user intent at the start of a session.
    • Build models to predict content viewership and identify content traits that resonate most with each subscriber.
    • Create user segmentations that enable meaningful cohort-based targeting and support near- personalized experiences.
    • Perform diagnostic analyses such as evaluation of failed searches to surface opportunities for product improvement. 
  Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience in Data Science and ML Engineering.
  • MS or Ph.D in Statistics/Data Science/Computer Science or related disciplines with specialization in machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with both supervised and unsupervised learning methodologies.
  • Full stack experience in data collection, aggregation, analysis, visualization, productionalization, and monitoring of data science products.
  • Familiarity with well-known  statistical and ML models and methods.
  • Ability to innovate without over-engineering.
  • Communicate concisely and assertively with a wide variety of stakeholders.
  • Strong detail orientation with a penchant for data accuracy.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience using Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, ML Engine, and APIs).
  • Experience with integrating AI solutions into existing business processes.
  • Experience using project management tools like those from Atlassian (JIRA, Confluence)

 

#LI-AD1

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

  • Implement and manage enterprise networking solutions with high reliability and availability

  • Act as technical project manager by preparing project plans, interacting with other departments, and guiding IT resources as required

Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience (required)
  • CCNP or equivalent experience (required)
  • CCNP Security or equivalent experience (required)
  • CCIE Routing and Switching (preferred)

Technical Experience

  • Minimum 5–7 years of experience in a large corporate IP network communications environment
  • Hands-on experience with routers, switches, firewalls, IOS, NXOS, load balancers, SD-WAN technology, and automation
  • Knowledge of IP security implementation and multi-vendor IPS and URL filtering
  • Knowledge of Dark Fiber and CWDM/DWDM
  • Knowledge of MPLS, BGP, and Internet Exchange Peering
  • Knowledge of QoS and Multicast
  • Knowledge of Network Management and SNMP-based monitoring solutions
  • Experience with medium/large corporate network rollout and support
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise project management
  • Experience in Media, Entertainment, Broadcast, Hosting, or ISP environments

  • Team player with a collaborative working style
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to prioritize issues effectively
  • Strong time management with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently

  • Thoroughness and attention to detail

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Is this role for you?

The MMS Reporting & Strategy team sits within the Music & Media Services (‘MMS’) department at Paramount and is organised across Reporting, Analytics, and Systems & Technical Reporting.

We’re looking for a technically minded Systems & Reporting Analyst to lead day-to-day Systems & Technical Reporting within priorities set by the Director, MMS Reporting & Strategy. As the link between the team and technical colleagues, you’ll provide technical expertise, validated data and system support across two areas.

Technical Reporting:

You’ll handle queries from collective management organisations (CMOs) and clients about usage reporting issues and changes, resolving them directly or alongside technical teams. Getting hands-on with departmental reporting workflows, data and metadata, you’ll ensure accuracy and help develop and improve reports in line with contractual requirements and industry standards. You’ll also maintain clear documentation of reporting logic and report changes.

Systems:

You’ll represent international business needs, partnering closely with US Music colleagues, who represent domestic needs, to develop shared global solutions. You’ll gather requirements, complete testing and validation, and work with the Director to support new music system initiatives and developments.

You’ll partner closely with the wider team across both areas. Adaptability, curiosity and a proactive approach are key as the role evolves with business needs. We’re looking for someone who’s technically savvy and enjoys finding creative, practical solutions to problems.


What you will be doing?

  • Resolve technical reporting queries from CMOs and clients, investigating reporting discrepancies and data quality issues, and fixing them directly where appropriate or coordinating resolution with technical teams.

  • Work hands-on with departmental reporting workflows and data, keeping data accurate and making sure reports meet agreed CMO and client requirements.

  • Track reporting queries, changes and agreed actions through to completion, working proactively with technical teams to identify blockers, coordinate resolution and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Maintain workflows that prepare and transform data ready for onward reporting and analytics, validating outputs for accuracy.

  • Act as a key international business contact for Paramount’s internal cue-sheet system, partnering closely with US Music colleagues to develop shared global solutions that address international and domestic needs.

  • Gather and document system and reporting requirements, clarify business needs and work with technical teams to progress agreed improvements, making sure reporting meets contractual requirements and evolving industry standards.

  • Maintain clear technical reporting documentation, including reporting logic, testing outcomes and known issues, partnering with Analytics colleagues who deliver user-facing training materials where needed.

  • Support the wider development, enhancement and rollout of music systems, working closely with the Director.

  • Conduct user acceptance testing, validate system changes against agreed requirements and gather stakeholder feedback.

  • Communicate system and reporting changes clearly to the wider department, CMOs and other affected stakeholders.

What are we looking for?

Essential Skills & Experience: 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail and a resourceful approach to unfamiliar problems: research the issue, test possible solutions and seek input when needed.

  • Strong data skills, including preparing, validating and reconciling large datasets and identifying missing, duplicate or inconsistent records.

  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements and working with technical teams to deliver reporting or system changes.

  • Experience with user acceptance testing (UAT) and validating changes against agreed requirements.

  • The ability to understand and explain reporting logic, data flows, metadata and system interactions.

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with experience managing competing requests and meeting deadlines.

  • A proactive approach: you spot issues and opportunities, suggest practical improvements and take ownership of agreed actions through to completion.

  • Curiosity about how systems and processes work, a creative approach to problem-solving, enthusiasm for new technology, and a drive to improve data quality and reporting reliability.

  • Confident using SQL to query, join and aggregate data, and Excel to reconcile and validate outputs using formulas and pivot tables.

  • Experience in a systems, reporting, data or similarly technical analyst role.

Desirable Skills & Experience: 

  • Experience with Alteryx or comparable data workflow tools. Training can be provided.

  • Knowledge of CMOs, cue sheets and music rights.

  • Experience within music, media, broadcasting, entertainment or rights management.

  • Experience with automation tools, AI agents or AI-assisted workflows, including checking the accuracy of their outputs.
