job.title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA, one of the most geographically diverse broadcasters in the U.S., is seeking an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Shared Services team. This position will be part of the TEGNA corporate team with company-wide responsibility but will be physically located at our NBC Affiliate in Indianapolis, WTHR. The Accounts Receivable Specialist will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the accounts receivable sub-ledger for assigned stations/accounts. Additionally, in collaboration with collector and stations sales, the Specialist will resolve credit balances – refund, application, or transfer. Overall, this position is responsible for a “clean” aging providing collectors accurate balances when making their collection calls.


Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:


•    Identify balances needing adjustment and prepares online adjustment requests for routing
•    Work with station personnel to move adjustment requests through the process per policy
•    Reconcile customer receivable accounts and timely applies prepayments to invoices
•    Research and reconcile account balances and account activity per station/customer request
•    Provide account statements upon request
•    Conduct research for short pay discrepancies and resolve to proper next actions
•    Build and maintain positive relationships with station personnel and collectors
•    Provide a high standard of customer service to both internal and external customers


Requirements:

•    High School Diploma or GED
•    2 years of active experience with accounts receivable balances using an aged balance report as the primary source tool in a high-volume entry environment with responsibility for hundreds of accounts and collaborating with remote personnel
•    Knowledge of the accounting journal entry resulting from actions taken to resolve balances
•    Understanding of cash application and AR procedures and is a “numbers” person
•    Ability to quickly learn and achieve proficiency in new software applications as needed
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills including superior customer service skills
•    Professionalism and strong work ethic
•    Strong time-management and organizational skills


Preferred Qualifications:


•    Two or four-year degree
•    4 or more years of experience
•    Intermediate Excel skills – comfort exporting to Excel and manipulating results
•    Broadcast Industry experience
•    Wide Orbit Software experience

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. Research local businesses and identify potential advertising and marketing opportunities.

Collaborate cross-functionally to support exceptional customer experiences.

Represent LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network with professionalism and integrity.

Required

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong customer service mindset.

Self-motivated with a desire to build a sales career.

job.title: Press Operator I
job.description:
Press Operator

Gannett Publishing Services

New Castle, Delaware

“We have an opening for a highly motivated individual in the Gannett corporation at one of our regional print facilities.”

“It is a fast-paced manufacturing operation which would require basic mechanical and\or manufacturing skill sets” This position is Full Time and will offer $20 per hour based on work-related experience.

The Wilmington GPS group is looking for a full-time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our Goss HO presses. The work includes working with a team to prepare the presses for production, operates the presses or any of their components, cleans the presses and the pressroom, maintains the mechanical readiness of the presses, and other duties as assigned.Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success:

·Optimum quality of printed products.

·Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

·Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

·A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

This position requires a high school education or equivalent. Three years’ experience in web offset printing is desirable, although production experience of any kind may be helpful.Mechanical ability and familiarity with computers is preferred. Candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.You must be able to lift/carry up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator spends most working hours on his/her feet.In addition to long periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure.Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, and weekends.

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.

What we offer:

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our Senior Security Engineer, you will bridge the gap between traditional infrastructure security and modern DevSecOps. We are looking for a proactive security engineer to define secure-by-design frameworks, implement high-impact DevSecOps pipelines across multi-cloud environments (AWS and GCP), and lead critical security reviews for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.

Beyond technical mastery, you will act as a collaborative partner to our internal teams, fostering a culture of proactive security, cyber vigilance, and continuous improvement. If you thrive in rapidly evolving environments and have a passion for building secure, resilient ecosystems, this is your next challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Secure-by-Design Architecture: Implement, own, and champion secure-by-design frameworks across cloud, infrastructure, and application ecosystems, ensuring all system architectures address robust cybersecurity requirements.
  • Design & Integration Reviews: Review and approve security architecture designs for new internal systems, cloud platforms, and third-party integrations.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Design, enable, and maintain automated security pipelines to proactively scan Git repositories, catching vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle.
  • Cloud Security Management: Manage security lifecycles within multi-cloud environments (primarily AWS and GCP) to ensure continuous compliance and threat mitigation.
  • Vulnerability Management: Own and run the end-to-end vulnerability management program, prioritizing remediation efforts across enterprise systems.
  • AI & Emerging Tech Security: Assess and secure emerging technologies, evaluating security-focused Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI workflows to keep NPR aligned with industry progressions.
  • Security Monitoring & SIEM: Leverage SIEM platforms (specifically Splunk) to develop advanced dashboards, write queries, and build automated reporting mechanisms for real-time threat intelligence.
  • Network & Endpoint Defense: Deploy, recommend, and test advanced security controls, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), enterprise-level antivirus, and perimeter security for Cisco networking devices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal NPR technology and business teams to address security gaps, resolve concerns, and provide subject matter expertise in ongoing cybersecurity meetings.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of experience in an information security, security engineering, or infrastructure security role.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in DevSecOps, secure software development, or automated CI/CD security pipeline integration.
  • Strong hands-on technical experience administering enterprise security tools, including SIEM (Splunk), EDR/anti-malware, and vulnerability management systems.
  • Proven experience securing multi-cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud security posture management.
  • Practical knowledge of core networking concepts and principles, including securing perimeter devices (such as Cisco hardware).
  • Demonstrated track record of cross-functional technical communication, documentation, and assisting development teams with security remediation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, or specialized cloud/DevSecOps credentials (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and network automation tools.
  • Practical experience implementing secure workflows for generative AI tools or LLMs.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Threat & Vulnerability Analysis: Analytical capability to interpret automated scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities, and formulate remediation plans.
  • Cloud Security Architecture: Foundational competence in designing and securing cloud-native services and environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Ability to write utility scripts (Python, Bash, etc.) to automate security checks or integrate tools.
  • SIEM Querying: Proficiency in building custom queries and alerts within SIEM platforms like Splunk.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Exceptional interpersonal and technical communication skills to bridge security policies with developer workflows.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $125,000-152,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Photography Director, The Cut
job.description:
PHOTOGRAPHY DIRECTOR, THE CUT 

WHO WE ARE

New York Magazine and The Cut are part of Vox Media, the leading modern media company. We guide our audience from discovery to obsession. We inspire essential conversations about what’s now, what’s next, and what’s possible.

As a community of journalists and storytellers, business professionals, creators and technologists, we believe it is a moral and business imperative to amplify voices: to cultivate diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our organization and media. This applies to our candidates, our teams, our storytelling, our creative work, and our platforms, products, and partnerships.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Cut is looking for a Photo Director to set and lead our visual strategy across digital, social, video, and print. The ideal candidate will have at least ten years of experience in visual production and a deep understanding of photography, art direction, and visual storytelling, along with an enviable book of contacts across agencies, photographers, and creatives. This role requires strong editorial judgment, exceptional leadership skills, and the ability to manage many projects and deadlines at once in a fast-paced environment. You will report to Lindsay Peoples, Editor-in-Chief of The Cut and work closely with her to uphold and advance the visual identity of The Cut, while partnering with editorial teams to turn ideas into compelling visual narratives. You will also lead and mentor the photo team, guiding them to deliver strong results while nurturing their craft and creative sensibilities.

We're looking for someone who obsessively follows culture (from politics to fashion to celebrity) and knows what makes a Cut story. You should have impeccable visual taste, big ideas on how to expand the visual language of The Cut, and a passion for storytelling.

WHO YOU ARE

Responsibilities & Qualifications

  • Set the visual strategy for The Cut across print, digital, social, and video
  • Provide clear visual direction, constructive feedback, and support to the photo team
  • Spearhead all aspects of photo shoot production, from commissioning teams and liaising with vendors to ensuring each shoot is successful and on budget
  • Track and maintain the overall photo budget, setting and assigning individual project budgets to team members and communicating clearly with editorial leadership and finance partners on all active projects
  • Manage workflow, including assigning work, overseeing workloads, and maintaining visual quality
  • Manage photo research, image selection, credits, and CMS upload and publication
  • Conduct deep visual research and curate lists of photographers accompanied by visual boards
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with the editors across The Cut to understand their visual needs and orchestrate projects accordingly
  • Regularly pitch ideas for new photographers, essays, and photo-driven stories
  • Develop and maintain relationships with photo agencies, independent photographers, stylists, and studios
  • Ensure contracts, photo fees, and usage rights are in place for all images, whether produced or researched, and that all photography meets ethical standards and adheres to copyright law
  • Collaborate with sales, partnerships, editorial, web, social, and video teams to ensure the highest level of visual execution across all platforms
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in visual production, photo editing, or a related field
  • Strong people manager with a track record of inspiring and developing talent
  • Excellent editorial judgment, with demonstrated experience managing teams to develop visual stories across platforms and a detailed understanding of each platform's requirements
  • Proficiency in photo editing software such as Adobe Creative Suite and Photoshop
  • Ability to travel on occasion for assignments and shoots

Staff Engineer, Snowflake Platform
Dow Jones, Data Architecture & Platform Engineering
New York, United States | Job ID: TBD | Internal career level: Staff Engineer
Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations
around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events.
About the team
The Data Architecture & Platform Engineering team runs the data infrastructure behind Dow Jones products,
analytics, and AI across B2B, B2C, and internal use cases. We own the Snowflake footprint which serves as the
foundation of all DJ structured data, the surrounding platforms and patterns, and the governance framework. We
build for scale, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
The role
This is an individual-contributor leadership role focused on Snowflake infrastructure at the Dow Jones enterprise
scale. You'll own the platform end to end: account architecture and administration, security and access control, and
the DevOps machinery that makes Snowflake safe and easy to use across dozens of teams and every business unit.
You will own the Snowflake platform's AI story: efficient, cost-managed access to Cortex and other AI features,
optimized patterns for LLM-assisted workflows, and standards that let engineers across DJ build with AI on top of
governed data.
You'll ship the hard parts yourself, set the standards other teams follow, and mentor the engineers who work in and
around Snowflake. You lead through influence: design reviews, working code, written arguments, and mentoring.
You'll partner with security, compliance, finance, product, and engineering leaders to turn DJ's data-platform goals
into infrastructure that holds up over time.
You'll split your time between hands-on Snowflake work on the highest-stakes projects; standards and platform-level
decisions; and mentoring engineers across levels.
What you'll do
• Own the Snowflake footprint across Dow Jones: accounts, warehouses, roles, databases, and the operating
model behind them.
• Design and evolve RBAC, column and row-level policies, masking, tagging, and data classification for
every business unit.
• Build and maintain the DevOps pipeline for Snowflake: Terraform, CI/CD for schema and object changes,
automated testing, and change management.
• Set and enforce standards for security, network policies, private connectivity, SSO, SCIM, and secrets
management.
• Optimize cost and performance: resource monitors, warehouse right-sizing, query analysis, credit
budgeting, and FinOps reporting.

observability across the platform.

• Hunt technical debt in the platform to reduce complexity so downstream teams get more done with less.
• Debug the problems no one else can. Lead during incidents and get to root cause fast.
• Mentor engineers across levels, including senior and staff peers, through design guidance, code review,
pairing, and documentation.

• Contribute to how the org grows engineers: development practices, career frameworks, communities of
practice.
• Communicate through design docs, wiki, and tech talks; tailor the message for engineers, product, security,

• 7+ years in data engineering, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles, with time spent at large or
enterprise-scale companies.

speaking.

job.title: Bureau Chief, Mansion
job.description:
Job Description:


Mansion Bureau Chief, Features
in New York, NY



The Wall Street Journal’s Features team is seeking a dynamic, experienced bureau chief to run Mansion, our luxury real estate section. Through its digital coverage and weekly print section, this section serves a broad and sophisticated audience: wealthy homeowners and real-estate professionals tracking the market and its biggest trends; aspirational readers who turn to it as a dream book; and anyone interested in social, cultural and economic forces shaping the world through the lens of real estate. 


This is an opportunity to lead a high-profile team that is prized for its ability to break major news, uncover market-moving shifts, produce deeply reported stories with real authority, as well as smart, buzzy features that capture the culture around homeowning.


Working collaboratively with columnists and reporters across Features and with teams throughout the newsroom, the ideal candidate is a self-starting editor with deep experience in real estate and home coverage and a sharp instinct for conceiving distinctive and highly visual digital stories. This editor should know how to turn strong reporting and ideas into journalism that travels across platforms and reaches audiences in different ways—from vertical video and social carousels to newsletters and the WSJ app.


The bureau chief will work closely with graphics, video, audience and platform editors to determine the best ways to package, present and amplify Mansion journalism, helping each story reach the right audiences in the right formats. 


A proven ability to find the stories where real estate intersects with investing, wealth, how people live and where they choose to live is essential.


The bureau chief will set the section’s editorial agenda, identify the biggest stories and opportunities, develop ambitious reporting and push the team beyond the expected. The goal is to build on Mansion’s position as an essential source for understanding the real-estate market and the people, money, culture and forces shaping how and where we live—and to ensure that journalism reaches and engages audiences wherever they encounter The Journal. 


You will:

  • Assign and edit multiple stories each week that explore the best of real estate and homeownership, from market and investment stories to architecture and design, delivering smart, engaging and useful reading for a broad audience. 
  • Manage and coach dedicated reporters and columnists on the Mansion desk, while building strong partnerships across Features and the broader newsroom to bring the best reporters and ideas to real estate coverage. 
  • Generate ambitious, highly shareable story ideas for the team that have clear news value, a strong real-estate hook and sharp, distinctive execution. 
  • Bring deep experience covering real estate and a strong understanding of the property market, along with a well-developed network of sources across the industry to break news, uncover trends, develop ambitious features and identify story lines that The Journal can own, from original reporting and exclusive access to distinctive franchises and deeper examinations of the forces reshaping how and where people live. 
  • Easily modulate between editing surprising, engaging and well-reported feature stories with fast, news-driven deal reporting. Embody the Features mission to simultaneously inform and entertain our audience. 
  • Work collaboratively and egolessly with others—both with Features editors as well as with our style and culture teams of reporters.
  • Know how to amplify traditional profiles, trends and event stories with humanizing detail and a sharp eye for shareable, well-crafted narratives that can become distinctive, high-impact Features stories. 
  • Embrace audience data, using metrics alongside strong editorial judgment, great taste and imaginative ideas to shape smarter real estate coverage. 
  • Ensure the top-tier execution and ethical standards of the Wall Street Journal and WSJ. Magazine are consistently met: that work is of impeccable quality across all platforms, and that The Journal’s codes of conduct and overall Standards & Ethics rules are scrupulously met. 

You have:

  • 5 to 8+ years experience as an editor on real estate or similar topics, including editing fast-breaking news, reported feature stories, and well-developed enterprise or longer-form features.
  • Experience editing complex subject matter.
  • An ability to identify potential legal issues.
  • An ability to enhance storytelling for our mobile audience, with a sophisticated understanding of how to capture and sustain audience attention across platforms. 
  • A proven history of finding unexpected takes on the real estate world, as well as an eye for elevated cultural and visually sumptuous stories that appeal to a general audience. 
  • Great contacts and a dogged, indefatigable sense of how to make stories happen.
  • A sense of humor, including a demonstrated ability to find clever, intelligent ways into stories that are being widely covered. 
  • A meticulous approach to getting facts and details exactly right, knowing how to push your team to avoid errors and bulletproof high-profile, visible stories with an attention to detail.
  • Visual thinking and a vested interest in how stories will look and present across platforms.
  • A collaborative, team-player attitude, an upbeat outlook and an entrepreneurial spirit as we grow and evolve coverage needs.

You will report to the Deputy Coverage Chief, Features.  This is a fulltime position based in our New York, NY office.  To apply, please submit your resume, a cover letter explaining how you would approach the job and a link to a portfolio of your relevant work by December 7. If necessary, include a very brief description of the role you played in each example. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage early submission as the position may be filled before the deadline.

job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role Lead the team that keeps Suno Corporate IT Systems running. As Senior Manager, IT Operations, you'll lead our IT Engineers and build our IT Service Desk. Your team owns IT operations across our four US offices — Cambridge, New York, San Francisco, and Los Angeles — including identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration software, office A/V, office networking, and Tailscale. Your success will be measured through the impact of your team. You'll establish clear ownership over operational areas, ensure top-notch service that your colleagues trust, and your team will leverage AI and Automation to scale efficiently. You'll partner closely with Operations, People, Finance, Security, and Engineering, and you'll be the senior IT presence on the West Coast. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/0fzLoGLLVcxm3uBA What Your Team Owns Identity and access management — Okta, SSO and SCIM coverage, joiner / mover / leaver automation via our IGA platform, access reviews, and ad hoc access requests. Endpoint management — the Mac fleet in MDM, zero-touch enrollment, OS and patch compliance, device trust, and endpoint security in partnership with our EDR/MDR providers. Collaboration software — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the broader SaaS portfolio: configuration, hardening, licensing, and lifecycle. Office A/V — conference rooms, videoconferencing, and event spaces. Corporate Networking — wired, wireless, and WAN across four sites, including design for buildouts and expansions with outside experts where it makes sense. Tailscale — our zero-trust network layer: ACL policy, device posture, access to internal tools and infrastructure, and the day-to-day administration in collaboration with Engineering IT service delivery — the service desk, AI IT Service Management platform, SLAs, escalation paths, knowledge base, and the Tier 0 partnership with office managers. What You'll Do Manage the IT Engineers — set expectations against our role standards, give direct feedback, run 1:1s and performance conversations, and grow people on the IC track. Manage against outcomes and impact, not tenure and activities. Build the IT Help Desk — define the service model (what the desk handles, what escalates to engineering, what office managers cover at Tier 0), write the job profiles, our our service desk team. Own operational outcomes — the team's quarterly plan across the areas above, clear ownership of each area by a named engineer, and honest status reporting to the Senior Manager of IT and leadership. Run change well — size changes by scope, impact, and reversibility; make sure the team communicates before changes land and can roll them back after; bring in the right partners early and avoid surprises. Scale service as Suno scales — runbooks and knowledge articles good enough for AI-powered self-service to actually deflect; automate what the team has handled twice; absorb headcount growth without proportional growth in tickets or effort. Manage vendors and partners — MSPs, network and A/V integrators, EDR/MDR providers, and SaaS vendors; hold them to results and know when to bring work in-house. Lead IT for the West Coast — own IT for the SF office directly, oversee LA coverage, and partner with Facilities on buildouts, moves, and expansions. What You'll Need Must-Haves 10+ years in IT, including 3+ years managing IT engineers, a help desk, or an IT operations team at a high-growth company. You've built a support function, not just inherited one — you can discuss service model, SLAs, staffing, and deflection you put in place and what changed because of it. Working knowledge across the stack your team owns — identity (Okta or equivalent, SCIM, IGA), Apple-first endpoint management, Google Workspace and Slack administration, office networking and A/V, and zero-trust networking (Tailscale or comparable) — deep enough to set priorities, review your team's work credibly, and ask the right questions, without needing to be the best engineer in the room. Strong people leadership — you've hired, coached, given hard feedback, and managed performance, including for people in other offices and time zones. Clear written communication — you need to be able to communicate clearly and concisely for executive, business, and technical audiences. Judgment under growth — you can tell a one-way door from a two-way door, move fast on the reversible, and slow down on the consequential. Modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud) and endpoint security partnerships (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Expel, or similar). Tailscale or another zero-trust network layer in production — ACL design, device posture, SSO integration. ITSM design experience — intake, categorization, SLAs, and reporting from scratch; AI-powered self-service a plus. Experience running IT through a multi-office expansion — new sites, floor expansions, and the integrators and vendors that come with them. Experience as an early IT leader at a company that grew from hundreds to a thousand employees. Work Location Policy This role is expected to work from the San Francisco Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience. job.title: Advertising Operations Associate
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO’s mission from the very beginning was to win the audience. We dedicate ourselves to providing accurate, non-partisan, impactful information to the right people at the right time so that they can act with confidence and speed.


POLITICO is in search of an Advertising Operations Specialist who will work closely with the Media Business team to ensure successful activation and fulfillment of advertising campaigns. The ideal candidate will be agile and work well in a fast-paced environment. 


Who You Are:

  • A detail-driven problem solver who thrives in fast-paced, deadline-oriented environments.
  • A collaborative communicator with a knack for translating data into actionable insights.
  • A tech-savvy professional fluent in ad operations tools, creative platforms, and web languages.
  • A dependable team player who takes initiative and embraces leadership opportunities.
  • A strategic thinker who values integrity, innovation, and contributing to a mission-driven culture.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work closely with Media Business to ensure successful activation and fulfillment of advertising campaigns
  • QA advertising assets and troubleshoot any technical and performance issues
  • Launch, monitor and optimize digital campaigns using the ad server
  • Analyze performance of advertising campaigns and products
  • Contribute to product performance benchmarks and insights using multiple data sources and visualization tools
  • Maintain runsheets, campaign pacing and inventory forecasting reports
  • Liaise with Design team to insure placement of print advertising
  • Assist with evaluation, implementation and administration of ad tech platforms

What You’ll Need:

  • 0-1 years of experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to be dependable when working on a team
  • Experience analyzing data to extract meaningful, actionable insights
  • Experience using Google’s advertising platforms or comparable ad serving platforms
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel
  • Familiarity with web languages (HTML, Javascript, etc.)
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment
  • Ready to take on leadership opportunities and become Subject Matter Experts in our platforms

COMPENSATION: $50,000 Annual Base. This position is eligible for commission. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

job.title: Senior Backend Developer
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Software Developer to join our Apps Experience team on a 12 month fixed contract. 

 

You could be building the products that showcase our progressive and independent journalism, crafting the tools that journalists use to write their stories, developing the services that allow those stories to be distributed across the globe, or safeguarding our financial future.

 

About the role

  • You’ll mostly be programming in Scala and Typescript, running in AWS, but we use the tool that best fits the problem.
  • You’ll be working in a cross-functional team, which is empowered to rapidly iterate and release new features.
  • You won’t be coding in isolation - our culture is strongly collaborative, whether pair programming with other developers or working closely with editorial and commercial colleagues.
  • Sometimes deciding what code to write is as hard as writing the code itself. As an engineer you’ll be involved in product decisions as well as technical ones.
  • You have a strong interest in growing your skills even further.

 

Much of our code is openly available on GitHub, and some of our projects are widely used throughout the Open Source community. Many of our developers regularly attend and present at conferences. Please visit our Guardian Developers site and the Guardian Developer blog for more information about working in the Digital Development team.

 

About you

  • As a full stack engineer, you’ll be equally willing to dive into a purely functional and composable Scala back-end, or a complex Typescript front-end.
  • You inspire the people you work with, and are inspired by them in return.
  • You contribute to the direction of your team's products
  • You are passionate about spreading engineering best practice beyond your immediate team.
  • You are excited by the opportunity to shape the future of digital journalism.
  • Your interests go beyond just your team’s objectives; you are curious about where the organisation is moving as a whole.
  • You have a strong interest in growing your skills.
  • You can make reasoned choices regarding what technologies to use and when to use them.
  • We believe diversity of people, backgrounds, experience and ideas helps us to build better products and achieve more. We welcome applicants who have taken traditional and non-traditional career paths into software development.

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

 

Our engineers and developers operate in a hybrid environment working 1 day a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 4 days a week remotely.

 

We strive for transparency in remuneration.  The salary for new Senior Developers at the Guardian is £72,000 per year.

 

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

 

How to apply

Please upload your CV and covering letter as one document. You should also highlight the extent to which your skills/experience meets the requirements of the role and your motivation behind applying.

 

Our interview process involves two stages: a face to face interview and a pairing test. We may offer a remote pairing test for candidates who would have to travel a long distance to our office in London, however you will have to arrange to come to our office for the face to face interview.

 

The closing date for applications is Friday 30th October 2026.

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Anna Vipers  on anna.vipers@guardian.co.uk to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

 

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

 

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

 

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

 

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

 

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

 

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

job.title: Database Engineer II
job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

 

AXS actively seeking a Database Engineer to provide quality, scalable data solutions for AXS products. The candidate will be expected to collaborate to design and then develop, implement, and optimize critical databases, processes and reports to achieve business goals and support the development and data platform teams.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain relational and NoSQL databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aurora, MongoDB, etc.).

Burson es la agencia global líder en comunicación, diseñada para generar valor para los clientes a través de la reputación. Con equipos altamente especializados, tecnologías líderes en la industria y una creatividad innovadora, ayudamos a marcas y empresas a redefinir la reputación como ventaja competitiva para que puedan liderar hoy y en el futuro. Trabajar en Burson es formar parte de una comunidad global de profesionales comprometidos con el aprendizaje continuo y con liderar el cambio innovador.

Burson forma parte de WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), un referente mundial en transformación creativa. Para más información, visite bursonglobal.com y síganos en LinkedIn e Instagram.

Profile Summary:

The Corporate Brand & Technology Director is a strategic, entrepreneurial, and bilingual (Spanish/English) leader in corporate communications, public relations, and reputation management at Burson. This position serves as the primary driver of the client-agency relationship for the firm's largest accounts, spanning strategic communications, PR, digital communications, and influencer marketing across the consumer, technology, and innovation sectors.
The role is responsible for developing integrated strategies based on the PESO model, leading multidisciplinary teams, managing the financial health and profitability of assigned accounts, and providing high-level consultative counsel (C-Suite Counsel) to leaders in the technology, consumer, and corporate brand sectors. The ability to leverage insights, data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence tools to strengthen Data Storytelling is also considered a desirable advantage that brings differentiated value to the position.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Strategic, Business, and Account Management Capabilities

  • Senior consulting and C-Suite counsel: Develop the strategy, design, and execution of annual public relations and strategic communications programs. Serve as the day-to-day strategic partner to C-level executives, providing thoughtful, high-impact counsel aligned with their business priorities.
  • Client-agency relationship leadership: Guide agency teams toward sustained account success. Proactively anticipate both stated and unstated client needs, identify communication gaps, assess reputational risks, and implement immediate action plans.
  • Business development and intrapreneurship: Apply a growth mindset by proactively identifying expansion opportunities within existing client relationships and leading the development and presentation of creative, strategic proposals to win new business.
  • Financial accountability and profitability: Develop and manage budgets with a high degree of accuracy. Support the tracking of key financial indicators, manage profit margins, prevent over-servicing, and address budget variances or issues in a timely manner.
  • Inspirational leadership and mentorship: Lead, motivate, and develop agency talent. Inspire high performance through strengths-based feedback, ongoing coaching, active listening, and the promotion of a diverse and inclusive culture.

B. Corporate Brand, Consumer, Digital, Influencer Marketing, and Technology & Innovation Strategy

  • Corporate, consumer, and brand strategy: Design and implement multichannel communication strategies focused on building and protecting corporate reputation, while positioning consumer brands through compelling, high-value narratives.
  • Digital, social media, and influencer marketing strategy: Guide the integration of cross-channel digital campaigns and ensure a consistent brand presence across social media and digital platforms. Lead influencer, content creator, and digital opinion leader strategy and management, overseeing the full process from strategic selection through measurement of partnership impact.
  • Technology ecosystem expertise: Bring a strong understanding of technology business models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C) and key trends such as Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, SaaS, and Digital Transformation. Distill highly technical concepts into clear, engaging, and persuasive narratives for mainstream media, consumer audiences, investors, and key spokespeople.
  • Launches, annual plans, and the PESO model: Design and implement strategic communication plans, executive positioning programs (Thought Leadership), and launch campaigns for technology innovation and consumer products and services, integrating paid (Paid), earned (Earned), shared (Social), and owned (Owned) channels.
  • Media relations and reputation crisis management: Lead positioning and relationship-building with journalists, editors, and key local, national, and international media across consumer, business, lifestyle, and technology sectors. Provide decisive, strategic leadership during crises, contingencies, or reputational risks affecting clients in the technology and corporate sectors.

C. Preferred Data & Intelligence Capabilities (Valued but Not Required)

  • Data-informed counsel: Preferred ability to use data, metrics, and competitive analysis to inform strategic decision-making and strengthen campaign narratives.
  • Analytics and monitoring tools: Preferred familiarity or experience with social monitoring and listening platforms (Brandwatch, Meltwater, Talkwalker) and data visualization/dashboard tools (Power BI).
  • Artificial intelligence applications: Preferred understanding of the strategic use of generative AI tools and cognitive platforms to optimize communications workflows and landscape analysis.
  • Visualization and insights: Ability to translate complex communications data and metrics into clear, visual presentations that demonstrate return on investment (ROI) for the client.

Profile Requirements:

  • Professional experience: A minimum of 12 years of experience in public relations, communications agencies, or corporate communications functions, managing Corporate Brand, Consumer, Digital Strategy, and/or Technology & Innovation accounts.
  • Team leadership: At least 5 years of direct experience managing, developing, and mentoring multidisciplinary teams.
  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in Spanish and English (C1/C2 spoken and written), with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with clients, executives, and global networks.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university qualification in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Preferred studies/certifications: Courses or certifications in Digital Strategy, Influencer Marketing, Analytics, Data Storytelling, or AI-powered productivity tools.
  • Core interpersonal skills: Exceptional client relationship management, strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, inspirational leadership, resilience, and adaptability in dynamic environments.

More about the role:

Burson's Insights & Intelligence team sits at the heart of this work, turning data into strategic insights that drive storytelling, campaign performance, and business outcomes.

Burson is seeking to hire a Director to join our best-in-class Insights & Intelligence team, supporting a diverse portfolio of high-profile global brands across sectors including technology, retail, financial services, and beyond. This role requires a balance of social listening expertise, analytical rigor, strategic thinking, AI fluency, client leadership, and team management.

The ideal candidate will be client-facing and possess a strong understanding of social media listening, cultural and competitor trends, analytics reporting, and research methodologies, alongside exceptional writing and presentation skills. They will understand how to develop insight-driven strategies that support integrated campaigns and have a passion for turning data into compelling stories.

As part of a highly collaborative team, you'll play a key role in uncovering cultural insights, monitoring online conversations, and helping brands make informed decisions through social and digital intelligence. You'll partner closely with internal teams and clients to deliver actionable insights tied to brand reputation, campaign performance, thought leadership, sustainability, and corporate communications initiatives. In addition, you'll contribute to new business efforts and help mentor and guide junior team members as the practice continues to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to continue building a career at one of the world's leading global communications agencies while working across high-profile client accounts.

What you'll do:

  • Develop strategic insights that inform communications, marketing, and reputation-driven campaigns.
  • Translate data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior client stakeholders.
  • Proactively deep dive into data to inform and steer critical decision making, as well as work with complex datasets to aggregate, ingest and organize data in a clean, ready-to-use fashion for the team to deliver data-led findings in a 2 way that makes sense for each brand.
  • Monitor, track, and evaluate earned and owned organic campaign performance analytics, based on client KPIs, targets and baselines.
  • Identify trends, cultural signals, and audience behaviors.
  • Oversee social listening programs using tools such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, and similar platforms ensuring data integrity and methodological rigor.
  • Help identify opportunities to expand existing client engagements through social listening, analytics, and intelligence-led solutions.
  • Mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance on methodologies, insight development, and client delivery.
  • Serve as a thought partner to account teams and clients, helping shape strategic recommendations and best practices across engagements.
  • Apply AI capabilities to enhance insight generation, trend detection, and forecasting while helping to evolve Burson’s AI-enabled analytics and intelligence approaches.
  • Provide easy to understand social analytics with strategic implications relating to the overall brand objectives and work within a team to develop and execute creative digital and social media content.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 6-7+ years of experience in analytics, insights, or intelligence roles working within or for the PR, Communications, or Advertising industry, with a deep understanding of its unique data landscapes, client demands, and strategic challenges.
  • Strong background in social media analytics and social listening.
  • Exceptional understanding of social listening, particularly with experience using Sprinklr for analytics, in addition to other Boolean Language and platforms, like Brandwatch, Meltwater, etc.
  • Proven ability to translate data into strategic insights.
  • Experience with generative AI models and integrating AI into operational workflows.
  • Client-facing communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and impactful business recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, prioritize effectively, and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leading and mentoring junior team members, with a track record of fostering team development and delivering high-quality client work.
  • Excellent storytelling and presentation skills.
  • Detail-oriented while keeping sight of bigger picture/trends; intellectually curious.
  • Keen eye for data trends and the ability to investigate and extract insights and stories.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.

Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Quiénes somos:

Burson es la agencia global líder en comunicación, diseñada para generar valor para los clientes a través de la reputación. Con equipos altamente especializados, tecnologías líderes en la industria y una creatividad innovadora, ayudamos a marcas y empresas a redefinir la reputación como ventaja competitiva para que puedan liderar hoy y en el futuro. Trabajar en Burson es formar parte de una comunidad global de profesionales comprometidos con el aprendizaje continuo y con liderar el cambio innovador.

Burson forma parte de WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), un referente mundial en transformación creativa. Para más información, visite bursonglobal.com y síganos en LinkedIn e Instagram.

📢 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo en Burson Perú!

En Burson, líder global en comunicaciones y relaciones públicas, seguimos creciendo y buscamos a un/a Practicante Profesional de Asuntos Públicos (Derecho) con pasión por la investigación, el análisis regulatorio y la coyuntura política.

Si eres una persona dinámica, analítica y quieres dar el siguiente paso en tu carrera aprendiendo de un equipo de alto impacto, ¡esta oportunidad es para ti! 🚀

🎯 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales desafíos?

  • Monitoreo normativo: Realizar seguimiento y síntesis diaria de la normativa primaria y secundaria clave para nuestros clientes.
  • Análisis estratégico: Evaluar proyectos de ley y normativas vigentes para identificar implicancias directas e indirectas, sumando análisis de políticas comparadas a nivel internacional.
  • Investigación aplicada: Analizar tendencias regulatorias, políticas públicas y el entorno empresarial peruano actual.
  • Elaboración de informes: Redactar reportes analíticos con recomendaciones estratégicas tanto en el plano regulatorio como comunicacional.
  • Apoyo integral: Colaborar en proyectos de asuntos públicos, eventos, campañas y estrategias integradas de comunicación.

🔍 ¿Qué buscamos?

  • Recién egresado/a o Bachiller de la carrera de Derecho o carreras afines.
  • Genuino interés y seguimiento activo de la coyuntura política y normativa del país.
  • Gran gusto por la investigación y pensamiento crítico.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita (redacción impecable y capacidad de síntesis).
  • Autonomía, proactividad y facilidad para trabajar en equipo.
  • Dominio del idioma inglés (deseable).

🌟 ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Aprendizaje práctico y de primer nivel en una agencia global líder en su rubro.
  • Exposición a proyectos retadores y clientes de diversas industrias.
  • Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, inclusivo y orientado a la excelencia profesional.

(¡Ayúdanos a compartir esta oportunidad con quien consideres que cumple con el perfil!)

#OportunidadLaboral #Burson #BursonPeru #AsuntosPublicos #Derecho #Legal #PracticasProfesionales #PublicAffairs #TrabajoPeru #EmpleoPeru

Tu lugar está en Burson:

Nuestra visión es que Burson sea la principal ‘academy company’ para profesionales creativos de la comunicación y líderes emergentes. Ofrecemos un entorno dinámico donde los colaboradores vienen a potenciar sus habilidades, ampliar sus redes y, en última instancia, crear las mejores soluciones para las marcas líderes de hoy. Nuestro compromiso con su crecimiento se refleja en nuestros sólidos programas de beneficios y programas para el talento, que incluyen oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, programas de mentoría con líderes de la industria, una cultura apasionante e inclusiva que fomenta la colaboración y la innovación, así como programas para recompensar y retener a los mejores talentos. Invertimos en nuestra gente porque creemos que su éxito es nuestro éxito.

Burson es una agencia integrada por personas inspiradas en nunca dejar de aprender. Reconocemos que lo que mejor hacemos, la creatividad y la comunicación, requieren un nivel de entendimiento profundo y lleno de matices. Por eso es fundamental para nosotros contratar a personas extraordinariamente talentosas, con diversos contextos culturales e identidades. Sin ello, no podríamos realizar el trabajo esencial de inspirar las ideas más impactantes, fomentar diálogos constructivos, cultivar experiencias significativas e impulsar la innovación y la creatividad para nuestros socios. Tu perspectiva es única -tu talento- es lo que te convierte en un #BursonPerson, y es así como, en equipo, conseguimos resultados excepcionales para nuestros clientes.

Al hacer clic en el botón "Enviar solicitud" a continuación, toda la información que ingresas se enviará a Burson. Antes de continuar, recomendamos revisar nuestra Política de privacidad de Contratación. Las personas residentes de California deben leer nuestro Aviso de privacidad sobre contratación de California. Estos documentos detallan cómo manejamos sus datos personales cuando solicita un puesto de trabajo con nosotros, así como las opciones para actualizar o eliminar la información que nos ha proporcionado.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Interesujesz się biznesem, gospodarką i tematami, które wpływają na funkcjonowanie firm i całych branż? Śledzisz aktualne wydarzenia, rozumiesz zależności pomiędzy biznesem, regulacjami i opinią publiczną? Chcesz pracować dla firm, które kształtują rynek w obszarach takich jak zdrowie, energetyka, przemysł, technologie czy nowoczesne usługi? Dołącz do nas!

Poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Junior Account Executive, która będzie wspierać zespół w realizacji działań z zakresu komunikacji korporacyjnej, relacji z mediami, komunikacji eksperckiej oraz budowania reputacji marek i organizacji. To rola dla osoby, która ma już pierwsze doświadczenie w komunikacji lub PR i chce dalej rozwijać się pod opieką bardziej doświadczonego zespołu.

Pracujemy dla klientów reprezentujących różne sektory gospodarki, w tym m.in. finanse, technologie, healthcare, e-commerce.

Więcej informacji o nas znajdziesz na naszej stronie internetowej.

Oferujemy:

  • Pracę w jednej z największych i najbardziej utytułowanych agencji PR w Polsce i na świecie
  • Hybrydowy model pracy
  • Dostęp do pakietu narzędzi generative AI (abonament na najnowsze wersje najpopularniejszych rozwiązań)
  • Medicover
    • W pełni finansowany pakiet medyczny dla pracowników
    • Możliwość odpłatnego rozszerzenia pakietu dla bliskich
  • Platformę benefitową z kafeterią (w tym Medicover Sport)
  • Jasną ścieżkę kariery, możliwość rozwoju w ramach globalnych i lokalnych szkoleń. Więcej na ten temat przeczytasz w zakładce Kariera na naszej stronie.
  • Wsparcie Twojego dobrostanu psychicznego.
    • Bezpłatna infolinia psychologiczna dla pracowników i ich rodzin 24/7
    • 10 konsultacji rocznie u specjalistów: psycholog, psychiatra, psychoterapeuta
  • Pracę w nowoczesnym biurze w tętniącym życiem Centrum Praskim Koneser
  • 6000-6500 PLN brutto / mies.

Zakres obowiązków:

  • Realizacja działań dla klientów agencji (m.in. tworzenie tekstów, monitoring mediów, kontakt z mediami, pomoc przy organizacji wydarzeń, przygotowywanie rekomendacji oraz kontakt z podwykonawcami)
  • Przygotowywanie raportów, zestawień i prostych analiz danych
  • Wsparcie zespołu w przygotowywaniu rekomendacji i strategii komunikacji
  • Wsparcie przy przygotowywaniu ofert przetargowych i działaniach z zakresu business development
  • Budowanie relacji i współpraca z dziennikarzami, liderami opinii oraz influencerami

Nasze wymagania:

  • Minimum rok doświadczenia zawodowego w zakresie komunikacji / public relations / tworzenia treści do mediów (doświadczenie po stronie agencji PR będzie dodatkowym atutem)
  • Wykształcenie wyższe lub w trakcie studiów
  • Dobra znajomość rynku mediów, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem mediów biznesowych i branżowych
  • Zainteresowanie biznesem, gospodarką i aktualnymi trendami rynkowymi
  • Proaktywna postawa - wychodzenie z inicjatywą do zespołu i gotowość do uczenia się
  • Umiejętność analizowania informacji i wyciągania z nich wniosków
  • Lekkie pióro i posługiwanie się poprawną polszczyzną
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (na poziomie min. B2) - warunek konieczny, poziom językowy sprawdzamy podczas rozmowy rekrutacyjnej

Jak wygląda rekrutacja:

  • Do wybranych kandydatów zadzwoni nasza Talent & Culture Managerka
  • Po rozmowie telefonicznej umawiamy się na spotkanie – stacjonarnie w biurze (mamy pyszną kawę!) lub przez Teams
  • Spotkanie odbywa się w gronie kandydat + HR + manager. Chcemy dać Ci możliwość poznania naszej kultury pracy i dowiedzenia się więcej o tym, jak się u nas pracuje. Nie bój się pytać o to, co jest dla Ciebie ważne!
  • Krótkie zadanie rekrutacyjne – nie martw się, nie zajmie dużo czasu, ale pomoże nam lepiej zrozumieć Twoje kompetencje praktyczne
  • Po zakończeniu rozmów, na pewno damy Ci znać o naszej decyzji

Wierzymy, że różnorodność talentów gwarantuje odważne pomysły i konstruktywny dialog, wspiera innowacje i kreatywność. Poniżej podajemy orientacyjny zakres wynagrodzenia brutto na tym stanowisku w momencie publikacji ogłoszenia. Przedział ten odzwierciedla ramy wynagrodzeń obowiązujące w całej naszej globalnej grupie, obejmujące różnorodne Agencje i specjalizacje. W przypadku tej konkretnej roli, nasza propozycja wynagrodzenia zostanie ustalona w ramach wskazanego zakresu, w oparciu o nasze wewnętrzne wytyczne oraz z uwzględnieniem specyficznych warunków rynkowych dla naszej specjalizacji. Oprócz podanego przedziału wynagrodzeń, oferujemy kompleksowy pakiet benefitów, mający na celu dbanie o Wellbeing naszych pracowników jak i ich rozwój zawodowy.   • Understand the media landscape and be able to help develop and customize media lists for your clients.
  • Build media relationships and be able to leverage relevant knowledge to benefit your clients.
  • Assist in press materials development and support the preparation of press events.
  • Stay updated on social media trends and build relationships with key influencers and community contacts to optimize channels.
  • Embeds Burson proprietary AI tools as a core part of the marketing workflow — applying them to competitor research, content development, campaign performance analysis, and audience strategy to make marketing decisions faster and more informed.
  • You must possess a strong familiarity with how Generative AI tools are used across communications programmes, especially in planning, research, ideation, content creation, and daily operations to drive relevance and efficiency.

job.title: Senior Account Executive/Account Manager - Healthcare Communications
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 

More about the role
We are a diverse team of 40+ healthcare communications specialists who thrive on curiosity, the thrill of a challenge, good old-fashioned fun and working in partnership with clients to improve the health of the world, one brilliant idea at a time.

We deliver global, EMEA and UK integrated marketing communications solutions for many of the world’s leading healthcare companies. Our breadth of work is limitless, as we challenge ourselves to innovate in all that we do and really make a difference. If it’s led by solid-insight or data, nothing is out of reach; from traditional media campaigns, data communications and brand launches, to multi-channel digital and social media programmes, to influencer campaigns and disease awareness initiatives, to patient apps or patient advocacy partnerships, to multi-award-winning corporate re-positioning videos and crisis management, the list is endless.

We are very proud to have been awarded the EMEA Healthcare Consultancy of the Year for a few years running, as well as having received awards across the board in Social Media, PR, Marketing, Innovation, Digital and Influencer categories – an accolade to be proud of when pitted against some of the best consumer campaigns from less-regulated industries.

We believe that working here is a chance to change lives, including your own. We’re a super supportive team with a warm, friendly and social culture. Through our solid PDP process and ongoing training and support, we pride ourselves on nurturing our people to be their very best.

Our London Office
Burson employs over 450 people in the UK, and our stunning Southwark offices run over two floors as part of the larger WPP Campus, Rose Court. We have access to a beautiful roof terrace with panoramic views across London and a bar/restaurant area, which is a great spot for client meetings and socialising with the wider agency and other WPP OpCo’s.

What you'll do

  • Bring enthusiasm for the intersection of communications and healthcare.

  • Join a dynamic, fast-paced team environment at Burson.

  • Start your career strong as an Account Executive with structured support.

  • Assist with essential account administration for client and team projects.

  • Learn on the job under the guidance of experienced managers.

  • Stay updated on industry news and understand its client impact.

  • Show a strong interest in healthcare and media trends.

Experience that contributes to success

  • Team Contribution: Show a can-do attitude, flexibility, and eagerness to contribute.

  • Account Administration: Deliver high-quality, proactive support to improve account efficiency.

  • Programme Support: Take ownership of specific tasks to aid campaign execution.

  • Skills Development: Build core PR and integrated marketing competencies.

  • Media Management: Support media outreach and response activities effectively.

  • Digital Media: Develop knowledge of digital and social media tools to enhance client work.

  • Reporting: Provide accurate, timely reporting to document and communicate client activity.

  • Quality & Spec Standards: Address internal and client edits throughout the approval process, delivering final assets to exact technical specifications. 
  • Post-Production Operations & Asset Management 
  • Process & Workflow Spearheading: Partner with Creative Operations and Production leads to develop robust post-production processes (file structures, spec sheets for editors, taxonomy, and project forecasting).

This is a great opportunity for a writer who loves the challenge of making complex science feel human, relevant, and creatively powerful. You’ll work at the intersection of medical rigor and brand storytelling, helping shape work that is strategically grounded, emotionally intelligent, and deeply impactful.

  • Partner with an Art Director and broader creative team to develop integrated campaign concepts and executions
