Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a New Business Lead to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry seeks an accomplished and strategically minded Head of New Business to lead the agency’s growth function and drive best-in-class business development for 21GRAMS. In this role, you will establish and refine new business processes, develop a high-performing growth team, and serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior leadership, directly impacting pipeline development, win rates, and revenue growth.

This position is integral to 21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, a healthcare advertising and communications firm dedicated to making healthcare more human through innovative, client-centered work conducted with integrity and excellence. You will lead all aspects of new business development, from opportunity identification through pitch execution. You will ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized experience, fostering collaboration, efficiency and confidence at every stage.

Additionally, you will help own the new client onboarding process, ensuring that day-to-day brand teams are fully equipped with the insights, timelines, and resources needed to service each brand from day one. This critical handoff function bridges the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work, setting the foundation for long-term client partnerships.

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.

What you’ll do:

New Business Process Development

  • Establish, refine, and enforce new business processes and standards across the agency
  • Create repeatable frameworks for how opportunities are evaluated, pursued, and executed

Growth Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing new business team
  • Ensure every team member involved in the pitch process has a seamless, organized, and collaborative experience

Pipeline Management

  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities 
  • Manage the full pipeline from initial opportunity through close 
  • Track and report on win rates, pipeline health, Saleforce integration, and revenue impact 

Pitch Leadership

  • Lead and support pitch efforts across the agency and with Real Chemistry Partners
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams through the pitch process 
  • Foster confidence and collaboration at every stage of the pursuit

Strategic Partnership with Senior Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to agency leadership on all growth matters 
  • Inform and influence go-to-market strategy across therapeutic areas including launch planning

New Client Onboarding

  • Help own the end-to-end onboarding process for all newly won clients 
  • Ensure day-to-day account teams are fully equipped with the insights, context, and resources needed to service each brand from day one 
  • Bridge the gap between winning the business and delivering exceptional work

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution
  • 12+ years of new business, account management, or project management experience in a healthcare advertising setting
  • Minimum 5+ years in a leadership or supervisory capacity managing high-performing, cross-functional teams in high-pressure environments
  • Demonstrated expertise in pharmaceutical advertising, healthcare communications, or life sciences agency environment with hands-on experience managing teams and new business opportunities
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical promotion standards, FDA/OPDP guidance, and healthcare communications
  • Demonstrated ability in data analysis, reporting, and translating metrics into actionable business insights
  • Working knowledge of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches, with ability to select appropriate methodology for each pitch opportunity
  • Proven track record of leading, developing, and motivating teams to high performance
  • Executive-level communication skills—ability to present complex information clearly to C-suite audiences, stakeholders, and clients
  • Strong written and verbal communication with ability to adapt messages for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinking and sound judgment, with demonstrated ability to solve complex problems, make decisions under uncertainty, and balance competing priorities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Deep expertise in pharmaceutical advertising and healthcare communications, particularly with experience in oncology, rare disease, specialty pharmaceuticals, or other complex therapeutic areas
  • Demonstrated results from process improvement initiatives with measurable impact on efficiency gains, cost reduction, or quality improvement
  • Client relationship management experience at a senior level, including presenting to pharmaceutical and biotech executives

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

Professional Competencies

  • Strategic Business Leadership: Setting vision and direction; aligning operations with business objectives; thinking beyond immediate execution to organizational capability building
  • Process Excellence: Designing, implementing, and continuously improving standardized processes and workflows that scale across new business
  • Stakeholder Management: Building and maintaining effective relationships with executives, clients, cross-functional partners, and team members; navigating competing interests
  • Organizational Development: Building high-performing teams, developing talent, creating culture, and leading organizational change

Required Leadership Attributes

  • Change-Positive, Growth-Oriented

You actively seek smarter, faster, and more effective ways to operate. You are not threatened by AI, innovation, new tools, or new ways of working—you're energized by them. You challenge legacy thinking thoughtfully, experiment with confidence, and view change as an advantage rather than a disruption. You don't defend the status quo because "it works"; you see every process, system, and methodology as a candidate for improvement. You are quick to spot opportunities to expand how we operate collectively and you bring others along on that journey. You stay current with emerging PM tools and methodologies because you're genuinely curious about better ways forward, not because compliance requires it.

  • Commercially and Market Aware

You operate beyond internal agency mechanics and understand the bigger picture. You know your clients' business contexts, therapeutic landscapes, and commercial realities well enough to make informed decisions, ask smarter questions, and connect execution to real-world impact. You don't need to be a medical expert, but you are an industry-savvy operator who understands pharma economics, launch timelines, competitive dynamics, and patient access challenges. You ask "why does this matter commercially?" and "what does success look like for the client?" regularly. This commercial acumen informs how you scope projects, allocate resources, and prioritize decisions. You help your team see beyond deliverables to outcomes.

  • Confident Driver of Progress

You embrace being a driver, not just a facilitator or administrator. You create momentum, push for clarity and decisions when you see ambiguity, hold teams accountable constructively without micromanaging, and move work forward even when information is imperfect or circumstances are complicated. You don't wait for consensus to take action; you make smart calls and bring people along. You recognize that indecision is a decision, and you're willing to take that on. You drive toward clear wins and celebrate progress, which energizes your teams and builds confidence across the organization.

  • Steward of Team Balance and Performance

You actively shape the health of the system, not just the output. You recognize burnout early—in individuals and in teams—and you recalibrate workload, expectations, or resources proactively before people break. You also recognize underperformance with equal clarity and you raise the bar constructively, providing support and accountability. You design operating rhythms, sprint cycles, and governance structures that support both sustainable, high performance and uncompromising standards. You understand that how people feel about their work is as important as what they produce, and that sustainable excellence requires both.

  • Ownership Mindset and Creative Agency

You do not wait for permission to elevate the work. You bring forward ideas on how to operate better, propose smarter ways of organizing projects, design stronger plans, and take responsibility for improving outcomes beyond your assigned scope. You see gaps and fill them. You spot inefficiencies and fix them. You don't assume "that's someone else's problem"—you own the enterprise. This doesn't mean doing everything yourself; it means taking initiative to identify what needs to change and driving toward solutions. Your ownership extends to your team's success, your clients' outcomes, and the health of the broader organization.

  • Strong Judgment and Prioritization Instincts

You consistently make good calls under pressure and constraint. You distinguish signal from noise in a sea of competing demands. You make smart trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk with sound instinct—not by formula. You prioritize effectively, recognizing what matters most and what can wait. You have good instincts about people, situations, and strategic priorities, and you trust those instincts while remaining open to new information. When you have to move fast, you do. When you need to be deliberate, you are. You know the difference, and you rarely get it wrong.

  • Courage and Comfort with Productive Discomfort

You are willing to push when it's uncomfortable and challenge constructively when you see a better path. You hold tension without smoothing it away prematurely; you recognize that some of the best solutions come from sitting with uncomfortable questions rather than resolving them quickly. You make difficult calls when needed—hard conversations, tough decisions, unpopular stands—with confidence rather than approval-seeking. You bring backup (data, reasoning, alternatives) to every discussion. You operate with the confidence of someone who takes responsibility for their decisions and is willing to defend them, but you're also genuinely open to being wrong and course-correcting when new information warrants it.

Pay Range: $250,000-$290,000

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Technology Lead to join our growing team!   

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has done a lot in its first 5+ years. Known for our creativity, we've just been ranked as the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. It takes a team to do ambitious things, and our ambition is to help people connect with healthcare – by making advertising less of an interruption and more worth people’s time because it gets them. As an agency with the full capabilities of Real Chemistry at our fingertips, we’ve got endless potential.   

At ROOM42 — 21GRAMS' in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — we are seeking an AI-Forward Technical Lead who is simultaneously a craftsperson, a creative partner, and an accelerator. This person moves fluidly between writing production-quality code, protecting design intent through every build decision, and orchestrating AI tooling to compress the distance from concept to shipped experience. Whether the starting point is a client brief, a Figma file, or a napkin sketch, this Technical Lead is the person who figures out the fastest, most technically sound path to a working, beautiful, compliant deliverable — and builds it. 

This role spans the full ROOM42 output spectrum: marketing websites, microsites, conference kiosks and panel experiences, interactive apps, and data-driven digital tools for healthcare and pharma clients. The ideal candidate has mastered the traditional web development lifecycle and is actively transforming it — using AI at every meaningful stage. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do:  

Build and Architect 

  • Own end-to-end technical execution for ROOM42 deliverables — websites, microsites, interactive apps, conference kiosk and panel experiences, and real-world evidence platforms 

  • Write and review production-quality code across the full stack; maintain a target of 50% direct hands-on contribution alongside leadership responsibilities 

  • Architect solutions that balance speed-to-market with long-term maintainability, security, and accessibility compliance 

  • Lead technical solutioning on new engagements — translating UX wireframes and creative briefs into clearly scoped, achievable builds 

DevOps and Delivery Infrastructure: 

  • Own Git workflows, branching strategy, and code review standards across all active ROOM42 builds 

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for ROOM42's primary hosting environments (WP Engine, Pantheon, Acquia, Netlify/Vercel for JAMstack); make deployments repeatable and low-risk 

  • Manage staging, UAT, and production environment configurations; provision and document access for all ROOM42 developers 

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across the DevOps lifecycle — from scaffolding new projects to post-deploy validation 

 

AI-Augmented Design-to-Code Pipeline: 

  • Operate Figma MCP server integration to accelerate design handoff — extracting tokens, components, and layout specs directly into code-ready outputs; eliminating manual interpretation cycles 

  • Leverage AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor AI) as daily build accelerators — not novelties — across front-end, back-end, and configuration work 

  • Define and document ROOM42's AI-augmented build workflows for each deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner 

  • Stay ahead of emerging agentic tooling (MCP servers, AI browser agents, generative UI frameworks) and evaluate when adoption creates genuine delivery leverage 

 

QA and Test Automation: 

  • Implement AI-assisted QA automation across ROOM42 project types — visual regression testing, accessibility scanning, cross-browser checks, and functional testing pipelines 

  • Establish a QA automation baseline for repeatable deliverable types (CMS sites, kiosk apps, email builds) so that human QA effort concentrates on edge cases and client-specific requirements 

  • Triage technical defects surfaced by QA — classify root cause, assign or resolve remediation, verify fix integrity before re-advancing to UAT  

Standards, Mentorship, and Team Health: 

  • Define and maintain ROOM42's technical standards across deliverable types — coding conventions, repo structure, accessibility requirements, security baselines, deployment protocols 

  •  Conduct code reviews for all ROOM42 developers before deliverables advance to QA; enforce standards consistently and use reviews as teaching moments 

  • Partner with RC's VP of Technology on standards alignment, tooling strategy, and team architecture as the practice scales 

  • Lead technical onboarding for new ROOM42 hires — tool access, standards orientation, and first-week productivity within two weeks of start date 

  • Serve as primary technical escalation point when blockers threaten delivery; resolve environment, integration, and access issues within 24 hours of identification 

 

Technical Delivery: 

  • Partner with Producers and TDMs on SOW scoping — translate creative and functional requirements into accurate technical estimates for hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout 

  • Own the technical delivery lifecycle for key ROOM42 engagement from kickoff through post-launch, work with technical delivery managers to ensure timeline integrity, milestone readiness, and handoff completeness 

  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across all active projects; proactively flag risks to Delivery Managers before they surface in status calls 

  • Drive milestone gates: work closely with QA lead to ensure that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready — not optimistically ready 

  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping APIs, licensing constraints) and surface conflicts before they collide 

  • Own technical documentation throughout each engagement: architecture decisions, environment setup, API integration specs, deployment runbooks — so no knowledge lives only in one person's head 

  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, demo walkthroughs — presenting clearly and without jargon 

 

Quality Outcomes: 

  • Define 'done' for every deliverable type — not just 'it works' but that it is performant, accessible, secure, cross-browser validated, and visually faithful to approved design 

  • Own quality accountability end-to-end: if something ships broken, looks wrong, or fails an MLR technical review, this role is accountable for the root cause and the remediation 

  • Work with QA lead to establish and maintain a ROOM42 quality checklist for each deliverable type — covering functional, visual, performance, accessibility, and security checks — so quality is structural, not ad hoc 

  • Review developer output not only for code correctness but for UX implementation fidelity: does the built experience actually look and behave like the approved design? 

  • Lead post-launch quality reviews on major engagements; document defect patterns and translate them into upstream process improvements 

  • Champion performance as a quality dimension: page load, animation smoothness, kiosk responsiveness, and interactive load times are quality metrics, not afterthoughts 

  • Maintain zero tolerance for preventable defects reaching client UAT — own the internal quality bar so clients aren't the ones finding the obvious problems 

 

Design Eye, UX/UI Partnership, and Creative Collaboration: 

  • Speak UX fluently — understand information architecture, user flows, interaction patterns, and content hierarchy well enough to actively contribute to UX decisions, not just receive them 

  • Evaluate wireframes and prototypes through both a user experience lens and a technical feasibility lens simultaneously: identify where a flow creates friction before it's built, and where a design pattern creates technical debt before it ships 

  • Read a Figma file not just for spec values but for design intent — understand what the designer was solving for and protect that intent through every build decision, especially when specs have gaps or edge cases aren't covered 

  • Catch UX implementation drift before QA does: spot when a multi-step interaction is off-sequence, a loading state is missing, an error condition is unhandled, or a mobile breakpoint breaks the intended user journey 

  • Catch visual implementation drift with the same discipline: notice when padding is off, a typeface is rendering incorrectly, a hover state feels wrong, or a component is pixel-perfect in isolation but contextually broken in the live layout 

  • Participating actively in UX and design reviews as a technical partner — able to say 'that interaction pattern will feel laggy on kiosk hardware' or 'here's how we can get the same UX outcome with a lighter implementation' or 'this flow needs an empty state that the design doesn't account for' 

  • Understand foundational UX/UI principles — user task flow design, progressive disclosure, feedback and affordance, responsive and adaptive layout, motion and timing — well enough to make confident decisions when the design file doesn't cover every scenario 

  • Bridge the gap between design and engineering vocabulary; translate UX intent and creative direction into precise technical implementation notes that developers can execute without ambiguity or interpretation risk 

  • Push back constructively when a UX or design spec is technically infeasible at the required timeline or budget — and always bring an alternative that preserves the experience intent, not just a 'no' 

  • Appreciate that in healthcare and pharma, the human story being told is someone's life — and that the quality of the experience we build, how it feels to use, how clearly it communicates, how gracefully it handles errors, is not separate from the mission 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.  

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.  

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

 

What you should have:   

  • 7+ years of hands-on development experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead, staff engineer, or architect role 

  • Demonstrable full-stack proficiency — not a generalist who dabbles; someone who can build, review, and unblock at every layer 

  • A genuine design eye with UX/UI depth: able to evaluate user flows and interaction patterns for experience quality, read a Figma file for intent, catch UX and visual implementation drift, and make confident decisions at the design-code boundary without designer supervision 

  • Technical delivery experience: has owned milestone tracking, risk communication, and deployment readiness across concurrent projects — not just individual coding output 

  • Demonstrated accountability for quality outcomes: has owned defect triage, post-launch quality reviews, and upstream process improvements when things go wrong 

  • Active, daily practitioner of AI code generation tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) — able to define team-wide workflows around them 

  • Hands-on experience with Figma MCP server or comparable design-to-code AI tooling; familiar with design token standards and component handoff patterns 

  • QA automation experience: visual regression, accessibility automation, or AI-assisted test generation in a production environment

Job Summary: 

Real Chemistry is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team!

Real Chemistry is looking for driven, savvy game changers who are ready to dive into the trenches and make an immediate impact. We are currently seeking an Account Manager with client services experience in healthcare. The position offers a great opportunity for an individual with a passion for healthcare to work with leading clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and health IT fields. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Lambertville, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Responsible for exceptional client service and account management activities for 3-4 accounts
  • In collaboration with account associate, senior management and project management staff, drive flawless and timely project execution and high-touch client communications
  • Participates in development of clients’ marketing strategies and tactics; collaborates with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure consensus around tactics’ scope and approach
  • Support overall account development, resourcing fiscal performance and growth
  • Support day-to-day client contact in executing ad hoc requests and delivering planned activities and materials
  • Develop draft scope of works, contracts, presentations, creative briefs, PR and marketing materials and other internal/external communications
  • Ensure client feedback is gathered, understood and addressed as appropriate across deliverables and internally
  • Document status and otherwise communicate need-to-know information to all project stakeholders to ensure progression along critical path
  • Sets meetings, provides agendas and contact reports
  • Ability to run client calls or meetings independently
  • Manage account finances; must be able to track budget, raise invoices and POs

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

What You Should Have:

  • Highly organized with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail
  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration
  • Professional presence, performs with a sense of urgency and with a client service orientation
  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable
  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget
  • Has good understanding of social media vehicles and is comfortable managing and drafting communications around them
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Good management of Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) – particularly PowerPoint
  • Excellent business communication ability including informal/formal presentation and writing skills; this includes confident public speaking both internally and externally with clients, vendors, and affiliates
  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines
  • Able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Able to clearly communicate project updates, scopes and recommendations to clients
  • Ability to develop project scopes and client and vendor contracts
  • Demonstrated experience with media monitoring, research and taking on projects with limited supervision
  • BA or equivalent work experience required

Real Chemistry (RC) is looking for an Account Manager to join our growing team!   

The Account Manager (AM) is the bridge between the clients and their project needs. This individual ensures the clients’ strategic objectives are met with each project, serves as the trusted advisor to the clients, and must have a strong awareness of the account’s strategic direction and knowledge of the clients’ products. The AM is in a position of leadership within the organization and must successfully partner with the Project Management Team to oversee large project teams and manage multiple projects within an account. The success of this position relies on the success of the team, meeting clients’ expectations, partnering with RC colleagues, and individual performance 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will work eastern business hours.

  • Provide support in driving strategic partnerships with clients by having and applying knowledge of their products and services
  • Act as liaison between client and project teams
  • Ensure strategic objectives are met with each client project
  • Support organic growth opportunities for the account through a strong understanding of RC capabilities, client needs, and attention to buying signals
  • Actively participate in strategic brainstorming sessions and annual strategic planning
  • Partner successfully with Project Management Team to execute projects from the initiating and planning phases through the closing phase
  • Develop and manage project creative briefs and client scope statements
  • Supervise projects to ensure tactical and strategic goals are met
  • Follow all policies, procedures, industry standards, compliance guidelines and ensure team members’ adherence
  • Execute client status meetings and prepare all meeting materials and follow-up items (agendas, notes, etc.)
  • Monitor the overall project scope from a client and account perspective and communicate scope changes when necessary 
  • Provide final approval on all deliverables to ensure strategic objectives are met
  • Develop and communicate status reports with management and the client, monitor project and team results against client expectations 
  • Monitor and manage project-related risks and issues in partnership with the project manager; resolve and escalate risks and issues to the client when needed
  • Attend and contribute to department meetings and trainings 
  • Any other duties as assigned; duties and responsibilities may be removed, modified, or added by leadership at any time as business or operations require
  • Model our RC values in interactions with colleagues, clients, vendors, healthcare professionals and others as well as exercising appropriate levels of professionalism and professional judgment when representing our agency
  • Demonstrate work efficiencies by managing time, meeting deadlines, and achieving utilization expectations 
  • Display appropriate teaming and collaboration skills, including proactively communicating changes, completing tasks as assigned and on agreed timeline to avoid overload of teammates, adapting to changes provided by the team, and seeking opportunities to help others
  • Commit to conducting business according to the highest ethical standards, as demonstrated by a strong knowledge of industry legal compliance guidelines appropriate to the position, organizational ethics, and individual ethics and integrity
  • Demonstrate proactive learning by asking questions to seek answers appropriate to the role and level of experience/training, seeking feedback and actioning for improvement
  • Apply the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to deliver exceptional work, as exhibited by strong accuracy, problem solving, quality management, and client centered behaviors

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

AI Business Partner - Activation

Role Overview

The AI Business Partner translates business priorities into practical AI solutions that improve how work gets done. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, domain expertise, and applied AI, this role identifies high-value opportunities, builds working prototypes and pilots, and partners cross-functionally to scale successful solutions.

This Partner will be aligned to Activation, a portfolio that spans media, social, content, creator/influencer/Starpower, and omnichannel. The work will vary across these areas and will be conducted in partnership with the designated business and discipline leads. Discipline leaders own business strategy, workflow priorities, functional requirements, stakeholder alignment and adoption within their respective capabilities. The Activation AI Business Partner brings applied AI and technical expertise to assess feasibility, prototype solutions, support operationalization and scale validated capabilities across Activation. The right person is comfortable moving between distinct disciplines with different maturity levels, tooling and ways of working, and can sequence where to focus first.

This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly from ambiguity to action — working with stakeholders to define problems, rapidly testing ideas using modern generative AI tools, and helping the organization adopt AI in ways that are useful, responsible, and aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

AI Opportunity Identification & Prioritization

  • Partner with business and discipline leaders to identify high-value opportunities to apply generative AI across workflows, deliverables, and business processes.
  • Translate business priorities, functional requirements and user needs defined with discipline leaders into clearly scoped AI use cases, pilots, and solution concepts.
  • Assess opportunities based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, adoption potential, scalability and risk.
  • Partner with discipline leaders  to prioritize opportunities within individual capabilities and help sequence initiatives  across the broader Activation portfolio.
  • Maintain visibility across the Activation AI opportunity pipeline to identify shared needs, reusable components, dependencies and opportunities for cross-discipline scale

 

Prototyping & Solution Development

  • Build and iterate on working prototypes, pilots, and lightweight AI-enabled tools in response to business priorities and functional requirements established with business and discipline leads using modern development environments, LLM APIs, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
  • Design prompts, workflows, and tool interactions that guide AI behavior toward accurate, useful, and contextually relevant outcomes.
  • Test solutions quickly with representative users and discipline subject matter experts, incorporate user feedback, and refine prototypes based on real-world usage and evolving requirements.
  • Move ideas from concept to demonstrable value, balancing speed, practicality, technical feasibility, quality and responsible AI requirements.
  • Provide technical consultation during discovery to help discipline leaders distinguish between workflow, process, data, platform and AI-related needs

 

Cross-Functional Delivery & Scaling

  • Own the technical progression of validated concepts from discovery through prototype, pilot, handoff and scaling, in partnership with the appropriate teams (i.e., platform, data, security, governance teams, etc.)
  • Partner closely with AI technical teams, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions where appropriate.
  • Define technical requirements, solution dependencies, integration considerations and implementation paths in partnership with technical specialists.
  • Identify when an opportunity should be addressed through an existing enterprise capability, workflow redesign, vendor solution, configurable agent, lightweight prototype, or production-grade build.
  • Work with business and discipline leads to align on priorities, solution design, success metrics, rollout approach and post-launch ownership.

 

Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

  • Partner with discipline leaders to support successful adoption of AI solutions through solution-specific guidance, training, onboarding materials, and usage playbooks.
  • Communicate AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations in clear, accessible language for non-technical audiences.
  • Equip discipline leaders and subject matter experts with reusable materials they can adapt for role-specific training, change management, and workflow adoption.
  • Capture adoption feedback, usage barriers, and technical issues and translate them into product or solution improvements.
  • Help build AI fluency across the organization by enabling teams to use tools responsibly and effectively in their day-to-day work.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

 

Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

  • Help ensure AI solutions are designed and applied in ways that are responsible, compliant, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare communications environment.
  • Incorporate considerations related to privacy, safety, quality, transparency, and human oversight into solution design and rollout.
  • Partner with relevant stakeholders to align AI use with organizational standards, governance expectations, and evolving best practices.
  • Promote thoughtful experimentation while maintaining appropriate safeguards and quality controls.

 

Domain Expertise Application

  • Apply working knowledge strong understanding of healthcare communications, including advertising, activation, communications, and medical domains, to shape relevant and impactful AI solutions.
  • Apply working knowledge of and demonstrate fluency in paid media, social, and influencer marketing — including the platforms, buying and measurement mechanics, and campaign workflows that drive day-to-day execution.
  • Partner with designated discipline leaders and subject matter experts for deep functional expertise, strategic judgement, workflow validation and quality assessment.
  • Understand how agency Activation teams operate, including campaign cycles, reporting cadences, client and platform dependencies, and where handoffs create friction.
  • Ensure solutions reflect real-world workflows, stakeholder needs, and the nuances of regulated client environments.
  • Translate domain knowledge into practical requirements that improve usability, relevance, and business fit.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in AI innovation, product, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated experience in media, social, influencer, or adtech — agency-side, platform-side, or in an ad tech product/analytics role. This background is a priority for this position; the technical dynamics of media are difficult to learn quickly on the job.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, and iterating on generative AI workflows, prototypes, copilots, agents, or similar solutions.
  • Proficiency with LLM APIs, prompting strategies, AI-assisted development environments, and modern tools used to prototype AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical, testable AI use cases and solution concepts.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and execution skills in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to evaluate solutions through the lens of usefulness, risk, quality, and business impact.

 

Skills and Competencies

  • Paid Media; Social Media; Influencer Marketing; Campaign Operations; Media Measurement & Analytics
  • Agentic Workflows; AI - Artificial Intelligence; Large Language Models (LLMs); Machine Learning
  • Coding; Programming Languages; Software Engineering
  • Product Demonstration; Technical Troubleshooting
  • Implementation Management; Solution Delivery; Solution Design
  • Client Relationship Management; Problem Analysis; Workflow Analysis

 

This position is crucial in driving the execution of AI strategies at Real Chemistry, ensuring that AI initiatives are not only innovative but also practical, effective, and aligned with real-world needs. The chosen candidate will play a pivotal role in enhancing the organization's capabilities and fostering a culture of AI-driven innovation and continuous improvement.

Real Chemistry is seeking an  AI Transformation Senior Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Senior Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

  • Think like a consultant and act like an owner, bringing structured problem solving and a bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges.
  • Are energized by rethinking traditional processes for the age of AI, and stay curious about emerging tools, agents, and automation approaches.
  • See the whole picture across people, processes, systems, vendors, and data, and understand how a change in one area ripples through the others.
  • Are highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, adept at managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while delivering results under tight deadlines.
  • Build trust quickly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership, and can guide teams confidently through change.

What you should have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in strategy, transformation, or digital consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Deloitte Digital, or similar firms, large or boutique), or in a corporate strategy, transformation, or M&A integration role.
  • Hands-on experience with transformation work, such as digital transformation, M&A integration, acquisitions, or divestitures, including process mapping, integration or separation planning, Day 1 readiness, or operating model design.
  • Demonstrated experience mapping current- and future-state processes and designing target operating models, ideally across G&A or back-office functions.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation platforms such as Power Automate or Workato, or RPA) and the ability to translate business needs into practical automation use cases.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and analysis tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings simply and confidently to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • PR, communications, advertising, healthcare, or agency experience a plus.

Director, Technical Product Operations

Role Summary

Real Chemistry is seeking a hands-on Director, Technical Product Operations to own the end-to-end management, operation, and security of our flagship client-facing SaaS products.  These platforms are hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS), delivered to clients as a commercial product, engineered to be SOC 2 compliant, and increasingly powered by AI-enabled features.

This is a working leadership role — not a purely strategic one. The successful candidate is a technically credible, roll-up-your-sleeves operator who has personally implemented and run a product on AWS infrastructure, and who can lead a team while remaining directly engaged in architecture, deployment, security, and production support. You will be the single point of accountability for platform availability, performance, security posture, and the fully-supported client experience.

What you'll do:

Platform Ownership & AWS Operations

  • Own the full lifecycle of the client-facing SaaS products hosted on AWS — from infrastructure design and deployment through ongoing operation, optimization, and support.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, resilient AWS environments (compute, storage, networking, databases, backups) with clear separation across development, staging, and production.
  • Lead high-availability and disaster-recovery (HA/DR) design, including backup, failover, and recovery procedures, to meet client and contractual uptime commitments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and controlled promotion paths between environments.
  • Own observability — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting — and drive continuous improvement of platform performance and cost efficiency (FinOps).

Security, Compliance & SOC 2

  • Maintain and continuously mature the platform's security posture, ensuring controls are designed, implemented, evidenced, and audit-ready.
  • Own SOC 2 compliance for the platform — partnering with Information Security and external auditors to sustain Type I and progress toward Type II attestation.
  • Enforce least-privilege identity and access management (AWS IAM), encryption in transit and at rest, secrets management, and tamper-evident audit logging.
  • Coordinate third-party penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation within defined risk timelines.
  • Ensure client-facing security, data-handling, and confidentiality requirements are met and clearly documented for client assurance.

AI-Enabled Product Features

  • Support the secure integration and operation of AI/ML and LLM-enabled features within the product, including approved AI providers, usage boundaries, and cost guardrails.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to productionize AI capabilities with appropriate data classification, DLP, and human-in-the-loop controls where required.

Support, Reliability & Client Experience

  • Ensure the product is fully supported — establishing SLAs, incident response playbooks, on-call coverage, and runbooks for production systems.
  • Serve as senior escalation point for platform incidents, driving rapid resolution and transparent client communication.
  • Own change management, release governance, and post-incident reviews to continuously improve reliability.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Lead, and mentor the external IT / platform engineering team, setting technical standards and delivery discipline.
  • Partner closely with Information Security, Product, and Client-facing teams to align platform capabilities with commercial and client needs.
  • Communicate platform health, risk, and roadmap clearly to both technical teams and executive / C-suite stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors and third parties (AWS and supporting services).

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on track record — the candidate must be a practitioner who has personally implemented and operated a product on AWS infrastructure, not solely a manager of others who do.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing a product on AWS (compute, networking, databases, IAM, IaC) from build through production operation.
  • 7+ years in IT / platform engineering / cloud operations, including 3+ years operating production workloads in AWS.
  • Prior leadership or people-management experience, ideally leading external IT, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering functions.
  • Strong working knowledge of SOC 2 (and adjacent frameworks) and the practical implementation of the underlying controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secrets management, logging/audit).
  • Proven ownership of production reliability — SLAs, incident response, on-call, and HA/DR.
  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable with hands-on technical teams and C-suite stakeholders.

 

What you should have:

  • Experience delivering a client-facing / commercial SaaS product (multi-tenant, externally sold).
  • Experience productionizing AI / LLM-enabled features and governing AI usage, data handling, and cost.
  • Familiarity with regulated or enterprise-client environments (HIPAA-adjacent, GDPR, GxP).
  • Experience with containerization/orchestration (ECS/Fargate, EKS), AWS Lambda, and observability tooling.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps / Security, CISSP, CCSP).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Pay Range: $200,000-$235,000

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing Biddable Media team! 

A Manager, Paid Search is responsible for the end-to-end execution, performance, and day-to-day management of paid search campaigns across assigned accounts. This individual translates client objectives into tactical campaign strategies, owns campaign optimization and budget management, identifies opportunities for account growth, and communicates performance insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. The Manager also coordinates day-to-day projects and begins developing leadership skills by delegating work, overseeing campaign execution, and mentoring junior team members. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

What You'll Do 

  • Own the day-to-day execution and performance of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and supporting search technologies, from planning and setup through launch, optimization, and reporting. 
  • Develop tactical paid search strategies aligned with client objectives, audience strategies, KPIs, and broader integrated media plans. Contribute to campaign forecasts, planning inputs, and supporting data analysis. 
  • Oversee flawless campaign launches, including campaign setup, trafficking, quality assurance, tracking, tagging, and delivery requirements. 
  • Own campaign pacing, budget management, and ongoing optimization, monitoring real-time performance and making data-driven adjustments to meet client KPIs and improve account performance. 
  • Track campaign spend, maintain accurate budget forecasts, and actualize budgets monthly while proactively identifying and communicating pacing or delivery risks. 
  • Troubleshoot platform, tracking, attribution, trafficking, and reporting issues using strong platform expertise and analytical problem-solving skills. 
  • Translate campaign data into clear performance narratives, actionable insights, and optimization recommendations that connect results to client objectives. 
  • Proactively identify and recommend account evolutions, testing opportunities, and platform innovations that improve campaign effectiveness and support account growth. 
  • Communicate account status, campaign performance, and recommendations directly to clients and vendors; participate actively in client meetings and lead day-to-day discussions with support from senior leadership as appropriate. 
  • Develop paid search strategies, performance recommendations, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate day-to-day account projects and collaborate with Integrated Media, Analytics, Strategy, Ad Operations, Creative, and Client Experience teams to deliver campaign objectives and manage cross-functional dependencies. 
  • Delegate and oversee campaign responsibilities assigned to Associates and Senior Associates, breaking down projects into manageable tasks and ensuring deliverables are accurate and timely. 
  • Mentor and train junior team members on platform execution, campaign processes, and best practices while continuing to develop people leadership capabilities. 
  • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, training materials, automation initiatives, and emerging platform capabilities that strengthen team efficiency and performance. 

This Position Is a Perfect Fit for You If  

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What You Should Have  

  • 3+ years of professional experience managing digital media campaigns, with significant hands-on experience in paid search. 
  • Strong expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and paid search campaign management. 
  • Experience managing campaigns end to end, including planning, setup, launch, optimization, reporting, and performance analysis. 
  • Strong understanding of bidding strategies, keyword management, audience targeting, attribution, conversion optimization, and campaign measurement. 
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor campaign performance, manage budgets and pacing, and optimize toward established KPIs. 
  • Experience developing forecasts, tracking spend, and maintaining accurate monthly budget actualization. 
  • Ability to troubleshoot platform, tracking, tagging, attribution, and reporting issues. 
  • Experience translating campaign data into meaningful insights, performance narratives, and optimization recommendations.

job.description:

Role Overview

Real Chemistry is looking for an experienced Senior Analyst (Omnichannel Analytics) to help us build and scale our business intelligence practice for our media and omnichannel clients through advanced analytics, insights, and attribution modeling. We are looking for someone with hands-on-keyboard experience crafting analyses that answer clients’ key business questions about media performance. Reporting to the Director, Beyond Insights, this position will be client facing, with the opportunity to speak to ongoing deliverables and work with cross-functional media, strategy, and technology teams. You will get to use a new set of data partners to seamlessly integrate media and channel data flowing from partners into Tableau dashboards and ultimately client-facing performance reports. 

Location: This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN. 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Build, manage, and deliver time-based performance reporting for media and omnichannel campaigns (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting) 
  • Integrate media, channel, and partner data sources into Tableau dashboards and client-facing performance reports 
  • Conduct data exploration, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and mining across structured media and marketing data sources 
  • Develop quantitative analyses, predictive models, and attribution approaches that explain how media programs are performing and where to optimize 
  • Craft analyses and insights that answer clients’ key business questions, and present findings directly to client and internal stakeholders 
  • Partner with media, strategy, data engineering, and marketing technology teams on measurement methodology and campaign execution 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence/advanced analytics/data analytics working closely with data 
  • Pharmaceutical media and marketing experience, with hands-on exposure to HCP and/or consumer omnichannel campaigns 
  • Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis, including the development of algorithms leveraging SQL, R or Python 
  • Experience working with relational databases and with Snowflake or Databricks 
  • Experience with visualization tools/packages such as Tableau or PowerBI, and with creating dashboards 
  • Experience with reporting in media tools like Google Campaign Manager, Doubleclick Campaign Manager and Adobe Experience Manager 
  • Experience building reports in Google Slides or Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations to senior clients externally or to senior internal stakeholders 
  • Formal training/education in quantitative/data analysis, and an understanding of causal inference 
  • Understanding of visual information design principles 
  • Knowledge of agile principles/project management and experience with agile tools and methodologies 

The Ideal Candidate 

  • Creative. You are energized by turning messy, multi-source media data into clear answers to real business questions. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers 
  • Customer first. You enjoy client-facing work and can explain your analysis and its implications to a non-technical audience 
  • A collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional teams and are comfortable working across Media, Analytics, Strategy, and Technology partners 
  • A culture carrier. You embody Real Chemistry’s values of Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an “I.”

Job Summary:  

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Intelligence join our growing team!   

Real Chemistry Analytics enables smarter decision-making through the power of data, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and actionable insights. Our teams help clients understand audience behavior, measure performance, uncover growth opportunities, and optimize business outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. By combining healthcare expertise with data science, measurement, and strategic consulting, we help clients transform complex information into meaningful actions that drive impact for brands, healthcare professionals, and patients.  

In this role, you will help turn data from a range of sources into meaningful insights and clear, strategic narratives from both quantitative and qualitative data. You will work in partnership with senior leads and cross-functional teams to deliver standard and custom analyses across integrated communications and business questions.  

Curiosity and a willingness to think outside the box are a must, as we are often tasked with answering age-old communications and marketing questions in a new way. 

This role can be remote within the United States or based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN.  

Who you are:   

  • You have a passion for telling stories fueled by data and insights   
  • You’re innovative and want to bring value and new ideas to everything you do   
  • You have a moderate understanding of (or willingness to learn) the healthcare/pharmaceutical space   
  • You thrive in an environment that requires constant learning and adaptation   
  • You are reliable, organized, and conscientious  
  • You work well independently, but also enjoy collaborative work assignments   
  • You get the importance of staying on top of the details and believe in exceeding expectations   

What you’ll do:  

  • Manage and support day-to-day analytics and intelligence workstreams across client accounts, remaining actively involved in the research, data analysis, and development of deliverables. 
  • Assist in the development of integrated analyses that connect multiple data sources and translate findings into clear insights, implications, strategic recommendations, and cohesive narratives. 
  • Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis across social, digital, search, media, audience, competitive, and customer data to uncover meaningful trends and opportunities. 
  • Build and refine keyword-based queries, Boolean searches, data pulls, and analytical frameworks, while guiding junior team members in their development and application. 
  • Aggregate, clean, organize, interpret, and quality-check data, particularly for complex, ambiguous, or high-priority assignments. 
  • Help synthesize research into clear strategic narratives that guide client communications and engagement strategies. 
  • Manage and contribute directly to recurring and ad hoc reporting, as well as audience, influencer, competitive, landscape, and measurement assessments. 
  • Contribute to KPI frameworks, success metrics, benchmarks, and measurement plans. 
  • Partner with account, strategy, activation, data visualization, and data science teams to deliver integrated solutions, and present findings and recommendations to internal and external audiences. 
  • Aid in the management of project timelines, deliverable expectations, and day-to-day coordination while reviewing work, coaching junior team members, and stepping into the details when needed. 
  • Contribute to methodology development, process improvements, proprietary tools, new-business efforts, and capability-building initiatives across the Integrated Intelligence team. 

What you’ll bring:   

  • 4+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: marketing analytics, communications analytics, social listening, digital analytics, audience research, strategic planning, search analytics, primary or syndicated research, or healthcare/pharmaceutical marketing. Agency experience strongly preferred, given the specific client mix for this role. 
  • Deep understanding and experience with social media listening, including comfort working with data across social platforms and familiarity with platforms such as Brandwatch, Quid, Meltwater or Muck Rack.  
  • Familiarity with cross-channel measurement reporting and analytics, including KPI tracking, performance benchmarks, audience engagement, digital behavior, and communications outcomes. 
  • Project management experience, including handling timelines and expectations for multiple deliverables. 
  • Experience developing reporting deliverables, landscape analyses, performance readouts, or insight-driven presentations.  
  • Experience with multi-modal research approaches, using novel data sets and triangulating across methodologies to deliver impact. 
  • A passion for telling stories motivated by data and insights, bringing creativity to analytics, and merging art and science, qual and quant.  
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot.

  • Conduct primary and desk research to build a clear understanding of markets, sectors, audiences and behaviours. 
  • Develop consumer and stakeholder insights that help shape creative and brand strategy. 
  • Carry out category and competitor analysis, identifying the most relevant opportunities and challenges. 
  • Support senior strategy colleagues across global account work, strategic projects and client deliverables. 
  • Contribute to creative briefs, strategic narratives and presentations, making complex findings clear and engaging. 
  • Work closely with Creative, Client Services, Medical Education and wider cross-functional teams. 
  • Support new business pitches through research, insight development and strategic thinking. 
  • Present thinking confidently to internal teams and, as experience grows, to clients. 
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving agency environment. 

This position is a perfect fit for you if 

  • You are curious, creative and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in understanding people and what drives them. 
  • You are a clear and engaging communicator who enjoys presenting ideas and contributing to discussion. 
  • You bring positive energy, ambition and a desire to develop within strategy. 
  • You can balance detailed research with the ability to step back, identify the key insight and tell a compelling story. 
  • You are collaborative, proactive and comfortable working across different disciplines and with colleagues in other markets. 
  • You are adaptable, organised and able to deliver high-quality work against deadlines. 
  • Our Company values - Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” - really speak to you. 

What you should have 

  • Approximately 3-5 years of strategy, planning, research or insight experience within an agency environment. 
  • Experience in healthcare advertising is welcome, but candidates from traditional consumer or AOR advertising agencies who are interested in moving into healthcare will also be considered. 
  • A strong foundation in market research, desk research, audience insight and competitor or category analysis. 
  • Experience working across more than one client, category, sector or therapy area. 
  • An understanding of how agency teams operate, including fast-paced delivery and changing priorities. 
  • Experience supporting new business pitches is useful but not essential. 
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, persuasive recommendations. 
  • A collaborative mindset and the potential to grow into greater strategic ownership over time.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

The Role:  

We're looking for a senior social-first content creator who lives and breathes digital culture and knows exactly what stops the scroll. You'll create platform-native content that connects brand goals with real-world healthcare impact, blending creativity, strategy, and what audiences are actually engaging with right now. You will sit and be embedded on the social media team. 

This is your chance to make health feel less clinical and more human, using your design chops, storytelling instincts, and cultural fluency to create scroll-worthy work that performs. Think: TikTok edits that explain the science and get shared. Instagram carousels that inform without boring. And LinkedIn posts that even non-HCPs want to save.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily support East Coast working hours; candidates based in other time zones may be considered if they are comfortable working East Coast hours.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Develop platform-native content concepts and creative approaches tailored to how audiences consume content across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and emerging social platforms
  • Turn complex (sometimes science-y) info into clean, creative stories that hit for both consumers and professionals  
  • Serve as a social-first creative expert, advising internal teams on content formats, creator trends, editing styles, platform best practices, and evolving audience behaviors
  • Collaborate with social strategy to develop concepts and formats that break through  
  • Identify emerging trends, content formats, and cultural moments to inform timely, relevant social content
  • Contribute to new business and pitch work with agile social-by-design creative that shows what we’re capable ofour social-first approach to content

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

What you should have:  

  • 4-5 years of content creation experience (agency, freelance, in-house doesn’t matter as long as you’ve got the receipts)  
  • Experience creating social content using Adobe Creative Suite, and related creative tools, including Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or After Effects, with the ability to select the right tool for the right creative challenge
  • Experience creating short-form video, social graphics, carousels, motion assets, and creator-style content
  • Partner with social strategy to concept, and independently create, edit, and deliver social content from idea through final asset while balancing multiple brands
  • Able to translate complex topics into content that informs and engages 
  • Organized, fast-moving, and unfazed by multiple workstreams or deadlines 
  • Passionate about creativity with purpose and how digital content can actually drive better health outcomes
