  • Demonstrated success managing and growing complex enterprise relationships and multimillion-dollar accounts. 
  • Experience advising senior leaders on communications, reputation, stakeholder engagement, public affairs, or related business challenges. 
  • Strong ability to synthesize research, analytics, and insights into clear strategic recommendations. 
  • Outstanding executive communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. 
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and navigate complex client organizations. 
  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of client retention and expansion. 

 

Preferred Background

Promotion/Social Media Specialist - KS95

#26-1339

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

KSTP-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

Hubbard Radio-Twin Cities is a full-service media company with legendary radio stations and cutting-edge digital solutions. We serve the Greater Minneapolis-Saint Paul community and offer a menu of marketing services including radio, full-service digital, influencer marketing, creative services, custom content, podcasts and events. At Hubbard, we're looking for the best people in local media to help build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion.

Job Overview

The Promotions Coordinator/Social Media Strategist serves as the primary liaison for contest winners, manages prize fulfillment, coordinates station events, and works closely with programming, sales, and promotional partners to ensure flawless execution of station campaigns and experiences. The role also provides support for the station's digital and social media strategy by analyzing audience engagement, evaluating campaign performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and helping shape content strategies that strengthen listener connection and brand impact.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-service focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines and moving pieces.

Job Responsibilities

Contest & Promotion Management

Coordinate and execute all on-air and online contests and giveaways.

Manage winner selection, verification, paperwork collection, and prize fulfillment.

Process contest-related documentation, including tax forms and check requests.

Track winner paperwork and ensure compliance with station, legal, and accounting requirements.

Maintain accurate records of prize inventory and distribution.

Monitor and respond to promotions email and phone lines.

Event Coordination

Execute station events, appearances, and promotional activations.

Coordinate event staffing, logistics, and communication with sales, talent, and street team.

Create event materials, schedules, and briefing sheets.

Maintain event supplies, promotional inventory, and station vehicles.

Attend and support station events, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy

Create a station social media strategy for KS95. Provide actionable recommendations to enhance station/brand content performance, audience growth, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Assist with content planning and social media calendars, ensuring consistent and strategic messaging across platforms.

Coach and direct the team on best practices in social media posting by platforms.

Analyze social media, digital marketing, and audience engagement performance to identify trends, successes, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

Help execute sponsor and client deliverables across social media platforms.

Assist in promoting station events, contests, and community initiatives.

Stay informed on emerging social media trends across platform changes, algorithm updates, digital marketing best practices, and new advertising opportunities across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging digital channels.

Experience using analytics and reporting tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, or similar platforms.

Ability to analyze audience, social media, and promotional campaign data; identify what is driving engagement and results; and make strategic recommendations for future content, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and Holidays.

Preferred

Experience in radio, media, entertainment, promotions, marketing, or event coordination.

Familiarity with WordPress, VPromo, Asana, Audience, and Canva

Experience with contesting, prize fulfillment, and event logistics.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The hourly rate of pay for this position is $24.04 per hour.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.

 

 

CUMULUS MEDIA | York-Lancaster, PA Our local stations in the York-Lancaster, PA area include I-105 Pennsylvania’s Country Leader (WIOV-FM), 96.1 SOX The Susquehanna Valley’s Greatest Hits (WSOX-FM) WARM 103.3 80s-90s-NOW (WARM-FM) and NEWSTALK 93.9 & 910 WSBA-AM.  Cumulus Digital is our portfolio of Digital Advertising Products for Local Businesses.

The Multi-Media Advertising Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of sales experience required; with background in broadcast, media or digital advertising sales highly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or related field preferred, but not required.

  • Valid driver's license required. Driving is an essential function of this position because regular travel is required to perform key job duties, including meeting with clients & prospects, as well as attending business-related events.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects.

  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit; with a positive and friendly attitude and willingness to collaborate.

  • High energy and passion for sales.

job.title: Programming & Executive Assistant, FOX Nation & Talent Development
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to support the President of FOX Nation & Talent Development. This role provides high-level executive and operational support across FOX Nation programming, talent development, and FOX News Books. The ideal candidate is a resourceful, detail-oriented professional with exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and handle confidential information in a fast-paced environment.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage a complex executive calendar, coordinate meetings with internal and external stakeholders, resolve scheduling conflicts, and oversee communications with professionalism and discretion.
  • Prepare daily briefings on ratings, programming, talent schedules, premieres, and production updates. Conduct research and develop polished presentations, talent profiles, organizational charts, and executive materials.
  • Coordinate talent meetings, visits, and engagements; support prospective hires and industry partners; and manage onboarding for new talent.
  • Track upcoming releases, premieres, livestreams, and production developments; coordinate screeners and viewing materials; and prepare programming summaries for executive review.
  • Collaborate with talent on book projects from concept through publication, coordinating editorial development, research, design, cover art, marketing, and promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate talent appearances, promotional shoots, live events, executive meetings, and other strategic initiatives, ensuring schedules, logistics, and materials are aligned.
  • Arrange domestic and international travel, accommodations, transportation, itineraries, catering, and meetings for executives, talent, and guests.
  • Process expense reports through Workday, manage correspondence and office needs, and maintain efficient day-to-day operations while safeguarding sensitive information.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Prior administrative experience in a fast-paced professional environment.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and changing schedules.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with senior executives, talent, and external partners.
  • Strong research, problem-solving, presentation development, and information management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with Canva and other presentation tools.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the flexibility to adapt quickly, collaborate across departments, and adjust work hours as business needs require.

job.title: DIGITAL PRODUCER/REPORTER - KTUU
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KTUU:

Alaska's News Source has a reputation of excellence as the state's most-watched news source, producing 32 hours of broadcast news, weather, and sports content each week on KTUU-TV/Channel 2 and KYES/Channel 5 in Anchorage as well as KATH and KYEX in Southeast Alaska. Strong reach and brand loyalty are augmented by added broadcast distribution to more than 200 rural communities throughout the state via ARCS-TV, Alaska's rural communications service. A leader in digital content, AlaskasNewSource.com offers breaking news and statewide community coverage. Our News and Weather Apps, podcasts, and streaming content offered through Connected TV platforms reach audiences far beyond broadcast. Our mission is "To Tell Alaska's Story," and we strive to consistently distinguish ourselves as Alaska's preferred source for news, information, and community service.

Job Summary/Description:

The Digital Content Producer/Reporter gathers, writes, reports, and copy edits news stories for all digital platforms, apps, and digital extensions in addition to generating story ideas for digital and broadcast coverage, editing, and posting multimedia content to all digital platforms and social media. Appearances on CTV, television, and digital platforms/social media as an on-camera reporter should be expected. This position may also be called upon to shoot video and live stream press conferences or breaking news events as warranted. This shift will include work on nights and weekends, as well as fill-in shifts to cover the AM shift, as assigned.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but not be limited to) the following:

* Strong journalism and writing skills with an emphasis on AP style
* Copy-edit digital news stories written by other newsroom reporters
* Social media skills as related to journalism
* Video news gathering, shooting, and video/audio editing
* On-camera presentation of news as assigned for CTV, digital, and broadcast platforms
* Make phone calls and work with other reporters/newsmakers to generate content for all digital platforms and broadcast
* Create eye-catching visuals and graphics to increase digital and social media engagement
* Develop and maintain sources for online and on-air reporting
* Constant vigilance of current events
* Respond to viewer/reader inquiries by phone, email, and social media
* Various shift work will be required; holiday work required

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Knowledge of AP Stylebook
* Able to use social media outlets to engage viewers
* Must be able to shoot and edit video (Grass Valley Edius knowledge is a plus)
* Must be able to work well under pressure and with limited supervision
* Strong initiative and attention to detail is required
* Ability to maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving in a manner that will work well with co-workers, supervisors, and viewers/readers
* Solid keyboarding skills
* Comfort and clear, accurate, conversational delivery style on-air and on digital LIVE platforms
* Ability to work with Google Docs, ARC CMS, ENPS, Grass Valley edit, or equivalent
* College Degree in Journalism or equivalent
* Valid Driver's License and clean driving record

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy, including weather and newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

San Diego is one of the most enviable places to live in the country, and for good reason. With its year-round Mediterranean climate, stunning Pacific beaches, and iconic landmarks like Balboa Park, the world-famous San Diego Zoo, and the historic Gaslamp Quarter, the city offers a lifestyle that's hard to match. Whether you're catching waves at La Jolla Shores, hiking the bluffs at Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve, or exploring the vibrant food scene in North Park and Barrio Logan, there's always something new to discover.


San Diego is also a proud sports city, home to the MLB's San Diego Padres at Petco Park and the newest addition to the local sports landscape, San Diego FC of MLS. The craft beer scene is legendary — with pioneering breweries like Stone Brewing and Ballast Point putting the city on the national map. The city's close proximity to the Pacific coast, mountains, desert, and the international border with Tijuana, Mexico, makes it one of the most geographically diverse metros in the nation.


Beyond the beaches and burritos, San Diego boasts a thriving tech and biotech industry, world-class universities, and a strong military community that gives the city a deeply patriotic and community-minded spirit. It's a place where big-city energy meets laid-back coastal living — and once you're here, it's easy to see why so many people never want to leave.

job.title: Coordinator, Channel Operations (FAST)
job.description:
Tennis Channel is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Coordinator, Channel Operations to support the 24/7/365 operational execution and day-of-air integrity of our expanding portfolio of FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television) channels, including Tennis Channel 2 and PickleballTV.

Reporting directly to the Manager, FAST Channel Operations, this role serves as an essential operational point of contact responsible for daily playlist preparation, live tournament tracking, metadata accuracy, advertising cue-point verification, and transmission quality control. Because professional tennis operates across global time zones, this position requires full flexibility to work non-traditional hours—including dedicated overnights, early mornings, weekends, and holidays aligned with international tournament coverage.

The ideal candidate thrives in a high-tempo live sports broadcast environment, possesses sharp technical and editorial problem-solving skills, and demonstrates meticulous attention to detail under tight live-to-air deadlines.

This role is onsite and located in Santa Monica, CA.

 

  • Hours & Shift Structure: 24/7/365 operations coverage. This is a full-time position working dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, including weekends and holidays, aligned with live tournament windows across worldwide time zones (ATP/WTA global tours, Grand Slams, PPA pickleball).

  •  

In this role you will...

Execute Channel Scheduling & Playout

  • Under the direction of the Manager, build, review, maintain, and release accurate daily and multi-day channel playlists utilizing cloud-based playout systems (e.g., Amagi) and traffic schedules.

  • Coordinate playlist timing and media elements for live matches, studio wrap shows, encore telecasts, original programming, and promotional priority blocks.

  • Monitor live-event tournament dynamics—including weather interruptions, match overruns, court assignments, and join-in-progress (JIP) scenarios—and make real-time playlist and log adjustments to maintain schedule integrity.

  • Execute day-of-air programming adjustments and hot-swaps in response to breaking live tournament coverage across domestic and international time zones.

  •  

Monitor Channels & Maintain Quality Control

  • Perform active eyes-on-glass monitoring across linear FAST feeds and OTT distribution platforms (e.g., Samsung TV Plus, Roku Channel, Amazon Prime Video, Pluto TV) to ensure uninterrupted playback, audio/video synchronization, pristine picture quality, and compliant closed captioning.

  • Inspect, verify, and quality-check SCTE-35 advertising markers, program segment breaks, and commercial cue points to support monetization accuracy and viewer retention.

  • Conduct pre-air QC on playlists, media files, secondary graphics events, and promotional assets prior to scheduled transmission.

  •  

Manage Asset Ingest, Metadata & Partner Coordination

  • Track the intake, processing, segmentation, and technical validation of file-based video assets, confirming media readiness ahead of transmission deadlines.

  • Enter and audit rich program metadata, including titles, synopses, episode numbers, ratings, territorial restrictions, and Electronic Program Guide (EPG) schedules across distribution endpoints.

  • Act as the operational floor contact during live match windows, proactively logging incidents, triaging playout anomalies, and escalating technical issues to Broadcast Operations, Engineering, Playout Vendors, and Platform Support.

  • Adhere to contractual rights windows, territorial blackout rules, and network Standards & Practices guidelines.

  • Handle Operational Administration & Provide Shift Coverage

  • Maintain accurate operational shift logs, discrepancy reports, incident tickets, and daily run sheets.

  • Deliver structured, comprehensive handoffs between operational shifts to ensure continuity across tournament coverage cycles.

  • Follow and uphold standard operating procedures (SOPs) for live event execution, emergency filler routing, and ad-break contingencies.

  •  

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of operational experience in FAST, live streaming, broadcast playout, master control, traffic, or digital media operations.

  •  

  • Shift Availability: Ability to work dedicated overnight and early-morning shifts, weekends, and holidays in a 24/7/365 live sports environment, matching the global tennis calendar.

  •  

  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience working with cloud-based playout automation platforms (e.g., Amagi CLOUDPORT or similar), broadcast CMS, or traffic scheduling systems.

  •  

  • Live Operations Aptitude: Demonstrated experience handling live sports or breaking events, with the ability to calculate runtimes, adjust join-in-progress segments, and navigate delay scenarios under tight deadlines.

  •  

  • Digital Video & Metadata: Familiarity with broadcast video file specifications, closed captioning formats (608/708, WebVTT), SCTE-35 cue markers, EPG delivery, and content segmentation.

  •  

  • Communication & Composure: Strong verbal and written communication skills; proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical, editorial, and commercial teams while maintaining composure during high-pressure live broadcast situations.

  •  

  • Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) and broadcast collaboration tools.

  •  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior direct operational experience with Amagi cloud playout and scheduling workflows.

  • Prior experience supporting 24/7 live-sports FAST channels or AVOD services across major CTV aggregators.

  • Familiarity with major distribution delivery endpoints (Roku, Samsung TV Plus, Amazon Prime Video, Fubo, Apple, etc.).

  • Working knowledge of professional tennis (ATP/WTA tours, tournament structures, time-zone shifts) and pickleball (PPA).

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Human Resources Manager
job.description:
Sinclair is looking for an experienced Human Resources Manager to join KABB and WOAI-TV in providing front-line, on-site, day-to-day HR support. The HR Manager will also support our station in Corpus Christi, TX.

The HR Manager provides on-site, practical, day-to-day guidance across each of the functional areas of human resources including recruiting, onboarding and offboarding, benefits, leaves of absence, employee relations, training, and performance management. The successful candidate brings three to five years of human resources experience in a fast-paced environment, along with sound judgment, clear communication, reliable follow-through, and strong attention to detail.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with HR colleagues and station leaders to provide responsive, practical support to employees and managers across multiple stations, while building an understanding of each station’s people, operations, and culture.

  • Help ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations, including FMLA, FLSA, workers’ compensation, ADA, and EEO requirements; interpret and apply company policies consistently and help managers understand their responsibilities.

  • Support employee relations matters, including being responsive to complaints and investigations in coordination with the Regional HR Manager.

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding actions, including preparing materials, presenting information, and collecting required documentation.

  • Support recruiting by posting openings, preparing offer letters, coordinating pre-employment requirements, maintaining accurate tracking records, communicating promptly with candidates, and helping ensure compliant hiring practices.

  • Support benefits administration by maintaining working knowledge of company plans, assisting with Open Enrollment communications and employee education, and participating in audits as needed.

  • Support performance management and review cycles, including compliance tracking, follow-up, and audits.

  • Administer leaves of absence in accordance with company policy, benefit plan requirements, and applicable federal, state and local laws.

  • Respond to unemployment, worker’s compensation claims and employment verification requests.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential electronic HR and personnel records, and handle sensitive employee information with discretion.

  • Help plan and coordinate employee training, morale events, and team activities, manage assigned HR projects and perform other related duties as needed.

  • This is an onsite position supporting our stations in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, with the potential to expand to additional Sinclair stations.

  • Some travel to assigned locations required.

     

 Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field.
  • Three to five years of human resources experience.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong interpersonal and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees and managers at all levels.
  • A positive, service-oriented approach and dependable follow-through on assigned work.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and sensitive situations, including when under pressure and/or tight deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and close attention to detail.
  • Oracle HRIS experience is a plus.

 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Sinclair

Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR and The Nest. Sinclair’s AMP Media produces a growing portfolio of digital content and original podcasts. Additional information about Sinclair can be found at www.sbgi.net.

job.title: Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, reaching audiences across streaming, digital, social, audio, live events, sports, and linear television. Powered by the scale of ViX, premium content, first-party audience capabilities, and deep cultural connection with Hispanic consumers, we help brands drive measurable business outcomes across every stage of the consumer journey.


The Manager, Ad Sales Strategy & Analytics plays a key role in driving advertising revenue growth through revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, competitive intelligence, and strategic decision-making.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Sales Planning & Analytics, this role owns the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develops bottoms-up revenue projections while partnering closely with Ad Sales and Finance leadership. The Manager will evaluate pipeline and bookings performance, identify revenue risks and opportunities, and translate complex business data into actionable recommendations for Sales and executive leadership.


The role partners across Ad Sales, Finance, Research, Business Development, and Sales Operations.


YOUR DAY TO DAY: Revenue Strategy & Forecasting

•       Own the weekly advertising revenue forecast and develop bottoms-up projections by account, category, platform, and other relevant dimensions.

•       Analyze revenue pacing, bookings, forecast accuracy, and performance against budget, plan, and prior year.

•       Identify and quantify revenue risks and opportunities and provide recommendations to Sales and Finance leadership.

•       Partner with Ad Sales and Finance on forecasting, annual planning, budgeting, target setting, and long-range revenue planning.

•       Develop scenarios and sensitivity analyses to assess changes in sales performance and marketplace conditions.


Sales Performance & Pipeline Analytics

• Leverage Salesforce to analyze pipeline health, bookings, opportunity stages, expected revenue, aging, win rates, conversion, and pipeline coverage.

• Monitor sales performance against revenue targets and quotas and identify opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and sales productivity.

• Develop dashboards, scorecards, and performance reporting for Sales leadership.

• Evaluate account, seller, category, and platform performance to identify revenue opportunities and risks.

Sales Compensation & Incentive Analytics

• Support sales compensation and incentive planning through quota, attainment, performance, and revenue analysis.

• Develop and validate analytics supporting bonus and incentive calculations.

• Evaluate the relationship between sales performance, compensation plans, and revenue outcomes.


Market & Competitive Intelligence

• Analyze market share, advertiser spending, category trends, competitive activity, and marketplace dynamics.

• Leverage syndicated research and competitive intelligence platforms including Nielsen, MediaRadar, Vivvix, and similar sources.

• Identify whitespace, share-of-wallet, and growth opportunities across advertisers, categories, and platforms.

• Translate market intelligence into actionable revenue and sales recommendations.


Cross-Platform Revenue & Monetization

• Analyze advertising performance across linear television, streaming, digital, social, audio, sports, live events, and emerging platforms.

• Evaluate ViX, digital, and social revenue opportunities and audience/content monetization.

• Partner with Sales, Research, Product, and Business Development on new advertising products, packages, and cross-platform monetization opportunities.

• Assess the financial and revenue implications of new products and monetization strategies.


Executive & Strategic Decision Support

• Develop executive presentations, dashboards, and strategic narratives covering revenue performance, forecasts, pipeline, financial results, market trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Present analyses and recommendations to the CFO, President of Ad Sales, senior Sales leadership, and broader Sales organization.

• Lead ad hoc analyses and strategic projects addressing key business priorities.

• Serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales and Finance leadership.


Reporting, Analytics & Team Leadership

• Build and automate recurring reporting, dashboards, and forecasting processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

• Partner with Sales Operations, Finance, Data, and Technology teams to improve data quality and reporting processes.

• Manage and mentor a junior analyst, providing prioritization, coaching, quality control, and professional development.



YOU HAVE Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

• 2+ years in analytics, sales strategy, finance, revenue management, business intelligence, media, advertising, or a related field.

• Experience with revenue forecasting, sales performance analytics, financial analysis, or strategic planning.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations and executive-level insights.

• Experience managing multiple priorities and independently owning projects.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications

Contests, and recognition programs

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources. In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

job.description:
Director, Marketing Operations at Hearst Newspapers

About the Role

Hearst Newspapers is looking for a strategic and hands-on Director of Marketing Operations to lead the technology, processes, and team supporting our digital subscription marketing business.

Reporting to the VP of Digital Subscriptions, this role leads a team of four and serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.

A major focus of the role is email and newsletter optimization- ensuring our customer communications, lifecycle programs, audience segmentation, personalization, and marketing automation are effective, scalable, and continuously improving.

This person will also help manage and evolve the MarTech ecosystem supporting our digital subscriber journey, from audience and customer data through website experiences, offers, checkout, and ongoing subscriber communications.

This is not primarily a campaign execution, Sales Operations, Ad Operations, or project management role. We’re looking for someone who understands the technology behind modern marketing and can translate business needs into scalable solutions.

What You’ll Do

* Lead and develop a team of four Marketing Operations professionals.
* Own and continuously improve the technology and operational processes supporting email, newsletters, lifecycle marketing, CRM/CDP, and marketing automation.
* Partner with Marketing and Editorial to improve the performance, personalization, segmentation, and effectiveness of email and newsletter programs.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into technical requirements and deliver new capabilities.
* Help oversee the technology supporting the digital customer journey, including websites, audience data, personalization, subscription offers, and customer communications.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot issues across platforms, data flows, integrations, campaigns, and customer experiences.
* Establish effective intake, prioritization, QA, governance, and release processes across multiple Hearst newspaper markets.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and enable Marketing teams to do more.
* Evaluate vendors and technology solutions and help ensure the MarTech ecosystem is scalable and well integrated.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, BI, Editorial, Finance, and Customer Service.
* Create processes and capabilities that can scale consistently across Hearst Newspapers’ markets while still supporting local needs.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

* Significant experience in Marketing Operations, preferably leading a Marketing Operations function or team.
* Deep, hands-on experience with email and/or newsletter operations, including segmentation, lifecycle communications, personalization, QA, testing, and optimization.
* Strong knowledge of MarTech platforms, marketing automation, CRM/CDP, and customer data.
* Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to build or improve marketing capabilities.
* Strong understanding of how data moves across marketing systems and the ability to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.
* Experience managing and prioritizing competing requests across multiple stakeholders or business units.
* Proven people leadership experience.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business decisions.
* Experience using AI and automation to improve marketing processes and team efficiency.

Preferred:

* Experience in media, publishing, subscriptions, or consumer marketing.
* Experience supporting multiple brands, markets, or decentralized organizations.
* Experience with website/digital customer experiences, personalization, subscription offers, or checkout.
* Experience with platforms such as BlueConic, Sailthru, Salesforce, or comparable MarTech solutions.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, or data activation.
* Experience evaluating vendors and implementing new marketing capabilities.

The Person We’re Looking For

You’re someone who enjoys figuring out how things work and how to make them work better.

You don’t simply take a request and pass it along to Engineering. You ask questions, understand the underlying business and technical problem, identify the right solution, and bring the right teams together to make it happen.

You’re comfortable moving between marketing strategy, technology, data, and operations, and you know when to get into the details and when to step back and lead.

You’re curious about AI, constantly looking for ways to eliminate manual work, and comfortable operating in a complex, multi-market organization where priorities don’t always align.

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

Senior Audience Producer

Hearst Connecticut Media Group is looking for an innovative, collaborative Senior Audience Producer to help guide ambitious journalism through audience insights, thoughtful optimization and responsible use of AI. Working alongside editors and reporters, this role will help drive engagement, subscriptions and return visits across CT Insider’s digital platforms, newsletters, social media, audio and print.

This is a digital newsroom audience role - not a television or live-news producing position. We are looking for a journalist who understands digital audiences, analytics, content optimization and audience strategy, and who can work closely with reporters and editors to help journalism reach and resonate with more readers.

Senior Audience Producers will embed with key newsroom topic teams, which may include data, state politics, investigations, education, business, real estate, high school sports and UConn sports. This is an opportunity to innovate, experiment and help strengthen the reach and impact of journalism that matters to Connecticut communities.

 

About the Team

Hearst Connecticut Media Group (HCMG) is a collection of the state’s most important news properties, providing local, watchdog and investigative reporting that impacts communities across Connecticut.

HCMG includes close to 170 journalists working at 10 daily newspapers – Connecticut Post, Greenwich Time, Journal Inquirer, The Middletown Press, The New Haven Register, The News-Times, The Norwalk Hour, Record-Journal, Republican-American and Stamford Advocate – 13 weekly newspapers, Connecticut Magazine and multiple websites.

HCMG expanded further in 2021 with the launch of Connecticut’s No. 1 statewide news source, CTInsider.com, covering everything from sports and politics to breaking news stories and compelling features about Connecticut residents and businesses.

 

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with editors, reporters, photographers and audience team members to ensure journalism engages, retains and converts local readers into subscribers.

* Analyze and interpret audience metrics, translating insights into clear recommendations that inform short- and long-term coverage decisions.

* Optimize journalism across websites, social media, newsletters and search to expand reach and deepen audience engagement.

* Use topic-area knowledge and audience insights to identify story opportunities and develop recurring content series and annual special projects.

* Guide responsible and relevant use of AI and other emerging tools to improve newsroom workflows and audience outcomes.

* Communicate across departments during breaking and planned news events to alert audiences to key developments across platforms.

* Support topic teams in planning and executing audience strategies that encourage return visits and subscriber growth.

* Lead or contribute to livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain audiences, where applicable.

 

Qualifications

* Strong editorial judgment and experience working in a deadline-driven digital news or journalism environment.

* Demonstrated understanding of digital audience development, engagement and content optimization.

* Ability to optimize stories for websites, social media, newsletters and search.

* Strong comfort with analyzing and interpreting metrics and communicating what the data means.

* Experience editing short- and mid-form video, photos and audio using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or Premiere.

* Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.

* A quick, organized and technically capable problem solver who consistently meets deadlines.

* Strong organizational and detail-oriented skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities.

* Flexibility to work nights and weekends for breaking news and special content opportunities.

* Collaborative approach and curiosity about audience behavior, journalism and emerging technology.

 

Preferred qualifications

* Knowledge of topic area in sports

* Experience planning and running livestreams and podcasts that engage and retain viewers.

* Experience using analytics to shape editorial strategy and coverage decisions.

* Experience developing strategic plans or audience-focused digital initiatives.

 

Please note: This role is not a television producer, live-news producer or broadcast production position. Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on producing television newscasts, live broadcasts or broadcast control-room operations are not the target profile for this position.

  • Build and improve consumer subscription experiences. Develop subscription offers, checkout flows, promotions, gifting, onboarding, and account management features that support acquisition, conversion, and retention.

  • Support experimentation and growth. Partner with consumer revenue, product, and analytics teams to improve paywalls, registration experiences, and subscription journeys through reliable experiments and measurable results.
  • Evolve our publishing platform. Build reusable components, editorial tools, and reader experiences that support the distinct needs of our brands and make publishing easier.
  • Contribute to the NYMag mobile app. Partner with mobile engineers on reading experiences, content discovery, and subscriber features. Design APIs and content models that support consistent experiences across platforms.
  • Guide incremental modernization. Identify architectural risks and technical debt, improve developer workflows, and balance near-term delivery with the long-term maintainability of an established platform.
  • Improve quality and reliability. Investigate production issues, strengthen automated testing and observability, and address performance, accessibility, and security across publishing and subscription workflows.
  • Champion responsible AI use. Develop and refine AI-assisted and agentic workflows for implementation, testing, debugging, review, and documentation. Protect sensitive information, validate generated changes, and maintain accountability for the resulting software.
  • Help the team succeed. Mentor engineers, lead constructive code and design reviews, document important decisions, and establish shared practices that improve the team’s effectiveness.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Deep JavaScript expertise and substantial experience building and operating production web applications and Node.js services.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives across systems or teams, with impact beyond their individual contributions.
  • Strong frontend fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, accessibility, browser behavior, and application performance, alongside experience with frameworks such as Vue or React.
  • Experience designing APIs, data models, and integrations, including reliable handling of authentication, authorization, and transactional workflows.
  • Sound judgment when evolving mature codebases, including knowing when to extend existing patterns and when to introduce new approaches.
  • Strong debugging and testing skills, with experience diagnosing problems across application, service, and data boundaries.
  • The ability to connect engineering decisions to reader experience and business outcomes, including subscription conversion, engagement, and retention.
  • Experience using AI development tools responsibly, including providing useful context, evaluating generated output, and recognizing when human review and decision-making are essential.
  • Clear communication, collaborative technical leadership, and the ability to contribute to a TypeScript and React Native codebase.

Additional experience that would be valuable includes:

  • Consumer subscriptions, digital media, ecommerce, or other businesses built around recurring customer relationships.
  • Paywalls, payment platforms, subscription billing integrations, identity systems, or entitlement management.
  • Experimentation platforms, conversion analytics, and customer lifecycle experiences.
  • React Native, Expo, or shipping applications for iOS and Android.
  • Content management systems, editorial workflows, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
  • Building reusable AI workflows, agent tooling, or automation that improves engineering productivity.

Our web platform uses Node.js, Express, Clay CMS, Vue, and Handlebars. Our mobile app uses TypeScript, React Native, and Expo. You’ll work across these technologies and the services connecting content, customer accounts, and subscriptions.

We value curiosity, trust, respect, and clear communication. We’re looking for someone who enjoys sharing knowledge, learning from colleagues, and helping the whole team succeed. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every technology listed.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Financial Controller plays a critical leadership role in ensuring the integrity, transparency, and long-term sustainability of The Washington Post’s financial operations as a privately held media organization. Reporting to the Acting CFO, this role provides enterprise-wide stewardship of global accounting, financial reporting, governance, and systems evolution—supporting informed decision-making and responsible growth. 


This role is designed for a strategic financial leader who can lead meaningful transformation while maintaining rigorous accounting discipline. In the near term, the Financial Controller will assess current-state accounting operations, systems, and team capabilities and lead a deliberate redesign of the controllership function. This includes rethinking how accounting work is structured, enabled by technology, and experienced by the team. Over time, the scope of this role will expand, further strengthening enterprise-wide financial stewardship. 


As a highly visible leader, the Financial Controller balances hands-on execution with enterprise leadership—providing trusted stewardship in a complex, evolving environment while shaping the future of how accounting operates at The Washington Post. 


What Motivates You 

  • Leading financial stewardship in a privately held media organization where integrity, discretion, and long-term thinking are essential 
  • Challenging legacy processes and assumptions to reimagine how accounting work can be performed and delivered 
  • Driving transformation that goes beyond incremental improvement to reshape operating models, team culture, and ways of working 
  • Serving as both a strategic leader and a hands-on expert when the work or moment requires it 
  • Building strong, capable teams through active coaching, clear expectations, and a commitment to continuous development 

 

How You’ll Support the Mission 

 

Strategic Accounting & Financial Leadership 

  • Provide enterprise leadership for global accounting operations, including general ledger, close, consolidation, and statutory reporting. 
  • Establish and advance a long-term vision for the controllership function aligned with organizational strategy and the needs of a privately held media company. 
  • Assess, redesign, and modernize accounting processes, operating models, and organizational structure to support scale, resilience, and effectiveness. 
  • Operate as a “player-coach,” moving seamlessly between strategic leadership and hands-on accounting work as needed during periods of transformation, team development, and systems change. 

Financial Reporting, Controls & Governance 

  • Maintain final accountability for the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all internal and external financial reporting. 
  • Own the worldwide consolidation and end-to-end accounting close process. 
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce global accounting policies and standards to ensure consistency and compliance, including revenue recognition. 
  • Design, implement, and maintain a strong internal control environment appropriate to a privately held enterprise. 
  • Oversee financial reporting controls and internal audit activities. 
  • Prepare and present financial reports, analyses, and insights to senior leadership. 

ERP, Systems & Technology Transformation 

  • Lead the evaluation, selection, and migration of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including assessment of tradeoffs, risks, and long-term implications. 
  • Own the future-state accounting systems architecture and ensure alignment with business strategy, scalability needs, and data integrity standards. 
  • Provide hands-on leadership during system migrations, recognizing and mitigating change and execution risk. 
  • Drive optimization of existing and new systems to improve automation, accuracy, and transparency across accounting operations. 

Audit, Risk & Stakeholder Partnership 

  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, including coordination of pension and 401(k)-related audits. 
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality, timely, and informative financial reporting. 
  • Collaborate with FP&A to ensure reporting supports internal decision-making and provides meaningful operational insights. 
  • Assume leadership of enterprise Risk functions as the role evolves, strengthening governance and risk awareness across the organization. 

People Leadership & Culture Building 

  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing global accounting organization, recognizing that the current team is capable and still developing. 
  • Actively coach and mentor leaders and individual contributors, setting a high bar for performance, accountability, and growth. 
  • Establish a strong team culture and identity grounded in excellence, trust, inclusion, and continuous improvement. 
  • Create clarity around roles, expectations, and development pathways to support both near-term transformation and long-term capability building. 

Skills and Experience You Bring 

  • Deep technical accounting expertise with the ability to apply standards in complex, real-world business environments 
  • Demonstrated experience leading ERP evaluation, selection, and migration initiatives, including ownership of future-state system design 
  • Proven ability to lead and sustain transformation, including rethinking operating models and ways of working 
  • Comfort operating as both a strategic leader and hands-on practitioner during periods of change 
  • Strong judgment, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information 
  • Ability to translate accounting and financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders 
  • Experience operating effectively in highly visible leadership roles with critical deadlines and competing priorities 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance 
  • CPA designation 
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams to include people managers 
  • 10+ years progressive experience in accounting or financial management, including senior-level leadership responsibility at Big 4 or similar organization with revenue and systems complexities 
  • Experience leading ERP system evaluations and migrations 
  • Experience with global accounting operations, financial reporting, and audit coordination 
  • Experience in media, advertising, or directly related industries. 
  • Experience with automation or leading automation strategy and implementation 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Public accounting experience 
  • Experience in a privately held, multi-entity, or complex organizational environment 
  • Prior responsibility for or partnership with risk management, internal audit, or governance functions 
  • Experience leading accounting or finance transformations during periods of organizational or systems change 

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$149,900 - $278,300 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Global Digital Accounts
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

 Job Title:  Sr. Manager, Digital Accounts

A little bit about our team:

The WMG Global Commercial Services team maximizes WMG revenue and market share, leading through best practices, platform expertise and forward thinking solutions that support our recorded music strategy.

Your role:

You will manage relationships and business operations with all assigned accounts across a variety of developing and established business models  You will work with these partners on a global scale to maximize opportunities for our artists with the goal of increasing market share and revenue.  

 

Here you’ll get to:

  • You will act as the account lead in the US and globally for assigned accounts. You will implement our commercial deals and improve opportunities to grow the customer base and income.

  • You will support senior management across ad hoc projects (i.e., new accounts, cross-functional assignments, etc.)

  • You will understand all points of WMG’s commercial agreement with each assigned account. You will ensure they are accurately followed through active communication with both in-house and external parties.   

  • You will coordinate and develop strategies with key partners across WMG, including labels, affiliates where assigned accounts have meaningful presence, and central teams. This will support each team in improving platform and in-service opportunities, resulting in increased market presence and on-platform activity.  

  • You will maintain strong knowledge of partner’s goals and business strategies and communicate information to leadership, labels, business development, and analysis teams via regular updates, quarterly business reviews, and other forms of communication

  • You will regularly update assigned accounts on new releases and catalog changes. You will also help WMG and Partner operational teams to ensure WMG repertoire is available on the platform.

  • Collaborate with teams from Finance, Growth Initiatives, and Tech. Ensure reporting is accurate, received, and up to date for every assigned account. 

  • Collaborate with Business Development by using daily account knowledge to advise on the partner's current state. Provide forward-thinking topics to support WMG and our labels in negotiations.

About you:

  • You have a minimum of 5+ years experience with a range of Commercial Music, Marketing/Sales, and Account Management 

  • You can work independently and manage time efficiently.

  • You have strong communication skills and can work with various levels of stakeholders

  • You are experienced with and/or interested in new, emerging categories of music consumption as well as user generated/ad supported platforms.

  • You have the ability to be creative, goal-oriented, and a flexible team player.

  • You are passionate about music and understand the current music landscape. 

We’d love it if you also had:

  • You are highly proficient in Microsoft Office and Google’s suite of tools.

  • You are a problem solver with strong analytical and negotiation skills.

  • You have experience diving into data and using it with purpose.

 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office.
