job.title: Storm Warning Meteorologist
job.description:
We are seeking a full-time meteorologist with outstanding forecasting and communication skills to join our family of Storm Warning Meteorologists at the AccuWeather Severe Weather Center in Wichita, Kansas. We are looking for someone who is energetic, driven, team oriented and has a proactive work ethic. This is a fast-paced environment where the goal is to save lives, protect property and help clients maximize weather-related opportunities while minimizing weather-related risks. If you would like to contribute to a highly professional team that also knows how to have fun along the way, then this opening is for you! 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

As a Storm Warning Meteorologist, you will have opportunities to handle all types of hazardous weather forecasting and issue weather warnings for major business, transportation, education, media, and government organizations. These include:  

  • Utilize internal warning software to create your own customized, site-specific hazardous weather warnings (tornado, wind, flash flood, hurricane, etc.) independent of government agencies. 
  • Create hazardous weather forecast graphics and customized text discussions for transportation and other specialized clients across North America. 
  • Daily interaction with clients that need to make immediate operational weather-related decisions. 
  • Use internal computer applications. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

  

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor’s in Meteorology or Atmospheric Sciences. 
  • Refined customer service skills. 
  • Ability to meet strict deadlines. 
  • Great attention to detail. 
  • Ability to process meteorological data and make swift, accurate warning decisions. 
  • Ability to interact with and collaborate professionally with other members of the forecasting team. 
  • Must be willing and able to work semi-rotating shifts that include afternoons, evenings, overnights, weekends, and some holidays. 

 

ABOUT ACCUWEATHER

 AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. 

 

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION 

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. 
 
AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to human.resources@accuweather.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

job.title: Digital & Social Platform Editor
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About the Role

Semafor is seeking a Digital & Social Platform Editor to help amplify our journalism across platforms and formats.

This is not a  traditional “social posting” role. We’re looking for someone who understands how modern media travels — across video, live events, podcasts, breaking news, YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X, and emerging platforms. The right candidate understands that packaging and distribution is editorial — and an important part of propelling our journalism forward.

This role sits at the center of newsroom, audience, video, audio, and events. You’ll help shape the strategy for how Semafor’s journalism is framed, edited, clipped, promoted, and distributed in real time . 

You should have strong editorial instincts, comfort with video and light editing workflows, sharp news and platform judgment, and a deep understanding of how to create platform-native content that drives reach without compromising editorial quality. Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs is important.

Responsibilities

Packaging & Distribution of Our Best Journalism

  • Work with newsroom leaders to identify the strongest moments, angles, and formats for distribution across scoops, breaking news, enterprise reporting, interviews, video, podcasts, and live journalism
  • Develop deep relationships with distribution platforms, with a special focus on LinkedIn, YouTube and X 
  • Package and distribute Semafor journalism across social and digital platforms in formats optimized for each audience and channel
  • Write platform-native copy, headlines, captions, hooks, and framing that increase engagement and discoverability
  • Publish and optimize content across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms

Video & Live Content

  • Support rapid-turnaround distribution from Semafor events, including clipping live mainstage conversations in real time, or editorial video
  • Knowledge of analytics, audience development, and platform performance trends
  • Interest in business, politics, media, technology, and global affairs
  • Work closely with video and audio producers to extend the reach and lifecycle of original content
  • Execute social video editing, formatting, subtitling, and platform optimization
  • Ability to clip, package, and publish short-form video from interviews, podcasts, newsroom shoots, and live events

Events & Promotion

  • Support promotional campaigns for Semafor events, franchises, and editorial launches
  • Coordinate social coverage plans and live posting during major convenings and newsroom moments
  • Help extend the reach of Semafor’s live journalism before, during, and after events
  • Develop and implement promotion plans for shows and big events across all platforms

Audience & Editorial Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the newsroom and audience teams to identify distribution opportunities and audience growth strategies
  • Apply editorial judgment to determine what content should travel, where it should live, and how it should be framed
  • Monitor performance trends, audience behavior, and platform shifts to inform publishing strategy
  • Maintain Semafor’s editorial standards, voice, and accuracy across all distributed content

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in social media, audience development, digital publishing, or platform distribution
  • Strong editorial instincts and understanding of news judgment
  • Experience publishing across major social and video platforms, with a particular focus on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Reddit
  • Understanding of platform-native storytelling and audience behavior
  • Ability to work quickly and calmly in a fast-paced newsroom and live event environment
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Experience covering or supporting live events
  • Familiarity with Premiere, CapCut, Descript, or similar editing tools
  • Experience working with a wide array of journalists, newsroom teams

Compensation: The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000 annually based on individual candidate experience and skills.

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Election Reporter (Temporary)
job.description:

The successful candidate should have a strong interest in local politics and digging deeply into Los Angeles and the county's massive bureaucracies. They should be able to report breaking news on deadline and write longer-term stories on a variety of topics, including post-fire recovery, homelessness and elections.

The reporter will regularly collaborate with others, including writers covering Los Angeles County, Sacramento and breaking news. Experience covering L.A. city and county government is a plus.

Responsibilities:

• Report and write stories about local politics, including breaking news, enterprise stories and voter guides

• Cultivate sources and contacts to aid in the execution of a range of stories

• Identify unique angles that will advance a news story beyond what other outlets have already reported

• Write engaging headlines and SEO components that are lively and conversational in tone (when appropriate) with a digital, diverse audience in mind

• Work with fellow writers, editors, audience engagement staff and other reporters to achieve department and organizational goals

• A minimum of five years of journalism experience

• Excellent skills in news writing and reporting, combining strong news judgment, fluency in style and deep knowledge of taste and legal considerations

• Ability to foster excellent communication with peers, supervisors and the newsroom

• Proven ability to juggle multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment

• Ability to navigate digital platforms and stay on top of current events

job.title: Event Staff Ford Amphitheater - Rocky Mountains
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

EVENT STAFF:

  • GUEST SERVICES
  • BOX OFFICE ATTENDANT

GUEST SERVICES

A Brief Overview
Guest Services Staff will act as the primary provider of direct services to guests when they are inside the venue. They are responsible for providing a safe environment for all guests beginning the moment they enter the facility. The incumbent will provide a variety of customer service duties on behalf of the venue for its guests, in an expert, professional and friendly manner.

A Brief Overview

  • Answer guest questions, direct guests to important areas of the venue (restrooms, ATM, VIP areas, and concert area) and provide additional assistance whenever necessary.
  • Scan tickets for entry into the venue, administer applicable wristbands for event entrance (21+, VIP Access, Private Event Access).
  • Greet guests and resolve guest complaints, escalating concerns as necessary. Monitor guest conduct to ensure a safe and secure environment for all. Monitor the consumption of alcohol to ensure no under-age drinking is taking place and those guests consuming beverages are doing so responsibly.
  • Seat guests and assist ADA patrons.
  • Enforce all policies and procedures of the venue. Complete all company and venue required trainings and participate in employee meetings.

The Stage Manager is responsible for coordinating and executing all on-stage and loading dock operations from pre-show preparations to day-of-show execution for concerts and events. This role serves as the central point of communication between the Venue Production Manager, touring, client, and/or rental vendor team ensuring that technical and logistical execution aligns. The Stage manager oversees all stage activity and ensures smooth load-in/outs, efficient communication, and on-time performances.

·       Supervises the load-in and load out of band and rental equipment  

·       Responsible for documenting accident, incident, and disciplinary issues for the production crew and reports actions back to Production Manager  

·       Production Manager may have Stage Manager execute settlements per contract with artists post show  

·       Ensure all in-house policies are enforced regarding staging, safety and show protocol

job.title: Artist Agreements & Clearances Manager
job.description:
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

The Artist Agreements & Clearances Manager is a cross-company role responsible for securing and managing artist agreements, releases, and content clearances in support of production and distribution across the Recording Academy and its affiliates. In this position, you will be a key liaison between internal stakeholders, artists, managers, labels, publishers, and legal teams, supporting events, series, exhibits, GRAMMY Studios programming, and expanding organizational objectives. You are a detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for music and the music industry. You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships, can balance creative needs with legal and company requirements, and are calm under pressure. You have a collaborative spirit and service mentality.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

Artist Releases & Agreements

  • Draft, negotiate, execute, and manage artist agreements and releases across all Recording Academy and affiliate productions, ensuring timely execution for live and pre-recorded content.
  • Maintain organized records of all agreements, including rights granted, restrictions, and obligations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure content usage plans and artist negotiations are accurately reflected in contractual terms.

 

Sync and Misc. Clearances

  • Secure synchronization rights and related clearances for music and content use across all Recording Academy and affiliate platforms.
  • Coordinate with record labels, publishers, PROs, and other rights holders to obtain necessary licenses.
  • Track and manage rights by territory, media, term, and usage to ensure compliance.
  • Oversee the license lifecycle, including payments, amendments, extensions, expirations, and archiving
  • Troubleshoot and resolve clearance issues under tight production timelines.
  • Support additional clearance needs, including artwork, likeness, podcast, and other media usage.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with internal stakeholders early in the process to assess and address clearance, release, and agreement needs.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for all artist-related contractual and clearance matters.
  • Clearly communicate requirements, risks, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders.

 

Process & Systems Management

  • Refine workflows for outreach, negotiations, contract execution, and rights tracking.
  • Maintain and improve systems for documenting, tracking, and reporting rights and permissions.
  • Keep standardized clearance process resources current and accessible.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.

 

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure content is cleared prior to distribution across all platforms.
  • Flag risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Stay current on music rights, licensing practices, and industry standards.

 

 

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 5+ years’ experience in music business affairs, content clearance, and music publishing.
  • Paralegal experience and/or the ability to draft and review content licensing agreements and negotiate terms with knowledge of how smaller negotiations affect big-picture relationships.
  • Established relationships with record labels, music publishers, and artist management.
  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive follow-through.
  • Flexibility to succeed in a fast-paced production environment with tight deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects proactively and independently while providing cross-company support.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting salary for this position is $64,400 to $70,800 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States. 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

This is a hybrid role, based in New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will work Eastern business hours.

job.title: AI Enterprise Architect - WPP Media
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

WPP Media, as part of WPP ET, is undergoing a significant transformation, modernising our ways of working, adopting cloud-native architectures, and prioritising AI and data-driven insights. This role is crucial for infusing AI-first thinking at every level. You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and hands-on technological exploration, acting as a catalyst for innovation. We need someone who can work closely with our teams to discover, design, and help deliver a truly reimagined future powered by AI, ensuring solutions align with our enterprise architectural principles and standards.

Are you a hands-on technologist with a solid understanding of the media or advertising business, eager to explore and apply cutting-edge AI? This isn't a traditional Enterprise Architect role focused purely on mapping and integration. Instead, we're seeking an aspiring architect who thrives on discovery and practical application.

You will be instrumental in exploring how emerging technologies, especially agentic AI, can fundamentally reimagine our business operations and client services. You'll also identify opportunities to accelerate our existing strategic programs, enhancing underlying systems (like ERPs) with AI rather than replacing them. This role is a unique opportunity to grow into a full Enterprise Architect by actively contributing to the strategic application of AI, working closely with product and engineering teams to turn vision into reality, all while learning to navigate and contribute to our architectural standards and governance processes.

Business Impact:

AI-Driven Innovation: Directly contribute to identifying, prototyping, and integrating agentic AI solutions that challenge conventional business models and create new value.

Operational Acceleration: Leverage AI to enhance the efficiency and intelligence of existing in-flight programs and core business systems.

Strategic Growth: Help shape the future technology landscape of WPP Media, defining how AI will underpin our next generation of products and services.

Learning & Development: Gain invaluable experience in enterprise-level architectural thinking, directly influencing major technology decisions and business strategy, including adherence to governance.

What you'll be doing:

  • AI Opportunity Identification: Actively research and identify high-impact opportunities for leveraging agentic technologies and broader AI/ML capabilities across our media business operations and client offerings.
  • Concept Prototyping & Validation: Work hands-on with cross-functional teams to prototype, test, and validate AI-driven concepts, demonstrating their potential to reimagine workflows or accelerate programs.
  • AI-First" Solution Design: Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners to embed AI capabilities into the design of new products and enhancements for existing systems.
  • Business Process & AI Mapping: Assist in mapping current business processes, identifying specific areas where AI can be introduced for significant efficiency gains or new value creation, and contributing to high-level capability models.
  • Technology Trend Monitoring: Keep abreast of the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and agentic systems, sharing insights and potential applications with the wider team.
  • Architectural Contribution & Governance Support: Contribute to defining and documenting architectural principles and patterns specifically tailored for AI-powered solutions, ensuring scalability, security, and ethical considerations. You will also support efforts to ensure new projects and solutions align with WPP's architectural standards and compliance guidelines.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for business leaders, fostering understanding and buy-in for new initiatives.
  • Learning & Growth: Actively engage with senior architects and technical leaders, seeking mentorship and opportunities to expand your enterprise architectural knowledge and skills.
  • Focus on WPP ET goals that require architecting to align WPP Media to the rest of WPP ET, particularly in the area of AI capabilities 

Key 2026 Goals:

  • AI-Driven Innovation & Exploration: Actively contribute to the identification, exploration, and initial validation of innovative AI and agentic technology applications that either reimagine core business operations or accelerate strategic programs.
  • Strategic Solution Design: Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into high-level solution designs, ensuring alignment with defined business capabilities and technology roadmaps.
  • Architectural Standards & Governance Contribution: Support the application and evolution of WPP's architectural principles and governance frameworks, contributing to the development of design standards and ensuring solution compliance.
  • Continuous Architectural Development: Proactively engage in continuous learning and mentorship opportunities to deepen understanding of enterprise architecture practices, technology trends (especially AI), and their application within the media business.

What you'll need:

  • Media Business Acumen: Solid understanding of the media and advertising industry, including its key players, workflows, and operational challenges. Familiarity with common media production tools and workflows.
  • AI/ML Foundations: Demonstrated interest and foundational knowledge in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts, including Generative AI and/or agentic systems. You should be excited by the potential of AI to transform business operations and client offerings.
  • Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering: Proven ability to gather, analyze, and document business requirements, translating them into actionable insights and technical specifications.
  • Business Process Understanding: Experience in analyzing business workflows and processes, with an eye towards identifying areas for improvement or re-imagination through technology.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong grasp of modern technology stacks, cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP), APIs, data structures, and the software development lifecycle. Working knowledge of public cloud technologies and basic DevOps principles.
  • Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Ability to break down complex business challenges into manageable parts, identify opportunities for technological intervention (especially AI), and propose practical, innovative solutions.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong oral, presentation, and written communication skills. Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders and foster effective collaboration.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Interpersonal Skills: Proven ability to build rapport, influence, and collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including business leaders, product owners, solution architects, and development teams.
  • Growth Mindset & Curiosity: Eagerness to learn, adapt to new technologies, and proactively seek opportunities for professional development within the enterprise architecture domain. This includes an interest in Enterprise Architecture frameworks (like TOGAF®) and methodologies.
  • Collaboration Tools Proficiency: Proficiency in modern collaboration tools, including the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, for effective remote and hybrid teamwork.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Why we're hiring:

We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive  Data Analyst to be a critical hands-on contributor to our client reporting and analytics initiatives within WPP Open. Reporting directly to the Data Analytics Lead, you will be responsible for translating complex business questions into robust analytical solutions, going beyond descriptive reporting to identify patterns, drive predictive insights, and deliver actionable intelligence to our client teams. 

This role is for an expert practitioner who thrives on diving deep into data, possesses exceptional SQL skills, and has a proven track record of delivering impactful analytical products. What you'll be doing:

Advanced Data Analysis & Insight Generation: 

  • Perform complex, hands-on data analysis to identify key trends, patterns, and anomalies in client usage data from the WPP Open platform. 
  • Go beyond standard reporting by conducting in-depth investigations, root cause analysis, and contributing to predictive insights to proactively identify opportunities and risks.

Reporting & Dashboarding Delivery: 

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, actionable dashboards and reports using various BI tools, serving as a primary delivery expert for monthly and ad-hoc client reporting.
  • Ensure all reporting is accurate, consistent, and provides clear, concise narratives that drive understanding and action. 
  • Continuously optimize existing reports and build new ones based on evolving client needs and strategic direction from the Lead. 

Technical Execution & Collaboration: 

  • Work closely with the Lead to understand strategic objectives and translate them into concrete analytical and reporting deliverables. 
  • Collaborate effectively with Data Engineers and Architects to ensure data availability, quality, and the implementation of efficient data pipelines. 
  • Provide technical expertise and contribute to the definition of data models and analytical frameworks. 

Stakeholder Communication & Problem Solving: 

  • Clearly communicate complex analytical findings, methodologies, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify data-related challenges and propose innovative solutions to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and analytical capabilities.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Service:

  • Keep up with the industry. Learn everything you can about your clients and understand the trends and issues (e.g., media, business, political and cultural) that could impact them, their competitors and the overall patient journey.
  • Participate in client planning meetings and calls. Ask informed questions and absorb important details.
  • Create professional, actionable client-facing communications (e.g., updates on media opportunities, status reports, campaign summary reports and general account activity reports).
  • Demonstrate proficiency with document review systems (e.g., Veeva Vault). Be able to upload error-free, quickly and in high-pressure situations. 

Strategy:

  • Ask. Wonder. Learn. Read presentation decks, listen in meetings, understand not just what you are doing but why it is being done, and how it adds value to our clients’ businesses.
  • Be responsible for tactical execution of client programming and able to deliver first drafts of next-step recommendations, campaign materials, timelines and briefs.
  • Contribute to IMC programs in a way that creates value and showcases our “Do Something Different” approach to meeting client objectives. 

Media:

  • Develop and maintain media lists and leverage relationships in collaboration with the GCI Health media team. Study and deliver well-written materials.
  • Monitor and report client media coverage. Understand how to use media platforms such as Cision and Factiva. Translate and communicate to clients in a way that adds value to their business.
  • Research, develop and pitch fresh, thought-provoking stories, and help coordinate press materials and events (such as press kits, news releases and press conferences).
  • Know the media landscape – including editorial calendars and subscribing to media newsletters. 

Digital:

  • Monitor, pitch and help build relationships with key social influencers and community contacts to optimize digital channels.
  • Stay current on social media channels, trends and analytics tools and make recommendations to strengthen client campaigns.
  • Develop content for social and digital channels to support brand strategies and appeal to target audiences.
  • Communicate and collaborate with the GCI Health digital team, as appropriate. 

Creativity:

  • Organize and participate in brainstorming meetings and contribute ideas based on knowledge of the client and outside reading and research.
  • Know our capabilities and when to engage creative resources.
  • Be curious. Note the latest trends in media, culture, healthcare innovation, etc., and apply them to clients’ programs by presenting a thoughtful and comprehensive POV. 

Research and Insights:

  • Know research and measurement methodologies and resources.
  • Implement research and measurement tools for client campaigns so we can measure success.
  • Synthesize research for analysis and summary reports for teams and clients. 

Business Development:

  • Listen. Every client meeting can lead to opportunities to add value and grow the relationship.
  • Monitor social media and other channels for relevant opportunities that could lead to new business; proactively flag with supporting rationale to core account team.
  • Assist with case studies for client presentations, new business pitches and industry awards.
  • Participate in new business research projects. 

Collaboration:

  • Share ideas; jump in when needed and ask others for their opinions and builds.
  • Weigh potential solutions and compromises based on what they mean to us and our clients. Be ready to defend your position confidently and articulately.
  • If people disagree, help find a solution everyone’s happy with; know when to involve a manager. 

Communication:

  • Know your audience; use language, style and tone that appeal to them. Communicate efficiently.
  • Meet or beat deadlines. Clearly communicate with clients and teams when deadlines shift.
  • Be professional when communicating to co-workers, clients and external audiences; skip jargon and clichés. Write with clarity and accuracy.
  • Follow AP Stylebook (or AMA, pending client preference) guidelines when writing press materials; understand how to reference. 

Financial Management:

  • Learn “the business” of our business and how we make money through meeting billability targets.
  • Record billable hours daily in Maconomy and make supervisors aware of your time.
  • Follow agency procedures for client budgets and budget tracking.
  • Manage vendor relationships, costs and invoicing. 

Diversity and Inclusion:

  • Create an inclusive and welcoming environment.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in a changing work environment.
  • Bridge differences between and among yourself and others.
  • Seek out and use ideas, opinions, and insights from diverse sources and individuals.
  • Use self-awareness to deflect biases.
  • Consistently demonstrate integrity and credibility while building trust through inclusive behavior. 

Team Management:

  • Coach and mentor junior team members (account coordinators and assistant account executives) to help them learn our business and capabilities.
  • Delegate tasks to junior team members with clarity, including timetables and expected outcomes.
  • Identify and implement skills-development needs for team members.
  • Review the work of junior team members and provide constructive feedback and edits where appropriate. 

Accountability:

  • Fulfill all commitments of your role.
  • Admit mistakes and misjudgments. Figure out how to avoid them in the future.
  • Take responsibility for tough decisions and actions to get things done.
  • Be a problem-solver. 

Agency Responsibilities:

  • Help recruit top talent by knowing our capabilities, locations and talking about the company in a positive way.
  • Contribute to the agency in a meaningful way through participation in culture initiatives, staff meetings, manager meetings and by being supportive of and kind to colleagues.
  • Adhere to GCI Health’s confidentiality and disclosure agreements and code of ethics/conduct.
  • Participate in agency Learning and Development opportunities as appropriate and as agreed upon with your manager.
  • Do Something Different in your approach, involvement and agency contributions!

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We are seeking an experienced and detail‑oriented Global Data Steward to join our team in Chennai, India, supporting WPP Media’s global Master Data Management (MDM) initiative.

This role plays a critical part in maintaining the integrity of WPP Media’s Golden Master Data assets across domains such as Clients, Media, Suppliers, and other core business entities. The role works hands‑on with AI‑assisted mastering and mapping in our internally developed MDM platform, Matrix.

The role requires strong ownership, sound judgement, and an attitude focused on getting it right — not just getting it approved. The Global Data Steward is expected to actively drive data quality outcomes, challenge poor inputs or AI recommendations, and ensure that master data decisions are correct, intentional, and fit for long‑term enterprise use.

As a Global Data Steward, you will work cross‑region with markets, finance teams, and global stakeholders. A structured, proactive, and assertive (“pushy when needed”) approach is essential to ensure mappings are completed, standards are met, and nothing critical stalls.

What you'll be doing:

  • Review, validate, and approve AI‑generated mapping recommendations using WPP Media’s internal Matrix MDM tool.
  • Apply strong judgement to ensure AI recommendations:
    • Correctly represent real‑world business entities.
    • Do not introduce duplication, fragmentation, or incorrect hierarchies.
    • Follow agreed global standards, naming conventions, and data models.
  • Assess and approve new master data additions to the Golden List across multiple domains (e.g. Client, Media, Supplier).
  • Actively drive and push local, market, and finance teams to:
    • Complete required mappings.
    • Resolve unclear or missing information.
    • Correct poor‑quality or inconsistent submissions.
  • Challenge, reject, or return mappings and requests where data is incomplete, incorrect, or poorly justified.
  • Take ownership of end‑to‑end stewardship flow, ensuring items do not stall in queues or wait indefinitely for market action.
  • Provide structured feedback into Matrix to improve AI‑assisted mastering and stewardship efficiency over time.
  • Serve as a guardian of data quality, consistency, and enterprise usability of master data.
  • Collaborate closely with Local Data Stewards, Finance, Product, and Platform teams to ensure alignment on standards and expectations.
  • Enforce and uphold data governance principles, approval workflows, and escalation paths.
  • Escalate complex, disputed, or model‑level issues to the appropriate governance forum when required.
  • Ensure all stewardship decisions are clearly documented, auditable, and transparent.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in Master Data Management, data stewardship, data governance, or data quality roles, ideally in a global or multi‑market organization.
  • Strong understanding of master data concepts including golden records, canonical entities, hierarchies, and deduplication.
  • Experience working with MDM tools and approval workflows (experience with internally built tools is an advantage).
  • Comfortable reviewing and challenging AI‑assisted or rule‑based mappings (no ML development required).
  • Highly structured, organized, and comfortable pushing stakeholders to meet data quality and completion standards.
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to think long‑term and cross‑domain.

Why we're hiring:

The Head of Security Incident Management is responsible for leading and maturing WPP's global Security Incident Management capability, providing strategic, operational, and technical leadership across the entire incident response lifecycle.

Reporting directly to the Director of Operational Security, this role owns the Security Incident Management function, including Security Incident Management Leads, Senior Security Incident Responders, and Security Incident Responders. The position ensures that security incidents are managed consistently, effectively, and in accordance with WPP policies, regulatory obligations, and operational standards.

The role evolves and scales incident response capabilities in alignment with WPP's Autonomic Security Operations (ASO) strategy and automation-first operating model. This includes oversight of people, process, technology, governance, service performance, and continuous improvement.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the end-to-end Security Incident Management capability across WPP.
  • Lead and develop Security Incident Management Leads, Senior Security Incident Responders, and Security Incident Responders.
  • Establish the strategic direction for incident response, aligned to Operational Security objectives and the wider ASO roadmap.
  • Maintain overall accountability for the management of critical and major security incidents.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for Sev1 and Sev2 security incidents.
  • Ensure appropriate incident governance, communication, decision-making, and stakeholder engagement throughout the incident lifecycle.
  • Provide executive-level updates during significant cyber security incidents and crisis situations.
  • Define and own the Security Incident Management strategy, roadmap, and maturity objectives.
  • Develop a globally consistent incident response operating model across WPP.
  • Establish and maintain incident response frameworks, methodologies, and standards.
  • Drive adoption of intelligence-led and threat-informed response capabilities.
  • Ensure incident management processes support regulatory, legal, client, and contractual obligations.
  • Partner with Security Architecture, Security Technology & Visibility, Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, and Automation functions to continuously enhance response capability.
  • Lead the transformation of Security Incident Management into an automation-first capability aligned to ASO principles.
  • Partner with Automation & Process Engineering to automate investigation, triage, enrichment, containment, reporting, and evidence capture where appropriate.
  • Drive reductions in manual effort, investigator workload, Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
  • Ensure incident management processes can consume automated intelligence, orchestration workflows, and agentic capabilities with appropriate human oversight.
  • Sponsor operational innovation that improves quality, consistency, resilience, and scale.
  • Lead strategic coordination during major cyber incidents, ransomware events, breaches, regulatory incidents, and business-critical security events.
  • Coordinate Operational Security, Legal, Privacy, Enterprise Technology, Communications, Executive Leadership, and external partners.
  • Oversee engagement with forensic providers, law enforcement, cyber insurance providers, and specialist third parties where required.
  • Ensure effective recovery, lessons learned, and organisational improvement following major incidents.
  • Own Security Incident Management policies, standards, procedures, playbooks, and operating documentation.
  • Ensure incident response activities are auditable, measurable, and aligned to governance requirements.
  • Chair incident review and service improvement forums.
  • Oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Post Incident Review (PIR) programmes, ensuring actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
  • Support internal audit, client assurance, certification requirements, and regulatory reviews.
  • Define and own Security Incident Management KPIs, KRIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.
  • Provide regular reporting to Operational Security Leadership, Cyber Leadership, and executive stakeholders.
  • Drive continual service improvement through data-led decision-making.
  • Maintain visibility of incident trends, response effectiveness, control gaps, and organisational risk exposure.
  • Ensure lessons learned are converted into measurable improvements across detection, response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and automation.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and career development for personnel within the Security Incident Management function.
  • Build and maintain a high-performing investigation and response culture.
  • Establish competency frameworks, training plans, certification pathways, succession planning, and effective resource coverage.
  • Foster collaboration across Detection Engineering & Response, Threat Intelligence & Knowledge Sharing, Automation & Process Engineering, Technology & Visibility, and Vulnerability Management.

 

What you'll need:

Essential

  • Extensive experience leading enterprise-scale Security Incident Management or Incident Response functions.
  • Demonstrable experience directing major cyber security incidents and crisis response activities.
  • Strong understanding of modern incident response methodologies, operating models, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary cyber security teams in large, global organisations.
  • Deep technical understanding of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, cloud security, identity security, email security, and digital forensics.
  • Experience defining operational metrics, service management frameworks, and continual improvement programmes.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, executives, legal teams, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders.
  • Proven experience building and maturing operational security capabilities.

Desirable

  • Experience implementing automation-first or Autonomic Security Operations operating models.
  • Experience working within highly regulated, global, or federated organisations.
  • Familiarity with cyber crisis management and executive incident response.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCED, CGEIT, CRISC, or equivalent.

 

Who you'll be working with:

job.title: IAM Engineer - SSO
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Senior Identity and Access security Engineer is responsible for governing who, and what, can access DTS systems, data, APIs, tools, workflows and AI-enabled capabilities.

This is a hands-on governance and control role, reporting into the SVP Security and Compliance. The role ensures that access across DTS is appropriate, auditable, reviewed, least-privileged and aligned with security, privacy, compliance and client commitments.

The scope covers traditional human access, external users, privileged access, service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, dataset access, and the emerging governance of AI agents and agentic workflows.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Security, Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal/DPO, TechOps, Enterprise Technology and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure DTS has a clear and controlled model for access across platforms such as WPP Open, Choreograph, InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve and related DTS capabilities.

 

What you'll be doing:

1. Identity and access governance framework

Define and maintain the access governance framework for DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining access governance standards, processes and control expectations.
  • Establishing how access should be requested, approved, provisioned, reviewed, revoked and evidenced.
  • Ensuring access governance covers internal users, external users, clients, partners, vendors, service accounts, machine identities and AI agents.
  • Aligning identity and access governance with DTS architecture, security, privacy, compliance and data governance requirements.
  • Ensuring access governance is practical for product and engineering teams to implement.

 

2. Access reviews and recertification

Own the process for regular access reviews and recertification across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining the scope, frequency and evidence requirements for access reviews.
  • Coordinating access reviews for critical DTS systems, production environments, privileged roles, sensitive datasets, client-facing platforms and administrative tools.
  • Ensuring access review outcomes are tracked, remediated and evidenced.
  • Identifying stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Escalating overdue, high-risk or unresolved access issues through the appropriate governance channels.

 

3. Privileged access governance

Ensure privileged access across DTS is properly controlled, justified and auditable.

This includes:

  • Reviewing access to production systems, cloud environments, security tools, databases, CI/CD tooling, administrative consoles and sensitive platforms.
  • Supporting least-privilege, just-in-time and time-bound access models where appropriate.
  • Working with Cloud and Platform Security and Infrastructure to improve privileged access controls.
  • Ensuring privileged access risks are visible in the DTS risk register where required.

 

4. External user, client and partner access governance

Govern access for external users, clients, agencies, partners and vendors.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for external user onboarding, approval, permissions, expiry and offboarding.
  • Ensuring external access has a clear business owner and justification.
  • Supporting access governance across client workspaces, agency environments, partner integrations and shared collaboration areas.
  • Working with Product and Engineering to ensure tenant, workspace and client-level isolation is appropriately governed.
  • Tracking risks related to stale accounts, vendor access, partner permissions and external user overprivilege.

 

5. Service account, machine identity and API access governance

Govern non-human access across DTS systems and platforms.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for service accounts, machine identities, automation users, API keys, tokens, secrets and integration credentials.
  • Ensuring non-human access has clear ownership, purpose, scope, rotation, expiry and auditability.
  • Working with Product, Engineering, Cloud Security and Infrastructure to reduce unmanaged credential risk.
  • Ensuring service accounts and machine identities are included in access reviews.
  • Supporting stronger governance of API access, token issuance, credential lifecycle and integration permissions.

 

6. AI and agentic access governance

Define and oversee the governance model for AI agents and agentic workflows across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining how AI agents are identified, permissioned, monitored, reviewed and revoked.
  • Ensuring agents have clear ownership, scoped permissions and auditable actions.
  • Defining which agent actions require human approval or additional control.
  • Governing agent access to APIs, tools, datasets, workflows, client environments and production capabilities.
  • Ensuring agents act within delegated authority and cannot exceed the permissions of the user, system or business process they represent.
  • Working with Product, Architecture and Security to ensure agentic workflows are designed with clear action boundaries.
  • Working with the Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead to test whether agent permissions and action boundaries can be bypassed.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering to ensure AI access models support permitted use, minimisation and data protection requirements.

7. Data access governance

Govern access to sensitive, client, partner and WPP-owned data across DTS.

This includes:

  • Defining standards for dataset access approval, review, revocation and evidence.
  • Supporting data classification from an access-control and security-governance perspective.
  • Ensuring access to sensitive data is role-based, purpose-based, least-privileged and auditable.
  • Supporting controls for cross-client, cross-market, cross-agency and partner data access.
  • Ensuring data access governance supports InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open and other DTS data collaboration use cases.
  • Working with Privacy Engineering on data minimisation, permitted use, retention and privacy-by-design requirements.
  • Ensuring data access risks are surfaced through the DTS risk process.

 

8. Governance of access to tools, workflows and actions

Ensure access governance extends beyond systems and datasets into tools, workflows and actions.

This includes:

  • Defining governance for access to operational tools, workflow automation, orchestration systems, AI tools and administrative actions.
  • Ensuring high-risk actions are subject to appropriate approval, logging and monitoring.
  • Supporting segregation of duties across sensitive workflows.
  • Ensuring automated workflows and agents have clearly scoped authority.
  • Working with Security Operations to ensure high-risk access and actions are visible in monitoring and detection processes.

 

9. Auditability, evidence and reporting

Maintain clear evidence of access governance and support audit and assurance requirements.

This includes:

  • Producing access governance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, client assurance, internal audit and risk reviews.
  • Working with the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure access controls, reviews, exceptions and remediation actions are documented.
  • Reporting on access review completion, high-risk access, overdue actions and access control gaps.
  • Supporting client and audit questions related to identity, access, privileged roles, service accounts, AI agents and data access.
  • Ensuring access governance is repeatable, measurable and auditable.

 

Who you'll be working with:

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer will be accountable for:

  • DTS identity and access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews and recertification.
  • Privileged access governance.
  • External user, client, partner and vendor access governance.
  • Service account, machine identity, API key and token governance.
  • AI agent identity, permission and action governance.
  • Dataset and sensitive data access governance.
  • Governance of access to tools, workflows and high-risk actions.
  • Access governance evidence for audit, compliance and client assurance.
  • Escalation of material access risks into the DTS risk process.

 

What you'll need:

The successful candidate will have:

  • Experience in identity governance, access management, IAM, security governance, GRC, data access control or platform security.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, role-based access control, attribute-based access control, access reviews, privileged access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience governing access across SaaS platforms, cloud environments, APIs, data platforms or enterprise technology estates.
  • Knowledge of identity platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Azure AD / Entra ID or similar.
  • Understanding of service accounts, machine identities, API keys, tokens, secrets and non-human access governance.
  • Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, delegated authority and tool-access governance would be highly valuable.
  • Understanding of data classification, dataset access governance, privacy-by-design and audit requirements.
  • Ability to work across security, architecture, product, engineering, infrastructure, legal, privacy and compliance teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to coordinate reviews, evidence, remediation and reporting.
  • Ability to translate complex access issues into clear risks, controls and practical actions.

 

Leadership expectations

The Senior Identity and Access Security Engineer is expected to:

  • Be structured, disciplined and pragmatic.
  • Bring clarity to complex access and permission models.
  • Challenge excessive, unclear or poorly governed access.
  • Work constructively with product and engineering teams to design workable controls.
  • Avoid creating unnecessary bureaucracy while ensuring access is properly governed.
  • Treat human, machine and agent access as part of the same control landscape.
  • Escalate material access risks clearly and early.
  • Support DTS in building a secure, auditable and scalable access governance model.

 

Success measures

Success in the role will be measured by:

  • DTS having clear identity, access and data access governance standards.
  • Regular access reviews completed on schedule with evidence.
  • Reduction in stale, excessive, orphaned or poorly owned access.
  • Stronger governance of privileged access and production access.
  • Clear ownership and review of service accounts, machine identities, API keys and tokens.
  • Defined governance for AI agent identities, permissions and actions.
  • Improved auditability of access to data, APIs, tools, workflows and production systems.
  • Better alignment between identity, security, privacy, architecture, product and engineering teams.
  • Material access risks being visible through the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.
  • Increased confidence that DTS can answer: who or what has access to what, why, and when was it last reviewed?

Title: Lead Software Engineer

Level: Lead Engineer, Data & Technology Solutions

Location: Copenhagen

Reporting to: Director of Engineering

About Open Intelligence:

We are the Activation arm of WPP Open Intelligence. Our team builds the foundational data infrastructure and high-performance edge services that power WPP’s position in the market. With approximately one-third of all global media spend flowing through WPP, our platform operates at the core of this massive network-deeply integrated and adopted by the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. Operating at our scale presents unique engineering challenges. Our edge services currently handle over 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process 10,000 requests per second. With operations spanning the US, UK, and ongoing expansion into EMEA and APAC, our infrastructure continuously interacts with up to 98% of the population in our active markets. We are an engineering-led team focused on building robust, scalable, and highly reliable systems.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who thrives on owning backend systems end to end — architecture, delivery, and the people who build them. You care more about sound software design, reliable APIs, and clear ownership than about any single framework or language.

You are comfortable setting technical direction for a squad, mentoring engineers, and turning product roadmap into shippable, versioned contracts. Hands-on when it matters, you design and operate services, partner integrations, and orchestration components in production — authentication, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, and the operational discipline that keeps live systems healthy. You are likely highly proficient in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin, and experienced with cloud platforms, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. Interest in infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform), durable workflows, and AI coding assistants is a plus when it helps the team ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

Beyond the technical craft, you are a strong communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders, and align sibling teams on interfaces. You take ownership of reliability and technical debt for the systems your squad runs, escalate blockers early with clear options, and are motivated by growing both the platform and the engineers who build it.

 

WHY ARE WE HIRING We are at a critical inflection point in our growth and need to scale our engineering team to tackle an expanding set of complex challenges. As the digital ecosystem evolves, we are actively developing and releasing a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These solutions are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while remaining uncompromising on our promise to protect user privacy.

To support this product evolution, our infrastructure is undergoing massive global expansion. By the end of this year, we will be fully operational across the rest of the EMEA and APAC regions. Concurrently, we are deepening our integrations to support even more of the largest supply-side partners in the AdTech industry. We are hiring because we need strong engineering talent to help us architect for this next order of magnitude in scale-ensuring our systems remain resilient, performant, and compliant as our global footprint and feature set rapidly expand.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

· Lead an engineering squad: set technical direction, prioritize delivery, run design and code reviews, and grow engineers through mentoring and clear ownership.

· Own the architecture and health of activation and orchestration services — API, databases, partner gateways, internal integrations, MCP and agentic integrations.

· Partner with Product and sibling teams to turn roadmap phases into shippable, versioned contracts — not ad hoc

integrations.

· Drive API integration engineering: authentication, rate limiting, idempotency, retries, partial-update patterns, and runbooks as partner APIs evolve.

· Establish and uphold production standards — CI/CD, testing, observability, auditability, and safe release practices.

· Keep an end-to-end overview of how data flow through activation — what is live, what is in progress, and where dependencies or technical debt block the next phase.

· Contribute hands-on where it matters: critical paths, new gateways, framework foundations (e.g. tool registry, workflow runtime, guardrails hooks).

· Identify and address technical debt deliberately; balance speed with reliability for systems that support live campaigns.

· Share knowledge in design reviews, stand-ups, and cross-team forums; escalate blockers early with clear options.

· Stay curious about agentic orchestration, durable workflows, and AI coding assistants to improve how the team designs and ships software.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

· Strong communication — you explain trade-offs to engineers, product, and non-technical stakeholders and align multiple teams on interfaces.

· 6+ years in software engineering with 2+ years leading engineers or owning a significant technical area (team lead, staff, or equivalent).

· Proven delivery of backend and API-centric systems in production — services, integrations, or platforms at meaningful scale.

· Solid experience building and operating REST/HTTP APIs and event- or workflow-driven systems (durable state, async jobs, or orchestration).

· Comfort owning third-party integrations — auth, errors, versioning, operational monitoring, and partner-driven change.

· Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Go, or Java/Kotlin) and sound software design (patterns, testing, code review).

· Experience with CI/CD, Git, and testing — unit, integration, and boundary/contract tests where APIs matter.

· Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and deploying services with containers and Kubernetes.

· Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and production observability (metrics, logs, tracing).

· A track record of technical debt and reliability ownership — incidents, postmortems, and systemic fixes, not one-off firefighting.

· Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to improve team productivity without lowering the production bar.

 

NICE TO HAVE

· Experience leading delivery of orchestration, workflow, or agentic systems (tool registries, policy/guardrails, human-in-the-loop flows).

· Full-stack exposure — internal UIs or ops tools (e.g. change logs, escalations) backed by the same APIs you own.

· Familiarity with AdTech / MarTech — SSPs, DSPs, deals, audiences, or campaign activation terminology.

· Experience in a monorepo or large shared codebase with many integration surfaces.

· Awareness of data privacy and safe handling of sensitive data in distributed deployments.

· Prior work on audit trails or decision logs for high-trust or automated systems.

Approximately one-third of global media spend flows through WPP, and our platform is deeply integrated with major supply-side partners across the AdTech industry. At our current scale, our edge services handle more than 60,000 classification requests per second, while our contextual classification pipelines process approximately 10,000 requests per second.

We are expanding our engineering team to support the next stage of growth and a new catalog of privacy-preserving data products. These products are designed to scale advanced targeting capabilities while protecting user privacy.

This is a highly strategic, lead-level role for someone who understands modern attack paths and wants to shape how security is measured and improved. Technical Security & Exposure Governance

Adversarial Assurance Governance

  • Oversee and govern continuous adversarial testing and offensive validation programs across infrastructure, applications, APIs, cloud, and identity.

  • 新しいツール（AIや新しいプロセス）に柔軟に対応し、それらを活用して新たな広告プロセスを構築する意欲がある

 

主な職務

  • 戦略的リーダーシップ
    • ストラテジストと連携し、洞察に満ちたブランド戦略やコミュニケーション戦略の立案を推進する。
    • クライアントやストラテジストと共に、ビジネス目標に沿った精度の高いクリエイティブブリーフを共創し、End to Endで推進する。
    • ストラテジストならびにコネクションプランナーと連携し、キャンペーン全体における消費者ジャーニー、各ファネル・チャネルの役割、コネクションポイントを定義し、コミュニケーションプランの策定を主導する。

    • クリエイティブチームと連携し、インパクトのある革新的なアイデアの創出を推進する。
    • 優れたクリエイティブアイデアを擁護し、各タッチポイントで最高の水準で実行されるよう導く。
    • 大胆なアイデアが生まれやすい環境作りを支援する。
  • クライアントおよび外部パートナーとの関係構築
    • 日々のクライアント担当者やシニアステークホルダーと、信頼に基づいた強固な関係を構築・維持する。
    • クライアントの期待を超えるため、彼らのビジネス、ブランド、社内プロセスを深く理解する。

  • チームマネジメント
    • チームメンバーが最高水準のサービスを提供できるよう、day to dayの業務を支援し、モチベーションを高める。
    • チームメンバーのトレーニングや能力開発のニーズ把握に貢献する。
    • 協力的でポジティブなチーム環境を醸成する。
  • リーダーシップ
    • 困難な状況に対して問題を前向きに乗り越え、ソリューションファーストのマインドセットを持ってチームを導く。
    • クライアントやOpen X / Studio X Leadershipのビジョンを深く理解し、トランスフォーメーションを推進するドライバーとなる。
    • シニアステークホルダーや外部パートナーと協力し、プロジェクトで最良の成果を達成する。
    • チーム内の模範として、効果的なコミュニケーションと品質へのコミットメントを示す。
  • グロースへの貢献
    • 効果的かつ効率的にチーム運営を行うことができる。
    • 新しいビジネスの機会を視野に入れて行動できる。

 

Job Overview

As the Integration Lead, you will play a crucial client-facing role within the team dedicated to the Coca-Cola account. You will lead the planning, development, and production of integrated marketing campaigns across various touchpoints—including TVC, events, digital, social and shopper — by collaborating closely with internal and external specialist teams such as creative, strategy, media, social, digital, and shopper. As a member of VML & Ogilvy Japan, part of the WPP network, you are expected to become a trusted partner to the client and contribute to their business success.

 

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a full-service advertising agency or equivalent client service experience.

Who you are

  • Adaptable to new tools (e.g., AI, new processes) and motivated to leverage them to build new ways of work.

 

Key Accountabilities

    • In collaboration with strategists and connection planners, define the consumer journey, the role of each funnel and channel, and key connection points to lead the development of the overall communication plan.
  • Creativity
    • Partner with creative teams to drive the creation of impactful and innovative ideas.
    • Champion excellent creative ideas and guide their execution to the highest standard at every touchpoint.
    • Help create an environment where bold ideas can flourish.
  • Client Management and External Parties
    • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with day-to-day clients and senior stakeholders.
    • Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand, and internal processes to exceed their expectations.
    • Liaise with media partners and other external collaborators to orchestrate a single, comprehensive experience and ensure seamless campaign implementation.
  • Team Management
    • Support and motivate team members in their day-to-day tasks, to deliver the highest standard of service.
    • Contribute to identifying team members' training and development needs.
    • Foster a collaborative and positive team environment.
  • Leadership
    • Lead the team through challenging situations with a positive, solution-first mindset.
    • Become a key driver of transformation by deeply understanding and promoting the vision of the client and Open X / Studio X Leadership.
    • Partner with senior stakeholders and external partners to achieve the best project outcomes.
    • Serve as a role model within the team, demonstrating effective communication and a commitment to quality.
  • Contribution to Growth
    • Be responsible for managing the team efficiently and effectively.
    • Actively identify and pursue new business opportunities.
