job.title: VML & Ogilvy | Senior Social Strategist (WPP Content Studio), Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

The Role 

You are a hands-on strategist who can turn a brand problem into social work people would choose to spend time with. You find the audience behavior that matters, give social a clear job and build a plan the team can make. 

You own strategy workstreams across client brands, from always-on content to campaigns and creator work. You work with the Social Strategy Lead and with creative, account, media, production and analytics teams. You lead client conversations on your assignments and help junior strategists improve through direct feedback. 

You know the platforms from the inside, but you can also zoom out to the brand idea and the wider customer journey. You understand how organic content and paid social move people from discovery to action, and can explain why a plan should perform. 

What You Will Lead 

Social Strategy and Planning 

  • Turn business and brand briefs into audience insight, a clear social role and useful creative briefs.
  • Build always-on and campaign plans with distinct jobs for channels such as Instagram (Meta), TikTok, X, LINE and YouTube, where relevant.
  • Give organic, paid, owned and earned work distinct roles across the funnel, with creators and communities where they serve the idea.
  • Stay involved from strategy through content planning and production so the idea survives execution.

Performance, Data, and AI 

  • Use social listening, platform data and client research to find opportunities and test assumptions.
  • Lead paid social planning for your assignments: objectives, audiences, placements, budget split, creative variants and test design.
  • Work with media and analytics teams to read performance, improve creative and targeting, and make clear recommendations on spend.
  • Set KPIs for each stage of the funnel, with a baseline and a learning goal. Know when reach, engagement, traffic, conversion or cost per result matters.
  • Build agentic workflows with AI and WPP.open that turn client briefs, audience signals and performance data into strategic choices, then carry those choices into creative briefs, channel plans, content guidance and next tests, with human review.

Content and Channels 

  • Partner with creatives to shape platform-native ideas, hooks and formats that work in feeds and paid placements.
  • Write channel guidance and examples that make the strategy useful to creators and production teams.
  • Apply a current understanding of Japanese audience behavior and platform conventions.
  • Define the role of creators and influencers in the plan and how their contribution will be judged.

Client Leadership and Teamwork 

  • Lead the strategy and paid social planning workstream for assigned projects, present your thinking and handle client feedback clearly.
  • Work with account, creative, media, creator and analytics partners to make one coherent plan.
  • Mentor junior strategists through briefs, reviews and specific feedback on their work.
  • Keep decisions, deadlines and handovers clear when several projects are moving at once.

What You Bring 

Experience 

  • Strong social strategy experience across brands, with independent ownership of campaigns or always-on programs.
  • Work that shows the path from insight and brief to live content and what it achieved.
  • Experience leading paid social and performance marketing plans, with a working knowledge of how campaigns are set up, bought, optimized and measured across the funnel.
  • Working knowledge of major social platforms in Japan, organic social and creator partnerships.
  • Ability to connect brand strategy and the wider customer journey to the work social can do best.
  • Confidence presenting recommendations to clients and working across disciplines.

Craft 

  • Sharp at finding the useful insight, writing a single-minded brief and making a clear deck.
  • Able to guide content ideas without flattening what makes them native to a platform.
  • Comfortable with listening, analytics and paid platform results, and able to turn a report into the next action.
  • An instinct for building useful agentic workflows, with the judgment to check and improve their output.

Mindset 

  • Close to social culture without chasing every trend.
  • Collaborative, practical and open to challenge.
  • Calm under pressure and comfortable moving between strategy and detail.
  • Generous with junior teammates and accountable for your own work.

Language Requirements 

Able to work effectively with Japanese and English-speaking teams and clients.

job.title: VML & Ogilvy | Social Strategy Lead, Japan
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Purpose:

The Social Strategy Lead plays a senior leadership role across social strategy and intelligence within WPP Content Studio Japan.

This person helps shape how social is understood, planned, measured, and evolved across Content Studio clients, including BAT, Nestle, and future WPP Japan clients.

This is not an executional planner role, but a leadership role for someone who can set direction, read culture, interpret platform signals, guide strategy teams, and help clients understand what brands should do on social and why.

The role sits at the intersection of social strategy, culture, data, platform behavior, creator ecosystems, AI-enabled workflows, and measurable business impact.

The Social Strategy Lead works closely with the Content Studio Lead, who owns business and account leadership. Together, they ensure the studio delivers work that is strategically sharp, creatively strong, operationally realistic, and commercially valuable.

What Success Looks Like

  • WPP Content Studio Japan has a clear, credible, and differentiated social POV.
  • Every client has a clear social strategy across always-on, campaign, creator, paid, organic, owned, and earned.
  • Social listening and performance data turn into real creative and business decisions.
  • Teams stop reacting to trends blindly and start using signals intelligently.
  • Clients see WPP Content Studio as a senior social strategy partner, not just a content delivery team.
  • AI and WPP.open become practical tools inside strategy, insight, ideation, reporting, and learning loops.
  • Social work becomes more platform-native, culturally relevant, measurable, and easier to scale.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Social Strategy Leadership
  • Lead social strategy initiatives across key WPP Content Studio Japan clients.
  • Set clear platform roles across Meta, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, emerging channels, and client-specific ecosystems.
  • Connect organic, paid, owned, earned, creator, and community activity into one clear strategic system.
  • Translate business goals into social priorities, content principles, channel roles, and measurement frameworks.
  • Ensure always-on and campaign work ladder up to a clear brand and business objective.
  • Act as the senior social strategy POV across key client conversations and internal decision-making.
  1. Social Intelligence, Culture, and Listening
  • Lead the studio’s social intelligence and listening capability.
  • Turn social signals into actionable insight, not trend noise.
  • Oversee how teams read audience behavior, platform shifts, category conversations, creator movements, and cultural tensions.
  • Build repeatable intelligence outputs for clients and internal teams.
  • Use social data to identify opportunity spaces, risk areas, content territories, creator angles, and community behaviors.
  • Ensure Japan-first cultural nuance is embedded into social strategy, especially for regulated or sensitive categories.
  1. Platform and Content Direction
  • Guide teams on what works natively across different platforms and why.
  • Define format strategy by platform, audience, behavior, and objective.
  • Shape recommendations around hooks, storytelling, creator formats, community mechanics, captions, social commerce, search behavior, and shareability.
  • Partner with creative teams to push ideas beyond generic calendars and campaign cut-downs.
  • Ensure content is designed for the feed, the algorithm, the audience, and the brand.
  1. Creator and Community Strategy
  • Define the strategic role of creators across client work.
  • Guide creator archetypes, casting logic, briefing angles, collaboration models, and success metrics.
  • Partner with casting, PR, media, and account teams to ensure creator work is more than talent selection.
  • Build community-aware thinking into social plans, including conversation drivers, UGC mechanics, participation loops, and earned potential.
  • Help clients understand when to use creators, when not to, and how to measure value beyond reach.
  1. Measurement, Reporting, and PDCA
  • Define KPI frameworks across organic, paid, creator, campaign, and always-on content.
  • Ensure reporting answers what worked, what failed, why, and what to do next.
  • Partner with analytics and media teams to connect performance data with creative decisions.
  • Establish learning loops that improve briefs, formats, creative rules, posting rhythm, and content investment.
  • Push the studio away from passive reporting and toward active optimization.
  1. AI and WPP.open Enablement
  • Use AI and WPP.open to improve strategy quality, speed, and scale.
  • Help design AI-enabled workflows for insight mining, persona development, content territory building, platform adaptation, reporting, and post-campaign learning.
  • Partner with the Chief Content Architect to codify useful agentic workflows.
  • Set clear human review points so AI supports judgment but does not replace it.
  • Help strategy teams build better prompts, better frameworks, and better decision systems.
  1. Client and Stakeholder Leadership
  • Join senior client conversations as the social strategy lead.
  • Present social POVs clearly and confidently to clients, regional teams, and internal leadership.
  • Help clients navigate platform changes without hype or panic.
  • Translate complex social behavior into simple business-facing recommendations.
  • Support new business and organic growth by showing how WPP Content Studio can lead modern social thinking.
  1. Team Leadership and Standards
  • The Social Strategy Lead works closely with strategy and planning talent across WPP Content Studio Japan to elevate strategic quality and collaboration.
  • This includes close collaboration with social strategists, content planners, social analysts, and related strategic roles across client teams.
  • The role is responsible for setting the standard of strategic thinking across the studio, ensuring that every planner and strategist works from a shared understanding of social behavior, platform roles, audience insight, creator ecosystems, and performance learning.
  • The Social Strategy Lead is accountable for developing the strategy team’s capability, reviewing strategic outputs, mentoring talent, and ensuring planners and strategists are proactive, culturally sharp, data-aware, and able to guide both clients and creative teams with confidence.
  • Create clear ways of working between strategy, creative, media, analytics, account, and production teams.
  • Build a culture of curiosity, speed, accountability, and practical excellence.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a community manager.
  • Not a content calendar operator.
  • Not just a trend hunter.
  • Not a reporting-only role.
  • Not responsible for running the business alone.
  • Not the person who fixes every executional issue.

This person sets the social direction and ensures the studio acts intelligently.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +5 tears of strong senior experience in social, digital or content strategy, or platform-led brand strategy.
  • Proven ability to lead strategy across multiple brands or business units.
  • Deep understanding of Japan social behavior and major platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube, creator ecosystems, paid/organic dynamics, and emerging formats.
  • Hands-on experience with social listening, performance reporting, audience insight, and cultural analysis.
  • Ability to connect data, culture, platform behavior, brand goals, and creative ideas.
  • Confident client-facing presence with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or mentoring strategy, planning, intelligence, or content teams.
  • Comfortable using AI tools, prompt systems, WPP.open, and automation to strengthen strategy work.
  • Strong deck, storytelling, presentation, and simplification skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Clear, calm, and decisive.
  • Culturally curious and platform-native.
  • Strategic but practical.
  • Strong enough to challenge weak thinking.

  2. 制作企画、印刷、撮影、カラーレタッチの制作に関する十分な知識

  5. 創造的で柔軟性があり、業務への情熱と前向きな姿勢を持ち続けられること
  6. タイトな納期に対応できる作業スピードを持ち、要求の厳しいクリエイティブおよびプロダクション環境で働く能力があること
  7. 優れたコミュニケーション能力と対人スキル
  8. 日本語のネイティブスピーカーであること

  1. Adobe InDesign、Illustrator、Photoshopなどデザインソフトの実務経験
  2. 英語力 (基本的な会話やドキュメンテーションの解読力)

WPP Productionについて

私たちWPP Productionは、WPPグループ内のあらゆるコンテンツプロデューサー、スタジオ、そして制作（クラフト）の専門家を結集し、ひとつの繋がった組織として統合されたグローバル・プロダクション・カンパニーです。

世界最高峰の人間によるクラフトマンシップ（熟練した制作技術）と次世代テクノロジーを融合させ、大規模なマルチチャネル・コンテンツシステムを企画・デザインし、世界へと届けています。

国境のないボーダレスなコラボレーションを前提に構築され、深い制作技術の専門性に裏打ちされた私たちは、常時稼働（Always-on）かつAI主導で動く現代のマーケティング世界のために設計された「プロダクション・エンジン（制作の中核）」です。　なお、WPP ProductionはWPPグループの一員です。

Purpose of the role 

The Senior Analyst, Purchase to Pay (PTP), is part of a team responsible for performing day to day tasks within the Purchase to Pay (PTP) function covering Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense and Payment, as well as Month End Closing process and some other specific accounting activities related to the stream. The Senior Analyst will be required to handle activities for any of the subfunctions within the PTP function as assigned by the PTP manager.

Key responsibilities include accurate and timely recording and payment of vendor invoices, statutory payments, employees claim and intercompany transactions in accordance to the defined SLAs/KPIs while adhering to Company policies and procedures as well as relevant legal and statutory requirements.

The Senior Analyst will work with management to drive the implementation of global process initiatives to streamline and/or automate the PTP process which includes system enhancement and process improvement. 

What you'll be doing:

Job Description 

Accounts Payable (AP) & Invoice Processing:

Receive and scan vendor invoice/vendor billing files and supporting documents  Check all invoices for proper documentation, attach the invoice to the AP System and submit for payment accordingly. Ensure invoices are processed in line with WPP Policies, SOX requirements, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP). Process invoices, credit memos and debit memos in a timely and accurate manner according to SLA / KPI set by management and agreed with WPP Operating Companies (OpCo) Ensures that all invoices assigned are properly accounted for at the end of each business day. Respond to vendor inquiries. Follow up with vendor and respective OpCo to resolve all discrepancies in a timely manner Verifies vendor accounts by reconciling monthly statements and related transactions. Perform reconciliations of vendor statements, research and address discrepancies as appropriate. Review reconciliation and supporting documentation for purchases made by Company Settled Credit Card and revert to OpCo on queries Properly book and upload all intercompany transactions Work with PTP Leaders on Account Analysis to clear Aged AP and Net Debit Balance (NDB)

Payments Processing:

Generate proposed payment selection file or be the reviewer of proposed payment selection file in accordance with agreed timetable.  Submit the payment selection file to the OpCo in line with the agreed timetable or be generater of payment confirmation file in accordance with agreed timetable, base on proposed payment selection approved. Review, request amendments where applicable, and submit to approvers to authorise payment aligned to the agreed timetablet or be the reviewer the amendments and regenerate payment confirmation. Transact payment to bank in accordance with the country/OpCo banking functionality Responsible for the following tasks related to payments: Act as main contact with bank regarding payments queries. Process Time and Expense (T&E) related payment. Process and post cheque and wire remittance deposits to the appropriate bank account and invoices, ensuring reconciliation of the batch. The work will include preparing Inuktitut versions of program material for use on radio and television programs.

Function:

Performs a variety of tasks associated with the preparation, production and presentation of programs and program material – for example, announcing, hosting, versioning between English and Inuktitut, writing and operating production equipment.   • Plans and organizes, or participates in the planning and organizing of programs or program segments, ensures the preparation of material for broadcast and, where a Producer is not assigned, assumes production responsibility

  • Develops and maintains contacts with a variety of sources

  • Gathers and reports information from various sources

  • Evaluates information gathered, organizes it and presents it on air in a coherent and understandable form

  • Describes actualities such as music programs, parades and sporting or other special events

  • Reads newscasts, news bulletins, weather forecasts and other survival information

  • Ensures the proper operating condition of equipment by making the necessary checks

  • Ensures that program audio mixes achieve optimum results

  • In case of technical failure, makes emergency substitutions or repairs to maintain clear and continuous service; ensures appropriate follow-up

  • As required, performs the following tasks:

    • participate in community relations activities to promote the CBC;

    • direct a program or program segment in studio or at a remote location;

    • maintain an appropriate level of communication with members of the audience;

    • archive programs and program scripts and lineups;

    • perform incidental technical functions necessary to ensure the smooth and continuous functioning of the station.

  • Excellent on-air presentation skills  

  • Excellent Inuktitut skills

  • Good writing, and interviewing skills

  • A critical thinker with strong editorial judgment

  • A strong understanding of Inuit and northern issues

  • Good computer skills and willingness to maintain Social Media networks using external platforms like Facebook, Twitter etc.

  • Mature, positive attitude and an excellent ability to contribute to a team environment

  • Demonstrated ability to perform at a high level in a high pressure, tight deadline environment.

job.description:
Corus est une force motrice de l'industrie des médias, avec un portefeuille diversifié de marques reconnues qui divertissent et informent les auditoires par le biais de récits exceptionnels et de contenu captivant, touchant chaque jour des millions de personnes à travers le monde entier.

Notre culture et notre équipe sont ce qui fait de nous, noUS.

Nous sommes passionnés par le désir de tisser des liens avec le monde qui nous entoure : nous voulons exprimer, échanger et faire partie de la vie des gens. Notre culture primée est l'expression de qui nous sommes, ce que nous faisons et comment nous prospérons. Nos valeurs représentent notre culture en action. Elles décrivent notre manière d'atteindre nos objectifs, de travailler ensemble, de nous engager avec nos partenaires et d'interagir avec nos collectivités. Chez Corus, nous Gagnons ensemble, Pensons différemment, Faisons avancer les choses, Apprenons chaque jour, et Démontrons notre bienveillance.

Prêt à vous joindre à noUS?

Envie de découvrir les coulisses de la télé? Tu cherches une équipe chaleureuse et un nouveau défi? Corus Média recherche une personne créative et organisée pour propulser la présence numérique de nos chaînes spécialisées francophones : Vivéo, Historia, Séries Plus et Télétoon la nuit.

Tu orchestreras le calendrier éditorial, tu créeras des contenus visuels et vidéo accrocheurs, tu déploieras des campagnes payantes et tu géreras nos chaînes YouTube, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes et nos partenaires de production.

Ta mission : faire briller nos marques en ligne, engager nos communautés et mettre en valeur nos productions grâce à des contenus créatifs et performants.

Pour accomplir cette mission, il te faudra faire preuve de créativité, d’organisation, de proactivité et avoir un vif intérêt pour la télé québécoise et les tendances numériques. Nous cherchons une personne passionnée et capable de jongler plusieurs projets à la fois sur qui l’équipe peut compter!

Tes responsabilités

Stratégie et planification

• Contribuer à l’élaboration de la stratégie numérique et sociale de nos marques, puis la déployer.

• Concevoir le calendrier éditorial et en assurer le suivi, de la production à la diffusion.

• Repérer les tendances émergentes et proposer des concepts novateurs pour maximiser notre portée.

• Collaborer avec l’équipe des communications pour les trousses de presse numériques, les partenariats, les concours et tous les autres projets spéciaux.

• Travailler en synergie avec la responsable du service à l’auditoire pour la gestion de communauté.

• Conseiller les équipes internes sur les meilleures pratiques et les outils numériques.

Création et gestion de contenu

• Piloter tout le cycle de production en collaboration avec l'équipe créative : idéation, création visuelle, montage vidéo (publications, Reels, Stories, etc.) et diffusion.

• Gérer et optimiser les chaînes YouTube de nos marques, y compris leur référencement (SEO).

• Collaborer avec les équipes de production pour repérer les occasions de captation de contenu et coordonner le crosspostage.

• Appliquer les meilleures pratiques d’accessibilité numérique (sous-titres, formats adaptés, lisibilité).

Publicité numérique et analyse de performance

• Paramétrer, programmer et optimiser des campagnes payantes sur Meta Ads et Google Ads.

• Mesurer la performance (organique et payant), puis présenter résultats et recommandations.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Études en communications, marketing numérique, médias sociaux ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion de médias sociaux, création de contenu et placement publicitaire numérique.

• Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français.

• Maîtrise de ensemble des outils de Meta et de Google Ads (paramétrage, ciblage, suivi).

• Bonne connaissance de YouTube et de ses outils d’optimisation (SEO vidéo, listes de lecture).

• Maîtrise d’outils de création et de montage (Photoshop, Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva ou équivalents)

• Anglais fonctionnel, requis pour communiquer efficacement avec les partenaires

• Vif intérêt pour la télé québécoise, la culture et les contenus d’ici.

• Curiosité marquée pour les tendances du web.

Envoie ta candidature d’ici le 30 octobre 2026. Nous communiquerons uniquement avec les personnes retenues pour une entrevue.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Company Overview

Cumulus Media is an audio-first media company delivering premium content to a quarter billion people every month — wherever and whenever they want it. Cumulus Media engages listeners with high-quality local programming through 377 owned-and-operated radio stations across 84 markets; delivers nationally-syndicated sports, news, talk, and entertainment programming from iconic brands including the NFL, the NCAA, the Masters, US Soccer, and AP News, across more than 7,800 affiliated stations through Westwood One, a leading national audio network; and inspires listeners through the Cumulus Podcast Network, an established and influential platform for original podcasts that are smart, entertaining, and thought-provoking. Cumulus Media provides advertisers with personal connections, local impact and national reach through broadcast and on-demand digital, mobile, social, and voice-activated platforms, as well as integrated digital marketing services, powerful influencers, full-service audio solutions, industry-leading research and insights, and live event experiences. For more information visit www.cumulusmedia.com.


Position Overview

The Account Executive successfully manages relationships with dozens of local and regional businesses, protects and grows the revenue base, identifies and creates new business opportunities with existing and new clients; provides marketing solutions to help customers achieve their business goals; strategically plans and implements initiatives to meet personal, company and corporate directives, recognizes that achieving budgeted revenue targets is the minimum expectation of performance. The right individual will invest in personal professional development, understanding technology, marketing and the full suite of company products and services.


Key Responsibilities & Qualifications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Able to create and identify client business needs by gaining a deep understanding of their goals, objectives and processes as well as their external environment including key market and consumer trends to proactively develop customized marketing solutions to meet client objectives
  • Deliver and Develop effective and informed marketing solutions via multi-platform, integrated sales presentations identifying Cumulus broadcast, digital, and event tactics to foster brand loyalty and deliver results for the client
  • Ability to negotiate and close business that drives revenue results and fosters long term client relationships, regardless of medium or platform
  • Commitment to having a proficient understanding of the Cumulus Media assets and resources and a desire to constantly learn and grow your product knowledge thus staying relevant and current with industry advertising opportunities for your clients
  • Represent the full suite of products and services as marketing solutions to new and existing clientele. This includes station digital assets, internet-based marketing, social media, streaming, events and specialized programming
  • Ability to appropriately manage time to optimize revenue opportunities, client interaction, implementation and fulfillment of successful sales agreements. Individual must be able to assist in the development of creative messaging, regardless of platform
  • Excel at prospecting and aggressively seeking new clientele by networking, cold calling, canvassing, referrals or other means to maintain a full pipeline of sales prospects at all times
  • Follow all station and corporate procedures for preparing orders, resolving billing issues, submitting regular reports regarding sales, pipeline lists, forecasts and competitive analysis
  • Collaborate, create, and capitalize on opportunities to best represent our brand while working to help your clients achieve success


Qualifications:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, social networking platforms and CRM tools
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Passion for developing new business relationships in an outside sales role
  • Enjoy presenting to clients of sales opportunities and post-sale successes
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and ability to connect with viable prospects
  • Comprehension of sales metrics in order to fill a sales funnel and maintain a constant pipeline of new business
  • Self-motivating and entrepreneurial spirit
  • Positive and friendly with a willingness to collaborate
  • High energy and passion for sales
  • Flexible, creative and curious
  • Digitally savvy
  • 3+ years in Media Sales background preferred

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.


The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5+ years of systems engineering, Linux administration, or broadcast/media platform support experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Dalet Galaxy / Dalet Plus or comparable MAM platforms strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and Bash scripting; ability to build and maintain production monitoring automation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux administration, MS-SQL, XML/metadata workflows, and basic networking.
  • Experience supporting live production or newsroom editorial environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and ownership through completion.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable partnering with vendors, editorial staff, and engineering teams.

job.title: Streaming Host/Digital Producer
job.description:
If you’re a video-savvy person who is innovative and lives for creating  news content for streaming and digital platforms, we want to hear from you!

DC News Now has an exciting opportunity for someone to join us as a Streaming Host/Digital Producer.

The ideal host/digital producer is creative, thriving  in a collaborative environment. The person serving in the position will be a leader in the newsroom, developing quality content that follows the highest journalistic standards and provides a rich experience for our community.

We are looking for a storyteller who is plugged into the community and takes an audience-first approach to producing and sharing programs, videos, and other content across streaming, digital, social, and linear platforms. We operate as one content team in our newsroom, which means the host/digital producer will work closely with other content creators including broadcast producers, photojournalists, anchors, and reporters.

RESPONSIBILITIES

•    Produce audience-first, engaging content through original programming for the DC News Now streaming apps

•    Support telling the stories of communities throughout  the D.C. area through videos, social media posts, live streams, and digital articles

•    Social listening: monitor social chatter and track trending stories via Chartbeat, Google Trends, and our social media platforms; report findings to newsroom

•    Urgently and aggressively report news on streaming and digital  platforms as it happens

•    Focus on accuracy and balance in stories and social content through copy editing and training of staff

•    Produce, shoot, and/or edit videos for DC News Now digital and streaming platforms

•    Drive website traffic through Search Engine Optimization and/or Generative Engine Optimization best practices, website management, app management, push notifications, and application of advanced social media skills

•    Work with all newsroom team members on content coverage, digital-broadcast coordination, and social listening

•    Use digital and social analytics to inform editorial decisions

•    Assist reporters and anchors in the creation of native social content

•    Implement best practices on DC News Now digital, streaming, and social media platforms

•    Ensure newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the DC News Now brand across platforms

QUALIFICATIONS 

•    1-2 years experience in streaming and/or digital content production, including on-camera work, preferred

•    Excellent organization and time management capabilities

•    Strong written and verbal communication skills

•    Video editing experience

•    Familiarity with OBS and/or vMix a plus

•    High standard of professionalism and accuracy

•    Audience-focused, solution-oriented approach

•    Positive outlook and enjoyment working in a team environment
 

Compensation Range: $30 - $33 (hourly) based upon experience

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more. job.title: Director, Partnership Sales
job.description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Director, Partnership Sales develops, secures and grows strategic partnerships that advance the PGA of America’s mission to serve the Member and grow the game of golf. This role leads the partnership sales process from prospecting and outreach through proposal development, negotiation, contracting and onboarding. While collaborating across the Association to create customized opportunities across the PGA’s championships, events, member and consumer platforms, media, digital, PGA REACH, education, hospitality, licensing, content and other strategic assets. The Director builds trusted relationships with brand decision-makers, agencies, media partners and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful value, achieve revenue objectives, maintain a strong sales pipeline, support partner retention and identify opportunities to expand existing relationships.

RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

Lead partnership sales efforts, including prospecting, outreach, presentations, negotiations and closing.

Develop and manage a qualified sales pipeline to achieve new business, renewal and revenue goals.

Identify prospective partners and emerging opportunities aligned with the PGA’s mission, audiences and assets.

Create customized partnership proposals, sales materials, pricing strategies and financial analyses.

Collaborate with internal departments and media partners to develop integrated opportunities across PGA assets.

Lead contract development and negotiations in partnership with Legal and senior leadership.

Manage relationships with assigned partners, ensuring satisfaction, delivery of benefits and achievement of objectives.

Develop recaps and performance reports to demonstrate partner engagement, return on investment and renewal opportunities.

Identify opportunities to retain, renew, extend and expand existing partnerships.

Maintain strong relationships with brand decision-makers, agencies and industry contacts.

Monitor industry trends and competitive activity to inform sales strategies and identify new revenue opportunities.

Communicate partnership opportunities, agreements, progress and challenges to senior leadership.

INCLUSION:

Employees are expected to contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and respecting others’ beliefs, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and individuality to help ensure a supportive and engaging experience for Association Members, partners, customers, and guests. PGA of America respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and thrive. 

SHARED VALUES: 

 

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing. 

SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibility.

FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

Assists in the development of the partnership development budget and manage partnership activations within assigned budgets.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Sports Management or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred. 


Five or more years of progressive experience in partnership sales, sponsorship sales, sports marketing, media sales, experiential marketing or a related discipline.

Demonstrated success securing and growing complex partnerships and strategic business relationships, including developing proposals, presentations, financial analyses and contracts.

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and build relationships with senior clients, agencies and internal stakeholders, with a strong understanding of integrated marketing, media, digital, content, hospitality and experiential activation.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

Job Knowledge/Technology:  Must have knowledge of partnership sales techniques, integrated marketing and the golf or sports industry. Ability to communicate effectively across multiple mediums, manage sales and marketing activities, maintain a sales pipeline, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners. Demonstrated ability to develop partnership opportunities aligned with the PGA of America’s strategic priorities, understand client needs, and support revenue growth. Requires strong presentation, relationship management, financial analysis and contract negotiation skills, as well as proficiency with standard business and customer relationship management technologies. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders.

Ability to travel up to 40%.

Travel is required both domestically and internationally.

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Podcast Coordinator
job.description:
Fox News Audio is looking for a Podcast Coordinator to be part of the fast-paced and growing FOX News Podcast Network. The Podcast Coordinator will assist the Podcast Producers in blocking, booking, gathering sound, and assisting in the production of FOX News Audio’s daily and weekly podcasts. In addition to their production duties, the Podcast Coordinator will also create social media posts and website write-ups to promote the products. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate the programming and platform placement across the FOX News podcast portfolio
  • Assist in producing podcast segments, along with coordinating reporters, talent live remotes, and recordings
  • Manage and keep clear communication with reporters, editors, assignment desk, and anchors
  • Update content on platforms as stories progress
  • Work closely with producers on developing stories and new content creation
  • Create content to populate our social media pages across multiple verticals
  • Work with producers to fact check copy, QC audio quality, and ensure the final products meet editorial & CMS requirements
  • This role may also assist in the editorial structuring of podcast content

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Experience editing all-news radio or producing podcast programming
  • Highly skilled in writing and copy editing
  • Strong digital journalism skills and social media experience
  • Ability to make the right decisions during breaking news situations, as well as during routine shifts
  • Ability to interact with high profile talent
  • Great communication skills, a terrific attitude, and ability to collaborate with the team
  • Creative and “out of the box” thinking
  • Avid news consumer with prior journalism experience, preferably in an audio newsroom
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts in a 24/7 news operation, including nights, overnights, weekends, and early mornings
  • Knowledge of iNews, ENCO, and Adobe Audition (Cool-Edit) is a plus

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
The Systems Engineer is an individual contributor on the Digital Newsroom (DNR) Systems Administration team responsible for the engineering, automation, and operational reliability of the Dalet media-asset-management platform and related production systems in New York and Washington, DC. This backfill position replaces a retiring engineer and restores capacity for scripting, proactive monitoring, data migration, and frontline production support across NY and DC.

The Systems Engineer works closely with editorial, media desk, library, and operations teams, partners with Dalet support and internal engineering groups on Mimir, Pyramid, and Project Fresh Start initiatives, and contributes to the team's transition from reactive ticket handling to automated detection and remediation. Success requires strong Dalet platform knowledge, disciplined scripting in PowerShell and Bash, and dependable ownership through completion — including weekends and live production windows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Dalet Platform Engineering & Administration
    • Administer and troubleshoot the Dalet MAM environment in NY and DC — including Dalet Admin Tool configuration, BPM workflows, proxy generation, WebSpace, Wowza load balancers, workflow servers, and ingest/recording components (Brio).
    • Resolve escalated production issues: proxy-not-generating failures, media sync problems, ZID-to-DCID transfer errors, mount failures, TRINT workflow disruption, and slug/metadata special-character recording failures.
    • Configure Dalet Admin Tool settings and BPM rules to prevent recurring operational failures (e.g., illegal-character handling, recording-stuck conditions).
    • Support restricted-folder lifecycle, asset restore/purge requests, and media-desk coordination for NY and DC editorial workflows.
    • Partner with Dalet iCare/support on complex escalations; document root cause and remediation in ServiceNow (DNRNYD) and Confluence.
  • Monitoring, Scripting & Automation
    • Develop, maintain, and extend production monitoring and remediation scripts (PowerShell and Bash) covering recurring Dalet failure modes — Brio recording stuck, MDS/MDD agent health, AuditTrail freshness, BPM thresholds, NetXchange agents, WebSpace/Wowza restarts, send-to-NEXIO catchers, EDL agent errors, and DST offset checks.
    • Tie monitoring automation to tracked DNRNYD tickets with documented thresholds, alert logic, and remediation steps.
    • Contribute to the team's proactive monitoring posture and eventual integration with broader observability initiatives (e.g., Grafana).
    • Apply Python and modern tooling to extend operational automation where practical.
  • Mimir, Migrations & Platform Programs
    • Support Object Store-to-Mimir image and metadata migration work — including XML mappings, JSON watch-folder definitions, VOS re-tagging, shared-asset import logic, and batch validation.
    • Execute and validate large-scale content and metadata migrations (e.g., transcript backfill, person/non-person image regeneration) with minimal production impact.
    • Participate in Mimir Phase 2 and Pyramid platform testing — TestRail case authoring, post-upgrade retesting in DEV and PROD, and permissions/workflow validation with platform owners.
    • Support Project Fresh Start and Dalet upgrade activities (MFP testing, MS-SQL maintenance, version upgrades) as assigned.
  • Production Pipelines & Linux Administration
    • Own or support recurring production delivery workflows — including the Fox News Sunday Hulu unified-delivery package (format updates, captioning conversions, container changes, illegal-character handling, and external QA coordination).
    • Administer Linux systems supporting Dalet and related DNR infrastructure in NY and DC.
    • Perform MS-SQL queries and data tasks tied to Dalet metadata, migration, and reporting workflows.
    • Transform and validate XML metadata for ingest, migration, and platform-integration use cases.
  • Operations, Documentation & Collaboration
    • Provide frontline and weekend production support for NY and DC Dalet users — editors, media desk, library, and operations teams.
    • Respond to ServiceNow incidents and requests; maintain clear written documentation in Confluence for systems, scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
    • Collaborate with peer DNR engineers (Mimir, Pyramid, ingest, editing platform) and BMT teams on cross-platform initiatives.
    • Participate in on-call and weekend coverage rotation aligned to live news production schedules.
    • Work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and maintenance windows as required.

job.title: Manager, Revenue Partnerships
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ROLE SUMMARY

We are seeking a Manager Revenue Partnerships dedicated exclusively to our rapidly expanding Podcast & Audio Creator portfolio. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of podcast ad sales, revenue partnerships, and creator monetization. You will be responsible for transforming client marketing objectives into multi-platform podcast sponsorships. Acting as the strategic backbone for our sales executives, you will carve out and bring innovative ideas to the table that unlock custom budget across holding company agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Podcast Strategy & Sponsorship Packaging

  • Custom Proposals: Architect both proactive and reactive custom campaigns tailored to brand objectives using our entire podcast audio and video ecosystem.
  • Inventory Packaging: Creatively package podcast inventory; including pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll, and personal endorsements integrations around spiked interest periods throughout the year.
  • Multi-Platform Extensions: Integrate and build audio sponsorships with digital video (YouTube), social media extensions, events and distribution across streaming platforms.
  • Executive Storytelling: Build high-impact, visually compelling pitch presentations that are client-facing and best in class.

Sales Enablement & Monetization Growth

  • Marketing Support: Reporting directly to Revenue Partnerships, partner directly with Creator Partnerships, Sales Leadership and Account Executives to build narratives that support both creator’s initiatives and brand initiatives.
  • Market Intelligence: Work with Sales Research and Sales Marketing to monitor digital audio trends, creator economics, and competitive pricing benchmarks to maximize revenue per client.
  • Proactive Pitching: Turn proactive marketplace concepts into scalable, category-specific sales materials to unlock new brand budgets.
  • Creator Liaison: Collaborate with internal show producers and top talent to ensure revenue initiatives are met and brand integrations feel organic and brand-safe.
  • GTM Strategy and Framework: Coordinate cross-functionally with multiple teams to establish service level agreements, product minimums and streamline a process for GTM strategy for each show in the portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 4–7+ years in media/advertising sales development, media planning, digital audio partnerships, or agency-side audio buying.
  • Podcast Expertise: Deep knowledge of the podcast landscape, including host-read dynamics, programmatic audio and attribution tools.
  • Analytical Skills: Fluency with audience data and podcast analytics to evaluate campaign ROI and optimize ad spend.
  • Communication: Outstanding written and presentation skills, with a proven ability to pitch high-level media buyers and brand directors.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment backed by the enterprise scale of Fox Corporation.

Lead Software Test Engineer

 

Is this the role for you?

POSITION SUMMARY:

Skydance is looking for a passionate, self-motivated lead software test engineer to handle all aspects of testing (functional, performance, load, security, etc) across a large multiplatform environment.  This individual will be partnering with various teams (product, engineering, and quality) by assisting with the development of processes and tools that allow the organization to excel in its continuous software development initiatives.  As code is being delivered multiple times per day, test coverage and automation is crucial in allowing products to deliver quickly to market while maintaining the high level of quality our consumers deserve across our many diverse platforms. 

 

What will you be doing?
PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide technical quality leadership and guidance to the projects and resources that are assigned by implementing testing best practices 

  • Work on product/project teams developing test plans, test cases and test execution 

  • Partner with software engineering to design and develop tools and to assist in continuous development initiatives

  • Perform hands-on code and test-design review (spotting logic bugs, flaky-prone patterns and bad practices), and hold the line on quality standards across the team 

  • Own test-suite health: prioritize test maintenance, identify and resolve flaky tests in CI, and drive risk-based and requirements-based coverage decisions 

  • Document processes and testing knowledge continuously to reduce key-person risk and support knowledge transfer across the team.

 

What are we looking for?

JOB SKILLS:

  • Deep understanding of software quality best practices, with a passion for learning and adopting emerging technologies and methodologies
  • Solid software development expertise and technical architecture capabilities
  • Strong object-oriented programming background, with a focus on building scalable, reliable, and reusable solutions
  • Hands-on proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience in one or more of C#, PHP, or Java
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, SVN, and Stash
  • Experience with automation and testing tools, including Selenium, WebDriver, JUnit, TestNG, Appium, and Cypress
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and build automation tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo
  • Experience using performance testing tools, including JMeter and LoadRunner
  • Experience working within Agile development and testing environments
  • Understanding of web video playback, encoding, live streaming, and related technologies
  • Knowledge of network analysis and proxy tools such as Charles, Fiddler, and HttpWatch
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, content delivery networks (CDNs), database fundamentals, and caching strategies
  • Experience with TDD and BDD methodologies is a plus
  • Strong coding and analytical problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience writing and debugging unit tests
  • Good understanding of test design patterns and the ability to apply them pragmatically when appropriate
  • Practical experience leveraging AI within quality engineering, including AI-assisted test generation, prompt engineering, and evaluation of AI/LLM outputs, combined with an awareness of data governance and safety considerations
  • Experience designing and building test automation frameworks and architectures from the ground up
  • A proactive, self-motivated professional who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team

 

EXPERIENCE:

The ideal candidate should have a background in software engineering and is seasoned in software quality best practices.  Additionally, the candidate should have: 

  • 5+ years of designing and working with test automation frameworks and developing automated test scripts (web, mobile & OTT) specifically object-oriented frameworks 

  • 5+ years working and testing with various online research and analytics tools 

  • 3+ years working with and leading offshore resources 

  • Demonstrated experience designing (not only maintaining) a test automation framework from scratch, including architecture and technology choices 

  • Experience with online streaming video experiences (web, mobile & emerging technologies) a plus 

 

 

EDUCATION:

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

Overview:

The core of this role is news desk support. Most days, that means building folders — ingesting footage, pulling assets, and organizing everything a producer needs to write a piece. But the best PAs bring editorial instincts to that work. If you're deep in a folder on a breaking story and you spot a vault clip that just became gold, we need you to recognize it and flag it. That awareness is what separates a good PA from a great one.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

You'll be assigned to the ET news desk, where you'll be the link between raw footage and finished stories.
  • Media management — ingest shoot footage, log and label assets, and build organized folders that segment producers can write directly from
  • Transcription — turn celebrity interviews and field shoots into accurate, usable transcripts on deadline
  • Asset coordination — pull b-roll, photos, social clips, and archival material; track rights and credits
  • Producer support — research, fact checks, and content prep across broadcast, digital, and social
  • Rundown meeting prep — pull and assemble daily photo docs with pap and social images to support editorial planning
  • Field and studio assistance — crew support, errands, and on-the-ground help when shoots need an extra set of hands
  • Cross-department coverage — pitch in where the show needs you

 

Qualifications:

  • You live and breathe pop culture — you can name every famous face in a crowded shot
  • You're fast, accurate, and organized under pressure
  • You communicate clearly and work well with a team
  • You have sharp editorial instincts — you know the difference between a great sound bite and a throwaway line
  • Degree or internship in TV, film, or a related field is a plus, not a requirement
  • Must pass a short celebrity knowledge quiz

 

 

CBS Media Ventures is the preeminent company in television syndication. CMV produces or distributes popular, critically acclaimed hits including “Dr. Phil,” “Judge Judy,” “Entertainment Tonight,” “Wheel of Fortune,” “Jeopardy!,” “Inside Edition,” “Rachael Ray” and “The Drew Barrymore Show.”

The division also handles national barter advertising sales for Debmar-Mercury's and Fox's first-run syndicated programming, and operates Dabl, a multiplatform, advertiser-supported lifestyle network (www.dabl.com). CMV is part of CBS Entertainment Group and a division of Paramount Global.

job.title: Director of Social Paramount + EMEA
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Is this role for you?

Paramount+ is looking for a Director of Social, EMEA. You’ll lead a team in creating standalone content, partner with colleagues to build social into the heart of marketing campaigns and stay curious about understanding results.

Part of the Paramount+ EMEA Marketing team, you’ll report to the VP Media and Social.

You’ll lead a high performing team partnering with Media, Marketing, Creative and PR teams to turn our biggest campaigns into cultural moments, not just activity that runs, but activity that gets talked about. You’ll lead the total social plan, using data led creativity to generate buzz that drives commercial results.

The EMEA marketing team sets the strategic direction for campaign delivery across the region, partnering with local, in-market teams to align on planning priorities and championing creative that is distinctly, authentically local in every market we operate in.

The London-based social team is responsible for the growth and output of our UK & Ireland channels, whilst also collaborating with teams across EMEA (currently focussed on Germany, Italy and France).

You’ll build and own relationships with Global Content and Social teams, local Marketing and Press, agencies and platforms.

Due to the nature of our work and organisational setup, you’ll need to be available for regular out of hours work and calls. You’ll be based in our Camden office with a set blend of office/home days.

What you will be doing?

  • Own the growth of Paramount+ social presence in UKI and across EMEA, including through paid, organic, partner, publisher and influencers
  • Set strategic direction for our full social mix, leading how we deliver best-in-class, integrated campaigns and activity that drive buzz and recommendation of both Paramount+ and our content
  • Lead a data-informed social strategy for UKI, working with partners and platforms to build a social playbook and learning agenda that delivers tangible results
  • Facilitate excellence and rigour in delivery of social output, nurturing a measurement mindset and a culture of continuous improvement across the team
  • Own a measurement process for total social, creating and embedding a framework that assesses impact of all activity, testing and prioritisation consistently across EMEA
  • Define how social insights feed into creative campaign briefing and development
  • Partner with Marketing and Creative teams to embed social thinking into title campaign development, creating work with outsized cultural relevance
  • Work with global and local teams to align delivery with global priorities while championing local cultural nuance and creativity
  • Make it easy to share best practice, learnings and efficiencies in how we deliver across EMEA markets
  • Build strong relationships with partner agencies and platforms to stay at the forefront of new opportunities, tools and research
  • Partner with marketing and press teams to maximise impact from events, premieres and talent access
  • Own the organic amplification layer: social creative, influencer and platform partnerships that extend creative work beyond paid reach
  • Provide final sign-off for all social output, and be accountable for the buzz and share-of-voice it generates, not just its delivery
  • Build a curious and creative high-performing team

What are we looking for?

  • Extensive experience in organic and paid social media at a leadership level. 
  • A strong track record in integrated social management within entertainment or a culturally engaged product, gained on either the brand or agency side.
  • Evidence of owning strategic direction while also driving rigorous delivery across social, including YouTube, Reddit, Meta and TikTok
  • Skilled at building creative integrated social campaigns at scale that deliver across both brand and commercial objectives
  • Track record of turning marketing campaigns into culturally talked-about social moments, with demonstrable impact on buzz
  • Experience managing Creator and Influencer programmes
  • Curious and analytical with hands-on experience in choosing the right data and metrics from social platforms and research tools
  • Confidence in directing and critiquing social creative, empowering creatives while delivering against objectives and brand requirements
  • Strong people management skills, delegating with skill and developing high-performing teams in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Able to work autonomously, setting priorities and processes for the whole team
  • Naturally collaborative, and able to influence a wide range of stakeholders

 

#LI-RE1

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.
