job.title: Sales Planner
job.description:
We’re seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Sales Planner to join the AMP Sports Ad Sales team. This role is responsible for supporting the pre-sale and mid-flight operational process — developing accurate, strategic media plans and ensuring smooth campaign delivery across Digital, Linear, Social, and Audio platforms.

The Sales Planner works closely with Sales, Pricing & Planning, Inventory, and Ad Operations to ensure proposals, billing, and reporting are precise and aligned with business goals. This position is focused on sales and planning operations, not client relationship management.

Core Responsibilities

Pre-Sale Strategy & Proposal Development

  • Develop and refine multi-platform media plans aligned with sales strategy, pricing guidance, and client goals.
  • Partner with the Sales team to translate RFPs into actionable, competitive proposals.
  • Collaborate with Pricing & Planning to maintain rate integrity and ensure margin objectives are met.

 

Inventory & Deal Management

  • Coordinate with Inventory Management to confirm availability and optimize utilization across campaigns.
  • Maintain deal accuracy from proposal through IO submission, ensuring plans reflect current inventory and approved pricing.
  • Track sold inventory and forecast revenue pacing for assigned accounts.

 

Campaign Reporting & Billing Accuracy

  • Own the preparation and accuracy of campaign performance reports, surfacing results and pacing updates to the Account Manager for client delivery.
  • Partner with Campaign Management and Finance to reconcile billing, delivery, and revenue discrepancies.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of booked revenue, flight dates, and campaign changes to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Provide proactive visibility into any pacing or delivery concerns that may impact revenue or performance to Account Management and Sales.

 

Sales Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Process and review Insertion Orders (IOs) to ensure accuracy and alignment with approved plans.
  • Collaborate with Campaign Management and Traffick teams to support smooth campaign setup and execution readiness.
  • Support Operation Leadership in forecasting, reporting, and pipeline management.

 

Process Optimization & Collaboration

  • Maintain and improve internal planning documents, templates, and pricing matrices.
  • Identify workflow efficiencies to improve speed and accuracy across Sales Planning and Campaign Management.
  • Work with Marketing and Research to incorporate sponsorship opportunities or insights into proposals when applicable.

 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in media planning, sales operations, or pricing & inventory within a publisher, network, or agency.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with ad sales systems such as Freewheel, Operative One/AOS, WideOrbit, Broadway, Prisma, or Google Ad Manager.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a commitment to operational excellence.

 

The base salary compensation for this role is $66,500. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist - Business Development
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say - it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy it here.  We're searching for that special someone, a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win - and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. 

 

The base salary compensation for this role is $60,000. This position is also eligible to earn uncapped commissions of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of "earned." Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it!

As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.

We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community.

We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth.

We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ Your New Role The Producer of Global Productions is a vital role in CNN’s feature content team. They will be responsible for producing feature content for all of CNN’s platforms - from written digital features to crafting bite-sized social videos to filming full 30-minute TV documentaries - and strive to innovate and experiment with new technologies. This position is ideal for a someone with experience of producing beautiful, impactful stories for digital, TV and social platforms. They will be journalists with a passion for global storytelling and travel. Your Role Accountabilities A Producer is a master storyteller who can write and crafts content that connects with audiences – wherever they are, and wherever they’re going next. They conceive story treatments across a range of different platforms, including digital, TV and social media, while maintaining CNN’s high standards. The Producer will work across CNN’s portfolio of sponsored series, often in partnership with other producers or specialist section editors, to deliver against defined KPIs. They will work in a team that travels extensively and collaborate with regional bureaus to introduce CNN’s global audience to the wonders, innovation and compelling characters found in other locations. The Producer will take on ambitious video storytelling challenges, working with CNN’s on-air talent and many different teams to deliver content that distinguishes CNN against the company’s competitors. They will organize production logistics and production schedule, regularly working to tight deadlines. They will work with camera operators and video editors to script and create editorial features to CNN’s editorial standards. They will also ensure that Ofcom guidelines are followed, and that CNN’s defined editorial processes and procedures are adhered to. The Producer will also create stand-out digital content including long and short-form articles, interactives, image galleries, videos, infographics, photo essays, social content, and opinion writes. This content will contribute to successful delivery of sponsorship KPIs and the wider CNN audience growth targets. This position will work under the Executive Producer who will assign budgets and goals for each sponsored campaign. The Producer will also work with Concept Development experts to ideate new sponsorship series proposals. This role is suitable for ambitious storytellers who nurture relationships and collaborate effectively with others to create content that helps the team to achieve success. Qualifications & Experience Proven track record of creating engaging content (written, video, social) that drives traffic. Strong writing and editing skills are essential skills for this role. Relevant experience and passion in using social media as a publishing and audience engagement tool Must be comfortable with news and feature production and understand the difference. Strong communicator and collaborator. Strong and proven editorial judgment. Deep understanding of multiple platforms and different devices. A good understanding of current affairs is a must. Must understand S&P and Ofcom compliance guidelines Must be organized, efficient and able to multi-task booking, logistics, and research. A positive, self-starting attitude will serve the candidate well in this position. About Skydance Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. Job Summary: Job Requirements Production Associate Job Summary ABC News is looking for a Production Associate to support the Assignment Desk in our New York Bureau. This role provides editorial, production, and logistical support to producers, correspondents, and newsroom teams covering daily news and breaking stories across platforms. This is an overnight position, and candidates must be available to work overnight shifts. The ideal candidate is highly organized, adaptable, and passionate about current events and journalism. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to impactful storytelling while developing a broad understanding of operations in a 24/7 newsroom. Key Responsibilities Support producers and correspondents with assignment logistics, including travel bookings, scheduling, credentialing, and administrative coordination. Assist with live-shot production for broadcasts, including Good Morning America and World News Tonight , and coordinate live and recorded segments. Receive and monitor video feeds, news wires, and social platforms to track developing stories, flagging significant updates for editorial teams. Coordinate information across ABC News platforms, News Services clients, and owned and affiliated stations through Microsoft Teams, phone, and email. Research and pitch stories, gather information, and organize production materials to support accurate and timely coverage. Assist with clearing user-generated social media content. Log, transcribe, edit, and process video content for distribution across ABC News platforms. Support operational readiness as coverage priorities shift, performing additional production and newsgathering duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Minimum of one year of experience in a newsroom or news-related environment. Genuine interest in current events, journalism, and news production. Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with close attention to detail. Ability to manage competing priorities, work effectively under pressure, and meet tight deadlines. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, email, and common business and communication tools, with the ability to learn newsroom systems. Availability to work the required overnight schedule, with flexibility for evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as coverage demands. Preferred Qualifications Strong news judgment and curiosity about local, national, and international events. Ability to remain calm and focused during breaking news. Collaborative approach and willingness to support teams across functions. Initiative, accountability, and strong problem-solving skills. Adaptability as editorial and operational needs evolve. Required Education BA or BS from an accredited four-year college or university, or equivalent professional experience. job.title: Freelance Assignment Editor, FOX Weather
job.description:
FOX Weather is America’s Weather Team, and we are seeking a confident, highly motivated, and proactive Freelance Assignment Editor to join our newsroom. This role is critical in driving real-time weather news coverage across all platforms. You will work closely with our programming and field teams to coordinate breaking weather events, select compelling live visuals, and support dynamic storytelling as we cover weather news. In this fast-paced environment, you must have strong news judgment, be comfortable handling multiple breaking stories at once, and thrive under pressure. Prior experience pitching, researching, writing, and building editorial elements in a collaborative team setting is key. An interest in weather is a must.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicate with officials and sources for editorial information
  • Monitor both traditional and social media for breaking weather news stories
  • Pitch unique and interesting guests, stories, and segments
  • Conduct in-depth research and compile well-rounded reports for our field teams
  • Help find stunning live visuals to support all platforms
  • Select elements such as sound, video clips, and graphics to help tell a story
  • Manage daily deadline turnarounds of a live show environment
  • Monitor and coordinate contributor feeds and resources
  • Build strong relationships with Assignment Desks at FOX affiliates and other news service partners across the FOX News Media Family

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in journalism, communications, or a related field of study preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of TV newsgathering, assignment desk, or field production experience
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to react quickly to breaking news
  • Ability to solve problems quickly, stay calm under pressure, and adapt rapidly to changing conditions
  • Willingness to work early mornings, late nights, and weekends
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines and manage multiple tasks without sacrificing accuracy
  • Basic understanding of meteorology and weather science concepts
  • Interest and understanding of weather, severe weather patterns, and their impacts
  • Previous network-level or national newsroom experience
  • Familiarity with newsroom systems such as iNews or similar editorial toolsA degree or certification in meteorology or atmospheric sciences equivalent is a plus

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Digital & Ad Tech
job.description:
We are looking for a motivated and career-oriented candidate with a proactive approach and strong analytical, Excel, and data set management skills. As a Senior Financial Analyst, Digital & Ad Tech, you will step into a critical position responsible for financial modeling to support the labor capitalization and software development process. The Senior Financial Analyst will work on monthly budgets and forecasts, key financial reporting, ad hoc analysis, tracking of KPIs, and creating dashboards and tools to review operational performance and initiatives.

This is a high-visibility and challenging position rich in data analytics. The Senior Financial Analyst will be responsible for providing key budget/forecast and actuals analysis to understand the Digital Division's financial performance. This analysis is key to the management team’s decision-making and interpretation of financial results.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish a deep understanding of the business and leverage data to build insights
  • Assist in the preparation of forecasts, budgets, and variance analysis, reviewing with business partners to ensure understanding of the drivers and operational impacts
  • Actively work with operations and other finance team members to improve the effectiveness of the financial planning process, assumptions, and results
  • Create and maintain trackers for key operational drivers and Operational Expenses such as Licenses, Contractors, and Headcount among others, and execute financial performance reporting and analysis for critical projects
  • Partner with Finance Operations and Asset Management teams in the creation and management of Purchase Orders and Capital Requests, Prepaid Schedules, etc. to guarantee proper accounting treatment, correct coding, as well as compliance and alignment between actuals and forecast/budget approach
  • Support month-end close activities to enhance the accuracy and ensure timely delivery of financial results
  • Help develop reporting tools, reviews, analyses, and cost-tracking systems
  • Perform ad hoc financial analysis to evaluate the operation and business initiatives

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another highly analytical/quantitative discipline
  • 2+ years of experience in budgeting and forecasting experience
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency using Excel, with financial modeling and data mining experience
  • Working knowledge of Financial Systems (i.e., Workday financials, Adaptive)
  • Experience operating and thriving in a fast-paced, ever-changing, results- and customer-service-oriented environment
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize activities, manage timelines, deal effectively with pressure, and show deep intellectual curiosity
  • Ability to be a team player with a highly collaborative and team-oriented work style
  • Positive attitude and solutions-oriented approach
  • Ability to develop strong relationships with others and communicate effectively

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Database management and query design such as SQL and other coding skills

job.title: Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager
job.description:
FOX News Media is seeking an experienced Broadcast & Media Technology Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across studio operations, live broadcast production, contribution/transmission networks, Media Asset Management (MAM) pipelines, and fast-turnaround content creation/editing environments.

This role will manage projects from initial discovery and technical requirements gathering through solution delivery, systems integration, testing, commissioning, and transition to 24/7 broadcast operations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely across broadcast engineering, studio operations, control rooms, post-production, editorial, transmission, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and external systems integrators/vendors.

The ideal candidate combines disciplined project management practices with a strong technical understanding of how broadcast content moves from field capture/ingest through studio control rooms, non-linear editing (NLE) suites, central MAM repositories, master control/playout, and multi-path transmission.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES

Project Delivery and Governance

  • Lead the full project lifecycle, including discovery, scoping, technical design coordination, procurement, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, cutover, hypercare, and operational handover.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering work breakdown structures, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, hardware/software lead times, risks, issues, and capital/operating budgets.
  • Establish governance routines, engineering working sessions, steering committee reporting, and change-control decision forums.
  • Coordinate workstreams across broadcast engineering, studio tech, transmission/traffic, newsroom operations, editing/post-production, IT infrastructure, and third-party vendors/systems integrators.
  • Track delivery against broadcast milestones, schedule, budget, quality standards, and operational-readiness criteria.
  • Maintain rigorous project documentation, including functional specs, system schematics coordination, rack elevations, acceptance test plans (ATP), cutover runbooks, and handover documentation.

Broadcast & Media Technology Delivery

  • Lead initiatives involving production switchers, audio consoles, studio cameras, robotics, multi-viewers, tally/intercom systems (e.g., Riedel, RTS), broadcast graphics (e.g., Vizrt), and virtual/augmented reality studio tech.
  • Oversee deployments for field acquisition, bonded cellular (e.g., LiveU, Dejero), satellite/fiber contribution, IP contribution protocols (SRT, RIST, Zixi), and baseband/IP ingest pipelines.
  • Manage MAM implementations, metadata schema standardization, ingest automation, nearline/deep archive tiers, LTO/cloud storage lifecycles, and media supply chain orchestration.
  • Drive technical delivery for non-linear editing (NLE) platforms (Adobe Premiere, Avid Media Composer), shared production storage (SAN/NAS/Isilon/Avid NEXIS), fast-turnaround news editing, and transcode/QC workflows.
  • Coordinate projects for playout automation, routing matrices (SDI and IP), primary/backup transmission paths, satellite uplink/downlink, terrestrial fiber circuits, and disaster recovery (DR) facilities.
  • Facilitate technical integration between newsroom systems (e.g., iNEWS, ENPS), rundown automation, prompters, and playback servers.
  • Translate operational and editorial requirements into clear engineering workstreams and technical deliverables.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and technology refreshes, such as SDI-to-ST 2110 IP transitions, cloud-assisted production, and hybrid on-prem/cloud workflows.
  • Coordinate technical design reviews alongside Principal Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads.

Live Operations, Commissioning & Deployment Readiness

  • Plan and direct factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), end-to-end rehearsal workflows, operational shadow periods, cutovers, and rollback strategies.
  • Schedule and oversee maintenance windows and deployment sequencing to ensure zero disruption to on-air linear feeds and 24/7 live studio operations.
  • Partner with Broadcast Operations and Engineering teams to establish support escalation models, monitoring/telemetry dashboards, signal path redundancies, runbooks, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer for operators, directors, editors, engineers, and technicians prior to on-air cutover.

Technology Modernization & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with engineering leads to evaluate emerging broadcast standards (SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, NDI) and cloud/virtualized production platforms.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks in the content creation and turnaround pipeline, introducing automation for ingest, transcode, QC, and archiving.
  • Promote standard operating procedures and best-practice deployment frameworks across all broadcast and studio facilities.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Media Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Technology project management experience, with experience directly managing broadcast engineering, studio facility, transmission, or media production technology projects.
  • Proven track record leading projects through technical scoping, RFP/vendor evaluation, rack/facility buildout, systems integration, commissioning, and on-air cutover.
  • Demonstrated working knowledge across core broadcast domains, including:
    • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
    • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
    • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
    • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
    • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.
  • Solid grasp of broadcast video/audio signals and protocols (Baseband SDI, SMPTE ST 2110, AES67, Dante, PTP timing, MPEG-TS).
  • Experience coordinating structured acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and high-stakes, off-hours facility cutovers with tight change-window constraints.
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Visio/Lucidchart).
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to bridge conversations between on-air talent/editorial teams and deep technical engineering specialists.
  • Experience leading facility buildouts, studio relocations, or control room overhauls.
  • Practical knowledge of IP media network architecture (SMPTE ST 2110, ST 2022-6/7, NMOS IS-04/IS-05).
  • Experience with broadcast equipment vendors and platforms (e.g., Grass Valley, Evertz, Ross Video, Sony, Avid, Imagine Communications, Vizrt, Harmonic, Telestream).
  • Familiarity with hybrid/cloud-based media workflows in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience managing external Systems Integrators (SIs) and broadcast equipment hardware vendors.
  • Relevant industry certifications: PMP, CAPM, or technical broadcast certifications (e.g., SBE - Society of Broadcast Engineers certifications).
  • Studio production, PCR/TCR control rooms, routing, and intercom systems.
  • Live contribution (SRT, RIST, ASI, Satellite, Fiber) and transmission pipelines.
  • MAM systems, automated transcode engines, and shared editing storage (SAN/NAS).
  • Post-production and NLE workflows (Avid, Adobe, automated QC).
  • Newsroom Computer Systems (NRCS) and broadcast automation/playout.

The FOX Internship Program is for motivated college students who are passionate about the news and media industry. Students are paid to gain real-world work experience with guidance from top media professionals. Students are assigned to a department that matches their skill set, work experience, and career aspirations.

job.title: Campaign Manager, Digital Sales Operations
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Campaign Manager is the lead for managing digital assets and campaign execution for all Livestreaming Sports Advertising campaigns throughout their entirety. You will be responsible for acquiring digital assets, analyzing campaign placements, ensuring that campaigns are accurately executed, including that every aspect of the campaign is being delivered as expected. You'll also be responsible for any troubleshooting and additional ad-hoc reporting requests.

The Sales Operations team works side-by-side with the Peacock Sales team to ensure that advertising campaigns run smoothly and exceed client expectations. We are looking for a detail oriented, technically savvy, problem solver with superior customer service skills and leadership qualities to join our team today.
 
Responsibilities:

  • Interface with internal teams and Ad Agencies to obtain and manage digital assets throughout the pre- and post-launch process
  • Review received assets and recommend any adjustments needed to meet NBCU specifications
  • Lead weekly meetings with cross-functional teams (Sales, Planning, Inventory) to ensure alignment on plans and initiatives for Peacock
  • Troubleshoot campaign advertisement issues
  • Review and analyze campaign health reports to provide feedback to Peacock sales partners and advise on any necessary adjustments
  • Analyze placements in the ad server and determine endpoint targeting and priority levels to meet the execution requirements
  • Participate in a rotating schedule of on-call coverage for Live events that may occur on nights and weekends – on average of one week on call every two months
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • 2+ years of experience in Sales Operations

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States now and in the future.
  • Desire to work in the entertainment media industry which requires availability during weekends if we are supporting a live event.
  • Must be 18 years or older.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Prior experience trafficking in an ad server (Google Ad Manager (aka DFP), Freewheel)
  • Previous campaign management a plus
  • Familiarity with a front-end order management system preferred (Operative.One)
  • Understanding of marketing KPI’s
  • Fluency in the language of digital media (impressions, CTR, CPMs, eCPMs, etc.) and online measurement (uniques, pageviews, visits, referrers, etc.)
  • Experience taking screenshots, cropping, and basic image editing
  • Must be able to pull third- and first-party reporting
  • Experience handling large volume of emails and multiple ongoing campaigns
  • Must be able to process first party hosted assets in our various internal systems
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel (including formulas)
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and ActionScript
  • Keen problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills and the ability to prioritize tasks
  • Must be detail-oriented and have the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent client relationship & interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as part of Ad Operations team

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $70,000 - $90,000

As a Data Architect, you will play a foundational role in the design and implementation of Unified Data, a net-new, greenfield enterprise data ecosystem for NBCUniversal Operations & Technology. Built primarily on Microsoft Fabric, Unified Data will establish a centralized, governed data foundation that brings together real-time operational events and historical data across enterprise technology domains to support reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and reusable data products.

You will define the target-state architecture, data organization and modeling standards, integration patterns, security and governance framework, and engineering practices for the platform. Operating within a complex and evolving technical environment, you will exercise independent judgment to evaluate multiple architectural approaches, assess interdependencies and technical tradeoffs, and determine solutions where established patterns or precedent may be limited. The data landscape spans areas including IT service management, employee and workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity and access, infrastructure and network services, collaboration platforms, operational telemetry, and enterprise master and reference data.

In addition to serving as the lead architect, you will act as a technical leader for the delivery team, providing guidance and translating architecture and business requirements into actionable engineering work, helping create and refine epics, stories, and tasks, identifying dependencies and sequencing, and ensuring work is aligned to the appropriate resources and teams while providing technical guidance throughout implementation.

Responsibilities:

  • Microsoft Fabric Architecture & Strategy: Independently define the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, notebooks, and semantic models to support cross-domain Operations & Technology use cases.
  • Greenfield Platform Architecture: Develop and establish the foundational architecture, standards, environment strategy, workspace organization, security boundaries, deployment patterns, and operating principles for a net-new enterprise data platform.
  • Technical Leadership & Delivery Enablement: Serve as the technical leader for the delivery team by translating architecture and program objectives into epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and implementation sequencing while helping route work to the appropriate resources and teams.
  • Enterprise Data Centralization: Drive the consolidation of fragmented operational data into a centralized and discoverable ecosystem using domain-aligned data products, authoritative data sources, reusable shared datasets, and common data contracts.
  • Operational Data Architecture: Design solutions spanning IT service management, workplace technology, endpoints and assets, identity, infrastructure, networks, collaboration platforms, telemetry, events, logs, and enterprise reference data. Evaluate cross-domain dependencies and technical tradeoffs to determine architectural approaches that address complex and evolving requirements.
  • Real-Time & Historical Data Design: Architect solutions that combine streaming and event-driven operational data with historical, transactional, master, and reference data to support operational visibility, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Lakehouse & Warehouse Patterns: Establish scalable patterns for raw, enriched, and curated data layers, Delta-based lakehouse designs, warehouse workloads, OneLake shortcuts, virtualization, partitioning, optimization, retention, and performance management.
  • Data Modeling & Semantic Standards: Define enterprise modeling principles, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, shared business definitions, and semantic standards using dimensional, normalized, domain-oriented, or hybrid approaches as appropriate.
  • Integration & Pipeline Architecture: Define resilient and reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, files, CDC, batch processing, and event streams.
  • Data Governance, Security & Quality: Partner with security, privacy, and governance teams to establish access controls, metadata, lineage, classification, data ownership, data contracts, quality standards, retention policies, and lifecycle controls.
  • Architecture Standards & Documentation: Independently develop and maintain target-state architectures, reference architectures, architecture decision records, data flow diagrams, technical standards, reusable patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
  • DevOps & Engineering Standards: Establish expectations for source control, CI/CD, environment promotion, infrastructure and configuration automation, testing, monitoring, deployment controls, and release management.
  • Architecture Review & Technical Governance: Lead reviews and advise teams on solution designs and major technical decisions to ensure implementations remain aligned with Unified Data architecture, security requirements, performance expectations, and engineering standards.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, solution architecture, or related roles, including responsibility for designing, establishing, or materially evolving enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience translating architecture and technical strategy into executable roadmaps, epics, stories, tasks, and implementation plans.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead across multidisciplinary engineering teams or complex technical programs.
  • Strong experience designing lakehouse and/or warehouse architectures, including layered data patterns from raw ingestion through curated and consumable datasets.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency with Python and/or PySpark for data engineering, automation, prototyping, and technical validation.
  • Experience architecting data solutions on Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Azure, or comparable enterprise cloud data platforms.
  • Experience designing both batch and real-time/event-driven data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data integration, distributed data processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, observable, and supportable production data platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, lineage, governance, and data quality principles.
  • Ability to independently evaluate complex technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, cost, and business requirements, and exercise judgment in determining appropriate architectural approaches.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate architectural concepts to engineers, product teams, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a greenfield environment where standards, processes, and technical patterns are being established.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience designing or leading a greenfield enterprise data platform or significant modernization of an existing data ecosystem.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, Eventstream/Eventhouse, semantic models, and Power BI.
  • Experience establishing Microsoft Fabric workspace, domain, environment, security, capacity, and deployment strategies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and services.
  • Experience with event streaming and messaging architectures such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience designing change data capture (CDC) and near-real-time ingestion architectures.
  • Experience with data governance practices and tooling, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data contracts, retention, and privacy controls.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure automation technologies such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform, or Bicep.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and technical delivery practices across multiple teams.
  • Experience building platform and pipeline observability, including logging, monitoring, alerting, SLAs/SLOs, and data quality monitoring.
  • Experience developing architecture decision records, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.
  • Experience designing data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic applications.
  • Background supporting large-scale Operations & Technology environments such as service operations, workplace technology, infrastructure, endpoint management, identity, security, or network services.
  • Media, entertainment, or consumer technology experience, particularly in environments where reliability, scale, and cross-domain data integration are critical.
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills, including the ability to lead technical design discussions and communicate complex architecture decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Track and coordinate Cyber Security involvement in technical and business driven technology projects
  • Partner with security incident response team to resolve and close the investigation of incidents with postmortem and remediation plans
  • Support and develop business-relevant metrics and key performance indicators supporting the measurement of Cyber security program maturity

  • 3+ years of work experience in Cyber Security

  • Understanding of data privacy, intellectual property, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to AI

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

  Overview As a member of Paramount’s Streaming Research and Insights team, you’ll lead technically rigorous UX research with a proficient quantitative focus across Pluto TV and Paramount+. Your work will shape product, design, and algorithm strategy, helping us better understand our audiences and improve their streaming experiences. Reporting to the SVP, Streaming Research and Insights, you’ll exercise significant self-directed judgment in setting research strategy and methodology. You’ll partner directly with senior product, engineering, and data science leaders, making major roadmap and resourcing decisions in partnership with the SVP. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll provide technical mentorship while working in an office environment. New York or Burbank are the preferred locations, with the final location to be confirmed.   Responsibilities
  • Lead quantitative research and causal inference. Use multivariate testing and quasi-experimental methods. Apply statistical modeling. Measure the product's performance. Assess how well teams are collaborating. Evaluate customer satisfaction. Work on improving these areas. Partner closely with the devoted A/B testing team to use experiment results and infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and improve recommendation algorithms and other AI/ML product systems in partnership with engineering and data science. Apply research and modeling techniques to validate model outputs, identify failure modes, and quantify user impact.
  • Own the research roadmap for an assigned area of the product portfolio. Partner proactively with product, design, engineering, and business stakeholders to define priorities and develop a forward looking plan combining quantitative and mixed methods research. Report progress and priorities to the SVP, Streaming Research and Insights.
  • Apply AI modeling and analysis techniques including predictive modeling, analysis supported by machine learning, and AI assisted synthesis of qualitative data to scale research output and identify patterns that warrant deeper investigation.
  • Lead complementary qualitative and usability research through interviews, usability testing, and diary studies to explain the reasons behind quantitative and behavioral signals and build a complete, statistically grounded comprehension of user needs.
  • Translate complex findings into clear recommendations for senior product, engineering, data science, and executive stakeholders.
  • Directly shaping product and technical roadmaps.
  • Provide technical mentorship to peer researchers and partners across teams on experimental design, statistical rigor, and research best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in quantitative UX research, experimentation, or applied data science. This experience should come from a consumer technology, streaming, or digital product company. The candidate must have a proven record of leading complex research programs that rely on statistical analysis.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Human Computer Interaction, Computer Science, Psychology, or a related quantitative field.
  • A solid background in experimental design and causal inference. This includes skills in multivariate testing and quasi-experimental methods. You need good statistical skills to validate and defend your results to executives. Additionally, you must be able to collaborate well with a hardworking A/B testing team.
  • Technical proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with hands on experience applying AI/ML modeling techniques, such as predictive modeling, natural language processing, or recommendation system evaluation, to research problems.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and improving algorithmic systems in direct partnership with engineering and data science teams.
  • Experience with recommendation or personalization engines.
  • Proven ability to turn ambiguous questions into quantitative research plans.
  • Self-reliantly defining scope, executing research, and defending methodology with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex statistical and technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent research and experimentation streams against shifting priorities in a fast paced, evolving office environment.

 

Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Haves)
  • Advanced degree, such as a master’s or PhD, strongly preferred, particularly a PhD in Statistics, Data Science, HCI, or a related quantitative or behavioral science field.
  • Experience with recommendation systems at scale, ranking algorithms, or generative AI and large language model evaluation.
  • Awareness with streaming media, entertainment, or subscription and advertising supported business models.
  • Experience building or scaling a research or experimentation function, including tooling, panels, or infrastructure.

job.title: B2B Sales Director, Reputation Intelligence
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Opportunity 

Help communications and corporate affairs leaders understand emerging reputation risks—and build the customer base for a new Dow Jones intelligence platform.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar combines Storyful’s social and narrative intelligence with Factiva’s licensed news content. It helps organizations understand which narratives are gaining traction, who is influencing them and where reputational pressure may build next, so leaders can make better-informed decisions.

 

As we prepare for general availability, we are seeking an experienced enterprise seller to generate new business and help establish a focused, repeatable sales approach. You will combine the opportunity to build an emerging business with the credibility, customer relationships and market reach of Dow Jones.

 

About the Role

Working in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week, you'll be a senior, quota-carrying sales person with direct responsibility for creating pipeline, developing opportunities and winning enterprise customers.

 

Your initial focus will be communications and corporate affairs teams in financial services, with the potential to expand into other priority sectors as we establish successful use cases.

 

You will own opportunities from prospecting and discovery through demonstration, negotiation and close. Success requires understanding how customers make decisions, identifying a meaningful business need and building a compelling case for investment—including where Reputation Radar complements an existing set of tools.

 

You will work with Dow Jones account teams and colleagues across Product, Marketing and Intelligence. Your customer conversations will also help refine our targeting, messaging, sales materials and product priorities.

 

This role suits someone who enjoys personally winning business and using what they learn to improve how a new product is brought to market.

 

You Will

  • Create and convert new-business pipeline. Personally prospect into priority accounts, develop qualified opportunities and deliver against an agreed revenue target.
  • Build focused account plans. Select and prioritize accounts using customer needs, business triggers, revenue potential and likelihood to convert. Establish clear actions and next steps.
  • Lead consultative discovery. Understand how customers identify reputation risks, brief leadership and make decisions, and where their current approach falls short.
  • Build a credible value case. Connect Reputation Radar’s capabilities to the customer’s priorities and demonstrate why the investment matters.
  • Navigate enterprise buying groups. Build relationships with senior Communications, Corporate Affairs and related stakeholders, while engaging users, budget holders, Procurement and other decision makers.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Coordinate demonstrations and specialist input, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms and progress opportunities through contracting and close.
  • Work with the wider Dow Jones sales organization. Partner with account teams to identify relevant opportunities within existing customer relationships and help them recognize where Reputation Radar can add value.
  • Turn Marketing activity into commercial action. Collaborate on targeted campaigns, events and content, and take ownership of account follow-up and conversion.
  • Bring customer insight back into the business. Share patterns in buyer needs, objections, competitive alternatives and purchasing decisions to strengthen positioning, sales enablement and product development.
  • Maintain commercial discipline. Keep accurate Salesforce records, qualify opportunities consistently and provide reliable forecasts.
  • Represent Dow Jones and Storyful in customer meetings, industry events and executive discussions.

 

You Have

  • 12+ years of professional sales experience
  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding enterprise B2B sales targets, including personally creating and closing new business
  • Experience selling information services, data, intelligence, strategic advisory or enterprise SaaS solutions
  • Experience engaging senior Communications, Corporate Affairs, Marketing, Public Affairs, Risk or executive stakeholders, or a clear ability to translate relevant adjacent experience to these buyers
  • The ability to sell through discovery, business value and customer outcomes, supported by clear examples of navigating complex buying decisions
  • A structured approach to account selection, prospecting, qualification and pipeline development
  • Strong listening, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and adapt your approach to different stakeholders
  • Experience collaborating with account managers, marketing teams and product or subject-matter specialists while retaining ownership of sales progress
  • The judgment and initiative to operate effectively as a product and its commercial approach evolve
  • Willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office at least 3 days a week

 

Particularly Useful

  • Knowledge of the communications, reputation, public affairs, media intelligence or risk intelligence ecosystem
  • Success introducing a new product, entering a new market or building demand where a buying category is still developing
  • Experience selling to financial services organizations
  • Existing relationships with senior communications and corporate affairs leaders
  • Experience working across multinational enterprise accounts

 

About Storyful

Storyful is a social and narrative intelligence company within Dow Jones. Combining proprietary technology with expert analysis and verification, Storyful helps organizations understand how information and narratives spread, influence stakeholders and shape reputation.

 

Dow Jones Reputation Radar brings together Storyful and Factiva capabilities to support communications and corporate affairs leaders with timely, decision-ready reputation intelligence.

job.title: Executive Assistant to the CFO
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a critical partner in ensuring the success of The Washington Post’s financial leadership. This role requires a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and strategic awareness, providing seamless administrative and operational support to the CFO while navigating a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.


The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with exceptional organizational skills, a service-minded attitude, and the ability to manage competing priorities with discretion, efficiency, and diplomacy. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the CFO’s calendar, coordinating cross-functional meetings, managing communications, and supporting the broader Finance team through administrative coordination and internal event planning. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to the success of our finance function while working closely with senior leaders at The Washington Post. 


What Motivates You 

  • You thrive on supporting a senior leader in a complex, fast-moving organization. 
  • You take initiative, anticipate needs, and provide solutions before problems arise.
  • You are energized by juggling multiple priorities and keeping everything organized. 
  • You enjoy being the reliable force behind the scenes that helps an executive and their team thrive.
  • You build strong, trusting relationships across functions and with all levels of an organization. 

 

How You’ll Support The Mission  

  • Provide high-level administrative support to the CFO, including calendar management, travel coordination, and preparation of meeting materials.
  • Act as a liaison between the CFO and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and follow-ups.
  • Support executive’s decision making for specific meetings, projects, or events by understanding the roles and responsibilities of employees in different departments within the organization, building relationships with colleagues across teams, and gathering and synthesizing relevant information to ensure successful outcomes. 
  • Draft, proofread, and edit professional correspondence, and basic presentation materials using available technology to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Leverage productivity tools, automation, and AI-enabled solutions thoughtfully.
  • Provide project management support and assistance at key internal and external events across the company. 
  • Attends CFO direct reports meeting, sends a summary email to the finance department, keeps track of action items for the directors, ensures weekly updates are filled out timely by the directors  
  • Support scheduling meetings with external guests by greeting the guests, completing security checks, and setting up food and drinks. 
  • Provide budgeting support, invoice review and contract management. 

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring 

  • At least 7 years of executive support experience; experience supporting a financial executive is a plus. 
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project management, process improvements, etc. 
  • Experience reviewing, tracking, and managing contracts. 
  • Professional maturity and ability to remain calm and flexible under pressure. 
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and attention to detail. 
  • Proven organizational acumen and interdepartmental coordination skills. 
  • Expertise with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and other products and the ability to quickly learn new software tools and systems. 
  • Demonstrated curiosity and comfort using AI-enabled productivity tools and automation to improve efficiency, organization, and quality of work, with sound judgement around confidentiality, accuracy, and appropriate use.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive business and people matters. 
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize workload with minimal supervision 
  • Excellent editing and proofreading skills 
  • Strong consulting and project management skills. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
  • Ability to work fast and well under pressure.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$74,000 - $111,000 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

The Washington Post is seeking a Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer to support creator-led branded content programs within WP Studios. This role combines creator partnership strategy with hands-on production, helping identify the right talent for client opportunities and guiding creators from initial outreach through content development, approval and distribution.


The Creator Partnerships Strategist & Producer will support both pre-sale strategy and post-sale execution, partnering with creators and internal teams to develop branded programs that align client objectives with the right platforms, formats, audiences and talent. This role works closely with Creative Strategy, Video Production, Program Management and Business Affairs, and will serve as a primary partner to creators throughout the campaign lifecycle, helping ensure content is strategically sound, on brand and delivered on time.


What Motivates You

  • You are excited by the evolving creator economy and enjoy identifying talent who can authentically connect brands with audiences.
  • You enjoy building creator partnerships that balance client objectives, audience needs, platform dynamics and strong creative ideas.
  • You are energized by working directly with creators and helping turn an initial concept into compelling, high-quality branded content.
  • You enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on production and seeing programs through from pitch to execution.
  • You are curious about social platforms, audience behavior, creator trends and emerging formats and use those insights to strengthen your recommendations.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments where creative, production, business and client considerations must come together to deliver successful work.
  • You value strong relationships and enjoy serving as a trusted partner to creators throughout the lifecycle of a campaign.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Develop creator partnership strategies that align client objectives and KPIs with the right platforms, formats, audiences and talent.
  • Source and vet creators based on their professional experience, industry expertise, audience, platform presence, content quality and campaign fit.
  • Negotiate creator fees, manage campaign budgets and maintain strong creator relationships throughout each partnership.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for creators from initial outreach through content development and posting, providing clear communication and coordination throughout the campaign lifecycle.
  • Guide creators through project briefing, scripting and revisions to ensure content remains on brand, responds to client feedback and is delivered on time.
  • Partner with Creative Strategists to develop creator recommendations and proposal materials for RFP responses and proactive pitches, supported by audience insights, platform best practices and industry trends.
  • Create sales materials and case studies that demonstrate WP Studios' creator and social capabilities.
  • Coordinate client review and approval and support the organic and paid distribution of creator content across social platforms.
  • Partner with Video Production, Program Management and Business Affairs to bring creator-led branded programs to market.
  • Use creator discovery and trend tools to identify talent, track industry developments and inform campaign decisions.
  • Maintain an up-to-date database of vetted creators, including professional experience, industry expertise and highest-performing platforms.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience sourcing, evaluating and developing partnerships with creators for branded content, social media or digital campaigns.
  • Experience guiding creators or talent through content production, including briefing, scripting, feedback and revisions.
  • Experience developing creator, social media or branded content strategies based on client objectives, audiences, platforms and campaign goals.
  • Experience working directly with creators, clients and cross-functional creative or production teams throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Experience negotiating creator or talent fees and managing campaign budgets.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, creator trends, audience behavior and platform best practices.
  • Ability to evaluate creators based on audience, expertise, platform presence, content quality and campaign fit.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear creative briefs, strategic recommendations and client-facing materials.
  • Strong relationship-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple creators, stakeholders and deadlines across concurrent programs.
  • Ability to use audience insights, creator discovery tools and industry trends to inform strategic and campaign decisions.
  • Experience collaborating across creative strategy, video production, program management, business affairs or comparable cross-functional teams.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

job.title: Vice President, Finance
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:


The Vice President, Finance is a senior financial leader responsible for driving profitable growth, financial discipline, and strategic decision-making across a music merchandise and apparel business operating through eCommerce, wholesale, retail, licensing and touring channels.

 

This role will engage in financial planning and forecasting, product and channel profitability, inventory and cost accounting, commercial deal evaluation, and management reporting. The Vice President will partner closely with executive leadership and teams across merchandising, eCommerce, retail sales, touring, licensing, production, supply chain, and operations.

 

The ideal candidate combines deep apparel-industry financial expertise with strong commercial judgment and a practical understanding of the operational complexities associated with inventory, product development, fulfillment, royalties, licensing, and multi-channel distribution.

 

How you'll CREATE:
