job.title: Director, Privacy and Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, technology transactions or a closely related field, gained at a law firm, in-house legal department or a combination of both.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data processing agreements and privacy, data use and security provisions in commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.
  • Experience advising on data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including access, deletion, correction and related requests.
  • Experience advising on privacy issues arising from websites, digital advertising, online tracking technologies, e-commerce, marketing and other consumer-facing data practices.
  • Familiarity with consumer protection and marketing requirements relevant to digital and direct-to-consumer activities.
  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.
  • Experience in entertainment, music, digital media, technology, e-commerce, advertising or another consumer-facing and data-intensive industry is a plus.

job.title: Director, Distribution (Music Nation)
job.description:
Great music deserves accurate, trusted distribution.

As Director, Distribution - Music Nation, you’ll lead the royalty distribution operations supporting Music Nation, overseeing matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, quality assurance, payment methodologies and market share calculations. You’ll play a key role in helping BMI deliver Rights Administration and Distribution services for an international collective management organization across both mechanical and performing rights.

This role sits at the intersection of royalty operations, repertoire integrity, data quality, technology and stakeholder partnership. You’ll ensure distribution processes are accurate, scalable and aligned with Music Nation’s licensing strategy while working across BMI to strengthen controls, improve data quality, manage operational risk and enhance the systems and processes that support distribution.

You’ll also help build BMI’s broader multi-right and multi-territory administration capabilities, bringing together operational leadership, analytical thinking, industry expertise and continuous improvement to support both today’s distribution cycles and future growth.

Position Summary

Direct, plan, and oversee all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, quarterly distributions, and quality assurance. Responsible for establishing and maintaining royalty payment methodologies, market share calculations, and royalty distributions.

This position serves as a key operational leader supporting BMI's delivery of Rights Administration and Distribution services to Music Nation and helps establish the organization's capability to manage mechanical and performing rights on behalf of an international collective management organization. The role ensures repertoire integrity across publisher, writer, society, and Music Nation data sources and supports the successful execution of Music Nation's licensing and distribution strategy.

FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB:

Essential Functions: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Lead all royalty distribution activities supporting Music Nation, including matching and identification, funds management, methodology and market share management, and quarterly distribution processing.

• Serve as Music Nation’s subject matter expert for royalty distribution standards and industry data exchange initiatives, representing the organization in industry forums and discussions with societies and other stakeholders to help support evolving rights administration and distribution needs.

• Own and oversee quality assurance strategies that support Music Nation’s quarterly distribution cycles, with particular focus on radio, live concert, and general licensing markets.

• Ensure distribution data integrity through production cycle monitoring, reconciliation testing, variance analysis, and issue resolution across internal systems and third-party data sources.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risk related to distribution processes, vendor inputs, and reporting outputs.

• Monitor changes to Music Nation License Agreements and ensure that distribution practices are appropriately aligned with any license agreement change. Work across the distribution supply chain to ensure the appropriate on-boarding of new licenses from inception through to distribution.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for operational, leadership, and external audiences.

• Partner with SoundExchange team supporting the neighboring rights management and distribution for Music Nation

• Support prioritization, workload planning, and process improvement efforts to ensure timely and accurate distribution outcomes.

• Develop operational procedures, workflows, controls, and service standards supporting Music Nation royalty distribution management.

• Monitor and improve data quality, operational performance, and processing accuracy through reporting, audits, and quality assurance reviews.

• Own market share assessments used for license fee allocations and ongoing rate settings.

• Collaborate with Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, and Product teams to support Music Nation business objectives.

• Participate in business requirements definition, testing, implementation, and enhancement of Music Nation distribution platforms and supporting technologies.

• Maintain compliance with BMI policies, industry standards, copyright requirements, and Music Nation service commitments.

• Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and operational scalability.

• Prepare and deliver operational metrics, readiness reporting, and executive updates to leadership.

• Support Music Nation service readiness initiatives and the ongoing development of BMI's multi-right and multi-territory administration and distribution capabilities.

• Perform additional duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• Directly supervises managers, team leads, analysts, and/or operational specialists supporting Music Nation royalty distribution functions.

• Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with BMI policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, workload prioritization, and employee development.

• Provides leadership across all locations for operational resources supporting distribution activities.

POSITION QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Concentration in Music Business, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related field preferred.

• Extensive knowledge of music publishing, copyright administration, and collective rights management.

Experience

• Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in music publishing, repertoire administration, copyright operations, collective management, or related rights distribution disciplines.

• Experience managing teams and operational processes.

• Experience with industry standards such as CWR, CAF, CISAC, and related music rights management frameworks preferred.

• Experience working with international repertoire administration and distribution preferred.

Skills and Abilities: which may be representative but not all-inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.

• Expert knowledge of music publishing operations, repertoire administration, and royalty distribution methods.

• Strong understanding of mechanical and performing rights distribution.

• Excellent leadership, coaching, and employee development skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong project and process management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.

• Ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Experience analyzing large datasets and identifying data integrity issues.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and enterprise business systems.

• Commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

• You lead accurate, timely and well-controlled royalty distributions for Music Nation across matching, identification, funds management, market share and quarterly processing.

• You establish clear distribution methodologies, procedures, controls and service standards that support both operational consistency and Music Nation’s evolving business needs.

• You use data, reconciliation, variance analysis and quality assurance to identify issues early, protect distribution integrity and drive continuous improvement.

• You balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution, keeping quarterly distribution cycles on track while improving scalability and operational efficiency.

• You build strong partnerships across Licensing, Rights Administration, Customer Service, International Relations, Technology, Product and external stakeholders to resolve complex issues and improve end-to-end outcomes.

• You translate complex royalty, repertoire and market-share data into clear insights and recommendations for operational teams, leadership and external audiences.

• You identify opportunities for automation and technology enhancement that improve accuracy, reduce risk and strengthen BMI’s ability to support multi-right and multi-territory administration.

• You develop a high-performing team with strong technical knowledge, clear priorities and a consistent focus on quality, accountability and service.

Why Join Us?

Distribution is where rights, data and value come together.

At BMI, accurate royalty distribution is central to delivering value to the creators, publishers and partners we serve. As Director, Distribution (Music Nation), you’ll have the opportunity to lead a highly visible operation supporting an international collective management organization while helping expand BMI’s capabilities across mechanical and performing rights.

You’ll work across teams, markets and technologies to strengthen distribution processes, improve data integrity, manage operational risk and help build scalable solutions for a growing multi-right, multi-territory service model.

If you’re energized by complex royalty operations, international rights management, data-driven decision making and building teams and processes that deliver accurate outcomes, we’d love to meet you!

job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a media organization dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We're hiring for a writer-editor to lead the afternoons and evenings on our newsdesk. 

Why it matters: Reporting to our Executive Editor, the news writer-editor will play a critical role as part of the 24/7 nerve center for the newsroom.

  • We are after people with a “see it, write it” mentality who have a personal passion for news and a fast-twitch set of journalistic reflexes.
  • This is a job for the news junkies who “monitor the situation” for fun and want to do it for a living. 
  • We operate at one cadence - do it right now - and are after people who marry a love of news with the thrill of being busy.  
  • This is the ultimate “safe pair of hands” job — someone we can trust to both edit the work of others and write their own, too. 

Go deeper: The role comes with a range of responsibilities, including:

  • Real-time news surveillance
  • Quick-turn writing of spot news stories
  • Editing a wide variety of national news, from breaking stories across the national file to the occasional enterprise.
  • Monitoring developments on key stories and flagging them to experts

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will have a get-stuff-done attitude, a strong sense of personal responsibility and urgency, and a passion for being on top of the news at all times. Some of the skills include:

  • Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with a team of journalists.
  • Writing and editing experience in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated experience monitoring and activating on news. 
  • A belief in Smart Brevity as the core writing style of Axios.
  • Experience working across teams to produce quality content.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the digital and social media landscape.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willing to work afternoons/evenings (2pm-10pm ET Sunday-Thursday)

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $70,000 - $110,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including telehealth services
  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health, and family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Axios is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, AgencyIQ by POLITICO
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager to design and deliver new tools and features for  AgencyIQ by POLITICO, a policy-driven product for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals sectors.

 

AgencyIQ combines expert research, data, and software tools for regulatory professionals in the life sciences, food, and chemicals industries. This Technical Product Manager will shape AgencyIQ’s roadmap and help the product team move from customer insight to working solutions faster. The role spans product innovation (including the development and roll-out of AI-driven tools), commercial strategy, and technology execution—driving measurable growth in subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention across both product lines.

 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with a proven ability to translate subscriber insights into product roadmaps that deliver commercial results, partnering closely with research, editorial, technology, data, and commercial teams.

Who You Are

 

  • You are a highly user-centric product manager with a strong track record of translating research, data, and market insight into clear roadmaps and measurable business impact.
  • You are comfortable with both customer discovery and hands-on technical work. You can test an idea with users, understand how it fits into a subscription product, and collaborate with engineers on APIs, data flows, security, and deployment.
  • You enjoy enabling others by creating repeatable processes that make the whole team more effective.

 

What You’ll Do


Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize a roadmap for AgencyIQ features and workflows, balancing customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and engineering capacity.
  • Interview customers and prospects; analyze usage, feedback, market developments, and competitors; turn findings into clear product requirements, experiments, and defined KPIs.
  • Partner with research, commercial, design, and engineering teams to improve acquisition, engagement, expansion, and retention of customers across the market segments we serve.

 

AI-Assisted Prototyping and Technical Enablement

  • Design and roll out a repeatable workflow that lets nontechnical product managers use approved AI coding tools, such as Codex or Claude Code, to build and test feature prototypes and data collection tools.
  • Work with POLITICO’s engineering and design teams to create reusable templates and documentation that adhere to company standards and connect to POLITICO systems through approved access paths.
  • Align new templates and workflows with the tooling, policies, and procedures established by POLITICO’s engineering and operations teams.
  • Define how prototypes are evaluated with users, reviewed by engineers, and either hardened for release or retired.
  • Build representative prototypes yourself and coach other product managers through the workflow, and improve it based on where they get stuck and what engineers need for an efficient handoff.
  • Create reusable evals for prototypes and AI-enabled features, using representative regulatory tasks, expected results, and clear quality thresholds. Run them as designs change and use the results to guide engineering review and release decisions.

 

Regulatory Data and Delivery

  • Scope and prototype reliable ways to collect public data from government sources in the United States, Europe, Japan, and other global jurisdictions using official APIs or structured feeds where available and compliant scraping where appropriate.
  • Partner with research and engineering on source provenance, data quality, parsing, change detection, monitoring, and maintainability so promising data prototypes can become dependable product capabilities.
  • Write clear specifications, make trade-offs visible, coordinate delivery to make the most of limited engineering capacity, and measure whether shipped features improve customer outcomes.

What You'll Need

 

  • 3+ years of product management experience delivering B2B software or data products, with evidence of strong product judgment and measurable customer or business results.
  • Hands-on ability to prototype with modern AI coding tools and enough working knowledge of code, APIs, databases, and software delivery to assess output and collaborate credibly with engineers.
  • Experience designing usable product workflows from interviews, usability tests, feedback, and behavioral data; fluency in product metrics and prioritization.
  • Experience working with engineering on technical requirements, integrations, testing, and release processes; sound judgment about security, data access, and where human review is necessary.
  • Ability to teach technical practices to colleagues with different backgrounds and to communicate decisions clearly to commercial, research, technology, and senior leadership teams.
  • Familiarity with Python or JavaScript, SQL, web data collection, cloud development environments, CI/CD, and API-based integrations.

Preferred Experience

 

  • Experience in information services, regulatory intelligence, or another B2B subscription business that combines expert content, structured data, and software.
  • Knowledge of public regulatory sources or the needs of regulatory affairs, policy, legal, or scientific users.
  • Knowledge of the U.S. capital markets—namely public equities and the institutions that trade them

COMPENSATION: $125,000 - 135,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.


We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here and email us careers@politico.com. We hope to see your application soon! 


About Us. 

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital. 


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes. 


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist. 


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself. 


These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization. 


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward-thinking, and collaborative. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, please read on!


THE JOB

Live Nation Entertainment’s Media & Sponsorship Division is seeking a Regional Director, Sales. This successful sponsorship sales professional will be responsible for creating and selling branded, high-impact music marketing programs across our San Francisco and Pacific Northwest market properties.


Live Nation Media & Sponsorship architects, sells and manages the company’s national corporate sponsorship programs with the world’s most recognizable brands. It is an exciting, fast-paced team that collaborates with all facets of Live Nation’s business including venues, festivals, ticketing, artists, content, media (digital, social, mobile), promotions, and concert production. To learn more about our division, check out: https://livenationforbrands.com/


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Create, package and sell solution-based music marketing programs for Live Nation Entertainment. Including amphitheater, club and theater venues throughout the San Francisco and Pacific Northwest market areas, digital media and marketing promotions
  • Meet or exceed revenue and key account goals
  • Focus on developing and maintaining strong relationships with important decision makers at client marketing companies and their respective advertising agencies in a variety of business categories
  • Craft sales presentations that creatively and distinctly differentiate and communicate unique assets addressing the goals of targeted prospects
  • Educate/position Live Nation assets and marketing capabilities to the sponsor/advertiser marketplace; demonstrate the branding values of live music tie-ins to create unique marketing value with Live Nation's assets
  • Structure, price, successfully negotiate and close deals that will keep you performing to expectations in tracking to your budget
  • Oversee sponsor contracts, invoicing, and accounts receivable or develop processes to ensure execution and collections

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Minimum of 5 years of sponsorship/solution-based marketing programs
  • A reputation as a "go-getter" and "Rainmaker”
  • Solid relationships with senior level marketing executives at relevant brands/agencies located in or doing business in the market(s)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and nurture relationships and work effectively at all levels of the decision process
  • Strong understanding of media/advertising buys to communicate value of sponsorship vs. pure media as a marketing solution
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership abilities with excellent oral and written communication skills

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, Vision and Dental benefits for you and your family, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)

YOURSELF: Generous paid time off policy including paid holidays, sick time and paid days off for your birthday, Free concert tickets

job.title: Staff Attorney
job.description:
WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The Staff Attorney will support the Chief Legal Officer, Associate General Counsel, Senior Managing Director of Legal Affairs, and overall Legal Affairs team with the Academy’s day-to-day transactional needs. Utilizing your excellent judgment, team collaboration skills, and commitment to the highest level of honesty, fidelity and integrity, you will provide legal advice to the Academy and its affiliates on a range of contracts.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts covering a range of Academy and affiliate activities, including vendor and services agreements, programming, events, licensing, technology and new initiatives under development.
  • Advise business teams on contract interpretation and obligations, explaining legal issues to non-lawyers in a digestible manner.
  • Issue spot and quickly assess when to escalate matters to more senior members of the Legal Affairs department.
  • Work with the team to streamline contract processes from commencement to conclusion, including maintaining contract playbooks and using technology to standardize processes.
  • Maintain organized records of executed contracts and related documents.
  • Collaborate intra- and inter-departmentally to maintain appropriate contract templates for business team use.
  • Assist with implementing and updating Academy and affiliate policies and procedures to ensure compliance and efficient administration of resources.
  • Stay informed about legal developments relevant to the Academy’s and its affiliates’ business operations.

 

 SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 
  • Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • License to practice law (or ability to become licensed) in state of residence.
  • 2-3 years’ experience practicing transactional law at an established law firm and/or in-house in a corporate legal or business affairs department.  
  • Experience advising on music and entertainment business matters strongly preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including an established track record of superior legal draftsmanship and negotiation, and the demonstrated ability to conclude matters efficiently and beneficially for the client. 
  • Must be a forward-thinking individual with sound, practical, and business-minded judgment including the ability to “think outside of the box,” come up with intelligent solutions to problems, master new technologies utilized to streamline contract systems, and assess and explain the business and legal impact of alternative options.
  • Ability to work well both independently and as part of a greater team, moving projects forward diligently and proactively.

 

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

 

 

SALARY AND BENEFITS

 

The starting salary for this position is $95,600 to $106,500 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market. 
 
The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements. Positions working 20+ hours per week also receive our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more). Click here for an overview of our company benefits.


Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity. 

 

 

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

 

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

 

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

 

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

 

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

 

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

job.title: Account Director, Earned Media - Health & Wellness
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are seeking an Account Director, Earned Media to join our growing Health & Wellness practice and help lead earned media strategy and execution across pharmaceutical, biotech and wellness clients. This role is ideal for an experienced media relations professional who is passionate about finding compelling stories within complex healthcare topics, building strong relationships with journalists and helping clients earn meaningful attention in an increasingly fragmented media landscape.

You will play a hands-on role in developing and executing earned media strategies, identifying newsworthy opportunities and proactively engaging traditional, trade, consumer and emerging media. From complex science and clinical data to product milestones, disease awareness, thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns, you will help translate healthcare stories into timely, relevant narratives that resonate with reporters and their audiences.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare communications experience, established media relationships, a track record of securing impactful coverage and the ability to confidently counsel clients and guide teams through execution. You will work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to ensure earned media is integrated into broader communications programs.

The Team

The Health & Wellness team at Burson is one of the largest and most innovative groups in the space. We have pushed the limits of traditional healthcare communications with a complete 360-degree integrated offer for our clients: social, digital, data, brands, celebrity, science, corporate, consumer and more.

We are a group of people who work hard as a team to continue building our reputation as visionaries in the industry. We are looking for individuals who want to challenge both themselves and the status quo.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and execute earned media strategies for healthcare clients that align with client objectives, communications priorities and the evolving media landscape.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and trade reporters, editors and other influential media contacts.
  • Proactively identify and pitch compelling stories ranging from complex science, clinical trial results, regulatory milestones and product approvals/launches to disease awareness campaigns, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing partnerships.
  • Translate complex scientific and healthcare information into clear, relevant and newsworthy narratives for different media audiences.
  • Serve as a trusted earned media counselor to clients, providing recommendations around story positioning, messaging, media targets, spokesperson preparation and outreach strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to insert clients and subject-matter experts into timely healthcare, cultural and industry conversations.
  • Work closely with account, digital, social, creative and strategy colleagues to integrate earned media into broader communications campaigns and ensure consistency across channels.
  • Manage day-to-day earned media programs from strategy through execution, keeping workstreams moving and ensuring teams deliver high-quality work.
  • Provide strategic counsel and support around issues management and sensitive media situations, working with senior team members as appropriate.
  • Help develop earned media plans, measurement frameworks and KPIs, and use performance insights to continually strengthen media strategies.
  • Oversee media monitoring and reporting across traditional, digital and trade outlets, identifying trends, opportunities and implications for clients.
  • Analyze earned media performance and translate results into actionable insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Manage and mentor junior team members, providing clear direction, feedback and opportunities to strengthen their media relations and healthcare communications expertise.
  • Review and provide thoughtful feedback on media materials including pitches, press releases, talking points, briefing materials, Q&As and media strategies.
  • Stay current on the evolving healthcare and media landscapes, bringing new reporters, platforms, trends and storytelling approaches to clients and internal teams.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 7+ years of experience in public relations and communications, with meaningful experience in earned media and healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech or wellness communications.
  • Demonstrated success securing media coverage for healthcare clients across areas such as product launches, clinical data, regulatory milestones, disease awareness, executive thought leadership and consumer-facing campaigns.
  • Strong relationships with healthcare, business, consumer and/or trade journalists, along with an understanding of how reporters and outlets approach healthcare stories.
  • Experience developing media strategies and translating those strategies into proactive, results-oriented media relations programs.
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory considerations that shape pharmaceutical and healthcare communications, including experience working within regulated client environments.
  • Strong client-management and counseling skills, with the confidence to present recommendations and provide thoughtful media guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to simplify complex scientific and healthcare information for a variety of audiences.
  • Strong judgment and an understanding of what makes a story timely, differentiated, credible and relevant to the media.
  • Experience managing multiple workstreams, deadlines and priorities in a fast-paced agency or communications environment.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing constructive feedback on media strategy and execution.
  • Experience using media monitoring, intelligence and measurement tools to evaluate earned media performance and inform recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrated healthcare communications, including how earned media can work alongside digital, social, influencer, creative and corporate communications.
  • Desire to work in a diverse and inclusive organization as an active participant in culture initiatives, training opportunities and employee resource groups.

Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

  • Able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met
  • Able to devise and articulate solutions to problems on an ongoing basis
  • Able to clearly communicate project updates, scopes and recommendations to clients

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. Our unwavering commitment is to create exceptional, high-quality branded entertainment that resonates deeply with the Hispanic consumer. Our impressive growth on the web with LaMusica.com and the promising reception of our latest venture, the podcast initiative, are testament to SBS' long-term strategy. By seamlessly delivering content through diverse channels, we not only maximize revenue but also extend the reach of our beloved brands. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant is responsible for analyzing multiple complex financial reports in preparation to present the company’s financial statements.  The Senior Accountant regulates and authenticates financial transactions and maintains a ledger to ensure effectiveness and accuracy of all accounting tasks.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Overall accounting and variance analysis.
  • Perform various functions directly related to the accounting month-end close process, which include but are not limited to preparing journal entries and supporting schedules, reconciling bank and ledger accounts, and reviewing detailed transactions for accuracy and validity of accounting treatment.
  • Analyze and prepare entries related to payrolls, benefits, commissions, barter, invoices, contracts, and various vendor payments for posting to the general ledger.
  • Analyze actual results against budgets and forecasts.
  • Prepare ad-hoc or other financial reports, as necessary.
  • Maintain US GAAP accounting and ensure compliance with all relevant accounting literature.
  • Maintain SOX compliance and update related process flows.
  • Review and analysis of financial statements and key metrics for assigned areas.
  • Prepare general ledger entries and balance sheet reconciliation in compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Identify and implement process improvements as continuous improvement.
  • Liaise with external auditors and provide documentation as necessary.
  • Help design and implement internal controls over accounting processes.
  • Update and maintain schedules to reflect activities and balances at period end, involving generating relevant system reports or obtaining data from third-party sources (such as sub-ledger reports, GL details, amortization schedules, payroll reports, account statements, contracts, and invoices).
  • Ensure accuracy by reconciling figures with source documents and validate the completeness and accuracy of acquired data.
  • Conduct calculations for items like accrued commissions and bad debt reverses.
  • Conduct reconciliation for SL to GL and books to bank where applicable.
  • Gather documentation and conduct research to explain and support changes in activities compared to prior periods.
  • Investigate aged balance to propose appropriate resolutions for reconciling items or accrual components.
  • Execute necessary adjustments via Journal Entries to ensure accurate representation of financial data.
  • Verify and ensure all required adjustments impacting account balances were made for each market in consolidated schedules.
  • Reconcile consolidated schedules with the consolidated general ledger to ensure alignment.
  • Analyze balance sheet accounts to appropriately classify balances between Short Term and Long Term, distinguishing between receivables or payables with terms exceeding one year as Long Term.
  • Additional accounts reconciliation and analysis as needed.

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • May lead projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • 4 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong technical accounting and financial analytical skills.
  • Detail-oriented and organized. Superior analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to meet a constant stream of deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively with different levels of employees.
  • Familiarity with accounting software and programs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

Why work for SBS?

 

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

Within FOX Entertainment’s Creative Advertising Group sits the Visual Innovation Studio (aka VIS). The VIS team is FOX Entertainment’s in-house design agency – combining the disciplines of design, animation, illustration, and photography to craft bespoke visuals for FOX’s marketing efforts.

The Digital Art Director at FOX Entertainment will have mastery of Art Direction, 2D & 3D Animation, and Traditional Design with the know-how and skillset to develop engaging digital content and experiences. You will also have a deep knowledge and interest in the best practices and nuances of social platforms including Instagram, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Snapchat, TikTok, and emerging platforms, as well as producing engaging content in different formats, including static images, video animations, motion graphics, AR filters and more. Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

Inclusive innovator and results-driven problem solver: these are the qualities we're looking for in our next Director of Engineering. If you're ready to build on the legacy of Utah's FIRST television station — and collaborate with the team at America's largest local media company — we want to hear from you.


Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, you will serve on the station’s senior leadership team – a key voice in every major decision, working side-by-side with every department.


Our Salt Lake City media group (KTVX, KUCW, ABC4.COM and News4Utah+) operates in the nation's 27th-largest market and is seeking a technology-forward leader to head our engineering team as we continue our tradition of industry FIRSTS.  Our media operation is pushing the envelope in creating new workflows and technology efficiencies – you will help lead us into the future, building on the foundation we have established.  We aren’t looking for traditional ways to produce content – we are looking for innovation as we propel our team into the future.


As Director of Engineering, you will set the technical vision for a modern, multi-platform media operation — driving innovation across broadcast, streaming, and digital. You will architect forward-looking workflows for our content teams, foster a culture where engineers grow and thrive, and lead from our Salt Lake facility, home to one of the company's largest traffic hubs supporting more than 100 stations nationwide. You will also represent our station group with DTV Utah, the first-of-its-kind cooperative created in 1998, through which eight of Utah's major broadcasters transmit from the state-of-the-art facility atop Farnsworth Peak.


This is not a desk job. You’ll be in the control room or our Stream Center during breaking news and in the newsroom shaping workflows –you’ll lead from the front when it matters most.


You will do all of this in one of the fastest-growing regions in the country — beautiful Salt Lake City. Skiing, hiking, camping, city living: it's all here. You will lead from a modern 80-thousand square foot facility, surrounded by an experienced leadership team invested in your success.  Are you ready to lead Utah’s First Television station into its next era of innovation?  Apply today.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Own the station's multi-year technology roadmap — set the strategy for station technical systems, from IP-based broadcast infrastructure to cloud and NextGen TV (ATSC 3.0) initiatives.
  • Partner with news and content teams to design modern, efficient workflows across linear, streaming, and digital platforms.
  • Lead the maintenance engineering and IT team — directing repairs, maintenance, and new systems installations.
  • Oversee transmitter and remote sites, ensuring reliability and performance.
  • Own capital planning: create and manage the capital budget and technical projects, assigning project champions.
  • Champion IT security best practices across all platforms, keeping current with company and industry standards.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and make strategic recommendations on their application.
  • Collaborate directly with department leaders to support station initiatives; ensure FCC compliance.

REQUIREMENTS:

 

  • A forward-looking mindset: you embrace innovation, adopt innovative technologies, and inspire your team to do the same.
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of equipment, systems, and workflow dynamics in a modern, IP-driven broadcast facility. This is not an office job.
  • Experience with systems from providers such as vMix, OBS, Ross, Florical, Vinten, Clear-Com, Bitcentral, Evertz, Cobalt, ENPS, and others — plus strong practical knowledge of computer networking and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Minimum five years of supervisory experience in engineering and technology within broadcast and/or production operations.
  • Proven ability to manage costs, including labor and operating expenses

COMPLEXITY:

Ability to interface well with other departments. Excellent leadership and communication skills. Ability to multitask under pressure and prioritize and pivot as needed. Good skills in troubleshooting. Ability to teach others to grow in this area. Must have good organizational skills. Emphasis on employee development and growth.

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Ability to carry heavy equipment at times (20-50 lbs.).  Position will require travel to high elevation mountain-top environments on occasion where temperatures and climate may vary. There are periods of strenuous activity for this position. Candidate must be able to work in these conditions.

Job Summary: The Senior Director, Programming Business Affairs is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing all aspects of sports rights acquisition, content licensing, contract administration, and rights management across ESPN and The Walt Disney Company (TWDC). Serving as a strategic partner to Programming, Legal, Ad Sales, Distribution, Business Development, and Finance, this executive will lead negotiations for key sports properties, ensure contractual compliance and execution, and maximize the value of content rights across linear, digital, streaming, direct-to-consumer, and emerging distribution platforms. This leader will act as the primary business affairs liaison for league and rights-holder partners, balancing sophisticated deal-making, relationship management, and operational excellence. The role requires a deep understanding of the evolving sports media landscape, media rights economics, and the strategic opportunities that drive audience growth, distribution expansion, and long-term business value. Key Responsibilities Sports Rights Acquisition & Negotiation Lead strategic preparation for major media rights renewals by organizing historical agreements, evaluating contractual obligations, identifying business opportunities, and coordinating enterprise-wide negotiation readiness. Lead and support negotiations for high-profile sports rights agreements, renewals, amendments, and strategic partnerships. Partner closely with senior Programming, Legal, Distribution, Ad Sales, Direct-to-Consumer, and Business Development leaders to maximize the value and flexibility of acquired rights. Evaluate new rights opportunities and emerging market trends, developing recommendations that support ESPN and TWDC's broader content strategy. Serve as a trusted advisor during complex negotiations, balancing business objectives, contractual protections, and partner relationships. Strategic Business Affairs Leadership Act as the central point of contact for league partners and rights holders on all business affairs matters. Provide strategic guidance and risk assessment on contractual issues, identifying solutions that align with both business priorities and legal requirements. Collaborate with executive leadership to develop scalable processes, governance structures, and best practices that support business growth and operational efficiency. Ensure alignment between contractual obligations and evolving distribution, monetization, and content strategies across the enterprise. Content Rights Management & Compliance Lead the Content Rights Management function, ensuring accurate interpretation, documentation, and administration of contractual rights across multiple platforms and businesses. Oversee the creation and maintenance of rights summaries, contract analyses, reporting frameworks, and compliance processes. Establish and maintain enterprise-wide standards, systems, and procedures that ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled, rights are fully leveraged, and cross-functional business initiatives remain compliant across ESPN and TWDC. Identify opportunities to optimize content utilization and unlock additional value from existing rights portfolios. Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Programming leadership, including senior executives responsible for content strategy, to support long-term content planning and rights portfolio management. Work closely with Disney Platform Distribution, Disney Advertising Sales, ESPN Direct-to-Consumer, Finance, Strategy, and Legal teams to ensure coordinated execution of enterprise priorities. Build strong internal alignment around key rights decisions and associated business implications. Understand affiliate, distribution, and platform-specific considerations and identify opportunities to expand audience reach and revenue generation. Team Leadership Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of business affairs and rights management professionals. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Drive employee engagement, team effectiveness, and succession planning while maintaining high standards of performance and operational excellence. Required Qualifications 10+ years of progressive experience in sports media, programming, business affairs, media rights, legal affairs, or a related field. Significant experience negotiating and managing complex media rights agreements, licensing arrangements, and strategic partnerships. Proven track record leading cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders across programming, distribution, advertising, legal, and business operations. Demonstrated people leadership experience, including a track record of developing, coaching, and leading high-performing teams. Strong understanding of the sports media ecosystem, including linear television, streaming, digital platforms, affiliate distribution, and evolving content consumption trends. Excellent executive communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and complex projects in a deadline-driven environment. Strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and decision-making skills. Preferred Qualifications Deep experience within sports media, professional sports leagues, teams, conferences, agencies, media companies, or rights-holding organizations. Demonstrated expertise in sports rights acquisitions, business affairs, media distribution, or sports-related legal matters. Strong understanding of content monetization models, direct-to-consumer businesses, and emerging media distribution trends. Ability to balance strategic thinking with executional excellence. Proven ability to influence senior executives and external partners in complex business environments. Passion for sports and deep appreciation for ESPN's role within the sports media landscape. Reputation as a trusted, collaborative leader who drives results through influence and partnerships. Education Required Bachelor's degree required. Education Preferred Juris Doctor (JD) strongly preferred. MBA, MS, or other relevant advanced degree preferred. #ESPNMedia The hiring range for this position in Bristol, CT is $188,200.00 to $252,400.00 per year and in New York, NY is $197,300.00 to $264,500.00 per year. job.title: Associate Producer, Hannity
job.description:
Hannity is looking for a dedicated, creative, and experienced Associate Producer to join our team. In this role, you will pitch stories, produce segments, assist the monologue writers, support field shoots, and contribute to the show’s daily editorial process.

The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative team environment and has a strong passion for current events and politics.

You will be offered the following shift: Monday – Friday from 2 PM – 10 PM, ET

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pitch segment ideas, story ideas, and guests daily
  • Assist monologue writers with research, elements, and segment production
  • Build graphics for various segments
  • Write banners and teases
  • Periodically write introductions, mini-monologues, and monologues
  • Help arrange field shoots
  • Assist bookers during breaking news situations

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Strong knowledge of and passion for current events and politics
  • Clear and concise writing skills
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments under tight deadlines and extreme pressure
  • Team-player attitude, with the ability to meet quick deadlines and respond to rapidly developing news
  • Excellent communication skills

job.title: Digital Art Director, Visual Innovation Studio (Motion Designer)
job.description:
Within FOX Entertainment’s Creative Advertising Group sits the Visual Innovation Studio (aka VIS). The VIS team is FOX Entertainment’s in-house design agency – combining the disciplines of design, animation, illustration, and photography to craft bespoke visuals for FOX’s marketing efforts.

The Digital Art Director at FOX Entertainment will have mastery of Art Direction, 2D & 3D Animation, and Traditional Design with the know-how and skillset to develop engaging digital content and experiences. This position will be expected to contribute conceptually, creatively, and technically while executing high-impact marketing initiatives with A+ quality for the digital and social media landscape. 

The Digital Art Director will be working on the VIS Digital Team with other creatives and designers to help build FOX show brands through campaign-level thinking and tactical executions across all social media and digital platforms. You will also have a deep knowledge and interest in the best practices and nuances of social platforms including Instagram, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Snapchat, TikTok, and emerging platforms, as well as producing engaging content in different formats, including static images, video animations, motion graphics, AR filters and more. You are proactive, hands-on, detail-oriented, and able to own projects from ideation through to execution.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with Creative Directors and team members to conceptualize and execute top-tier creative content, leveraging digital and social media best practices, including video editing, eye-catching motion graphics, and sound design, to craft visually arresting digital content
  • Create storyboards, comps, animation, visual effects, photo-retouching, and image enhancements that meet or exceed strategic objectives
  • Produce animated motion graphics, titles, text, and infographics that captivate and inspire
  • Seamlessly coordinating with Project Managers to align on timelines and deliverables, ensuring flawless execution from conception to completion
  • Develop branding/design systems for FOX’s owned and operated Social Media verticals, fostering cross-platform cohesion and brand integrity

 
WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Proficiency in Adobe Cloud with a focus on After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator
  • In-depth knowledge of digital ad products and placements, enabling the creation of channel-specific visuals that embody platform best practices
  • Critical eye for visual details such as color, typography, and composition
  • Highly organized and positive with a self-sufficient mentality
  • Highly collaborative and able to maintain creative excellence in a fast-paced, ever-changing landscape
  • Capability to work and transition seamlessly from projects across different media (social media, motion graphics, and static work)

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Knowledge of 3D Design within Cinema 4D or Blender

job.title: Producer - Local Media Game Production
job.description:
WORK OPTION

The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. _________________ Producer, Local Media Game Production (NABET)

Position Summary

The Producer, Local Media Game Production, will work with the Local Game Production Supervisor, Game Production Lead, internal production teams, and local broadcast partners to plan, coordinate, and support the execution of live NBA game broadcasts and related programming. This role supports all phases of production, including pre-production planning, live game execution, and post-production activities, while helping ensure creative, editorial, technical, and operational excellence. Working in conjunction with the onsite NBA teams’ Producers/Directors and game production teams, the Producer provides production and editorial support for assigned NBA broadcasts and helps ensure the onsite team has the content, resources, information, and production assets necessary for successful game coverage. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role works closely with the Local Game Production Supervisor to coordinate game coverage and production support across assigned broadcasts.

Major Responsibilities

Coordinate production planning with the Local Game Production Supervisor and work in conjunction with the onsite ATL Producer/Director team to support assigned broadcasts. Collaborate with internal and external partners on graphics, programming, advertising integration and trafficking, engineering, broadcast operations, and other production requirements. Support live game coverage for assigned broadcasts, working closely with the onsite ATL Producer/Director team to help ensure productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, and operational standards. Coordinate editorial direction and content needs with the Local Game Production Supervisor, onsite ATL Producer/Director, and other production personnel supporting assigned broadcasts. Ensure onsite production teams have the resources, content, information, and production assets necessary for successful broadcasts. Provide game production and editorial support during assigned NBA broadcasts, partnering with the onsite ATL Producer/Director and production personnel throughout game-day execution. Liaise with contracted and third-party vendors as needed to coordinate services, deliverables, production expectations, and issue resolution.
