job.title: Senior II Engineer - Commercial Technology
job.description:
About Us

The Financial Times is one of the world’s leading news organisations, globally recognised for its authority, integrity and accuracy, with a mission to deliver quality information and services worldwide.

At the FT, curiosity thrives and ambitious thinking is rewarded. Together, we help audiences stay better informed and deepen their understanding of the world around them.

Our Product & Tech teams drive us forward in an ever-evolving digital landscape, delivering cutting-edge products to over one million digital subscribers daily. Our growth relies on a diverse, dedicated and dynamic group of product, tech, delivery and data specialists.

With a supportive culture, entrepreneurial spirit and opportunities at every turn, there are no limits to where your FT career can take you.

Build a newsworthy career at the FT.

 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We believe everyone should have a fair opportunity to contribute, succeed, and reach their full potential. That means ensuring everyone is heard, respected, and valued, while identifying and removing barriers that may get in the way. Our commitment is to be an employer role model, grounded in inclusion and fairness for all.We want every application to receive fair and thoughtful consideration; therefore, all applications are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team, not by AI.

 

About you

You are an experienced senior engineer and technical leader with a strong software engineering background and a track record of providing technical direction across business-critical products and platforms.

You combine deep technical expertise with pragmatic engineering judgement. You are comfortable navigating complex systems, shaping architecture, making and facilitating significant technical decisions, and helping engineering teams turn business requirements into secure, resilient and sustainable solutions.

You think beyond individual features and solutions to the long-term health of the technology: architecture, reliability, security, scalability, operability, developer experience, technical debt and the ability of teams to evolve their systems sustainably.

You are comfortable working with engineers, Product, Programme and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical considerations clearly and making thoughtful trade-offs between immediate delivery needs and longer-term technical investment.

You are also motivated by developing engineering capability. While this is not a people-management role, you will mentor engineers, encourage technical ownership, create opportunities for others to develop their expertise and help build a strong engineering culture based on learning, collaboration and constructive technical challenge.

 

About the team

Commercial Technology is part of the Internal Products group within FT Product & Technology. We are a multidisciplinary group of Engineers, Product Managers and Business Analysts responsible for building and operating the technology platforms that support the FT’s commercial capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Service and Commercial Data.

We are undertaking a significant evolution of our commercial technology landscape, bringing these capabilities together around a more connected Salesforce platform and establishing a strong foundation for how our commercial teams engage with customers and use data.

In Marketing & Commercial Data, we are evolving our marketing technology landscape towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360, while continuing to operate and transition from established platforms including Bloomreach, Marketo and Legacy Salesforce Marketing Cloud products for B2B & B2C marketing.

In Sales & Service, we are consolidating several Salesforce CRM orgs with their associated processes and procedures into a leaner Commercial Technology estate, utilising data available to us via Data 360, into a setup that aligns with the FT’s future commercial capabilities and setup.

In Commercial Platform, we are establishing a centre of excellence at the heart of the commercial workflow, tasked with ensuring the security, health and viability of our day-to-day commercial operation and providing a primary support route for our business users

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership for one of the engineering capabilities within Commercial Technology, working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product, engineers, other Technical Leads and the wider Commercial Technology leadership team.

 

Our Technology

Our Commercial Technology landscape is evolving. Technologies and platforms within or interacting with Marketing & Commercial Data include:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (Advanced Edition)
  • Salesforce Data 360
  • Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud
  • Sales Collaboration & Enablement Tooling
  • Bloomreach
  • Marketo
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • APIs and integration technologies
  • AWS Technologies
  • Data platforms and integrations
  • CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
  • GitHub
  • Monitoring and observability tooling
  • Jira & Confluence

You do not need experience with all of these technologies to apply. We are particularly interested in engineering leaders who can lead teams through technology change and help engineers develop the skills required for an evolving platform.

 

What you’ll work on

As Technical Lead within Commercial Technology, you will provide technical leadership for the engineering capability responsible for the delivery, operation and continuous evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology.

You will be accountable for the technical direction and engineering integrity of the capability, ensuring our technology is secure, resilient, scalable, maintainable and aligned with wider Commercial Technology and FT engineering standards. You will lead architectural thinking, guide significant technical decisions and ensure technical risks, dependencies and opportunities are understood and actively managed.

You will help lead the technical transformation of the FT’s commercial technology landscape, shaping the transition from our established marketing platforms towards Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360 and the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem while ensuring our existing technology remains sustainable throughout that transition.

You will work in close partnership with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data. Together, you will provide the complementary people, delivery and technical leadership required to operate and evolve the capability successfully. The Engineering Manager is primarily accountable for people leadership, delivery, capacity and operational coordination, while you will be primarily accountable for technical direction, architecture, engineering standards and technical sustainability.

You will remain close to engineering delivery, working directly with engineers to solve complex technical problems, review and challenge approaches, improve engineering practices and create opportunities for engineers to develop greater technical ownership and expertise.

You will also work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other senior technical leaders on decisions that extend beyond your capability, ensuring local technical decisions contribute to a coherent and sustainable Commercial Technology landscape.

You will report to the Principal Engineer for the Commercial Technology domain.

 

Your responsibilities will include

Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Own the technical direction for the Marketing & Commercial Data capability, ensuring technology decisions align with the wider Commercial Technology strategy and FT engineering standards.
  • Lead architectural thinking and significant technical decisions across the capability, balancing immediate delivery needs with security, resilience, scalability, maintainability and long-term sustainability.
  • Establish and champion appropriate engineering standards, patterns and practices across the team.
  • Maintain visibility of architecture, technical debt, lifecycle risks, dependencies and emerging technology opportunities.
  • Work with the Principal Engineer, Principal Architect and other Technical Leads on decisions that span multiple capabilities, platforms or technology domains.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, modernise and improve the technology landscape while avoiding unnecessary complexity and duplication.

Engineering Quality & Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and guidance to engineers while creating appropriate autonomy for individuals to make decisions and take ownership of the technology they work with.
  • Mentor engineers and technical specialists, helping them develop their technical expertise, engineering judgement and confidence in making technical decisions.
  • Support engineers through complex technical challenges without becoming the decision-maker or implementation owner for every issue.
  • Promote strong engineering practices including testing, automation, observability, security, documentation and sustainable software development.
  • Encourage constructive technical challenge, knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to identify technical skills and capability gaps and help develop the engineering capabilities required for our future platform.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Engineering Manager – Marketing & Commercial Data to ensure technical strategy, people, delivery and operational priorities remain aligned.
  • Provide technical input into roadmaps, planning and prioritisation, ensuring delivery plans are technically achievable and account for complexity, dependencies, technical risk and longer-term investment.
  • Work with Product, Programme and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into appropriate technical approaches and clearly communicate technical considerations, trade-offs and opportunities.
  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early and work with the Engineering Manager and wider Commercial Technology leadership to ensure they are understood and appropriately managed.
  • Work closely with Technical Leads, Engineering Managers and engineers across Commercial Technology to coordinate technical decisions and shared dependencies.
  • Work effectively with external technology partners and delivery vendors, providing technical direction and ensuring solutions align with FT architecture, engineering standards and practices.

Operational Excellence & Technical Health

  • Be accountable for the technical health and sustainability of the Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions are designed and engineered with appropriate consideration for security, resilience, scalability, observability, maintainability and supportability.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager and Commercial Platform team to ensure new and changed capabilities are operationally ready and can be effectively supported within the wider Commercial Technology operating model.
  • Provide technical leadership during incidents affecting Marketing & Commercial Data capabilities, supporting diagnosis, technical decision-making and sustainable resolution.
  • Ensure technical debt, lifecycle risks and engineering improvements are visible, understood and appropriately considered alongside product and programme priorities.
  • Ensure learning from incidents and operational issues informs architecture, engineering standards and future technical decisions.

Change & Platform Evolution

  • Provide technical leadership for the evolution of the FT’s Marketing & Commercial Data technology landscape.
  • Shape the technical transition from established marketing platforms, including Bloomreach and Marketo, towards the FT’s strategic Salesforce-based marketing and data capabilities.
  • Define and evolve the architecture, engineering patterns and technical practices required to support the future Marketing & Commercial Data platform.
  • Work with the Engineering Manager to ensure the team develops the technical skills and knowledge required to own and evolve the future platform sustainably.
  • Work with Commercial Platform, other Technical Leads, the Principal Architect and the Principal Engineer to ensure platform changes integrate coherently with the wider Commercial Technology ecosystem and maintain operational continuity.

 

Technical and Leadership experience we’re looking for

  • Experience managing, leading or designing a Customer Data Platform, ideally utilising Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Data 360.
  • Significant software engineering experience working with complex production systems, platforms or enterprise technology.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across engineering teams or significant technology capabilities.
  • Strong architectural and engineering judgement, with experience making and guiding significant technical decisions.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices and the design of secure, resilient, scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Experience identifying and managing technical debt, architectural risk, technology lifecycle concerns and cross-system dependencies.
  • Experience working closely with engineers to solve complex technical problems while enabling others to take ownership and develop their expertise.
  • Experience balancing immediate delivery needs with longer-term architecture, engineering quality and technical investment.
  • Strong understanding of operational excellence, observability, reliability and production engineering.
  • Experience working effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Programme and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical considerations and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across teams and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area.
  • Experience leading technical change across significant platform or technology transformations would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing technology, customer data platforms, enterprise SaaS ecosystems or complex integration architectures would be beneficial, but is not essential

 

Characteristics we value

  • Strong technical judgement and curiosity.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes.
  • Pragmatism when balancing technical quality, delivery needs and operational risk.
  • An ability to make complex technical concepts understandable.
  • Confidence challenging technical approaches constructively.
  • An instinct for enabling and mentoring engineers rather than becoming the person through whom every technical decision must pass.
  • An appreciation for simplicity, reliability and long-term technical sustainability.
  • A collaborative approach to working across Engineering, Product, Data and business teams.
  • Calm and clear technical leadership during incidents and periods of change.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn.
  • An interest in how technology and data can enable better customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

 

What’s in it for you? Our benefits

  • Annual bonus scheme
  • 25 days paid leave
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Enhanced Parental Leave policy
  • Food Allowance
  • Multisport Card
  • Both in house and external training programs
  • Your own training dedicated budget (for conferences, courses etc.)

 

Accessibility

We are a disability confident employer and Valuable 500 signatory.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments/personalisation as part of the application process or to enable you to attend an interview. If you would like to discuss your requirements or have any questions, please contact the FT Talent team via email talent@ft.com and a member of our team will be happy to help.

job.title: Accountant / Senior Accountant
job.description:
Accountant / Senior Accountant  

Overview of the Firm   

FGS Global helps the world's most influential leaders move minds and markets. Working where business, government, and public opinion intersect, we advise CEOs, boards, and leadership teams at the most consequential moments.  

We work as one team across geographies and disciplines - bringing together specialists with backgrounds in communications, finance, law, government, journalism, data science, and digital. Whatever the moment demands, we combine multidimensional perspectives to help leaders anticipate what's next, engage the stakeholders who matter, and drive meaningful outcomes. 

Across 31 global offices, we draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust. This collaborative approach has established FGS as a market leader: we are consistently ranked Band 1 for Crisis & Risk Management and Litigation Support by Chambers and Partners, and were ranked the #1 Global M&A PR firm by deal value and deal count for four consecutive years (Mergermarket, 2025). 

 

The Role  

We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Accountant to join our Asia finance team in Hong Kong. This role supports the day-to-day accounting operations of the firm, with a focus on audit support, tax compliance, and financial reporting across the Hong Kong, Singapore, and China entities. 

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly with internal and external stakeholders, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced professional services environment. Experience with VAT/GST filing across Singapore and China jurisdictions will be highly regarded. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Perform day-to-day accounting activities for the relevant Asia entities, including revenue recognition, balance sheet reconciliations, and other month-end closing duties to ensure accurate and compliant accounting treatment. 
  • Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial and management reports. 
  • Support the statutory audit process by preparing and maintaining accurate financial records and providing necessary documentation to auditors in a timely manner. 
  • Assist with tax filing obligations across Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, including GST/VAT compliance and corporate income tax matters. 
  • Contribute to process improvements to enhance efficiency in the Asia finance function. 
  • Perform ad hoc finance and administrative duties as required. 

 

Desired Skills & Qualities 

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related discipline from a recognised university 
  • A recognised professional accounting qualification, or progress toward one, is preferred. 
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a professional services or multinational environment. Experienced candidates will be considered for Senior Accountant.  
  • Hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced and dynamic working environment 
  • Experience supporting statutory audits and tax filing is preferred; familiarity with Singapore GST and China VAT filing will be highly considered. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with ERP or accounting systems such as NetSuite is a plus. 
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines independently. 
  • Treasury experience is a plus but it is NOT a must 
  • Proactive, with good interpersonal and communication skills. 
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Cantonese is preferred; Mandarin proficiency is an advantage.

job.title: Director, Product, Workflow & Work Management
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

About Data & Technology Solutions:

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster and at scale

Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a Product professional to lead the evolution of Work Management capabilities within WPP Open, WPP's AI-powered platform.

The candidate will have experience building or managing enterprise work management, project management and workflow automation. You will understand how large organizations plan, assign, execute, approve and measure work at scale, and how technology can remove friction from these processes.

Leveraging this expertise, you will closely collaborate with the broader product leadership team to ensure that strategy effectively aligns with and advances our overarching vision across the entire product portfolio and to provide our agencies and their clients with a competitive advantage through the application of data and technology.

This role requires a person who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping shape how work gets done across WPP while ensuring Open can integrate seamlessly into the workflows our clients use.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Work Management capabilities within WPP Open, ensuring alignment with the broader Open platform strategy and business objectives.
  • Partner with Product Leadership to shape a product roadmap, emphasizing value realization through lean and iterative methodologies.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Design, UX to deliver a connected Work Management vision spanning briefing, project execution, approvals, and operational reporting. Set clear objectives with teams and ensure alignment of plans and workstreams to achieve them.
  • Design solutions that connect work across teams and agents, reducing handoffs and improving visibility from brief to outcome.
  • Define product requirements for integrations with leading work management and collaboration platforms, understanding thier roadmaps to implement capabilities in close synchronisation
  • Provide day-to-day vision, direction and motivation to the cross-functional product team, including product management, data analysts, engineers and product enablement.
  • Utilize data to drive product strategies and plans, gathering quantitative and qualitative feedback from users and stakeholders to enhance product adoption and usage continually.
  • Promote best practices of Product Management and Ownership throughout the team, identifying and implementing areas for improvement. Offer guidance and coaching to Product Managers and Product Owners to elevate processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Support development teams through definition of requirements, product reviews, user acceptance testing, and sign-off against requirements and specifications.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by balancing platform priorities with the needs of agencies, operations teams and clients. Keep them up to date with strategic direction and the product roadmap, and communicate new product releases to ensure successful advocacy and adoption.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles.
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise SaaS products, workflow platforms, work management solutions, or operational systems.
  • Understanding of Project and task management, Workflow analysis, transformation and automation, Approval workflows, Agency best practice operations and delivery processes
  • Direct experience with working with work management platforms and understand how these tools are deployed and integrated within agencies, enterprises, and client organizations.
  • Proficiency in leading and implementing agile development frameworks for delivering technical products, coupled with experience collaborating with cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering products that integrate with third-party enterprise systems. Understanding of APIs, system integrations, workflow orchestration and data interoperability.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients that require integration with proprietary or client-specific systems.
  • Familiar with AI-enabled workflow automation and agentic systems.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

  • Replace ageing and increasingly constrained consolidation technology
  • Standardise and simplify group finance processes, data and controls

The Head of Programme is accountable for the overall success of the EPM Transformation Programme, replacing WPP’s legacy BFC platform and delivering a modern enterprise performance management capability for group consolidation, planning, forecasting and management reporting.   • Change & Adoption: Ensure finance process readiness, data migration, training, deployment and adoption across a complex global organisation.

job.title: Helpdesk Support
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The IT Helpdesk role provides Level 1/2 end-user on-site and remote support to agency end users in a predominantly Mac OS environment in the country. This includes end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site. This role provides audio-visual support as needed for high-visibility meetings on-site, as well as advanced smart-hands support as needed to support other Omnicom IT centralized services. The role requires flexibility and adaptability to supporting multiple agencies in the region and supporting “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom support as needed.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device , and audio-visual support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides executive and VVIP support and audio visual (AV) support.
  • Provide quality assurance over any 3rd party IT services provided on-site.
  • Facilitate and coordinate site-specific activities (e.g., office moves, weekend power downs) as needed.
  • Support “ad-hoc” agency IT support as needed and directed by the IT Support Manager.
  • Works directly with internal and external 3rd party resources to ensure that end-user issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Manage the end-user experience delivered to agency end-users on-site and remote in the region.
  • Provide Level 1/2 end-user on-site support to agency end users, including troubleshooting, resolving, and documenting issues with desktop, laptop, mobile device, printer, and peripheral hardware and software.
  • Maintain rapport with agency end-users and be a go-to resource for IT troubleshooting.
  • Provide end-user support to VVIP and other senior executives on-site, including setting up, configuring, and testing devices, applications, and network connectivity.
  • Engage IT Support Manager(s) as needed to identify systemic issues with end-user support.
  • Maintain asset inventory and track IT hardware in the region.
  • Follow Omnicom IT policies, procedures, and standards for end-user support and service delivery. And report any violations of Omnicom security policies to management.
  • Provide attended meeting support for high-visibility internal and external meetings.
  • Provide “ad-hoc” or otherwise custom IT support to agencies, while also documenting the support requirements for review as a consolidation opportunity for Omnicom IT centralized services.
  • Provide advanced smart-hands support on-site, supporting other Omnicom IT centralized services that may not have an on-site presence.
  • Support cross-functional IT processes such as onboarding, offboarding, device replacement, incident resolution and request fulfillment.
  • Use ServiceNow ITSM platform to receive and manage incident and request tickets, maintaining proper ticket management protocols such as detailed comments and close notes.
  • Manage assigned tickets to complete within service level criteria.
  • Participate / provide after-hours support and flexibility to travel as needed.

Individual must also maintain an extreme level of confidentiality in dealing with all information that flows through the office.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of IT end-user support experience desktop, mobile device, and audio-visual support.
  • Strong technical knowledge and skills in Mac OS
  • In-depth knowledge of end-user platforms and services, including but not limited to, MacOS, Office365, Windows OS, Active Directory, etc., current desktop and mobile computing technology, core media business applications and their operation.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Must possess a “can-do” attitude and be ready to roll up their sleeves to get the job done.
  • Ability to function within a group and support other team members to resolve problems.
  • Ability to quickly analyze problems, interpret operational needs, and resolve or escalate problems in a timely manner as well as ability to provide real time support for end-user issues.
  • Ability to work calmly under high pressure situations.
  • Ability to maintain good rapport with agencies being supported.
  • Ability to communicate with executives and their staff.
  • Ability to prioritize and work on multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to train others in the use and support of Omnicom business systems.
  • Understanding of ITIL principles is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Jamf platform is preferred.
  • Knowledge of advertising and media businesses is highly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, Apple, or Cisco are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience, is preferred.

job.title: Control Room Technician - Global News Toronto
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Control Room Technician - Global News Toronto

Work Status: Part-Time

Location: Barber Greene - Toronto, ON (Onsite)

About the Role:

We're looking for a Part-Time Control Room Technician to join the team at Global News Toronto.

Reporting to the Manager, Broadcast Operations, you will play a key role in the technical execution of live and recorded broadcasts,

ensuring the seamless delivery of high-quality news and programming.

In this role, you'll support a fast-paced control room environment by operating, monitoring, and maintaining advanced broadcast and studio systems.

The ideal candidate has strong technical expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the flexibility to work a variety of shifts, including early mornings, evenings, late nights, and weekends.

You will contribute by:

• Assist in the operation of MOSART, the automated control room application.

• Operation of Maestro and ORAD virtual set control.

• Operation of Telemetric robotic cameras in virtual and real environments.

• Technical initialization and facilities check of all robotic cameras, audio boards, studio lighting, teleprompter, closed captioning and other control room and studio equipment.

• Quality control checks of all programming being played out from server.

• Remote coordination of live events.

• Ability to work a variety of shifts including late nights, early mornings and weekends.

• Other duties as assigned.

Skills and experience you bring:

• Minimum 3 years of network control room or related experience.

• Degree or diploma in Broadcast Technology from a recognized post-secondary institution.

• Comprehensive knowledge around any or all the following newsroom management systems including Mosart, ENPS, Open Media, Grass Valley, XPression and ORAD.

• Strong technical knowledge around switchers, audio and lighting boards, robotic cameras, graphics systems.

• Self-starter who takes initiative to improve workflows and production quality.

• Ability to work in a team environment, be a clear communicator and meet deadlines.

• Ability to calmly handle the demands and pressure of multiple online and broadcast deadlines in a high-tech environment.

• Excel at multitasking.

• Dexterity to adapt in a rapidly changing media and technology landscape.

• A positive, “Make It Happen” attitude.

job.title: Senior Producer & On Air Contributor
job.description:
Senior Producer & On Air Contributor

#26-1337

Chicago, Illinois, United States

Apply

Business Unit

WTMX-FM

Employee Classification

Full Time Regular

About Us

At Hubbard Radio Chicago we look for the best people to build dominant brands that connect consumers and advertisers to build better businesses and communities. We succeed by always doing the right thing with focus, urgency, and passion. Our company culture builds connections, careers, and employee growth. How? By creating a workplace that values autonomy and transparency. If that sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

312 Sports is Chicago’s sports podcast network and part of Gamut, the podcast network of Hubbard | Media That Connects. It’s home to some of the most recognizable voices in Chicago sports. Gamut produces 250+ shows across sports, news, entertainment and true crime.

312 Sports is hiring a Senior Producer to run day-to-day production and editorial for a slate of sports podcasts. You’ll shape the creative direction, run post-production, and share final editorial calls with the hosts on the audio and video versions of the shows. You’ll also contribute on-air. Production is the core of the job, and on-air work is a real part of it too.

Job Responsibilities

Production (Primary)

Lead production and own the editorial direction of multiple sports podcasts.

Make final post-production calls, in partnership with the hosts, on audio and video cuts.

Produce content for our various social media channels.

Shape each show’s segment structure, tone, pacing, and overall creative format.

Develop and maintain the editorial calendar with the show hosts, marketing, and content leadership.

Track the news cycle and pitch timely episode topics.

Identify, vet, and book guests who make the show better and bring new listeners with them.

Coach and develop guest contributors and secondary voices to fit each show’s tone and format.

Work with Sales, Marketing, and Ad Ops to promote the shows and execute sponsor integrations.

Work with analytics and audience development to track show performance and use the data to shape content.

On-Air Contributor

Contribute on-air, bringing a sharp, engaging presence on audio and video.

Represent 312 Sports with professionalism and creativity across all channels.

Cover key games and breaking stories as needed, including nights and weekends.

Qualifications

3–5 years of experience in podcast, radio, or television production, with proven editorial leadership.

Demonstrated ability to lead the creative process from concept through publication, especially in high-volume environments.

Proven track record of managing production schedules, deadlines, and editorial priorities independently.

Strong command of audio and video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Audition, Premiere, or similar).

Excellent news judgment and a strong grasp of local and national sports, particularly Chicago teams.

Exceptional writing and editing skills with a sharp, witty voice that fits an unfiltered, personality-driven brand.

Comfortable using analytics and audience data to make content decisions.

Hosting experience and confidence in front of the camera and microphone.

Comfortable working flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as the sports calendar demands.

A collaborative, proactive mindset and willingness to jump in wherever needed.

Physical requirements:

Sits or stands for extended periods. Manual dexterity to operate computer keys and other controls and equipment. Good vision and hearing to discern video and sound across platforms. Ability to communicate in English verbally and in writing, and to think creatively and tactically. The Company will make reasonable physical accommodations to facilitate performing essential job functions.

Compensation and Benefits

When extending an offer, the company considers a variety of factors such as (but not limited to) the candidate's work experience, education/training & key skills as well as internal peer equity and other market and business considerations.

The salary for this position is $50,000.

For information regarding our benefits, please copy the link below and paste in your browser: https://hubbardbroadcasting.com/our-company/working-here/

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability/vets.

Diversity Statement

Hubbard Broadcasting has been committed to representing the communities we serve since our founding over 100 years ago. The same holds true today. We know the best way to accomplish this is by recruiting and retaining top talent from diverse cultures, life experiences, and world views. With dignity and respect, we value YOU and everything that makes YOU uniquely YOU.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Phoenix, AZ: 4686 E. Van Buren Street, Suite 400, 85008

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.


The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.


Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.


Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Click Here to learn about the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance .


Our organization participates in E-Verify.  Click here to learn about E-Verify.

job.title: Broadcast Technician - Relocation to Huntsville, ON
job.description:
Reporting to the Director of Technical Operations, the Broadcast Technician is responsible for maintaining Vista Radio’s cluster of stations across our Ontario markets, ensuring reliable broadcast operations and supporting all technical processes related to transmission, studio systems, and content delivery.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Huntsville, Ontario. Interested candidates must be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided.

About the Role

The Broadcast Technician plays a critical role in keeping our stations on-air and operating at peak performance. This position supports transmitter sites, studio environments, automation systems, and network infrastructure, while ensuring compliance, uptime, and operational excellence across the cluster.

Responsibilities

Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of FM/AM broadcast transmitter systems

Diagnose RF and transmission system issues using strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; assess equipment health onsite and remotely, determine repair options, dismantle components for off-site repair, and complete replacements and installations as required

Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of radio studio equipment including computers, AXIA IP audio consoles, nodes, processors, analog consoles, mixers, microphones, amplifiers, speakers, and STL systems

Troubleshoot mixed digital and analog broadcast environments

Installation, maintenance, and ongoing troubleshooting of broadcast computers and hardware supporting ENCO Radio automation systems, servers, regulatory audio loggers, IP online streams, and audio distribution systems

Maintain building infrastructure, documentation, and inspection reports; identify current or potential issues and implement preventative maintenance measures to improve uptime

Proactively monitor critical equipment and make necessary adjustments to ensure broadcast continuity and content delivery

Troubleshoot, maintain, and repair radio automation systems and related networks, routers, switches, and wireless access points

Provide remote and hands-on technical support to station staff, including support for remote broadcasts

Liaise with management to address facility issues including HVAC, power outages, generators, internet and phone outages, working toward timely restoration

Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical records and generate reports with findings and recommendations; liaise with community contractors to obtain project costing aligned with departmental budgets

Travel to transmitter sites throughout the province for maintenance, testing, and site upkeep, including vegetation removal near towers and building entrances

Participate in after-hours and on-call rotations as required; respond to emergency and off-air situations. Travel may be required

Qualifications

Minimum three (3) years of recent and direct radio engineering experience in a Broadcast Technician role

Graduate of an electronics technician or technologist program preferred

Strong technical aptitude and hands-on troubleshooting skills

Self-motivated, reliable, and safety-conscious

Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to prioritize effectively in response to changing needs or critical off-air emergencies

Demonstrated interest in staying current with industry trends and technical standards

Positive attitude with a strong customer service mindset

Demonstrates Vista Radio’s core values: Integrity, Respect, Compassion, Responsibility, and Excellence

Ability and willingness to work in all climates

Valid driver’s license with a clean driving abstract

Proficiency in written and spoken English

Working Conditions

Permanent, full-time position based in Huntsville, Ontario

Relocation required for candidates not currently residing in the area; relocation assistance will be provided

After-hours and on-call work required

Travel within Ontario required

job.description:

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX 10 is searching for a versatile, personable, high-energy Streaming Host/Producer to drive coverage across all FOX 10 live stream platforms.

In this dynamic, nights-and-weekends role, you will host unscripted live coverage of breaking news events in real time, engage with digital audiences through chat and produce VOD content to inform our audience about topics that matter most. We are looking for a journalist who thrives in the fast pace of breaking news, doesn't need to rely on a teleprompter, and knows exactly how to connect with digital viewers on a personal, human level through a conversational approach. If you love unscripted reporting and are ready to redefine how local news is shared, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do

  • Own the Stream: Serve as the face and voice of our night and weekend stream. You will balance real-time coverage of events as they unfold with updates and insights on the day’s biggest topics.

  • Keep It Conversational: Ditch the script! Talk with our audience, not at them. You will drive digital engagement during both daily news blocks and breaking, unscripted events.

  • Master the Tech: We will train you to operate a Tricaster, empowering you to independently produce, direct, and anchor your very own streaming broadcasts.

  • Be a Team Player: Seamlessly transition between hosting your own live coverage and jumping in to support your talented teammates behind the camera in a producing role, when needs arise.

What You'll Need

  • News Junkie Mentality: A strong knowledge of current events, topics making headlines and stories that matter to our audience.

  • Confidence: Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently, on camera and off, in a fast-paced breaking news environment.

  • Sharp Instincts: Excellent editorial judgment, strong research skills, and a meticulous attention to detail.

  • Digital Fluency: Basic experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies. Familiarity with a Tricaster is a huge plus, but a willingness and ability to learn new technology quickly is a must.

  • Strategic Mindset: Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and always think several steps ahead.

  • Agility: The ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops in real time.

  • Collaboration: Strong communication skills and a team-first attitude.

  • Flexibility: Weekends, holidays, and varied hours required.

  • Growth Mindset: You see challenges as opportunities, not obstacles. You want to work with a team of like-minded journalists who want to set the bar in the ever-evolving streaming space.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience & Education

  • Professional Background: Minimum of 2 years of experience as a streaming producer, Multimedia Journalist (MMJ), or Reporter.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, or a related field is preferred.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • On-Camera Presence: Excellent unscripted delivery and communication skills are required.

  • Writing Mastery: Flawless writing and copy-editing skills, with high proficiency in English grammar and a conversational broadcast style.

  • Tech-Savvy: Proficiency with video production technology, including non-linear editing (such as Adobe Premiere Pro) and video switching tools.

  • Judgment: Exceptional news and editorial judgment backed by a deep commitment to ethical integrity.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KCPQ Fox 13 is seeking a per-diem Transmitter Engineer to support our primary broadcast transmitter facilities at Capitol Hill in Seattle, and Gold Mountain near Bremerton.


This role requires extensive experience in television transmitter site operations and maintenance.


Key Responsibilities


Transmitter Operations (Capitol and Gold Mtn sites)

· Primary Sites Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/air and liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

· Transmitter testing, failover testing, transport signal path monitoring, local MPEG encoder operation and baseband signal flow testing. Ability to work during high-profile events such as Sunday football games, The World Series, and other events.

· Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

· Emergency Restoration: Respond to transmitter outages, which includes driving up to the Gold Mountain site in various weather conditions to keep the station on the air.

· Compliance: Ensure the transmitter site complies with FCC standards.

· Experience: 2–3 years of experience in electronics repair, studio AV setup, IT/networking, or military technical roles. (A technical degree or equivalent training is highly valued).

· Technical Aptitude: A solid grasp of signal flow, electrical safety, and how to use basic tools (such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and hand tools).

· IT Knowledge: Basic IT/networking skills (IP addresses, subnets, switches, PC’s ).

· Driving & Logistics: Must have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the confidence to drive mountain roads in rain, fog, or light winter conditions.

· Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, and work comfortably behind equipment racks.

· Availability: Ability to work a flexible schedule, including being on-call for emergency transmitter or critical studio outages during off-hours.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
WCVB-TV is building a team of journalists dedicated to growing and diversifying the station's digital storytelling — original video and multiplatform content that lives across WCVB's digital platforms (web, app, YouTube, social, streaming) and within Chronicle and News broadcasts. We are seeking candidates for two off-camera positions. 

One position is based in the News department and is focused on fast-turn digital publishing, breaking news video, and enterprise/investigative reporting that extends NewsCenter 5's original journalism. The second position is based in Chronicle and is focused on field-produced, Chronicle-style long-form storytelling built for digital-first release in addition to broadcast use. 

What You'll Do

Field Production & Storytelling

  • Produce original video stories from pitch to final edit, largely working independently in the field

  • Bring either a Chronicle-style sensibility (tone, pacing, visual craft) or a news-enterprise sensibility (depth, context, follow-up reporting) to assigned stories, depending on the context
  • Ability to travel throughout New England — occasionally outside the region — is required
  • In-person attendance is required

Digital-First Publishing

  • Produce and edit short-form and long-form video optimized for digital platforms, including web, app, YouTube, and social
  • Turn content on a fast timeline — including breaking news — without sacrificing production quality
  • Package stories with strong titling, structure, and visual hooks suited to each platform
  • Adapt Chronicle and newsroom material for streaming, social, and other digital-first formats

Enterprise & Long-Form Storytelling

  • Develop digital-first stories that go beyond the day's headlines — true crime, investigative, lifestyle, archival, and multi-part features
  • Identify opportunities to advance a story or archival footage beyond its initial reporting
  • Identify opportunities to expand a single story into a series, or structure stories with future broadcast compilation in mind

Audience & Growth

  • Track platform trends and audience behavior, and identify stories with strong shareability
  • Experiment with emerging formats and growth strategies, evaluate results, and share what works with the team
  • Contribute to analytics-informed content planning, including for weekends and streaming events
  • Collaborate closely with digital, newsroom, and Chronicle teams to maximize reach

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in video production, TV news, digital media, and/or documentary-style storytelling
  • Strong mastery of the Adobe editing suite
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in the field, from pitch through final edit
  • Comfort balancing speed with production quality in a high-volume environment

Preferred / Bonus Skills

  • Experience producing serialized, episodic, or multi-part digital content

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent production of high-quality, platform-optimized video
  • Effective repurposing and extension of newsroom and Chronicle material
  • Energetic, inspirational collaboration across editorial, digital, and production teams

Salary

job.title: Part-Time Storm Chaser
job.description:
Part-Time Storm Chaser (Field Weather Coverage)

KOCO-TV is looking for a part-time Storm Chaser to join one of our many two-person severe weather chase teams. This is high-pressure, real-time work supporting on-air meteorologists during rapidly changing conditions. One team member drives. The other monitors radar, data, and communications. Precision, calm judgment, and ethical decision-making are non-negotiable. This role reports to the News Director. Applicants must reside in Oklahoma.

Role Overview
Storm Chasers provide critical, ground-level reports during severe weather events. This position may serve as either the driver or the radar/data operator, depending on assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a vehicle or monitor radar, weather data, and communications from the passenger seat during severe weather.
  • Capture live and recorded video using station-authorized equipment for on-air and digital platforms.
  • Report live on-air observations when directed.
  • Relay accurate, timely storm details to station meteorologists, including severity, movement, and real-time conditions from the field.
  • Monitor weather conditions before and during deployments to anticipate storm development.
  • Adhere strictly to journalistic ethics, safety protocols, and station policies at all times.

Work Schedule

  • No fixed schedule. Hours are dictated by weather conditions.
  • Availability required on short notice when severe weather is forecast.
  • Assignments are made at the direction of station meteorologists or news management.
  • In-person attendance is required.

Important Note
This is not a casual field position. Severe weather coverage is intense, unpredictable, and safety critical. Teamwork, judgment, and professionalism are essential.

Required Qualifications

  • Clean driving record (required for all team members).
  • Strong situational awareness and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Understanding of and commitment to journalistic ethics and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow direction precisely and communicate clearly in fast-moving situations.
  • Willingness to work in all weather conditions.

We need a hands-on anchor/reporter who is ready to lead by example. You must be a team player and community minded.

 

Leadership is a must! As the Weekend Anchor, you’ll be expected to lead by example and work with managers to develop an impactful weekend coverage plan across all platforms, while leading and motivating the weekend team. You will produce and anchor newscasts, write stories and approve scripts. You will serve as an MMJ Reporter and fill-in anchor during the week.

 

The Weekend Anchor must maintain an on-air persona that is friendly, energetic and authoritative, exhibit urgency every day, particularly during breaking news, and have a high-level of engagement on all social media platforms.

  

Applicants should have at least two years of professional on-air anchoring experience and/or professional reporting experience. Producing experience is preferred.

 

Overall, we’re looking for an experienced, hard-working journalist with a positive attitude and a team-oriented, leadership nature who can connect with viewers and tell impactful stories across Northwest Arkansas. 

 

 

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Many high-end business industries call NWA home, and they bring in some of the best talent in their fields. Cost of living is low, and quality of life is high. Add in our world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events, and Northwest Arkansas can’t be beat!

 

In fact, U.S. News ranks Fayetteville seventh best place to live in the country!  http://realestate.usnews.com/places/arkansas/fayetteville

  

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent, and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty.

 

Whether you’re looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes. 

 

*Must include a link to online reel when applying in order to be considered.

  • Present news stories and other content for all platforms.
  • Ensure all news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily.
  • Evaluate news leads and tips to develop story ideas.
  • Build a network of sources who supply information that allows the Station to stay ahead of its competitors.
  • Write and deliver news stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms
  • Communicate clearly and respectfully with management and team members.
  • Assist in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating news programming and other content.
  • Coach and mentor young talent.
  • Act as a field reporter as assigned, including live shots.

  • Participate in promotional activities including public appearances and community volunteer opportunities.

  • Produce newscasts.
  • Interact with viewers/users on social media sites.
  • Promote teamwork and maintain attitude of cooperation with all station personnel.

The QC team does not creatively direct licensees on the concept, direction or design of their product, but may offer recommendations for how to resolve a design that is in conflict with the guidelines.

  • Learn the Quality Control review system.

  • Clearly communicate and changes needed on products.
  • Communicate consistently and effectively with the rest of the Quality Control team

  • Be well versed in trademark compliance.
  • Establish and foster external relationships with licensees and each of the 32 clubs.
  • Manage internal relationships with other departments including Consumer Products,
    Sponsorship and Legal.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field
  • A minimum of 2 years of professional work experience in quality control 
  • An understanding of sports apparel and product
  • Experience participating in line reviews
  • Experience in product approval and quality control review

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • An understanding of the NFL brand
  • Exhibits the ability to distinguish color
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Understanding of AI & emerging technology
  • Must be well organized and punctual

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Reviewing physical product, which includes handling large boxes.
  • Travel required 5-10% of the time.

Salary $65,000—$80,000 USD

job.title: VP, Treasury & Risk
job.description:
The Vice President, Treasury & Risk will be a key leader within the NFL Finance organization, responsible for leading enterprise risk management, treasury, insurance, and internal audit functions. This role will strengthen the League’s governance, risk management, and control environment while providing strategic oversight of liquidity, cash forecasting, banking administration, and financial risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Internal Audit and Treasury professionals and manage external/co-sourced service providers as needed
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on risk, controls, governance, liquidity, insurance, and financial stewardship
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the League’s enterprise risk management framework, including enterprise-wide risk assessments, risk monitoring, mitigation planning, and reporting
  • Prepare clear and timely enterprise risk and emerging risk reporting for senior leadership and the Audit Committee
  • Oversee daily cash positioning activities, including liquidity management and cash position optimization
  • Develop short- and long-term cash flow forecasts to support liquidity planning, strategic business decisions, and investments
  • Develop a structure to work cross functionally to optimize working capital
  • Oversee banking administration, banking relationships, investments, and other treasury operations
  • Invest excess cash within approved cash investment guidelines to optimize interest income while preserving liquidity and principal
  • Design, analyze, monitor, and hedge exposures to foreign exchange and interest rate risk
  • Oversee and evaluate insurance programs to help ensure appropriate coverage, administration, and compliance

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field
  • 15+ years of experience across treasury, enterprise risk management, accounting, or finance, including significant leadership responsibility
  • Management experience and proven success leading and developing teams
  • Proven success building functions and creating or improving processes, policies, controls, and reporting
  • Strong executive presence, judgment, communication skills, and ability to influence across a complex organization

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • CPA, CIA, CTP, CRMA, CISA, or other relevant professional certification
  • Experience using data analytics, automation, and continuous monitoring within treasury, risk, or internal audit
  • Experience managing co-sourced internal audit or other third-party professional service relationships

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in the office.

job.title: Director of Engineering, WTXL
job.description:
WTXL, the ABC affiliate in Tallahassee, Florida, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is searching for its next Director of Engineering. This is your opportunity to lead the technology that keeps a local television station connected, innovative, and ready to serve its community every day. You’ll guide the station’s technical operations, lead engineering initiatives, and collaborate across teams to keep critical systems performing at their best. Bring your technical expertise, leadership, and problem-solving mindset to a role where what you do behind the scenes makes an impact on everything we deliver to our audiences.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Model and lead a culture of empathy, customer service and leadership.
  • Lead the research, design, installation and repair of all television, digital, OTT, Internet Systems, high power RF systems, production environments and all associated equipment using current platforms and protocols. 
  • Manage building facilities and grounds, including HVAC, power generation and security systems.
  • Partner with the news department to develop, build and support content workflow and support systems including integration and problem-solving software, hardware, networking and infrastructure while facilitating a collaborative environment between newsroom and production control staff.
  • Motivate and manage a staff of professional and technical engineers, operators and IT technicians. Develop and grow staff in technology and Scripps culture to meet the on-going and future technological needs of the station and evaluate staff growth opportunities and assessments.
  • Establish and implement engineering policies and procedures.
  • Evaluate and maintain the spectrum and broadband usage of the facility.
  • Manage projects.
  • Plan, design and document current and future broadcast and digital systems.
  • Collaborate with other departments to determine current and future studio and transmission and workflow needs.
  • Prepare and track capital, expense, repair and maintenance budgets.
  • Use company purchasing management system to purchase and track assets and services as well as replacement cycles.
  • Evaluate equipment solutions.
  • Keep the station compliant with the FCC Rules and Regulations, as well as related local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 10+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred
  • Network, SBE and/or Project Management certification preferred

WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • “Customer service first” mindset, ability to deliver a high level of customer service
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strategic planning abilities
  • Excellent managerial skills in working with management, users, staff, peers and vendors
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to relate technical matters to non-technical users
  • Ability to relate business matters to technical staff
  • Team player
  • Self-directed and can work independently
  • Strong project management skills
  • Can manage shifting priorities, demands and timelines smoothly
  • Knowledge of FCC rules
  • Understanding of electronic, electrical, mechanical and information systems
  • Keen interest in emerging broadcast related technologies and how they might be utilized in our business environment
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits
