job.title: Assistant News Director, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for an experienced and collaborative Assistant News Director to help lead one of the market's most trusted news operations. Working alongside the News Director, you will help oversee all news broadcasts and online content — shaping editorial direction, driving cross-platform audience strategies, and developing the talented team that keeps Cleveland informed. From planning landmark coverage of elections and major local events to managing the budgetary and operational heartbeat of the newsroom, your leadership will have a real and lasting impact. If you're a seasoned news leader who thrives under pressure and is passionate about delivering journalism that matters, WEWS wants to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Assist news director with supervisory responsibility for all news broadcasts and online content.
  • Involved in hiring and performance management of direct reports.
  • Assist news director in the on-going evaluation of personnel.
  • Create tactics and strategies to increase demos performance in key target areas for multiple platforms.
  • Implement and have working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Ability to manage cross platform content creation and distribution.
  • Write copy and edit scripts for air and web.
  • Knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Schedule anchors and multi-media journalists.
  • Lead coverage planning of major events, i. e. elections, special events.
  • Proactively communicate news initiatives across departments.
  • Evaluate workflow efficiencies.
  • Assist news director in managing the budgetary aspects of newsroom operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Advanced oral and written communication skills
  • Advanced computer skills including Microsoft Office
  • Broad understanding of newsroom operations and equipment
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast paced environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, sitting on the southern shore of Lake Erie with a rich cultural heritage and a passionate, proud community. Home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, the Cleveland Museum of Art, and the world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra at Severance Music Center, the city offers an exceptional arts and culture scene. The vibrant neighborhoods of Ohio City, Tremont, and Little Italy are filled with acclaimed restaurants, craft breweries, and independent boutiques that give Cleveland its distinctive, welcoming character.


Sports are woven into the fabric of life here. Cheer on the Cleveland Guardians at Progressive Field, rally behind the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, or soak in the electric atmosphere of a Cleveland Browns game at Huntington Bank Field. Cleveland's passionate fan base and storied sports history make it one of the most spirited towns in the country.


Beyond downtown, Greater Cleveland delivers outstanding outdoor recreation along the shores of Lake Erie, with stunning Metroparks, world-class kayaking, and easy access to Cuyahoga Valley National Park — Ohio's only national park. With a cost of living well below most major markets, a booming food-and-drink scene, and a community that is warm and genuine, Cleveland is a place where your career and your life outside of work will both truly thrive.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WEWS
job.description:
WEWS News 5, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC station in Cleveland, Ohio, is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our award-winning newsroom. This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking a journalist who can separate us from the competition through exceptional source-building, enterprise reporting, and compelling storytelling. We want someone who knows how to uncover stories that no one else has and deliver them in a way that informs, engages, and serves our community.


Cleveland is a resilient and passionate city with a rich history, diverse neighborhoods, and a strong sense of pride. From the shores of Lake Erie and the vibrant downtown district to world-class healthcare, arts, sports, and cultural institutions, Northeast Ohio offers endless opportunities to tell meaningful stories that impact viewers' lives. WEWS News 5 has a long-standing reputation for trusted journalism, investigative reporting, innovation, and community engagement. Our newsroom is committed to helping journalists grow, develop their skills, and make a difference in the communities they serve. If you're ready to tell stories that matter and be part of a team dedicated to impactful journalism, apply today.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and tips to develop original story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine story emphasis, and write content according to editorial standards and AP style.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, video for television, digital, social, and streaming platforms.
  • Appear on television programs while conducting interviews or providing narration.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news and community events.
  • Work collaboratively with photographers and other newsroom staff when assigned.
  • Assist producers in preparing newscasts and coverage plans.
  • Partner with digital teams to create compelling multimedia content for all platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of professional reporting experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with company-required limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong journalism skills, including enterprise reporting, source development, and storytelling
  • Proven ability to develop exclusive stories through relationship-building, public records research, and enterprise reporting that delivers meaningful impact for local communities
  • Computer literacy, including experience with newsroom content management systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment
  • Ability to edit video using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere, or similar editing systems
  • Strong broadcast writing and AP style skills
  • Experience publishing content across digital, social, and streaming platforms
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, ethical journalism
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Cleveland, Ohio is a city on the rise, blending Midwest charm with big-city energy. Situated on the shores of Lake Erie, Cleveland offers stunning waterfront views, vibrant neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. The city is home to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, world-renowned Cleveland Orchestra, Cleveland Museum of Art, and championship sports teams including the Guardians, Browns, and Cavaliers. Food lovers will appreciate the city's diverse culinary landscape, from historic West Side Market to innovative farm-to-table restaurants and craft breweries.


Cleveland's affordable cost of living, strong sense of community, and access to outdoor recreation—including Metro Parks, lakefront trails, and nearby Cuyahoga Valley National Park—make it an ideal place to build both your career and your life. With a revitalized downtown, diverse neighborhoods like Tremont, Ohio City, and Little Italy, and a growing tech and healthcare sector, Cleveland offers the perfect balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

The base salary compensation for this role is $42,000. This position is also eligible to earn uncapped commissions of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of ‘earned." Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 56 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
SOBRE EL PUESTO Y EL EQUIPO

En TelevisaUnivision, somos la empresa líder mundial de medios de comunicación en español,

llegando a millones de consumidores a través de plataformas digitales, streaming, redes

sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos expandiendo

nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, estamos realizando importantes inversiones en

tecnología, datos e innovación para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a nuestros suscriptores e

impulsar el crecimiento sostenible del negocio a largo plazo.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Datos (Data Engineering) diseña, desarrolla y opera pipelines de

datos de gran volumen y alta velocidad que impulsan ViX. Estos incluyen eventos de

reproducción e interacción de usuarios, datos de suscripciones, información publicitaria y el

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse), que permite transformar esta información en

decisiones de negocio. El equipo colabora estrechamente con las áreas de Ingeniería, Producto,

Ciencia de Datos y Analítica de TelevisaUnivision.

El Senior Data Engineer desempeñará un papel clave en el diseño, desarrollo e implementación

de nuestra plataforma de datos para streaming. Será responsable de gestionar integralmente

pipelines de datos en producción, desde la ingesta en tiempo real hasta la transformación de

datos estructurados y preparados para su análisis. Asimismo, colaborará con los equipos de

Ciencia de Datos, Analítica y Producto para comprender sus necesidades de información y llevar

las iniciativas hasta su implementación.

El candidato ideal combina sólidos conocimientos técnicos con una mentalidad colaborativa,

pasión por resolver desafíos complejos relacionados con los datos y compromiso con la entrega

de soluciones de alta calidad a gran escala.


SOBRE TI

Eres un profesional de Ingeniería de Datos que se desenvuelve con éxito en entornos dinámicos

y colaborativos, y disfruta transformando datos complejos en información de valor para el

negocio.

Cuentas con:

• Amplia experiencia en plataformas modernas de datos en la nube, especialmente

Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud

Composer.

• Dominio avanzado de Python, SQL y frameworks de transformación de datos como dbt.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos a gran escala, tanto por lotes

(batch) como en tiempo real (streaming).

• Experiencia trabajando con sistemas distribuidos a gran escala y tecnologías de Big Data,

incluyendo Spark y Hadoop.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para diseñar soluciones

escalables y eficientes.

• Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades de manera

efectiva.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración, con capacidad para trabajar con

equipos técnicos y no técnicos.

• Mentalidad de mejora continua y pasión por la mentoría y el intercambio de

conocimientos.


RESPONSABILIDADES DEL DÍA A DÍA

Desarrollo de la plataforma de datos

• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener pipelines de datos por lotes (batch) escalables,

confiables y eficientes utilizando Airflow (Cloud Composer), Python, SQL y dbt.

• Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de ingesta de datos en tiempo real que permitan

transferir datos de eventos desde Pub/Sub hacia Cloud Storage y BigQuery mediante

Dataflow.

• Desarrollar y optimizar modelos dimensionales de datos y flujos de trabajo dentro del

almacén de datos analíticos (data warehouse) para respaldar iniciativas de reportes,

analítica, Machine Learning y Producto.

• Gestionar integralmente los pipelines asignados, desde su diseño y desarrollo hasta las

pruebas, implementación y soporte en producción.

• Garantizar la calidad, integridad, seguridad y disponibilidad de los datos en todo el

ecosistema.

Colaboración multifuncional

• Colaborar con Gerentes de Producto, Científicos de Datos, Analistas y equipos de

Ingeniería para comprender los requerimientos del negocio y traducirlos en soluciones

técnicas.

• Contribuir a las discusiones sobre arquitectura de datos y a la estrategia de largo plazo

de la plataforma.

• Trabajar con las distintas partes interesadas para identificar oportunidades de mejora de

procesos y eficiencia operativa.

Rendimiento y optimización

• Optimizar el almacenamiento, procesamiento y orquestación de datos para mejorar el

rendimiento, la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de costos, incluyendo los costos de consultas

y almacenamiento en BigQuery.

• Monitorear, diagnosticar y resolver problemas relacionados con los pipelines y la

plataforma de datos, así como contribuir a las revisiones de incidentes.

• Implementar mejores prácticas de gobierno de datos, observabilidad, pruebas e

integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

Liderazgo y contribución al equipo

• Brindar mentoría y apoyo a ingenieros de datos junior mediante orientación técnica,

revisiones de código e intercambio de conocimientos.

• Contribuir a las decisiones arquitectónicas y a la definición de mejores prácticas de

ingeniería.

• Participar en entrevistas técnicas y apoyar el desarrollo de un equipo de Ingeniería de

Datos de alto desempeño.


REQUISITOS Y EXPERIENCIA

Experiencia y habilidades requeridas

• Licenciatura o maestría en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería, Sistemas de

Información o un campo técnico relacionado.

• Más de 7 años de experiencia en Ingeniería de Datos, Data Warehousing o entornos de

Big Data.

• Dominio avanzado de Python y SQL.

• Experiencia práctica en el desarrollo y gestión integral de pipelines de datos de nivel

productivo, desde su diseño hasta su operación.

• Amplia experiencia con Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo BigQuery, Cloud

Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow y Cloud Composer. También se considerará experiencia con

AWS.

• Experiencia con herramientas de orquestación de flujos de trabajo y transformación de

datos, como Airflow y dbt.

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de pipelines de datos en tiempo real o casi en tiempo real.

• Sólido conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de almacenamiento de datos (data

warehousing), incluyendo modelado relacional y dimensional.

• Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código (IaC), como Pulumi o

Terraform.

• Sólido conocimiento de frameworks de procesamiento distribuido de datos, incluyendo

Spark.

• Fuertes habilidades analíticas, de diagnóstico y resolución de problemas.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia brindando soporte a flujos de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de

Datos.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de observabilidad de datos, frameworks de calidad de

datos y prácticas de integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD).

• Experiencia trabajando en organizaciones de suscripción, medios de comunicación,

plataformas de streaming o productos digitales.


REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México.

• Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

• Experiencia demostrable brindando mentoría y desarrollando ingenieros de niveles

junior e intermedio.

• Trayectoria comprobada en el diseño y operación de plataformas de datos en tiempo

real y de gran volumen en entornos de producción, por ejemplo, plataformas que

procesan miles de millones de eventos al día.

• Experiencia de nivel experto con GCP: BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow (Apache Beam),

Cloud Composer (Airflow) y Cloud Storage. También se considerará experiencia con AWS.

• Dominio experto de Python y SQL, así como experiencia con dbt en entornos de

producción.

• Conocimiento profundo de conceptos de procesamiento de datos en streaming,

incluyendo tiempo del evento frente al tiempo de procesamiento, ventanas de

procesamiento (windowing), marcas de tiempo (watermarks), entrega exactly-once y

mecanismos de control de presión (backpressure); experiencia con Kafka, Flink o Spark.

• Conocimiento experto en modelado de datos para analítica, incluyendo modelado

dimensional, modelado de eventos y formatos de tablas lakehouse como Apache

Iceberg.

• Amplia experiencia con Infraestructura como Código (Pulumi o Terraform), CI/CD y

pruebas automatizadas para pipelines de datos.

• Experiencia demostrable gestionando la confiabilidad de los datos, incluyendo objetivos

de nivel de servicio (SLO), observabilidad de datos, gestión de incidentes y análisis

posteriores a incidentes.

• Experiencia comprobada en la reducción de costos de plataformas de datos en la nube a

gran escala.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita, verbal y de presentación, incluyendo la

elaboración de documentos de diseño y la comunicación con audiencias técnicas y

ejecutivas.

Requisitos deseables

• Experiencia en empresas de suscripción, plataformas de video en streaming (OTT),

medios de comunicación u organizaciones deportivas, incluyendo datos de calidad de

reproducción, interacción de usuarios y publicidad en plataformas con anuncios (AVOD).

• Experiencia dando soporte a cargas de trabajo de Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos,

incluyendo pipelines de características (feature pipelines), características en tiempo real

y datos para sistemas de recomendación y personalización.

• Experiencia con contratos de datos (data contracts), registros de esquemas (schema

registries) y herramientas de catalogación o trazabilidad de datos (data lineage).


REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

• Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.

• Se verificará la experiencia laboral y académica.

Job Summary: About the Role & Program The ABC News Audience Development team is responsible for creating, distributing, curating, and optimizing ABC News content across digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, major social media platforms, search, video, and other distribution channels. The team plays a critical role in connecting audiences with breaking news and original journalism while identifying opportunities to grow engagement across existing and emerging platforms. As an Audience Development Intern, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of journalism, audience strategy, analytics, and digital storytelling. Working alongside experienced audience development professionals, you will learn how editorial judgment, data insights, and experimentation help drive audience growth and engagement. The ideal candidate is passionate about news and current events, follows digital media trends, and is interested in understanding how audiences discover and consume content across platforms. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the New York, New York area from January 2027 - June 2027 What You Will Do On any given day, you will support audience development initiatives across ABC News digital platforms, including ABCNews.com, mobile apps, search, social media, video, and other distribution channels. You will help curate content experiences across owned platforms, support audience growth strategies, and assist in distributing content to external partners to help maximize visibility during major news events. You will contribute to headline testing efforts, monitor news, search, and social trends, and help identify emerging platforms, formats, and audience behaviors. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen editorial judgment, analytical thinking, collaboration, and digital storytelling skills while gaining exposure to how data and audience insights inform content strategy. job.title: Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist
job.description:
Fox News Media has a great opportunity for a Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist!  As a Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist, you know how to ready a person for their close-up! Your makeup artistry and hairstyling skills guarantee that you can make anyone feel confident in their skin. You will be a member of a team of artists responsible for preparing Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors to appear on national television. The Freelance Makeup Artist and Hairstylist will require a high level of proficiency in makeup artistry and hairstyling for both men and women, as well as the ability to understand and work in the rapidly changing environment of cable news.

**Please note that this position requires the candidate to style Hair AND Makeup.**

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Makeup application in a manner appropriate for television for both men and women; often this must be accomplished very quickly with a high level of skill, especially for women

  • Hairstyling in a manner appropriate for television. This too must be accomplished very quickly and includes a high level of proficiency in the techniques of blow-outs and velcro roller set, as well as using hot irons to accomplish volume and smoothness and a defined hairstyle for women

  • Provide excellent customer service for Fox News anchors, reporters, and contributors who are visiting Fox News by always projecting a friendly, helpful demeanor.

  • Demonstrate the ability to identify and solve problems by proposing solutions.

  • Be a dedicated teammate at all times. Jump in to help others who are readying talent for air. Be a good steward of the hair and makeup room by sharing this responsibility with your colleagues

  • Keep the hair and makeup room and one's personal space clean, tidy, and free of clutter, and identify products that need to be replenished to management so that supplies are well-stocked

  • Understand that the nature of television news requires employees to be able to change their schedule and/or work earlier or later than a planned shift to accommodate the needs of a news bureau responding to breaking news

job.title: Broadcast Production Engineer
job.description:
FOX News is on the hunt for a stellar Broadcast Production Engineer to work in our Washington DC bureau. This role involves providing support and routine compliance for our substantial media and broadcast systems within a competitive, live, 24/7 news environment. As a cornerstone of our Production Engineering team, within the Broadcast and Media Technology group, you'll coordinate with various engineering teams, providing support to IT groups/helpdesk, broadcast production, technical operation personnel, and network operations aggregations.

As our ideal candidate, you are enthused about broadcast engineering/IT and comfortable acclimating to evolving media technologies, concepts, and trends such as Media over IP, Cloud Computing, and Radio Workflows.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support infrastructure for on-air broadcast production systems

  • Oversee studio operations including video walls, video processing systems, and cameras

  • Supervise live control room production systems and subsystems

  • Handle infrastructure systems like routers, intercom, monitoring, KVM, audio suites, and live production-related equipment

  • Provide maintenance and support for off-site remote locations including the White House, Capitol Hill, etc.

  • Address, communicate, manage, and track technical issues in a live 24/7 production environment

  • Perform maintenance of subsystems including software and hardware updates, modifications, and replacements as warranted

  • Develop and retain process benchmarks for deployment and support documentation for operations

  • Collaborate on a team that works hands-on with the latest generation of production systems and technologies

  • Work on complex audio processing tasks and Audio-over-IP setups including gating, compression, equalization of talent microphone audio, and multi-band processing of outbound audio programming using Orban processors

  • Set up up small Dante audio networks

  • 5+ years' experience in broadcast production and live television

  • Extensive knowledge of standards like SMPTE for broadcast television and video environments

  • Strong technical skills in troubleshooting and repairing broadcast equipment

  • Aptitude to troubleshoot traditional SDI and IP audio/video signal routing environments

  • Familiarity with studio technologies including video walls, cameras, VR set technologies, image processing systems, touch screens, and lighting

  • Solid understanding of production control automation (e.g., Ross Overdrive) and Newsroom Computer System (NRCS) workflows

  • Proficiency in MS Windows workstation and server platforms

  • Experience with file-based workflows and knowledge of enterprise Media Asset Management systems (e.g. Dalet)

  • Ability to interpret technical documentation standards 

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of IT/networking theory, topology, and best practices

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks independently and as part of a team.

  • Aptitude to work a flexible schedule based on the needs of a live production environment, including overtime, holidays, weekends

  • Capability to remove, lift, and replace equipment in racks as warranted

job.title: Streaming Host/Producer
job.description:
FOX 10 is searching for a versatile, personable, high-energy Streaming Host/Producer to drive coverage across all FOX 10 live stream platforms.

In this dynamic, nights-and-weekends role, you will host unscripted live coverage of breaking news events in real time, engage with digital audiences through chat and produce VOD content to inform our audience about topics that matter most. We are looking for a journalist who thrives in the fast pace of breaking news, doesn't need to rely on a teleprompter, and knows exactly how to connect with digital viewers on a personal, human level through a conversational approach. FOX is seeking a senior, strategic, and technical Vice President with a strong foundation in Information, Security, Network, and Broadcast Media Technologies. The Vice President, Financial Security Products is the enterprise owner for retirement and financial-well-being products and for benefits-related funding and balance-sheet exposures. This leader connects employee financial security with disciplined oversight of defined-contribution and defined-benefit plans, multiemployer obligations, trusts, actuarial governance and financial reporting.

Here you can:

Product strategy

  • Set the multi-year strategy for retirement savings, retirement readiness, emergency savings, financial coaching and other financial-resilience programs.
  • Design healthcare solutions for one of the most diverse workforces in the world, supporting employees across studios, theme parks, productions, news, sports, corporate functions, and international businesses.
  • Own defined-contribution plan design, employer contributions, investments, recordkeeping, participant communications and outcome measurement.
  • Design targeted approaches for workforce populations with different earnings patterns, tenure, access and financial literacy.

Liability, funding and financial oversight

  • Oversee Taft-Hartley and multiemployer-plan exposure, including contribution obligations, funding developments and potential withdrawal liability.
  • Coordinate international defined-benefit and post-employment obligations with Global Benefits Products, Finance, Treasury, Accounting and local leadership.
  • Lead actuarial valuations, assumption and funding analysis, trust governance and consolidated benefits balance-sheet reporting.

Vendors, governance and outcomes

  • Manage recordkeepers, trustees, investment consultants, actuaries, auditors and financial-well-being vendors through scorecards and QBRs.
  • Track retirement readiness, participation, deferral rates, match utilization, financial resilience, service and investment outcomes.
  • Partner with Governance, Compliance & Fiduciary Affairs, Legal and Labor Relations on fiduciary governance, plan documentation and collectively bargained obligations.

Key Areas of Impact:

  • Advance retirement readiness and financial well-being outcomes for employees.
  • Ensure effective oversight of plan funding, liabilities, and long-term financial sustainability.
  • Maintain strong actuarial, accounting, fiduciary, and trust governance practices.
  • Drive high-quality vendor performance and participant service experiences through strategic management and continuous improvement.

Here you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in the healthcare space, with deep expertise in employer-sponsored healthcare programs. 
  • 5+ years of leadership experience, with demonstrated success leading teams, strategic initiatives and cross-functional partnerships.
  • Deep knowledge of defined-contribution plans and working knowledge of defined-benefit, multiemployer, trust, funding and financial-reporting matters.
  • Demonstrated experience translating actuarial and financial analysis into executive recommendations.
  • Experience managing recordkeepers, actuaries, trustees, investment advisors and other material vendors.
  • Exceptional financial acumen, risk judgment, governance discipline and executive communication skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, actuarial science, business, human resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience and Credentials:

  • Experience with multinational benefit liabilities and collectively bargained populations.
  • Experience with U.S. GAAP benefit accounting, asset-liability analysis or trust governance.
  • MBA, master's degree, actuarial credential, CFA, CEBS or comparable credential.

The Platform Solutions team provides support and builds business solutions for Sales, Planning, Marketing, Research, Account Management, and Finance departments across a national and global ad sales landscape.   • Own product strategy across the lead and prospecting lifecycle, including prospect identification, enrichment, qualification, assignment, engagement, and conversion

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, event monitoring, incident response, and threat hunting across the enterprise in a highly collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment. Cyber Response Operations serves as NBCUniversal’s 24x7 first line of defense against cyber threats. Event Analysts and Incident Responders follow the Incident Response Plan to identify, assess, contain, remediate, and document cyber events and incidents.

The Manager of Cyber Incident Response leads the Incident Response team while guiding and supporting the Event Analyst function. The role oversees escalations involving containment, remediation, forensic analysis, and coordination with impacted businesses and partner teams. This leader establishes the operating rigor needed for consistent performance while enabling responders to exercise sound judgment, creativity, and ownership.

The Manager is accountable for team readiness, workflow prioritization, escalation quality, process maturity, and employee development. The role requires regular engagement with business stakeholders, Information Security Officers, technical teams, vendors, and senior leadership during both routine operations and active incidents.

 

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage Incident Response operations, including prioritization, resource allocation, shift coverage, tooling requirements, workflow management, and escalation processes.
  • Ensure the NBCUniversal Incident Response Plan and supporting procedures are implemented and followed in day-to-day operations.
  • Oversee and manage cyber incidents across the NBCUniversal enterprise, from escalation and validation through containment, remediation, recovery support, and closure.
  • Serve as an Incident Handler or Incident Commander for significant incidents, coordinating response activities with impacted businesses, technical owners, and partner teams.
  • Act as the managerial escalation point for potential cyber incidents, responder support needs, and decisions requiring leadership awareness or approval.
  • Participate in the manager on-call rotation for cyber incident escalation and handling in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Supervise operational performance across shifts, ensuring consistent prioritization, ticket ownership, escalation discipline, and adherence to company standards.
  • Review shift handovers, queue health, and open incidents to ensure continuity, clear accountability, and timely follow-through across operating periods.
  • Maintain and enforce event and incident documentation standards, case-management requirements, key performance indicators, and process adherence.
  • Monitor operational metrics and trends, identify gaps, and implement improvements that strengthen effectiveness, risk reduction, and business impact.
  • Lead the review and governance of response processes, playbooks, tuning requests, automation opportunities, and technical procedures.
  • Drive the maturity, enhancement, and strategy of the Incident Response program in alignment with business and enterprise priorities.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Information Security Officers, business stakeholders, and other security and technology teams.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, including clear ownership, review cycles, approval requirements, and change management.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Incident Response personnel, providing regular feedback and supporting technical, professional, and career growth.
  • Create and deliver monthly metrics and executive reporting that communicate operational effectiveness, risk reduction, material trends, and business impact.
  • Communicate incident status, operational concerns, decisions, and risk clearly to business VIPs and senior leadership.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in an information technology-related field and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Seven or more years of cybersecurity or investigations experience, including at least four years in Incident Response, a Security Operations Center, threat intelligence, or a similar function.
  • Previous experience leading incident response operations, cybersecurity personnel, or complex incident coordination.
  • In-depth understanding of cyber threats, adversary techniques, response procedures, network and enterprise architecture, and threat detection.
  • Demonstrated ability to make evidence-based decisions under uncertainty and coordinate response activities across multiple teams.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-demand role that may require nonstandard working hours.
  • Availability to support employee development and accept escalations arising in a 24x7x365 global environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams, incidents, and escalation paths.
  • Working knowledge of core enterprise technology concepts, including web application architecture, networking, identity, endpoint, email, and cloud services.
  • Experience with host-based and network-based forensic tools and analysis.
  • Knowledge of recognized security and analysis frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Cyber Kill Chain, the Diamond Model, and NIST incident response guidance.
  • Experience applying security concepts in AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Knowledge of incident response technologies and capabilities such as EDR, XDR, SOAR, case management, and response automation.
  • Experience developing or improving incident-management processes, playbooks, metrics, or automation.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief technical professionals, business stakeholders, and senior executives.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt to changing and fast-paced environments.

Desired Characteristics

  • Prior experience managing a Cyber Incident Response, Security Operations Center, or related cyber defense function.
  • Experience supporting incident response or SOC operations for a large, complex, or global enterprise.
  • Hands-on familiarity with endpoint detection and response, forensic, network-analysis, email-security, and cloud-security technologies.
  • Relevant security certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCIA, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated success improving operational discipline, employee development, cross-team coordination, and executive communication.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV and Simon & Schuster, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

Role Details
The Convergent Account Executive owns the full advertising relationship across both linear and streaming for their assigned clients — spanning Broadcast dayparts (Prime, News, Late Night and Daytime), Cable Networks, and the full Streaming/CTV portfolio, including programmatic and direct IO (DIO) channels. This includes regular scheduled programming as well as specials (e.g., The VMAs, Golden Globes, AMAs) and sponsorship/integration opportunities. The Convergent AE is the single point of accountability for delivering unified, cross-platform (“360”) solutions, working in tandem with specialty, programmatic, and AM partners to maximize revenue across the entire Paramount portfolio. This position sets its own sales agenda and is responsible for growing and maintaining a book of business across both linear and streaming properties. 

 

Your Day-to-Day
Account & Revenue Management:

  • Manage a robust account list spanning multiple industries across both linear and streaming platforms
  • Develop and execute account strategies for long-term development and revenue growth across the full portfolio
  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis
  • Generate new sales leads and proactively uncover new linear and streaming sales opportunities
  • Manage a programmatic and direct sales pipeline — including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, and reporting

 

Client Strategy & Consultative Selling:

  • Act as a business specialist and trusted advisor on behalf of clients — strategically developing broadcast, streaming, and mixed-media solutions to suit their objectives
  • Establish and cultivate client relationships through a high volume of face-to-face calls
  • Bring proactive, consultative solutions to clients by leveraging Paramount's full sales product suite and delivering strategic insights through QBRs
  • Serve as the key point of contact internally and externally, prioritizing and leading accurate account management across teams

 

Cross-Platform Collaboration:

  • Collaborate across cable, broadcast, sports, and streaming/programmatic teams to generate revenue and deliver holistic client solutions
  • Collaborate with centers of excellence to develop strategic roadmaps and drive revenue across the full portfolio
  • Work in tandem with digital, programmatic, and specialty counterparts to ensure a seamless 360 client experience

 

Programmatic & Marketplace Expertise:

  • Confidently lead conversations about the programmatic landscape (SSP/DSP marketplaces) and direct 1:1 advertiser/agency strategies
  • Sell CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles across the full streaming ecosystem, leveraging both DIO and programmatic channels
  • Stay ahead of the curve on marketplace trends relating to clients as well as the broader linear and digital advertising industry, actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications
  • Establish oneself as a thought leader across the broadcast and streaming community, evangelizing Paramount's unique cross-platform positioning

 

Leadership & Team Development:

  • Partner with AM Management to mentor AM sales partners, ensuring best-in-class client servicing pre- and post-sale, including deal set-up, deal management, and post-campaign QBRs
  • Collaborate with AM Management to provide assigned AMs with clear day-to-day direction, real-time feedback, and development support to foster team growth, motivation, and performance

 

Qualifications
What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales experience spanning linear and/or streaming/programmatic, with direct experience in programmatic roles at publishers, ad tech firms, or platform companies preferred
  • Sales professional with an entrepreneurial spirit who thrives in a team, goal-oriented environment
  • Strong desire to win and grow as a cross-platform (linear and streaming) ad sales professional
  • Proven capability to sell across the full advertising ecosystem — broadcast, cable, CTV, sponsorships, and tentpoles
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and organizational skills
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate command of the business, offerings, and client needs
  • Ability to manage stress and balance multiple account priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High initiative, problem-solving ability, agility, and a growth mindset
  • Must be extremely detail oriented
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite, G Suite, and Salesforce; ability to learn proprietary systems for revenue / inventory management.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience

 

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

job.title: Electrician II
job.description:
Electrician II

Gannett Publishing Services / USA TODAY CO

Des Moines, IA

Position Details:

Performs advance level electrical maintenance (including preventive), diagnostics and repairs on production equipment and systems in an industrial environment to support efficient production operations as needed.

Serve in a lead role as part of a team to achieve and maintain on-time production performance, product quality and accuracy standards as well as operational safety including OSHA and EPA compliance.

Provide direction on electrical repairs of production equipment and perform electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repairs on specified equipment which may include, but are not limited to:  CTP Imagers, processors, benders; press controls, printing units, reels, dampening & inking systems; inserting equipment, stackers, strappers, labelers, applicators, bindery equipment, conveyors, motors, pumps, dryers and other ancillary equipment.  Potential involvement with the building department infrastructure equipment (HVAC and plumbing).

Monitor all production reporting for maintenance/repair issues. Record entries in repair log (failed equipment) and preventive maintenance log books while looking for trends in machine performance.   Communicate repair/maintenance issues and provide updates of ongoing projects and preventative maintenance programs to supervisor.

Safety:

Always work in a safe manner and consistently utilize required safety equipment to promote top-of-mind safety awareness:

Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Assist in leading safety compliance within the department including accident investigations and follow up.

Complete required annual OSHA safety training programs.

Ensure all machine safety-guards are installed, functioning properly, and in use.

Immediately report any potential safety hazards, operational concerns and all accidents/injuries and near misses to production management.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the essential duties and responsibilities listed above. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Requirements:

High school diploma or GED equivalent

Certified electrical training required (Vocational school, military, trade)

Journeyman level electrical certification required

Experience Required or Preferred

Minimum five years’ experience in electrical maintenance, diagnostics and repair required

Specialized Knowledge Required or Preferred:

Ability to read blueprints and sufficient computer skills required for diagnostic applications.

Ability to use precision instruments and measuring tools.

Ability to read pneumatic and electrical schematics/wiring diagrams. Ability to use testing equipment. Experience with PLC controllers. Experience uploading programs to a CPU and downloading to a laptop.   Experience with synchronous and asynchronous motors.  Understanding of AC frequency drive controllers, instrumentation and measurements.

Proficient verbal and written communication skills

Proven excellent time management skills working in a fast-paced deadline driven environment with a sense of urgency

Strong mechanical aptitude.

May be required to work flexible shifts; including weekend, nighttime and holiday shifts around loud production equipment.  May be on call for emergency services.

Strong communication skills

job.title: Climate Fellow
job.description:
South Florida is ground zero for climate change, where rising seas, record heat and extreme storms are reshaping daily life. The Miami Herald is offering a six-month reporting fellowship focused on the region’s most urgent climate challenges — and the people, ideas and solutions shaping its future.

As our multimedia climate reporter, you’ll drive daily coverage, break news and deliver exclusive enterprise stories that connect the science and policy of climate change to the lived experience of South Floridians. You’ll use digital tools and audience data to spot trends, test new formats and engage readers where they are — from social platforms to newsletters and beyond. AI and automation will help you spend less time on routine tasks and more time on reporting, sources and storytelling that matters.

You’ll work closely with editors and fellow reporters, pitching and producing original stories, recaps and multiformat versions that meet newsroom goals for audience growth and retention. Your reporting will focus on solutions and actionable information, helping readers understand not just the threat but what they can do about it.

What you’ll do:

  • Own daily and enterprise coverage of climate issues in South Florida, with a focus on solutions and impact
  • Use digital tools, analytics and social media to inform, distribute and measure your work
  • Collaborate across the newsroom to develop ideas, test new formats and reach new audiences
  • Build and maintain a diverse network of sources
  • Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, ethics and public service journalism
  • Embrace new technology, including AI, to work smarter and deliver more value to our readers

This is a six-month, grant-funded position.

We welcome candidates with at least 1-3 years of newsroom experience, a strong grounding in journalism ethics and a passion for digital-first, audience-focused reporting. Fluency in video, photo and social media storytelling is a plus.

To apply, submit a cover letter, resume and 4-6 samples of their work.

The Miami Herald and McClatchy are committed to building a newsroom that reflects and serves all of South Florida. Join us at the forefront of digital journalism, where every audience matters and every signal counts.

job.title: Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

CD Baby is the world’s largest digital distribution platform for independent artists. For more than 20 years, we’ve empowered creators to release their music to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, Instagram, TikTok, and 150+ other platforms worldwide—paying out nearly $1 billion in earnings directly to independent artists.


Built by artists, for artists, we’re a mission-driven, artist-first company, and we’re expanding our Support team with experienced, detail-oriented problem-solvers who care deeply about helping creators succeed.


How we LEAD:

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll handle our most complex support inquiries, serving as an escalation point for high-impact issues involving royalties, metadata, distribution workflows, rights management, account configuration, and platform compliance.


You’ll be an expert in the independent music ecosystem and CD Baby’s product suite, capable of diagnosing nuanced, multi-layered problems and communicating solutions clearly and empathetically.


You’ll report to our Customer Support Manager, and work closely with the rest of the Customer Support team and cross-functional partners to improve workflows, provide insights, and elevate the overall quality and consistency of the CD Baby artist experience.


How You’ll CREATE:

Expert Support & Escalation Handling

  • Manage complex customer cases, including advanced revenue issues, delivery failures, content policy blocks, and technical issues.

job.title: Graphics Multimedia Editor, Open-source Reporting
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times Graphics team is looking for a reporter with extensive open-source and investigative reporting skills to turn raw evidence into impactful visual stories. You have a track record for uncovering exclusive information off the news.

The Graphics team is a leader in using spatial and visual techniques on investigative stories, and we're looking for someone who is passionate about accountability journalism using cutting-edge reporting techniques.

Below are a few examples of the kinds of stories that you will be a part of:
  • An exclusive look at the failed columns of the Midtown Manhattan near-collapse
  • A 3-D analysis of why firefighters' lines of sight were limited in the deadly LaGuardia Crash
  • An investigation into the mass graves in Syria
  • An investigation into the causes of a Miami building collapse
  • A spatial investigation into a deadly fire in the Bronx
  • A forensic analysis of an apartment building collapse in the Turkey earthquake
Working with journalists on the Graphics team and across the newsroom, you will play an important role in shaping visual reconstructions and investigations that rely on spatial analysis or use 3-D modeling. You will gather and analyze evidence for stories across a wide range of topics for both quick-turn stories as well as longer-term enterprise.

You will be expected to take the initiative in leading major storylines, with the goal of uncovering new or exclusive findings across multiple visual story formats. You should be curious and driven, and be comfortable with moving between solo deep dives and fast-paced, cross-desk collaborations.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week.

Responsibilities:
  • Bring core OSINT fluency to the desk's coverage: geolocation, chronolocation, satellite/aerial imagery analysis, audio-video research, and more.
  • Analyze a variety of data sources, including satellite and aerial imagery, flight/vessel tracking data, social media platforms and radio scanner data.
  • Vet and build relationships with a network of sources on stories.
  • Generate ideas that help the team develop custom tooling to automate open-source reporting for analyzing and visualizing evidence.
  • Find new ways to report beyond the standard OSINT toolkit, by using computational techniques, including through machine learning, computer vision and approved AI tools.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to an Assistant Editor on the Graphics desk.
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of relevant experience as an investigative reporter, open-source researcher or forensic expert.
  • Proven experience conducting open-source investigations by sourcing audio and visual evidence across a variety of platforms.
  • Experience producing accountability journalism, with a strong portfolio.
  • Experience producing clear copy about the visual evidence on tight deadlines.
  • Experience verifying user-generated content from social media for authenticity.
  • Skilled in building timelines using a variety of sources, including official statements and metadata from user-generated content.
  • Familiarity with open-source intelligence tools and techniques like Google Earth, satellite imagery platforms, scanner audio data, flight or vessel tracking, or similar.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working both independently and collaboratively while managing multiple research threads.
  • Experience with advanced tools for reporting, such as QGIS, Blender for 3-D scene reconstructions, data analysis methods, audio and image forensics tools.
  • Adept at creating clear, visual explainers piecing together complex findings.
  • Familiarity with programming and custom tool development.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Suite and Figma.
  • Experience with web scraping tools and working with APIs.
  • Experience using command line tools.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.
This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.   REQ-020693

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Application Delivery
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The Developer Platforms mission at The New York Times builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and paved paths that help product teams ship high‑quality experiences quickly and safely. Our Application Delivery team owns the shared software delivery platform (CI/CD, artifact management) and deployment workflows used by hundreds of engineers across News, Cooking, Games and Audio to ship software.

As the Times leans into AI‑assisted and agentic development, Application Delivery is where those changes become real. You will set the technical direction for how AI‑generated and agent‑driven change flows safely, observably, and at scale through CI/CD.

You'll help teams reduce release risk with modern deployment patterns, and turn effective delivery practices into reusable pipelines and templates that scale across the organization, much like our GenAI platform roles turn internal practices into reusable tools and agents. When you improve this platform, you change how The New York Times ships software.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the DevEx Application Delivery team. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days/week.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical direction of software delivery as a shared product: shape paved paths in our shared platform that improve code health, release quality, and delivery speed for product teams.

  • Set the technical direction for agent‑ready delivery: design the policy, guardrails, and paved paths that turn AI‑generated and agent‑driven changes (migrations, test generation, pipeline maintenance) into safe, observable releases at scale by partnering with our Developer AI team.

  • Collaborate with Product, engineering leaders, and internal users to shape the roadmap for the delivery platform and bring measurable impact on quality and speed.

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and observable software delivery systems and workflows that improve reliability, and overall software quality and velocity.

  • Champion engineering excellence in delivery by setting best practices for testing, deployment strategies, progressive delivery, and observability that are easy to adopt through the platform.

  • Mentor engineers across the mission, contribute to hiring, and help foster an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture centered on shared platforms and high‑quality software delivery.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our mission and values and a commitment to our purpose to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience building the technical strategy and driving software delivery (Github Actions, Argo CD or equivalent CI/CD systems) or similar platform work with broad organizational impact beyond operations.

  • Experience building and scaling a platform as a product for internal engineers with multi-tenancy serving many teams through self‑service paved paths, with attention to adoption, backward compatibility, and isolation/guardrails between tenants

  • Demonstrated proficiency in building and maintaining production services in one or more general‑purpose programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or Java), including code review and debugging complex issues.

  • 5+ years of experience with containers, Kubernetes, package management tools(Helm or equivalent), IAC tools(Terraform or equivalent), Gitops‑based deployment workflows and cloud services such as AWS, GCP.

  • Experience using delivery and productivity metrics (e.g., DORA, SPACE) and platform observability to measure and improve release quality and delivery.

  • Proficiency with GenAI‑assisted developer tooling (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) and judgment about how to integrate agentic workflows into CI/CD safely.

  • Experience leading cross‑team technical work, communicating trade‑offs, and building understanding among diverse partners including Product, platform, and product engineering teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to artifact/package management (e.g., Artifactory or similar) with attention to security, retention, cost, and ease of use for engineers.

In addition to base salary, this role is also eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Policy
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Suno exists to unlock the joy of making music. Millions of people use Suno to turn ideas into songs, and our platform generates music at a scale no moderation playbook was written for. We believe AI amplifies and empowers the people who make music, and keeping that ecosystem safe, fair, and trusted is core to the product, not a cost center bolted onto it. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/4IWNXlPv9MXDsCQe The role You will lead Trust & Safety Policy at Suno. Directly building and shaping our policies, you will also partner with PM, Eng, and Legal to understand the impact policies have on detection and remediation of violative content, fraud, bots, and identity issues, while also navigating music rights and our regulatory obligations. Generation volume grows faster than any human review model can, so we focus on policies that enable our enforcement systems to scale with the platform, hold it to a high degree of accuracy, and understand what decisions cost. You will report to the Head of Trust & Safety and partner regularly with Comms, Product, Engineering, ML, and Legal. What you'll do Own the Trust & Safety policy portfolio end to end: content and behavior policies, enforcement standards, and the policy roadmap as generation volume and product surface area grow. Write policy that machines can enforce: translate principles into decision criteria, model thresholds and reviewer guidance that produce consistent outcomes at millions of generations per day. Own policy for the hard genAI music problems: artist voice impersonation, rights-adjacent abuse, synthetic content disclosure and prompt-level misuse, in partnership with Legal. Turn regulatory obligations (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) into enforceable internal policy and audit-ready documentation, in partnership with Legal. Run the policy development lifecycle: risk assessment, stakeholder review, launch guidance, enforcement calibration and post-launch measurement of policy effectiveness. Set the escalation and edge-case framework: who decides what, on what timeline, with what precedent, so novel cases become policy instead of one-off judgment calls. Publish externally when it counts: community guidelines, transparency reporting inputs, and policy explanations creators can actually understand. Partner with Product and Engineering early so policy shapes features before launch rather than cleaning up after them. What you'll bring 7+ years in trust & safety, platform policy, or integrity work, including 3+ years owning a policy domain at a UGC or generative AI platform. A portfolio of policies you wrote that shipped and held up: you can walk through the risk assessment, the enforcement design, and what you changed after launch data came in. Demonstrated experience making policy machine-enforceable: decision trees, model threshold input, labeling taxonomies or reviewer guidance that produced measurable consistency gains. Fluency in the regulatory landscape shaping platform policy (DSA, OSA and emerging AI-content regimes) and a record of converting obligations into operational requirements rather than memos. Working knowledge of music rights, IP or media licensing sufficient to write credible policy alongside Legal without needing them to hold the pen. Evidence of moving Product, Engineering and Legal to adopt policy positions they did not start with. Writing that operators, executives and regulators can each use: precise enough to enforce, clear enough to defend publicly. Nice to have Music, media, or IP-adjacent platform experience and fluency in rights-matching abuse patterns. Direct exposure to DSA, OSA, or emerging AI-content regulatory regimes as operational requirements. job.title: Contract Administrator - Special Events
job.description:
Company Information

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you’re ready to help create moments that matter, there’s a place for you here. Because it happens here.

Job Summary

The Contract Administrator will work closely with legal, operations, accounting and production teams to review artist, venue, co-promotion, vendor, locations and sponsor agreements. Additionally, this position will work closely with Manager of Contract Administration and/or accounting team to process wire requests and deposits for artists and venues. The Contract Administrator will review venue insurance requirements per contract obligations and ensure needs are met on an event-by-event basis.

Essential Functions

 

  • Manage the full lifecycle of Special Events agreements, including drafting, issuing, negotiating, reviewing, executing, and maintaining venue license agreements.
  • Draft, review, and administer ancillary agreements, including vendor agreements, data-sharing agreements, preferred catering agreements, and other event-related contracts.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Legal, and other internal stakeholders to ensure accuracy of event details, contractual terms, and operational requirements.
  • Review, collect, and approve certificates of insurance and related compliance documentation from clients, vendors, and third-party contractors.
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve contract administration processes, workflows, and communication channels between field teams and corporate offices.
  • Maintain accurate and organized event files, ensuring all contracts, amendments, insurance documents, and related records are current and properly archived.
  • Train and mentor new employees on contract administration processes, systems, and best practices.

job.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we’ve consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We’re passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we’re always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.  

The Role

The Senior Director of Business Development will drive AXS’s growth across the sports industry by identifying, developing, and closing new partnerships with teams, leagues, venues, and other rights holders. Reporting to the Vice President of Business Development, this role will manage the full business development lifecycle, from market development and prospecting through solution design, financial modeling, negotiation, contracting and transition to implementation.

The Senior Director will build trusted relationships with senior decision makers, develop customized partnership strategies, and clearly communicate AXS’s ticketing capabilities. This individual will work closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to create compelling proposals, structure commercially sound agreements, and ensure organizational alignment through the sales process.

The ideal candidate combines deep sports industry knowledge, strong commercial judgement, and a proven ability to navigate complex, long-term sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Industry Representation: Represent AXS at industry events and tradeshows. Facilitate strategic meetings and events with external partners and prospects.
  • Executive Support: Assist the Business Development leadership team with strategic tasks and ad-hoc initiatives that drive growth.
  • Data Integrity: Ensure CRM data accuracy and advocate for best practices in data management, facilitating smooth handoffs to Customer Success.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with potential partners and lead efforts to secure and coordinate meetings that drive business opportunities.
  • Sales Tools and Resources: Evolve sales tools, presentations, and contracts to meet marketplace needs and communicate AXS's value proposition.
  • Messaging and Content: Develop messaging and content that clearly articulate AXS's unique value across products, services, and verticals.

  • Strong understanding of the sports and live entertainment ecosystem, including teams, leagues, venues, promoters, and other rights holders.
