job.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager, Social and Community
job.description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK:  

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that’s thrown at us.

Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You’ll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers.

When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

SENIOR BRAND MARKETING MANAGER, SOCIAL & COMMUNITY

LOCATION: Remote (US) — Los Angeles preferred, but not required

THE ROLE

Splice is looking for a full-time Senior Social & Community Manager to own the voice of Splice across our organic social portfolio and our Discord community. This is one of the most visible roles on the team and is central to the strategic direction of Splice: what you publish, how you show up, and what you learn from our audience shapes how the business thinks about creators. You’ll plan and publish content, run programming that brings producers together, engage directly with them in the comments, DMs, and Discord, and use performance data to sharpen what we make next. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the culture of music production. You make music yourself, you know what resonates with creators, and you can turn that instinct into content and community moments that earn attention. You’ll work closely with our brand, community, and product teams to translate what’s happening at Splice into things our community actually wants to see and take part in. As our portfolio grows, so does the role, with the opportunity to take on social and community channels for additional Splice brands.

WHO WE ARE

Splice is a creative platform for people who make music. Serious producers choose Splice Sounds to bring their ideas to life. A subscription to Splice inspires and accelerates creative success for digital music creators with an industry-leading catalog of sounds and samples and an expanding AI stack. With a rent-to-own marketplace of DAWs and plugins, the Splice experience seamlessly integrates into any music production workflow, regardless of DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). Via Splice, an unparalleled team of sound designers and sample creators are fueling the success of a growing global community of chart-topping producers, students, and DIY creators.

HOW WE WORK

At Splice, DISCO is a rallying cry for collaboration, accountability, and unity within our organization; Direct, Inclusive, Splice Together, Creator Centric, and Optimistic. Our shared success depends on our ability to support one another, work well together, and communicate directly. By embracing flexibility and a unified approach, we can navigate anything that's thrown at us. Splice embraces a culture of remote work. You'll see your colleagues showing up from across the US and the UK. In order to keep us working well as a team, we have regular communication, including Town Halls, departmental all-hands and get-togethers. When you join Splice, you join a network of colleagues, peers, and collaborators. Are you ready?

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Social

  • Own the organic social strategy and publishing calendar across all Splice channels, from ideation through scheduling, posting, and platform-native optimization, and decide where we show up as platforms and audience behavior change
  • Create and edit content yourself, from concept to final cut, with a fast turnaround and a strong point of view on what will land
  • Show up in the comments, DMs, and replies as the voice of Splice, engaging producers directly, surfacing their work, and building real relationships in the process
  • Spot and act on cultural moments, trends, and sounds in real time, including reactive posting outside of the calendar
  • Partner with brand, product, and community teams to turn launches, artist packs, and platform news into content that feels native to each channel rather than an announcement
  • Source and amplify community and creator-generated content, coordinating directly with producers and artists

Community

  • Manage and grow the Splice Discord server, keeping conversation active and welcoming day to day
  • Plan and run recurring community programming, including beat battles, community challenges, and remix competitions, from concept and rules through promotion, judging, and recognition of winners
  • Start and sustain regular conversations that give producers a reason to come back, share their work, and give each other feedback
  • Work with moderators and internal teams to keep the community healthy, and bring what you hear in Discord back to the wider business

Data and reporting

  • Track performance across social and community channels and translate the numbers into clear recommendations: what to double down on, what to stop, and what to test next
  • Use data to make decisions on content, programming, and channel investment, and report on channel health, community growth, and engagement to the business on a regular cadence
  • Develop workflows to move faster and produce more, across ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, and analysis

Growth

  • As the Splice portfolio grows, take on strategy and management of social and community channels for additional brands, with the scope of the role growing alongside the portfolio

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years managing social channels for a brand, artist, label, or creator-facing company, with examples of work you can point to
  • Experience owning a multi-channel organic social presence, not a single platform
  • Experience speaking directly to a creator audience, ideally in music, but adjacent creative categories will be considered
  • You make music with a DAW. You understand production workflows from the inside and can talk to producers as a peer
  • A proven track record of building and engaging a community, not just growing follower counts, including hands-on experience running a Discord server or a comparable community space
  • Experience planning and running community programming such as contests, challenges, or competitions
  • Native fluency across the major social platforms, including the formats, editing conventions, and publishing tools for short-form video, long-form video, and text-based channels
  • Strong comfort with social and community analytics, and the ability to turn data into decisions and clear reporting for a business audience
  • Hands-on experience and a genuine appetite for new tools as they emerge
  • Strong writing and a natural instinct for tone. You can be funny, direct, and human without sounding like a brand account

NICE TO HAVES

  • Based in Los Angeles, with the ability to attend shoots, sessions, and creator meet-ups in person
  • Experience with Blender or other 3D rendering/animation tools, and the ability to create original content with them
  • Comfortable being on camera and featured in Splice content
  • Existing relationships in the producer, artist, or label community
  • Motion design, photography, or audio editing chops

SPLICE BENEFITS: 

  • Compensation & Equity: Competitive pay with annual reviews and equity opportunities.
  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO to recharge and thrive.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with immediate vesting and company match.
  • Parental Support: 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for non-birthing parents, and 18-20 weeks for birthing parents.
  • Flexible Work Options: Work remotely or connect at our office hubs and creative spaces worldwide.
  • Professional Growth: Annual learning budget, leadership programs, and team ambassador opportunities.
  • Community & Connection: Inclusive events, team meet-ups, and vibrant Employee Resource Groups.



The national pay range for this role is $112,000 - $140,000 Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

Creator Nation is a creator economy company backed by Live Nation Entertainment, the world's leading live entertainment company. We are the infrastructure behind a family of companies spanning talent management, advisory, creator marketing, and live experiences, built to give creators, brands, and fans the tools and services they deserve.


LIFE AT CREATOR NATION

Creator Nation exists to give creators, brands, and fans the tools and services they deserve. Creators work hard at their craft, so everything built for them should work even harder. As the infrastructure behind a family of companies spanning management, advisory, marketing and live experiences, backed by the reach of Live Nation Entertainment, we are uniquely positioned to deliver on that vision.


We are guided by our four core values:

  • Speed: Our industry moves fast and we move with it.
  • Simplicity: Common sense always wins.
  • Reliability: We earn the trust of our partners every day.
  • Precision: We strive to get things right the first time.

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Creator Nation, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Director of Communications to oversee Creator Nation’s overall marketing, communications, and brand PR strategy across the organization. This role will lead the social and content team, manage key internal and external media partnerships, and drive the company’s brand presence and visibility.


The Director of Communications will be expected to work in-office 5 days per week.

  • Own marketing and communications for Creator Nation and the companies under the Creator Nation umbrella, including brand, PR, social, content, and events
  • Lead the company announcement moments (acquisitions, executive hires, creator signings) from strategy through execution
  • Serve as the primary press contact and manage PR agency, media relationships, and executive visibility and thought leadership
  • Lead the social and content team: the Social Content Producer (ideates, shoots, and edits) and the Coordinator, Social Content (runs the channels and community), both reporting directly to this role
  • Set social and content strategy for company channels and executive social presence and ensure they stay aligned
  • Manage the annual marketing budget, sponsorships, and industry event presence
  • Travel to events and conferences as needed, including international travel
  • Partner with portfolio company leaders on brand consistency and marketing support across the group
  • Track coverage, campaign performance, and brand health and report results to leadership

  • 5 years of experience in marketing and communications, including experience managing people
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or related field 
  • Experience in entertainment, music, or the creator economy, ideally at a high-growth company
  • Strong press and media relationships and a track record of landing tier-one coverage

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 

 

THE ROLE

Reporting to the Vice President, Operations Finance, the Senior Director, Operations Finance owns operational accounting for Live Nation Canada. This is the senior operating leader of a function that accounts for every show, venue and festival we run in this country; tens of thousands of transactions a year, settled under contract in a fast-paced environment where the work is visible and the stakes are real.


The Senior Director’s mission will be to elevate the function by building a high-performing team and setting standards nationally for how shows and venues are accounted for. They will be responsible to evolve current processes toward greater automation, control and scale. Success in the first 12 months will be clear and measurable: a functioning management layer that consistently delivers on deadlines; a faster, cleaner close with a defensible timetable and fewer post-close adjustments; one written national process standard in use across all markets; an automated end-to-end workflow that is live, adopted and measurably reducing manual effort or error; and a strong control environment where audit findings are closed promptly and none repeat. Working in close partnership with the Vice President, the Senior Director will help shape the direction and priorities of the function. They will be the trusted go-to partner for the business on all matters of operational accounting. 


This is a great opportunity to own a national function, build a team around it, and elevate how Live Nation Canada does its accounting.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Leadership

  • Own the structure, capability and performance of a ~12-person operational accounting team spanning show settlement, venue accounting and financial close
  • Lead through managers: develop the management layer, set clear ownership accountabilities, establish performance standards and hold managers accountable for their teams' deadlines and quality
  • Own talent strategy for the function: hiring standards, onboarding, development plans, succession depth, and a coverage model that holds through peak season, festival periods and major tours

Event Reporting and Operational Accounting

  • Accountable for the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all events, venues and festivals accounting nationally (including the integrity of reported contribution margin by show, venue and market)
  • Own the close calendar end to end and commit to the timetable; ensure corporate reporting deadlines are consistently met
  • Own the accounting treatment of show settlement: from artist final settlements against contract, withholding tax, charity and merchandise/bundle recognition, co-promoted events,  joint venture splits, venue expense settlement and shared ancillary revenue
  • Own accounting for owned and operated venues, including inventory, labour costs and cash handling
  • Own balance sheet integrity for the function: reconciliation quality, accrual adequacy, deferred revenue, AR aging and collections performance for event-related balances
  • Develop and recommend accounting positions on complex deal structures such as co-promoted events, joint ventures, festival vehicles, rental versus promoted, international artist withholding, multi-year ancillary agreements
  • Partner with regional controllers to ensure consistent application of policy across markets, and resolve differences rather than reporting them
  • Partner with VP, Operational Accounting and Corporate for all technical accounting approval
  • Accountable for the day-to-day operation of internal controls over settlement, cash floats, AP approval and wire release, including SOX-relevant controls in scope
  • Play a critical role in internal and external audits; owning remediation of findings to closure while ensuring every settlement is audit-ready with proper documentation backup
  • Proactively identify control gaps as volume, venues and deal structures change, and implement corrective action

National Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement and sustain a national operational accounting playbook: settlement process, documentation standards, close process and checklist, reconciliation methodology, escalation path.
  • Identify and improve workstreams end to end; from business case through delivery to adoption and measured benefit
  • Define and report the function's operating metrics: days to close, settlement cycle time, restatement and error rates, aged AR, control exception volume. Use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement
  • Own the data standards that allow event economics to be reported consistently

Partner with the business

  • Provide the actuals, trend data and event-level insight that Strategic Finance and FP&A build the budget and forecast on; accountable for the reliability of what they plan from
  • Support due diligence, integration planning and post-close financial integration
  • Deputize for the VP, Operational Accounting on function matters with senior leadership to set priorities for the function, and act as their delegate with senior leadership when needed 



WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • CPA designation required; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field
  • 10–12 years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including experience leading managers and building a management layer, not only managing individual contributors
  • Demonstrated ownership of a close and control environment across multiple sites, markets or entities within a larger corporate finance organization
  • A track record of leading a process or systems improvement end to end, from business case through delivery and adoption to measured result
  • Live entertainment, hospitality, venue, sports or comparable high-volume, deal-driven, contract-settled environment strongly preferred; comfort with a pace where revenue is earned in a single night and settled quickly
  • Strong Oracle and/or Salesforce capability; advanced Excel; practical use of Claude, AI platforms, BI and automation tooling to reduce manual work
  • Ability to hold an accounting position under commercial pressure while keeping the relationship intact
  • Credibility and presence with senior commercial leadership; able to explain complex financial outcomes clearly to non-financial stakeholders and earn their trust
  • Resourceful and hands-on when it matters; this is a senior role embedded in an operating business
  • Availability for travel and on-site support for major shows and festival properties, including evenings and weekends during peak season

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, Dental and Vision benefits for you and your family, along with Employee Assistance Programs through Modern Health and ComPsych 
  • YOURSELF:  Generous paid time off policy including holiday closures, and sick time for you and dependents, along with free concert tickets 
  • WEALTH: RRSP program with company match, Stock Program Reimbursement 
  • FAMILY: New parent programs & support including caregiver leave and baby bonus, and infertility support 
  • CAREER: Tuition reimbursement, student loan repayment, and internal growth and development programs and training
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding network, gender reassignment support  

We thank all candidates for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

  • Practical use of Claude, AI platforms, BI and automation tooling
  • Experience working in a large, complex organization; public company reporting experience preferred.

Alongside gaining hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure SQL Server and Power BI, the successful candidate will complete a Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship.

We are looking for a motivated individual with strong analytical and interpersonal skills, a keen interest in data and technology, and a willingness to learn. Previous Business Intelligence experience is not required, as training and mentoring will be provided. Applicants must meet the apprenticeship eligibility requirements.

About the Role 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Provide immediate solutions to system issues and liaise with other support teams to ensure prompt resolution
  • Manage small scale changes through to completion
  • Perform quality assurance tests and assisting with new release processes
  • Automate and enhance workflows
  • Manage and administer reporting security
  • Collaborate with people across the firm to enable them to self-serve Business Intelligence through Power BI
  • Work with developers to support the technical implementation and roll-out of new reporting dashboards on Power BI
  • As skills and knowledge are gained, personally take on development work, through SQL and Power BI within the team.

What We're Looking For

At Brunswick, we seek smart and curious individuals dedicated to learning and growth. We value potential, strong work ethic, and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Standout candidates demonstrate:

  • Working knowledge of Excel, with an enthusiasm to develop more advanced skills
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • An interest in working with data and using it to solve business problems
  • The ability to communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels of the business
  • A proactive approach and willingness to learn
  • A resilient, enthusiastic team player with strong self-motivation and a collaborative, hands-on approach
  • An interest in databases and data; previous exposure to SQL would be beneficial but is not essential
  • An interest in Business Intelligence and data visualisation; previous exposure to Power BI would be beneficial but is not essential
  • An interest in developing commercial and financial understanding
  • A sense of fun

Applications close on Friday 30th October 2026 at 4.00pm.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of exceptional employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What's yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you will have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another, and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions.

 

Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams. When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of the CBC, but the future of our country.

 

There is an opportunity for this to be a full-time teleworking position. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why This Role Is Important

 

As a key member of our OTT team, you will work closely with product managers, architects and technical leads. Your primary focus will be to drive seamless product development within your domain and co-ordinate the technical initiatives required to deliver new features. You will ensure that all deliverables align with the guidelines, standards and practices established by the development leadership team.

 

This department manages the unified product architecture that powers both ICI TOU.TV and CBC Gem.

 

Benefits you can expect:

  • Flexible work schedule prioritizing you, your family, and your work.
  • Possibility of working from home.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Opportunity to be part of our affinity groups.
  • Buddy program and mentoring opportunities, allowing you to learn from the best in the industry.
  • Creative and dynamic work environment where your ideas and contributions are heard, valued, and respected.
  • A supportive leadership team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusion.
  • An environment that encourages experimentation and an iterative approach to achieve the most advanced forms of technical innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Consolidate and coordinate deliverables across five distinct teams and more than five platforms to define and document the scope of our recurring Agile release trains.
  • Coordinate go-live operations and post-launch monitoring alongside platform developers on a rotational basis.
  • Partner with the QA Lead to co-ordinate pre- and post-deployment testing cycles.
  • Define, document and track performance indicators for our deployment workflows.
  • Propose and lead initiatives that accelerate and optimize our deployment workflows.
  • Plan, coordinate and document mandatory updates across all application platforms.
  • Plan, coordinate and document the use of feature flags in close collaboration with product managers.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Lead and Enterprise Architect to define and track Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) objectives.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for SRE practices, working closely with the Cross-Functional SRE Lead to keep internal expertise up to date and relevant.
  • Foster and lead an SRE community of practice within the OTT team, encouraging team members’ active participation and engagement in community activities.
  • Maintain inventories and documentation for various dashboards.
  • Build strong, high-level collaborative relationships with external SRE teams through cross-functional dashboard integration.
  • Ensure the reliability and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.
  • Maximize uptime and maintain up-to-date development and integration environments, particularly for automated testing.
  • Document the use and manage the inventory of development and integration environments.

 

What You Bring

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • Five to seven years’ IT experience (as a developer, QA engineer, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) tools.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages like Bash or Python.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and a high degree of intellectual curiosity (acquiring and developing new skills and knowledge).
  • A critical mind (challenging the status quo and voicing new ideas).
  • Keen interest in major trends and challenges within the digital landscape.
  • Thoroughness, self-reliance and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and prioritization skills.
  • Strong analytical and conceptual thinking.
  • Flexibility, initiative and drive.
  • Ability to work well in a team and communicate effectively.
  • Fluency in French.
  • Professional working proficiency in spoken and written English required.

 

Given the scope and responsibilities of this role, you will operate in a bilingual environment where daily work is conducted in both official languages (English and French). The successful candidate will adapt smoothly and collaboratively to thrive in and support this multilingual workplace.

 

Please note that this is a 12-month contract position. At CBC/Radio-Canada, contract roles function similarly to regular full-time positions, offering the possibility of renewal based on performance and skill demonstration.

We’re seeking a bold, visionary leader to drive aggressive revenue growth across broadcast, digital, and experiential platforms while inspiring a high-performing, collaborative team culture. This is a hands-on, strategic role for someone who thrives on results, innovation, and community impact—someone ready to elevate our brand, empower our team, and deliver measurable success for our clients. Develop and execute integrated sales plans that capitalize on our full suite of media assets—linear, digital, and community-focused—to deliver measurable results for clients. Recruit, mentor, and inspire a high-performing sales team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous growth. Drive new business development while deepening relationships with key accounts, influencers, and community leaders to maximize market impact. Multi-Media Advertising Strategist

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Every now and then a great opportunity presents itself, that time is now, for you, at Townsquare Media in Bangor.  At Townsquare, we are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally.  We have a current opening which includes an existing book of business that requires a strong marketing professional.  You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and above average pay. 

We have a rare opening for the right person to bring our best-in-class marketing solutions to local businesses in eastern and central Maine. We’re the number one local media company in each of the markets we serve. Our top-rated radio stations, our market exclusive digital media solutions and our exciting live events are a winning combination for you, and our customers.

 

Responsibilities:

  • determine strategy for identifying, connecting and closing new opportunities in the Bangor market.
  • prospect and identify potential clients using our proprietary data and analytics;
  • build and maintain close working relationships with internal teams to identify key accounts and build solution based strategic plans that help businesses grow.
  • responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to both local and regional businesses in eastern and central Maine.
  • diversifying our clients’ solutions through cross-selling a variety of marketing solutions including broadcast, digital (website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Paid Search/Social, etc.), and live event sponsorship.

 

Qualifications:

  • B 2 B sales experience preferred
  • A strong business acumen
  • Outside sales experience in any field with a track record of success
  • General understanding digital advertising, broadcast media and event sponsorship
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic, and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance

  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 322 local terrestrial radio stations in 67 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com, and Loudwire.com.

job.title: Senior Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.


ABOUT THE ROLE


FOX is currently seeking a Senior Director, Broadcast Engineering to join our team in Tempe. In this leadership role, you will lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and continued evolution of cutting-edge broadcast platforms supporting one of the premier national broadcasters.


You will collaborate with leaders across FOX to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps. You will also partner with leading technology vendors and service providers to develop solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen reliability, and create long-term business value.


As a technology leader, you will guide the evolution of FOX’s broadcast infrastructure and help shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will lead and develop high-performing engineering teams while establishing the technical vision, standards, and operating practices needed to deliver exceptional viewer experiences at scale.


The way audiences consume media continues to evolve across televisions, streaming platforms, mobile applications, websites, and emerging distribution channels. At FOX, you will have the opportunity to help define and build the technology that supports this transformation and delivers high-quality experiences to millions of viewers.


Join us at FOX and make your mark as we continue building the future of our media and broadcast operations.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for FOX’s broadcast engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for broadcast platforms, architecture, and infrastructure
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of broadcast engineering technical experts responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving FOX’s technology ecosystem
  • Drive the transition to next-generation broadcast architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments while ensuring solutions meet security, reliability, scalability, and regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate FOX’s technology portfolio against emerging platforms, third-party offerings, and industry trends to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, and innovation
  • Partner with senior leaders across FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX News Media, and other business units to understand strategic priorities and translate business and operational requirements into technology strategies
  • Collaborate with other teams to design and deliver innovative solutions for complex business and technical challenges
  • Establish long-term technology strategies, product development plans, and implementation roadmaps in partnership with engineering, operations, and third-party vendors
  • Provide leadership and oversight for large-scale, highly complex technology programs from architecture and planning through implementation and operational readiness
  • Develop strategic partnerships with technology vendors and service providers, helping influence product direction and ensuring solutions support FOX’s current and future requirements
  • Use data, operational metrics, and performance insights to continuously improve the reliability, efficiency, security, and effectiveness of FOX’s broadcast platforms and engineering organization
  • Establish and monitor meaningful performance measures to align teams around organizational priorities and measurable outcomes
  • Champion operational excellence, including resilient architecture, testing, security, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices that minimize risk and strengthen platform performance
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning, particularly around emerging broadcast, IP, cloud, and media technologies
  • Build leadership capabilities and career development opportunities that attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent
  • Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that empowers teams to solve complex problems, challenge established approaches, and deliver high-quality technology solutions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED


  • 10+ years experience leading complex broadcast engineering, media technology, or software and infrastructure organizations, including direct management of leaders and highly technical teams
  • Extensive knowledge of Evertz broadcast infrastructure, systems, and solutions
  • Significant hands-on knowledge of broadcast technology and production environments, including the application of SMPTE 2110, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction across complex systems
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies and multi-year roadmaps for large-scale, business-critical platforms
  • Deep understanding of production video and broadcast operations and the technologies required to support highly available media environments
  • Strong knowledge of major broadcast systems and technology vendors across areas such as graphics, transcoding, playout, master control, video processing, monitoring, and distribution
  • Strong understanding of on-premises, cloud-based, and hybrid compute, networking, and storage infrastructure supporting modern broadcast environments
  • Experience leading major technology transformations and introducing new architectures while maintaining the reliability of critical production systems
  • Proven ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical strategies, architectures, and implementation plans
  • Strong analytical, reasoning, and technical troubleshooting capabilities with the ability to guide teams through highly complex technical challenges
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence senior executives, business leaders, engineering teams, operations teams, and external technology partners
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience managing multiple complex programs, priorities, and teams in a fast-paced media or technology environment
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing engineering teams and leaders

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER


  • Experience designing or operating cloud-native, IP-based, or software-defined broadcast and media platforms
  • Knowledge of emerging video technologies and formats, including 4K, High Dynamic Range (HDR), and HDR10+
  • Knowledge of broadcast and media industry standards, including Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) and Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers (SMPTE) standards
  • Experience working with emerging technologies and architectures shaping the future of broadcast, streaming, and media distribution
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its application in a broadcast environment.

- Tell Central & Western Wisconsin's story: Discover and highlight unique local stories, voices, and events that truly matter to our communities, giving them a vibrant digital life.
- Develop a beat system and cultivate sources within the community to generate unique "Only On" stories — timely, impactful reporting that goes beyond the press release.
- Confirm and pursue incoming news tips via email, phone, and social media with strong critical thinking and research skills.
- Write AP-style news stories daily for digital platforms, including weau.com and wsaw.com; publish and update stories as new information develops throughout your shift.
- Plan and build special website sections and features that highlight coverage, link platforms, and encourage user engagement.
- Reformat and optimize news content produced by other team members for maximum reach and engagement across digital platforms.
- Coach and collaborate with reporting staff to maximize the digital presentation of their stories.
- Communicate effectively with producers to incorporate digital elements into newscasts.
- Present content on-camera for delivery in newscasts, live streams, podcasts, and social media videos.
- Work with a sense of immediacy — both independently and as part of a team. That is our culture.
- Ensure factual, grammatical, and legal accuracy across all platforms, upholding the station's established journalistic standards and avoiding editorial bias.

- College degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with solid knowledge of AP Style *and writing conversationally for Broadcast.
- Ability to edit video in digital formats.
- Proficiency with Photoshop or Canva or comparable software to create and edit graphics.
- Ability to work well under pressure and collaborate effectively with a diverse team.
- Strong understanding of journalistic principles and ethics.
- Ability to balance long- and short-term projects while consistently meeting daily deadlines.
- Proven record of digital and social media success; must maintain a responsible and professional social media presence.

It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. Murrow Award for Journalism Excellence, the National Association of Broadcasters' Service to America Award, the George Foster Peabody Award, and is an annual attendee of the Southeast Emmy Awards.

WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina State House.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

 Job Summary/Description:  

WIS News 10 is seeking an energetic, digitally savvy Weekend Meteorologist to join our First Alert Weather team in Columbia, South Carolina. We want a dynamic communicator who pairs strong scientific expertise with a digital-first instinct—someone who commands the screen on linear broadcast and thrives in the fast-paced world of digital, streaming, and social storytelling. If you know how to build loyalty on social, turn complex radar data into compelling video, and step up with calm, decisive authority when severe weather strikes, this role is for you.

• Report from the Field: Deliver live, immersive field reporting that brings the impact of significant weather events directly to our viewers.

• Experience: Minimum 2 years of on-air and digital broadcast meteorology experience.
• Digital Fluency: Demonstrated track record of creating engaging video content for digital, OTT, and social platforms (YouTube, TikTok/Reels, Facebook Live, etc.).
• Technical Skills: Hands-on proficiency with WSI MAX
• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science.
• AMS or CBM/NWA seal preferred.
• High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to handle live, wall-to-wall severe weather coverage with composure and precision.

WTAP is THE main voice in the Mid-Ohio Valley. We may be among the smallest TV stations in America, but we are also one of the most dynamic. With state-of-the-art technology, a terrific on-air look, and a dynamic digital presence. You'll be proud of the work you'll do here. And you'll grow quickly because there is so much opportunity! You'll get to explore whatever you want to do in the communications field, whether it's on-camera, behind-the-scenes, or in sales. WTAP is involved in the communities we cover. From covering high school sports, to participating in local events, to helping small businesses grow and thrive through commercials and mobile products, WTAP does it all. And we do it all - together. The Mid-Ohio Valley includes the communities of Parkersburg, WV, and Marietta, OH, and the 50-mile area surrounding them. It's the kind of place where you can walk down the street and say "hi" to people, and they'll say "hi" right back at you! It's the kind of place where local news-people become like family to the viewers and online readers they serve and communicate with. There are wonderful parks, great hiking and biking areas, high-quality restaurants, and shopping - whether you like a mall or the uniqueness of small stores on Main Street. Our area is big on heritage, and the many fairs and festivals reflect that passion. Marietta College gives its hometown a New England feel. Ohio University and the community of Athens, Ohio, are nearby. The Ohio River is the common thread that runs through everything, and the Blennerhassett State Park, located on an island of the same name very close to Parkersburg, is a historic and beautiful place to get away to on a summer day. There's much to see and do within a couple of hours' drive from our location in Western West Virginia and Southeastern Ohio. Whitewater rafting, snow skiing, and so much more are available in the mountains of West Virginia. The locally situated Mid-Ohio Valley regional airport and airports in Charleston, West Virginia, and Akron, Columbus, and Cleveland, Ohio, give you access to anywhere you want to go. Wherever you may travel, though, our area is proud of its history and heritage with roots in oil and industry, which have helped shape our region into what it is today. WTAP is THE main voice in the Mid-Ohio Valley. We may be among the smallest TV stations in America, but we are also one of the most dynamic. With state-of-the-art technology, a terrific on-air look, and a dynamic digital presence … you'll be proud of the work you'll do here. And you'll grow quickly because there is so much opportunity! You'll get to explore whatever you want to do in the communications field, whether it's on-camera, behind-the-scenes, or in sales. The WTAP team is involved in the communities we cover. From covering high school sports to participating in local events, to helping small businesses grow and thrive through commercials and mobile products, WTAP does it all. And we do it all –together.

The Mid-Ohio Valley includes the communities of Parkersburg, WV, and Marietta, OH, and the 50-mile area surrounding them. It's the kind of place where you can walk down the street and say "hi" to people, and they'll say "hi" right back at you! It's the kind of place where local news-people become like family to the viewers and online readers they serve and communicate with. There are wonderful parks, great hiking and biking areas, high-quality restaurants, and shopping –whether you like a mall or the uniqueness of small stores on Main Street. Our area is big on heritage, and the many fairs and festivals reflect that passion. Marietta College gives its hometown a New England feel. Ohio University and the community of Athens, Ohio, are nearby.
The Ohio River is the common thread that runs through everything, and the Blennerhassett State Park, located on an island of the same name very close to Parkersburg, is a historic and beautiful place to get away to on a summer day.

There's much to see and do within a couple of hours' drive from our location in Western West Virginia and Southeastern Ohio. Whitewater rafting, snow skiing, and so much more are available in the mountains of West Virginia. The locally situated Mid-Ohio Valley regional airport and airports in Charleston, West Virginia, and Akron, Columbus, and Cleveland, Ohio, give you access to anywhere you want to go. Wherever you may travel, though. Our area is proud of its history and heritage with roots in oil and industry, which have helped shape our region into what it is today. WTAP's commitment to serve the Mid-Ohio Valley, the place that we call home, shows that it doesn’t matter what the market size… we are here doing what really matters.

Job Summary/Description:  

The Technical Director will function as one of the technical leads for production during live or taped studio broadcast productions. The Technical Director is responsible for the setup and operation of the production switcher and associated technical equipment in the Production Control Room and/or live location environment. They are also responsible for evaluating and then assigning all video inputs, taking into consideration timing and video levels, all while orchestrating the control room setup. Finally, the Technical Director will operate as the “right hand” of the Line Producer to develop and execute the creative and technical “look” of the production by creating special effects via the production switcher and various external effects equipment. This is a "freelance" position.

• Lead the control room and studio crew to produce regular, special, and live show programming

job.title: Network Architect
job.description:
Network Architect

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Network Architect to design, optimize, and oversee our network and firewall infrastructure. This position will be responsible for ensuring our data, cloud, and security systems are scalable, reliable, and secure.

This is the deepest technical seat on the network team. It owns how the network is designed: corporate, data center, cloud, and the media networks that carry live content, and it leads the team that runs it. The lead responsibility is real but informal. There are no direct reports. This role leads through design authority, technical credibility, and follow-through. On a lean team it is also a working role: the architect writes the configs, joins the maintenance window, and handles escalation for any outages or issues, and mentors other engineers.

Depth is the point of this position. It is not a role for a generalist who reviews vendor diagrams. The successful candidate can defend a design decision under questioning, read a packet capture, and troubleshoot a problem at all hours. This role owns the architecture being right and the network staying up.  This position will be the SME for all network and security infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Network Architecture

  • Plan, design, and own the LAN,WAN,and hybrid onsite/cloud architecture. Provide a roadmap to keep architecture up to date and to encompass new technologies.

  • Produce architect-grade documentation: designs with stated requirements, constraints, alternatives considered, failure modes, and a migration path. Not diagrams alone.

  • Maintain IP/Vlan schemas and configuration standards.

  • Set routing and switching standards — analyze traffic patterns, monitor network performance, and address any latency, network bottlenecks, or bandwidth issues.

  • Design for measurable resilience: no single points of failure on network paths, and a documented, tested behavior for every failure path.

  • Own capacity planning and technology lifecycle across the network; make the buy/refresh case with data.

  • Evaluate platforms and vendors on technical merit and give management a defensible recommendation, including the option not to buy. 

  • Prepare project plans, budget estimates, and resources needed for any infrastructure deployments.

  • Technical peer to partner with other teams for operational or engineering needs.

Network Security Architecture

  • Own Palo Alto firewall architecture: PAN-OS platform design, Panorama management, App-ID/User-ID policy model, decryption strategy, HA design, URL filtering, AI security, and geo-location firewall rules.

  • Own remote access and edge architecture — GlobalProtect, ZTNA/SASE direction, internet edge, and cloud connectivity.

  • Design segmentation and east-west controls, including microsegmentation strategy for the data center.

  • Ensure logging and flow visibility reach network monitoring and security tools.

  • Keep abreast of new URL categories, technologies, and vulnerabilities.  Make recommendations where needed for upgrades, changes, new licenses, or new technologies.

Network Operations Leadership (Soft Lead)

  • Own the operational health of the network day to day: monitoring, alerting, incident queue, change quality, code upgrades, policies, and procedures.

  • Set the engineering standards the team builds to; review every significant change before implementation.

  • Own change planning and maintenance windows in a 24x7 environment — pre-checks, rollback, post-change validation, and coordination with on-air schedules.

  • Serve as the top escalation point for network incidents and lead technical bridge calls.

  • Own the postmortem and drive corrective actions to closure.

  • Mentor engineers and grow the bench so the team is not single-threaded.

  • Coordinate with other business-unit technologists on shared work: agree on outcomes, publish expectations, follow up until closed.

  • Act as the technical delegate in vendor, carrier, and architecture review sessions.

Communication

  • Write clearly. Designs, standards, change records, and incident narratives are deliverables of this role, held to the same standard as the engineering.

  • Present and defend architecture to technical peers, and translate the same decision into cost, risk, and on-air impact for executives.

  • Communicate during incidents on a defined cadence: what is known, what is not, what is being done, when the next update comes.

  • Give management an accurate picture without prompting — what is on track, what is slipping, what needs a decision.

Ownership & Accountability

This is stated explicitly because it is the primary filter for this role. The successful candidate:

  • Owns the design and its consequences. A failure caused by an architecture decision is an architecture problem, not an operations problem.

  • Verifies rather than assume — redundancy is proven by testing the failover, not by reading the diagram.

  • Surfaces bad news early, with a recommendation attached.

  • Does not defer to a vendor SE for a decision this role should be making.

  • Takes responsibility for the team's misses when leading the work, and gives credit for the wins.

  • Do not let something fall because it sat outside the job description.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise network engineering, with 3+ years in an architect or principal-level role.

  • Expert-level routing and switching: BGP, OSPF, VXLAN/EVPN, multicast, QoS, high availability. Design-level, not just configuration level.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Palo Alto (PAN-OS, Panorama) and Cisco platforms (Catalyst, Nexus, ACI, Meraki switches and routers).

  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating networks in a 24x7 environment where downtime is externally visible.

  • Strong troubleshooting discipline: packet capture, flow analysis, and structured fault isolation under pressure.

  • Track record of leading technical work through people who do not report to you.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • CCIE, CCNP, Palo Alto certification, or equivalent depth demonstrated by work history.

  • Familiarity with multicast including protocol implementation and configuration

  • Experience with a data center or facility build, migration, or consolidation.

  • Familiarity with network monitoring and network observability platforms

  • SD-WAN and cloud connectivity design experience (Direct Connect / GCP Interconnect).

  • Automation or scripting for network config and validation (Python or equivalent).

  • AI experience to accelerate troubleshooting and problem resolution, automate repetitive tasks, and increase operational efficiency

job.title: Security Engineer
job.description:
Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in Allen Media Group (AMG) has a critical role to play. 


Join our amazing team as we embark upon our mission to defend AMG’s digital footprint towards a more resilient, scalable, and secure future. Our security-focused team is dedicated to support, protect and enable the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value. 


Your key responsibilities

  • Engineer security solutions and services following all relevant AMG standards and practices for On-Premise, Hybrid and Cloud-Based environments.

  • Implement and support solutions/technologies (includes production support and documentation): network proxies, intrusion detection/prevention systems, remote access, second factor authentication, security event monitoring, infrastructure and system hardening, patch deployment and vulnerability management.

  • Take accountability for the design, delivery and maintenance of new and existing security solutions or services, driving compliance with and contributing to the development of relevant standards.

  • Apply modern standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, security standards, design standards, industry frameworks to security solutions and services as appropriate. 

  • Look for ways to optimize security processes and recommend opportunities and solutions for improvement and automation. 

  • Help coordinate and drive remediation of identified risks and control deficiencies.

  • Work in a diverse, global environment and build strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically, and culturally dispersed organization.

  • Flexible to work outside of regular office hours to accommodate team and organizational calls and meetings. Weekend or late-night work may occur during the project and early life cycle support phases.

  • No direct supervision responsibilities, though technical leadership is required within assigned projects.


Skills and attributes for success

  • Intermediate skills in planning, designing, and solving complex security solutions and services

  • Technical knowledge in designing and implementing within at least one or more of the following security domains:

    • Network Security

    • Cloud Security 

    • Identity & Access Management (IdAM)

    • Application Security (Container Security tools, Docker, Kubernetes)

    • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) 

    • Cloud-based or On-Premise SIEM, Vulnerability Management

  • Communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal and able to communicate technical concepts effectively

  • Excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills and the ability to work within tight timeframes

  • Rapidly learn new and emerging technologies with ability to rapidly define engineering standards


To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Desire to work in a diverse, fast-paced environment

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent work experience required

  • 1+ years of Information Security experience

  • 3+ years demonstrated ability in an IT Engineering function

  • Thorough knowledge of industry frameworks (NIST, ISO etc.), security fundamentals

  • Technical proficiency in Google Cloud services, hybrid, and on-premise security solutions including Linux and Windows Operating Systems

  • Technical proficiency with writing custom, scripting tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, etc.), interacting with API’s and shell scripting

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Understanding of other technologies required to run a secure, enterprise level infrastructure that adhere to security best practices

  • Excellent time management, organizational, and decision-making skills

  • Ability to document processes, procedures, and security designs clearly and accurately for distribution to internal teams and customers


Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Technical experience in global IT & Security environments

  • At least one technical certification (e.g.CISSP/CISM/CISA, GCP Certification etc.)


What we look for

A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition to learn and passion for delivering security solutions and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.

job.title: Administrative Coordinator
job.description:
Administrative Coordinator

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 PLUS

The Opportunity

FOX 5 DC is seeking an organized, energetic, and service-minded Administrative Coordinator to help keep a fast-moving, multiplatform media operation connected and running smoothly. Reporting to the Office Manager, this role supports department heads and station teams across linear television, digital, streaming, and social media.

As a central coordination point for employees, viewers, visitors, community and business partners, vendors, and guests, you’ll bring a dependable, proactive, and approachable style; work effectively with varied personalities; and manage shifting priorities with sound judgment, discretion, and a positive, solutions-oriented approach.

What You’ll Do

• Support station operations. Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Office Manager, department heads, and station teams, including office operations, schedules, travel, expenses, supplies, mail, deliveries, and special projects.

• Coordinate meetings and calendars. Manage calendars, conference calls, agendas, meeting materials, rooms, technology, and follow-up items; anticipate conflicts and communicate changes promptly.

• Keep communications current. Draft, proofread, format, and distribute station memos, presentations, reports, correspondence, and other communications; maintain the internal Stay Ahead channel so information remains timely, useful, and current.

• Manage vendors and workplace needs. Coordinate vendor setup, invoicing, purchasing, and related activity in Coupa and Graphite Connect; work with vendors, contractors, building contacts, and internal teams on workplace and equipment needs.

• Deliver outstanding service. Support employees, viewers, visitors, guests, community and business partners, and vendors by coordinating access, hospitality, station tours, schedules, and on-site logistics.

• Track and report. Prepare tracking and data-driven reports for station leadership, monitor relevant social media trends and platform activity, organize key information, and provide timely, accurate updates.

• Support community and multiplatform initiatives. Partner with multiple departments to coordinate station events, community partnerships, employee activities, and other promotional or community initiatives across linear, digital, streaming, and social platforms.

• Protect information, strengthen processes, and stay ready to pivot. Maintain organized records and resources, safeguard confidential information, support administrative needs and provide administrative backup as needed, and help strengthen team processes and communication.

What You Bring

• Education and experience. High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, administration, or a related field preferred. Two or more years of progressively responsible administrative support, office coordination, or comparable professional experience.

• Service and communication. Excellent customer service, written and verbal communication, organizational, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with a positive, approachable, and professional demeanor.

• Judgment and follow-through. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently with limited supervision, anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, follow through on details, maintain strict confidentiality, and compile, organize, and communicate tracking information accurately and clearly.

• Technology. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn and regularly use station and Company systems such as Workday, WideOrbit, Coupa, Graphite Connect, collaboration tools, virtual meeting technology, and other evolving business platforms.

• Multiplatform adaptability. Comfortable learning digital, social, and streaming-related tools and adapting to evolving technology and workflows across linear broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media.

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Location & Schedule

This position is fully onsite, with an initial schedule of 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. As a member of the FOX 5 DC Admin team, hours and priorities may shift based on station operations, events, special projects, breaking news, and last-minute needs, including early mornings, late evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Ready to help people, stay one step ahead, and contribute to a fast-moving, multiplatform media operation? Apply today, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX is currently seeking a Senior Director, Broadcast Engineering to join our team in Tempe. In this leadership role, you will lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and continued evolution of cutting-edge broadcast platforms supporting one of the premier national broadcasters.

You will collaborate with leaders across FOX to understand business priorities and future growth plans, translating them into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps. You will also partner with leading technology vendors and service providers to develop solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen reliability, and create long-term business value.

As a technology leader, you will guide the evolution of FOX’s broadcast infrastructure and help shape the transition to next-generation architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will lead and develop high-performing engineering teams while establishing the technical vision, standards, and operating practices needed to deliver exceptional viewer experiences at scale.

The way audiences consume media continues to evolve across televisions, streaming platforms, mobile applications, websites, and emerging distribution channels. At FOX, you will have the opportunity to help define and build the technology that supports this transformation and delivers high-quality experiences to millions of viewers.

Join us at FOX and make your mark as we continue building the future of our media and broadcast operations.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for FOX’s broadcast engineering organization, establishing the vision and multi-year roadmap for broadcast platforms, architecture, and infrastructure
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of broadcast engineering technical experts responsible for building, maintaining, and continually evolving FOX’s technology ecosystem
  • Drive the transition to next-generation broadcast architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments while ensuring solutions meet security, reliability, scalability, and regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate FOX’s technology portfolio against emerging platforms, third-party offerings, and industry trends to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, and innovation
  • Partner with senior leaders across FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX News Media, and other business units to understand strategic priorities and translate business and operational requirements into technology strategies
  • Collaborate with other teams to design and deliver innovative solutions for complex business and technical challenges
  • Establish long-term technology strategies, product development plans, and implementation roadmaps in partnership with engineering, operations, and third-party vendors
  • Provide leadership and oversight for large-scale, highly complex technology programs from architecture and planning through implementation and operational readiness
  • Develop strategic partnerships with technology vendors and service providers, helping influence product direction and ensuring solutions support FOX’s current and future requirements
  • Use data, operational metrics, and performance insights to continuously improve the reliability, efficiency, security, and effectiveness of FOX’s broadcast platforms and engineering organization
  • Establish and monitor meaningful performance measures to align teams around organizational priorities and measurable outcomes
  • Champion operational excellence, including resilient architecture, testing, security, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices that minimize risk and strengthen platform performance
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning, particularly around emerging broadcast, IP, cloud, and media technologies
  • Build leadership capabilities and career development opportunities that attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent
  • Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that empowers teams to solve complex problems, challenge established approaches, and deliver high-quality technology solutions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 10+ years experience leading complex broadcast engineering, media technology, or software and infrastructure organizations, including direct management of leaders and highly technical teams
  • Extensive knowledge of Evertz broadcast infrastructure, systems, and solutions
  • Significant hands-on knowledge of broadcast technology and production environments, including the application of SMPTE 2110, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction across complex systems
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies and multi-year roadmaps for large-scale, business-critical platforms
  • Deep understanding of production video and broadcast operations and the technologies required to support highly available media environments
  • Strong knowledge of major broadcast systems and technology vendors across areas such as graphics, transcoding, playout, master control, video processing, monitoring, and distribution
  • Strong understanding of on-premises, cloud-based, and hybrid compute, networking, and storage infrastructure supporting modern broadcast environments
  • Experience leading major technology transformations and introducing new architectures while maintaining the reliability of critical production systems
  • Proven ability to translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical strategies, architectures, and implementation plans
  • Strong analytical, reasoning, and technical troubleshooting capabilities with the ability to guide teams through highly complex technical challenges
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence senior executives, business leaders, engineering teams, operations teams, and external technology partners
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts and strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience managing multiple complex programs, priorities, and teams in a fast-paced media or technology environment
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing engineering teams and leaders

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience designing or operating cloud-native, IP-based, or software-defined broadcast and media platforms
  • Knowledge of emerging video technologies and formats, including 4K, High Dynamic Range (HDR), and HDR10+
  • Knowledge of broadcast and media industry standards, including Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) and Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers (SMPTE) standards
  • Experience working with emerging technologies and architectures shaping the future of broadcast, streaming, and media distribution
  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its application in a broadcast environment.
