job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Reporting to and primarily supporting the General Counsel, Corporate Legal Affairs, Operations & Technology, the Coordinator will provide proactive executive and operational support to the GC’s office and serve as a central point of coordination for the Corporate Legal Affairs organization. The role will help advance leadership priorities and departmental effectiveness through executive office management, onboarding, recruiting coordination, internal communications, and the coordination of leadership meetings, team events, and department initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for the GC's office, triaging incoming requests and sequencing competing priorities
  • Manage a complex calendar across time zones, prioritizing competing requests and resolving scheduling conflicts with executives and assistants throughout the company
  • Prepare agendas, briefing materials, and presentations for leadership meetings and key stakeholder discussions
  • Track leadership action items and commitments, coordinate follow-up with responsible stakeholders, and escalate delays or issues as appropriate
  • Coordinate department initiatives and special projects by maintaining timelines, organizing meetings, monitoring deliverables, and preparing status updates for leadership
  • Arrange domestic and international travel and maintain detailed itineraries
  • Manage expense reports, purchase requests, invoices, reimbursements, and related records for the GC's office in accordance with company policies
  • Coordinate Corporate Legal Affairs leadership meetings, department meetings, offsites, town halls, and team events
  • Draft and distribute internal communications for Corporate Legal Affairs leadership, and maintain organizational charts, distribution lists, and team pages
  • Coordinate onboarding for new hires and internal transfers, including equipment, systems access, and orientation scheduling
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and recruiting logistics in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers
  • Support team engagement and recognition activities, and serve as a point of coordination with Human Resources, Finance, and other corporate functions on departmental activities and operational matters
  • Handle privileged and confidential information with discretion, and communicate professionally with senior executives, attorneys, and vendors

Basic Requirements:

  • 2+ years of administrative, executive, or operational support experience, preferably supporting a senior executive in a legal, corporate, technology, or media environment
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint
  • Ability to manage competing demands with sound judgment and a high level of responsiveness
  • Exceptional organizational, written communication, and interpersonal skills

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in a corporate legal department, law firm, or professional services environment

Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale

job.title: National News Boats Reporter
job.description:
USATODAY Network is seeking a consumer-focused Boats Reporter to lead coverage for our new national Boats hub. This journalist will create compelling, useful and audience-driven content for people who are considering a boat purchase, enjoy life on the water or are deeply engaged with boats and boating culture.

We’re looking for a boating enthusiast with strong reporting instincts, multimedia storytelling skills and a deep understanding of how to serve three key audience segments:

Boat shoppers and buyers researching models, features, prices and purchasing decisions

Recreationists looking for accessible, practical and inspiring ways to enjoy boating and life on the water

Boating enthusiasts who closely follow new products, innovations, destinations, events and boating culture

This role supports USAT Networks' strategic goal of growing engaged audiences through high-quality, platform-optimized consumer coverage. The reporter will become a leading voice of the Boats hub, producing authoritative journalism while helping establish its identity, audience and programming across multiple platforms.

The reporter will work closely with editors, visual journalists and reporters across the USA TODAY Network to deliver timely, relevant and distinctive coverage. Video will be central to the role. The successful candidate must be comfortable appearing on camera, developing original video concepts and producing content from idea through publication.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position. The role is remote, though candidates may also be based in a USAT local market.

Responsibilities:

Report and write useful, engaging stories for boat shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Develop authoritative buying guidance, product comparisons, explainers and other service journalism that helps consumers make informed decisions

Cover boating news, trends, innovations, destinations, events and culture

Generate original video concepts that complement the hub’s journalism and expand its reach

Report, shoot and produce platform-appropriate video, including on-camera segments, demonstrations, interviews and field reporting

Translate reporting into compelling visual stories for YouTube, social platforms and other video destinations

Pitch timely ideas based on news, seasonal interest, consumer demand, search behavior and audience data

Balance quick-turn coverage with enterprise reporting, distinctive features and recurring franchises

Create content optimized for search, social media, newsletters, video and other audience channels

Build and maintain relationships with boat manufacturers, dealers, industry experts, recreational organizations, boat owners and other relevant sources

Collaborate with journalists across the USA TODAY Network to identify local expertise, expand coverage and maximize reach

Help establish the hub’s editorial voice, coverage priorities and publishing rhythm

Monitor performance metrics and use the results to refine topics, formats, packaging and distribution

What you’ll need to thrive

A genuine passion for boats, boating and life on the water

Strong reporting, writing and news judgment

The ability to make boating approachable to newcomers without losing credibility with experienced enthusiasts

Confidence developing stories around consumer questions and real-world audience needs

Strong video instincts and comfort working both behind and in front of the camera

The ability to identify which ideas are best told through articles, videos, social content or a combination of formats

Familiarity with SEO, social media best practices and audience analytics

Clear, concise writing that avoids unnecessary jargon

An energetic and creative approach to building a new editorial product

The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across a distributed newsroom

Sound judgment when reporting in marinas, on boats and around the water

Requirements

Proven experience in journalism, digital media, video production or a related content field

Excellent reporting, writing, communication and organizational skills

Demonstrated experience creating original video content

Experience shooting and producing video in field environments

Comfort appearing on camera and conducting on-camera interviews

Ability to manage multiple stories and formats in a fast-paced environment

Understanding of audience strategy and digital publishing

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer, pre-employment background check

Preferred qualifications

Experience covering boats, outdoor recreation, travel, consumer products or a related subject

Demonstrated knowledge of boats and boating culture

Experience with video editing and YouTube programming

Experience producing product reviews, demonstrations or comparison content

Familiarity with consumer buying journeys, affiliate-supported content or commerce journalism

Knowledge of newsletter strategy and performance metrics

Experience using audience data to identify and develop coverage opportunities

How success will be measured

Growth in engaged audience across shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Development of a consistent and recognizable voice for the Boats hub

Performance of original video across relevant platforms

Search, social and direct audience growth

Growth in repeat visitation and audience loyalty

Timeliness, usefulness and distinctiveness of coverage

Development of successful recurring topics, formats and franchises

Effective collaboration with journalists across the USA TODAY Network

Use of performance insights to improve coverage and distribution

Application instructions

We’re eager to learn more about you and how you would build an ambitious, consumer-focused Boats hub. When applying, please upload a single PDF document that includes:

Your resume

A cover letter explaining your approach to serving boat shoppers, recreationists and enthusiasts

Links to three to six examples of your reporting, video or other digital work

A brief description of one story or video franchise you would launch for the Boats hub

It is important that these items be assembled into a single document and uploaded in PDF format. Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Associate Director, Creative Membership
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job overview:

The Associate Director, Creative Membership leverages deep music industry knowledge to cultivate and maintain strong relationships within the Atlanta creative community and its surrounding areas. In this role, you will serve as a vital bridge to songwriters, publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, and talent agents. A primary emphasis is placed on enhancing ASCAP's local presence through active on-the-ground engagement, which includes attending live shows, hosting industry mixers, and conducting in-person meetings with ASCAP members and local executives.

This position is based in our Atlanta office and will report to the VP, Creative Membership located in New York. This position currently is subject to ASCAP’s in office policy.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Discovery and development of talent, including songwriters, composers and producers, in the Atlanta and surrounding area.
  • Perform market research and partner closely with the Senior Director to identify, attract, recruit and successfully transition local up-and-coming creators to ASCAP, in order to grow the value of the ASCAP repertory.
  • Support and maintain relationships within the Atlanta and surrounding creative community, including songwriters and publishers, major record labels, entertainment lawyers, managers, an agents.
  • Develop an understanding of ASCAP’s Survey and Distribution System and ASCAP membership policies and procedures, to confidently guide members through membership and distribution related inquiries.
  • Stay informed of, escalating and making viable recommendations to the relevant internal subject matter experts on effectively addressing member needs.
  • Partner with the Marketing & Communications team to plan, curate, and host high-impact member events and recognition initiatives.
  • Act as a brand ambassador of ASCAP by attending industry panels, conferences and events.
  • Collaborate seamlessly across the ASCAP Creative Membership team to share best practices, align regional goals, and unify strategies.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Music Business, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in the Music Industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguous environments, and communicate with ASCAP leadership..
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to represent ASCAP with poise and professionalism across diverse creator and executive groups.
  • Exceptional judgment.
  • Knowledge of and enthusiasm for the Atlanta music industry.
  • Ability to juggle priorities and be a team player.
  • Market research skills.
  • Will be required to travel and attend events, including ASCAP’s membership events, outside of office hours and/or overnight.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office 3 days per week.

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy

Technology & Equipment

  • Execute videoconference stream support including call set-up, end user training, troubleshooting, and escalation follow-through.

  • Proficient in Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Keynote, PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

  • Community Engagement: Build meaningful relationships with viewers and community organizations to identify stories that matter.
  • Newsroom Collaboration: Work closely with anchors, producers, editors, and other journalists to deliver high-quality news coverage.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.

We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Spotify is expanding our Agency development team dedicated to driving new and innovative strategic partnerships with our largest agency partners in France. You will showcase all the technological and data assets available to drive business goals.

The Agency Development Lead will own strategic agency partnerships across the French market. This is not an account management role — you'll architect the agency relationships and commercial frameworks which create opportunities for the FR sales team to activate. You bring deep experience in partnership development and senior agency relationships at the holding company level, with an established track record of building long-term consultative solutions and innovative ways of working with agencies which create value for advertisers.  You have a passion for digital media, music, podcasts and innovation, and you know how to translate that into commercial strategy.

job.title: Senior Manager - Ad Operations
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is seeking a Senior Manager, Ad Operations to join our Revenue Operations organization, reporting to the VP, Revenue Partnerships. This role will support the day-to-day operational execution, reporting, and performance of our global advertising business, ensuring our ad stack, inventory, sales channels, and partner configurations are operating effectively and delivering against revenue goals and commercial commitments.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with experience operating across multiple advertising sales and monetization channels, including programmatic. They are highly organized, able to work independently, and comfortable managing stakeholders across internal teams and external partners. They should also bring an architectural mindset, with the ability to evaluate complex ad-serving systems, identify structural challenges, and recommend scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage day-to-day Google Ad Manager (GAM) operations, platform configuration, governance, and overall ad health
  • Support and troubleshoot advertising across multiple sales and monetization channels, including direct, programmatic, reseller, and partner-driven demand
  • Manage inventory health, forecasting, availability, utilization, delivery, and partner configurations through reporting against budgets, forecasts, commitments, and business goals to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable insights
  • Partner closely with Product & Engineering on ad development, technical integrations, troubleshooting, and platform improvements
  • Coordinate across Sales, Programmatic, Data, and Finance to maintain visibility into performance, risks, priorities, and business needs
  • Support Sales and external partners on technically complex advertising solutions, configurations, and delivery requirements
  • Maintain strong operational documentation, QA standards, and structured workflows

Experience and Background:

  • 5+ years of experience in Ad Operations, Revenue Operations, Ad Technology, Ad Development, or digital advertising
  • Deep hands-on experience with GAM and complex advertising environments across display, video, and audio
  • Experience operating across multiple advertising sales and monetization channels, including direct, programmatic, SSPs, resellers, demand partners, and other partner-led models
  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex advertising systems and translate performance data into actionable insights
  • Ability to assess complex ad-serving architecture, identify configuration or workflow challenges, and design scalable operational solutions
  • Strong working knowledge of Excel, Looker, and BigQuery
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools, automation, and emerging ad technology, with an understanding of how they can improve reporting, troubleshooting, optimization, and operational efficiency
  • Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience partnering with Sales and external advertising partners on technical requirements and operational execution
  • Highly organized, with experience using JIRA, Linear, or similar ticketing systems and maintaining clear operational documentation

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $130,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Job Description

As a Executive Assistant, you will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders, providing high-level administrative and operational support that enables business efficiency and seamless day-to-day execution. This role is ideal for a highly proactive, detail-oriented, and organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, manages multiple priorities with ease, and consistently delivers exceptional service to internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity, you will:

  • Provide executive support by managing complex calendars, coordinating meetings, screening communications, and anticipating the needs of senior leaders.
  • Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries.
  • Prepare, edit, and format confidential documents, reports, correspondence, and executive-level presentations.
  • Maintain organized records, files, and shared repositories, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and effective version control.
  • Partner with Finance to support expense management, budget tracking, purchase requisitions, forecasting inputs, and reporting activities.
  • Coordinate conferences, team events, town halls, offsites, and client meetings, including logistics, vendor management, participant communications, and materials preparation.
  • Act as a key point of contact for internal teams, senior stakeholders, external clients, and vendors, ensuring professional and timely communication.
  • Train and support administrative team members by sharing best practices, tools, and process knowledge.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, increase efficiency, and enhance administrative processes.
  • Provide project coordination support by tracking timelines, monitoring action items, facilitating follow-ups, and escalating risks when appropriate.
  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and digital productivity solutions to streamline administrative workflows, enhance efficiency, support research, content creation, scheduling, and day-to-day business operations.
  • Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Required Qualifications

You're a fit for the role if you have the following qualifications:

  • 3+ years of progressive administrative experience supporting senior leaders or executives in a professional and fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal), with the ability to confidently communicate, prepare documentation, and interact with global stakeholders.
  • Degree in Business Administration, Communications, Executive Assistant Studies, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, and executive priorities.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with a strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Highly proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and take initiative.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks, competing priorities, and changing deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally at all levels of the organization.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Experience coordinating projects, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely follow-up on action items.
  • Strong internet research and information-gathering skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting executives within a global or multinational organization.
  • Experience with expense management systems, travel platforms, and procurement processes.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, OneDrive, and other collaboration tools.
  • Experience coordinating large-scale events, conferences, leadership meetings, or company-wide initiatives.
  • Previous experience mentoring or training administrative professionals.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving process improvements and administrative efficiencies.
  • Ability to thrive in a highly dynamic environment requiring flexibility, adaptability, and strong multitasking skills.
  • Demonstrated interest in and comfort with using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar technologies, to enhance productivity, streamline administrative processes, support research and content creation, and improve day-to-day operational efficiency.

job.description:
Job Description

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira e atuar como Coordenador(a) de Suporte em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se à Thomson Reuters! Nesta oportunidade, você gerenciará um time de suporte técnico ao cliente, buscando excelência de performance através de capacitação, desenvolvimento constante e condução de feedbacks. Você será responsável por apoiar sua equipe no atingimento de metas, reportar resultados à liderança e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e experiência do cliente.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gerenciar um time de suporte técnico ao cliente buscando excelência de performance através de capacitação e desenvolvimento constante e condução de feedbacks individuais.
  • Apoiar o time direto, pares e gerente no atingimento das metas individuais e em equipe, por meio de priorização e planejamento das decisões.
  • Reportar periodicamente à liderança os resultados sob sua responsabilidade, identificando as causas por desvios e propondo ações corretivas e definitivas.
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes.
  • Participar do processo de seleção/admissão de novos colaboradores para o time.
  • Relacionar-se com demais áreas da empresa na busca de reter e melhorar a experiência do cliente.
  • Participar de sessões de discussão de ideias com demais .líderes da área de suporte, identificando e propondo melhorias nos processos e fluxos de atendimento.
  • Desenvolver as aptidões dos colaboradores, tornando-os cada vez mais completos e preparados para o atendimento com excelência.
  • Garantir que as estratégias definidas para o setor sejam aplicadas, auxiliando na busca pelos objetivos do negócio
  • Orientar as decisões por dados que norteiem a tomada de decisão e planos de ação.

Required Qualifications

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, áreas de tecnologia ou correlatas.
  • Experiência com rotinas de Escrita Fiscal e Contabilidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma híbrida em Campinas ou São Paulo.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de atendimento e indicadores de performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experiência na análise e interpretação de dados diversos por meio de excel e/ou dashboards.
  • Conhecimentos em planejamento estratégico.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua.
  • Conhecimento nas soluções Domínio da Thomson Reuters.
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de pessoas (coaching, mentoria).
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Certificações em gestão ou liderança.

#LI-TR1

 

 


O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: Adotamos um ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível para as nossas funções baseadas em escritório, proporcionando uma experiência integrada e coerente tanto no âmbito digital quanto físico.

Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa ""Grow My Way"" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: Oferecemos planos de benefícios abrangentes que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos para o bem-estar mental, físico e financeiro.

  • Impacto Social: Gere um impacto em sua comunidade com nosso Instituto de Impacto Social. Oferecemos a todos colaboradores dois dias de voluntariado pagos anualmente e oportunidades para se envolver em projetos de consultoria pro bono e iniciativas de Meio Ambiente, Sociais e de Governança (ESG).
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: Somos uma das poucas empresas globalmente que auxilia seus clientes na busca por justiça, verdade e transparência. Trabalhando em conjunto com os profissionais e instituições que servimos, contribuímos para sustentar o estado de direito, fomentar o comércio, detectar infratores, relatar os fatos e oferecer informações confiáveis e imparciais para pessoas em todo o mundo.

 

 

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, onde todos têm a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer profissionalmente em ambientes de trabalho flexíveis. Em um momento em que objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência estão sob ataque, estamos comprometidos em buscá-los. Ficou interessado? Faça parte da nossa equipe e contribua para moldar as indústrias que impulsionam o progresso da sociedade.

Como uma empresa global, confiamos no conhecimento único, perspectivas e experiências de todos os colaboradores para cumprir nossos objetivos comerciais. Para garantir que possamos fazer isso, buscamos colaboradores talentosos e qualificados em todas as nossas operações ao redor do mundo, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo/gênero, incluindo gestantes, identidade e expressão de gênero, origem nacional, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, deficiência, idade, estado civil, status de cidadania, ou outra classificação protegida pela lei aplicável.

job.description:
Job Description


We are seeking a high-impact Principal Architect to serve as our central subject matter expert in global e-invoicing, regulatory compliance, and platform architecture. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide reach, operating beyond traditional single-project allocation to influence delivery, pre-sales, and customer strategy. In this role, you will be the definitive go-to authority across all delivery projects, pre-sales engagements, and customer-facing interactions. You will leverage your deep mastery of the Pagero platform, hands-on integration expertise, and understanding of national e-invoicing authorities to solve complex technical challenges, shape strategic solutions, and translate intricate regulatory frameworks into clear, actionable guidance for our teams and clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Cross-Project Advisory & Escalation

  • Serve as the senior technical and functional escalation authority across all active delivery projects, resolving complex platform, integration, and compliance roadblocks.
  • Diagnose and solve the most challenging edge cases across the delivery portfolio, including non-standard ERP configurations, complex data transformation requirements, and multi-country mandate flows.
  • Design and establish reusable reference architectures, standard configuration templates, playbooks, and best-practice frameworks to scale delivery quality and consistency across the organization.

Pre-Sales & Commercial Enablement

  • Act as the dedicated Pagero platform and compliance expert for sales and pre-sales teams, providing deep functional and technical insight without holding direct ownership of SOW creation or pricing.
  • Advise solution architects and pre-sales consultants on platform capabilities, limitations, architectural fit, and feasibility.

  • Review proposed solution designs from pre-sales and delivery teams to ensure technical accuracy, platform feasibility, and regulatory alignment.

Customer Mandate & Regulatory Guidance

  • Act as the trusted advisor for enterprise clients navigating complex global e-invoicing mandates, clearance flows, format specifications (e.g., Peppol, UBL, XML), and government platform integrations.

  • Author and review customer-facing compliance roadmaps, mandate checklists, and country-specific onboarding documentation.

  • Foster continuous skill development across delivery teams through tailored training sessions, hands-on coaching, certification guidance, and internal knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Build, maintain, and expand an internal Pagero Knowledge Base and learning curriculum covering country-specific mandates, integration patterns, and platform updates.
  • Partner with delivery leadership to identify capability gaps across teams and deploy targeted technical enablement initiatives.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Architecture & Advisory Experience: Substantial experience operating in a Lead Architect, Principal Consultant, or Senior Subject Matter Expert capacity across complex enterprise deployments.
  • Pre-Sales Acumen: Demonstrated track record supporting pre-sales teams with technical solution reviews, discovery calls, and RFP responses.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory nuances to both executive business leaders and technical engineering teams.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience directly interfacing or collaborating with national tax authorities, e-invoicing standard bodies, or working groups.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) or structured technical training and onboarding curriculum within an enterprise technology or consulting environment.
  • Relevant industry or architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Cloud Certifications, or ERP-specific accreditations).

job.title: Sr Partner Manager - Legal Corporate Partnerships
job.description:
Job Description

What if your next role made you the architect of how resellers and distributors drive legal sales across the Americas, where your job was to hit a number by building, enabling, and scaling the channel partners that put TR in front of more legal buyers than any direct team could reach?

As a Partner Sales Manager on our Partnerships & Alliances team, you own the reseller and distribution sales execution for our Legal theater in the Americas and carry sales accountability for your assigned market. You turn reseller relationships into customer bookings. You drive sales targets through partner-led sales, co-sell motions, distributor programs, and select direct engagement. You're accountable for hitting your number.

You're responsible for channel sales in your theater. You'll build relationships with the reseller and distributor leaders who control access to law firms, corporate legal departments, and government legal buyers, and you'll support those partners in reaching General Counsel, Legal Operations leaders, and Managing Partners. You'll manage partner performance, onboard and enable new resellers, and close complex deals through the channel. You'll partner with technical resources (Partner Solutions Architects) when needed. You'll work closely with Partner Development Managers (PDMs) to understand partnership strategy, with PSAs to address technical complexity, and with sales leadership to drive theater results.

This is where channel strategy becomes sales. Turn reseller and distribution relationships into customer wins, quarter after quarter.


Key Responsibilities

Theater Ownership & Sales Accountability

  • Own sales execution and bookings targets for the Legal reseller/distribution channel across the assigned Americas theater, using reseller, distributor, co-sell, referral, or direct motions as appropriate.
  • Establish sales governance, manage deal progression, coordinate TR/partner/customer engagement, and maintain accountability for theater performance.
  • Develop theater strategy based on market dynamics, competition, legal buying behavior, customer segments, geography, and optimal reseller coverage.
  • Partner with TR direct account teams to align channel and direct coverage, resolve conflicts, and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Build senior-level relationships with reseller and distributor leaders and help partners engage key legal decision-makers.

Reseller-Led Pipeline & Deal Execution

  • Lead reseller-driven pipeline creation and execution across resale, referral, and co-sell opportunities.
  • Structure integrated TR and reseller solutions, aligning scope, pricing, discounting, positioning, and progression among all parties.
  • Improve deal velocity and win rates by qualifying early, aligning capabilities to customer needs, and removing barriers to close.
  • Manage deal registration, partner attribution, sales marking, forecasting, and reporting for partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities.
  • Oversee quote-to-order execution with resellers and distributors, partnering with Deal Desk, Finance, and Contracts to resolve issues.

Reseller & Distributor Relationship Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day relationship owner for theater resellers and distributors, supporting partnership questions, deals, and execution.
  • Onboard and develop new—including small and emerging—resellers; establish expectations, evaluate fit, and maintain regular communication and business reviews.
  • Enable partners with deal support, joint selling, customer introductions, collateral, training, certifications, demo environments, and field resources.
  • Measure partner performance across bookings, pipeline, certification, deal quality, and customer success; recommend investment, tier, or coverage changes.

Theater Go-to-Market & Operational Excellence

  • Execute theater-specific go-to-market plans, including reseller-enabled demand generation, joint marketing, vertical plays, account-based campaigns, and strategic-account growth plans.
  • Track and report sales, pipeline, win rates, deal size, cycle time, productivity, forecasts, risks, and opportunities; share customer and market insights with leadership, PDMs, PSAs, and Product while representing TR with integrity and customer focus.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in partner or channel sales, reseller or distributor management, alliance management, or enterprise sales, with a record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Demonstrated success selling through resellers, distributors, value-added resellers (VARs), or other indirect channels in B2B software or professional services, including managing partner margin, discount, and pricing structures.
  • Experience executing co-sell and partner-led sales motions with large consulting, technology, or channel partners.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, deal registration, and partner attribution processes, with strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.
  • Core competencies: building relationships with senior executives at partners and enterprise buyers, managing multiple partner relationships across tiers, collaborating across product, marketing, finance, and deal desk teams, and communicating clearly in customer and partner settings.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience selling into legal, tax, audit, or professional services markets, including law firms, corporate legal departments, or government legal buyers.
  • Experience managing channel conflict and partner program structures, such as partner tiers, rebates, incentives, market development funds, and certifications.
  • Familiarity with legal technology or legal information resellers and distributors across the Americas, including regional and language-specific markets.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join our award winning advertising team.

Account Executives provide sales support to our advertising team, across all advertising products (print, digital and podcast), to enable them to spend more time with customers.  As you will have the opportunity to support the team across the entire sales process, this is the perfect opportunity to learn the foundations of how to sell, from how to prepare material for pitches to writing and presenting campaign management reports. 

About the role

  • Administration of various processes related to the sales teams activities
  • Coordinating briefing meetings and advertising bookings
  • Researching the media marketplace reading trade press and relevant business press to increase your understanding
  • Analysing market data to provide competitive insight to arm the sales team with a view on the market 
  • Reporting, produce a monthly analysis with insight and commentary showing what our competitors are doing well and where there are opportunities for us
  • Identifying leads and sharing with the sales team insight into where our customers are advertising across competitor titles
  • Presenting pitches and Post Campaign Analysis to smaller clients with support from the Sales Support Lead. 

 

About You

  • Enjoys learning new skills and working in a fast paced environment
  • Interested in advertising and the media industry and keen to learn more
  • Loves working in an environment that is values driven and customer focused
  • Strong administrative skills and attention to detail
  • Able to multitask and work to tight deadlines, often with short lead times
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good numerical skills and comfortable working with data
  • Responsible, accountable, acts with integrity
  • Proactive, able to work on own initiative whilst being a strong team player

 

The starting salary for this role is £30,000 per annum.

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people at the Guardian. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from BAME candidates and those from other groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media. At the Guardian, many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

How to Apply

Please upload a copy of your latest CV. 

The closing date for applications is 6pm, Thursday 5th November 2025.

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs. Please contact Karen on karen.walter@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

Culture and Wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and Pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

Learning and Development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

job.title: Account Director, Defence
job.description:
Opportunity

Account Directors produce high quality advisory documents demonstrating a deep understanding of clients and issues. You will be regularly providing advice and analysis to clients, and developing an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events. You will manage some key workstreams as well as guiding executives and assistants on the account.

As an Account Director, you will also begin to develop a network and build relationships with clients, media, advisers, Brunswick colleagues and other stakeholders. You will work to develop your media-handling skills and have a good understanding of Brunswick’s different sectors and specialist offers and how to connect them with clients as part of our one firm offering.

About the Role

This role is working within Brunswick’s expanding Defence Sector Group, focussing on Investor Relations and capital market communications. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver media, political, regulatory and market analysis to clients, with intelligent insight and recommendations informed by data, analysis and experience.
  • Manage the development of high-quality client documents, playing a key role in drafting, proofing, editing and version control, along with seamless project management of client workstreams.
  • Guide executives and assistants in effectively supporting accounts.
  • Work to develop a solid understanding of different sectors and specialist offers.
  • Ensure all logistics for client meetings and events are executed smoothly and manage upwards to ensure Brunswick delivers on time and above expectation.
  • Begin to develop an advisory voice informed by research, experience and awareness of market trends and events.
  • Nurture a network amongst peers inside and outside the firm, providing valuable insight for the firm and for clients.

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly knowledgeable on business issues and current affairs; up to date on key trends, issues, commentators and debates, particularly as it relates to the investor community.
  • 2-5 years’ experience ideally working in the German aerospace and defence sectors as well as in relevant policy areas – with the potential to further expand it.
  • Experience in report writing (English/German), presentation preparation, stakeholder analysis and social media.
  • Able to demonstrate excellent written research and analysis for business audiences; must be able to synthesize large amounts of intelligence across numerous sources in a timely but thoughtful manner.
  • Proven project and/or program management experience, with the ability to oversee multiple fast-moving workstreams at any one time.
  • A dynamic self-starter with a strong work ethic.
  • High level of attention to detail and an intellectually rigorous, client-service attitude.
  • An experienced team-worker who prefers to work in a collegiate way.

Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

Brunswick is committed to transparent and equitable pay practices. Information regarding the salary range and overall compensation package for this role will be made available to candidates during the recruitment process and may be requested at any stage prior to interview.

 

About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. 

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. 

 

Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.

job.description:
Associate Director / Director, Strategy & Reputation, Energy & Sustainability (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)

About the Role

The Strategy & Reputation team works across the full breadth of corporate communications - from campaign strategy and issues management to corporate narrative, stakeholder engagement and sustainability communications. We deliver multi-channel, multi-stakeholder programmes for some of the world's leading companies, working fluidly with colleagues across public affairs, digital, crisis, financial communications and research. Our Energy & Sustainability capability is one of the fastest-growing areas of the practice – advising leading philanthropic groups, coalitions, start-ups and major businesses.

We are seeking an Associate Director or Director to join our London team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering a period of parental leave. The successful candidate will be an energetic, delivery-focused S&R generalist - ideally with some energy or sustainability experience - who can integrate quickly into an active team, hold accounts confidently and bring a campaigner's mindset to their work. The role also includes support for senior team members, and offers genuine exposure across a broad range of clients and issues.

Seniority level: Associate Director or Director (approximately 5-9 years' experience)
Contract type: 12-month fixed-term contract
Location: London

What You'll Do

Client Delivery

  • Manage / support a portfolio of client accounts on a day-to-day basis, working closely with senior and junior colleagues - including clients operating in energy, sustainability and regulated industries
  • Development and delivery of communications strategies across a range of issue types - campaign planning, corporate reputation, stakeholder engagement, and issues management
  • Develop high-quality client materials - strategy documents, messaging frameworks, briefing notes, reactive lines, sustainability narratives and stakeholder communications
  • Influence the conversations clients care about through the media, online and through partnerships with think tanks, influencers etc.
  • Monitor and interpret the media, policy and regulatory environment for clients - particularly across the energy transition, net zero and sustainability agenda - flagging relevant developments and helping shape client responses
  • Build and maintain strong media relationships across relevant beats, including energy, environment, business and policy, and proactively identify opportunities for clients

Business Development

  • Contribute to, and where appropriate lead, new business pitches and proposals, bringing sector knowledge and fresh thinking
  • Build your network proactively - with media, intermediaries and potential clients - with an eye on longer-term business development

Team and Culture

  • Mentor and help develop more junior colleagues on a day-to-day basis
  • Contribute to team culture - sharing ideas, insights and enthusiasm for the work
  • Engage with team initiatives on diversity, inclusion and belonging

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Solid experience in a corporate communications or S&R consultancy environment, with confidence managing accounts and client relationships
  • Strong generalist communications skills - able to move fluidly between corporate narrative, issues management, stakeholder engagement and campaign strategy
  • Exposure to energy, climate or sustainability-related communications briefs - whether in agency, in-house or on specific campaign mandates
  • A campaigner's mindset: experience developing and delivering communications campaigns across multiple channels and stakeholder groups
  • Strong writing skills - clear, precise and adaptable across different formats and audiences, including on technical or policy-heavy subjects
  • An ability to get up to speed quickly, work independently and integrate into an established team without a long runway
  • Proactive approach to media - with developing relationships across relevant beats, including energy, environment and business, and an instinct for creating opportunities

Preferred

  • Familiarity with the policy and regulatory landscape around net zero, the energy transition or environmental reporting
  • Experience supporting business development activity within a team
  • Genuine curiosity about energy, sustainability and the policy environment surrounding the energy transition - and comfort engaging with complex, multi-stakeholder briefs in this space

About FGS Global

FGS Global is the strategic leadership advisory for a complex world. With expertise in strategic and financial communications, policy and public affairs, and data-driven digital engagement, we help leaders align and activate stakeholders, shape and safeguard reputations, and succeed in critical moments. Across 31 global offices, our partners draw on the full depth of the firm so clients can operate with clarity, act with confidence, and lead with trust.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (pro-rated for contract duration)
  • Private medical insurance and life assurance
  • Pension contributions
  • 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays (pro-rated)
  • Access to firm-wide professional development programmes

Professional Development

We are committed to the professional growth of everyone who joins us, including on fixed-term contracts. You will have access to structured learning opportunities and development support throughout your time with us.

FGS Global is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

job.title: Head of Culture Activation
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

The Head of Culture Activation will play a pivotal role in shaping how WPP works, collaborates and delivers for its clients. As part of the Elevate28 transformation, this role will turn WPP’s strategy and values into meaningful, everyday behaviours, helping create a more connected, accountable and enterprise-first culture.

From leading the global culture diagnostic and developing the WPP Global Culture Playbook, to activating True One WPP and building a global community of Cultural Ambassadors, this role will drive culture change at scale. The focus is clear: embed the behaviours that strengthen collaboration, client obsession, constructive candour, psychological safety and AI confidence across WPP.

What you'll be doing:

The Head of Culture Activation owns the cultural strategy and frameworks that bring WPP’s culture to life across the employee experience. The role leads culture diagnostics, behavioural frameworks, activation campaigns and ambassador programmes to build a shared, enterprise-wide identity and consistent ways of working.   Key Responsibilities

  • Shape WPP’s cultural framework: Define the behaviours and ways of working that bring True One WPP and Elevate28 to life, translating enterprise values into clear, observable behaviours across the organisation.

  • Lead culture insight and measurement: Drive WPP’s global culture diagnostic across operating units and regions, using insights and data to understand progress, identify priorities and measure cultural transformation.

  • Create the WPP Global Culture Playbook: Develop practical frameworks and tools that enable leaders, managers and employees to embed WPP’s culture into everyday decision-making, collaboration and client delivery.

  • Drive enterprise-wide culture activation: Lead the True One WPP campaign and wider culture initiatives, using leadership storytelling, communications and employee experiences to create meaningful and sustained behaviour change.

  • Strengthen collaboration and high performance: Embed enterprise-first thinking, client obsession, constructive candour, psychological safety and AI confidence, while creating frameworks that encourage greater collaboration across WPP.

  • Build a global Cultural Ambassador network: Establish and empower a community of Cultural Ambassadors who champion WPP’s culture locally, strengthen connections across the organisation and accelerate new ways of working.

  • Embed culture throughout the employee experience: Ensure WPP’s culture is reflected from day one, including executive and employee onboarding, manager toolkits and key employee touchpoints.

  • Own the Cultural Transformation Roadmap: Develop and oversee a three-year roadmap, establishing clear milestones and measures of progress while monitoring adoption, change readiness and transformation fatigue.

  • Deliver measurable first-year impact: Establish the global culture diagnostic, behavioural framework, Culture Playbook, True One WPP activation campaign, Cultural Ambassador network and the longer-term transformation roadmap.

What you'll need:

  • Significant culture and transformation leadership experience, with a track record of shaping and embedding culture, values and behaviours across complex, global organisations.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale cultural change, bringing together diverse businesses, teams and identities around a shared enterprise culture and ways of working.
  • Strong senior stakeholder credibility and influence, with the confidence to partner with executive leaders and navigate complex, matrixed environments.
  • Deep expertise in culture activation and employee engagement, using compelling campaigns, storytelling and change strategies to turn cultural ambition into meaningful behaviour change.
  • A data-led approach, with experience using culture insights, employee feedback and behavioural measures to track progress and inform transformation priorities.
  • The ability to drive change at pace, balancing ambitious transformation goals with employee engagement, organisational readiness and change fatigue.
  • A collaborative, enterprise-first mindset, with the ability to break down organisational silos and build a strong, authentic sense of shared identity across diverse global teams.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Job Overview:

This position is part of the Digital Media department, which oversees CBC and Radio-Canada’s flagship digital products.


In partnership with the Media Solutions division, the person in this role plays a key role in shaping the vision for CBC-RC monetization experience evolution. They leverage a deep understanding of digital, user behaviours, market trends, and technology to inform strategic thinking and guide product direction.  They also will support the day to day audience segmentation activities and support and inform the monetization data strategy and roadmaps.


They lead the monetization products evolution — from testing to discovery to delivery — balancing user needs with business objectives. They collaborate with product managers to coordinate the work carried out by the product teams. They maintain strong ties with the sales, marketing, communications, and ad tech teams to ensure strategic and operational alignment.


This role also aims to create synergies across products to strengthen engagement within Radio-Canada’s broader digital ecosystem. The individual actively contributes to the organization’s digital transformation initiatives.

  • You are responsible for leading and evolving the organizations ability to drive revenue through the creation and maintenance of innovative ad products and services.  
  • You are responsible for developing a strategic roadmap that aligns to the strategic priorities of the Media Solutions (Sales) team, by identifying and executing on the highest priorities.
  • You enable the evolution of ad formats, the integration of technologies within the ad tech stack, the evolution of the data strategy and the enablement of key features and improvements for our users.
  • You establish a testing practice that is continuously finding ways to improve the existing ad experience with new ad loads, scenarios by user type and ad formats to adopt.
  • You are in lock step with the strategy of the Media Solutions team.  The products that your teams develop are relevant in the market and sellable.  
  • You enable real collaboration between your stakeholders and the product teams focusing them on solving problems together.  
  • You are the main point of accountability and escalation to Media Solutions as it relates to product development. 
  • You coach and mentor a cross functional team of product managers, data analysts and data experts.

This role requires a proactive and collaborative leader who acts as a crucial link between technical possibilities and business needs:


  • Problem Solver & Roadblock Remover: key to understanding what is possible, navigating the entire team around roadblocks, and creating options and alternatives to respond to business problems
  • Collaborative Leader: creates a positive and collaborative space that fosters deeper understanding between supported teams, often by facilitating meetings as forums for problem-solving
  • Clarity & Accountability: key to creating clarity on the roadmap, ensuring decisions are made, and escalating effectively to clear the path on execution
  • Efficiency Driver: focused on making things easier, faster, smoother, and better, including filling gaps personally with conversations and trackers, and coaching resources on performance
  • Client Service Mindset: sets high standards, seeks out feedback, acts on it, and ensures teams are serving stakeholders appropriately
  • Action-Oriented & Transparent: strongly biased towards action, pushing for ways forward with personal involvement over passing the buck. Works transparently, ensuring risks are appropriately distributed across all decision makers rather than made in silos
  • Product Leader: reinforces basic product principles, helps teams find effective ways forward, emphasizing the quest for value over increments of work

How you will make an impact:


  • You will work closely with your partners in Media Solutions - from Ad Tech, Ad Operations and Data Monetization to understand their needs to deepen the nature of the relationship.  You will invest the time in understanding their strategic roadmaps and the most important problems to solve.  
  • You will work closely with a team of product managers to ensure that roadmaps reflect the priorities and needs of the stakeholders and you will make sure the teams are focused on the right things.  You will make sure that the product teams are delivering real value to your stakeholders.
  • You will enable the generation of revenue through the activation of audiences first party data.  

Candidate Qualifications:


  • Minimum of five to seven (5 to 7) years of progressive leadership within the media or advertising industry
  • Deep expertise in advertising, digital transformation, and multi-platform consumer behaviour
  • Demonstrated adaptability in dynamic environments with the resilience to navigate ambiguity and lead organizational change
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills; bilingual proficiency in French and English is highly desirable
  • Superior relationship management skills with a proven ability to influence senior executives through diplomacy and strategic negotiation
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and high-pressure deadlines with operational excellence

This role described below is part of CBC’s CAPE program which is specifically for people with disabilities*. CAPE is a six-month paid placement program that aims to kick-start the careers of people with disabilities, eliminate barriers to employment, showcase individual talents and generate more discussion, learning and content related to disability, accessibility and inclusion.

The program will run from January 11 until June 25, 2027.


What do you need to be eligible?

  • You must self-identify as a person with a disability*. 
  • You must have no prior long-term work experience with the CBC. 
  • You must be able to work legally in Canada.  
  • You must be available for the assigned workweek during the program, to be discussed during the interview process (up to 38.75 hours-some roles have more flexibility).

*The Accessible Canada Act definition of disability:

“means any impairment, including a physical, mental, intellectual, cognitive, learning, communication or sensory impairment—or a functional limitation—whether permanent, temporary or episodic in nature, or evident or not, that, in interaction with a barrier, hinders a person’s full and equal participation in society." 


Please note by applying for this role you give consent to be recognized as a “CAPE participant” and as identifying as a person with a disability. No further information will be shared without your permission.

Part of the CAPE program includes attending weekly online group meetings with other CAPE participants. These meetings will be scheduled with your manager’s approval.

The ideal candidate is a curious and enthusiastic team player who is passionate about local news and current events, and is keen to learn more about your community.
