Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-05 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This role requires full-time on-site presence.

 

The Opportunity

 

We are looking for a Broadcast and IT Systems Specialist to support the studio, content creation, and presentation groups with technical issues as well as help implement groundbreaking technologies across our sites. From the virtualization of services to the implementation of video-over-IP and beyond, to the introduction of centralized and automated workflows, your input will impact CBC/Radio Canada across the country.

Every day your hands-on knowledge, your growing expertise, your problem-solving skills and your ability to translate technical issues will be called into play as you work closely with clients facing issues with content creation, backend systems, studios and control rooms. Your patience, sense of urgency and responsiveness will ensure that our content is prepped, scheduled and on the air or digitally available.

 

Who you are and where are you now?

 

You may be a Computer Science or Electronics grad with interest in working at the cutting edge of media and broadcast technology from cloud services to video-over-IP. Or, you may be an industry or technical analyst elsewhere seeking an opportunity to join a nationally respected brand and organization where you can grow your career.

 

What’s in it for you?

 

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems on an unbelievable scale. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. This is an opportunity to learn and work with the most cutting-edge broadcast infrastructure in the world. There is nothing else out there like this, at this scale...yet. You will be an expert in the industry and you will continue to grow and expand your skills as you install, configure, test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, update and modify equipment, software, systems and facilities ensuring their proper operating condition and optimal performance.

 

Be part of the change. Right now we are looking for people who can execute our strategy. Innovators who want to push future-forward thinking. Builders who want to be hands-on, building the next generation of media technology for the CBC/Radio-Canada audience. We want to hear the ideas, see the designs and implement the innovations brought to us by our teams. You want to be part of a team actively transforming the workspace for every individual at CBC/Radio-Canada. Our priority is to proactively and in-the-moment solve problems and ensure the users can engage with new functionalities, new tools and conduct their day-to-day work seamlessly.

 

Cutting-edge tech. Data management. Virtualization. IP for broadcast. AI. Security and reliability. The road ahead changes every day. By joining us now, you will become both pioneer and expert with a highly specialized, in-demand skill-set as you help us take steps towards the next frontier of media. As the official providers of technology to CBC/Radio-Canada, you will be joining the team that touches the latest technologies. You will work closely with vendor and internal partners across the organization. You will contribute ideas, develop methods and make recommendations to overcome problems, achieve desired results and permit better utilization of equipment.

 

Why join us?

 

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. We offer a rare-in-tech work-life balance with an excellent benefits package and a pension plan noted as one of the best in the country; we want to ensure you are happy in and out of the office.

 

We are a dynamic, in-flux team, brimming with potential. There’s a lot of exciting work ahead of us and while we aren’t there yet, we have a plan. Our focus is fulfilling our mandate to exceed audience expectations. We weigh our options, research, explore and evaluate. When we make a decision, we follow through with purpose. We don’t have one static future ahead of us, but a fluid set of options. This means a chance to be part of that change whether you are an idea generator or an executor.

 

What You Bring:

  • The education. You have a diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Broadcast, or a related field.
  • The experience. You have a general understanding and knowledge of computers, networking, IP infrastructure and maintenance of equipment, systems and relevant software technologies. You are familiar with Windows Server Systems, MacOS and Linux.
  • The extra skills. You may have exposure to managing backend systems, databases and remote support of server systems.
  • The interest. You want to learn more about audio, video and TV & Radio Broadcast networks.
  • The communication skills. You are skilled at communicating effectively with internal partners, relaying your opinions with sensitivity. You know how to listen and you understand perspectives. You can expertly analyze and synthesize information and document technical specifications.
  • The positive, collaborative attitude. You can work in a stressful and demanding environment of a production centre, in carrying out its duties effectively under tight deadlines while providing quality work and maintaining a professional and positive attitude.
  • The relationship building finesse. You are empathetic and patient. You understand the user perspective and your priority is providing rapid, stable solutions and support. You are guided by a sense of urgency. You can nurture strong two-way relationships with peers, partners, clients, staff, senior managers and vendors.
  • The analytical skills and creativity. You can think through issues and innovate solutions. You are proactive and creative in your approach. You are a problem-solver, a researcher and a detail-oriented planner.
  • The bridging capability. You work on the cutting edge of technology and pick up new tools quickly. You are aware of modern, best practices and you thrive in an agile environment. You understand how to dig into issues, remove the roadblocks and present solutions both immediate and long-term.
  • The flexibility. You are willing to work as part of an on-site rotating shift (day, evening and overnight).

Minneapolis/St. Paul, Minnesota, United States

Apply

Business Unit

Full Time Regular

About Us

KSTP 5 Eyewitness News is the award-winning ABC network affiliate for the Twin Cities. Part of Hubbard Broadcasting, KSTP-TV is a longtime market leader, and is committed to excellence in all that it does-broadcast news with hyper-local coverage, important public service that deals powerfully with today's issues, and now, more than ever, top-notch digital content, to reach our viewers and followers with information the way they want to receive it. When you work for KSTP, or our other local, independently operated station KSTC, Channel 45, you will find yourself among dedicated, passionate people who work hard every day to improve our product and our community. If you have the qualifications, and you are a person of talent and integrity, we invite you to apply!

Job Overview

This position is primarily responsible for studio production and maintenance, lighting, and audio operation. From time to time may direct automated newscast or technical direct live and pre-recorded production.

Job Responsibilities

Studio

Operate with proficiency handheld television camera for in studio and live remote productions.

Program and operate robotic cameras and Smart Shell program.

Operate VOICE teleprompter,

Understand audio equipment in the studio at a satisfactory level and with confidence during live and taped shows.

Complete knowledge of the lighting systems in all studios

Respond to all cues given over headset and in person during shows. Must react quickly and efficiently to cues and other directions. Act as a critical communication link between director and talent. Reports any concerns.

Take care of all aspects of studio maintenance, which includes cleaning, repair, set up, tear down and storage of studio and related items; routine inspection, monitoring performance and basic trouble shooting of equipment. Maintain studio lighting and other studio supplies. Follow proper protocol for notifying other personnel when items are needed or there are problems or failures. Studio Cleanliness includes Studio A, Studio C, Twin Cities Live studio, the production area and storage areas.

On a daily basis provides assistance to and provides input about the show.

Audio

Under the direction of the director, correctly/accurately switch all audio going through the audio booth. Work ahead to insure that all elements needed during your shift are ready to go.

Control the quality of the audio going through the audio booth. Insure that all elements of the audio are at the proper level. Insure that the balance between microphones, music, and videotape sources are mixed and at a proper relationship with each other.

Ready at the audio position during assigned shift to handle any audio needs, especially during times of breaking news.

Help with coverage of special events and with the coverage of audio during vacations and other times when no audio operator is available.

Qualifications:

job.title: Baseball Operations Trainee
job.description:
Overview:

The Baseball Operations Trainee is a seasonal, part-time position designed to provide hands-on stadium operations and event management experience for individuals interested in a career in professional sports. The trainee supports Durham Bulls games and other events across guest services, hospitality, parking, facility management, and event operations. The position generally runs between February and September for approximately four to seven months, depending on the candidate's availability and organizational needs. Hours vary based on the event schedule and include evenings, weekends, and holidays.


Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Supports the setup, operation, and breakdown of Durham Bulls games and other stadium events.

Assists with guest services by answering questions, providing directions, and helping resolve concerns in a professional manner.

Supports hospitality operations, including preparing event spaces and assisting with guest and group needs.

Assists with parking operations and helps maintain safe, organized pedestrian and vehicle flow.

Completes facility preparation, inspections, light cleaning, and event reset tasks as assigned.

Monitors assigned areas during events and promptly communicates safety, facility, or guest-service concerns to a supervisor.

Works with full-time staff, seasonal employees, vendors, and other departments to support efficient event execution.

Follows established safety procedures, stadium policies, and emergency protocols.

Maintains a flexible, team-oriented approach while rotating among operational assignments.

Performs other duties as required or assigned, provided they are reasonably related to the responsibilities outlined in this job description.


Required Qualifications: 

High school diploma or equivalent.

Strong customer-service and verbal communication skills.

Ability to follow instructions, exercise sound judgment, and work effectively with limited supervision.

Strong organizational skills, dependability, and attention to detail.

Ability to adapt to changing assignments and work collaboratively in a fast-paced event environment.

Availability to work a variable schedule that includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and most scheduled events during the assignment.

Ability to use basic communication tools, including email, mobile applications, and two-way radios, after training.

Ability to comply with Durham Bulls and Capitol Broadcasting Company safety and workplace policies.

No specific professional sports experience is required.


Preferred Qualifications:

Current enrollment in or recent completion of a sport management, hospitality, event management, business, or related program.

Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, athletics, live events, facilities, or venue operations.

Experience working collaboratively in a team-based environment.

Interest in pursuing a career in professional sports or event operations.

Familiarity with event-day operations or guest-service standards.


Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. 

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events.

Ability to move throughout the ballpark, including stairs, ramps, concourses, seating areas, and service spaces.

Ability to bend, crouch, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive event setup and breakdown tasks.

Ability to lift and carry equipment, supplies, or materials weighing up to 50 pounds, with assistance when appropriate.

Clear vision and hearing sufficient to communicate with guests and coworkers and respond to activity in a live-event environment.


Work Conditions: The work conditions and characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. 

Work is performed throughout the ballpark in indoor and outdoor areas and may involve heat, cold, rain, humidity, and changing weather conditions.

The event environment may include crowds, elevated noise levels, bright lights, and frequent interaction with the public.


Schedules vary based on games and events and may include long shifts, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

A pre-employment drug screening is required.

Capitol Broadcasting Company, Inc. is a diversified communications company which owns and/or operates WRAL-TV, WRAZ-TV, WRAL-FM, WRAL-HD2, WNGT-CD, WCMC-FM, WCMC-HD1, WDNC-AM, WCMC-HD2, WCMC-HD3, WCLY-AM, WCMC-HD4, Microspace, and WRAL Digital in Raleigh, NC; WILM-TV, WILT-LD and Sunrise Broadcasting in Wilmington, NC; The Durham Bulls Baseball Club, Bull City Hospitality, and Coastal Plain League in Durham, NC; The Holly Springs Salamanders in Holly Springs, NC; the American Underground startup hub in Durham, NC; and real estate interests including the American Tobacco Historic District in Durham, NC; Rocky Mount Mills in Rocky Mount, NC; MoJud Lofts in Greensboro, NC; and The Thread in Rock Hill, SC.

job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Administrative Coordinator

FOX Television Stations – FOX 5 DC / FOX 5 PLUS

The Opportunity

FOX 5 DC is seeking an organized, energetic, and service-minded Administrative Coordinator to help keep a fast-moving, multiplatform media operation connected and running smoothly. Reporting to the Office Manager, this role supports department heads and station teams across linear television, digital, streaming, and social media.

As a central coordination point for employees, viewers, visitors, community and business partners, vendors, and guests, you’ll bring a dependable, proactive, and approachable style; work effectively with varied personalities; and manage shifting priorities with sound judgment, discretion, and a positive, solutions-oriented approach.

What You’ll Do

• Support station operations. Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Office Manager, department heads, and station teams, including office operations, schedules, travel, expenses, supplies, mail, deliveries, and special projects.

• Coordinate meetings and calendars. Manage calendars, conference calls, agendas, meeting materials, rooms, technology, and follow-up items; anticipate conflicts and communicate changes promptly.

• Keep communications current. Draft, proofread, format, and distribute station memos, presentations, reports, correspondence, and other communications; maintain the internal Stay Ahead channel so information remains timely, useful, and current.

• Manage vendors and workplace needs. Coordinate vendor setup, invoicing, purchasing, and related activity in Coupa and Graphite Connect; work with vendors, contractors, building contacts, and internal teams on workplace and equipment needs.

• Deliver outstanding service. Support employees, viewers, visitors, guests, community and business partners, and vendors by coordinating access, hospitality, station tours, schedules, and on-site logistics.

• Track and report. Prepare tracking and data-driven reports for station leadership, monitor relevant social media trends and platform activity, organize key information, and provide timely, accurate updates.

• Support community and multiplatform initiatives. Partner with multiple departments to coordinate station events, community partnerships, employee activities, and other promotional or community initiatives across linear, digital, streaming, and social platforms.

• Protect information, strengthen processes, and stay ready to pivot. Maintain organized records and resources, safeguard confidential information, support administrative needs and provide administrative backup as needed, and help strengthen team processes and communication.

What You Bring

• Education and experience. High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, communications, administration, or a related field preferred. Two or more years of progressively responsible administrative support, office coordination, or comparable professional experience.

• Service and communication. Excellent customer service, written and verbal communication, organizational, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, with a positive, approachable, and professional demeanor.

• Judgment and follow-through. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently with limited supervision, anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, follow through on details, maintain strict confidentiality, and compile, organize, and communicate tracking information accurately and clearly.

• Technology. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn and regularly use station and Company systems such as Workday, WideOrbit, Coupa, Graphite Connect, collaboration tools, virtual meeting technology, and other evolving business platforms.

• Multiplatform adaptability. Comfortable learning digital, social, and streaming-related tools and adapting to evolving technology and workflows across linear broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media.

Benefits

• Comprehensive package. Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match.

• Lifestyle perks. Access to an onsite fitness center, vibrant local dining, and shopping options.

Work Location & Schedule

This position is fully onsite, with an initial schedule of 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. As a member of the FOX 5 DC Admin team, hours and priorities may shift based on station operations, events, special projects, breaking news, and last-minute needs, including early mornings, late evenings, weekends, and holidays.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
abc27 (WHTM-TV) is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to join our Sales team in Harrisburg, PA. This position plays a key role in driving digital revenue growth, strengthening advertiser relationships, and developing strategic marketing solutions that deliver measurable business results.


The Strategic Account Manager serves as the station's digital advertising expert and strategic partner to our Account Executives. Combining consultative selling, digital marketing expertise, and data-driven insights, this individual works alongside the Sales team throughout the customer lifecycle, from prospecting and developing proposals to evaluating campaign performance, retaining advertisers, and identifying opportunities for growth. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, analytical professional who can translate complex digital advertising capabilities into effective marketing strategies that help clients achieve their business objectives.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities


  • Partner with Account Executives to develop and execute customized digital advertising strategies that align with client objectives, target audiences, and measurable business goals.
  • Support station digital revenue goals by identifying opportunities for new business, account growth, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Serve as the station's subject matter expert on digital advertising products, audience targeting, campaign analytics, attribution, and emerging digital marketing technologies.
  • Conduct market research, audience analysis, and account planning to identify opportunities and develop strategic recommendations for advertisers.
  • Participate in client discovery meetings, sales presentations, and business reviews to provide digital marketing expertise and strategic guidance.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop compelling proposals, audience recommendations, and integrated advertising solutions across digital and broadcast platforms.
  • Analyze advertising campaign performance, interpret key metrics, and translate results into actionable recommendations that improve client outcomes.
  • Lead strategic performance discussions with advertisers to demonstrate return on investment, address concerns, and recommend opportunities for continued growth.
  • Proactively identify potential campaign performance issues, client retention risks, and opportunities to improve advertising effectiveness.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with advertisers by providing consultative guidance, industry insights, and recommendations that support long-term business partnerships.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Research, Ad Operations, and Digital Services teams to ensure alignment between advertising strategies, campaign execution, and client expectations.
  • Provide training, coaching, and ongoing support to Account Executives on digital advertising solutions, consultative selling techniques, and the effective use of research and performance data.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, competitive developments, emerging technologies, and changes in digital advertising to identify new opportunities for the station and its advertisers.
  • Contribute to improved advertiser retention, digital revenue growth, sales conversion, and overall effectiveness of the station's digital sales initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Skills


  • Minimum of two years of experience in digital marketing, media sales, strategic account management, advertising strategy, consultative selling, or a related field, or equivalent education and work experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital advertising solutions, audience targeting, campaign optimization, performance marketing, analytics, and attribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, present, and recommend strategic marketing solutions that drive measurable business results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex digital advertising concepts to clients and internal teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret campaign performance data and develop actionable business recommendations.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain positive client relationships, identify growth opportunities, and contribute to customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Strong presentation and consultative selling skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with advertisers, sales professionals, and station leadership.
  • Experience working with customer relationship management (CRM) systems, digital analytics platforms, audience research tools, and performance reporting systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and resolving challenges.
  • Willingness to stay current with emerging digital advertising technologies, industry trends, and evolving marketing strategies.
  • Previous experience in television, broadcast media, digital advertising, advertising agencies, or related media environments preferred.

job.title: Multi-Platform Producer
job.description:
Multi-Platform Producers are platform-agnostic storytellers who focus on delivering the strongest version of a story regardless of platform. They evaluate each story and determine the most effective format, presentation, and distribution strategy to inform, engage, and serve audiences wherever they consume content.

 

This role plays a key part in maximizing audience engagement by curating, packaging, prioritizing, and presenting content strategically and compellingly across all platforms. Working closely with managers and other newsroom teams, Multi-Platform Producers write and edit content, create graphics and promotional elements, oversee live and recorded content feeds, and ensure stories are presented accurately, effectively, and in ways that connect with audiences.

 

The ideal candidate is a creative storyteller with an understanding of audience behavior, content presentation, and multi-platform publishing. Candidates should have an understanding of, or a willingness to learn, the journalistic principles that guide our approach to content creation. Under the supervision of managers, all content is developed through a lens of accuracy, credibility, fairness, and audience service while embracing innovative storytelling techniques.

 

At WTNH, Multi-Platform Producers are not assigned to a single platform. They are responsible for evaluating content and determining how it can best inform, engage, and serve audiences across digital, social, and emerging platforms.

 

This will be a regular, full-time, non-union, non-exempt position. Schedule will be flexible but may include evenings, weekends, and holidays.

●Write, edit and produce audience-first, engaging storytelling through digital articles, videos, social media, push alerts, live streams, and interactive elements

●Work with all newsroom team members on content coverage and digital-broadcast coordination

●Distribute local content to national outlets and other Nexstar Digital platforms across the country

●Other duties as assigned by manager

 

Qualifications


●Experience writing, producing, or publishing content using journalistic standards.

●Proficiency in Associated Press style and Adobe Photoshop and/or Adobe Express

●Strong writing, copy-editing, and headline-writing skills.

●Understanding of digital, streaming, and social media content strategies.

●Ability to learn new technology and applications independently and quickly

●Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a team environment.

●Strong news judgment and attention to detail.

●Regularly meets measurements of success.

job.title: IT Support Specialist
job.description:
Nexstar Media Group, Inc. – Springfield Broadcast Hub Location: Springfield, Massachusetts 

Department: Broadcast Hub Operations & Technology 

Position Type: Full-Time 

 

Position Summary 

Nexstar Media Group is seeking a skilled and motivated IT Support Specialist for our Springfield Broadcast Hub. This position is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and supporting IT systems and network infrastructure within a mission-critical, 24/7 television broadcast operation. 

 

The ideal candidate will have a strong IT background, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with Broadcast Engineering, Operations, Management, and corporate IT to ensure system reliability and operational continuity. 

 

Core Responsibilities 

IT Systems Administration & Support 

 

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows workstations, servers, software, and peripherals. 
  • Utilize endpoint management solutions, including ManageEngine Endpoint Central (MEC), for security updates, software deployments, scheduled reboots, and patch compliance monitoring. 
  • Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, user accounts, access permissions, and Bitwarden password management deployment and ongoing support. 
  • Perform preventative maintenance, system upgrades, and hardware replacements. 

 

Network & Infrastructure Support 

 

  • Work closely with corporate IT to troubleshoot network connectivity, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and related infrastructure issues. 
  • Assist with network infrastructure installation and maintenance, including Ethernet cabling, RJ45 connector termination, and fiber optic cable installation and handling. 
  • Maintain clean, organized, and professional cable management throughout the facility, including equipment racks, patch panels, and workstations. 
  • Assist with network monitoring and proactively identify potential infrastructure issues. 

 Broadcast Engineering Collaboration 

 

  • Provide IT support for computer-based broadcast systems, media management platforms, and operational workstations. 
  • Coordinate maintenance and upgrades with Broadcast Engineering to minimize disruptions to live broadcasting. 
  • Participate in cross-training to develop familiarity with broadcast technologies and workflows while sharing IT knowledge and technical skills with Broadcast Engineering personnel. 

 

Documentation & System Management 

 

  • Maintain accurate IT asset inventories and documentation of system configurations, maintenance activities, and troubleshooting procedures. 
  • Track system health, patch compliance, and maintenance schedules, providing updates to Management as needed. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve system security, reliability, and operational efficiency. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Technical degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Working knowledge of Windows operating systems, computer hardware, basic server administration, and networking fundamentals. 
  • Experience with software installation, patch management, system maintenance, and technical troubleshooting. 
  • Ability to perform basic Ethernet cabling tasks, including RJ45 connector termination, and ability to work with fiber optic cabling. 
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and prioritize time-sensitive issues. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience with enterprise endpoint management solutions, particularly ManageEngine Endpoint Central. 
  • Experience with network monitoring and management platforms such as SolarWinds, WhatsUp Gold, PRTG, or similar solutions. 
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Bitwarden, Windows Server, Linux, and virtualization technologies. 
  • Experience installing, routing, organizing, and maintaining structured copper and fiber optic cabling in equipment racks and technical facilities. 
  • Experience supporting IT infrastructure in broadcast television, telecommunications, or other 24/7 mission-critical environments. 
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, or equivalent technical certifications. 

Work Environment & Expectations 

  • Position is onsite at the Springfield Broadcast Hub. 
  • Maintain professional technical workspaces and follow established IT security policies, maintenance procedures, and operational standards. 
  • Work collaboratively with Broadcast Engineering, Operations, and corporate IT teams. 
  • Maintain flexibility for occasional evening, weekend, or holiday support based on operational requirements.

job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary: Job Requirements This position is responsible for the creation, development and deployment of designs, animations, and real-time graphics directories at an expert level of understanding and skill. The Supervising Real Time Graphics Developer manages directory maintenance and new graphic builds specific to Ross Xpression independently or while leading a team. They communicate with teammates, partners, sponsors and executive-level stakeholders to help set expectations and ensure on-time delivery. They will lead a business segment requiring specialty knowledge of specific aspects of the products and services provided and created by the Graphics Innovation team. They will develop plant-wide workflows and processes, collaborating across organizations to implement and maintain. This role is expected to proactively provide and anticipate technical support themselves or by delegating. They manage the development and maintenance of training and on-boarding programs. This is a creative role that requires the ability to innovate, learn quickly and collaborate with others under varying deadlines to maintain the quality of ESPN on-air product. Preferred office location is Charlotte, NC; however, there is a possibility that the individual may be based in the Bristol, CT office. Responsibilities: Provide leadership in the technological growth of the department – driving innovation, researching new products, advising on potential vendors, and assisting with the stability and troubleshooting of our rendering, file storage and play out systems Own and manage a specialty business segment such as Ross Xpression, Vizrt, interactive, virtual studio, data visualization, augmented reality, etc. Manage a team of direct reports Plan, build, maintain and update complex Ross Xpression graphic directories independently or while leading a team of developers Provide team leadership, direction, troubleshooting and support for innovative system or plant-wide workflows Primarily utilize Ross Xpression, some Vizrt, potential for Unreal Engine or HTML in the process of graphics creation, development, and deployment of the highest-level creative Utilize other graphics software, such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe After-Effects, Adobe Illustrator, and Cinema4D, to aid in the creation of designs and animations Utilize and understand internal proprietary software and workflows Clearly communicate a creative vision and manage expectations with clients while ensuring effective delegation of assignments within Graphics Innovation Team while keeping management informed and involved when necessary Proactively research, plan for, and answer technical questions with respect to design/animation techniques and systems in use at a highly proficient level independently, by delegation or by leading a group Create system-wide workflows, scripts, and processes Coordinate with management to provide feedback, improve processes, and apply best practices to all project workflows Plan and implement hardware and/or software upgrades and new studio builds Teach, initiatives Translate project details and creative direction into custom design, animation, and layout solutions Push creativity and software skills to the highest levels, find and exploit new technology, and actively communicate on all phases of a project to maintain the quality of ESPN’s on-air product Manage special assignments such as in-house/off-site training and technical support for packagers, remote freelancers, and vendors Observe graphic format deviations and enforce ESPN graphic look Prepare image files for programs Regularly contribute innovative ideas, displaying the desire to push designs to the highest level, and learn new software to enhance individual versatility in the department Adhere to proper file management techniques to ensure efficient archiving and subsequent retrieval of projects Recognize, report, and help troubleshoot equipment/software/work environment issues Adhere to all administrative responsibilities, including time entry and daily reporting requirements Maintain high standards of efficiency, consistency, accuracy, creativity, and timely delivery of all requests Track and report on value of contributions Required Qualifications: Minimum of 8 years of experience creating and managing graphics in a live production setting at a major studio, network, or production company with a minimum of 2 years of leadership experience Ability to lead, manage and train developers at all levels Ability to simultaneously contribute to multiple projects playing different roles, including project managing, leading a team, or contributing as an individual Expert-level knowledge and understanding of a real-time graphics platform Expert-level grasp of broadcast and television production technologies Industry-leading 2D and 3D animation skills and excellent use of effective type layout Drive to learn, create, and apply cutting-edge concepts, techniques and software and the ability to share skills with others Ability to job.title: Spring 2027 FOX Technology Internship Program - Los Angeles, CA
job.description:
FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest media and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.

Please note this internship is offered on-site in Los Angeles, CA.


ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned internship site
  • Must be able to work on-site in Los Angeles, CA

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of the company and media industry

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-paged resume (PDF preferred)
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred)
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest
  • Indicate your office location of choice

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SPRING 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

AREAS OF PLACEMENT:
You will be considered for an internship based on the content of your cover letter, as well as your prior experience and interests, as determined during the recruitment process. Area of placement may include (but are not limited to):

  • AI/ML & Emerging Tech
  • Data & Analytics
  • Growth Marketing
  • Lifecycle Marketing
  • Product Strategy
  • Product Management
  • Software Engineering
  • Tagging & Governance
  • Broadcast Operations

SPRING 2027 SCHEDULE:

General Application Deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026

Program Timeline: Monday, February 8, 2027 - Friday, April 16, 2027

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 16 - 24 hours per week 

NOTE: Schedules vary based on department needs and your availability. We do our best to work around your class schedule.


STANDING OUT AS A TOP CANDIDATE:

Successful students have:

  • Knowledge of current FOX programming and talent
  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives
  • Knowledge of software applicable to your areas of placement. For example, HTML, Python, Java, SQL, Tableau, R, Figma

PROGRAM FEATURES:
FOX Master Classes: A variety of presentations, panels, discussions, and trainings geared toward advancing your knowledge of our company, industry, and software systems
Professional Development Series: A variety of activities geared toward enhancing your professional development
Networking Opportunities: Numerous opportunities to connect with fellow interns and other professionals within the company

job.title: Director, Digital Design
job.description:
Are you a creative force looking for the next challenge? Do you want the chance to be a pioneering designer in an emerging area of the sports industry? The FOX Sports Digital team is adding a Director, Digital Design to the team who will lead the creative direction of visual content across digital screens. You will work with our social, production, editorial, sales, product and operations team to make our FOX Sports brand come alive across all areas of digital.

From creating the look and style guide of our new content to pushing the envelope in on-set environmental design for FOX Sports Digital’s award-winning original shows, this role will help elevate FOX to the top of the design industry. You will have the unique chance to work on day-to-day content while also contributing to the vision for the design team’s long-term projects through template design, art design, environmental design, logo design and much more. Management, training, communication and feedback skills will be paramount as this role helps mold the next generation of talented creatives and content at the company.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and create styles and graphics across all Social and video platforms and O&O products
  • Build and develop show packages, including style guides, promotional material, set walls and graphics for talent
  • Enhance all original content, taking all of FOX Sports’ visuals in this content area to the next level in creative
  • Collaborate with content producers and designers to enhance and beautify any posts that land on our social channels and O&O platforms
  • Help find ways to improve design and content creation workflows, including learning new software and teaching new skills to less senior members of the design team
  • Manage the day-to-day operation of the design team and mentor and teach junior designers across FOX Sports Digital
  • Co-leading cross-department AI innovations, including static and video design with the use of AI programs
  • Build and maintain relationships across a variety of groups around Digital including Screening, Marketing, Editorial Talent, Content Ops, CPE and Original Programming units

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 8+ years of professional design experience
  • Vast experience in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, After Effects and Premiere
  • Deep knowledge on what works on digital, and experience working with social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, owned and operated platforms
  • Strong grasp of current sports design trends
  • Ability to work nights and weekends
  • Teaching and public speaking ability

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKEER

  • Knowledge of current AI software

job.description:

You have the ability to reel in the big get before anyone else! You know what it takes to get the exclusive and can find people via X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, among others.   • Pitch unique and interesting stories that our viewers will relate to 
  • Conduct research and compile well-rounded pre-interviews 
  • Manage daily deadline turnarounds of a live-show 
  • Strategize with your colleagues on best booking approaches

  • 2+ Years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Previous booking experience 
  • Strong writing skills and editorial judgment 
  • A passion for current events
  • Possess an extensive rolodex and can book everyone from high-profile politicians, executives and other people at the center of major news stories

job.description:

We are seeking an ML Solutions Architect who brings broad software engineering expertise along with strong machine learning-adjacent experience. In this role, you will lead the high-level design of systems that integrate ML models into our broader product suite. You will act as a technical consultant, evaluating customer requirements and determining whether they can be addressed with off-the-shelf solutions or should be escalated as specialized research initiatives for our Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning teams. 

This role is ideal for a systems-minded engineer who can translate product vision into scalable architecture, while balancing technical feasibility, performance, and maintainability. 

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) architecte de solutions ML possédant une solide expertise générale en ingénierie logicielle ainsi qu’une bonne expérience connexe à l’apprentissage automatique. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la conception de haut niveau des systèmes qui intègrent les modèles ML à notre offre de produits. Vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) technique en évaluant les besoins des clients afin de déterminer s’ils peuvent être satisfaits à l’aide de solutions prêtes à l’emploi ou s’ils doivent être confiés à nos équipes spécialisées en apprentissage profond et en apprentissage par renforcement. 

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant une vision systémique, capable de traduire une vision produit en une architecture évolutive, tout en conciliant faisabilité technique, performance et maintenabilité. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • System Integration & Coprocessing: Design and implement the software layers that allow ML models to interact with a real-time rendering engine. This includes managing data pre-processing and post-processing (coprocessing) to ensure high-performance execution. 

  • Technical Consulting: Evaluate incoming customer requirements to determine the optimal path forward. You will decide if a task can be solved using off-the-shelf tools or if it requires a deep-dive research project to be handed off to our Deep Learning or Reinforcement Learning engineers. 

  • Language-Agnostic Engineering: Build and maintain wrappers, APIs, and microservices that allow our ML stack to remain flexible and language-agnostic across different production environments. 

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the primary technical liaison between technical leadership, customers, and the core engineering team to spec out data and integration requirements. 

  • Modular Execution: Break down complex product visions into manageable architectural components, ensuring that ML components ship as part of a stable, scalable software product. 

Responsabilités principales 

  • Intégration de systèmes et coprocessing : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les couches logicielles permettant aux modèles ML d’interagir avec un moteur de rendu en temps réel, y compris les composants de prétraitement et de post-traitement nécessaires à une exécution performante.  

  • Conseil technique : Évaluer les demandes clients et déterminer la meilleure approche à adopter, qu’il s’agisse d’outils disponibles sur le marché ou de projets de recherche spécialisés à confier aux équipes d’apprentissage profond ou d’apprentissage par renforcement.  

  • Ingénierie agnostique aux langages : Développer et maintenir des wrappers, API et microservices afin de garantir la flexibilité et l’interopérabilité de la pile ML dans différents environnements de production et langages de programmation.  

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Agir comme principal point de contact technique entre la direction, les clients et les équipes d’ingénierie afin de définir les exigences d’intégration, de système et de données.  

  • Exécution modulaire : Décomposer des visions produit complexes en composantes architecturales claires afin de livrer des fonctionnalités ML au sein d’un produit logiciel stable et évolutif. 

Qualifications 

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as a Software Architect or Systems Engineer in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace. 

  • Technical Proficiency:

  • Fluency with 3D geometry, linear algebra, and/or computer graphics

  • ML Literacy: While you may not be training models daily, you must have enough ML-adjacent experience to understand model constraints, data requirements, and the "state of the art." 

  • Experience with fine-tuning and deploying models is a plus. 

  • Attributes: 

  • Strategic Decision-Making: Ability to perform "Build vs. Buy" analyses for ML components. 

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate high-level product vision into concrete engineering specs for both technical leadership and specialized engineers.

Qualifications

job.title: Director, Sports Sales
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Overview

Paramount is seeking an experienced Director, Sports Sales to help oversee their Holdco sports sales team and drive revenue growth across all CBS Sports properties. The position requires deep expertise in digital sports advertising, a deep linear sports sales background, and a consultative, solutions-driven approach. Operating in a dynamic environment, this role is in charge of leading team performance, meeting key business targets, and will report directly to the Vice President of CBS Sports Sales.   In this role, the Director, Sports Sales will evaluate sales data to identify market opportunities, leveraging competitive sports knowledge to generate leads, acquire new business, and position the team for success in the sports marketplace. Additionally, the Director will collaborate closely with a wide range of internal stakeholders to support sales across the Holdco team. Taking the lead on strategic projects designed to drive business growth and shape the future of Skydance and CBS Sports.   The ideal candidate is a collaborative team player with an in-depth knowledge of the sports marketplace and a genuine affinity for managing and developing talent. A successful candidate will be initiative-taking, creative, detail-oriented, and highly organized.   This is an onsite position at our New York office.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Team Leadership and Performance: Manage and evaluate a sales team to drive revenue growth for the respective holding company, fostering a culture of continuous learning and accelerated performance.
  • Revenue Generation: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly, and annual revenue targets across all CBS Sports properties.
  • Multi-Platform Sales Execution: Pitch and close solutions across the complete sports portfolio. Including digital, streaming, social, CTV, programmatic, sponsorships, and tentpole events. Leveraging linear, digital video, and programmatic channels
  • Pipeline and Forecasting Management: Oversee the sports sales pipeline, including prospecting, forecasting, management, reporting, and uncovering new opportunities.
  • Cross-Platform Collaboration: Partner across Paramount platforms, including broadcast and cable. Delivering holistic, multi-product client solutions.
  • Client Relationship Building: Cultivate deep client and partner relationships through a high volume of face-to-face meetings, representing CBS Sports as a market expert.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) or equivalent training and experience.
  • 10+ years of ad sales experience spanning linear, streaming, social, CTV, programmatic, sponsorships, and tent-pole events.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Proven track record in people management with the ability to lead, encourage, and delegate successfully.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills that demonstrate a solid command of the business and client needs.
  • Outstanding negotiation skills, solid business judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Exemplary analytical, project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, alongside hands-on experience using Salesforce.
  • Robust relationship-building skills are paired with a high drive to win and grow in streaming ad sales.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and self-motivated with agility and a growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to balance priorities, and thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving industry.

 

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $166,500.00 - 221,000.00.

Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.


This position is eligible to earn sales incentive compensation. 

 

What We Offer:

  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products.
  • Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more.

 

Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE)

job.description:
Purpose

Own acquisition performance across paywall, onsite, email, paid, social, lead generation and other prospecting channels, with accountability for new starts, acquisition revenue, CAC, ROI and scalable AI-informed growth strategies.

About the role

You'll own how USA TODAY and the USA TODAY Network win new subscribers. As Director, Acquisition, you're accountable for new starts, acquisition revenue, CAC and ROI across paywall, onsite, email, paid, social, lead generation and other prospecting channels. You'll set the strategy, run a disciplined test roadmap and use AI to spot what's working sooner and act on it faster.

What you'll do

Set acquisition strategy across channels, audiences, offers, messaging and journeys, with every initiative tied to subscriber and revenue targets.

Own paywall and acquisition marketing strategy, partnering with Optimization on a test roadmap for offers, messaging, layouts, journeys and audience targeting.

Build dynamic, scalable acquisition frameworks and templates that personalize by segment, product, market and channel.

Use AI to analyze results, detect performance anomalies, synthesize market and competitor research, draft strategic one-pagers and shape creative direction.

Partner with Product, Pricing, FP&A, Audience, Production and Analytics to forecast performance, prioritize work and resolve revenue dependencies.

Lead weekly, monthly and ad hoc acquisition readouts that turn performance insights into clear actions.

Build, coach and grow a team of acquisition marketers.

How we'll measure success

New subscriber starts and acquisition revenue

CAC, ROI, payback, conversion rate, lead quality and funnel performance

Experiment velocity, win rate and business impact of acquisition tests

Speed and quality of AI-supported insights, competitive analysis, reporting and creative recommendations

What you'll bring

8+ years in acquisition, growth or performance marketing, including 3+ years owning results for a subscription or direct-to-consumer business.

Direct accountability for acquisition targets such as new starts, revenue, CAC, ROI and payback.

Deep experience with paywall, onsite conversion or checkout optimization, backed by a structured experimentation program (test design, A/B and multivariate testing, statistical rigor).

Strong command of acquisition unit economics and forecasting, including partnering with FP&A on targets and variance.

Fluency with web and marketing analytics tools such as Google Analytics and comfort working directly in the data.

Regular, practical use of generative AI for analysis, research synthesis and content development, with examples you can walk us through.

The ability to present performance to senior leaders clearly and turn it into decisions.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

News, media or digital subscription experience

Hands-on experience with paywall, experimentation and personalization platforms

Ownership of paid media, SEO or lead generation programs

Offer and price testing experience

People leadership experience

The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The Post Digital Network is a top 10 digital news publisher in the United States. Our brands include the New York Post, California Post, Page Six, and Decider.
 

Who We Are Looking For:

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Paid Media Account Manager, Commerce to support our rapidly growing Paid Media business. This role is ideal for a post-sale champion who excels at client communication, project management, and operational execution within the performance marketing space.

In this role, you will be the strategic bridge between our brand partners, and internal sales and social teams. You will take the reins once a partnership is secured, ensuring successful partner onboarding and fast-turnaround campaign launches. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love turning complex client campaigns into seamless successes, this role is for you.

Our team is a competitive and agile group that is first to react to market trends and opportunities. We use data-driven insights to guide decisions, combining sharp instincts and thorough analysis to drive success for both the business and our brand partners.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Client Communication & Onboarding: Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact for brand and agency partners, onboarding them and managing ongoing communications.

  • Creative Review & Workflow Management: Review client creative assets, and ad copy to ensure compliance with both New York Post brand guidelines and social platform policies.

  • Internal Collaboration: Liaise closely with the Paid Media Sales team and coordinate with the internal Social team to fast-track creative approvals and asset delivery.

  • Campaign Launch & Quality Assurance: Oversee the technical setup and launch of paid media partnership through relevant platforms  (Meta Business Manager, TikTok Brand Access, etc.), ensuring all tracking and permissions are set up correctly.

  • Client Success: Act as an extension of your partners’ growth marketing teams through proactive communication, strategic collaboration, and optimization guidance.

  • Market Expertise: Stay ahead of the curve on social platform advertising trends, compliance shifts, and emerging digital opportunities.

  • Billing Support: Take ownership of the post-campaign financial lifecycle by assisting with monthly invoicing, spend tracking, and revenue reconciliation.

Requirements: 

  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: A master of execution who can track multiple client timelines, creative deadlines, and financial sheets without missing a beat. 

  • Exceptional Communicator: Highly professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage client expectations gracefully. 

  • Problem-Solver: Proactive in identifying potential campaign bottlenecks (e.g., ad rejections, tracking issues) and quick to implement solutions. 

  • Collaborative: A true team player who enjoys working cross-functionally across sales, editorial, social, and finance departments.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience in digital account management, client success, or ad operations.

  • Foundational understanding of the Paid Social ecosystems (e.g., Meta, TikTok), and Paid Search.

  • Comfortable working with data, Excel/Google Sheets, and analytics dashboards.

  • Basic experience with or understanding of digital media billing, tracking insertion orders (IOs), and monthly financial reconciliation.

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven media environment.

​Note: This role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of being on-site in the New York metro area three days per week (subject to change).

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

 

The Legal department has deep expertise in all core practice areas relevant to a global media and information company, including labor and employment, commercial agreements across all our businesses, privacy, intellectual property, M&A, litigation, corporate governance, compliance, media law and a variety of other specialties. The team is also responsible for the company’s compliance program, including screening for compliance with international sanctions, enforcement of company policies—such as the Dow Jones Code of Conduct—and bolstering internal systems and controls.

 

You Will

  • Build a Legal Operations Function: Serve as the first head of Legal Operations at Dow Jones. You will establish the function and develop a clear multi-year strategy. This role, which will have one direct report to start, will report to the General Counsel of Dow Jones, and will join the Legal leadership team. 
  • Strategic Planning & Execution: Assist in various key projects across the department. You will track department goals, manage the legal roadmap, and help ensure we are hitting our milestones.
  • Financial Management: Assist with the legal budget. This includes outside counsel spend management, accruals, and finding "value-based" fee arrangements to replace the billable hour where possible.
  • Technology & Data: Serve as the manager and visionary for our tech stack (CLMs, e-Billing, IP Management, AI integration, and agentic tools). You don’t just use the tools; you optimize them to drive global legal team transformation and provide data-driven insights to the executive team. To start, AI integration and AI-powered solutions (evaluating current tools and scoping the need for next-generation agentic solutions) alongside process improvement will be a key focus and strategic priority.
  • Global Operational Scaling & Change Management: Partner closely with a globally distributed legal team across multiple international regions to harmonize processes and drive adoption of new technologies.
  • Vendor Management: Oversee our relationships with law firms and ALSPs (Alternative Legal Service Providers). You’ll run RFPs when needed and hold our partners accountable.
  • Project Management: Assist with various projects throughout the department. Whether it's implementing a new privacy compliance workflow, streamlining the workflow on contracts, or helping to coordinate legal resources on large projects, you provide the structure that frees up time across the department.
  • Knowledge Management: Help the Legal team build and maintain our internal core contract templates, playbooks, and training materials that empower the wider company to move faster.
  • M&A/Integration: Work closely with the M&A team on possible M&A opportunities and any resulting integration efforts. 

 

 

Who You Are

  • The Architect: You see a messy process and instinctively want to build a workflow for it.
  • The Translator: You can speak Legal (risk mitigation/precedent) and Business (ROI/efficiency) fluently.
  • The Diplomat: You can deftly handle an inflated bill just as effectively as you can pitch a new software spend to the CFO.

 

 

You Have:

  • Experience: Minimum of 12 years of operations experience, and at least 5 years specifically within a Legal Operations function required. We are looking for someone who has worked in operations in a global legal department. Experience building a Legal Operations function from inception is strongly preferred. 
  • Education: A Law Degree (JD), MBA, or commensurate experience is valuable, but not required. We value operational excellence, project management experience, and other experiences that assist in navigating a growing, international business.
  • Tech Savvy: Deep experience with Enterprise Legal Management (ELM) software, AI-powered legal solutions, agentic tools, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms, with a proven track record of leveraging technology for global legal team transformation, is a plus.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience in the Media/Entertainment or Tech sectors is a plus.

  • Keen sense of how to make appropriate trade-offs between risk and business needs.
  • Big-picture, strategic decision maker with an ability to analyze and explain complex concepts with speed and resolution.
  • Superior work ethic and dedication to ethics and professional responsibility.
