job.title: Director, Global Technology
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As Architect for the Global Technology Global Sales Reporting group, you will be responsible for the technical design, implementation and ongoing operation of our global SAMIS Data Warehouse / DataLake. Large volumes of sales consumption data are ingested into this environment from various up-stream systems within cloud-based architectures. Users from various department gain strategic business insights from this data using the SAMIS Frontend.

What you'll do:

  • Transform the SAMIS architectural strategy into working code: Own the implementation of the end-to-end data lifecycle (Ingestion, Processing, Storage, APIs, Enablement, Security/Sharing) . You will personally write critical path code for new ingestion connectors and API services.
  • Code and enforce SAMIS development standards: Write the first versions of SAMIS coding templates, CI/CD workflows, and data quality frameworks. You will actively participate in design reviews and critical code review, submitting Pull Requests comments and alternative code snippets.
  • Deliver automated reporting by building the data marts: Engage directly with business teams and other tech leads (Operation, Sales) to understand their KPIs. Design, build, and optimize the actual SAMIS aggregate tables and materialized views that power their dashboards, ensuring sub-second query performance.
  • Align SAMIS releases with source upstream and downstream system: Work with System Owners, but at the API/Schema level. You will personally inspect upstream data workflows, write schema-validation scripts, and build automated alerting for when source systems introduce breaking changes.
  • Perform hands-on design and code walkthroughs: Sit with architects and project leads, reviewing not just high-level designs but actual Python/SQL/Java code/Agentic AI Pluginy. You will refactor problematic modules and help junior engineers through pair-programming sessions on complex SAMIS transformation logic.
  • Run Targeted POCs for SAMIS: Own the end-to-end execution of POCs for new SAMIS components and features (e.g., GoldenGate, Data Flow, Autonomous DB, New Lakehouse developments). You will set up the test environments, write the integration code, benchmark performance, and present your technical findings back to the Senior Leads for a final review.
  • Run weekly SAMIS technical working sessions: Facilitate deep-dive meetings with leads and architects, actively contribute code-level feedback, whiteboard solutions, and write proof-of-concept scripts on the fly to resolve technical issues.
  • Code the SAMIS release management strategy: Coordinate with DevOps to build and maintain the actual CI/CD YAML pipelines. You will define the deployment strategies  and personally oversee production releases, performing rollbacks when necessary.
  • Get hands-on with OCI infrastructure stack: Partner with the OCI CloudOps team, debug Spark cluster configurations, rewrite inefficient SQL queries, and tune AIDP to cut pipeline runtimes
  • Implement InfoSec requirements in the codebase: Collaborate with InfoSec, but then translate their policies into actual implementations, writing row-level security filters, setting up encryption key rotations, and embedding dynamic data masking directly into SAMIS API queries.
  • Drive SAMIS cost optimization through code refactoring: Work with Tech Leads and OCICloudOps, rewriting expensive table scans, implementing partition pruning strategies, and moving cold data to cheaper storage tiers directly via code, while reporting monthly savings metrics from a technical level
  • Help build SAMIS operational resilience from the ground up: Leverage your hands-on production experience to design and implement the full operational framework for SAMIS. Monitoring dashboards (e.g., Grafana/OCI Monitoring), define granular alerting rules based on pipeline SLAs, document comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures for recurring failure scenarios, and work on the automation fixes.

Who you are:

  • OCI ecosystem: Autonomous DB, AI Data Platform, Data Integration, Unified Catalog, Analytic Views, ORDS, Data Flow, Object Storage, OCI Events/Functions
  • Lakehouse: Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with Iceberg and Delta Uniform—ACID, time travel, schema evolution, and compaction
  • Data modeling: Star schema, snowflake, and dimensional modeling for analytical performance
  • Lakehouse strategies: Batch vs. incremental ingestion, partitioning, lifecycle management, and handling late-arriving data
  • Processing & orchestration: ETL/ELT tools, Spark (batch + streaming), and exposure to Agentic AI Workflows for self-healing pipelines
  • Languages: Expert in Python, PySpark, SQL; comfortable with performance tuning in Spark UI
  • APIs: RESTful API design, ORDS, authentication (OAuth/API keys), and data integration patterns
  • Non-functional: Proven track record in performance/stress testing, identifying and fixing bottlenecks under load
  • DevOps: CI/CD pipeline design (YAML-based) and Git branching/release strategies for safe, auditable deployments
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.title: Manager, Artist Relations
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How We Lead:

CD Baby champions human creativity, providing the technology, guidance, and professional infrastructure artists need to turn creativity and ambition into sustainable success.


We’re looking for an Artist Relations Manager to build and grow relationships with artists and their teams. Your first priority will be managing inbound referrals from our industry network, followed by strengthening relationships with high-value and high-potential artists already using CD Baby and developing targeted outreach to prospective artists. This is a relationship-driven role with a strong commercial and analytical component. You’ll use artist data and industry knowledge to identify opportunities, understand artists’ goals, and connect them with appropriate support.


As an individual contributor reporting to the SVP, Marketing & Revenue, you’ll own day-to-day artist relationships and partner with leadership to develop the processes and systems behind a growing Artist Relations program.

You’ll work closely with Artist Success and Lifecycle Marketing teams to support successful onboarding and ongoing engagement. You’ll remain the relationship lead for assigned artists, helping CD Baby understand and support their evolving needs.



How You’ll Create:

Manage inbound artist opportunities

  • Own referrals from artists, managers, labels, Virgin Music Group colleagues, and other industry partners.
  •  Evaluate opportunities against program criteria and recommend an appropriate level of service.
  • Explain CD Baby’s distribution, support, and additional services clearly, setting clear expectations about available support and how additional opportunities are considered.
  • Lead commercial conversations within approved parameters, partnering with the SVP, Marketing & Revenue and Legal and Business Affairs on negotiations and agreements as needed.
  • Document artist goals, service commitments, release plans, and relevant context for a complete handoff to Artist Success for onboarding and release coordination.
  • Maintain relationships with referral partners and follow through on introductions.

Develop relationships with our current roster

  • Use revenue, streaming, audience, and engagement data to identify existing artists who could benefit from a closer relationship with CD Baby.
  • Build relationships with selected artists and their teams, understanding their goals, upcoming projects, and service needs.
  • Maintain regular, purposeful contact with priority artists, anticipating concerns and identifying useful next steps.
  • Recommend relevant tools, services, and approved promotional opportunities based on each artist’s needs.
  • Identify relationship risks and coordinate internally to address concerns and retain artists’ future business.

Build a targeted artist recruitment pipeline

  • Identify prospective artists through industry data, research, professional relationships, live shows, and local music communities.
  • Develop targeted outreach to artists whose goals and needs align with CD Baby’s offering.
  • Build relationships with industry professionals who can introduce relevant artists.
  • Manage consistent follow-up from initial contact through qualification and conversion.
  • Represent CD Baby at shows, industry events, panels, workshops, and other artist-facing opportunities.

Connect artist relationships with lifecycle marketing

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to identify artist segments and signals that warrant personalized outreach, education, or additional support.
  • Coordinate direct contact with broader marketing communications so artists receive relevant, consistent messages.
  • Help develop approaches for nurturing prospective artists, reengaging existing customers, and introducing appropriate services.
  • Share insights from artist conversations to improve messaging, educational content, and lifecycle journeys.

Help build a disciplined artist relations program

  • Work with Artist Success to ensure commitments are understood and operational requirements are considered before they are made.

  • Track pipeline quality, conversion, artist engagement, retention, and commercial results.
  • Bring recurring artist needs and feedback to Product, Customer Experience, and Marketing.

Bring Your Vibe:

  • Strong commercial judgment and experience helping move opportunities from introduction through agreement.

job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners – in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. This is where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. Regardless of their role, each of our employees is vital in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life daily.

SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to North America's most prominent digital audio advertising ecosystem. As the combined advertising revenue organization of SiriusXM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBC Universal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

AdsWizz, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions. AdsWizz is the underlying monetization solution for well-known music platforms, podcasts, and broadcasting groups worldwide, giving advertisers of all sizes unprecedented access to premium and niche audio content. Through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats, AdsWizz efficiently connects buyers and sellers for digital audio and podcast advertising. AdsWizz is a global company with a presence in over 40 countries and a Technology Development Hub in Bucharest, Romania.

How you’ll make an impact:
As a Senior Staff Data Engineer, you will join a highly performing team of engineers who build, own, and maintain backend services, data products and reporting applications. You will design, collaborate, and execute building the AdsWizz data products and reporting systems at scale while automating and providing insights into the data onboarding with the SXM Media and AdsWizz services.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and build high-performance, reliable, and scalable reporting APIs and data pipelines.

  • Lead high-level architecture discussions and planning sessions work with ad measurement, revenue and addressability data.

  • Work with various teams of engineers building software in a collaborative development process.

  • Collaborate with the Product team to clarify the scope of the projects by giving thoughtful feedback which challenges and clarifies requirements intent.

  • Execute tasks with utmost clarity and precision, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and providing clear direction to drive projects forward effectively.

  • Collaborate with the Global Operations and Cloud Infrastructure teams to ensure flawless production deployments and support the Incident Management team.

  • Responsible for mentoring and guiding junior engineers.

What you’ll need:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience in Python or Java programming language (preferably JDK17 or higher).

  • 7+ years designing, building, and managing data pipelines using Spark, BigQuery, AWS EMR, and GCP Cloud Analytics.

  • 7+ years of experience crafting REST API based-microservices and scalable products, utilizing diverse cloud platforms (ideally AWS).

  • Cloud data warehouse & analytics platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery).

  • Observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack.

  • Data pipeline expectations framework experience (like Monte Carlo data, Great Expectations, Soda).

  • Working with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Messaging platforms and stream data processing (like Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub).

  • Collaboration tools like Miro (or Lucidchart), Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong understanding of engineering software processes, lifecycle methodology, configuration management, release management, and system verification and testing.

  • Ability to work independently and oversee entire projects or significant parts, focusing on research and completing the tasks on time.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a dedication to continuous improvement.

  • Nice to have expertise in Caching implementations (like Redis, Memcached, etc.).

  • Nice to have expertise in Designing and maintaining Public APIs and data contracts.

  • Nice to have Security basics (e.g., OAuth2 standard).

  • Nice to have Foundational Amazon Cloud Services, like S3, CloudTrail, SQS, SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, ElasticCache, Athena, Kinesis, EKS, Cognito, and others.

  • Nice to have NoSQL databases knowledge (Druid, DynamoDB, SingleStore, or others).

  • Nice to have hands on experience with AI coding assistants and tools to help with coding and data analytics.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Mathematics or a similar field.

  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

As a temporary editor, you'll edit stories from staff writers on the discovery team and collaborate with cross-team partners on publishing.

job.title: Sr. Strategy Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Senior Strategy Director to join Translation. This role demands four days in office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

  • Set the strategic direction across key client accounts, ensuring our thinking is clear, differentiated, culturally informed, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.
  • Define the real problem behind complex business and brand challenges, quickly identifying the tensions, opportunities, and strategic choices that should guide the work.
  • Lead the development of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, translating insight into a clear point of view that inspires both clients and creative teams.
  • Lead multiple engagements and workstreams simultaneously, maintaining a high standard of strategic quality while helping teams prioritize what matters most.
  • Shape the strategic approach to major briefs and opportunities, determining what we need to learn, questions to answer, and how different disciplines should come together.
  • Partner with Data Strategy, Context, Business, and Creative leadership to create an integrated strategic vision for the work.
  • Develop and mentor strategists, providing clear direction and feedback while helping junior and mid-level talent strengthen their judgment, storytelling and strategic craft.
  • Raise the quality of the Strategy discipline, establishing strong standards for briefs, narratives, presentations, research, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to Translation’s intellectual capital, developing perspectives that advance how we understand audiences, culture, brands, and business.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Exceptional strategic judgment with the ability to distinguish an interesting observation from an insight that can meaningfully change the work.
  • Strong command of brand, cultural, and creative strategy, with the ability to connect them into a cohesive strategic narrative.
  • Ability to simplify complex business and cultural challenges into clear, compelling strategic choices.
  • Persuasive storyteller who can build and present a strategic argument with clarity, confidence, and conviction.
  • Strong client leadership skills and the ability to build credibility with senior clients.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, bringing structure and direction to assignments that may not begin with a clearly defined answer.
  • Strong creative instincts and the ability to translate strategy into direction that inspires and improves creative work.
  • Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research, with the judgment to determine when additional research is necessary and how findings should inform strategy.
  • Ability to lead, coach, and elevate other strategists while maintaining accountability for the quality of their work.
  • Collaborative leadership style with the ability to bring different disciplines and perspectives toward a common strategic ambition.
  • Deep curiosity about people, culture, brands, and business, informed by interests and experiences that contribute a distinct point of view.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in strategy, brand development, communications, cultural strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategy for significant client accounts, campaigns, brand platforms, or integrated engagements.
  • Proven ability to independently develop and defend strategic recommendations with senior clients and internal leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize research, cultural intelligence, business context, and audience understanding into actionable strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading strategy across multiple/ complex, multi-workstream accounts.
  • Strong understanding of the digital, social, media, and creator ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn cultural understanding into distinctive brand, cultural, and creative strategies.
  • Proven ability to uncover and translate audience-specific insights into impactful brand, cultural, and creative strategies

About UnitedMasters 

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $160,000 -$190,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

job.title: Social Media Editor
job.description:
Job Description:

POLITICO is seeking a social media editor to play a key role in our North American social media team — to help expand the reach of our journalism and connect with new audiences across a variety of formats and platforms. 


This role is focused on off-platform growth. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in growing our social audiences in strategic ways that drive our business goals, helping determine how our reporting reaches audiences on platforms including Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn and emerging channels. They will also assist in the development and execution of social-first video projects, working closely with visual journalists to bring our journalism to life.


Who You Are:

We're looking for someone who understands both the demands of a fast-moving newsroom and the realities of modern social platforms. The ideal candidate is a strong editorial thinker who knows what works on social and understands how to bring a multimedia newsroom to life. 

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Publish to and manage our social accounts including Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn and emerging channels.
  • Implement social strategies and playbooks for breaking news, key policy coverage areas, enterprise projects, etc.  
  • Work with newsroom leaders, reporters and producers on social best practices
  • Work closely with product & tech teams to identify & implement social workflow improvements and tools across our website and app 
  • Regularly share insights and takeaways with data and audience teams  
  • Participate in daily coverage planning and be a voice for our audience 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze audience data, identify trends, and provide timely recommendations that contribute to informed journalistic decisions 
  • Maintain off-platform standards and journalistic independence  
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in content creation, delivery, and audience engagement based on data analysis. 
  • Stay aware of social media trends, innovations, and best practices and incorporate them into the newsroom's workflow. 

 

What You’ll Need:

  • 2-3 years of experience in social media, newsroom experience is required  
  • Experience identifying, analyzing, and using data to independently test theories, confirm assumptions, and measure success via iteration and with attention to detail.   
  • Strong writing skills, and experience drafting compelling headlines and polished copy across a variety of formats. 
  • Excellent news judgment: This candidate will have to respond in breaking and fast-moving scenarios and cover a wide-variety of subject matters responsibly and fairly. 
  • Knowledge of politics and policy news. Fluency is a major plus.
  • Experience editing and creating social video is not necessary, but is a major plus. 
  • NOTE: This role may require a schedule outside normal working hours. 


COMPENSATION: $75,000 - $85,000 Annual Base. The final salary offered will be based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

We value our people. Click here for more on what we offer and what it’s like to work for POLITICO. 


Let’s keep in touch. You can view our list of open positions here.


About Us.

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.


Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.


Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.


Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.

These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.


POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

job.title: Arts and Culture Correspondent
job.description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

 

We’re looking for an arts and culture correspondent to be at the forefront of the cultural conversation. You’ll generate exclusives, break major stories, identify the trends everyone will be talking about, and produce ambitious features spanning the full breadth of arts and culture. From interviewing the artists shaping the moment to investigating the forces transforming the creative industries, you’ll deliver original journalism that informs, surprises and sets the agenda.

 

This position is as a 12-month fixed-term contract or internal staff secondment. This role follows a nine-day fortnight schedule.

 

About the role

 

  • Write news, features, liveblogs, interviews, background and other material to ensure that important arts stories are covered
  • Break exclusive arts news stories 
  • Check stories for accuracy and legal compliance
  • Source interviews and stories
  • Monitor a range of sources and diaries for breaking/developing/upcoming stories
  • Participate and shape thinking on the subject across the newsroom, spotting the broader social, cultural and political trends as well as being confident in analysing the significance and direction of the arts and culture specialism
  • Contribute reporting for the Guardian’s range of multimedia formats, including social media, podcasts and video

 

About you

  • Demonstrable experience of working as a journalist, including arts and culture coverage, online and in print, on a major news website, newspaper or magazine
  • Knowledge/ awareness of the demands of digital platforms and print 
  • Proven experience of writing news and features 
  • Experienced in effectively utilising social media and multimedia
  • Ideally, you’ll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role, seeking out underreported parts of the arts and culture landscape in all their diversity

 

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King’s Cross in London.

Job share applications are welcome. If you are keen to apply jointly with someone else as a job share, you should make a single application and combine your application documents.

The salary range for this NUJ position starts at £54,239, with the final offer determined by the successful candidate's skills, experience, and responsibilities.

 

How to apply

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for. 

We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process. 

The closing date for applications is Friday 6 November 2026.

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.

Benefits at the Guardian

You'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

job.title: Temp-to-Perm Finance Analyst
job.description:
About the Guardian

The Guardian is a global news organization that delivers fearless, independent journalism. From breaking news and award-winning investigations to in-depth coverage of technology, sports, film, culture, and lifestyle, the Guardian offers a global view that deepens our audiences' understanding of America and the world.

Headquartered in New York City, Guardian US is an entirely digital operation that seeks to engage US readers by combining the Guardian's international coverage with US voices and expertise. Core coverage areas include US politics, technology, the climate emergency, economic and racial inequality, health, sports, culture, and more. Guardian US launched in 2011 and has bureaus in New York, Washington DC, New Orleans, and Los Angeles. The Guardian is an independently owned, mission-driven organization funded by readers around the globe.

It's the talent, energy, and commitment our people bring to The Guardian that makes us who we are. Across our business, we have some of the most creative thinkers in media and beyond, award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial teams, digital talent, and more.

About the role

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Temp-to-Perm Finance Analyst to support the Finance function through financial reporting, planning, analysis, and business partnership. This role will play a key part in delivering accurate and timely P&L reporting, financial analysis, ad hoc reporting, and management insights, while partnering closely with teams across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Hyperion, Microsoft Excel, and Google Workspace, with strong financial acumen and the ability to translate financial data into meaningful insights. This individual will be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and collaborating cross-functionally to support business objectives and improve financial performance.

 

Department: Finance

Location: New York, New York

Hybrid/Remote/In-Person: Hybrid, 3 days 
Terms and conditions: Full-time, Temp to Perm (Temporary duration: 6 months)

Annual Salary: $110-120k

 

Key responsibilities

Financial Reporting & P&L Management

  • Own and support monthly P&L reporting, including preparation, analysis, variance explanations, and identification of key business drivers.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial reports and analyses for Finance leadership and cross-functional business partners.
  • Support the preparation of presentations and financial insights for Finance leadership and business stakeholders.

Financial Analysis & Strategic Planning

  • Analyze actual results against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights.
  • Investigate variances and financial trends, working with relevant stakeholders to understand root causes and communicate findings.
  • Support the broader Finance function across forecasting, budgeting, reporting, planning, and other strategic and operational initiatives.
  • Assist with special projects and other ad hoc analyses as needed to support evolving business and Finance priorities.

Systems, Modeling & Process Improvement

  • Leverage Hyperion to support financial reporting, data analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning processes.
  • Develop and maintain sophisticated Excel-based financial models, reporting tools, and analyses to support decision-making.
  • Utilize Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, and Google Slides, to facilitate reporting, analysis, presentations, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Develop and improve reporting processes, templates, and analytical tools to increase efficiency, accuracy, and visibility into financial performance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with other Finance team members to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial reporting.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business performance, gather financial inputs, resolve discrepancies, and provide financial guidance.
  • Serve as a trusted financial partner to cross-functional teams, helping stakeholders understand financial results and make informed business decisions.

 

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of relevant financial analysis or FP&A experience.
  • Strong experience with P&L reporting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperion or a comparable enterprise financial planning and reporting system.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Slides, and Drive.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver both recurring and ad hoc financial reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate financial information clearly to both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and business partnering skills.

 

How to apply

We know there are great candidates who might not check all these boxes or who possess important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, we encourage you to apply and tell us about yourself.

All candidates interested in applying should upload a resume and cover letter.  

 

All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Please email the recruiter listed on the job posting or at recruitment.us@theguardian.com to discuss further so we can work with you to support you through your application.

 

Compensation and benefits

  • 20 days of vacation leave in addition to 12 company holidays and 2 personal days
  • Unlimited sick time
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • 401(k) Match
  • Subsidized healthcare coverage including medical, vision, and dental
  • Medical and Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Generous parental leave with 100% pay
  • Long Term and Short Term Disability insurance 
  • Life insurance 
  • Commuter benefits 
  • Wellhub
  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hybrid schedule 

 

Culture & wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. You will also have the opportunity to hear unique insight from our journalists in our morning conference, a live discussion on the news story of the day. 

We offer great tools to help you prioritize your wellbeing including access to Employee Assistance Programs.

job.title: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
About SoundExchange

SoundExchange is the largest global neighboring rights organization in the world, redefining how creators in the music industry get paid. By turning data into fast, accurate revenue for artists and rights owners, we have collected and distributed more than $13 billion in digital performance royalties to date on behalf of more than 800,000 music creators. As the sole organization designated by the U.S. government to administer the Section 114 sound recording license, SoundExchange seamlessly collects and distributes digital performance royalties from platforms like Pandora, SiriusXM, iHeartRadio, and thousands more, as well as all available international performance royalties through a strong global partnership network. 

 

Title: Salesforce Developer
Department: Technology
Job Location: Washington, DC or anywhere (Continental US)
Reports To: Director, Engineering
Supervisory Role: No
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Summary: 

SoundExchange seeks a Salesforce Developer to design, build, maintain, and enhance scalable Salesforce solutions and integrations that support account management and customer service operations.

The Salesforce Developer will translate business requirements into secure, maintainable solutions on the Salesforce platform; integrate Salesforce with existing systems; ensure data quality, reliability, and security; and provide ongoing technical support for production applications.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Salesforce development and configuration experience with the ability to design complex solutions, collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, and support reliable applications in a production environment.

Essential Functions:

  • Design, develop, configure, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions that meet documented business and technical requirements
  • Participate throughout the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, code review, testing, documentation, deployment, and production support
  • Support, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance existing Salesforce applications to improve reliability, performance, usability, and maintainability
  • Design, build, document, monitor, and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and other applications using APIs, web services, and event-based integration patterns
  • Collaborating with stakeholders and other developers to identify and implement improvements for the system
  • Apply Salesforce security, privacy, and development standards, including appropriate access controls, secure coding practices, and protection of sensitive data
  • Collaborating with integrated teams to ensure smooth data flow with minimal interruptions or disruptions

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (KSAs):

  • Proficient in Salesforce administration and development concepts, including Lightning Experience, Lightning Web Components, Flow, security and sharing, and platform configuration
  • Proficiency with Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, SOSL, Salesforce APIs, asynchronous processing, and declarative automation; familiarity with Visualforce for supporting legacy solutions
  • Understanding of the Salesforce data model, including standard and custom objects, relationships, fields, data quality, data migration, and governance practices
  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with team members and business partners
  • Proficiency in Agile software development methodology, processes, and practices
  • Experience with Salesforce testing and release-management practices, including Apex unit tests, automated regression testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD deployment pipelines
  • Knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns, REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, middleware, error handling, and integration monitoring
  • Experience developing, integrating, or supporting Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions is preferred

Required Education, Certifications/ Licenses, Related Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  • 4 years or more years of experience in software engineering
  • At least 3 years of experience in Salesforce development

ADA SPECIFICATIONS:

  • This position requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (standing and/or seated) all of the time
  • This position requires the ability to spend all of the time viewing computer monitors

Travel Requirements:

  • If hired remote, this person is expected to travel to the Washington DC corporate office as needed (2-4 times per year).

PAY RANGE:  $115,000.00 - $135,000.00 

Note:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary.

Taking Care Of The Band:

At SoundExchange we empower creators and help shape the future of music. One way we do this is by respecting different voices, varied perspectives, and distinct backgrounds of all our team members. We are intentional in creating a culture where we recognize that all employees have the opportunities and support needed to thrive. We strive to create teams that reflect the music community we serve – every individual’s unique attributes and abilities are valued, and are part of how we innovate, create, and deliver experiences to the creators we champion.

SoundExchange has an employee-led committee that focuses on amplifying different voices and backgrounds and undertakes activities to promote inclusion and access. It helps to cultivate SoundExchange culture and policies, advocates for equality within the music industry, and participates in community building activities in the Washington, DC area where SoundExchange is located.

All with the goal of promoting more belonging and access in the workplace, music industry, and local community.

Accommodations:

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the SoundExchange Careers website as a result of your disability. job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Director to join our growing team!

21GRAMS, a Real Chemistry subsidiary is an advertising agency born to make healthcare more human. Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you?

21GRAMS is in search of an Account Director. In addition to being the diplomatic face of the brand, both internally and externally, they accept the role of manager, liaison, thinker, and problem-solver. The Account Director leads broad-based, complex work-streams, is critical to the smooth running of Accounts, is a credible advisor and has very strong marketing communications experience.

The Account Director has mastered communications, project management, and has a strong point of view on the pharmaceutical side. This person should be able to confidently lead client projects and internal teams, encouraging smart, effective and integrated solutions, and always deliver results and client satisfaction. This position offers the opportunity to become an internal leader while developing strong relationships with clients.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Establish and maintain productive working relationships to drive agency success
  • Demonstrate understanding and knowledge of key messages/message platform, data, and promotional story for brand and competition
  • Develop and align on key agency/client documents that drive success (e.g., Project and Creative Briefs)
  • Read and interpret analytics around programming, tactics, and overall brand performance (e.g., metrics, KPIs, goals)
  • Negotiate, when necessary, to meet and deliver on client needs while managing agency resources and projects effectively
  • Continuously identify new opportunities to make recommendations based on customers, markets, and competitive environments, including corresponding rationales
  • Lead by example: exhibit professional conduct while providing ongoing leadership as a role model for the team
  • Demonstrate a solutions-oriented approach and collaborate across teams to drive success
  • Pursue business objectives, while developing talent and preserving the 21GRAMS culture
  • Supervise, train, and mentor team members to develop the skills and careers of others by providing guidance

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing or a related field or equivalent
    experience is required
  • 5-7 years marketing experience, agency environment preferred.
  • Strong ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects with strong organizational
    skills.
  • Excellent business communication skills
  • Strong written and oral communication and presentations skills
  • Experience working on Therapeutic brands a plus
  • Previous experience managing junior staff preferred

Pay Range: $135,000.00-$155,000.00

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

 

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. job.title: Finance Business Partner- FTC
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

We're looking for a commercially minded Finance Business Partner to join our HQ Finance team on a 3-month fixed-term contract, partnering closely with Finance and People leaders to provide meaningful financial insight, robust reporting and informed decision support.

You'll analyse financial performance, challenge and influence stakeholders, and support budgeting and forecasting across key corporate functions. Through detailed variance analysis, you'll help identify performance drivers, highlight opportunities for improvement and provide the insight needed to support effective decision-making.

You'll also contribute to broader transformation initiatives across WPP, working with senior stakeholders to drive efficiency, improve business insight and support change across a complex global organisation.

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible and make an immediate impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Partner with HQ Finance and People leaders to provide financial insight and analysis, including tracking actual performance against budgets and forecasts.
  • Act as the primary finance contact for budget holders and department leads, supporting the development of accurate, transparent, and robust budgets and forecasts.
  • Lead month-end performance reporting, including cost actualisation, variance analysis, risk and opportunity assessment, and the identification of mitigating actions.
  • Support management accountants through the month-end close process by providing information required for journal preparation and posting.
  • Maintain the integrity and accuracy of budget and forecast data within WPP's financial systems.
  • Partner with the Finance Director, GBS, Finance and People to support business cases, cost-saving initiatives, and transformation programmes.
  • Analyse key cost drivers and collaborate with business leaders to identify efficiencies and opportunities that contribute to transformation and cost optimisation targets.
  • Work closely with FP&A, Controllership, Tax and other Finance teams to ensure consistent, accurate, and aligned reporting and analysis.
  • Own and manage the calculations that underpin the Finance and People recharge process across WPP.

What you'll need:

  • Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent) with proven Finance Business Partnering experience within a complex, international organisation.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable business insight.
  • Confident partnering with and influencing senior finance and non-finance stakeholders, providing constructive challenge and supporting informed decision-making.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience using enterprise financial systems and ideally data visualisation tools such as Power BI.
  • Excellent organisational and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver at pace in a fast-moving environment.
  • Comfortable working across large, diverse and international teams, building effective relationships across functions and geographies.
  • Proactive and improvement-focused, with experience identifying opportunities to simplify, automate and standardise processes and make better use of data.

 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.title: Director of Audience Development
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

At Bonneville International, our purpose is to build up, connect, inform, and celebrate communities and families in the markets we serve. As an integrated media company, we provide content, advertising, and digital marketing solutions across 19 radio stations in Denver, Phoenix, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, and Seattle, along with the NBC Affiliate TV station, KSL-TV 5, in Salt Lake. We are responsible for lifting and inspiring with respect and giving voice to all the communities and clients we serve.

 

We believe that empowering our employees to share their ideas and experiences will fuel creativity, innovation, and inspiration. A diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to our ability to create and deliver exceptional content, products, and services that represent our communities. We’re proud of our history and we want talented people to join us as we continue to grow!

 

To learn more about Bonneville and how our local media matters, visit: https://bonneville.com/

 

Position Overview

Bonneville Seattle is looking for an enthusiastic, results-driven individual to develop, engage, and grow digital audiences across all our distribution platforms. This Director of Audience Development will shape the Company’s voice and brands through various distribution channels. They will guide digital strategy, content, staffing, and distribution across web, apps, audio, video, and social media. Working closely with Seattle leadership, programming, sales, and corporate teams, they will strengthen our brands, support audience growth, and grow revenue all in alignment with the Company’s mission and values.

 

Note:  Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an on-site role that requires the employee to work at our Seattle site.

 

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop and execute digital audience growth and engagement strategies that support business objectives, strengthen Bonneville Seattle’s brands, and grow over-the-air (OTA) audiences through digital channels.
  • Establish editorial vision, voice, and creative direction across digital platforms, cultivating distinct brand identities for MyNorthwest.com, 710sports.com, and individual shows, hosts, reporters, and contributors.
  • Lead digital content staff, including hiring, training, coaching, goal-setting, and performance management.
  • Oversee content gathering, production, editing, publishing, and distribution across web, apps, audio, video, and social channels.

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

CBC News is proud to offer its winter internship to aspiring journalists from across the country, a six-week, in-person program that provides valuable hands-on experience in multiplatform news environments. 


Please note that we can only consider your application if you have been recommended by the journalism coordinator at your university or college. Please do not apply unless you have been recommended by your school and have received an invitation from CBC to apply to our program.


We are currently accepting applications for our winter 2027 session:


Winter Session: Monday January 11 to Friday February 19, 2027


The deadline for submitting your application is Friday October 23, 2026, at 11:59 pm ET.


About the program:

  • Our six-week full-time program offers students hands-on experience in multiplatform news environments. 
  • Our placements are located at the CBC Toronto Broadcast Centre but include the possibility of working at other local newsroom locations in Ontario. 
  • Interns parallel the programs they're assigned to. Most work is in person, Monday to Friday. However, some placements are hybrid home-office arrangements. Some roles require weekend shifts and/or early morning or late afternoon/evening work. 
  • Internships are unpaid. Interns are responsible for accommodation and travel. 
  • If successful, a student’s placement area will depend on the interests they express to us, our assessment of their strengths and the ability of our programs/departments to host interns.

Note: Here is a list of typical placement areas however they're subject to availability and vary throughout the year. 

 

Program criteria:

  • You must be enrolled in a journalism program recognized by CBC.
  • Internship must be a requirement of your program. 
  • We will not consider any student application unless recommended by your school’s coordinator.
  • Students must not have already interned in an editorial role at the CBC.
  • Students must be in—or about to enter—their final year of study at the time of the internship.
  • Students must be available full-time. We are unable to accommodate class/work schedules. 
  • Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada at the time of application and throughout the internship period. Proof of work authorization may be required.
  • You and your college or university must ensure you are covered for all eligible insurance costs through the Ministry of Training, Colleges and Universities.

Note: Standard recruitment at CBC includes a mandatory background check for selected students prior to receiving an official internship offer. There is no charge.  

 

Please note that CBC values equal opportunity and nurtures an inclusive workplace where individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada's public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website.


Should you have workplace accessibility or accommodation needs, please inform us as soon as possible. 


What are the application requirements?


To be eligible for consideration, candidates must ensure they provide a single PDF that consists of the follow items:

  • A one-page cover letter that explains what you bring to the program
  • A one-page resume 
  • Portfolio:  Please provide three examples of your journalism work. If you've worked in more than one medium, make sure your examples reflect that range (ie. text, audio, video, interactive, etc). For each link, please write one sentence about why you chose to submit this piece. Please provide links to your work, not the actual files. Group projects are acceptable; however, you MUST clearly describe your own contribution.

Employment during internship:


While we do not want interns to overextend themselves during their internship, we are sensitive to the importance of income derived from part-time jobs. If the work is journalistic in nature, we will ask interns for details to ensure that there is no conflict of interest while at the CBC. 


Note:


Although proficiency in technical skills is essential to the work of journalists, this is not a technical internship. This is an editorial internship which is not designed for people who are interested in careers in directing, switching, lighting, editing and camera work.


If your school has nominated you but you decide NOT to submit an application, please notify us.


Thank you for your interest, time and effort. We look forward to reviewing your application package!



Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.
 
We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Are you a skilled visual storyteller, an ambitious self-starter and a collaborative team player? 


CBC News is looking for an experienced and creative videojournalist to join our team to bring stories from communities in southwestern Ontario to our video platforms.


Equally comfortable in front of the camera as behind it, the successful candidate will be a strong journalist and innovative storyteller who brings original ideas and treatments to their stories, has an understanding of what works for social and streaming platforms, excels at breaking news and has demonstrated skills in video and digital journalism. 


A keen observer and critical thinker, you must be able to analyze a broad range of issues and thrive in the fast-paced, high-pressure world of multiplatform news. You will know how to gather, write, edit and package stories for a variety of platforms including digital, radio, social, TV and streaming. 


In this role, you will focus your storytelling on communities in southwestern Ontario within the region around the urban centre of Windsor, concentrating on areas and people that traditionally have been under-represented in media coverage. You will play a key role in helping us grow and engage audiences in these communities.


As such, you will put audience needs at the centre of your journalism, ensuring your work highlights a broad range of perspectives, experiences and points of view. You will ensure that all CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful, immediate and resonate with the communities we serve. 


You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, are at ease with juggling multiple tasks and priorities at once and are able to troubleshoot yourself and your team out of any technical problem.


This position will generally be scheduled Tuesday to Saturday and requires full-time, on-site presence.

Your responsibilities:

  • Pitch, research, write, shoot, edit and package compelling original stories for all platforms that will engage and inform the audience, deepen our community connections and elevate a range of voices.
  • Respond quickly to breaking news events – chasing, gathering, shooting, writing and packaging stories for digital, radio, social and visual programming.
  • Regularly present stories on-air, both live and packaged, providing analysis and context to enhance the audience’s understanding of issues.
  • Distill large amounts of complex information under tight time constraints.
  • Demonstrate effective and creative storytelling treatments and presentations.  
  • Research internal archives and source user-generated content to effectively support and shape compelling visual stories.
  • Leverage strong interpersonal skills to foster and maintain a broad pool of sources and contacts.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to develop and break stories, and coordinate long-term coverage.

Your profile: 

  • Demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced daily multiplatform news environment. 
  • Sound news judgment and a demonstrated ability to react quickly to breaking news and changing priorities, and chase multiple stories at once.
  • Ability to generate, pitch and pursue strong story ideas that meet the needs of our audiences in southwestern Ontario
  • A proven work ethic, strong communication skills and a positive, team-first attitude. 
  • Superior writing skills across platforms.
  • Superior shooting and editing skills, and demonstrated experience producing innovative visual content for multiple platforms (digital, social, television)
  • Ability to present stories live on-air, from within the studio and out in the field.
  • Knowledge of emerging storytelling formats and willingness to embrace change and new tasks across all CBC platforms.
  • Superior level of technical knowledge with a variety of cameras, broadcast equipment and non-linear editing platforms, including strong troubleshooting skills related to live video transmission.
  • A strong desire to live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture.
  • A strong proven connection to the communities we serve in Hamilton, and a deep and nuanced understanding and appreciation of diverse perspectives and lived experiences.
  • Possession of a valid driver’s licence and a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada's insurance company.
  • University degree in journalism or equivalent with a minimum of five years of recent, related experience.
  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours as required.

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

The Senior Development Events Coordinator plays a key role in driving, coordinating, and executing Development-led donor engagement events that advance the mission of K-LOVE. This role partners closely with the Development Events Manager, internal Ministry teams, and external vendors to deliver exceptional, well-executed live and hosted donor experiences.

 

The Senior Coordinator takes full responsibility for assigned events, workstreams, and tasks from concept through post-event follow-up, exercising independent judgment, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of outcomes. This includes managing logistics, timelines, communications, data integrity, and on-site execution while representing the Ministry with excellence, integrity, and a servant’s heart. 

 

 

This is an onsite role in Franklin, TN

 

 

Here's some of what you will be doing...

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers no later than November 5, 2026. All are encouraged to apply.

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.
