Job Title:  Director, Financial Data Reporting

 

Position Overview

The Director, Financial Data Reporting leads the strategy, architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise ﬁnancial data and business intelligence solutions. This role combines deep expertise in data engineering, warehousing, analytics, ﬁnancial systems, and technical leadership to improve business processes, expand access to trusted information, and enable timely, informed decision-making.

 

The Director owns the full systems development life cycle for complex reporting and data initiatives—from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, production support, and continuous optimization. The role also directs the conﬁguration of interactive dashboards, including global and local ﬁlters, to meet a broad range of ﬁnance and business requirements.

 

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership, Corporate Finance, IT, Security, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director translates business needs into scalable technical solutions, strengthens data governance and controls, resolves performance challenges, and advances the organization’s ﬁnancial reporting capabilities.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic leadership: Connects data and technology priorities to business strategy and long-term enterprise needs.
  • Business partnership: Builds credibility across Finance, IT, Security, operations, vendors, and executive leadership.
  • Execution and accountability: Converts complex requirements into reliable solutions and delivers measurable results across competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement: Uses data, technology, and disciplined problem-solving to simplify processes and improve performance.
  • Communication and inﬂuence: Presents complex information clearly and drives alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the strategy, design, development, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of enterprise ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehouse, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Manage the full systems development life cycle across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring solutions align with stakeholder requirements, technical standards, delivery commitments, and business priorities.
  • Own the AWS (RDS MySQL, S3) and SQL Server reporting databases, including moving the remaining legacy reporting to AWS.
  • Own month-end close data processing: WideOrbit, programmatic, digital and MAI revenue loads and the journal entry/invoice ﬁles into SAP, including reconciliations and controls.
  • Own the Power BI estate: reports, data models, scheduled refreshes and subscriptions, including daily revenue pacing and the daily liquidity summary.
  • Lead digital analytics data engineering on Google Cloud (BigQuery) and the Tableau-to-Power BI migration.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors supporting data and reporting.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and backup coverage so no critical process depends on one person.
  • Evaluate and recommend system architecture that improves scalability, reliability, availability, performance, and access to critical ﬁnancial data.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Build and optimize data processes that integrate multiple disparate data sets into a trusted reporting environment, reducing executive reporting cycle times.
  • Partner with Corporate Finance and cross-functional teams to identify reporting needs, resolve data and warehouse performance issues, and deliver timely, actionable insights.
  • Oversee the integration of WideOrbit, WideOrbit Programs, MAI, Concur, Costar, Darwin, Operative, ADP, Blackline, Magnit, and related vendor systems with SAP and the broader reporting environment.
  • Design and conﬁgure interactive dashboards using global and local ﬁlters to support a diverse matrix of ﬁnancial and operational requirements.
  • Establish data governance, validation, reconciliation, documentation, and quality-control practices that support accurate, consistent, secure, and audit-ready ﬁnancial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and Security to maintain appropriate data access, privacy, retention, and information-security standards.
  • Provide production support and operational oversight, including monitoring, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, change management, and business continuity for critical reporting solutions.
  • Deﬁne and monitor success measures for data availability, reporting accuracy, system performance, user adoption, project delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Provide technical leadership, communicate complex data concepts clearly, manage key vendor relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders, business partners, and technical teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related ﬁeld; an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in ﬁnancial data reporting, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or ﬁnancial systems, including at least ﬁve years leading enterprise initiatives, technical teams, or cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering executive reporting solutions and leading complex systems integrations, cloud or data warehouse migrations, and ERP transformations.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL-based environments, cloud data platforms, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, dashboard design, data quality practices, and ﬁnancial reporting architecture.
  • Experience with project management, SDLC governance, quality assurance, production support, and vendor management in a complex operating environment.
  • Proven ability to inﬂuence senior leaders, translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, manage competing priorities, and support multiple business units.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and executive-presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to ﬁnancial, operational, and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related ﬁeld.
  • Experience with SAP, Power BI, AWS MySQL, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and enterprise ﬁnancial or media-industry systems.
  • Relevant certiﬁcation such as CPA, CMA, CBIP, Microsoft Power BI, AWS, GCP, SAP, PMP, or CSM.

job.title: Multi-Media Content Creator
job.description:
Are you ready to take your career to new heights and be a part of a dynamic team at Rogers Sports & Media? We believe in creativity, innovation, and collaboration in everything we do, and we are looking for people who share this mindset to join us. With a monthly reach of 30 million Canadians, you can help shape the future of sports, news, e-commerce, and entertainment. At Rogers, we value diversity and inclusivity and believe that every voice matters. Join us today and be a part of a team that is redefining the future of media.

 

 

We’re looking for a part-time Multi-Media Content Creator to shape and strengthen our brand as our operations continue to transition to CityNews 24/7 and we radically change the way we produce and tell our stories in order to better engage and build our audiences.   

 

The ideal candidate has competence in many of the skills required to work in a modern, multi-platform, continuous news operation, and an aptitude and desire to learn more.   

 

Writing, chasing, researching, producing, digital storytelling, pitching, interviewing, vetting, posting, and desktop editing – you have, or with training are on your way to having, the ability to create journalistic content from the idea stage to publishing or broadcast.   

 

You have a passion for local news, strong editorial judgement, and are looking for an opportunity to learn and grow while working alongside a talented, innovative and fun team of journalists. 

  

What you’ll be doing: 

 

  • Working independently or as part of a team, you will create fast-paced, compelling and informative news content for our digital properties and for broadcast.
  • Coordinating and deploying newsroom and field resources to gather elements and create news content.
  • Pitching during daily creative brainstorms and story meetings
  • Emailing, calling and interviewing people as you chase, research, and create enterprise or breaking news content.
  • Creating, independently or as part of a team, innovative video content optimized for our audience.
  • Ensuring that content is factually and grammatically correct. 

  

What you have: 

 

  • Creative vision and keen editorial judgment
  • Superior writing, organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Shift work required (mornings, evenings and weekends)
  • An appetite to learn and grow 

 

Skills and Competencies: 

 

This role is designed to build a newsroom staff that has the capability to respond, as individuals or small teams, to an ever-increasing appetite for continuous news on multiple platforms, and to create that content from conception to broadcast or publishing. 

 

WRITING: Write news content for television and digital platforms. Proofread and copy-edit news content.  

 

RESEARCH/CHASE: Research, pitch and chase story ideas, including breaking news and leads submitted by our audience.    Pre-interview guests and arrange necessary resources for broadcast segments. 

 

 

CONTENT VETTING: Vetting breaking and enterprise news content (including video and audio packages) for television, radio, and digital platforms, including fact checking.

  

DIGITAL AND TELEVISION CMS KNOWLEDGE: Edit and publish digital content in our content management system (WordPress) and/or manage television content in our television content management system.  In WordPress, this includes headlines and media, and ensuing our digital platforms and homepage are updated with the very latest local, national and international news stories, and that our pages and apps are optimized for reach and engagement.  In Inception, this requires building lines in Inception Running Orders, inserting production cues, creating Xpression elements (keys/graphics), generating placeholders and ensuring broadcast elements have times (keys/durations) updated accordingly. 

  

VIDEO EDITING: Visual editing skills, including the ability to add keys and graphics prior to digital publishing.   Independently create video content, from raw media to final product, with an ability to apply editorial judgment.   

 

VIDEO/STILL PHOTOGRAPHY: Basic still and video photography skills, including the ability to add those photos and videos to digital and broadcast content.  

 

INTERACTIVES: Create engaging interactive digital content using tools like timelines,  maps, infographics, basic animations. 

 

VIDEO SUPPORT: Ability to perform various tasks related to the production of visual news, including scheduling content feeds, records and live streams; coordinating live hits in a control room; searching for visuals from various sources (CityNews archives, social media, licensed content providers.) 

 

RESOURCE MANAGEMENT: Deploy and manage resources (field camera operator/editors, reporters etc.) for breaking and enterprise news, shifting those resources based on story tracking on social and other platforms.   

 

DIGITAL PLATFORM PUBLISHING: Distribute and amplify content, including breaking news and push alerts, to our internal and external platforms. Delivery and promotion of digital content on our social channels, whether created by the MMCC or others, including audience engagement. Creating digital media campaigns to promote stories/specials. This incorporates scheduling social posts but also understanding how/when the audience consumes content on various platforms. 

 

LIVESTREAM: Initiate and manage live video streams on our internal and external platforms. 

  

ADVANCED DIGITAL KNOWLEDGE:  Knowledge and understanding of Digital News beyond content creation, including; tracking digital analytics to continually optimize and update content distribution,  troubleshoot and manage technical issues that may arise (pages not loading, no audio on video, duplicated alerts), keeping up to date with the latest digital products and trends.

Are you a sharp editor, strategic digital thinker, and hands-on content creator who understands how great stories find audiences today? At Townsquare Media – New Jersey, we’re looking for a Director of Digital News & Audience to help lead the digital evolution of New Jersey 101.5, while serving as a digital content resource for our other brands across New Jersey.

You’ll work alongside our journalists, personalities, producers, and content teams to create compelling original content, strengthen the stories we’re already telling, and expand their reach across web, social, video, apps, newsletters, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. What matters most is that you understand great storytelling, strong journalism, and how audiences discover, consume, and share content across platforms.

And this isn’t a role that manages from the sidelines. You’ll write, edit, publish, produce, package, analyze, and create content yourself, while helping talented people around you make their work even stronger.

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted New Jersey stations.

  • Supporting day-to-day news priorities and coordination while balancing breaking news, daily content production, and longer-term audience-growth initiatives
  • Serving as a digital content resource across our New Jersey brands, helping teams capitalize on strong stories and audience opportunities
  • Exploring new platforms, technologies, and AI-assisted content and workflow tools to improve efficiency and creativity while maintaining strong editorial standards and human judgment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in digital journalism, digital media, audience development, social/video content, online publishing, or a related content environment
  • A proven track record of creating digital content that earns and grows an audience
  • Exceptional writing, editing, story-framing, and headline-writing skills
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to make smart, responsible decisions quickly, particularly during breaking or developing news
  • Deep familiarity with Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform-specific formats, audience behavior, discovery, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of social and short-form video storytelling, including hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, titles, and vertical video
  • Hands-on experience creating, editing, publishing, and packaging digital content—not simply directing others
  • Experience using analytics and performance data to identify opportunities and turn insights into actionable content decisions
  • Strong understanding of SEO, search and social discovery, newsletters, apps, push notifications, and digital audience development

  • Knowledge of New Jersey—its communities, culture, issues, and personalities—is a major plus
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with great instincts, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward action. You should be excited to experiment, pay close attention to what audiences are telling us through performance and engagement, and turn those insights into action. Just as importantly, you’ll be a collaborative, positive teammate who makes the people around you better.

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Twin Falls

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities – Richland/Kennewick/Pasco, Yakima, and Wenatchee stations. 

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Regional Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facilities in the Boise, Twin Falls, Tri-Cities, Yakima, and Wenatchee markets. 

 

Essential Functions:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with FCC technical rules and perform duties of Chief Operator
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Cognitive & Communication:

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Safety & Physical Requirements:

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, visually inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

  • After-hours and weekend work as required
  • On-call availability for emergency response

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.

Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX Entertainment is looking for a new member on the dynamic publicity team to lead publicity strategy and execution for high-profile scripted and unscripted series. We are looking for someone with television publicity experience across both scripted and unscripted series at a network, platform, studio or agency, with experience leading and managing publicity campaigns.


You will drive day-to-day press strategy and identify opportunities to build visibility for series and talent, including booking talk show appearances, print interviews, photo shoots, set visits, affiliate satellite tours and radio press junkets; cast appearances, screenings, New York press trips and affiliate tours; as well as series stunts and other special projects. As our Executive Director, Publicity, you will partner across departments, including Social Media, Special Ops/Content, Affiliate Marketing, Design, Digital and Programming, serving as a campaign leader for the launch and ongoing publicity of FOX series.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and lead comprehensive publicity campaigns for TV series, including scripted, unscripted, animation, event, single-camera and/or multi-camera series
  • Develop pitches, book and coordinate print interviews, talk show appearances, photo shoots, set visits, affiliate satellite tours, radio press junkets, new media initiatives and other press activities, managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Identify opportunities beyond traditional press, including creators, social platforms and cultural moments, to reach new audiences
  • Oversee creative copy and design of launch kits, press kits, invitations and special episodic mailers
  • Assist in the planning of show-specific parties, screenings, press conferences, TCA sessions and episodic milestone events
  • Prepare show synopses, talent biographies, releases, pitch letters, media alerts, episodic loglines, tip sheets and itineraries

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least seven years of television publicity experience working on both scripted and unscripted series at a network, platform, studio or agency, with experience leading and managing publicity campaigns
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication and organizational skills
  • Excellent leadership, team building, problem-solving, time management, decision-making and strategic planning skills
  • Creative thinker who brings fresh ideas and turns them into impactful campaigns
  • Ability to work well with different levels of management, as well as with talent, managers, producers, publicists, agents and studio executives
  • Experience planning and executing New York and Los Angeles press tours and appearances, multi-city press tours and major-market affiliate events
  • Strong relationships with television and entertainment press outlets across print, digital, broadcast and radio, including talk show bookers
  • Corporate communications experience helpful.

job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Perform pre-production technical checks of control room and stage systems, including signal routing, intercom and IFB functionality, camera and lighting readiness, belt pack frequencies and batteries, and audio levels.
  • Assist with setup, strike, and reconfiguration of studio, control room, and stage equipment, including cable management, panel configuration, and equipment swaps.
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to monitor production and studio spaces and escalate unresolved technical faults, documenting symptoms, troubleshooting steps taken, and resolution to support recurring-issue tracking and preventive maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Production Management to ensure studio spaces, production resources, and operational dependencies are ready before scheduled productions.
  • Work with Scheduling to verify daily crew assignments, confirm personnel arrival and check-in, and promptly escalate staffing gaps or call-outs.
  • Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, receiving, inspection, equipment staging, transport, and organized storage for studio, remote, and tentpole productions.
  • Work with the IT Asset Management team to maintain equipment lifecycle and asset records in Oracle and ServiceNow, including serial numbers, locations, condition, warranties, inventory audits, check-in/check-out, and disposition.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, including purchase requisitions and purchase orders, vendor onboarding, contract intake documentation, and routine studio and engineering supply orders.
  • Maintain a centralized PO Tracker documenting approval status, delivery timelines, budget classification, SLA tracking, and invoice reconciliation.
  • Maintain SOPs, incident logs, workflow guides, facility reference materials, and operational status reports for the Director of Production Operations. 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging. 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time, non-exempt position requiring 40 hours per week.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on production needs.
  • Seasonal position up to 7 months

job.description:
Are you a detail-driven digital producer who loves bringing campaigns to life online? Scripps is looking for a talented web professional to create, launch, maintain, and optimize contest and sponsorship experiences across our local television station websites. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of revenue, creativity, and technology — translating sold sponsorship elements into polished digital executions that make advertisers look great and audiences come back for more. From building contest landing pages and managing entry forms to ensuring every disclosure and eligibility rule is exactly right, your work will directly support local station revenue and strengthen the digital presence of Scripps markets across the country. If you thrive in a deadline-driven environment, love getting the details right, and enjoy collaborating across teams, this is your opportunity to make a real impact at one of America's leading broadcasting companies.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Create and update contest landing pages, sponsorship hubs, contest pages, entry forms, rules pages, confirmation messaging, and related content in our enterprise content management system (CMS).
  • Coordinate intake, requirements, asset collection, production, approvals, scheduling, launch, updates, expiration, archiving, and post-campaign review, as well as expertise on legal guidelines regarding contests.
  • Translate sold sponsorship elements into digital executions that accurately reflect client commitments, brand standards, campaign dates, markets, and deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary web-production contact for station sales, marketing, creative, digital, legal, and operations teams across multiple markets.
  • Perform prelaunch and ongoing quality assurance for links, forms, images, copy, disclosures, dates, mobile display, accessibility, tagging, and overall user experience.
  • Ensure official rules, eligibility language, privacy disclosures, sponsor identification, and contest content are posted as approved; escalate legal or policy questions when required.
  • Maintain reusable CMS components, page templates, documentation, naming conventions, and organized digital assets to improve speed and consistency.
  • Manage multiple simultaneous campaigns with firm launch dates, communicate status and risks, and resolve blockers before they affect station or advertiser commitments.
  • Use available analytics and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve traffic, engagement, conversion, and campaign execution.
  • Diagnose publishing, rendering, form, tracking, or content issues and coordinate with technical teams or vendors when resolution requires additional support.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Knowledge of content management systems, web publishing practices, process improvement, and documentation standards
  • Ability to create and maintain responsive digital experiences using established tools and standards
  • Strong project coordination, organizational, and prioritization skills in a deadline-driven environment
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to perform quality assurance, identify risks, and escalate issues appropriately
  • Clear communication, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Knowledge of digital advertising, analytics, accessibility, privacy, and regulatory requirements, with a focus on advertiser and campaign needs
  • Knowledge of digital media, publishing, contests, and sponsorship campaigns
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for troubleshooting and developer collaboration
  • Familiarity with digital campaign platforms, tools, and integrations
  • Ability to apply enterprise standards while adapting work to local-market needs

job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance. Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. ã

¤ CNN is hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact programs that span product, technology, design, and product operations. This is a deeply technical senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move between architecture, code, product strategy, operating models, and executive decision-making without losing the thread. The role reports directly to the Senior Director of Technical Program Management and will be trusted with ambiguous, multi-quarter programs that do not fit neatly inside one function. The programs in this portfolio often have no single functional owner, require trade-offs across several organizations, and need sustained influence with Vice Presidents, Directors, principal-level practitioners, and the teams doing the work. This is not a coordination-only position. The person in this role will define the problem, establish the program strategy, understand the underlying systems, challenge weak assumptions, create alignment, and drive measurable outcomes through delivery, launch, adoption, and iteration. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Lead a portfolio of high-priority, cross-organization technical programs from early problem framing through execution, launch, adoption, and measurable business or customer impact. Turn broad goals into clear program strategies, outcome metrics, decision rights, sequencing, governance, and executable plans across multiple teams. Build and maintain integrated plans, dependencies, critical paths, decision logs, risk views, and executive-level narratives that make the real state of the work visible. Identify the technical, product, organizational, and operational constraints that will determine success; resolve them directly or drive the right leaders to a timely decision. Work with senior leaders, including VPs, to clarify priorities, expose trade-offs, remove blockers, and create durable alignment without relying on formal authority. Move comfortably between several programs and levels of detail in the same day, while preserving context, commitments, and follow-through. Create the minimum effective operating model for each program: enough structure to move quickly and safely, without adding process that does not improve outcomes. Develop trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Operations, Architecture, Data, Security, Editorial, Revenue, and other partner organizations as the work requires. Raise the quality of program leadership across the organization by modeling strong judgment, direct communication, technical curiosity, and disciplined execution. TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS This role is not a software-engineering position, but it is intentionally more technical than a traditional program-management role. The successful candidate must be able to engage engineers and architects as a credible peer and independently investigate technical questions. Read, write, review, and reason about code. Use (ai) code when it is the fastest way to validate an assumption, automate work, inspect data, reproduce a problem, or demonstrate a solution. Understand modern software-delivery practices, including source control, pull requests, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, release strategies, and production operations. Evaluate system architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, event flows, data models, cloud infrastructure, security constraints, reliability concerns, and integration risks well enough to shape the program plan. Lead technical discovery with engineers and architects, translate findings into decisions and sequencing, and recognize when a proposed plan is technically incomplete or unrealistic. Use data and technical evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes and to challenge estimates, assumptions, or dependencies constructively. Communicate technical choices and consequences in language that product, design, operations, and executive stakeholders can act on. PRODUCT, DESIGN, AND OPERATING JUDGMENT Frame the customer, user, editorial, operational, or business problem before converging on a solution; connect program work to a clear value hypothesis. Partner closely with Product and Design to define intended outcomes, success measures, experience principles, scope boundaries, and the smallest credible path to learning or value. Pressure-test prioritization using customer impact, strategic fit, technical leverage, cost, risk, reversibility, and opportunity cost. Translate product strategy into a delivery approach that includes discovery, design, engineering, operational readiness, launch, measurement, and follow-up—not just a milestone schedule. Work with Product Operations to improve planning, decision-making, portfolio visibility, adoption, feedback loops, and repeatable ways of working across teams. Recognize when a program needs a product decision, a technical decision, an operating-model change, or an executive trade-off, and drive the correct conversation. EXECUTIVE INFLUENCE AND PROGRAM LEADERSHIP Present complex situations to senior leaders with clarity: what changed, why it matters, what choices exist, what you recommend, and what decision is needed. Escalate early and with options. Avoid status-only escalation and make it easy for leaders to take the next action. Build alignment across leaders who may have different goals, incentives, vocabulary, or operating rhythms; surface disagreement rather than allowing false consensus. Make sound decisions independently within the role's mandate and know when additional input or explicit executive sponsorship is required. Stay effective under ambiguity, organizational change, incomplete information, and shifting priorities while maintaining a high bar for quality and accountability. Create an environment in which teams can raise risks, make decisions, and move quickly without losing transparency or ownership. WHAT YOU WILL BRING Required qualifications At least 5 years of direct experience leading complex technical programs, with demonstrated principal- or senior-level scope in a matrixed organization. A strong software-engineering foundation or equivalent hands-on technical background, including the ability to complete a practical coding assessment. Demonstrated ability to understand architecture and implementation details, ask precise technical questions, and convert technical realities into an effective program strategy. Strong product judgment, including problem framing, customer or user thinking, prioritization, metrics, experimentation, and trade-off analysis. A record of driving cross-functional outcomes across Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations from ambiguity through launch and adoption. Experience influencing Directors, VPs, and other senior leaders through clear reasoning, evidence, strong recommendations, and persistent follow-through. Exceptional independence, ownership, context switching, and organizational awareness; able to enter a new domain quickly and determine what matters. Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive updates, decision documents, program narratives, and direct facilitation of difficult conversations. A practical approach to process: rigorous where risk and complexity demand it, lightweight where speed and learning matter more. Preferred qualifications Previous experience as a software engineer, engineering lead, architect, technical product manager, or similarly technical role. Experience with large-scale consumer digital products, media or publishing systems, subscriptions, advertising, data platforms, AI-enabled products, or platform modernization. Experience leading programs that require changes to both technology and the way teams plan, make decisions, or operate. Experience working across multiple time zones, business units, vendors, or shared-platform organizations. Comfort using modern development, analytics, planning, and collaboration tools to investigate work directly rather than relying only on reported status. WHAT STRONG PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE First 90 days — Context and trust: Build a clear map of the portfolio, systems, stakeholders, constraints, and unresolved decisions. Establish credibility with technical and product leaders and create momentum on the highest-value issues. By 6 months — Independent program leadership: Run multiple high-stakes programs with reliable visibility, strong technical and product framing, timely decisions, and fewer avoidable surprises. Senior leaders should view the role as a force multiplier, not an additional reporting layer. By 12 months — Durable outcomes: Deliver measurable program results, improve the organization's ability to execute across boundaries, and leave behind reusable decision, planning, and operating patterns that make future work faster and clearer. CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT The interview process will evaluate the complete shape of the role rather than program-management mechanics alone. Candidates should expect: A practical coding assessment focused on problem solving, code comprehension, implementation quality, debugging, automation, data handling, or API/system interaction. It is not intended to be a trick-algorithm exercise, but candidates must demonstrate genuine hands-on ability. A product-thinking component that evaluates problem framing, customer or user value, prioritization, success metrics, sequencing, trade-offs, and the ability to connect technical work to product outcomes. A technical program deep dive covering architecture, dependencies, delivery strategy, risk, decision-making, and how the candidate personally changed the outcome. A leadership and influence discussion focused on independence, ambiguity, context switching, executive communication, conflict, and driving action across organizational boundaries. job.title: Assistant Manager, Programming and Content Curation
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Assistant Manager, Programming and Content Curation Job ID 10158450 Location City of Taguig, Philippines Business The Walt Disney Company (APAC) Date posted Oct. 14, 2026 Assistant Manager, Programming and Content Curation Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Wherever you are in the amazing world of Disney, you are contributing to the stories of our iconic brands, recognized by audiences everywhere for entertainment, information and inspiration. Innovation, imagination and inclusion are at the core of Disney, defining the experience that we deliver as well as providing the foundation of our success. The scope of our business, combined with global growth and collaboration, results in an inclusive employee experience characterized by continuous learning, development and achievement. Disney Entertainment (DE) brings together the Disney’s best-in-class product, technology, and commercialization teams together into one global organization. DE is responsible for the P&L management and all distribution, network and engineering operations, sales, advertising, data, and certain key technology functions worldwide for the Company’s content engines. DE also manages operations of the Company’s streaming services including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+ and Disney+ Hotstar; and domestic broadcast and cable television networks. Disney+ is the dedicated streaming home for movies and shows from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star and more. Disney+ is available on most internet-connected devices and offers commercial-free programming with a variety of original feature-length films, documentaries, live-action and animated series and short-form content. Alongside unprecedented access to Disney’s incredible library of film and television entertainment, the service is also the exclusive streaming home for the latest releases from The Walt Disney Studios. The Assistant Manager, Programming and Content Curation will be responsible for providing assistance in executing programming and content curation plans for Disney+. The role is vital to plan and execute content strategy and high-impact curation to ensure subscribers are engaged via a calendar of editorial initiatives that support content discovery and time spent viewing, critical to supporting broader business KPIs of subscriber retention and customer lifetime value. The role will become an expert/super-user in the Disney+ programming and curation tool. This role is based in The Philippines. Build, publish and manage content on Disney+ in the Disney CMS in order to maximize audience engagement and retention. Ensure the Disney+ platform is up to date with the latest content made available through our delivery workflow. Quality assurance of content as it is published to the Disney+ platform, checking that content plays out as expected, appears in the planned placements and all information is accurate, localised, and is of highest editorial standard. Identify, triage and escalate urgent issues through to support channels as required Work closely with the regional programming & content curation team and global teams to wireframe the service each week. Prioritizing events and programs depending on a variety of global/local requirements, and in the editorial tone of voice of the D+ service. Work closely with marketing teams to ensure alignment of local messaging and agreed prioritisation of titles on the service. Assist in the trafficking of artwork assets and metadata. Partner with Product teams on testing new features in the CMS to improve guest experience. Facilitate verbal and written communications between teams, and to the larger organisation to ensure smooth information-sharing, issue resolution, and workload transitions. Track performance of merchandising areas of the service over time. Leverage assigned market & service behaviour data, audience research to drive data and analytics that determine effective programming strategies. This role works closely with Lifecycle and Brand & Content Marketing to ensure business priorities are communicated accurately and according to the broader content marketing strategy. Supports Regional Programming initiatives as needed. Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree Fluent in English (spoken and written). Deep understanding of TWDC content library, brands, franchises, and characters. Keen interest in Asian content. A Strong understanding of Philippines market landscape is a must Prior experience in the streaming industry is considered an advantage. Previous experience in data analysis would be a plus. Comprehensive expertise in digital media platforms, including hands-on management of web, app, streaming, and connected devices. Proven ability to work across a matrixed organization while also able to self-motivate. Demonstrated ability to thrive working in an extremely fast-paced environment. Skills: Adopts a challenging and questioning approach, proposing information and solutions in creative ways. Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload to meet competing deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations. Collaborative team player with a strong ability to build trust, foster open communication, and contribute to shared success. Agile and proactive to learn or adapt to new tools as needed Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy Strategic thinker with good communications skills. Creative mindset with the ability to leverage on data to develop strategy/decisions. Results-oriented Proficient in computer systems. Expert level in the use of Excel, PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Docs, and other relevant software tools The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. We are committed to building a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Disclaimer This position is with The Walt Disney Company Philippines, Inc, which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (APAC). From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. job.title: Creative Strategy & Partnership Marketing Intern, Glendale, Spring 2027
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Creative Strategy & Partnership Marketing Intern, Glendale, Spring 2027 Job ID 10162405 Location Glendale, California, United States Business Disney Experiences Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 Creative Strategy & Partnership Marketing Intern, Glendale, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Be part of an innovative team and culture… Do you live for the Big Idea? Do you know how to make something compelling that people will want to connect with? If so, we would love to hear from you! Every day we have fun creating compelling, memorable work for one of the greatest brands on the planet. This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the Glendale, CA area from January 2027 - June 2027 A day in the life… The Creative Strategy & Partnership Marketing Intern will support the team who develops and executes creative marketing initiatives across Disney Experiences. Working alongside marketing, creative, production, and partnership teams, the intern will gain hands-on experience in campaign planning, content development, creative strategy, and project coordination. This role provides an opportunity to learn how creative ideas move from concept to execution while supporting day-to-day project needs. The intern will assist with research, presentation development, content tracking, meeting coordination, and various projects that contribute to the team's success. The intern will gain exposure to the creative development process, including traditional and non-traditional advertising, partnership marketing initiatives, and content production for both Disney-owned platforms and third-party networks. This internship offers a unique opportunity to learn from industry professionals while contributing to meaningful projects that support business and marketing objectives. The Intern will gain an understanding of the programming process from pitch to execution, in producing traditional and non-traditional advertising content including linear and streaming programming content on 3rd Party Networks and Disney owned platforms. Key Responsibilities: Assist with project tracking, meeting coordination, and team communications to help keep projects organized and on schedule. Assist in creating presentations, recap documents, and other materials for team and stakeholder meetings. Help compile campaign results, performance summaries, and post-project recaps to support team reporting and learning opportunities. Maintain project documents, trackers, and organizational resources that support collaboration across teams. Conduct research on industry trends, consumer interests, entertainment marketing initiatives, and partnership campaigns to support creative development and brainstorming efforts. Assist in the development of broadcast, streaming, and short-form content projects. Research various topics and compile findings to support content development and production activities. Support project management activities, including scheduling meetings, tracking deliverables, and updating project status reports. Familiarize yourself with video clip libraries and source materials to support production and creative needs. Track programming initiatives and assist with recap reporting. Create presentations, pitch decks, and visual storytelling materials that support internal and external initiatives. What we are looking for… Basic Qualifications: Strong organizational and communication skills. Proficiency with Keynote and PowerPoint presentation skills. Strong experience in both Windows and Mac environments. The ability to communicate through Outlook and messaging. An interest in Strategy and Content Production. Preferred Qualifications: Ability to collaborate with others, accept feedback and enthusiastically perform a wide range of tasks. Detail oriented, strong self-initiative and the ability to prioritize responsibilities. High level energy with a strong desire to learn and grow. Creative problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with creative applications such as Adobe Premier and/or Photoshop Required Materials: Candidates selected to advance to the hiring leader interview will be asked to submit a previously completed PowerPoint or Keynote presentation that reflects their own independent work. Job Summary: Job Requirements Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. One of the goals for the Ad Platforms is to transform advertising and Disney's Ad platform with AI and data science. We build solutions to measure and optimize every aspect of the advertising life cycle. Our tenant is a strong cross-domain team to deliver E2E solutions for machine learning and data science. Our team is seeking a principal machine learning engineer who will be an outstanding addition and leading development for prediction or optimization engines for addressable ad platforms. The right person for this role should be experienced in crafting implementation for either machine learning technologies or data-driven algorithms. If you are someone who is proactive, inquisitive, and innovative in these domains, this is a phenomenal role for you! Job Summary: As our team's Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will apply your battle-tested experience, deep technical knowledge of software and systems including Machine Learning and AI technologies, and leadership skills to unblock and guide our ML , Research and functional teams to create scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable models and pipelines. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Apply state of the art AI/ML to the Innovation and Creative Platforms for Ad Experiences. Leverage novel backend and/or ML/AI solutions for complex ad serving challenges with fast turnaround. Drive design and implementation of LLM and GenAI related applications ensuring scalable and efficient approaches for large scale data analysis and model development. Provide Prompt Engineering support to different functional team Identify and experiment models from training, testing, production rollout to continuous optimization. Lead the ad algorithm architecture design and iterations for models Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and program managers in an open and creative environment to design, implement and productionalize solutions. Mentor team members and support their technical growth. Leverage observability tools to provide visibility into performance of AI/ML and other backend solutions Support oncall activities on a rotational basis Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience At least 10 years of working experience on large scale machine learning Strong knowledge of and experience implementing AI/ML technologies and applying mathematical and statistical concepts. Proficient in Java, Python, Scala, large scale ML/DL platforms and processing tech stack. Ability to collaborate with and lead projects across cross-functional teams such as Product Management, Architecture, and other Engineering teams Passionate about understanding the ad business, applying advanced research to relevant business scenarios, and seeking innovation opportunities to enhance business effectiveness. Passionate about technology, open to interdisciplinary collaborations, and experienced in building data-driven services and applications. A proven track record of thriving in a fast-paced, data-driven, and collaborative work environment is required. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in large scale machine learning using tools such as scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, pytorch Experience with LLM-based application development, using LLM-as-a-service providers such as AWS Bedrock, Azure Cognitive Services, or Google's Vertex AI Experience using frameworks such as LangGraph, Crew AI, and strands sdk for developing agents Experience with vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation Experience with best practices in agentic development such as LLM guardrails, tool calling, and consistent APIs such as MCP and A2A Experience with designing and implementing agentic architectures in multiple modalities such as text, image, video, and audio. Experience in the advertising, digital video advertising, or digital marketing domain Required Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related equivalent experience. Preferred Education: Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, Information Systems or related equivalent experience. #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $220,600 to $295,900 per year and in Glendale, CA is $210,500 to $282,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.title: Account Executive, Ad Sales
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a data-driven, results-oriented Account Executive to drive podcast and digital media sales for some of the most recognized names in the creator marketplace. This role spans across multiple platforms—including Podcast, YouTube, and Social Media—offering a unique opportunity to work with high-profile creators and innovative brands.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive business development by identifying and cultivating relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders across holding company advertising agencies and brands.
  • Sell various ad formats, including host-read endorsements, Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), programmatic, video, and custom branded content integrations across the entire podcast portfolio.
  • Develop and deliver tailored sales presentations that clearly articulate value and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prospect and pitch new business, expanding Red Seat Ventures’ footprint and share of client advertising budgets.
  • Lead the full sales cycle from initial outreach and proposal creation through negotiation, closing, and post sale client presentations.
  • Work with Sales Assistants and Account Managers to ensure flawless campaign execution, overseeing all aspects of delivery, reporting, and client satisfaction.
  • Create custom marketing and media solutions that align with client goals and optimize results across multiple platforms.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of meeting and exceeding revenue goals in media sales;, preferably across podcasting, digital audio, TV, or social platforms.
  • Existing relationships with audio and digital buyers at major holding company agencies and brand teams. 
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to inform strategy and decision making.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a talent for building long term relationships.
  • Self starter with a passion for storytelling, content, and the evolving creator economy.

job.title: Executive Director, Publicity
job.description:
FOX Entertainment is looking for a new member on the dynamic publicity team to lead publicity strategy and execution for high-profile scripted and unscripted series. We are looking for someone with television publicity experience across both scripted and unscripted series at a network, platform, studio or agency, with experience leading and managing publicity campaigns.

You will drive day-to-day press strategy and identify opportunities to build visibility for series and talent, including booking talk show appearances, print interviews, photo shoots, set visits, affiliate satellite tours and radio press junkets; cast appearances, screenings, New York press trips and affiliate tours; as well as series stunts and other special projects. As our Executive Director, Publicity, you will partner across departments, including Social Media, Special Ops/Content, Affiliate Marketing, Design, Digital and Programming, serving as a campaign leader for the launch and ongoing publicity of FOX series.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and lead comprehensive publicity campaigns for TV series, including scripted, unscripted, animation, event, single-camera and/or multi-camera series
  • Develop pitches, book and coordinate print interviews, talk show appearances, photo shoots, set visits, affiliate satellite tours, radio press junkets, new media initiatives and other press activities, managing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Identify opportunities beyond traditional press, including creators, social platforms and cultural moments, to reach new audiences
  • Oversee creative copy and design of launch kits, press kits, invitations and special episodic mailers
  • Assist in the planning of show-specific parties, screenings, press conferences, TCA sessions and episodic milestone events
  • Prepare show synopses, talent biographies, releases, pitch letters, media alerts, episodic loglines, tip sheets and itineraries

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least seven years of television publicity experience working on both scripted and unscripted series at a network, platform, studio or agency, with experience leading and managing publicity campaigns
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication and organizational skills
  • Excellent leadership, team building, problem-solving, time management, decision-making and strategic planning skills
  • Creative thinker who brings fresh ideas and turns them into impactful campaigns
  • Ability to work well with different levels of management, as well as with talent, managers, producers, publicists, agents and studio executives
  • Experience planning and executing New York and Los Angeles press tours and appearances, multi-city press tours and major-market affiliate events
  • Strong relationships with television and entertainment press outlets across print, digital, broadcast and radio, including talk show bookers
  • Corporate communications experience helpful.
