job.description:
WORK OPTION

In Office _________________

Position Summary

The Technical Manager, Local Media serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the execution, performance, and continuous improvement of production technology services supporting the NBA's Local Media ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President, Production Technology, this role leads the day-to-day technical operations supporting Local Media league program facilitated game broadcasts, ensuring reliable, scalable, and consistent execution across NBA arenas and NBA Secaucus. Serving as an operational owner of the technical production service function for the Local Media team, the Technical Manager oversees production technology operations supporting broadcast contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, master control, HSAN connectivity, and distribution workflows. This position provides leadership to freelance Technical Managers, establishes operational standards and best practices, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and partners closely with GPM Broadcast Engineering & Broadcast Operations, technical production operations vendors, NBA teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver best-in-class live broadcasts. The Technical Manager serves as the primary technical liaison between engineering, production, and broadcast operations, ensuring technical readiness, operational excellence, and seamless execution across all League-supported productions. This role partners closely with the Vice President, Production Technology to translate strategic technology initiatives into scalable operational capabilities while continuously improving the League's production technology service model. This position is based in the NBA Secaucus office and requires regular in-office attendance five (5) days per week. This role supports live NBA game productions and League events and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours in accordance with the NBA game schedule and other League programming. Occasional domestic travel to NBA arenas and other League event locations may be required.

Major Responsibilities

Operational Leadership Lead the League's Technical Manager function, providing leadership, coaching, scheduling, onboarding, performance feedback, and operational oversight for freelance Technical Managers supporting NBA Local Media productions. Serve as the primary point of contact for the Local Media production operation working with the GPM Broadcast Engineering team on the HSAN connectivity platform, ensuring reliable contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, and distribution of live NBA game broadcasts. Own, in conjunction with the NBA with Broadcast Engineering & Operations team, the operational performance, service delivery, and reliability of production technology services supporting League-produced broadcasts. Establish operational priorities, technical standards, service levels, governance processes, and best practices supporting production technology operations across League-supported productions. Oversee day-to-day production technology operations between NBA arenas, NBA Secaucus, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, production operations vendors, distribution, and participating NBA teams. Lead operational readiness planning for all supported productions, ensuring technical infrastructure, connectivity, transmission paths, communications systems, and production technologies are fully prepared prior to each event. Partner with the Vice President, Production Technology in developing the long-term operational roadmap for production technology services, ensuring operational readiness, scalability, and alignment with evolving business priorities. Support implementation and operational transition of new production technologies, workflows, and infrastructure initiatives developed by Production Technology leadership. Live Broadcast Operations Coordinate production technology, transmission, signal acquisition, routing, monitoring, master control, and broadcast distribution workflows supporting live NBA game productions. Serve as a primary technical escalation point during live productions, leading cross-functional troubleshooting efforts and coordinating rapid resolution of production technology issues. Lead technical incident response during live broadcasts, directing cross-functional teams to restore service while minimizing operational impact. Develop contingency plans, operational playbooks, and technical readiness procedures supporting mission-critical live productions. Provide operational leadership for preseason games, NBA All-Star, NBA Summer League, international games, and other League events. Participate in after-hours operational support and on-call rotations supporting live productions and critical production technology systems. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures, engineering runbooks, technical documentation, and operational support workflows. Establish, monitor, and report on operational KPIs, service levels, incident trends, and system performance metrics to identify opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency. Lead post-event operational reviews, root cause analyses, corrective action planning, and lessons learned following technical incidents. Recommend workflow enhancements, automation opportunities, and operational improvements that improve service quality, scalability, resiliency, and production efficiency. Coordinate maintenance windows, software deployments, network changes, and system upgrades while minimizing operational impact to live productions. Ensure operational compliance with League technical standards, broadcast quality expectations, and established production technology procedures. Evaluate production technology operations and recommend process improvements that support long-term operational excellence and organizational scalability. Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership Lead onboarding, mentoring, scheduling, performance management, and ongoing development of freelance Technical Managers and technical support personnel. Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement. Build and maintain strong partnerships with NBA teams, internal departments, broadcast partners, and key stakeholders to ensure consistent technical execution and exceptional service delivery. Provide subject matter expertise supporting new production workflows, operational planning, and League-wide production technology initiatives. Support annual operational planning, staffing strategies, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and production technology expense management. Represent Production Technology within cross-functional planning meetings and operational governance forums, ensuring alignment across engineering, production, operations, and distribution teams. job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Telemundo Station Group, part of the NBCUniversal Owned Television Stations division of NBCUniversal, is comprised of 26 local television stations in the U.S. and Puerto Rico. Producing and broadcasting more than 15,000 hours of unique and relevant local content each year, including award-winning news, public affairs, and entertainment programming, Telemundo Station Group serves the largest Hispanic television markets in the country including Los Angeles, New York, Miami-Fort Lauderdale, Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, Chicago, San Antonio, San Francisco Bay Area, Phoenix, Harlingen, Orlando, Fresno, Sacramento,  Philadelphia, Washington D.C., San Diego, Tampa, Denver, El Paso, Boston, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City, Tucson, Hartford, Fort Myers, Springfield, Richmond and Puerto Rico. In addition, Telemundo Station Group operates TeleXitos, a national multicast network that offers viewers popular action and adventure television series and feature films in Spanish. The group also provides support to 50 Telemundo affiliates across the country and manages dedicated local websites and applications, as well as a robust digital out-of-home operation.

Telemundo Fresno is looking for a Photographer/Editor. As a Photographer/Editor, you will be responsible for shooting and editing stories, including spot news and features.

The ideal candidate will directly work with and report to Assignment Desk and works closely with Executive Producer and New Director.

  • Through the creative use of the camera, and proficient lighting and editing skills, will provide the viewer with a story on a given topic.
  • Will operate camera, or cellular bonded technology and edit on Adobe Premier Pro edit systems.
  • Respond quickly to breaking news while taking directions and interacting with the assignment desk, reporters/anchors, production, control room, and appropriate personnel.
  • Shoot and edit high-quality video, interviews, and story packages
  • Set up and operate microphones and monitor audio levels
  • Set up and operate lighting equipment
  • Perform work under pressure with multiple, daily deadlines
  • Gather video and interviews independently as needed
  • Troubleshoot technical issues in the field

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism and/or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience as a news photographer
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) both written and verbal
  • Be available to work evenings, weekends and holidays as required
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV on www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds of equipment at a given time – including camera, lighting kit, cable reel, and LiveU and Dejero units.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be willing to work in Fresno, CA
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program
  • Must have valid driver’s license and good driving record
  • Must be willing to work evenings and weekends
  • Must be hands on

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Director, Content Analytics & Insights, will sit on the NBC/Bravo Cross-Platform Analytics team within NBCU Media Group Decision Sciences and serve as a key leader overseeing content performance and forecasting for entertainment series across NBC and Bravo, including linear and Peacock performance. This role acts as a strategic authority on content and audience intelligence, managing a high-performing team responsible for delivering actionable insights, scalable analytical frameworks, and self-service data solutions for a wide range of NBCU stakeholders and clients.

This leader will partner closely with Content Programming, Scheduling, Marketing, Ad Sales/Finance, Communications, and Strategy while integrating with other groups across Decision Sciences to translate first- and third-party Nielsen data into clear recommendations that inform business decision-making. The role will have a direct and measurable impact on the success of NBC and Bravo entertainment series in the linear and streaming landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop deep expertise for NBC Entertainment and Bravo content performance and audiences across linear and Peacock, serving as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders across Programming, Scheduling, Comms/PR, Strategy, Marketing, and Finance

  • Develop and oversee linear ratings forecasts and audience projections, leveraging historical performance, marketplace trends, and viewing behaviors to deliver actionable guidance for Ad Sales, Finance, and Scheduling stakeholders
  • Partner closely with Consumer Insights to shape research agendas and deliver integrated, holistic perspectives on content performance and audience engagement via comprehensive End of Season reports
  • Translate audience data to provide strategic consultation and research support to Programming, Marketing, Finance, and Strategy stakeholders (often thru ad-hoc and urgent requests), helping inform decisions related to content development, scheduling, promotion, audience growth, and franchise expansion
  • Identify emerging audience trends and changes in viewing behavior across the broader linear and streaming landscape, proactively surfacing competitive intel, implications and strategic opportunities for NBCUniversal's entertainment portfolio
  • Collaborate with Operations & Technology teams to oversee the data requirements, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of data products that enable scalable, self-service access to insights across NBCU
  • Own projects end-to-end, from framing and planning through execution and delivery, ensuring outputs are timely, accurate and aligned with business objectives
  • Champion data democratization, performance storytelling, and data-driven decision-making across the organization
  • Harness AI solution to accelerate analysis, surface patterns and trends, and deepen actionable insight
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing, high-output analytics team while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and equitable culture within NBCUniversal

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in the media and entertainment industry, with a strong track record of working with large, complex datasets (Nielsen and first-party) and advanced analytical tools
  • Expertise in Nielsen measurement methodology, data and reporting systems (NPower, NNTV) with experience running complex segmentation analyses for both linear/traditional and streaming content/platforms
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively, confidently, and persuasively with stakeholders at all levels, especially executive leadership, and comfort presenting and speaking extemporaneously in senior forums
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming/media landscape and a love and appreciation for great unscripted and scripted content
  • Strategic, outcome-oriented thinker with the ability to derive insights, conclusions, and recommendations from ambiguous or unstructured data from disparate sources
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance workflows, including automating repetitive work, synthesizing large and disparate datasets to surface themes, and identifying patterns and trends more quickly
  • Highly collaborative leader with strong intellectual curiosity, accountability, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to drive projects of varying scope with clarity and purpose
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative or analytical field required
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, SQL and Tableau

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supervising entry-level and mid-career employees

Department: Video Technology Group

Paramount direct-to-consumer is a division of Paramount Skydance Corporation that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS Sports Digital and CBS News Digital.


Description: 

Division Overview:
The Video Technology Group delivers industry-leading  streaming solutions, setting company-wide video standards and enabling premium content delivery to millions daily. The team drives innovation in digital video and supports integration of video delivery systems across all Paramount products.

As part of this group, the Live Video Platform team builds and maintains live streaming encoding platforms, manages video processing and publishing workflows, and integrates with CMS and publishing pipelines. This role involves working on high-visibility, mission-critical projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies to deliver exceptional video experiences and maximize user engagement and revenue.

 

Role Details:
Do you have a passion for live streaming? Are you a builder that enjoys creating innovative solutions? Do you love to solve problems and continually learn?  Do you have a strong background in video streaming and compression?  Does sharing your knowledge and collaborating across multiple teams in a DevOps culture sound exciting to you?  If you answered yes, then we may be looking for you!  

 

Your Day-to-Day:
●    Quality Assurance workflows across a suite of back-end and front-end frameworks
●    Other video QA and software engineers to build, test, and release these video platforms
●    Automation testing across the whole end-to-end video lifecycle, including acquisition, processing, delivery and playback. 
●    Development and maintenance of internal automated QA systems, ensuring that QA testing is seamlessly integrated with continuous integration and deployment strategies
●    Define and develop useful metrics and alerts for monitoring live streaming events and proactively identify reliability risks.
●    Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
●    Working with internal services to increase automation of the QA workflow.
●    Reviewing test plans with team members to test across different points in the video pipeline.
●    Analyzing test reports, and thoroughly documenting bugs.
●    Create and maintain detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
●    Monitor and track resolution of defects, coordinating with developers in order to prevent, report, and resolve defects
●    Provide QA support both pre and post deployment including occasional evenings and weekends.
●    Investigate and resolve issues in live streaming workflows by collecting relevant logs and metrics, diving into troubleshooting, and suggesting mitigations.
●    Sitting between developers and internal customer teams to ensure platform reliability, scalability & availability.
●    Working with the development team to test new product features and provide feedback into product development for our video streaming platform.
●    Interfacing with other platform teams to build and test video streaming workflows end-to-end.

Key Projects:
●    Aligning test plans to cover Live end-to-end video lifecycle testing.
●    Support Video infrastructure QA and Monitoring for major league launches like UFC, NFL
●    Standardizing regression practices across application platforms and improving automation QA coverage.


Qualifications:
You have -
●    Experience developing pytest automated test framework (or similar) and familiarity with a range of automated test strategies. 
●    Experience working with distributed systems and creating QA strategies to enhance fault-tolerant of such architectures.
●    7+ years of experience with live streaming video or distributed software QA.
●    Strong troubleshooting skills.
●    Drive issues to resolution and provide root cause analysis if needed.
●    Experience with streaming protocols such as HLS, DASH, CMAF, SRT, Zixi, RTP, RTMP.
●    Experience with modern video & audio codecs such as H264, HEVC, VP9, AV1, AAC.
●    Knowledge and understanding of DRM, SCTE-104/35, Closed Captioning, Digital Ad Insertion.
●    Experience with AWS Media Services (MediaLive, MediaConnect, MediaPackage) and / or competing vendors (Zixi, Unified Origin, ATETE, Harmonic, Bitmovin).
●    Experience with REST APIs and data-interchange formats such as JSON and XML.
●    The ability to successfully work with internal business units & teams with varying technical backgrounds.
●    Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
●    Tooling & Ecosystem:
○    Experience with Docker and, preferably, Kubernetes.
○    Familiarity with working within cloud providers (AWS, GCP, OCI) and infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform.
○    Exposure to building Python REST APIs. We use FastAPI with Celery for distributed task processing.
●    BS degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study or equivalent practical experience.


You might also have -
●    Familiarity of Rust 
●    Live streaming operations experience.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFMY-TV Greensboro, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Greensboro is seeking an innovative Producer to shape our daily newscasts. At WFMY-TV Greensboro, we build creative shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We prioritize original storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of our newscasts to set our product apart in the Greensboro market. 

At TEGNA, we are committed to our core values: We Win, We Work Smarter, We Demand the Truth, and We Do the Right Thing. These values guide how we create content and serve our communities.

We value a collaborative, motivated journalist who works well within a team to bring the truth to our growing audiences across platforms, starting with our streaming and broadcast services. We want your authentic personality to drive your storytelling and writing in an exciting and captivating manner to hold the audience.

You’ll also have access to modern tools and workflows as TEGNA continues to drive innovation.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories.
  • Show off your creativity and storytelling skills.
  • Craft stories of all lengths on all platforms for specific audiences.
  • Meet daily deadlines.
  • Combine live pictures, graphics, compelling video and emotional sound to create an engaging experience for our audience.
  • Booth continuous coverage on our live streams for breaking news and community events.
  • Consistently try new things after thoughtful discussion with supervisors.
  • Allow the impactful and emotional conversations the community needs to drive the content in your rundown.
  • Use data analytics to help shape the content of your show.
  • Challenge traditional ways of doing things.
  • Ensure all communities and viewpoints have a voice and presence in your show.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in journalism, communications or related field or equivalent years of experience.
  • 1-3 years of news content experience.
  • Top-notch communication skills are an absolute must.
  • Solid journalistic judgement and a news philosophy that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement. 
  • Understanding of the tenets of professional journalism.
  • Skills in producing engaging, content-driven newscasts and digital content.
  • Strong social media skills, including an active news hound presence on your preferred social platforms. 
  • Organizational skills and the ability to work under time pressure deadlines.
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events. 
  • ENPS and Edius system experience preferred.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role:

#LI-Onsite 

The New York Times is an international brand that prints nine daily newspapers. These are printed at our Print Plant in College Point, Queens, and distributed to the New York Metropolitan area and the Eastern Seaboard. Our daily work is guided by our mission and values. 

We are looking for a part-time casual Paperhandler with in-depth knowledge of all Paperhandler equipment and multiple newsprint roll types for commercial printing. You will undergo a training period, after which you will read work orders or receive instructions to determine work assignments, material, and equipment requirements. You will be reporting to the Deputy Plant Manager and you will report to work onsite at our Printing facility in College Point, Queens, New York. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Ensure that all paper rolls for the nine daily newspapers are handled and transported safely. 
  • Work in a Union production environment with deadlines on a daily basis. 
  • Take inventory of paper rolls and prepare them for use in the printing facility. 
  • Ensure that all paper rolls are stacked according to safety regulations. 
  • Operate Paperhandler equipment safely while working with extreme care and caution. 
  • You must maintain a clean environment in the paper storage area. 
  • You must follow all safety guidelines and report any accidents or incidents to the supervisor. 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Must be willing to work flexible hours in a Union production environment on a daily basis. 
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. 
  • Can stand and walk for 8-10 hours per shift and lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be willing to undergo a background check. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 1+ year of experience in a production environment. 
  • The ability to work with different types of paperhandler equipment. 
  • The ability to work in a team environment. 

This role is a union role represented by the Paperhandlers and Straighteners Union.

REQ-#020015

Additional Compensation and Benefits

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

The shift rate of pay for this role is:$163.60—$163.60 USD

job.title: Sr. Staff Threat Intelligence Engineer
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the Role As our Sr. Staff Threat Intelligence Engineer, you’ll lead Suno’s work to understand and counter the adversaries targeting our platform, our users, and our business across security, trust & safety, and fraud. You’ll identify who is targeting Suno and how they operate, and turn that understanding into defenses across the company. Your analysis will shape how our security, T&S, and fraud teams prioritize risk and invest in protections. Your technical depth will make sure those recommendations hold up in our systems. This is a high-leverage role that will define how Suno anticipates and responds to emerging threats as the platform grows What You'll Do Investigate the threat actors and campaigns targeting Suno, from account takeovers and payment fraud to coordinated platform abuse, and connect activity across all three areas. Analyze large-scale event and account data with Python and SQL to find patterns, link related activity, and size emerging threats. Translate adversary tactics into concrete countermeasures, recommending detection, product, and architecture changes that engineering teams can build. Brief security, T&S, and fraud leaders with intelligence ranging from quick situational updates to deeper strategic assessments. Raise the bar for the team by setting standards for collection, analysis, and tradecraft as the threat intelligence function grows. Protect the community creating on Suno, so making music stays safe, fun, and open to everyone What You'll Need Must-Haves 10+ years of experience in threat intelligence, with significant depth in at least two of security, trust & safety, and fraud. Strong threat intelligence fundamentals: tracking threat actors, attributing campaigns to them, OSINT, and linking related accounts and infrastructure. Hands-on data skills: Python scripting and SQL against large datasets to drive your own investigations. Technical fluency in modern web and cloud architecture. You need to understand how an attack works and how to break it, without needing to ship production code yourself. A track record of influencing engineering, product, and leadership teams that don't report to you, and turning findings into action Nice-to-Haves Experience with generative AI misuse, such as account farming, API or reseller abuse, or automated content abuse. Background at a consumer platform or a company built on user-generated content. Experience partnering with engineers to design detection rules and abuse signals. Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms or graph analysis tools. Work Location Policy This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience. Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees Company Equity Package 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k) Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave Creative Education Stipend Generous Commuter Allowance In-Office Lunch (5 days per week) Compensation: The annual salary range for this role is $316,080 - $414,855 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

job.title: Artist & Label Partnerships Manager - GSA (15-month fixed-term)
job.description:
We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors.

As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization.

In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. 

We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. 

This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

job.title: Data Scientist - Business Analytics
job.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

job.title: Director of Sales - Emerging & Scaled (New Business)
job.description:
Spotify's Emerging & Scaled (E&S) business is growing rapidly across the US and Canada, and we're investing in accelerating first-time advertiser growth. As part of our mission to help brands connect with fans through audio and video, we're expanding our New Business organization.
We're looking for an experienced Director of Sales to lead our New Business acquisition strategy across North America. In this role, you'll lead and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team, driving the full sales cycle from prospecting through closing. Reporting to E&S leadership, you'll shape scalable acquisition strategies, strengthen pipeline generation, and create a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching and measurable performance goals. You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

job.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
job.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer.

As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

job.title: Principal Engineer - ONESOURCE Income Tax
job.description:
Job Description

Are you an engineering leader who likes solving hard technical problems and also understands the business behind them? Thomson Reuters is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the ONESOURCE Income Tax team. Our portfolio includes Income Tax, Estimated Payments, DataQuery and Reporting, Workpapers, and General Ledger Manager Classic. These are tier-one products that large US corporations rely on to file their taxes, and our customers have high expectations.

Our applications are built on .NET, Angular, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL. DataQuery, our data warehousing solution, runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with a Looker front end. Our products are delivered through the ONESOURCE platform, hosted on AWS and GCP, and customers also use them through our APIs. We have started building with AI, including our own MCP servers, and we are moving toward agentic AI.

In this role, you will set the long-term technical vision for our current platforms and the applications we build next. You will set engineering standards, lead secure design practices, and help the team through SOC audits and third-party security testing. You will also represent engineering to Product, Security, the Product Management Office, and senior leadership. This is a strategic, high-impact role. You will be seen as a technical role model, both inside the organization and in the wider industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Technical vision and strategy: Set the long-term technical vision for the ONESOURCE Income Tax portfolio. Design solutions that support long-term business goals and contribute to strategy across the business unit.
  • Architecture and standards: Understand our current legacy systems in depth. Define the architecture patterns, standards, and best practices for future applications.
  • Agentic AI: Help design the architecture for AI agents and expand the team's existing MCP server capabilities. Find places where AI and other technologies can change how the business works.
  • Security and compliance: Lead the team's approach to secure design so applications pass third-party penetration tests and meet our high standards for Snyk vulnerability scanning. Set up patterns and processes for the team to follow instead of fixing issues yourself. Help the team through SOC audits and related controls.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: Guide the design, maintenance, and modernization of applications and infrastructure on AWS and GCP.
  • Complex, high-risk initiatives: Lead complex projects with significant risk that affect a whole sub-business unit, function, or major product. Run development reviews and spot and fix weaknesses in existing designs.
  • Technology selection: Lead the selection, evaluation, and rollout of new technologies and tools, and promote their adoption across teams.
  • Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Product Owners, ISRM/Security, the Product Management Office, and senior leadership. Represent the engineering team and negotiate solutions between key people.
  • Communication: Present complex technical ideas and technology strategy to executives, technical managers, peers, and developers.
  • Mentorship and culture: Mentor and coach Senior and Lead engineers. Help individual contributors understand proposed technical changes and strengthen the wider engineering culture.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Start and take part in work across business units. Look for shared opportunities and recommend improvements to processes, products, or services.
  • Innovation: Encourage practical innovation and contribute to standards and patents. Develop new concepts, services, and technologies that meet current and future customer needs.
  • Project partnership: Work with project managers to include technical status in project reports. Lead or support several projects at once.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in senior, lead, or principal-level technical leadership roles
  • Strong experience with the Microsoft stack (.NET / C#), Angular, Microsoft SQL Server, and PostgreSQL
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and GCP, covering both applications and infrastructure
  • A proven record of designing and evolving large, high-availability enterprise applications, including modernizing legacy systems
  • Strong grounding in secure software design and application security, including Snyk (or similar tools), penetration testing and fixing what it finds, and secure coding standards
  • Familiarity with SOC audits and the engineering controls and evidence that compliance requires
  • Experience leading through influence: setting technical direction, defining patterns and standards, and guiding teams without managing them directly
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience working with Product, Security, program management, and senior leadership
  • Business sense and the ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business results

Preferred Qualifications

  • A background as a software or solutions architect
  • Experience in the tax, accounting, finance, or a related regulated domain
  • Experience with agentic AI, LLM-based solutions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
  • Experience with GCP data warehousing solutions and Looker
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (for example, Terraform or CloudFormation) and CI/CD practices
  • Experience designing and governing APIs used by external customers
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (for example, AWS or GCP Professional Architect, or security certifications)
  • An external presence, such as conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or work on industry standards
  • Experience mentoring Senior and Lead engineers and building engineering culture across several teams

#LI-GK1

Job Description

Product Manager – Pagero

Our customers send and receive invoices, but not always digitally. Some arrive on paper or as an emailed PDF, and some have to reach a customer's online bank or digital mailbox. Could you help make sure every document gets where it's going?

You will join the team that ensures our customers can trade with businesses and consumers who don't send or receive standard e-invoices, taking ONESOURCE Pagero beyond markets with e-invoicing mandates and delivering growth through global reach. You will work in both directions: enabling customers to receive invoices and orders, that arrive on paper or email, and to send invoices in print, by email, or, in the Nordics, to a customer's online bank or digital mailbox. These services combine Pagero's invoice expertise with specialist sub-processors, including AI solutions.

You will report to the Director of Product Management. If you already know Pagero from integration, services or support, you'll have a head start, and if you're new to it, you'll learn quickly. This role suits someone early in their product career, and you will learn from experienced Product Managers. As your skills and ownership grow, you will take on more responsibilities.


ONESOURCE Pagero is Thomson Reuters’ solution for e-invoicing and digital business document exchange. Businesses connect once to the open Pagero Network to send and receive compliant e-invoices and other business documents, such as purchase orders, with their customers, suppliers and tax authorities, whatever systems they use.


Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as Product Manager - Pagero, you will:

  • Help provide, manage and grow the services, from paper and PDF invoice and order capture to print and delivery to banks and digital mailboxes, by researching markets and competitors, building business cases for new markets, channels and service tiers, and contributing to how each is priced, packaged and improved
  • Help to manage our sub-processors by preparing performance data and agendas for reviews, contributing your view and following up on actions
  • Track how each service performs, including volumes, quality, cost per document and margin, and turn it into reports that show what is working and where to act, while keeping service information and decision records up to date
  • Learn from customers by joining customer meetings and drawing out patterns from what Sales, Support and Professional Services hear
  • Apply product judgement by forming your own view of what good looks like, speaking up if something falls short, and spotting how a change at a sub-processor, in our platform or in a delivery channel affects customers, cost and other teams
  • Use AI tools and data to work smarter by preparing for calls, analysing sub-processor and service data, and checking what the tools produce before you rely on it
  • Grow into ownership by bringing proposals and not just problems, taking on defined parts of the portfolio and, over time, sub-processor relationships

Required Qualifications

You’re a fit for the role of Product Manager - Pagero if you have the following required qualifications:

  • Early career experience in product, operations, analysis or a customer-facing technology role, including internships or projects, that shows you learn fast and deliver
  • Curiosity about customers: you ask who a service is for and what problem it solves before suggesting a fix
  • Good instincts of what good looks like: you form a view and say when something falls short
  • Interest in how products are taken to market, how competitors compete, and how a change in one part affects the rest
  • Comfort with data: you can pull, question and explain numbers, and say what success should look like
  • Active use of AI tools to learn and work faster, with the judgement to check what they produce
  • Clear communication and reliable follow-through, including working with several people and sub-processors, and bringing next steps and not just problems
  • Successfully pass an extended background check (criminal and credit).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with sub-processors or contracts 
  • Experience in a Pagero role such as integration, support or professional services
  • Familiarity with e-invoicing, order processing, accounts payable/receivable or document capture
  • Experience preparing reports or presenting to customers or senior colleagues

job.title: Senior Manager, Product Analytics
job.description:
Thomson Reuters' Transactional Compliance portfolio connects businesses to a growing network of e-invoicing, tax determination, and trade compliance capabilities. Pagero alone connects more than 14 million businesses across 75+ countries and is recognized by IDC MarketScape as a Leader in European compliant e-invoicing. As these products integrate more closely within the TR ecosystem, the organization is scaling its product analytics capabilities across the portfolio.

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Product Analytics to lead data analytics across Transactional Compliance products, and to manage a team of product analysts and data engineers. This role is responsible for defining the analytics strategy across the portfolio, building the frameworks and AI powered tools that turn data into product and business decisions, and developing team capabilities across both analytics and engineering disciplines. This is a player coach role: you set direction across multiple product areas and develop your team, while staying close enough to the work to shape what is possible yourself.

The role carries direct responsibility for advancing Product Analytics' north star: better products through embedded partnership across the product lifecycle, easy data through democratized, AI-powered access, and actionable data that shifts decisions from gut feel to evidence. That includes leading the team's shift from producing analysis to building and owning the AI agents and self-service tools that produce it, while applying data science methods, such as segmentation, behavioral modeling, and experimentation, to answer harder product questions across the portfolio.

This position is suited for a senior product analytics or data science leader with experience managing teams that include data engineers, applying data science methods to product decisions, and building AI assisted and agentic workflows into day-to-day analytics delivery.

About the Role:

As Senior Manager, Product Analytics, you will be responsible for:

  • Product Analytics & Data Science Strategy: Define how data becomes a competitive and operational advantage across Transactional Compliance products.
  • AI Powered and Agentic Analytics: Lead the team's shift from producing analytical outputs to building and owning the AI agents, conversational tools, and self service products that produce them.
  • Product Instrumentation & Data Architecture: Own the strategy for how product behavior is measured across the portfolio. Partner with engineering to design event driven data collection across the customer journey and guide your data engineers' evaluation of data storage and processing architecture.
  • People Leadership: Build, manage, and develop a team of product analysts and data engineers with a clear operating model for intake, prioritization, and delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the primary product analytics partner for product leadership across Transactional Compliance offerings. Build working relationships with peer analytics leaders across TR, particularly where scope or data infrastructure overlaps, and translate complex technical and statistical findings into decision ready narratives for product, engineering, and senior leadership.

About You:

The ideal candidate for the Senior Manager, Product Analytics position possesses:

  • At least 8 years of experience in product analytics, data science, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years leading teams that include data engineers or other technical roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to set and execute an analytics strategy across multiple products.
  • Strong grounding in data science methods, such as segmentation, behavioral modeling, causal inference, or experimentation, and the judgment to know when they add more value than a dashboard.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, cloud data platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, or equivalent), and pipeline architecture, sufficient to evaluate trade offs and lead data engineers effectively.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling and agentic workflows including building and owning production analytics agents or self-service tools.
  • Strong communicator across levels: able to explain statistical and technical findings to non-technical executives and give specific direction to analysts and engineers alike.
  • Based in Sweden (Gothenburg), with the right to work there.

Nice to have:

  • Experience leading analytics or data science for more than one product line or business unit at once.
  • Experience with e-invoicing, indirect tax, global trade compliance, VAT, or other B2B/regulatory transaction platforms.
  • SaaS product experience, particularly in enterprise or B2B settings.

job.title: Sales Development Representative - Reuters Imagen
job.description:
Job Description


As a Sales Development Representative at Reuters Imagen, you own the top of the commercial funnel for your territory. You'll find the right prospects, open the right conversations, and qualify opportunities to the point where a commercial specialist can take them forward. The Reuters Imagen customer base is a specific world - sports federations, broadcasters, media rights holders, and enterprise content organisations - and you'll need to understand it well enough to hold a credible conversation before the CS or AM is in the room.


You'll work in a defined territory and will work closely with both Commercial Specialists and Account Managers at the point of qualification, remaining connected through the sales cycle to inform your own future prospecting.


Key Responsibilities


As a Sales Development Representative at Reuters Imagen, you will:


  • Identify and research target accounts within your territory using a combination of industry knowledge, event intelligence, CRM data, and market signals
  • Build and maintain a healthy outbound pipeline through multi-channel prospecting: personalised outreach, LinkedIn, industry events, and inbound lead follow-up
  • Develop territory plans that prioritise target segments, accounts, and buying triggers relevant to the Imagen platform and Reuters AI ecosystem
  • Track and manage prospecting activity and pipeline status accurately in Salesforce
  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand prospect workflow, content challenges, technology stack, and decision-making structure
  • Articulate the Imagen value proposition clearly and credibly to a range of buyer personas, from operational and technical contacts to commercial and executive stakeholders
  • Handle early-stage objections and questions, and know when to bring in a Solutions Architect or Account Manager
  • Execute a clean, well-briefed handoff to the Commercial Specialist at the point of qualification, with full context on the prospect, the conversation, and the identified opportunity
  • Collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and the Commercial Lead to align outreach with live campaigns, product launches, and event follow-up
  • Maintain working knowledge of the sports, media, and broadcast technology landscape in your territory, including rights cycles, federation calendars, platform procurement patterns, and competitive dynamics
  • Feed market intelligence back into the commercial team: emerging accounts, competitive moves, buyer sentiment, and territory trends
  • Represent Reuters Imagen at industry events where attendance supports pipeline development



Required Qualifications


  • Experience in a sales development, business development, or outbound sales role
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills: able to identify genuine opportunity, map decision-making structure, and brief a handoff accurately
  • Demonstrable ability to build pipeline through outbound prospecting and convert cold or warm outreach into qualified conversations
  • Comfortable engaging buyer personas from operations and IT through to commercial and executive level
  • Fluent professional English, written and verbal; additional language relevant to territory an advantage
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment and flex schedule to collaborate across time zones
  • Demonstrable use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and similar) for research, outreach personalisation, and workflow efficiency



Preferred Qualifications


  • Direct experience selling technology or software solutions; prospecting into sports federations, leagues, broadcasters, or media rights organisations
  • Working knowledge of the sports, media, or broadcast industry: understands how rights holders, federations, broadcasters, and content organisations operate, and what their content challenges look like
  • Familiarity with media asset management, content distribution, video workflow, or adjacent technology categories
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, intent data tools, or similar prospecting platforms an proficiency with Salesforce for pipeline tracking and activity management

job.title: Customer Success Data Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is seeking a highly analytical and customer-focused Customer Success Data Analyst to join the global Customer Success organization in India. This mid-senior individual contributor role will support the Reuters Connect and Reuters News Agency portfolio, helping customers realize measurable value from Reuters editorial content, data feeds, and media services.

The Customer Success Data Analyst will transform customer usage data, engagement signals, commercial information, and product health metrics into clear and actionable insights. This role goes beyond producing reports: it is responsible for identifying the story behind the data, diagnosing adoption and engagement challenges, surfacing commercial risks and opportunities, and enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to make informed retention and growth decisions.

Reporting to the Director of Customer & Sales Enablement, the successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Editorial, Product, Data, Sales Enablement, and Commercial Policy & Operations teams. The role requires strong critical thinking, advanced business intelligence and reporting skills, data-quality rigor, and the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to both internal stakeholders and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and enhance customer health scoring methodologies across the Reuters portfolio, including defining metrics, developing models, and identifying early churn-risk indicators.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of individual accounts and customer segments to diagnose declining engagement, adoption gaps, underutilization, and commercial risk.
  • Segment customers based on health, usage trends, engagement trajectory, commercial value, and expansion potential to support Customer Success and Sales prioritization.
  • Analyze customer usage, product adoption, engagement, and commercial data to identify retention and growth opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, scorecards, and insight-led narratives for Customer Success Managers, Sales teams, senior stakeholders, and clients.
  • Translate customer data into clear and actionable recommendations that support renewals, retention, adoption, expansion, and customer value realization.
  • Support Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, renewal discussions, and customer meetings with tailored data-driven insights.
  • Help customers understand their content consumption and product-usage patterns and demonstrate the business value of Reuters products and services.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, data patterns, and commercial signals while applying critical thinking to validate findings before presenting conclusions.
  • Support customer feedback, Voice of Customer, and customer-sentiment analysis initiatives.
  • Partner with the Data team to build, improve, and maintain scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
  • Use Salesforce and related tools for reporting, dashboard development, data management, customer activity tracking, and commercial analysis.
  • Ensure data quality across Customer Success reporting by identifying, investigating, and resolving inconsistencies in CRM, usage, engagement, and customer-record data.
  • Collaborate with internal data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
  • Incorporate AI-enabled tools and automation into reporting and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and analytical depth.
  • Work independently in a global, matrixed environment while managing multiple priorities, stakeholder requests, and reporting deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Four to six years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, customer success analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a SaaS, B2B, technology, media, data services, subscription, or customer-focused commercial environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex reporting, analysis, modeling, and presentation of findings.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data-visualization platforms.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience, including report creation, dashboard development, data management, activity tracking, and CRM data analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, customer scorecards, analytical models, and recurring performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking ability, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, validate data, and identify actionable findings.
  • Experience analyzing customer engagement, product usage, customer adoption, retention, and commercial performance data.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality.
  • Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes, and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proven ability to present complex data findings clearly and confidently to non-technical audiences, including external clients.
  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, planning, prioritization, organization, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively and independently in a globally distributed and matrixed organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or improving customer health-scoring frameworks, engagement models, churn-risk models, or customer segmentation methodologies.
  • Experience with Net Promoter Score, Voice of Customer, customer-feedback programs, or customer-sentiment analysis.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data extraction, transformation, data cleansing, analysis, and reporting automation.
  • Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or similar customer-health and engagement tools.
  • Experience supporting Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, client renewals, account planning, or commercial growth discussions.
  • Understanding of the news, media, publishing, information services, financial information, or B2B content industry.
  • Experience analyzing how customers consume editorial content, data feeds, media products, or subscription-based services.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools for analytics, reporting automation, data analysis, or workflow improvement.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to develop executive-ready and client-facing presentations.
  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Editorial, Data, and Commercial Operations teams.

job.title: Director, Touring
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

As a Director Touring, you will undertake the pivotal role of overseeing the management of multiple tours, with a focus on operations from the promoter's standpoint. This entails strategic planning, logistical coordination, and ensuring seamless execution to meet touring team and clients objectives. Lead and closely collaborate with the touring department, overseeing various projects such as developing and evaluating financial models, as well as preparing tour offers for theaters, arenas, and stadiums at a directorial level.

Essential Functions:

  • Lead and review ticket sales, holds, and other appropriate ticketing items for assigned tours, working with tour ticketing director to manage these items.
  • Oversee and work directly with various departments (i.e. marketing, operations, ticketing, production, legal) on overall aspects for assigned tours.
  • Guide and closely collaborate with the touring department, overseeing various projects such as developing and evaluating financial models, as well as preparing tour offers for theaters, arenas, and stadiums at a directorial level.
  • Negotiate venue deals for each tour at the theater, arena and stadium level. Maintain regular communication with client representatives for each assigned tour.
  • May focus on developing strategies to expand AEG’s global footprint with each artist and oversee all aspects of tour cycle – Offer Creation, Contracting, On Sale, Inventory Management, final settlement
  • May be responsible for completing nightly settlements at each show as well as in addition to overall tour settlement, work to open additional ticket inventory for sales and/or day-of- show ticketing needs on site at the venue.
  • May entail overseeing all tour logistics, ensuring timely dissemination of information to relevant departments to all parties, and drafting artist and venue contracts, overseeing various departments to ensure advancement of production requirements have been met.

 

Required Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree (4-year)
  • 6-8 years Of related work experience
  • Understanding of accounting and ability to complete accurate show settlements (inclusive of working knowledge of global exchange rates)
  • Understanding of and experience in touring music business both domestic and international (i.e. has worked on at least one touring project that has extended beyond North America).
  • Ability to build effective working relationships with clients, venues, and co-workers
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook)
  • Excellent written, verbal and listening communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Self-motivated and takes initiative
  • May require heavy travel for long period of time of the road.

 

Pay scale: $108,244 - $165,685

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

job.title: LN Venues, Director of Operations - Vinyl Room Las Vegas
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.

 

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE JOB

The Director of Operations, Vinyl Room leads all daily operations for the Vinyl Room at House of Blues Las Vegas. This role provides strategic and hands-on leadership across team development, member and VIP experience, programming, venue standards, financial performance, and operational execution.


WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Recruit, onboard, train, develop, and manage Vinyl Room managers and hourly team members.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and lead coaching, performance management, conflict resolution, discipline, and terminations in accordance with company standards.
  • Ensure compliance with workplace standards, policies, and responsible alcohol-service requirements.
  • Lead floor operations and maintain clear, consistent communication across the Vinyl Room team and venue leadership.
  • Participate in weekly operations calls and oversee weekly recaps, dining-tracking sheets, inventory reporting, and nightly operations reports.
  • Direct purchasing, receiving, and weekly inventory processes.

Guest Experience & Membership

  • Deliver elevated service and recognition for Vinyl Room members, Live Nation executives, VIPs, and special guests.
  • Serve as a senior operational resource for members throughout their Vinyl Room and House of Blues experience.
  • Ensure special events and member experiences are executed to the highest standards and guest satisfaction.
  • Oversee guest relations, membership fulfillment, and membership renewal efforts.
  • Maintain all House of Blues and Vinyl Room hospitality, service, and presentation standards.
  • Stay current on nightlife industry trends, promotions, and guest-experience best practices.

Revenue Growth & Financial Performance

  • Lead Food & Beverage COGS, controllable expenses, and labor management to meet budget guidelines.
  • Develop and execute short- and long-term plans for revenue growth and cost-control initiatives.
  • Own the unit’s P&L performance and drive results that meet or exceed budget expectations.
  • Create and execute nightly programming that increases guest count, member engagement, and incremental sales.
  • Partner with VIP Services and the sales team to execute revenue-generating initiatives.
  • Develop programming opportunities both in-house and with external promoter partners to grow member usage and revenue.

Venue Atmosphere & Facility Standards

  • Create and maintain the high-energy, premium atmosphere expected of the Vinyl Room.
  • Ensure lighting, sound level, music selection, furniture placement, décor, and overall presentation meet Vinyl Room standards.
  • Oversee facility maintenance, repairs, cleanliness, and physical-plant needs.
  • Maintain a polished, safe, and guest-ready environment at all times.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
