job.title: 21GRAMS- Senior Delivery Manager
job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager join our growing team!

21GRAMS, Real Chemistry’s advertising agency, has been ranked the #2 creative health agency in the world by Cannes Lions. ROOM42 is 21GRAMS’ in-house production company, content studio, and Digital & Technology services arm — the team that turns briefs, Figma files, and napkin sketches into working, beautiful, compliant digital deliverables for the top pharma and biotech companies in the world.

We are looking for an AI-Forward Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) to run technical delivery across the full ROOM42 output spectrum — marketing websites, microsites, emails (including Veeva rep-triggered and approved email), banners, IVAs, conference kiosks and interactive experiences — built with in-house developers and specialist vendor partners. This is the person who owns whether the right work gets to the right build team, whether the estimate is real, whether it ships to spec and on time, and who is increasingly using AI to make all of that faster and more consistent. The project manager and account teams own the client relationship and the date. The TDM owns whether that date is achievable and gets the work built — qualifying intake, routing to the right build team, running the review-and-QA lifecycle, holding vendors to standard, and applying AI where it creates genuine delivery leverage, not novelty.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US based in any of our U.S. office locations, including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Lambertville, NJ, San Francisco, or Carmel, IN or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

Intake & Technical Qualification

  • Triage incoming requests from Workfront and Jira; assign deliverable type, complexity tier, and dependency flags (Veeva, MLR, client restrictions) within a defined SLA.
  • Return incomplete requests rather than absorbing them — no handoff to build without specs, assets, link matrix, CTAs/UTMs, and a real level-of-effort estimate.
  • Own or validate the estimate before any build commitment, using ROOM42’s estimation tooling and rate card. 

Build Team Routing & Vendor Management

  • Decide in-house vs. vendor partner per project against MSA offshore rules, client restrictions, Veeva dependency, and capacity — and escalate routing decisions that carry cost or transition implications.
  • Run day-to-day vendor delivery: standing syncs, staging-date accountability, cap-burn visibility against SOW, and knowledge-transfer documentation during vendor transitions.
  • Escalate quality issues to the vendor lead and commercial issues to the Digital & Technology leadership.

Technical Delivery Lifecycle

  • Own delivery from kickoff through post-launch: dev kickoff, staging links, review-round sequencing (R1/R2/R3), MLR/PRC submission readiness, QA gate, and go-live.
  • Maintain a live view of technical progress across a concurrent portfolio; proactively flag risks to Producers and Delivery leadership before they surface in status calls.
  • Drive milestone gates with QA — confirm that what moves from development to QA to UAT to production is actually ready, not optimistically ready.
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent projects (shared environments, overlapping timelines, licensing, PDUFA-anchored dates) and surface conflicts before they collide.

AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate the delivery workflow — status synthesis, ticket hygiene, QA support, specification drafting, and documentation — not as novelties but as real accelerators.
  • Partner on ROOM42’s AI-augmented QA and design-to-code workflows (visual regression, accessibility scanning, Figma-to-code handoff) so quality is structural and repeatable across deliverable types.
  • Help define and document AI-assisted delivery playbooks per deliverable type so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner, and evaluate emerging tooling for genuine leverage.
  • Apply judgment to AI output — know where AI-assisted work needs human review before it reaches a client, and keep quality from degrading as volume scales.

Quality, Standards & Portfolio Hygiene

  • Define ‘done’ for each deliverable type with the technical lead and QA — not just ‘it works,’ but performant, accessible, cross-browser validated, MLR-clean, and visually faithful to approved design.
  • Own quality accountability for your portfolio: if something ships broken or fails an MLR technical review, own the root cause and the remediation.
  • Enforce Jira/Workfront field discipline and status accuracy so the portfolio is legible to leadership and reporting is reliable.
  • Lead post-launch reviews on major engagements; translate defect patterns into upstream process improvements.

Partnership & Communication

  • Serve as the technical delivery counterpart to Producers, account teams, UX/UI, developers, and QA — translating between them without jargon.
  • Partner with Producers on SOW scoping: turn creative and functional requirements into accurate hours, stack decisions, and phased rollout plans.
  • Participate in client-facing conversations where technical delivery credibility matters — scoping sessions, risk discussions, and demo walkthroughs.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

What you should have:

  • Hands-on AI implementation experience in a real delivery context — you have built or stood up AI-assisted workflows that shipped, not just experimented with tools. This means applying AI to concrete delivery problems (specification drafting, estimation, ticket and status synthesis, QA support, documentation, triage classification, deployment), measuring whether it actually saved time, and exercising judgment over the output before it reaches a client.
  • Daily, practical fluency with AI build and delivery tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Figma-to-code integrations, AI-assisted QA — and the discernment to tell genuine leverage from hype and to catch where AI output degrades quality at scale.
  • 5+ years of digital project or technical delivery management in an agency or production environment, running concurrent digital builds from intake through launch.
  • Hands-on experience delivering across web (WordPress and/or Drupal), email, and banners; exposure to IVAs, Veeva, or interactive experiences a strong plus.
  • Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-delivery experience — familiarity with MLR/PRC review cycles, compliance gates, and fixed regulatory launch dates.
  • Vendor and cross-functional coordination: routing work, holding external partners to standard, and managing offshore/nearshore delivery.
  • Fluency in delivery tooling: Jira, Workfront or comparable, and a working understanding of QA, staging/UAT/production flow, and design-to-code handoff.
  • Enough technical literacy to hold a credible build conversation with developers and vendors, scope realistically, and know when to pull in the technical lead — without needing to write production code.

Nice to have

  • Experience defining and documenting AI-augmented delivery playbooks so the approach scales beyond a single practitioner across a team or vendor pod.
  • Hands-on work with agentic tooling — MCP servers, AI browser agents, or generative UI frameworks — and a point of view on where each creates real delivery leverage.
  • Built AI-assisted QA automation in production: visual regression, accessibility scanning, or AI-generated test coverage.
  • Veeva certification (approved email and/or IVA).
  • Experience standing up delivery processes, studios, or standards from the ground up.

Pay Range: $95,000-$100,000
The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal parity.

In addition to base salary, Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefits package and a variety of programs designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and success.

Real Chemistry reserves the right to update compensation and benefits programs at any time.

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Business Growth & New Opportunities

  • Contribute to growth opportunities by shaping smart social POVs, strategic recommendations and pitch-ready thinking. 

This Position is a Perfect Fit for You if: 

Mindset, Ownership & Leadership Style 

  • You’re a confident, curious social leader who loves the pace of platform change but keeps the work grounded, strategic and reputable. 
  • You can zoom out to spot patterns, connect insights to business opportunities and zoom in to make the strategy, copy, storytelling and details sharper. 
  • You enjoy coaching people, building trust with clients and living our values: Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I.” 

What Experience & Skills You Should have: 

Experience, Leadership & Healthcare Context 

  • 7–10 years of social media, digital marketing or integrated communications experience, ideally in healthcare, biotech, pharma or another regulated industry. 
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, assignments and stakeholders at once. 
  • Experience leading teams, managing performance and supporting the development of direct or indirect reports. 
  • Comfort balancing hands-on client work with team leadership, internal initiatives and business development support. 
  • College degree required; BA or equivalent preferred; understanding of FDA, fair balance, adverse event and client review considerations preferred. 

Social, Paid, Influencer, Analytics & Tools 

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behavior and content best practices across organic, paid and influencer-led programs. 
  • Experience building strategic plans, channel recommendations, paid social approaches and insight-led performance narratives for senior stakeholders. 
  • Fluency with social buying, publishing, listening, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including platforms such as Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Microsoft Office and Canva. 
  • Strong communication, organization and judgment, with the ability to synthesize inputs, shape strong copy, delegate effectively and keep work moving.

Display knowledge of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms including Facebook/Instagram, X, LinkedIn, etc.

Advise the execution of social media tactics including content development and distribution, paid promotions and results reporting.  
  • Thrive in a face-paced, ever evolving environment: Organization is critical for success in this role, whiling maintaining strong organization and tracking of client communications to ensure all deadlines are met. Act as source of truth and knowledge holder when it comes to timelines and processes. Ability to manage multiple competing deadlines, while understanding how to prioritize is key.   
  • Appreciate a world culture that requires constant learning and innovation: Cultivate and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of social media trends and platforms to guide account teams and help Real Chemistry continue to be a leader in the space.

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.  
  • You are a highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.  

What you should have:   

  • 2-4 years of experience in social media, in biotech or pharmaceutical   
  • College degree (BA or equivalent)   
  • Shown proficiency in social media, both personally and professionally   
  • Understanding of how paid promotion works on the main social media platforms: Facebook/Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok. Experience with social media ad technologies is a plus   
  • Experience working with influencers to create social content  is a plus  
  • Experience in social channel engagement and community management monitoring  
  • Highly organized, mindful of deadlines with the ability to multi-task and work under limited supervision   
  • Experience collaborating effectively internally and externally as part of an integrated team   
  • Outstanding written and oral communications and presentations skills   
  • Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint   
  • Agency experience in a client-facing role preferred   
  • Understanding of the FDA regulations guiding social media efforts for biotech and pharma clients   

Pay Range: $60,000-$75,000

job.title: Analyst – Indirect Tax
job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Why we're hiring:

Filing GST monthly RETURNS (GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B) of Clients ,  Filing of GST returns as per GSTR -2A & GSTR-2B Available Input tax credit (ITC), Preparation of GSTR-9 & 9C Annual Return (Indirect taxation).

 

What you'll be doing:

 

Independently handling GST compliances which broadly involve following tasks:

  • Amendment in registration,
  • Preparation of the data, review and filing of the monthly returns (GSTR 1 and 3B)
  • Addressing the queries of consultants related to input & output transactions, before arriving at the final liability.
  • Coordinating the details of advances received and advances adjusted against subsequent billing, before finalising the monthly GST liability; 
  • Also, identify the ineligible credit from the input register and remove the same from input register;
  • Reconciling GLs, with returns data
  • GST Credit reconciliation – Compiling the details, sending mails, calling vendors for resolution, etc.
    • GST Audit (9/9C) - Compiling the details for Annual GST Audit based on the monthly return and books of accounts. Provide other reports on input and all the items of expenses, as required for the purpose of audit;
    • GST Assessment & Appeals – Able to handled GST assessments which involved data preparation, documentation collation, liasioning with the GST officers, preparing submissions with guidance of seniors, regularly monitory the notice /assessment tracker and keeping eye on timelines
    • Miscellaneous - Advisory services on applicability of GST, Rate of tax applicable, HSN Code to be used, allowability of input credit;

 

What you'll need:

  • Should be an experienced problem solver with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Prior experience in Indirect Taxation.
  • Commerce Graduate / Inter- CA / Mcom / CMA with 3-7 years of experience.
  • Advanced MS office skills.

 

 

Who you are:

You're open: we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

 

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

Scale and opportunity – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. job.description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

Finance Director

Reporting to: Norway and Sweden Market Leader & EMEA CFO

Location: Sweden

 

Who we are:
Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More About the role

Burson is seeking a commercially focused Finance Director, to lead finance across our Swedish market, with oversight of Norway. This is a senior market finance leadership role, partnering closely with local and regional leadership to drive financial performance, strengthen operational discipline and support sustainable growth across the two markets.

The role will be responsible for financial planning, reporting, forecasting, controls, compliance and commercial finance support across a business of approximately $10m revenue. It requires someone who can operate strategically, but who is also comfortable being close to the detail in a smaller market environment.

We are looking for a pragmatic, hands-on and commercially astute finance leader who can provide clear insight, challenge and counsel to leadership teams, while ensuring strong governance, accurate reporting and effective financial management.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead finance across Sweden and Norway, ensuring strong financial management, governance and commercial discipline across both markets.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to both market leadership, providing clear insight, challenge and counsel to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Own the budgeting, forecasting and planning processes, ensuring alignment with local market priorities, regional expectations and group reporting requirements.
  • Provide accurate, timely and meaningful financial reporting, including revenue, profitability, margin, cost management, cash flow and working capital performance.
  • Translate financial data into clear commercial insight, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that help leaders make informed decisions.
  • Partner with client and business leads on pricing, profitability, resourcing and commercial decision-making to support sustainable growth.
  • Oversee month-end, quarter-end and year-end close processes, working closely with local, regional, shared service and group finance teams.
  • Ensure the integrity of financial records, reporting and controls, maintaining compliance with Burson/WPP policies and relevant Swedish and Norwegian requirements.
  • Lead on audit, tax, statutory reporting and external advisor relationships, ensuring deadlines are met and risks are managed effectively.
  • Drive improvements in finance processes, systems and ways of working, creating greater consistency, efficiency and accountability across the markets.
  • Support strong operational discipline around revenue recognition, billing, collections, approvals and project financial management.
  • Lead, support and develop the local finance function, building strong relationships across a matrixed, international environment.

Experience You’ll Bring:

  • Significant experience in senior finance, financial control, Financial Planning & Analysis or commercial finance roles, ideally within a professional services, communications, consulting, agency or matrixed international environment.
  • Strong understanding of financial management within a smaller or mid-sized market, with the ability to balance strategic input with hands-on delivery.
  • Proven experience partnering with senior leaders to improve financial performance, commercial discipline and operational decision-making.
  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, reporting, variance analysis and performance management experience.
  • Good understanding of accounting, controls, audit, tax and compliance requirements across Sweden; exposure to Norway or wider Nordic markets would be advantageous.
  • Experience working with regional or group finance teams, ideally in an international network or multinational organisation.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial information and turn it into clear, actionable insight.
  • High level of integrity, sound judgement and confidence in providing constructive challenge.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain finance matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Fluent English is essential; Swedish language skills are highly desirable. Norwegian language skills or experience working with Norway would be an advantage.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Independent productions 

  • Actively contribute to the department’s programming strategy by reviewing and making appropriate recommendations on kids’/youth content.
  • Strategically prioritize projects for evaluation in alignment with management objectives.
  • Help maintain strategic relationships with the independent producer community.
  • Attend independent producers’ project pitches.

job.title: Online Supervisor - Global News Toronto
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Global News Toronto

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, ON (Onsite)

About the Role:

Globalnews.ca is looking for a full-time Online Supervisor based in Toronto to join its team.

Reporting to the Managing Editor for Local Coverage, the successful candidate will both report stories and help oversee a dynamic group while creating top-quality content daily.

They will require a strong communication and organizational skills and must be able to move efficiently and responsibly through a sizeable volume of stories coming from markets across the country.

They will also show a track record for reporting news hits.

A demonstrable enthusiasm and curiosity for local stories is a must, as is a passion for mentoring younger reporters.

The successful candidate will have at least 5-7 years of journalistic experience as an editor, reporter or preferably both.

This is a Group 5 position under the current collective agreement.

This position will oversee the latter part of the daily news cycle and will provide some work-from-home flexibility.

You will contribute by:

• Encouraging, directing, and overseeing the production and promotion of compelling online content.

• Communicating, teaching, tracking and model Global News’ best practices in digital journalism.

• Mentoring newer employees in best journalism and online practices including but not limited to CP Style and Global News Journalistic Principles and Practices.

• Writing, posting and promoting online content.

• Champion online coverage at meetings and throughout the day to ensure digital platforms are prioritized.

• Report on top-performing content to help inform editorial decisions for all publishing platforms.

• Developing and execute strategies to grow and engage our audience on globalnews.ca and social media.

• Monitor real-time site performance and work with online staff to optimize.

• Working with managing editors, news directors and others to implement a flexible workflow that supports multi-platform content production.

• Working with managing editors and administrative support staff to schedule online journalists, ensuring region-wide coverage seven days a week.

• Maintaining regular contact with fellow Global News digital leaders and communicating key changes and improvements to staff and managers.

• Participating in planning special news, community and marketing events and projects.

• Support marketing with online and social efforts, as required.

• Ensuring all online stories are vetted for content, grammar and style.

• Work with managing editors to improve your own and your team’s writing skills.

• Ensuring local and wire content is posted and promoted in a timely fashion.

• Oversee access to official accounts on social networks.

• Ensure content is promoted optimally.

• Overseeing viewer relations on social media.

• Resolve and respond to website user complaints and feedback.

Skills and experience you bring:

• Post-secondary education in journalism, communications or a related field

• Minimum of 7 years’ experience in a major market print or online role.

• Experience supervising or leading a team is required.

• Editing experience is required.

• Proficient in social media including but not limited to Snapchat and Instagram.

• Must have excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently, effectively, and cooperatively in a team environment.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Punctuality and promptness is required.

• Successful candidate must be able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

• A positive, can-do attitude is essential.

job.title: Donor Advisor I
job.description:
Description

Job Summary

The Donor Advisor I (DA1) cultivates and stewards a portfolio of about 600-800 donors with mid-major gift capacity for all Hope Media Group brands. The DA I follows a scalable stewardship plan for individual donors. The DA I may create Individual Donor Plans (IDPs) for a small segment to match donors’ passions and interests with brands, projects, and initiatives at Hope Media Group. They will support donor communications and impact reporting; gift solicitations with individual donors, foundations, and corporations – all while nurturing a life of generosity in each donor. The DA I is attentive to donor’s spiritual needs. The DA I prays with donors as needed.


Essential Functions

Portfolio Stewardship:

  • Engages, shepherds, and solicits a portfolio of qualified mid-level donors in support of all Hope Media Group brands and programs
  • Builds and stewards relationships with portfolio donors
  • Creates, maintains, and updates complete donor data in CRM 
  • Engages with donors with phone calls, handwritten notes, personal emails, and texts to identify specific donor HMG brand interest(s) and to build connection to other HMG brands
  • Promptly and professionally responds to and resolves donor requests and inquiries 
  • Provides ongoing spiritual care to portfolio, including praying with donors on phone calls and in-person as appropriate
  • Works with Executive Director, Donor Experience and leadership team members to coordinate meetings with major donors if needed
  • Seeks and creates opportunities to deepen donor experiences with Hope Media Group brands
  • Inspires donors during experiences such as group tours of Hope Media Group campus and studios
  • Occasionally attends events such as breakfasts, galas, sports competitions, rodeos, vision trips, and pre-concert dinners to engage with donors as needed (requires early mornings, some evenings and some weekends.)

Demonstrated Faith: 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry’s Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG’s media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Non-Essential Functions

  • Other responsibilities as assigned to support the mission of HMG


Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred, but not required if has customer service experience

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in development/fundraising for non-profit organizations or customer service experience 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated understanding of fundraising, principles, methods, and practices; and the ability to develop successful donor relationships through cultivation and stewardship
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and executing strategy 
  • Prioritizes and task-switches with a fluctuating workload and competing priorities
  • Organizes and manages time with frequent interruptions
  • Attention to detail regarding writing, data entry and numerical accuracy, with a focus on data analysis and data integrity 
  • Listens and quickly picks up on verbal/tonal cues
  • Clearly communicates both verbally and in writing with constituents and corporate partners by telephone, letter, e-mail, and in person
  • Takes initiative, works independently, and collaborates with team members
  • Ministry minded person who learns quickly from the trainings and offers suggestions for improvement when needed
  • Shows initiative and consistently hungers for continuous improvement
  • Discerns and elicits the interests and concerns of others, meeting needs and discovering ways to improve engagement with donors
  • Natural ability to quickly build rapport and trust with ministry stakeholders
  • Able to process analytically and think strategically regarding managing a portfolio of donors and upgrading gifts.
  • Skilled at positioning a funding offer and making the ask 
  • Demonstrates strong moral, ethical and relational skills
  • Desires and shows willingness to pray for others
  • Sound understanding of the theology of fundraising and fundraising ethics
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish a plus
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Word, Excel & Teams. Ability to be trained on Virtuous CRM 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • Local travel as needed

Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional as event planner/participant.
  • Occasional for conferences or retreats.


Physical Requirements:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Physical activity that includes sitting, talking, expressing/exchanging ideas verbally. Repetitive motions include reading, writing, typing on a keyboard and talking. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists and hands. Occasional travel by car as required. Light work. Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work. The worker is required to have strong visual acuity.

Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts
  • Company Paid Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays
  • 403B Retirement with Company Match
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains 

Third-Party Recruiter Policy:

  • We are grateful for the interest of those who wish to support our hiring efforts. However, Hope Media Group does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from external staffing agencies or search firms. Submissions from third parties will not be considered and may be retained without obligation or payment or fees.

job.title: R1 News Anchor
job.description:
About the Role:

The R1 News Anchor is responsible for anchoring newscasts, news gathering, reporting, content creation, execution, and collaborative strategy on all WIBC/Network Indiana on air, digital and social platforms. The position requires the production and gathering of text, images, audio/video,etc. Video production and posting experience preferred. The ideal candidate will have a knack for social media and possess excellent writing skills and news judgement. Will be responsible for creating on air news packages for use on WIBC and Network Indiana and anchoring newscasts as assigned. This role requires synthesizing complex information into clear, concise narratives that inform and captivate viewers while maintaining journalistic integrity and impartiality. The anchor will collaborate closely with producers, reporters, and technical staff to ensure seamless broadcast execution and adherence to editorial standards. Additionally, the position involves staying current with breaking news, conducting live interviews, and adapting to rapidly changing news environments. Ultimately, the R1 News Anchor plays a critical role in shaping public understanding and trust through professional and compelling news presentation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a news anchor or reporter with on-air presence in a professional broadcast environment.
  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex information clearly and engagingly.
  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, news production processes, and media law.
  • Ability to work under pressure and adapt quickly to breaking news and changing schedules.
  • Experience with digital media platforms and social media engagement to extend news reach.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Broadcast Media, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in teleprompter operation and familiarity with broadcast studio technology.
  • Experience in investigative journalism or specialized reporting areas such as politics, economics, or science.

Responsibilities:

  • Present daily news broadcasts clearly and confidently, ensuring accuracy and professionalism in delivery.
  • Write report on, write, and edit news stories, scripts, and content for broadcast.
  • Conduct live interviews with guests, experts, and correspondents to provide in-depth coverage and diverse perspectives.
  • Monitor breaking news and update scripts promptly to reflect the latest developments during live broadcasts.
  • Maintain a strong on-air presence by engaging viewers with a balanced tone and clear communication.
  • Participate in editorial meetings to contribute ideas and feedback for improving news coverage and presentation.
  • Adhere to all journalistic ethics, legal standards, and company policies to uphold credibility and trust.

Skills:

The R1 News Anchor utilizes strong communication skills daily to deliver news stories in a clear, engaging, and trustworthy manner, ensuring viewers remain informed and connected. Critical thinking and editorial judgment are essential for selecting relevant news content and responding effectively to live developments. Technical skills and familiarity with broadcast equipment, support smooth and professional on-air presentations. Interpersonal skills facilitate productive collaboration with producers, reporters, and guests, enhancing the quality and depth of news coverage. Additionally, adaptability and composure under pressure enable the anchor to maintain poise during breaking news and live interviews, ensuring consistent broadcast excellence.

job.title: Ticket Scanner
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for friendly and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as a Ticket Scanner. In this role, you will be responsible for scanning and verifying tickets at stadium entry points, assisting guests with entry procedures, and ensuring a smooth and efficient gate operation. This is a great opportunity to be part of an exciting event experience while providing excellent customer service. This is a part-time, seasonal, event day position that will primarily support holiday and special events, with opportunities to work additional events throughout the year. 

Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions: 

  • Greet guests warmly and scan tickets using electronic scanning devices to verify entry.
  • Ensure tickets are valid and assist with any scanning or access issues.
  • Direct guests to appropriate seating areas, customer service booths, or other stadium locations as needed.
  • Monitor entry points to prevent unauthorized access and address any security concerns.
  • Provide information about venue policies, seating arrangements, event activities, and promotions.
  • Work closely with security and event staff to maintain a safe and organized entry process.
  • Assist guests with mobility challenges or special access needs.
  • Maintain a professional and positive attitude while handling large crowds.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications: 

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle large crowds efficiently.
  • Comfortable using electronic ticket scanners and basic technology.
  • Ability to stand for long periods and work outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Availability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Physical Demands: 

  • This role requires the ability to stand and walk for extended periods, often for the entire duration of a shift (typically 4-6 hours per game, with potential for doubleheaders or extended events).
  • Must be able to remain standing at a designated gate or station with limited opportunity to sit.
  • Requires frequent repetitive hand and arm motions for scanning tickets, tearing stubs, and directing guests.
  • Must be able to occasionally lift or carry light items (under 20 lbs), such as a box of supplies, a stanchion, or a signage stand.
  • Needs the ability to bend, stoop, or reach to assist guests, pick up items, or manage entryway equipment.
  • Must possess sufficient manual dexterity to efficiently handle tickets, operate a handheld scanner or tablet, and make quick, accurate exchanges.

Work Conditions: 

  • This position works almost exclusively outdoors at stadium entry gate areas. You will be exposed to all seasonal weather conditions, including intense sun, heat, humidity, rain, and cold.
  • Hours are entirely event driven. This requires absolute availability for all home games, which include evenings, weekends, and holidays. Shifts typically begin 60-90 minutes before gates open and may extend through the end of the game. Flexibility for special events, rain delays, or double-headers is required.
  • Must adhere to all safety and security protocols, including bag check policies and crowd management procedures. You are expected to maintain a professional appearance and demeanor as a representative of the team.

Benefits: 

  • Opportunity to work in an exciting sports environment.
  • Complimentary Durham Bulls branded polo shirt

Pre-Employment Information:

  • A pre-employment drug screening is required. 
  • Capitol Broadcasting Company participates in E-Verify.

Capitol Broadcasting Company is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)

FOX Television Stations—FOX10/FOX10Xtra | Phoenix, AZ

 

Are you a driven, results-oriented sales professional and a skillful relationship-builder who thrives in a collaborative environment? If so, we are looking for a proactive business development professional ready to make an immediate impact within a fast-paced, innovative culture. Join a team where critical input and new ideas are essential, all while enjoying the career stability that comes with working for a highly successful, well-known industry leader.

 

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, we lead the Phoenix television market by broadcasting the highest volume of local news and complimented with the most watched live sports (NFL, MLB, NCAA, NASCAR, INDY, and more). Beyond our broadcast footprint, we provide sophisticated, best-in-class Digital and OTT/CTV offerings. We are looking for a strategist who can weave these assets into comprehensive, omnichannel marketing solutions, enabling clients to achieve measurable results throughout the marketing plan.

 

The FOX10 Phoenix Sales Team has an excellent opportunity for an experienced Account Executive focused on driving revenue through an omnichannel approach, with a primary emphasis on bringing brand-new video advertisers to Phoenix’s leading local television station.

 

Why Join Us?

  •  Work in a fast-paced environment where teamwork is paramount. We brainstorm together, support one another's strategies, and celebrate our collective successes.
  • Collaborate with accomplished media professionals to drive revenue and elevate your omnichannel sales approach.
  • You will have the opportunity to work alongside top talent in the market, utilizing advanced technology and advertising platforms.

 

Job Summary

  • Assume primary responsibility for actively prospecting, developing, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline focused heavily on converting brand-new video advertisers who have not traditionally utilized TV or premium streaming.
  • Design and present omnichannel campaigns, seamlessly integrating traditional linear broadcast, Fox Local Extension (FLX) OTT, Fox Local News (FLN), and our digital/mobile platforms to address client challenges.
  • Source new sales opportunities through a combination of researching potential accounts, initiating outbound communication, and following up on inbound leads.
  • Maintain a consistent presence in the field to develop relationships, conduct needs-analysis meetings, and present the benefits of our complete video portfolio.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (sales management, FLX, marketing, and creative services) to develop custom presentations that highlight the utility of our solutions.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the competitive media landscape, OTT platforms, and a clear understanding of the characteristics that give FOX10 a competitive advantage.
  • Manage client advertising initiatives and create impactful post-campaign recaps, providing actionable recommendations to further optimize client ROI.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Proactive Business Development: Experience managing high-volume sales activity in a B2B environment. You excel at identifying untapped opportunities and consulting with new clients to demonstrate how video can achieve their business objectives.
  • Digital Video Advertising, Broadcast Sales, and/or Agency experience is preferred.
  • Team-Oriented Approach: You naturally build rapport with both clients and colleagues. You recognize that collaboration drives success and actively contribute to a positive workplace environment.
  • Omnichannel Expertise: You manage your time efficiently to meet deadlines, and you have a strong grasp of how traditional broadcast and digital/OTT video work together to create an effective marketing funnel.
  • Proven Track Record: You thrive in a metrics and results-driven sales culture. You are skilled at conveying technical information, addressing objections, and preparing professional presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and account management skills are required. Proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Varied hours, weekends, holidays, and local travel are required. Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • College degree (or equivalent work experience) and a minimum of 1 to 3 years of sales experience is required.

 

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Package: Excellent health benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. 401k with company match.
  • undefined

Additional Details

  • The on-target earnings for this position are $140,000-$150,000 annually.
  • Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and have a valid, local driver’s license.
  • Local travel and entertainment are required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours and overtime as needed.
  • FOX 10/Fox 10 Xtra Phoenix is a 24/7 operation.

 

If you have proven success in digital and ad sales and have the skills and experience to excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Director, Technology Business Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service. Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise. Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms. At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.


ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX's direct-to-consumer product and technology organization powers FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and FOX News digital experiences across mobile, connected TV, and web platforms. We are seeking a Director, Technology Business Operations to lead the strategy, systems, and processes that connect technology investments, resource planning, and software capitalization. 


Reporting to the VP of Product Operations, you will establish a reliable, scalable source of truth that enables leadership to understand where engineering resources are invested, measure associated costs, and make informed decisions about future investments. In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner with Program, Engineering, Finance, Controllership, Internal Audit, and People Systems to modernize how labor and investment data is captured, classified, analyzed, and reported. You will also drive the development of AI-assisted workflows and automation that improve accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, and reduce administrative effort. The ideal candidate combines financial and operational expertise with strong technical fluency, a systems-oriented mindset, and the ability to translate complex data into simple and actionable business insights. You will play a critical role in building an operating model that is accurate enough to withstand external audit, insightful enough to guide strategic investment decisions, and streamlined enough to integrate naturally into how teams work.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive technology business operations strategy spanning software capitalization, investment planning, resource analytics, and operational governance.
  • Own and continuously improve software labor capitalization methodologies, ensuring clear distinctions between capitalizable development and non-capitalizable activities, including maintenance, research, operations, and support.
  • Partner with Controllership, Internal Audit, and external auditors to establish capitalization policies, internal controls, evidence standards, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Drive audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce findings, shorten audit cycles, and minimize manual evidence collection.
  • Develop investment and resource planning models that connect labor costs to technology initiatives, products, platforms, and business outcomes.
  • Deliver financial and operational analyses that inform annual planning, quarterly business reviews, capitalization forecasts, and strategic investment decisions.
  • Evaluate resource allocation scenarios, including employee versus contingent labor, build-versus-buy decisions, platform versus product investments, and capacity planning.
  • Own the multi-year roadmap for systems, data models, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities that support labor tracking, classification, financial reporting, and investment analytics.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and People Systems to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and implement scalable solutions across Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, and related platforms.
  • Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for classification recommendations, anomaly detection, audit evidence assembly, and planning analytics, with appropriate human oversight, traceability, and controls.
  • Partner with the VP of Product Operations to streamline information flow across teams, systems, identify opportunities to eliminate redundant reporting, simplify workflows, and reduce administrative burden for engineering teams and leadership.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years’ experience in technology business operations, software capitalization, technical accounting operations, engineering finance, or technology investment planning within a complex, multi-product technology organization.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling cross-functional systems, processes, and operating models across Finance, HR, and Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software development capitalization practices, financial controls, audit requirements, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience developing financial and operational models that connect technology investments, labor costs, resource allocation, and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and technical capabilities, including hands-on experience with SQL, business intelligence and analytics tools such as Tableau or Amplitude, and advanced spreadsheet modeling. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You proactively seek out the information, context, and relationships you need to move work forward rather than waiting for them to come to you.
  • Experience working with enterprise HRIS, financial, and software development systems, including Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, or comparable platforms. 
  • Ability to generate artifacts and products from insights that are simple to use and enable executive decision making, yet solid enough to withstand audits and internal reviews. 
  • Practical experience designing or implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation, with an understanding of data integrity, human oversight, and audit risk.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, establish appropriate controls, and determine where automation can improve operational accuracy and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of how software engineering organizations plan, prioritize, develop, and deliver products across multiple platforms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, demonstrated ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and drive organizational change without direct reporting authority.
  • A user-centered, continuous improvement mindset. 
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience supporting software capitalization processes through external financial audits.
  • Experience developing technology investment frameworks or resource optimization models across multiple digital products and platforms.
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer streaming, digital media, or subscription-based technology businesses.
  • Experience implementing AI agents or intelligent automation within financial operations, technology governance, or enterprise planning workflows.
  • Experience integrating data across HRIS, financial planning, engineering work management, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience building operational capabilities or governance frameworks from the ground up in a rapidly evolving technology environment.

job.title: EXECUTIVE PRODUCER - SPORTS - KPHO/KTVK
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KPHO/KTVK:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you a sports visionary who knows that being "first" is only half the battle? Arizona’s Family is looking for a high-energy, contemporary Sports Executive Producer who understands that in today’s world, relevance is everything. We aren't looking for a traditional "TV person" — we need an audience-first, screen-agnostic leader who treats a smartphone screen with the same urgency as a 65-inch 4K TV. You’ll be the architect of a sports brand that Arizonans can’t live without, leveraging powerhouse pro partnerships while hosting your own daily streaming show. If you’re ready to lead the conversation—and be the face of it—on every platform that matters, let’s get to work.

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

What You'll Do:
• Lead the sports narrative: Oversee the creation, planning, and daily delivery of live and multi-platform sports content that feels urgent, essential, and tailored for wherever the audience is watching.
• Host your own show: Step in front of the camera as the host of our daily sports streaming show, driving high-energy segments that bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and digital-first fans.
• Own the digital space: Collaborate daily with our digital team to ensure our sports coverage isn't just "on" social media, but actively driving the conversation and engagement there.
• Leverage pro partnerships: Maximize our exclusive access and partnerships with professional teams to deliver content and "inside-the-huddle" access our competitors simply can’t match.
• Champion youth athletes: Develop a strategy to highlight local high school and youth sports, making Arizona’s Family the undisputed home for the stories that matter to local families.
• Inspire and coach: Lead a team of producers, reporters, and anchors with a focus on "buy-in," providing consistent feedback and monthly reviews to keep the storytelling bar high.
• Evolve the content: Analyze the totality of our news blocks to ensure stories evolve across platforms and repetition is eliminated—keeping our audience engaged from the first whistle to the final buzzer.
• Drive breaking news: Be the aggressive voice in the room when sports news breaks, ensuring we are the most accurate and fastest source across all digital and broadcast platforms.

What You Bring:
• Screen-agnostic leadership: You don't care which screen the audience uses, as long as they are watching us. You understand how to pivot content seamlessly between social, streaming, and broadcast.
• On-air charisma: You’re a natural communicator who is comfortable hosting a daily show, bringing personality and expertise to a digital-first audience.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) is the station’s digital thought leader, customer success leader, and strategic revenue partner. Combining consulting, sales expertise, technical knowledge, and data analysis, the SAM helps Account Executives win business, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable results.


Working alongside Account Executives throughout the customer lifecycle, the SAM supports research, account planning, client discovery, solution development, sales presentations, performance analysis, and growth recommendations. As the station’s digital subject matter expert, the SAM translates marketing strategies, audience insights, and performance data into digital revenue growth and advertiser retention.


This is a customer success and growth role - not tactical fulfillment or support position. The SAM owns client outcomes, retention, and revenue expansion.


Key Responsibilities

Revenue Growth & Customer Success

  • Develop consultative strategies aligned with advertiser objectives, audiences, and success measures.
  • Identify renewal, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that increase recurring revenue and client value.
  • Support station digital revenue and budget attainment.

Digital Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the station’s expert on digital advertising, audience solutions, analytics, attribution, and emerging technologies.
  • Translate complex capabilities and performance data into clear business recommendations.
  • Educate clients and sales teams on trends, best practices, and growth opportunities.

Sales Partnership & Client Engagement

  • Partner with Account Executives from prospecting through renewal while maintaining clear account ownership.
  • Conduct research and account planning to develop client-specific strategies.
  • Participate in discovery meetings, presentations, and business reviews as the digital strategy expert.
  • Support proposals, audience recommendations, and integrated marketing solutions.

Performance & Retention

  • Analyze campaign results and convert findings into actionable insights.
  • Lead performance reviews that demonstrate ROI and recommend next steps.
  • Identify performance risks and opportunities that improve retention and account growth.

Collaboration & Sales Enablement

  • Collaborate with sales, research, ad operations, and digital services to provide a consistent client experience.
  • Coach sales teams on digital solutions, consultative selling, and effective use of insights.
  • Share market intelligence and success stories that strengthen digital selling.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, media sales, strategic account management, advertising strategy, or consultative selling.
  • Strong knowledge of digital advertising, audience targeting, analytics, attribution, and performance marketing.
  • Proven ability to develop and present strategies that drive revenue and business results.
  • Strong analytical, sales, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience with research, analytics, CRM, and reporting platforms.
  • Media, broadcast, agency, or digital advertising experience preferred.

Success Measures

  • Digital revenue growth and budget attainment.
  • Advertiser retention, renewal, and account expansion.

job.title: Security Engineer
job.description:
Security Engineer — GRC, Cloud, Workspace & IdAM

Reports to: Director, Systems Operations & Cybersecurity

Location: Atlanta / Hybrid


Position Summary

This role runs programs that most organizations staff separately: governance and compliance, cloud, SaaS, Identity and Access Management security posture, and the assessment cycle that tests them all.

It is an individual contributor role with program ownership. There are no direct reports, and nearly everything that needs to change is owned by someone else — a cloud engineer, an application owner, a business-unit administrator. The work is therefore split between doing (assessing, documenting, evidencing, configuring) and driving (getting findings closed by people who do not report here).

The Director owns policy approval, budget, vendor contracts, and executive reporting. This role owns the programs running, the findings closing, and the evidence being ready before it is asked for.


Key Responsibilities

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Maintain the security policy and standards library — drafting, revision cycles, approvals, publication, and attestation tracking.

  • Own the risk register day to day: intake, scoring, treatment plans, owner assignment, and review cadence.

  • Map controls to the applicable framework(s) — NIST CSF / CIS Controls / SOC 2 / PCI DSS.

  • Run exception and risk-acceptance governance: documented, time-bound, owned, and reviewed on expiry rather than renewed by silence.

  • Own third-party and vendor risk reviews, including pre-contract security assessment and periodic reassessment of critical suppliers.

  • Complete customer and partner security questionnaires; assemble evidence packages for audits, insurers, and M&A due diligence.

Identity & Access Management (IdAM)

  • Implement, support, and troubleshoot Identity and Access Management (IdAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.

  • Administer and maintain identity security platforms and directories (e.g., Okta, Password Safe).

  • Design and enforce secure remote access.

  • Partner with the identity team on SSO coverage and lifecycle so SaaS access follows the joiner/mover/leaver process rather than around it.

Google Workspace & SaaS Security

  • Own the security configuration of Google Workspace: admin console hardening, context-aware access, 2SV enforcement, Drive external sharing controls, Gmail threat protection and routing rules, DLP policies.

  • Govern third-party OAuth application access — review, approve, restrict, and periodically re-review what has been granted access to corporate data.

  • Monitor Workspace alert center and audit logs; investigate and escalate anomalous access, sharing, and configuration change.

  • Extend the same discipline to the broader SaaS estate: inventory sanctioned applications, review security configuration at onboarding, and identify shadow IT.

Cloud Security

  • Operate the cloud security posture platform (Wiz) across GCP/AWS/Azure: coverage, policy tuning, and triage of misconfigurations, exposed workloads, and toxic combinations.

  • Route findings to the accountable engineering owner with enough context to act, and track them to closure against defined SLAs.

  • Review cloud IdAM configuration — over-permissive roles, standing access, unused credentials, key hygiene.

  • Contribute cloud security requirements to new architecture and provide secure-by-default baselines that teams can adopt without a consultation.

  • Partner with the network and endpoint security functions on shared telemetry, logging coverage, and detection gaps.

Security Assessments

  • Plan and execute recurring internal security assessments against the control framework.

  • Coordinate third-party penetration tests and external audits: scoping, scheduling, access, evidence, and readout.

  • Own the finding lifecycle end to end — validation, owner assignment, remediation tracking, retest, and closure. A finding is not closed because it was assigned.

  • Maintain a single consolidated view of open findings across all sources (pen test, audit, cloud posture, vulnerability scanning, assessments) so remediation is prioritized once, not five times.

  • Support security awareness programs and phishing simulation where they intersect with control requirements.


Communication

  • Write clearly and for the audience. Policy, findings, risk narratives, and evidence summaries are the primary output of this role — writing quality is a core requirement, not a soft skill.

  • Explain a finding in terms of business impact and required action, not tool output. An engineer should be able to read the ticket and act without a meeting.

  • Give the Director an accurate picture without prompting — what is closing, what is stuck, what needs escalation or a risk decision.

  • Present assessment and compliance status to stakeholders across the business units at a defined cadence, showing trend and decision rather than raw counts.


Ownership & Accountability

This is stated explicitly because it is the primary filter for this role. The successful candidate:

  • Owns the outcome, not the ticket. Nearly every fix belongs to someone else — driving it to closure still belongs here.

  • Follows up without being reminded, and escalates with a recommendation when follow-up stops working.

  • Verifies rather than assumes. Remediation is confirmed by retest, not by an email saying it was handled.

  • Keeps the evidence current continuously, so audits and insurance renewals are a retrieval exercise rather than a fire drill.

  • Raises the uncomfortable finding, including when it lands on an internal team or a senior stakeholder.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in information security, with demonstrated ownership of a GRC program or a substantial portion of one.

  • Technical knowledge in designing and implementing Identity & Access Management (IdAM) and Privileged Access Management solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud security posture management (Wiz or comparable tool) and practical understanding of cloud IdAM and misconfiguration risk in at least one major provider.

  • Administration or security-configuration experience with Google Workspace (or comparable enterprise SaaS suite), including sharing controls, DLP, and OAuth app governance.

  • Experience running or supporting security assessments, audits, and penetration tests, including evidence production and remediation tracking.

  • Working knowledge of at least one control framework — NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or PCI DSS — applied in a real environment rather than studied.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive remediation through teams that do not report to you.

  • Strong technical writing. Candidates should expect to provide a writing sample.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


Preferred

  • CISSP, CISA, CCSK, CISM, or cloud provider security certification.

  • Experience administering and maintaining security platforms such as Okta, Password Safe, Crowdstrike, Wiz, Palo Alto XSIAM, and ExtraHop.

  • Scripting for evidence collection and reporting automation (Python, PowerShell, or equivalent).

  • Experience with cyber insurance underwriting questionnaires or M&A technology due diligence.

  • Experience in media, broadcast, or another 24x7 operational environment.

  • Familiarity with vulnerability management and endpoint security tooling (CrowdStrike) as a consumer of their output.


First-Year Success Measures

Timeframe

Expected Outcome

 

90 days

Policy library and risk register inventoried and current-state assessed; Wiz, Workspace, and IdAM configurations baselined against benchmark; consolidated open-findings view established; relationships built with each remediation owner.

6 months

Control framework crosswalk complete and evidence mapped; exception governance running with dated, owned entries; cloud, Workspace, and identity findings closing against SLA with measurable backlog reduction; third-party risk review process operating at onboarding.

12 months

Audit, questionnaire, and insurance evidence produced on request without a scramble; at least one full internal assessment cycle and one external test completed with findings closed or formally accepted; measurable reduction in external Drive exposure and over-permissive cloud/IdAM roles; risk register reviewed in a standing governance forum with business participation.


Working Conditions

  • Occasional participation in incident response and after-hours escalation.

  • Periods of elevated workload around audit, assessment, and insurance renewal cycles.

  • Occasional travel to sites/facilities.

  • Hybrid/Atlanta office onsite expectations.
