job.title: Systems Operations Architect
job.description:
Systems Operations Architect

Reports to: Director, Systems Operations & Cybersecurity 

Direct reports: None. Design authority for the systems estate; works alongside the Lead Systems Engineer and through matrixed engineers in the business units.

Location: Atlanta / Hybrid 

Position Summary

This is the deepest technical seat on the systems team. It owns how the platform estate is designed — directory and identity infrastructure, virtualization and compute, storage and data protection, and the Windows and Linux operating environments — and it owns whether that design holds up when something fails.

The role has no direct reports and no authority over matrixed engineers or application owners. It leads through design authority, technical credibility, and follow-through. On a lean team it is also a working role: the architect builds the proof of concept, writes the automation, joins the maintenance window, and takes the escalation when a recovery is not going as documented.

Depth is the point of this position. It is not a role for a generalist who reviews vendor reference architectures. The successful candidate can defend a design decision under questioning, explain the failure behavior of their own cluster design, and has personally recovered something important under time pressure.

The Director owns budget, vendor contracts, policy, and executive reporting. The Lead Systems Engineer owns day-to-day operational execution and the team queue. This role owns the architecture being right, the recovery actually working, and the estate not accumulating debt faster than it retires it.

Key Responsibilities

Directory & Identity Infrastructure

  • Own Active Directory and Entra ID architecture: forest and domain design, trust model, sites and replication, DNS, and hybrid identity synchronization.

  • Own the tiered administration model — administrative tiering, privileged access workstations, clean-source principle, and the roadmap to eliminate standing domain-level privilege.

  • Own Group Policy and configuration architecture, and the migration path toward modern management where it makes sense.

  • Own certificate services (ADCS) design: hierarchy, templates, autoenrollment, lifecycle, and the plan for what breaks when a CA expires.

  • Design service account and machine identity architecture — gMSAs, credential rotation, and integration with the privileged access management platform tools. 

  • Partner with the identity function on Okta integration, authoritative source of truth, and authentication flow design across on-premises and SaaS.

Virtualization, Compute & Storage

  • Own VMware vSphere/vCenter architecture: cluster and failure-domain design, HA and DRS policy, admission control sizing, host lifecycle, and storage presentation.

  • Own the hypervisor platform strategy, including the Broadcom licensing trajectory. Evaluate alternatives on cost, risk, and migration effort, and give the Director a defensible recommendation — including the option to stay.

  • Design storage architecture for the platform estate — capacity, performance tiering, replication, and the interaction with media storage where they meet.

  • Own capacity planning and hardware refresh cycles; make the buy case with data rather than vendor projections.

  • Design the hybrid and cloud IaaS footprint (GCP, AWS, Azure) — landing zone, connectivity, workload placement criteria, and migration path.

Data Protection & Recovery

  • Own backup and recovery architecture end to end: coverage, immutability, air-gapped or logically isolated copies, retention, and replication topology.

  • Define recovery tiers with real RTO and RPO commitments per workload, agreed with the business rather than assumed by IT.

  • Design and prove the ransomware recovery capability — isolated recovery environment, clean-room restore procedure, and AD forest recovery. Own the runbook and lead the exercise.

  • Establish restore testing as an architectural requirement with published results. A backup platform that has never been restored at scale is an unvalidated assumption.

  • Own disaster recovery design for critical platform services, including dependency mapping so recovery order is known before it is needed.

Operating Environment (Windows & Linux)

  • Own standards, hardening baselines, and golden images across Windows Server, Windows endpoints, and Linux (Ubuntu) distributions (CIS Benchmarks / DISA STIG as the reference).

  • Own patch architecture across both OS platforms — tooling, ring strategy, maintenance window design, exception handling, and emergency patch capability.

  • Own configuration management and infrastructure-as-code direction (Terraform, Ansible, DSC or equivalent) and drive the estate toward declarative, repeatable builds.

  • Own OS lifecycle and end-of-support planning so migrations are scheduled work rather than compliance emergencies.

  • Design provisioning and decommissioning so systems enter and leave the estate with their monitoring, backup, patching, and inventory records correct.


Technical Leadership

  • Set the engineering standards the systems team builds to; review designs and significant changes before they ship.

  • Serve as top technical escalation for platform incidents alongside the Lead Systems Engineer, and lead recovery on the hard ones.

  • Own the postmortem for system architecture-related failures and drive corrective actions to closure.

  • Mentor engineers and grow the bench so the team is not single-threaded — including this role.

  • Coordinate matrixed engineers and application owners on shared work: agree on outcomes, publish expectations, follow up until closed.

  • Act as the Director's technical delegate in vendor and architecture review sessions.

  • Support audits, assessments, and cyber insurance questionnaires with accurate architectural detail and evidence.

Communication

  • Write clearly. Designs, standards, runbooks, and recovery procedures are deliverables of this role, held to the same standard as the engineering.

  • Produce architecture-grade documentation: requirements, constraints, alternatives considered, failure modes, and migration path. Not diagrams alone.

  • Present and defend architecture to technical peers, and translate the same decision into cost, risk, and business impact for executives.

  • Communicate during incidents and recoveries on a defined cadence: what is known, what is not, what is being done, when the next update comes.

  • Give the Director an accurate picture without prompting — what is on track, what is slipping, what needs a decision.

Ownership & Accountability

This is stated explicitly because it is the primary filter for this role. The successful candidate:

  • Owns the design and its consequences. A failure caused by an architecture decision is an architecture problem, not an operations problem.

  • Verifies rather than assumes. Recovery is proven by restoring, redundancy by failing over, and hardening by testing — not by reading the documentation.

  • Surfaces bad news early, with a recommendation attached.

  • Does not defer to a vendor SE for a decision this role should be making.

  • Retires technical debt deliberately rather than documenting it and moving on.

  • Does not let something fall because it sat outside the job description.

Architecture-Grade Depth

Candidates should be prepared to whiteboard, without notes:

  • An AD tiered administration model, and specifically how it interrupts credential theft and lateral movement.

  • A vSphere cluster design with stated failure domains and the admission control math behind the host count.

  • An AD forest recovery from backup — order of operations, what goes wrong, and how long it actually takes.

  • A ransomware recovery design: where the immutable copy lives, how the clean room is built, and how you know the restored data is trustworthy.

  • A patch architecture spanning Windows and Linux with rings, SLAs, and a credible exception process.

  • A hybrid identity design across AD, Okta, Google Workspace and Entra ID — where authority lives and what breaks when the sync stops.

  • A certificate hierarchy and the blast radius when a CA or a widely deployed certificate expires unnoticed.

Depth in several of these with genuine working competence in the rest is acceptable. Surface familiarity across all of them is not.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise systems engineering, with 3+ years in an architect or principal-level role.

  • Expert-level Active Directory: design, hardening, tiering, and remediation at enterprise scale — not administration alone.

  • Deep design and operational experience with VMware vSphere/vCenter, including storage and failure-domain design.

  • Demonstrated ownership of backup, recovery, and DR architecture, with real recovery experience under pressure. Candidates should expect to be asked about a restore that went badly.

  • Genuine competence in both Windows Server and Linux at the architecture level. This role cannot be filled by a Windows-only or Linux-only engineer.

  • Patch and configuration management design across a mixed estate, with automation and infrastructure-as-code (PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Ansible or equivalent).

  • Experience operating in a 24x7 environment where downtime is externally visible.

  • Working understanding of identity and privileged access platforms (Okta, BeyondTrust or comparable PAM) as an integration partner.

  • Track record of leading technical work through people who do not report to you.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • VCP/VCAP, Microsoft (Windows Server, Entra ID), RHCE, or equivalent depth demonstrated by work history; CISSP a plus.

  • Experience executing a directory, hypervisor, or backup platform migration.

  • Experience with a data center or facility build, migration, or consolidation.

  • Experience supporting broadcast, playout, or media asset management infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with hardening frameworks (CIS, STIG) applied in production rather than studied.

  • Media, broadcast, or another 24x7 operational background.

First-Year Success Measures

Timeframe

Expected Outcome

90 days

Current-state architecture documented across directory, virtualization, and data protection; unrecoverable or untested workloads identified and ranked; standing privilege and single points of failure catalogued; working relationships with application owners and business-unit engineers.

6 months

Target-state architecture and roadmap approved; hardening and build standards published and applied to new systems; recovery tiers defined with business-agreed RTO/RPO; at least one full recovery exercise completed with results reported honestly.

12 months

Demonstrated recovery capability against stated objectives, including an AD forest recovery exercise; measurable reduction in standing privileged access and in unsupported operating systems; hypervisor platform strategy decided and underway; provisioning and patching largely automated; team cross-trained with no single points of failure.


Working Conditions

  • Participates in an on-call rotation; serves as senior escalation for major platform incidents and recoveries.

  • Maintenance windows, migrations, and recovery exercises regularly fall outside business hours.

  • Occasional travel to sites/facilities.

  • Hybrid/onsite expectations.

job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Infrastructure Project Manager Job ID 10161707 Location Anaheim, California, United States Business Disney Vacation Club Date posted Oct. 15, 2026 Infrastructure Project Manager Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Summary You will oversee all maintenance, planning, and project management for all facilities occupied by the Disney Vacation Club (DVC) Cast and Guests at Disneyland Park and Resort areas. We are looking for a project manager with a construction/engineering background with negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Exceptional project management and experience in project execution. You will report to Manager, Infrastructure Planning and Development. What You Will Do Manage the development, implementation and closeout of all aspects of infrastructure projects, throughout the life cycle of the project. This includes project development, budgeting, site walks, punch walks and maintenance of all job files. Oversee scope development, bid process, contract management, incorporating operational requirements, project scheduling, establishing a critical path to ensure schedule execution, and providing prompt and detailed communication with both the contractors and operational partners, during the life of the project. You will help resolve any issues that may occur promptly and avoid cost changes by developing cost-effective options for resolution. Responsible for all operational aspects of DVC Cast workspaces, which include security, custodial, maintenance, safety regulatory requirements, environmental programs, and vendor management. As well as all maintenance is required to maintain the upkeep and show standards of DVC kiosk, sales centers, and Cast back-of-house areas. Required Qualifications & Skills 3+ years experience in planning, project management, or a similar field Basic knowledge of: Building construction practices and materials Project management processes and purchasing/contract management, including phasing of project schedule. Construction finance (budgets, capital vs. expense). You will make decisions to manage project budgets. Experience with Microsoft Office, SharePoint, and Smartsheet/other project management tool Preferred Qualifications Experience with Computer Aided Design (CAD) and Bluebeam Revu Education Bachelor's Degree in construction/project management or related engineering field (Civil, Electrical, etc.) or equivalent experience Degree in Architecture, Engineering or Construction Management is preferred PMP Certification is preferred ﻿ Additional Information Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities, and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more about our benefits and perks at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits . The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. Job Summary: Job Requirements BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. How will you contribute to our magical experience? The Sr Analyst, Finance (Temp position - 7 months) will join the team to support the planning, forecasting, reporting and analysis of Regional Overhead Expenses across Latin America. The role is responsible for preparing financial deliverables, monitoring expense performance, supporting business partners, and providing timely and accurate reporting to regional and U.S. finance teams to support decision-making and financial objectives. The Sr Analyst, Finance will be responsible for: Prepare AOP, Forecast, LRP and Quarterly Close deliverables for Regional Overhead Expenses, including G&A and Security. Provide financial planning, reporting and analytical support to Corporate Citizenship, Corporate Communications and Human Resources teams as a Finance Business Partner. Manage regional T&E budgets, including budget consolidation, actuals tracking, variance analysis and management reporting. Prepare and maintain BI reports and dashboards to support expense monitoring and decision-making. Prepare quarterly forecasts for overhead expense allocations and monitor actual results against plan. Coordinate and prepare recurring and ad hoc financial reports, schedules and deliverables required by U.S. Corporate Finance teams, ensuring accuracy and timely submission. · Support FP&A activities related to payroll expenses and headcount planning, including forecasting, budget management, variance analysis and workforce reporting. What we need from you to be part of this story: Bachelor´s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance or related fields. +3 years of experience in FP&A roles. Preferred industries: Entertainment, Technology, Finance or Consulting. Team player, highly responsible and dedicated. Strong analytical and logical skills. Solid proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Power BI and AI Tools (Copilot, Claude) are a plus. Advanced level of English. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Executive Assistant, Marketing Technology & Operations Job ID 10163192 Location Burbank, California, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 Executive Assistant, Marketing Technology & Operations Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements ** This role sits in our Burbank, CA offices, and this person is required to be on-site 4 days/ week** About the Role & Team: The enterprise Marketing Technology & Operations team is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and enthusiastic Executive Assistant to support the Head of Marketing Technology & Operations and a Vice President. This role will help drive leadership effectiveness, team connectivity, and operational alignment. Through proactive coordination and sound judgment, the Executive Assistant helps the team operate efficiently and deliver against key business priorities. Responsibilities: Calendar and Schedule Management : manage day-to-day meetings, long-term planning, ongoing schedule optimization Meeting Coordination and Reporting : book conference rooms, issue meeting requests through Outlook, coordinate agenda and other handouts, print items for meetings, send emails, take meeting notes and follow-up with attendees Travel : Arrange executive air travel, lodging, ground transportation, remote offices/access and other travel logistics Manages Travel and Expense (including understanding of company expense policies) and creates expense reports and reconciles credit card account as needed. Coordinate administrative tasks for full team such as book team meetings, order supplies and processing invoices Create and maintain team documents as requested Supports departmental projects, as needed Interacts with internal senior executives and their offices and external partners as needed. Occasionally creates presentations using Keynote, Google Docs or MS Office Suite and spreadsheets using Excel, Google Spreadsheets Maintains standards of strict confidentiality with respect to all matters and documents Promotes teamwork both internally and externally, works exceptionally well with executives, staff, and external associates Assists with departmental tasks, including conference room requests, team events, employee recognition efforts, offsites Support onboarding of new team members and foster a collaborative, inclusive culture within the Marketing Technology & Operations organization. Identify opportunities to enhance team efficiency, streamlining administrative workflows, improving tools and templates, and enabling better coordination across teams. Required Qualifications & Skills: At least three (3) years of professional experience in an administrative, coordinator, marketing, communications, entertainment, or related role. Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic administrative partner within a high-performing marketing organization, anticipating needs, managing competing priorities, and driving solutions. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with experience supporting presentation development and executive communications. Working knowledge of Ai tools such as Copilot and Claude Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft polished correspondence and marketing materials. Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with experience managing multiple concurrent priorities tied to deadlines, launches, and events. High level of professionalism, discretion, and judgment when working with sensitive information, talent, and senior leadership. Proactive, adaptable, and calm under pressure in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment. Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across different departments. Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $80,700.00 to $$108,100.00 per year based on a 40- hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Sr Mgr, Product Management Job ID 10155788 Location Burbank, California, United States / Orlando, Florida, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Oct. 22, 2026 Sr Mgr, Product Management Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements Department Description: At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. The Enterprise Technology mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence. Team Description: We are looking for a strategic, technically fluent Sr. Product Manager to drive product vision and execution across emerging technology discovery, AI-powered automation, and intelligence products that help senior and executive leadership navigate Disney's technology landscape. This role sits at the convergence of innovation and enterprise impact: equal parts strategic thinker and hands-on product leader. You will lead discovery, roadmap strategy, requirements development, and cross-functional delivery. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in AI and automation product management, is comfortable engaging directly with senior stakeholders, and has genuine curiosity about the frontiers of emerging technology and what they mean for a large, complex enterprise. What You’ll Do: Discovery & Product Delivery Lead discovery sessions, process mapping, and structured analysis to identify high-ROI automation opportunities in support of the technology transformation program. Balance innovation with practical business judgment, prioritizing solutions that deliver measurable value while remaining scalable, maintainable, and cost-effective over time. Distinguish processes that can be automated as-is from those requiring redesign, and guide engineering teams accordingly. Model end-to-end workflows (capturing pain points, exception paths, data dependencies, and human decision inputs) and translate them into clear requirements for engineering and AI/ML teams. Define vision, KPIs, personas, use cases, and user journeys for tools & products, author high-quality PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Deliver scalable automation solutions that integrate with enterprise systems and architectural patterns, working closely with engineering, AI/ML, and platform partners. Emerging Tech & Transformation Intelligence Product Own the product strategy and roadmap for an internal intelligence platform that gives technology and business leadership visibility into Disney's capability landscape, technology investments, and transformation progress. Translate complex organizational data (capability assessments, technology evaluations, portfolio signals, and benchmarks) into intuitive, executive-facing product experiences. Define requirements for features such as maturity dashboards, technology radar views, capability mapping, and portfolio analytics. Partner with strategy, data engineering, and architecture teams to federate data sources and surface them through coherent product surfaces. Actively engage senior and executive stakeholders to understand how they consume and act on technology portfolio information; incorporate that feedback into product decisions. Emerging Tech Scouting & Strategy Stay current on advances in emerging technologies; evaluate their relevance and applicability to Disney's enterprise context. Work closely with the internal teams to de-risk and validate emerging capabilities before scaling. Synthesize insights from research, conferences, and vendor evaluations into product strategy recommendations for the team and leadership. Contribute to the team's internal tech radar and knowledge base, keeping the organization's emerging tech stance current and actionable. Product Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Manage and mentor product team members, fostering a culture of user-centricity, rigorous thinking, and continuous improvement. Build and maintain a clear, prioritized product backlog, informed by user feedback, business strategy, and organizational goals. Establish and track product KPIs (including ROI, cycle-time reduction, error reduction, executive adoption, and employee satisfaction) using data to guide roadmap evolution. Communicate product strategy, timelines, and impact to technical and non-technical audiences including senior leadership and cross-functional partners. Facilitate cross‑functional partnerships to align priorities through structured discussions and clear decision framing. Help drive adoption of new product capabilities and workflows through clear documentation, enablement, and change support. Required Qualifications & Skills: 10+ years in product management, ideally with experience across both enterprise automation products and executive- or leadership-facing analytics / intelligence platforms. Proven experience partnering directly with VP-, SVP-, or executive-level stakeholders to define strategy, prioritize investments, and influence decision-making. Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle (from discovery and research through launch, measurement, and iteration) on complex, data-intensive products. Strong technical foundation; able to engage substantively with engineering and AI/ML teams on architecture, data models, and system design tradeoffs. Hands-on familiarity with generative AI technologies (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering) and their practical application in enterprise settings. Demonstrated experience building products or tools that surface data, insights, or recommendations to senior or executive stakeholders. Experience driving organizational adoption of new products, AI capabilities, or workflow changes, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and success measurement. Experience with process analysis, automation, or operational excellence programs, including the ability to translate messy workflows into clear product requirements. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to present strategy, product outcomes, and complex tradeoffs to senior leadership. Comfortable navigating organizational complexity, building cross-functional alignment, and influencing without direct authority. Strong attention to detail paired with big-picture strategic thinking; able to zoom in and out fluidly. Familiarity with human-centered AI design principles and responsible AI practices. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building or owning portfolio management, capability management, or technology strategy products. Background in enterprise architecture, business capability modeling, or technology taxonomy development. Experience with technology maturity models or benchmarking frameworks. Experience developing technology evaluation frameworks, technology radars, innovation pipelines, or enterprise experimentation programs. Familiarity with enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), BI tools, and/or AI/ML infrastructure. Expertise in driving process improvement or operational transformation initiatives at scale. Required Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a comparable field of study and/or equivalent work experience required. MBA or advanced degree a plus. #TECHATDISNEY Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $191,300 - $256,500 per year and in Orlando, FL is $182,200 - $244,300 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Worldwide Services, Inc., which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (Corporate). To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Worldwide Services, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs . We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished. Job Summary: Job Requirements About the Role & Team Through innovative storytelling and a culture of collaboration, Disney Live Entertainment creates, produces, and delivers remarkable and engaging entertainment experiences. From the intimate to the spectacular, our work can be seen at Disney theme parks, resort hotels, cruise ships and other locations the world over. This diverse team – representing a wide variety of disciplines and talents from technical directors, writers and lighting designers to choreographers, cosmetologists, and music producers – brings magical worlds to life through technical expertise, performance excellence, incomparable ingenuity, unparalleled spectacle… and a dash of pixie dust. With a strong understanding of Video Design theory and practice, the Associate Video Systems Designer provides technical design expertise in the areas of media playback, routing and displays technology. If selected for this role, you will report to the Manager-Video Systems Design. This is a Casual Temporary role with no guarantee of weekly working hours, as hours will fluctuate based on business needs. What You Will Do Participate in project’s creative development, functioning as a consistent interface between creative and technical with regard to media playback/quality of media delivered by media development Define scope by identifying system needs and functions based on creative goals Close partnership with technical direction and other design disciplines, to include working closely with CAD department to ensure 3D modeling requirements are met/delivered to media development Work closely with the media provider to work out show timing and cueing requirements for the show system Work with all disciplines closely to ensure all show timing is correct to requirements of the show Develop/execute video system designs for live shows and facility infrastructure as assigned Design appropriate systems for shows and/or facility infrastructure that address ship operational needs Create design drawings: plans, line, layouts, 3D pre-visualization, occlusion assessment, BTU/power/weight load estimates, etc. Participate in the creation of design package as a living document assembled along with the show development and production from initial concept and pitch phase Research video and projection technologies in support of design effort Receive, organize, and place all show content onto the show media servers and is familiar with multiple media serves and the ability to program them Oversee the installation, test & adjust and programming of required elements Provide support through programming, training, rehearsals and opening of show Provide an integrated structure throughout the entire process of development through implementation of live show entertainment product, and development of equipment and labor budgets Work with procurement, technical direction, and production to comply with company buying standards and schedule of receiving equipment/products/etc. Assist technical direction staff with video integrator management, factory acceptance testing and site acceptance testing Support design progress through buy off, procurement, installation, and test & adjust, programming, rehearsals and opening, concluding with as-built documentation for operating partners at the venue Conduct ongoing entertainment show quality evaluations (ASQA Reports) of existing entertainment offerings to assist with maintaining the original entertainment show intent and exceptional quality Required Qualifications & Skills 3+ years experience in video systems design in live show/theatrical production, live event production, technical, and/or stage management production Strong understanding of current technology and industry standards for all aspects of Video Design (theatrical, industrial, concert, cinematic, etc.) as applied to live show and facility infrastructure systems Advanced experience with most video delivery systems, such as front and rear projection, LED monitors and screens, and high-powered projectors Advanced comprehension of the various formats for video content creation and compatible delivery systems in both file delivery and live delivery environment, and understanding of SMPTE standards Demonstrated understanding of video distribution and routing systems, including advanced network setup, advanced signal flow, file management, and advanced Video programming methods Able to work well under pressure with a variety of personalities while maintaining an open and positive perspective that reflects confident professionalism and an unconditional dedication to providing consistently superior products and services Demonstrated ability to work closely with Technical Director(s) and Video crew to prioritize, organize, instruct and problem-solve during installation, content integration and programming Ability to read and understand architectural blueprints and interpret electrical drawings Aptitude for collaborating with other Designers, Directors, Writers and Producers as part of creative process Possess excellent communication skills; highly motivated; can accept direction easily Proficiency with CAD drafting programs both 2D and 3D Demonstrated ability to deliver on a Project’s established scope, schedule and budget General understanding of 3D and UV workflow Demonstrated commitment to stay current with video display delivery systems technology, and research & development efforts within industry as well as with content formatting requirements and basic content creation parameters Ability to work flexible hours - nights, weekends, holidays Must possess a passport and be responsible for a corporate credit card for travel purposes Willingness to travel on domestic and international assignments, as needed P referred Qualifications Knowledge of Industry Standards Fluency in any additional languages is a plus Education College degree or equivalent work experience in the technical aspects of Video/Broadcast Production, or Theater Arts and its associated skills, with focus on job.title: Product & Technology Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Product & Technology Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 Job ID 10163573 Location Glendale, California, United States / San Francisco, California, United States / New York, New York, United States Business The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 Product & Technology Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements About the Role & Program: Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. What You Will Do… Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performing applications, services, and platforms that power Disney’s streaming, advertising, and digital experiences Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, product, design, and data partners to bring new features from concept to production Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, and contribute to code reviews and technical discussions Work with APIs, data, and distributed systems to deliver reliable and efficient solutions at scale Help debug, optimize, and improve performance of existing systems, ensuring a seamless experience for users Contribute to system design, documentation, and architecture conversations, gaining exposure to real-world engineering challenges Support the deployment and monitoring of applications, including logging, metrics, and observability improvements Continuously learn new technologies and tools, applying them to enhance products and workflows Play a role in building experiences that reach millions of users globally across Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, and beyond Areas of placement may include: Ad Platforms – The Ad Platforms team builds and operates Disney’s industry-leading advertising technology, powering monetization and innovation at a global scale across Sports, News, and Entertainment. This team designs and delivers the solutions that enable advertising across Disney’s streaming ecosystem, connecting content, audiences, advertisers, and partners through reliable, data-driven platforms. It’s a space where technology, creativity, and impact come together to drive meaningful business outcomes for Disney and its advertising clients Locations of placement for this team include: Glendale, CA San Francisco, CA Santa Monica, CA Seattle, WA Product Engineering - The Product Engineering organization powers the platforms, infrastructure, and products behind Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, and more. Working at the intersection of storytelling and technology, this team plays a critical role in creating seamless, reliable, and world-class streaming experiences. As part of Product Engineering, you’ll go beyond building features—you’ll help shape how millions of people experience Disney every day, with opportunities to do meaningful, high-impact work at scale. Locations of placement for this team include: Bristol, CT Glendale, CA New York, NY San Francisco, CA Santa Monica, CA Seattle, WA Required Qualifications & Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, Go, or Scala Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented or functional programming Experience working with APIs and web services, particularly RESTful APIs and JSON-based communication Understanding of software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), testing, debugging, and writing clean, maintainable code Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex technical challenges and systems Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, product, and design teams Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to new tools and technologies Detail-oriented and quality-focused mindset, with a commitment to building reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems Preferred Qualifications: Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and cloud-native development practices Experience with microservices, distributed systems, or large-scale, high-availability platforms Familiarity with databases and data systems (SQL, NoSQL, data modeling, large-scale data platforms) Experience with frontend frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript) or full-stack development Exposure to DevOps and infrastructure tools (CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.) Understanding of observability practices (logging, monitoring, performance optimization) Interest or exposure to AI/ML, personalization systems, or data-driven product experiences Education: Currently enrolled undergraduate student in an accredited college/university, pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Information Technology or related field. Recruitment Timeline: The Summer 2027 Software Engineering internship program offers multiple positions, running from May/June 2027 through August/September 2027. Candidates whose skills and experience align strongly with the requirements for a specific internship will be contacted directly regarding opportunities for this season. Communication with applicants will occur at various times between November and January, and candidates will receive updates throughout the selection process. Eligibility Requirements & Program Information: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class in the semester/quarter (spring/fall) prior to participation in the internship program AND returning to school the semester/quarter following the internship OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or Disney College Program Additional Information: Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship Fully available from M-F, 40 hours each week for the entire program duration: May/June - August/September 2027 (12 weeks) Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The pay rate for this role in Glendale, New York City, Bristol, Santa Monica, Seattle, and San Francisco is $43 per hour. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits, visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. Job Summary: Job Requirements About the Role & Team Through innovative storytelling and a culture of collaboration, Disney Live Entertainment creates, produces, and delivers remarkable and engaging entertainment experiences. From the intimate to the spectacular, our work can be seen at Disney theme parks, resort hotels, cruise ships, and other locations the world over. This diverse team – representing a wide variety of disciplines and talents from technical directors, writers and lighting designers to choreographers, cosmetologists, and music producers – brings magical worlds to life through technical expertise, performance excellence, incomparable ingenuity, unparalleled spectacle… and a dash of pixie dust. The Costuming Project Management Office (PMO) aligns project outcomes with Disney Live Entertainment's strategic business objectives. While our clients produce highly-crafted and innovative costumes that enhance Disney storytelling, we create our own form of magic by helping teams navigate complex challenges, improve the way work gets done, and transform ideas into results. The Business Analyst supports this mission by partnering with stakeholders to understand business needs, evaluate opportunities, and define solutions that drive informed decision-making and continuous improvement. If selected for this position, you will report to the Senior Manager - Projects & Initiatives. This is a Casual Temporary/Seasonal role with no guarantee of weekly working hours, as hours will fluctuate based on business needs. What You Will Do Support costuming with new business processes, feasibility, and business case definition Gather requirements for various workflows Perform business process modeling Provide business change management support Ensure work is aligning to business standards Provide project support Run reporting and create automation from multiple sources Required Qualifications & Skills Minimum two years of experience working on project teams Experience with hands on report development and sustainment utilizing business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Smartsheet or SQL Skilled in project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or MS Project Prior experience translating complex data and analytics into compelling business stories Ability to collaborate and work through compromises that result in win/win agreements and outcomes Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage partners at all levels both internally and externally Experience working in a fast-paced environment with competing tasks Willing to travel between various work locations in a given day Ability to work around all types of fibers, fabrics, and synthetic furs Schedule availability to work flexible hours including weekends, nights, and holidays Ability to travel domestically & internationally up to 10% of the time Preferred Qualifications Experience with Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Costuming and/or products Education High School Diploma or equivalent required Benefits & Perks Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities and special extras that only Disney can provide. Learn more about our benefits and perks at https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits . #DLEJobs Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $46,080 to $61,740 per year based on a 24 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs Energy Plant Services Manager-Reedy Creek Energy Services Job ID 10162527 Location Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States Business Walt Disney World Resort Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 Energy Plant Services Manager-Reedy Creek Energy Services Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: Job Requirements “We create happiness.” That’s our motto at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts, and it is reflected in everything we do. At Disney, you will help create the conditions that enable our teams to push boundaries, deliver innovative solutions, and build the never-before-seen. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact? The Energy Plants Services Manager is a key member of the Energy Plants and Maintenance Operations team within the Reedy Creek Energy Services (RCES) organization. RCES Cast Members support the Central Florida Tourism Oversight District (CFTOD) by operating and maintaining CFTOD owned utility systems serving the Walt Disney World (WDW) Resort. In this role, you will provide leadership to the Cast Members who operate the energy plants across the WDW Resort. You will also provide operational ownership of the mechanical and electrical systems within assigned central energy plants, including chilled water, hot water, compressed air, and associated utility distribution systems. You will report to the Sr. Manager, District Plants and Utility Maintenance Operations. This is a full-time, second-shift position scheduled from 2:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. and based on-site in Orlando, Florida. What You Will Do Lead the safe, reliable, and efficient daily operation of energy plants that provide chilled water, hot water, and compressed air services to the WDW Resort. Plan, budget, coordinate, and complete preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment outages, and non-routine work within approved financial and operational requirements. Champion a proactive safety culture through visible leadership, active engagement, and accountability in support of the commitment that no one gets hurt. Lead, coach, and support a team of unionized Cast Members responsible for operating and maintaining assigned energy plants and utility equipment. Coordinate with RCES partners, Engineering, project teams, and contractors on equipment repairs, plant improvements, and capital projects performed within active operating facilities. Procure repair parts, operating supplies, and specialized services needed to maintain assigned assets and support plant reliability. Partner with internal clients to align plant capabilities, operating conditions, service expectations, customer requirements, and planned outages. Provide accurate and timely operating information to Engineering to support equipment evaluations, system modifications, capital planning, and plant upgrades. Prepare and maintain accurate regulatory, environmental, safety, and operational compliance documentation and reports. Provide coaching, performance feedback, and development support to help Cast Members build capability and advance their career goals. Required Qualifications and Skills Eight (8) or more years of progressive experience in planned work, maintenance planning, scheduling, coordination, and execution for plant, utility, or industrial equipment, including experience supporting chillers, air compressors, hot water boilers, and related plant support equipment. Possess an Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Section 608 Universal Certification or obtain the certification within 90 days of hire. Demonstrated experience leading teams through operational, organizational, or process change. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Cast Members, leaders, clients, contractors, and other internal and external partners. Proficiency with SCADA and Human Machine Interface (HMI) systems used to monitor, operate, and control mechanical utility plant equipment and systems. Proficiency using an Enterprise Asset Management system to procure parts, supplies, and outside services; manage maintenance activities and personnel; document completed work; and coordinate preventive maintenance programs . Ability to work safely and effectively in varied environments, including outdoor locations and active industrial plant settings. Availability to work outside scheduled hours in response to operational demands, equipment availability, planned outages, and system or equipment emergencies. Preferred Qualifications Experience using Maximo for Utilities or a comparable Enterprise Asset Management system. Working knowledge of applicable ASHRAE guidelines and standards. Understanding of plant control and communication systems, utility distribution systems, and critical-path activities within an energy plant environment. Education · Bachelor's degree in engineering, facilities management, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience, is preferred. Additional Information Benefits and Perks: Disney offers a rewards package to help you live your best life. This includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities and special extras that only Disney can provide. Job Summary: Job Requirements Job Summary: The Walt Disney World Resort is looking for a full-time Registered Radiologic Technologist (RTR) delivering X-Ray tasks and general clinical activities associated with an Occupational Health Clinic. The work environment is fast-paced, and you will work side-by-side in a highly collegial, cooperative team management setting that requires frequent communication, intra-team consistency and close cooperation. You will report to the Occupational Manager for Radiology. You Will/Responsibilities X-Ray Support : · Maintain and use equipment and supplies necessary to demonstrate portions of the human body on X-Ray film for diagnostic purposes · Perform X-Rays on patients · Handles the complete process from obtaining images, sending imaging, receiving results, and routing results to appropriate provider · Perform Quality Assurance of images and review incoming radiology reports · Work with radiology vendors to maintain equipment · Maintain radiology exam logs and work with radiology reading facility · Maintain radiology protocols · Manage lead shielding standards Clinical Support : · Reviews providers’ schedules and prepares for patient visits. This may include follow up on all prior testing and results to expedite physician review and streamline patient flow · Assists Provider for Initial Exams, Re-check Appointments, Medical Surveillance/Regulatory Compliance exams and other types of Occupational Clinic Provider visits · Calls patient back into exam room, performs intake processes and preps patient for physician exam (including conducting preliminary medical tests - Snellen Eye tests, grip strength measurements, range of motion studies). · May assist in coordinating outside referrals for diagnostics, treatments (i.e. physical therapy) and specialist providers in the fulfillment of external Provider orders. · May request medical records from other providers as appropriate · Performs other medical treatment in accordance with training, certification and provider orders · Provides patient education and instructions as directed by physician · Complete all documentation and quality checks to reduce chance of omission and errors · Ensure timely discharges for patients by printing and providing appropriate paperwork and next step directions · Physical demands require frequent walking, standing, sitting and light lifting (less than 15 lbs.) · Occasional stooping and bending and frequent fine fingering/handling/reaching (side, overhead, low) YOU WILL HAVE/QUALIFICATIONS • Valid, non-expired Florida X-Ray Certificate is REQUIRED • ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) Certification is REQUIRED • Graduate and Certificate from Radiologic Technology • Current CPR certification • Flexible work schedule including working evenings, weekends, Holidays and occasional overtime • Active and clear Florida Drivers’ License Preferred Qualifications • 1-3+ years of experience in a fast-paced clinical setting • Prior experience in working with an electronic Scheduling and Medical Record System • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite Required Education • High School Diploma or equivalent • Non-Expired Florida X-Ray certificate is REQUIRED • Graduate and Certificate from approved program in Radiologic Technology • Current CPR certification • ARRT Certification • Active and clear Florida Drivers’ License Disclaimer PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $63,100-$84,500 per year. job.description: Keywords Location Search Jobs ABC News Publicity Intern, Spring 2027 Job ID 10160865 Location New York, New York, United States Business Disney Entertainment Television Date posted Oct. 23, 2026 ABC News Publicity Intern, Spring 2027 Apply Now Save Job SHARE Facebook LinkedIn Email WhatsApp Links open in new tabs. Job Summary: About the Role & Program: Are you passionate about news and media? Do you want to learn and grow with America’s most trusted news source? Are you a reliable, curious, go-getter excited about storytelling? An internship with the ABC News Publicity department offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting high-profile programs and connecting with audiences across multiple platforms. You’ll join a team of professionals in a fast-paced environment where interns play a vital role and are relied on every day. With curiosity, dedication, and a willingness to jump in, you’ll learn on the job, build valuable connections, and develop skills that can shape your future career in news and media. The ABC News Publicity department manages all media relations and internal and external communications for ABC News and its programs and platforms, including World News Tonight with David Muir , Good Morning America , Nightline , 20/20 , This Week with George Stephanopoulos , The View , Tamron Hall , GMA3 , ABC News Live, ABC News Studios, ABC News Digital, ABC News Audio, and ABC NewsOne. We handle press outreach, social media, and publicity campaigns to ensure our content reaches audiences effectively across all platforms. What You Will Do: Compile and edit daily press clips, reporter media lists, and correspondent, anchor, and executive bios; support and lead coverage reports for ABC News Studios projects, including gathering press clips for documentary releases. Support and lead extensive clip tracking during breaking news or PR crisis situations. Maintain social media accounts, creatively disseminate program information, and design graphics using Canva. Assist with awards submissions by coordinating invitations, tracking RSVPs, and managing follow-up communications. Assist during virtual and in-person events, including occasional evenings and weekends. Participate in brainstorming and publicity strategy meetings, write press releases and loglines, and manage weekly status reports and highlights documents Required Qualifications & Skills : Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced environments, especially within a news organization. Hands-on, proactive mentality, and willingness to take on any task to support the team. Dependable, responsive, and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Proficient in MS Office Suite and Canva; familiar with Muck Rack and social listening tools (Sprout, Sprinklr, or similar). Previous media or PR experience; flexible to support evening/weekend coverage and handle sensitive information with discretion Excellent writing, verbal, and interpersonal skills, collaborating effectively across departments and levels. Preferred Qualifications & Skills: Basic knowledge of Adobe/MailChimp Existing knowledge of media and news Proficient in using and navigating ChatGPT and other AI tools Education: Junior or Senior year. Senior preferred Major or previous coursework in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or related major preferred Eligibility Requirements & Program Information Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements: Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship. Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program. Be at least 18 years of age Possess unrestricted work authorization Additional Information Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 until June 2027 Fully available from Monday through Friday for the duration of the internship, 40 hours each week Able to provide own housing for the duration internship program The pay rate for this role in New York is $23.00 per hour. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits. Apply Now Save Job About Disney Entertainment Television: Disney Entertainment Television is a collection of renowned content brands at The Walt Disney Company creating original entertainment and news programming for the company’s streaming platforms Disney+, Hulu and Star, and its broadcast and cable networks. Its extensive portfolio is comprised of ABC Entertainment, ABC News, ABC Owned Television Stations, Disney Branded Television, Freeform, FX, Hulu Originals, National Geographic Content and Onyx Collective, in addition to Disney Television Studios, which include 20th Television, 20th Television Animation, ABC Signature and Walt Disney Television Alternative. Responsible for over 4,500 hours of programming a year across more than 300 programs of all genres, Disney Entertainment Television’s creative brands are at the forefront of groundbreaking storytelling, captivating audiences and generating critical acclaim. In 2023, Disney Entertainment Television’s programming excellence earned 163 Emmy® nominations across daytime, primetime, news & documentary, and children’s & family categories. job.title: Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)
job.description:
Account Executive (Regular Full-Time)

FOX Television Stations—FOX10/FOX10Xtra | Phoenix, AZ

Are you a driven, results-oriented sales professional and a skillful relationship-builder who thrives in a collaborative environment? If so, we are looking for a proactive business development professional ready to make an immediate impact within a fast-paced, innovative culture. Join a team where critical input and new ideas are essential, all while enjoying the career stability that comes with working for a highly successful, well-known industry leader.

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, we lead the Phoenix television market by broadcasting the highest volume of local news and complimented with the most watched live sports (NFL, MLB, NCAA, NASCAR, INDY, and more). Beyond our broadcast footprint, we provide sophisticated, best-in-class Digital and OTT/CTV offerings. We are looking for a strategist who can weave these assets into comprehensive, omnichannel marketing solutions, enabling clients to achieve measurable results throughout the marketing plan.

The FOX10 Phoenix Sales Team has an excellent opportunity for an experienced Account Executive focused on driving revenue through an omnichannel approach, with a primary emphasis on bringing brand-new video advertisers to Phoenix’s leading local television station.

Why Join Us?

  •  Work in a fast-paced environment where teamwork is paramount. We brainstorm together, support one another's strategies, and celebrate our collective successes.
  • Collaborate with accomplished media professionals to drive revenue and elevate your omnichannel sales approach.
  • You will have the opportunity to work alongside top talent in the market, utilizing advanced technology and advertising platforms.

Job Summary

  • Assume primary responsibility for actively prospecting, developing, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline focused heavily on converting brand-new video advertisers who have not traditionally utilized TV or premium streaming.
  • Design and present omnichannel campaigns, seamlessly integrating traditional linear broadcast, Fox Local Extension (FLX) OTT, Fox Local News (FLN), and our digital/mobile platforms to address client challenges.
  • Source new sales opportunities through a combination of researching potential accounts, initiating outbound communication, and following up on inbound leads.
  • Maintain a consistent presence in the field to develop relationships, conduct needs-analysis meetings, and present the benefits of our complete video portfolio.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (sales management, FLX, marketing, and creative services) to develop custom presentations that highlight the utility of our solutions.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the competitive media landscape, OTT platforms, and a clear understanding of the characteristics that give FOX10 a competitive advantage.
  • Manage client advertising initiatives and create impactful post-campaign recaps, providing actionable recommendations to further optimize client ROI.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proactive Business Development: Experience managing high-volume sales activity in a B2B environment. You excel at identifying untapped opportunities and consulting with new clients to demonstrate how video can achieve their business objectives.
  • Digital Video Advertising, Broadcast Sales, and/or Agency experience is preferred.
  • Team-Oriented Approach: You naturally build rapport with both clients and colleagues. You recognize that collaboration drives success and actively contribute to a positive workplace environment.
  • Omnichannel Expertise: You manage your time efficiently to meet deadlines, and you have a strong grasp of how traditional broadcast and digital/OTT video work together to create an effective marketing funnel.
  • Proven Track Record: You thrive in a metrics and results-driven sales culture. You are skilled at conveying technical information, addressing objections, and preparing professional presentations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and account management skills are required. Proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Varied hours, weekends, holidays, and local travel are required. Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and a valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • College degree (or equivalent work experience) and a minimum of 1 to 3 years of sales experience is required.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Package: Excellent health benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. 401k with company match.

Additional Details

  • The on-target earnings for this position are $100,000-$110,000 annually.
  • Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and have a valid, local driver’s license.
  • Local travel and entertainment are required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours and overtime as needed.
  • FOX 10/Fox 10 Xtra Phoenix is a 24/7 operation.

If you have proven success in digital and ad sales and have the skills and experience to excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Director, Technology Business Operations
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service. Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise. Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms. At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX's direct-to-consumer product and technology organization powers FOX One, FOX Sports, FOX Nation, and FOX News digital experiences across mobile, connected TV, and web platforms. We are seeking a Director, Technology Business Operations to lead the strategy, systems, and processes that connect technology investments, resource planning, and software capitalization. 


Reporting to the VP of Product Operations, you will establish a reliable, scalable source of truth that enables leadership to understand where engineering resources are invested, measure associated costs, and make informed decisions about future investments. In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner with Program, Engineering, Finance, Controllership, Internal Audit, and People Systems to modernize how labor and investment data is captured, classified, analyzed, and reported. You will also drive the development of AI-assisted workflows and automation that improve accuracy, strengthen audit readiness, and reduce administrative effort. The ideal candidate combines financial and operational expertise with strong technical fluency, a systems-oriented mindset, and the ability to translate complex data into simple and actionable business insights. You will play a critical role in building an operating model that is accurate enough to withstand external audit, insightful enough to guide strategic investment decisions, and streamlined enough to integrate naturally into how teams work.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive technology business operations strategy spanning software capitalization, investment planning, resource analytics, and operational governance.
  • Own and continuously improve software labor capitalization methodologies, ensuring clear distinctions between capitalizable development and non-capitalizable activities, including maintenance, research, operations, and support.
  • Partner with Controllership, Internal Audit, and external auditors to establish capitalization policies, internal controls, evidence standards, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Drive audit readiness and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce findings, shorten audit cycles, and minimize manual evidence collection.
  • Develop investment and resource planning models that connect labor costs to technology initiatives, products, platforms, and business outcomes.
  • Deliver financial and operational analyses that inform annual planning, quarterly business reviews, capitalization forecasts, and strategic investment decisions.
  • Evaluate resource allocation scenarios, including employee versus contingent labor, build-versus-buy decisions, platform versus product investments, and capacity planning.
  • Own the multi-year roadmap for systems, data models, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities that support labor tracking, classification, financial reporting, and investment analytics.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and People Systems to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and implement scalable solutions across Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, and related platforms.
  • Design and implement AI-assisted workflows for classification recommendations, anomaly detection, audit evidence assembly, and planning analytics, with appropriate human oversight, traceability, and controls.
  • Partner with the VP of Product Operations to streamline information flow across teams, systems, identify opportunities to eliminate redundant reporting, simplify workflows, and reduce administrative burden for engineering teams and leadership.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 10+ years’ experience in technology business operations, software capitalization, technical accounting operations, engineering finance, or technology investment planning within a complex, multi-product technology organization.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling cross-functional systems, processes, and operating models across Finance, HR, and Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software development capitalization practices, financial controls, audit requirements, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience developing financial and operational models that connect technology investments, labor costs, resource allocation, and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and technical capabilities, including hands-on experience with SQL, business intelligence and analytics tools such as Tableau or Amplitude, and advanced spreadsheet modeling. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You proactively seek out the information, context, and relationships you need to move work forward rather than waiting for them to come to you.
  • Experience working with enterprise HRIS, financial, and software development systems, including Workday, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, or comparable platforms. 
  • Ability to generate artifacts and products from insights that are simple to use and enable executive decision making, yet solid enough to withstand audits and internal reviews. 
  • Practical experience designing or implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation, with an understanding of data integrity, human oversight, and audit risk.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, establish appropriate controls, and determine where automation can improve operational accuracy and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of how software engineering organizations plan, prioritize, develop, and deliver products across multiple platforms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, demonstrated ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and drive organizational change without direct reporting authority.
  • A user-centered, continuous improvement mindset. 
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience supporting software capitalization processes through external financial audits.
  • Experience developing technology investment frameworks or resource optimization models across multiple digital products and platforms.
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer streaming, digital media, or subscription-based technology businesses.
  • Experience implementing AI agents or intelligent automation within financial operations, technology governance, or enterprise planning workflows.
  • Experience integrating data across HRIS, financial planning, engineering work management, and business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience building operational capabilities or governance frameworks from the ground up in a rapidly evolving technology environment.

An integral part of the Production & Operations Finance team, the Senior Financial Analyst helps manage the Rockefeller Center Operations (RCO) budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for Capital and Space Allocations as well as ad-hoc financial analysis.

Here you can:

  • Consolidate and report actuals, quarterly estimates, strategic and operating plans (LRP and Budget), and related variances vs budget.
  • Coordinate monthly closes for the Finance Manager, including helping to process recurring journal entries and helping to manage the actuals vs. budget reconciliation. 
  • Perform standard and special analyses that provide insightful views into the operations and financial performance for RCO, as well as a point of contact for resolution of financial questions with operating and FP&A partners.  
  • Ownership and maintenance of Facilities space allocations
  • Create ad-hoc financial reports and models to support evolving business needs.
  • Working closely with RCO Project Management team to build capital budget plans
  • Creating/Updating/Maintaining files to assist with budgeting & tracking of expenses
  • Looking for opportunities to build/enhance current models
  • Answering ad hoc requests as necessary
  • Maintaining up to date finance process documentation
  • Posting monthly/quarterly allocations, cross charges, & intercompany transfers
