  • 2+ years of experience in Finance
  • Must be proficient with MS Office Suite products – particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Knowledge of SAP or similar application preferred

  • Exceptional financial modeling and analysis skills, with experience in forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate summarized and concise financial information to key stakeholders including operations, controllership, FP&A, and senior leadership
  • Team Player with the ability to function in a cross functional environment and willingness to jump into projects to meet department goals
  • Ability to quickly grasp new concepts and problem solve independently
  • Excellent organization and time management skills; ability to deliver on multiple project assignments, meet tight deadlines and be effective under pressure
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills
  • Continuous improvement attitude, ability to seek out and implement best practices
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

job.title: Senior Data Product Manager- eCommerce
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We seek an experienced and driven Sr. Data Product Manager – eCommerce within the Global Data & Analytics Products team.

As AI transforms how businesses operate, trusted data products become even more critical. In this role, you will ensure UMG's eCommerce data products are AI-ready by design—governed, semantically consistent, well-documented, observable, and trusted—enabling analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and generative AI applications to reliably consume enterprise data at scale. You'll also embrace AI as part of your own product management practice, using modern AI tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration while maintaining a relentless focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

You are passionate about treating data as a product and building trusted, scalable data foundations that enable decision-making across UMG. You understand that great data products require more than pipelines—they require clear ownership, reliability, governance, usability, and stakeholder trust.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of enterprise eCommerce data products and data marts that serve as authoritative sources of truth for digital commerce performance. These products will power reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, AI applications, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making across UMG’s direct-to-consumer ecosystem.

You will partner closely with eCommerce business leaders, Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Governance teams to define, build, and continuously improve trusted data products that are reliable, discoverable, and broadly adopted across the organization.

You will champion product management principles within the data ecosystem, ensuring eCommerce data products have clear roadmaps, service levels, semantic definitions, documentation, quality standards, and measurable business outcomes.

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Product Management (Data Platform).

How you’ll CREATE:

  • Champion AI-ready data products by ensuring trusted business definitions, semantic consistency, metadata, lineage, documentation, observability, and governance are embedded into every data product.
  • Ensure enterprise data products are designed to support emerging AI capabilities, including semantic retrieval, intelligent agents, recommendation systems, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Partner with eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, and Analytics stakeholders to define trusted business metrics, KPIs, and data definitions.
  • Define scalable dimensional models and semantic layers that support entities such as sales, orders, customers, products, subscriptions, marketing attribution, fulfillment, and customer lifecycle reporting.
  • Establish authoritative data products that serve as the source of truth for digital commerce performance across brands, labels, and regions.
  • Partner with enterprise tech & business teams to standardize the global data layer for digital ecommerce
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Global Insights, and AI teams to identify opportunities where trusted consumption data products can enable artist forecasting, audience segmentation, fan engagement, trend detection, catalog optimization, and intelligent decision-support.
  • Drive standardization of business definitions for metrics such as revenue, orders, conversion, customer acquisition, repeat purchase, AOV, LTV, refunds, subscriptions, and marketing performance.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement SLAs, monitoring, observability, incident management, and operational support processes.
  • Establish and maintain data contracts with upstream commerce platforms and source systems to improve reliability and predictability.
  • Drive adoption of eCommerce data products through business-friendly documentation, semantic models, stakeholder enablement, and training.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve data product usability and business outcomes through AI-enabled capabilities while maintaining strong governance, privacy, and data quality standards.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience supporting enterprise eCommerce, direct-to-consumer (D2C), retail, or digital commerce organizations.
  • Experience delivering data products that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or generative AI initiatives
  • Strong understanding of common eCommerce business processes, including product catalog, pricing, promotions, customer lifecycle, order management, fulfillment, subscriptions, and returns.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or other modern commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, BigCommerce, or custom commerce ecosystems.
  • Shopify experience Preferred
  • Experience working with customer, order, product, marketing, and transactional datasets.
  • Understanding of digital marketing and attribution concepts, including paid media, email, CRM, customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Demonstrated experience owning data products throughout their lifecycle, from strategy and requirements through adoption and operational support.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate product discovery, documentation, analysis, and collaboration.
  • Strong understanding of the data foundations required for enterprise AI, including dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, data marts, semantic layers, and modern analytics architectures.
  • Experience in defining and managing data quality frameworks, governance standards, and operational reliability practices.
  • Experience in establishing and managing data contracts and cross-functional data ownership models.
  • Strong SQL proficiency preferred, with the ability to independently validate requirements and investigate data issues.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and stakeholder value.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills.
  • Strong systems thinker with a customer-centric product mindset.
  • Knowledge of the music and label business is a plus.

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team: 

Homemade / WMX is Warner Music Group’s merchandise and e-commerce services division, focused on helping artists connect with fans through merchandise, physical music, touring, VIP ticketing, retail, licensing and direct-to-consumer experiences. We work at the intersection of creativity and commerce, partnering with artists, managers, and label teams to build thoughtful, high-quality products and experiences that fans care about, and marketing them to drive revenue and add value to our clients business. From artist stores and limited-edition vinyl to tour merchandise and global retail programs, we treat merch and physical products as meaningful extensions of an artist’s creative vision. Homemade / WMX combines the global scale of Warner Music Group with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach. We value collaboration, ownership, and curiosity, and we’re building a forward-thinking team that’s excited to evolve how artists reach and engage their audiences.


Your role: 

As Vice President, eCommerce Solutions & Deployment, you will oversee the practical implementation, technical configuration, and deployment of e-commerce capabilities across 150+ artist stores, flagship properties, and global megastore concepts. This role requires a combination of strategic solution design and tactical execution across multi-store environments operating under tight timelines. You will bridge commercial needs and technical execution by partnering directly with Central Tech for technical build needs, while working closely with the Operations team to ensure every deployment seamlessly connects with fulfillment, customer service, and post-purchase workflows. 


Here you’ll get to: 

  • Architect and roll out pragmatic technical solutions across Homemade's multi-store e-commerce platform, enabling fast, repeatable, and stable store deployments across all active webstores.
  • Co-own operational link to Central Tech, along with head of e-commerce operations, translating campaign requirements and artist needs into actionable platform configurations and deployment specifications.
  • Work in lockstep with the Operations team to ensure all front-end store setups align smoothly with backend fulfillment mechanics, call center workflows, and inventory systems.
  • Lead high-stakes deployment initiatives, including global Megastore launches, key artist site rebuilds, and rapid-turnaround merchandise drops.
  • Identify and resolve deployment bottlenecks, site performance issues, and user journey friction across the global e-commerce portfolio.
  • Build and mentor a team of high-performing e-commerce operators focused on site deployment, front-end optimization, and technical execution.
  • Drive digital excellence across storefronts by optimizing user journeys, checkout flows, and post-purchase email integrations in collaboration with Digital Merchandising and Audience teams.
  • Evaluate and integrate pragmatic third-party e-commerce tools, apps, and partner solutions in collaboration with Business Development to drive fan engagement and conversion.
  • Drive user journey optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) across all webstores.
  • Partner with D2C Analytics to build and maintain a robust analytics engine to track site performance, conversion health, and user behavior, embedding data-driven decision-making across all store deployment projects.
  • Collaborate with the Audience & CRM teams to build optimal post-purchase email flows and digital touchpoints that enhance fan engagement.
  • Partner with the company leadership to identify, evaluate, and integrate strategic third-party partners and innovative commerce tools to elevate the overall fan experience.

About you: 

  • You have deep hands-on expertise in complex, multi-store e-commerce environments (e.g., Shopify Plus, headless architectures, multi-region/currency deployments).
  • You have a proven track record of managing multiple fast-turnaround projects simultaneously under tight deadlines with high flexibility and adaptability.
  • You are highly skilled at cross-functional collaboration, acting as the bridge between technical engineering (Central Tech), day-to-day fulfillment/logistics (Operations), and marketing/merchandising teams.
  • You enjoy solving complex front-end user experience friction and translating complex technical requirements into actionable solution roadmaps.
  • You excel at cross-functional execution, serving as a seamless connector between Central Tech engineering teams, Operations and fulfillment partners, and commercial label leads.
  • You possess a strong track record of applying pragmatic e-commerce tactics to improve site performance, conversion rates, and user experience.

We’d love it if you also had:

job.title: Go-to-Market & Industry Marketing Manager
job.description:
AccuWeather is expanding its Marketing team and looking a Go-to-Market & Industry Marketing Manager to join its growing team. The Go-to-Market & Industry Marketing Manager supports the execution of AccuWeather's go-to-market strategy across priority industries and strategic growth initiatives. This role partners closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to develop industry-specific messaging, customer stories, sales enablement materials, campaigns, webinars, and market-facing programs that accelerate enterprise growth. 

The ideal candidate is an execution-oriented marketer who enjoys translating customer insights and business strategy into repeatable go-to-market programs. This individual will help operationalize industry marketing initiatives, support multiple strategic growth priorities, and continuously improve how AccuWeather brings solutions to market. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Industry Go-to-Market Execution 

  • Support execution of go-to-market programs across priority industries, including Retail, Manufacturing, Transportation & Logistics, Energy, Insurance, Healthcare, and other strategic growth markets.  
  • Develop and maintain industry messaging, value propositions, customer stories, and sales collateral.  
  • Create and maintain industry landing pages, webinars, campaigns, nurture programs, and supporting marketing assets.  
  • Support industry-specific product launches and commercialization initiatives.  

 

Customer & Market Intelligence 

  • Conduct customer interviews, market research, and competitive analysis to support go-to-market planning.  
  • Monitor industry trends, emerging customer needs, buying center evolution, and competitive positioning.  
  • Translate market insights into messaging, campaign recommendations, and customer-facing content.  
  • Maintain industry personas, use cases, and supporting documentation.  

 

Sales Enablement 

  • Develop sales plays, battle cards, presentations, customer proof points, and enablement materials.  
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development to support strategic account planning and executive meetings.  
  • Ensure customer-facing messaging remains consistent across campaigns, presentations, and outbound programs.  
  • Support development of case studies, testimonials, and industry-specific success stories.  

 

Campaign & Program Execution 

  • Execute industry webinars, customer panels, conference follow-up campaigns, and thought leadership initiatives.  
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Creative Services, and Digital Marketing to deliver integrated campaigns.  
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities supporting strategic growth initiatives.  
  • Support AI-assisted marketing workflows and identify opportunities to improve campaign execution through automation.  

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Creative Services.  
  • Support multiple strategic initiatives as business priorities evolve.  
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of AccuWeather's go-to-market processes and marketing effectiveness. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.  
  • 4–7 years of experience in B2B Marketing, Industry Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Go-to-Market roles.  
  • Experience developing customer-facing marketing content and sales enablement materials.  
  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and customer journeys.  
  • Excellent written communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.  
  • Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously.  
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer and market insights into actionable marketing programs.  

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS, APIs, data, AI, or technology solutions.  
  • Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot.  
  • Familiarity with AI-powered productivity and content development tools.  
  • Experience supporting webinars, conferences, customer advisory boards, or executive events.  
  • Experience working with vertical marketing programs and enterprise sales organizations.  

 

About AccuWeather 

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making. 

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones. 

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee. 

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally. 

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

To help us do this work, The Times is hiring a Director of Media Relations & Communications to support rapid response and issues management communications throughout the organization. You will advance and defend the reputation of the New York Times and its employees by creating and executing media relations strategies during emerging issues and high-stakes situations. You will be part of a team that develops and executes comprehensive rapid response strategies, handles complex media inquiries, and provides expert counsel to senior leadership on sensitive communications matters. The ideal candidate possesses exceptional judgment, a deep understanding of the media landscape, strong writing and communication skills, and the ability to thrive under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

This is a hybrid role based either in our New York City headquarters or our Washington, San Francisco or Los Angeles bureaus, reporting to the Executive Director of Media Relations and Communications. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week. This position requires regular after hours, weekend and on-call work.

Responsibilities:

You will draft and rapidly disseminate accurate, consistent, and impactful statements, Q&As, talking points, and other communications materials under tight deadlines.

Issues Management: Working with colleagues across the communications team, you will develop and execute comprehensive issues management communications plans, collaborating with internal subject matter experts to gather accurate information and develop informed responses to complex issues.

You will also be responsible for reporting on your efforts in collaboration with the communications operations team.

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of increasing experience in media relations, public affairs, or corporate communications, with a significant focus on rapid response and issues management.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
Producer, Radiolab 

Radiolab is seeking a full-time Producer to join the team. Radiolab producers take ideas from pitch to broadcast, participating in all parts of the production process. The Producer will spend much of their time deep in tape, sorting through vast amounts of audio, crafting the arc of the episode in ProTools, and building out the story. They will work closely with the editorial team, making new drafts of episodes. Sometimes the Producer will work on ideas they’ve pitched; oftentimes they’ll produce other team member’s work. The Producer will help craft the soundscape of the show. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Regularly produce episodes from pitch to broadcast with minimal support

  • Find, pitch more ambitious, nuanced, and successful story ideas

  • Develop the arc of an episodes and craft narratives, with minimal editorial support

  • Executing notes from editors on new drafts of episodes

  • Cut interview selects and tracking tape

  • Source archival tape

  • Research for story ideas, booking guests, arranging logistics (ie ISDN, travel)

  • Pre-interview, book potential guests, engineer in-studio interviews and tracking

  • Perform field reporting and/or recording

  • Conceive of storyboards with the team 

  • Write narration and craft the sound design/soundscape of episodes.

  • Create new drafts of episodes in ProTools, experimenting relentlessly with story construction

  • Liaise with fact checker for episodes

  • Write and produce content for web, newsletter, and other platforms as needed


Key Qualifications:

 

  • At least five years experience producing, reporting and/or editing in long-form narrative audio, and/or comparable experience in a related field

  • Preferably has experience creating stories similar to the ones heard on Radiolab

  • Has a clear grasp of what makes a surprising, impactful and complicated story that could be heard on Radiolab

  • Has a proven ability to develop story arc and narrative

  • Has solid journalism skills including: interviewing, database research and fact checking

  • Has experience with linear editing software (ProTools, Logic, et cetera), and an advanced understanding of sound design

  • Sense of humor and musicality are a plus

 

It's important on the Radiolab team for everyone to work hard, be willing to pitch in on whatever is needed to get the job done, have an open mind, demonstrate integrity in their journalism, be wildly curious, and not be afraid to be a little bit weird.


Additional Information


This is a full-time non-exempt position with a salary range of $87,771-$95,000 and includes eligibility for medical, dental and vision insurance through SAG-AFTRA.

  

This role is based in New York City and is expected to work at our NYC Headquarters  two days per week.

 

This position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement between New York Public Radio and SAG-AFTRA.


Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion


New York Public Radio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We continuously strive to place our employees at the center of our thinking and elevate inclusive practices to develop and support a more engaged and productive workforce. Our journalism and operations in the service of that journalism benefit from a broad range of perspectives, from all backgrounds, at all levels of the organization. Diversity is essential to honest, authentic, accurate storytelling and reportage; creating an institution in which all voices are encouraged, valued, and heard.

Equal Opportunity


New York Public Radio is an equal opportunity employer committed to achieving the goal of equal employment opportunity for all. Applicants and employees are considered and evaluated for positions without regard to mental or physical disability, race, creed, color, religion, gender, national origin, citizenship status, age, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, employment status or any protected federal, state or local status unrelated to the performance of the work involved. 


About Radiolab:


Created in 2002 by host Jad Abumrad, and now co-hosted by Lulu Miller and Latif Nasser, Radiolab began as an exploration of science, philosophy, and ethics using innovative composition and sound design. Radiolab has expanded and evolved to become a platform for long-form journalism and storytelling. The show challenges its listeners’ preconceived notions about how the world works. Radiolab provokes, it moves, it delights, and it asks its audience to see the world around them anew. 

 

In the past year, the show released a series on a Guantanamo Bay detainee named Latif Nasser; covered the pandemic (by looking at the present and the past); composed an experimental non-narrative meditation on the end of the world; reported out topical stories on the power of protest (here and here, too), the risk of Donald Trump trying to steal the election, the responsibilities of the police (and lack thereof); and escaped to the bottom of the sea to spend time with an octomom.

 

Since its founding nearly two decades ago, Radiolab has won some of the most prestigious awards in journalism, including two George Foster Peabody Awards, Third Coast awards, The Silver Gavel, as well as other accolades. In 2011 Abumrad received the MacArthur Genius grant. The show has spawned successful spinoff series, like More Perfect, Gonads, The Other Latif, G, Border Trilogy, and Radiolab for Kids.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Senior Software Engineer — Content Tools

Content Tools •  CoCounsel Legal Integrations

Overview of the Role

The CoCounsel Legal Integrations team within Thomson Reuters is seeking Senior Software Engineers to join the Content Tools team in building purpose-built APIs that give AI agents precise, governed access to TR’s proprietary legal content across various international jurisdictions. These tools are the bridge between TR’s authoritative content and the AI products, such as CoCounsel Legal, that depend on them, and they carry high stakes — every result must be accurate and grounded in TR’s authoritative content. This is a full-ownership engineering role on a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys, and operates the production content APIs that agentic workflows rely on.

The team’s operating principles are non-negotiable: you own what you build end-to-end, from the first commit to the production dashboard. You ship to production constantly, and you treat delivery friction as an engineering problem to solve, not a fact of life. You use AI-assisted development as a primary tool, with the expectation that the majority of code is written with AI assistance. And you practice verified spec-driven development: you write the acceptance criteria and utilize evaluation datasets that specify a tool’s behavior before you build it, and that eval suite gates every change in CI. Senior Engineers own a tool, subsystem, or content domain end-to-end, hold design-decision authority within their scope, serve as the team’s subject-matter expert in at least one area, and mentor more junior colleagues. This is a role for someone who takes genuine pride in the quality, reliability, and pace of their work.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

Content Tool Engineering

  • Design, develop, and own Content Tools end-to-end: the APIs and retrieval components that let agents query TR legal content through precise, well-documented, contract-driven interfaces, for example, jurisdiction-specific tools spanning legal content across multiple geographies

  • Build API-first: every tool ships with a versioned contract, schema, and ownership metadata so consuming teams and agent developers can use it self-service, without needing to ask you how it works

  • Design retrieval components for agentic use: respect explicit latency budgets across multi-hop chains, shape result payloads with token economy in mind, and build clean tool boundaries that give agent orchestrators predictable interfaces

  • Build and tune the retrieval and search behind the content tools in collaboration with our research scientists from TR Labs — improving relevance and ranking quality on our Vespa based search platform.

  • Practice verified spec-driven development: write the acceptance criteria and utilize evaluation datasets that define a tool’s behavior before you implement it — the eval is the spec — then build the eval suite, gold data, and CI gates that verify every change

  • Work in the team’s core stack — Python, FastAPI, and Pydantic on AWS, search in Vespa, with CI in GitHub Actions and observability in Datadog — building agent tools on the Claude Agent SDK and exposing them to agents over MCP (Model Context Protocol), and contributing to the shared libraries, generators, and patterns that help the whole team build tools correctly

Reliability & Operations

  • Participate in the on-call rotation and take end-to-end ownership of incidents in your scope — triage, root-cause analysis, clear communication, and post-mortems that surface systemic fixes; you built it, you run it. Write and improve the runbooks for your areas.

  • Treat delivery friction as a bug: a slow deploy, a flaky test, or a painful local workflow is a problem worth fixing, because the team’s ability to ship constantly depends on every engineer pushing back on friction

  • Instrument your components with structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing; for agentic retrieval paths, capture tool-invocation sequences and per-hop inputs so non-deterministic failures can be diagnosed and reproduced

  • Define and monitor SLOs for the tools you own, and treat fast, safe delivery as part of the job rather than a trade-off against reliability

  • Use AI-assisted development tools fluently across your workflow — generation, review, testing, debugging, — and model effective patterns for the team

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Take technical direction for your tools with design-decision authority within your scope; break product and customer requirements into work the team can execute, and provide technical input on feasibility rather than only receiving tasks

  • Serve as the team’s go-to subject-matter expert for at least one content domain or tool family; provide domain-expert review on high-risk PRs and mentor more junior engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching

  • Work with our R&D division (TR Labs) and research scientists — alongside them, not receiving handoffs — to bring new retrieval capabilities into tools in a well-tested, observable, responsible way

  • Build working relationships with CoCounsel Engineering and product owners:

  • Capture decisions in writing through project-level ADRs, and communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Champion ethical AI and secure, responsible engineering across your work

About You

You’re a fit for the Senior Software Engineer role if you bring:

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, developing, and testing production backend, API, or data-infrastructure systems, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of features and components

  • Mastery of Python and strong fundamentals, including API design and a rigorous testing discipline (unit, integration, and evaluation) — you write high-quality production code and test everything you ship

  • Solid distributed-systems knowledge: you understand the failure modes of services, queues, and datastores and design systems resilient to them

  • Proficiency with AWS cloud services , Datadog and CI/CD practices (Blue/Green, Canary deployments); you ship small PRs frequently with fast feedback loops

  • Demonstrated operational ownership: on-call participation, architectural documentation and decision records, post-mortems, and a clear philosophy that building and operating are inseparable

  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools as a primary part of your workflow — you write the majority of your code with AI assistance and use it to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality, and you own the outcome regardless of how the code was produced

  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including design documents and component documentation

Preferred Experience

  • Working knowledge of information-retrieval fundamentals (precision/recall trade-offs, hybrid search, ranking) and how low-level retrieval signals connect to downstream product quality

  • Experience building tools or APIs for agentic AI systems, including tool protocols such as MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar

  • Background in legal technology, knowledge management, or other high-stakes information domains where source attribution, accuracy, and entitlement matter

  • Familiarity with search and retrieval engines (Vespa, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch) at the level of writing queries, designing indexes, or operating clusters

  • Experience with agent and retrieval evaluation: deterministic eval suites and gold data gated in CI, red-teaming for prompt injection (e.g., Promptfoo), and tracing for LLM workflows (e.g., Langfuse)

  • Working understanding of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and container orchestration (ECS or Kubernetes), with the ability to configure and optimize CI/CD pipelines

Job Description

KeyCite is a foundational capability within Westlaw. It helps legal professionals understand and navigate legal authority with confidence, including how a case or statute has been treated over time.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, AI Engineering to build and lead a team that is evolving KeyCite for the next generation of AI-powered legal research. You will lead engineers across AI, large-scale data processing, backend services, and platform modernization. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead the team and stay close enough to the technology to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.

This role includes both modernizing a critical, long-running platform and building new AI capabilities. The work involves some ambiguity. Priorities are clear, but the approach may change as the team learns and the market evolves.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of backend, platform, and AI engineers.
  • Set technical direction. Partner with Product, Editorial, Research, and engineering teams to turn the KeyCite product vision into a scalable technical strategy and roadmap.
  • Deliver AI capabilities. Lead the development and productionization of generative AI and machine learning capabilities that help customers understand legal information and the relationships within it.
  • Modernize the platform. Evolve KeyCite's processing, publishing, and services to improve scalability, reliability, and the speed at which new capabilities ship.
  • Apply AI to complex domain problems. Work with AI researchers and legal domain experts to decide how generative AI, machine learning, and traditional software can work together in trusted professional workflows.
  • Establish engineering excellence. Set standards for architecture, reliability, observability, experimentation, testing, and AI evaluation.
  • Take ideas to production. Lead work from prototype through productionization, measurement, and continuous improvement.

job.title: Contract Administrator
job.description:
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. 

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. 

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Contract Administrator will work closely with legal, operations, accounting and production teams to review artist, venue, co-promotion, vendor, locations and sponsor agreements. Additionally, this position will work closely with Manager of Contract Administration and/or accounting team to process wire requests and deposits for artists and venues. The Contract Administrator will review venue insurance requirements per contract obligations and ensure needs are met on an event-by-event basis.

Essential Functions

  • Review and edit artist(s) contracts including issuing, mark-up, receipt and processing. Collect all pertinent information related to the agreement, clarify data points and issue to artist management team and talent buyers associated with deal.
  • Review venue, vendor, co-promotion, sponsor and location agreements. Submit edited contract to supervisor, talent buyer, or general manager of venue for approval and issue to vendor, co-promoter, or sponsor.
  • Initiate wire requests/deposits for artist and/or venue and submit for approval. Follow up with upper management for confirmation in timely manner to process with accounting department.
  • Review venue insurance for potential risks or special circumstances. Amend insurance agreement to include additional information and coverage as needed.
  • Develop and update contract process, create new ways to disseminate information from field to office. Ensure that all show files are up to date with new or revised contracts and insurance agreements.
  • May be responsible for training new employees in contract administration and creating contract templates for training.
  • May work with exhibitors ensuring paperwork is completed correctly and communicate venue information/updates as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred)
  • 2-4 years Of related work experience
  • Paralegal, legal experience preferred
  • Basic knowledge of contract administration and legal language
  • Strong attention to detail and highly organized
  • Ability to compare/analyze documentation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office programs (Excel, Outlook, Word) and Adobe software
  • Ability to prioritize, multi-task and perform well under pressure
  • Interest/knowledge of music industry preferred

Payscale: $25.50 - $26.78/hour

Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship.  AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

job.title: LN Concerts, Tour Marketing Director - Comedy
job.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com.


WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on! 


THE JOB

The Director, Comedy Tour Marketing is a critical part of the Tour Marketing team, as a strategic marketing leader and core member of the department partnering with Tour Promoters, to develop & execute innovative marketing strategy for comedy, podcast, and non-music tours.

This person will provide best in class service and foster strong relationships with both our internal teams and external partners.

They will act as a strategic partner in developing marketing plans working internally with cross functional teams – including partnering with creative strategy to lead creation of artist pitches. They will also lead marketing for special projects – developing overall marketing strategy in coordination with external partners & regional marketing team.

Bottom line, they are responsible for elevating the level of service we provide to our artist clients and partners.



WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

· Develop and execute marketing plans in conjunction with artist & project teams

· Manage onsale timelines in partnership with ticketing lead

· Cultivate & maintain relationships with external partners to provide excellent client services

· Analyze past purchaser data & use research tools to drive decisions & shape ongoing marketing strategy

· Manage marketing budgets to achieve business objectives

· Collaborate with multiple teams to successfully execute strategic integrated marketing campaigns

· Execute national promotions and oversee local promotions, both in support of individual shows and tours

· Partner with PR team to develop & execute media events and PR opportunities to support tours

· Oversee the planning of digital media campaigns across multiple platforms

· Oversee social media campaigns and promotions to drive ticket sales, awareness and fan engagement

· Oversee the production of marketing assets including: audio & video spots, key art, social content, etc.

· Effectively utilize internal marketing tools & resources, following best practices

· Manage one or more employees at the coordinator level within tour marketing department



WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

· Minimum 5-7 years marketing experience in live entertainment or industry related field – international experience a plus

· Proven track record of outstanding client relationships

· Deep understanding of the live entertainment business

· Ability to clearly communicate strategic initiatives and navigate complex situations under pressure

· Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to professionally present pitches, marketing concepts and strategies to artist teams

· Work well in a team environment

· Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines while managing multiple projects

· Ability to adapt, communicate and manage in a fast-paced environment

· Strong time management skills, excellent organization skills and attention to detail

· Creativity skills and problem-solving aptitude

· Proactive work ethic

· Passionate about live experiences

· Ability to recognize and define problems, collect information, establish facts and implement innovative solutions, tapping in key stakeholders.

· Strong Microsoft Office Suite, G-Suite skills, Box

· Ability to learn and efficiently use project management software/tools – Asana knowledge a plus

· Experience with digital asset management systems and workflows

· Experience managing marketing budgets & campaign planning

· Bachelor’s degree required

· Knowledge and interest in comedy, podcast, and non-music entertainment a plus

· Fluency in secondary language a plus


BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:


HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. 


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. job.title: Partnership Marketing & Promotions Coordinator
job.description:
Job Summary:


PARTNERSHIP MARKETING & PROMOTIONS COORDINATOR

Location: New York, NY or remote elsewhere in the US -- please note preference for EST time zone

Division: Ticketmaster

Line Manager: VP, Partnership Marketing

Contract Terms: Temporary, Part-Time, up to 15 hours per week, Flexible schedule

 

 

THE TEAM

 

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. We’re fans who help fans everywhere get into the live events they love. A proud division of Live Nation Entertainment, Ticketmaster has changed the way the world connects with their favorite artists, teams, and shows, and we continue to shape innovation every day. We’re not just selling tickets (though we do that better than anyone else), we’re enriching lives one amazing experience at a time. And we think that’s pretty amazing.

 

THE JOB

 

The Partnership Marketing & Promotions Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for promotional campaigns (e.g., sweepstakes, contests, surprise-and-delight programs, etc.) and for ongoing sponsorship asset tracking for the Ticketmaster Partnership Marketing Team portfolio of sponsorships. In addition, this role assists the Partnership Marketing team by handling day-to-day clerical work, documentation upkeep, the sweepstakes winner-process, and routine monitoring/reporting on sponsorship assets. It's important to note this is intended to be a support role, and therefore, final compliance, legal, and decisions remain with full-time Partnership Marketing staff and Legal departments at Ticketmaster.


Please note this is a temporary part-time position with a set engagement of up to fifteen (15) hours per week for a one (1) year term working on campaign launches, winner processing windows, and reporting deadlines.

  

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 

Administrative & Clerical Support

  • Maintain and organize shared files, trackers, and the promotional materials library (microsites/landing pages, partner lists, approved creative assets, affidavits etc.)
  • Schedule and coordinate stakeholder meetings; prepare agendas and distribute notes/action items
  • Data entry and upkeep of campaign trackers, budgets, and timelines in Excel/Word/PowerPoint
  • Format and proofread sponsorship & promotions documents for internal and client distribution
  • Manage routine promotions correspondence as directed by the Partnership Marketing Managers
  • Prepare, organize, and file documentation for audit and record-keeping purposes (affidavits, releases, W-9s, receipts)

 

Promotions Support

  • Support the Partner Marketing team in developing promotional plans for music & sports, live-event initiatives.
  • Build and maintain promotional campaign timelines, launch plans, channel requirements, and approval paths.
  • Compile all needed details for promotions (prize structure, eligibility, dates, entry mechanics)
  • Convert campaign objectives into clear briefs for creative, CRM, media, and partners
  • Develop copy for entry pages, social and any promotion materials
  • Submit promotional artwork requests as needed to internal creative team for development
  • Build entry pages utilizing in-house system and route
  • Assist with collecting and organizing winner documentation (Affidavits of Eligibility, Liability & Publicity Releases, Guest Releases, W-9 forms etc…)
  • Perform an initial completeness check on W-9s and releases and flag discrepancies— all final verification and legal sign-off remains with Legal and the Promotions Manager
  • Initiate and manager winner communications (notifications, status updates, document follow-ups) and secure winner affidavits and accompanying paperwork under the direction of the Partnership Marketing Manager and agency.
  • Coordinate event requirements: ticket quantities, venue details, winner communications with the Partner Marketing team and agency team
  • Monitor entry periods and help track prize procurement status, shipping logistics, and fulfillment timelines
  • Establish repeatable processes, trackers, templates, and documentation that improve campaign quality and team efficiency.

 

Sponsorship Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor sponsor assets across digital/social placements to confirm delivery against contracted terms
  • Coordinate materials for monthly partnership marketing newsletter and populate templates for deployment.
  • Assist with the audit of asset tracking links and pull and compile recurring reporting on sponsor asset performance for internal reviews
  • Support basic competitive/landscape monitoring related to competitive sponsorship activity as assigned

 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

 

  • Bachelors Degree
  • Prior experience in a marketing support, or coordinator role
  • Basic knowledge of sports marketing and sponsorship principles
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong project management skills, including timeline ownership, prioritization, follow-through, and risk management
  • Proficiency with common productivity, presentation, spreadsheet, communication, and project-tracking tools (Google, Microsoft, Canva etc.)
  • Comfortable learning new software/reporting platforms (promotion management tools, tracking dashboards etc.)
  • Clear, concise and professional written and verbal communication
  • Ability to handle sensitive/confidential documentation
  • Desire for a flexible schedule and ability to pivot on competing priorities and projects as needed
  • Familiarity with sponsorship, promotions, or sweepstakes processes a plus
  • Basic design tool familiarity (Canva, Photoshop) a plus

 

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

 

  • Passionate and motivated.
  • Driven with and by an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Resourceful, innovative, forwarding thinking, and committed.  

 

 

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

 

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

 

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

 

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. THE JOB

The Social Insights Analyst will play a key role in Live Nation Entertainment’s Concert division, living and breathing in social listening, reporting and analytics from start to finish, including query building, dashboard development and delivering reports. This role will uncover insights and trends for actionable storytelling opportunities, guide marketing strategy, and inform cross-functional partners on social, cultural, and influencer trends. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Analytics & Strategy, this position is ideal for someone who thrives in building scalable analytics systems while staying deeply connected to cultural and platform trends and developments. 

We're looking for a data-minded storyteller who lives at the intersection of social media and analytics. You'll own reporting and measurement for earned conversation tied to tours, on-sales, and artist activations. This is a great fit for someone who's equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and a comment section.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Own measurement and analysis of earned social conversation: mentions, share of voice, sentiment, engagement on non-owned posts, organic reach, and virality across Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Run social listening across tour cycles (from announcements, on-sales to live moments), tracking fan sentiment, conversation volume, and flagging shifts in real time.
  • Measure fan- and creator-generated content (UGC): what's made, how it spreads, which moments drive organic amplification, and how artists, media, and fan accounts pick it up.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports (daily, weekly, campaign-level, ad-hoc, and post-mortem), using Boolean logic to sharpen queries and insights delivery.
  • Run competitive and benchmark analysis to contextualize our performance.
  • Build alert systems for emerging artist topics, trends, and brand risks, supporting Community Management, Marketing, and PR/Comms in shaping response messaging.
  • Partner with social listening-tool vendors and cross-functional teams to improve benchmarks, KPIs, alerts, and depth of insight.
  • Uncover fan insights through audience demographics to help guide campaign planning

  • Hands-on experience with social listening and publishing tools (Meltwater, Brandwatch, Sprout, Quid, etc.) plus platform-native analytics.
  • Comfortable with audience demographic tools such as Audiense as well as platform follower demographics through CreatorIQ.
  • Fluency in earned-social metrics (share of voice, sentiment, mention volume) and a clear sense of which ones actually matter.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and a solid grasp of Boolean logic for query development.
  • Proven ability to own analytics end-to-end (query design, reporting, dashboard development and maintenance), with a track record of spotting and fixing gaps in reporting infrastructure.

  • Strong communication skills: you can turn a spike in conversation into a one-slide "so what" for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines under pressure.
  • A proactive, collaborative team player who flags insights before they're asked for and adapts to evolving leadership needs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, or a related field.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Passion for live music, touring, and artist marketing.
  • Experience with sentiment analysis, text/topic classification, or unstructured conversation data.
  • Familiarity with creator/influencer earned-coverage measurement.
  • Experience connecting earned social signals to broader marketing or fan-growth outcomes.

job.title: Vice President, Consumer Brand, Sports Portfolio - Burson
job.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Consumer Brand team partners with some of the world's most recognized sports brands, properties, leagues, and organizations to create culturally relevant communications programs that drive conversation, engagement, and business impact. We operate at the intersection of sports, earned media, entertainment, influencer engagement, athlete partnerships, and brand storytelling to help clients connect with consumers through compelling narratives, strategic partnerships, and integrated communications campaigns.

We are seeking a Vice President, Consumer Brand Sports to serve as a senior communications leader responsible for developing and executing integrated earned media and brand communications programs for a diverse portfolio of sports clients. This role will lead strategic communications initiatives that generate meaningful earned media results, elevate brand reputation, and connect clients with consumers through sports, culture, talent, and experiences across diverse consumer audiences.

The ideal candidate brings established relationships with key media outlets, publishers, journalists, producers, influencers, and industry stakeholders, along with expertise in athlete marketing, sponsorship activation, sports business trends, and culturally relevant storytelling that helps brands authentically engage consumers.

This individual will lead in the development and execution of campaigns, athlete and brand partnership programs, experiential events, press trips, and other integrated communications initiatives. They will serve as a trusted counselor to senior clients, delivering strategic recommendations, executive communications support, and compelling presentations while building long-term relationships and driving client growth.

The Vice President will manage and mentor team members, collaborate across agency disciplines, and contribute to agency growth through business development, client expansion, innovative communications strategies, and thought leadership.

The preferred locations for this role are Los Angeles (Hybrid), Southern California (Remote), or San Francisco (Hybrid).

What you'll do:

Lead Client Communications Programs

  • Develop and execute integrated earned media and communications programs for leading brands, sports properties, and entertainment clients.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, providing senior-level counsel on media strategy, reputation management, athlete partnerships, sponsorship activations, and brand storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders while proactively identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships and grow business.

Drive Earned Media Excellence

  • Leverage deep knowledge of key sports, consumer, lifestyle, entertainment, and business media outlets, publishers, journalists, podcasts, newsletters, broadcast partners, and emerging media platforms.
  • Develop media strategies that generate earned coverage, cultural relevance, and audience engagement across traditional, digital, social, and emerging channels.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with sports, consumer, lifestyle, entertainment, and business media.

Lead Athlete Activations and Experiential Programming

  • Develop and execute athlete activation programs that align with client business objectives and brand narratives.
  • Identify and manage athlete, ambassador, influencer, and talent partnerships that drive visibility and engagement.
  • Lead the planning and execution of press trips, media tours, product launches, experiential activations, sporting event programs, and marquee consumer experiences.
  • Partner closely with talent agencies, athlete representatives, leagues, teams, and industry partners to maximize program impact.

Provide Team Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and develop account teams while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and career development support to junior and mid-level team members.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across strategy, creative, social, influencer, analytics, and production disciplines to deliver integrated client solutions.

Contribute to Agency Growth

  • Play an active role in business development, including prospecting, pitch strategy, proposal development, and presentation delivery.
  • Contribute to new business opportunities by developing communications strategies and presenting recommendations to prospective clients.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through strategic counsel and innovative programming.
  • Partner with account leadership to identify organic growth opportunities, support account planning and resource management efforts, and contribute to the overall financial success of the business.
  • Represent Burson as a subject matter expert in sports communications, athlete partnerships, consumer brand marketing, and integrated communications.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • 10+ years of experience in sports communications, consumer brand marketing, earned media, public relations, or integrated communications, preferably within an agency environment.
  • Deep understanding of the consumer sports landscape, including major leagues, teams, athletes, media ecosystems, sponsorship trends, fan engagement strategies, and cultural moments that drive conversation.
  • Proven relationships with leading sports, consumer, lifestyle, business, and entertainment media outlets, publishers, and journalists.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated earned media campaigns that generate impactful coverage and measurable results.
  • Significant experience planning and executing press trips, media events, product launches, experiential activations, and large-scale event communications programs.
  • Proven success leading athlete activations, sponsorship campaigns, endorsement programs, and talent-driven consumer marketing initiatives.
  • Strong client-facing presence with exceptional presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
  • Experience counseling senior executives and marketing leaders on communications strategy, media engagement, and reputation management.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead integrated teams and collaborate effectively across disciplines to deliver business results.
  • Experience attracting, managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of agency business operations, including account management, staffing, financial oversight, and resource planning.
  • Proven success supporting and winning new business opportunities, including developing pitch strategies, presenting recommendations, and building relationships with prospective clients.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail, and sound judgment in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a strategic mindset and delivering exceptional client service.
  • A passion for sports, culture, communications, and storytelling, with a pulse on emerging trends and opportunities shaping the industry.

job.description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our growing team!  

21GRAMS, part of Real Chemistry, takes an innovative approach to advertising, and focusing on making healthcare more human.  Not just in our work, but in the way we conduct business, approach client relationships, and treat each other. It’s a place where people subscribe to the adage, “Be good to each other, but hard on the work.” A place where people are not just in it for the paycheck, but to make a dent in the universe. Sound like you? 

At 21GRAMS, we set the benchmark for excellence in healthcare project management. As trusted leaders, we build confidence through teamwork, ownership, and proactive risk management. We uphold our processes with accountability, deliver with precision, and communicate with clarity. Creative problem-solving, adaptability, and integrity define our work. Guided by purpose and collaboration, we inspire our teams to achieve best-in-class outcomes for every project.

The Senior Project Manager leads complex, integrated initiatives across channels and provides day-to-day leadership for the project team. This role balances hands-on delivery with mentoring and process stewardship.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do: 

·      Lead execution of integrated campaigns that span digital, print, events, and video.

·      Develop detailed Gantts and critical paths across multiple deliverables and vendors.

·      Anticipate risks, propose solutions, and manage change control to protect scope, timing, and margin.

·      Mentor and coach Project Managers and Coordinators. Model best practices and documentation hygiene.

·      Partner with Account to align execution to strategy and client expectations.

·      Own forecasting inputs and invoice readiness in collaboration with Finance.

Portfolio Management:

·      Oversight of approximately 5 million dollars in revenue.

·      Administrative involvement in new business and shadowing scoping.

Resource Management:

·      Own staff plan rollup inputs and updates. Plan and communicate resourcing needs.

·      Develop brand Gantts and coordinate sequencing across workstreams.

Client and Vendor Relationship Management:

·      Active in client communications for delivery topics.

·      Own vendor relationships for assigned brands.

Training, Growth, Reporting:

·      Manage team best practices, process reference documents, and onboarding tools.

·      Shadow leadership to gain foundational management skills.

Admin Operations:

·      Own day-to-day task management within Workfront and Teams.

·      Ensure program compliance across all teams on the brand.

Execution:

·      Think strategically at the brand level. Identify overlaps and staggering opportunities.

·      Drive process improvements and QA across deliverables.

Finance:

·      Create scopes and change orders. Review estimates.

·      Analyze brand-level finances, forecast, and support invoicing. Speak to finances with clients.

Culture, Comms and Collaboration:

·      Build morale. Investigate and analyze issues. Gather the right collaborators.

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

·  ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you. 

·  You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving. 

·  You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data. 

·  You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines. 

 What you should have:  

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Expert knowledge of digital and print production workflows.

• Strong skills in scoping, budgeting, resource planning, and risk management.

• Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills. 

• 5 or more years of project management experience in healthcare communications.

• Prior mentoring or supervisory experience.
